अमितानां महाशब्दो यान्ति भूतानि संभवम् । ततस्तेषां महाभूतशब्दोऽयमुपपद्यते ॥
data.md: Bhrigu said All things which belong to the Infinite or the Vast are known by the name of Great. Therefore these five clements are called Great creatures.

data.v: चेष्टा वायुः खमाकाशमूष्माग्निः सलिलं द्रवः । पृथिवी चात्र संघातः शरीरं पाञ्चभौतिकम् ॥
data.md: Activity is wind. The sound is space. The heat that lives within it is fire. The liquid juices cc:itained in it are water. The solidified matter, viz., flesh and bones from the Earth. The bodies are thus made of the five elements.

data.v: इत्येतैः पञ्चभिर्भूतैर्युक्तं स्थावरजङ्गमम् । श्रोत्रं घ्राणं रसः स्पर्शो दृष्टिश्चेन्द्रियसंज्ञिताः ॥
data.md: All mobile and immobile objects are formed of these five elements. The five senses also made of the give clements. The car is formed of the properties of space. The nose of earth; the tongue of water; touch of wind; and eyes of tire.

data.v: पञ्चभिर्यदि भूतैस्तु युक्ताः स्थावरजङ्गमाः । स्थावराणां न दृश्यन्ते शरीरे पञ्च धातवः ॥
data.md: Bharadwaja said If all mobile and immobile objects be made of these five elements, why is it that in all immobile objects those elements are not seen.

data.v: अनूष्मणामचेष्टानां घनानां चैव तत्त्वतः । वृक्षाणां नोपलभ्यन्ते शरीरे पञ्च धातवः ॥
data.md: Trees do not appear to have possessed any heat. They appear to have no motion. They are again formed of thick particles. The five elements are not seen in them.

data.v: न शृण्वन्ति न पश्यन्ति न गन्धरसवेदिनः । न च स्पर्शं विजानन्ति ते कथं पाञ्चभौतिकाः ॥
data.md: Trees do not hear; they do not sec; they cannot smell or taste. They cannot touch. How then can they be regarded as formed of the five elements.

data.v: अद्रवत्वादनग्नित्वादभौमत्वादवायुतः । आकाशस्याप्रमेयत्वाद्वृक्षाणां नास्ति भौतिकम् ॥
data.md: It appears to me that for the absence of any liquid matter in them, of any heat, of any earth, of any wind, and of any empty space, trees cannot be considered as compounds of the five primary elements.

data.v: घनानामपि वृक्षाणामाकाशोऽस्ति न संशयः । तेषां पुष्पफले व्यक्तिर्नित्यं समुपलभ्यते ॥
data.md: Bhrigu said Forsooth, though possessed of density, trees have space within them. They always bear flowers and fruits.

data.v: ऊष्मतो ग्लानपर्णानां त्वक्फलं पुष्पमेव च । म्लायते चैव शीते न स्पर्शस्तेनात्र विद्यते ॥
data.md: They have heat within them for which leaf, bark, fruit, and flower are seen to fall off. They sicken and dry up. This indicates that they have perception of touch.

data.v: वाय्वग्न्यशनिनिष्पेषैः फलपुष्पं विशीर्यते । श्रोत्रेण गृह्यते शब्दस्तस्माच्छृण्वन्ति पादपाः ॥
data.md: By sound of wind and fire and thunder, their fruits and flowers fall down. Sound is perceived through the ear. Trees have, therefore, ears and do hear.

data.v: वल्ली वेष्टयते वृक्षं सर्वतश्चैव गच्छति । न ह्यदृष्टेश्च मार्गोऽस्ति तस्मात्पश्यन्ति पादपाः ॥
data.md: A creeper entwines a tree all around. A blind thing cannot see its way. Therefore it is evident that trees have vision.

data.v: पुण्यापुण्यैस्तथा गन्धैर्धूपैश्च विविधैरपि । अरोगाः पुष्पिताः सन्ति तस्माज्जिघ्रन्ति पादपाः ॥
data.md: Again trees regain vigour and put forth flowers for good and bad smell, of the sacred incense of all sorts. It is evident that trees have scent.

data.v: पादैः सलिलपानं च व्याधीनामपि दर्शनम् । व्याधिप्रतिक्रियत्वाच्च विद्यते रसनं द्रुमे ॥
data.md: They draw water by their roots. They catch all sorts of diseases. Those diseases again are cured by various operations. From this it is clear that trees have perception of taste.

data.v: वक्त्रेणोत्पलनालेन यथोर्ध्वं जलमाददेत् । तथा पवनसंयुक्तः पादैः पिबति पादपः ॥
data.md: As one can draw water through the hole of a lotus-stalk, trees also, with the help of wind, drink through their roots.

data.v: ग्रहणात्सुखदुःखस्य छिन्नस्य च विरोहणात् । जीवं पश्यामि वृक्षाणामचैतन्यं न विद्यते ॥
data.md: They are subject to pleasure and pain, and grow when cut or lopped off. These facts clearly prove that trees have life. They are not manimate.

data.v: तेन तज्जलमादत्तं जरयत्यग्निमारुतौ । आहारपरिणामाच्च स्नेहो वृद्धिश्च जायते ॥
data.md: Fire and wind cause the water thus drawn up to be digested. The tree grows and becomes humid proportionate to the quantity of the water taken up.

data.v: जङ्गमानां च सर्वेषां शरीरे पञ्च धातवः । प्रत्येकशः प्रभिद्यन्ते यैः शरीरं विचेष्टते ॥
data.md: In the bodies of all mobile things the five elements reside. The proportions are different in each. Mobile objects can move for these five elements.

data.v: त्वक्च मांसं तथास्थीनि मज्जा स्नायु च पञ्चमम् । इत्येतदिह संख्यातं शरीरे पृथिवीमयम् ॥
data.md: Skin, fresh, bones, marrow, and arteries and veins, that exist together in the body are formed of earth.

data.v: तेजोऽग्निश्च तथा क्रोधश्चक्षुरूष्मा तथैव च । अग्निर्जरयते चापि पञ्चाग्नेयाः शरीरिणः ॥
data.md: Energy, anger, eyes, internal heat, and the heat which digests the good taken, these five, form the fire that exists in all embodied creatures.

data.v: श्रोत्रं घ्राणमथास्यं च हृदयं कोष्ठमेव च । आकाशात्प्राणिनामेते शरीरे पञ्च धातवः ॥
data.md: The cars, nostrils, mouth, heart, and Stomach, these five, form the element of space that exists in the bodies of living creatures.

data.v: श्लेष्मा पित्तमथ स्वेदो वसा शोणितमेव च । इत्यापः पञ्चधा देहे भवन्ति प्राणिनां सदा ॥
data.md: Phlegm, bile, sweat, fat, blood are the five kinds of water that exist in inobile bodies.

data.v: प्राणात्प्रणीयते प्राणी व्यानाद्व्यायच्छते तथा । गच्छत्यपानोऽवाक्चैव समानो हृद्यवस्थितः ॥
data.md: Through the vital breath called Prana, a living creature is capable of moving about. Through that called Vyana they act. That called Apana goes downward. That called Samana lives within the heart.

data.v: उदानादुच्छ्वसिति च प्रतिभेदाच्च भाषते । इत्येते वायवः पञ्च चेष्टयन्तीह देहिनम् ॥
data.md: Through that called Udana one passes exertion and is enabled to speak by virtue of its going through (the lungs, the throat, and the mouth). These are the five sorts of vital airs that cause an embodied creature to live and Imove.

data.v: भूमेर्गन्धगुणान्वेत्ति रसं चाद्भ्यः शरीरवान् । ज्योतिः पश्यति चक्षुर्भ्यां स्पर्शं वेत्ति च वायुना ॥
data.md: Through the earth-element an embodied creature perceives the properties of scent. From the water-element he perceives taste. From the fire-element as represented by the eyes, he perceives forms, and from the wind-element he perceives touch.

data.v: तस्य गन्धस्य वक्ष्यामि विस्तराभिहितान्गुणान् । इष्टश्चानिष्टगन्धश्च मधुरः कटुरेव च ॥
निर्हारी संहतः स्निग्धो रूक्षो विशद एव च । एवं नवविधो ज्ञेयः पार्थिवो गन्धविस्तरः ॥
शब्दः स्पर्शश्च रूपं च रसश्चापां गुणाः स्मृताः । रसज्ञानं तु वक्ष्यामि तन्मे निगदतः शृणु ॥
data.md: Sound, touch, vision and taste are the properties of water. I shall describe fully that now the perception of taste. Listen to me.

data.v: रसो बहुविधः प्रोक्तः सूरिभिः प्रथितात्मभिः । मधुरो लवणस्तिक्तः कषायोऽम्लः कटुस्तथा । एष षड्विधविस्तारो रसो वारिमयः स्मृतः ॥
data.md: Great Rishis have mentioned various sorts of taste. They are sweet, saltish, bitter, astringent, sour, and pungent.

data.v: शब्दः स्पर्शश्च रूपं च त्रिगुणं ज्योतिरुच्यते । ज्योतिः पश्यति रूपाणि रूपं च बहुधा स्मृतम् ॥
ह्रस्वो दीर्घस्तथा स्थूलश्चतुरस्रोऽणु वृत्तवान् । शुक्लः कृष्णस्तथा रक्तो नीलः पीतोऽरुणस्तथा । एवं द्वादशविस्तारो ज्योतीरूपगुणः स्मृतः ॥
शब्दस्पर्शौ तु विज्ञेयौ द्विगुणो वायुरुच्यते । वायव्यस्तु गुणः स्पर्शः स्पर्शश्च बहुधा स्मृतः ॥
data.md: These are the sixteen sorts of forin which forms the property of light or vision. The property of the wind element is touch. Touch is of various sorts; warm, cold, agreeable and disagrecable, indifferent, burning, mild, soft, light and heavy.

data.v: कठिनश्चिक्कणः श्लक्ष्णः पिच्छलो मृदुदारुणः । उष्णः शीतः सुखो दुःखः स्निग्धो विशद एव च । एवं द्वादशविस्तारो वायव्यो गुण उच्यते ॥
तत्रैकगुणमाकाशं शब्द इत्येव तत्स्मृतम् । तस्य शब्दस्य वक्ष्यामि विस्तरं विविधात्मकम् ॥
data.md: Space has only one property, namely sound. I shall now describe to you the different sorts of sound.

data.v: षड्ज ऋषभगान्धारौ मध्यमः पञ्चमस्तथा । धैवतश्चापि विज्ञेयस्तथा चापि निषादकः ॥
data.md: They are the seven original notes called Shadaja, Rishabha, Gandhara, Maddhyaina, Dhaivata, Panchama, and Nishada.

data.v: एष सप्तविधः प्रोक्तो गुण आकाशलक्षणः । त्रैस्वर्येण तु सर्वत्र स्थितोऽपि पटहादिषु ॥
data.md: These are the seven sorts of the property which belongs to space. Sound pervades like the Supreme Being the entire space though attached especially to drums drums and other instruments.

data.v: आकाशजं शब्दमाहुरेभिर्वायुगुणैः सह । अव्याहतैश्चेतयते न वेत्ति विषमागतैः ॥
आप्यायन्ते च ते नित्यं धातवस्तैस्तु धातुभिः । आपोऽग्निर्मारुतश्चैव नित्यं जाग्रति देहिषु ॥
पार्थिवं धातुमाश्रित्य शारीरोऽग्निः कथं भवेत् । अवकाशविशेषेण कथं वर्तयतेऽनिलः ॥
data.md: How docs bodily fire or heat, entering the body, live there? How also does the wind, getting space for itself, cause the body to move and work?

data.v: वायोर्गतिमहं ब्रह्मन्कीर्तयिष्यामि तेऽनघ । प्राणिनामनिलो देहान्यथा चेष्टयते बली ॥
data.md: I shall, O twice-born one describe to you the course in which the wind moves, and how, O sinless one, that powerful element makes the bodies of living creatures move and work.

data.v: श्रितो मूर्धानमग्निस्तु शरीरं परिपालयन् । प्राणो मूर्धनि चाग्नौ च वर्तमानो विचेष्टते ॥
data.md: Heat lives within the head (brain) and protects the body. The vital air called Prana, living within the head and the heat that is there, create all sorts of exertion.

data.v: स जन्तुः सर्वभूतात्मा पुरुषः स सनातनः । मनो बुद्धिरहंकारो भूतानि विषयाश्च सः ॥
data.md: That Prana is the living creature, the universal self, the eternal Being, and the Mind, Intellect and Consciousness of all living creatures, as also all the objects of the senses.

data.v: एवं त्विह स सर्वत्र प्राणेन परिपाल्यते । पृष्ठतश्च समानेन स्वां स्वां गतिमुपाश्रितः ॥
data.md: Thus Prana makes the living creature move about and exert. Then by virtue of the other vital air called Samana, every one of the senses performs its own work.

data.v: वस्तिमूलं गुदं चैव पावकं च समाश्रितः । वहन्मूत्रं पुरीषं चाप्यपानः परिवर्तते ॥
data.md: The vital air called Apana, by the help of the heat that is in the urethra, abdomen and intestines, moves, carrying out urine and excreta.

data.v: प्रयत्ने कर्मणि बले य एकस्त्रिषु वर्तते । उदान इति तं प्राहुरध्यात्मविदुषो जनाः ॥
data.md: That single vital air which works in these three, is called Udana by those who are wellread in this science.

data.v: संधिष्वपि च सर्वेषु संनिविष्टस्तथानिलः । शरीरेषु मनुष्याणां व्यान इत्युपदिश्यते ॥
data.md: That vital air which works, living in all the joints, is called Vyana.

data.v: धातुष्वग्निस्तु विततः समानेन समीरितः । रसान्धातूंश्च दोषांश्च वर्तयन्नवतिष्ठति ॥
data.md: Heat is circulated all over the bodies of living creatures by the vital air Samana. Living creatures by the vital air Samana. Living thus in the body, that vital air works upon the various sorts of watery and other elementary substances and all bad humours.

data.v: अपानप्राणयोर्मध्ये प्राणापानसमाहितः । समन्वितः स्वधिष्ठानः सम्यक्पचति पावकः ॥
data.md: The heat, living between Apana and Prana, in the navel, works, with the help of those two vital airs, in digesting all food that is taken by a living creature.

data.v: आस्यं हि पायुसंयुक्तमन्ते स्याद्गुदसंज्ञितम् । स्रोतस्तस्मात्प्रजायन्ते सर्वस्रोतांसि देहिनाम् ॥
data.md: There is a canal beginning from the mouth down to the anus. Its extremity is called the anus. From this main canal various minor oncs branch out in the bodies of all living creatures.

data.v: प्राणानां संनिपाताच्च संनिपातः प्रजायते । ऊष्मा चाग्निरिति ज्ञेयो योऽन्नं पचति देहिनाम् ॥
data.md: The various vital air passing through these canals mix with each other. The heat which lives in Prana is called Ushman. This heat causes digestion in embodied creatures.

data.v: अग्निवेगवहः प्राणो गुदान्ते प्रतिहन्यते । स ऊर्ध्वमागम्य पुनः समुत्क्षिपति पावकम् ॥
data.md: The vital air called Prana, carrying a current of heat, goes (from the head) downwards to the extremity of the anal canal and thence goes up once more. Returning to the head again, it once more sends down the heat it carries.

data.v: पक्वाशयस्त्वधो नाभेरूर्ध्वमामाशयः स्थितः । नाभिमध्ये शरीरस्य सर्वे प्राणाः समाहिताः ॥
data.md: Below the navel is the quarter of digested maller. Above it is that for the food which is taken. In the navel reside all the forces of life that keep up the body.

data.v: प्रसृता हृदयात्सर्वे तिर्यगूर्ध्वमधस्तथा । वहन्त्यन्नरसान्नाड्यो दश प्राणप्रचोदिताः ॥
data.md: Urged by the ton sorts of vital airs having Prana for their first, the canals, branching out from the heart, carry the liquid juices of food, upwards, downwards, and in contrary directions.

data.v: एष मार्गोऽथ योगानां येन गच्छन्ति तत्पदम् । जितक्लमासना धीरा मूर्धन्यात्मानमादधुः ॥
data.md: The main channel leading from the mouth to the anus is the path by which Yogins, knowing no fatigue, calm in happiness and misery, and highly patient, succeed in attaining to Brahma by drawing the soul within the brain.

data.v: एवं सर्वेषु विहितः प्राणापानेषु देहिनाम् । तस्मिन्स्थितो नित्यमग्निः स्थाल्यामिव समाहितः ॥
data.md: Thus is heat placed in the vital air called Prana and Apana and others, of all embodied creatures. That heat is always burning thcre like a fire placed in vessel which can be seen.

data.v: यदि प्राणायते वायुर्वायुरेव विचेष्टते । श्वसित्याभाषते चैव तस्माज्जीवो निरर्थकः ॥
data.md: Bharadwaja said If it is the air that keeps us alive, if it is the air that makes us inove and act is if it, the air that makes us breathe and speak, then it appears that life is not worth much.

data.v: यद्यूष्मभाव आग्नेयो वह्निना पच्यते यदि । अग्निर्जरयते चैव तस्माज्जीवो निरर्थकः ॥
data.md: If the animal heat be of the nature of fire, and if it is that fire which helps digestion by dissolving the food we take, then life is not worth much.

data.v: जन्तोः प्रमीयमाणस्य जीवो नैवोपलभ्यते । वायुरेव जहात्येनमूष्मभावश्च नश्यति ॥
data.md: When an animal dies, that which is called its life is never seen to depart. Only the vital air relinquishes it, and the internal heat is put out.

data.v: यदि वातोपमो जीवः संश्लेषो यदि वायुना । वायुमण्डलवद्दृश्यो गच्छेत्सह मरुद्गणैः ॥
data.md: If life were nothing else than air, or if life depended only on the air, then it could have been seen like the outward sea of air, and when passing out it would have been mixed with that air.

data.v: श्लेषो यदि च वातेन यदि तस्मात्प्रणश्यति । महार्णवविमुक्तत्वादन्यत्सलिलभाजनम् ॥
data.md: If life depended upon air, and if it ended with the passing of that air from the body, it would then mingle with the eternal air like a portion of water passing into the great sea and thereby only changing the place of its residence. If a quantity of water be thrown into a well, or if the flame of a lamp be thrown into a burning fire, either of them, entering the original element, loses its independent existence. If life were air, it also, when the animal died, would merge in the great sea of air outside.

data.v: कूपे वा सलिलं दद्यात्प्रदीपं वा हुताशने । प्रक्षिप्तं नश्यति क्षिप्रं यथा नश्यत्यसौ तथा ॥
पञ्चसाधारणे ह्यस्मिञ्शरीरे जीवितं कुतः । येषामन्यतरत्यागाच्चतुर्णां नास्ति संग्रहः ॥
data.md: How we can say that there is life in this animal body which is composed of the five elements? If one of those clements disappear, the dissolution of the other four is brought about.

data.v: नश्यन्त्यापो ह्यनाहाराद्वायुरुच्छ्वासनिग्रहात् । नश्यते कोष्ठभेदात्खमग्निर्नश्यत्यभोजनात् ॥
data.md: The element of water dries up if food is not taken. The element of air disappears if the breath is controlled. The element of space disappears if the excretions cease. So also the element of fire disappears if food does not go in.

data.v: व्याधिव्रणपरिक्लेशैर्मेदिनी चैव शीर्यते । पीडितेऽन्यतरे ह्येषां संघातो याति पञ्चधा ॥
data.md: The element of earth is shattered to pieces by disease, wounds and other sufferings. If only one of the five is spoiled, the union is dissolved and the five go away into five different directions.

data.v: तस्मिन्पञ्चत्वमापन्ने जीवः किमनुधावति । किं वेदयति वा जीवः किं शृणोति ब्रवीति वा ॥
data.md: When the five ingredients of the body which is a compound of the five elements, are separated, where does life go? What does it then know. What does it then hear? What does it then say?

data.v: एषा गौः परलोकस्थं तारयिष्यति मामिति । यो दत्त्वा म्रियते जन्तुः सा गौः कं तारयिष्यति ॥
data.md: The cow, it is said, will save me in the next world. The animal, however, which is given away, itself dies. Whom then will this cow save?

data.v: गौश्च प्रतिग्रहीता च दाता चैव समं यदा । इहैव विलयं यान्ति कुतस्तेषां समागमः ॥
data.md: The taker of the cow and the giver are both equally subject to death. Both of them meet with destruction in this world. How then will they meet again?

data.v: विहगैरुपयुक्तस्य शैलाग्रात्पतितस्य वा । अग्निना चोपयुक्तस्य कुतः संजीवनं पुनः ॥
data.md: How will the man that has been eaten up by birds, or that has been shattered to pieces by a fall from a mountain summit, or that has been consumed by fire, regain life?

data.v: छिन्नस्य यदि वृक्षस्य न मूलं प्रतिरोहति । बीजान्यस्य प्रवर्तन्ते मृतः क्व पुनरेष्यति ॥
data.md: The root of a tree that has been cut down docs not revive. Only the seeds put forth sprouts. Where is the person who having died regains life?

data.v: बीजमात्रं पुरा सृष्टं यदेतत्परिवर्तते । मृता मृताः प्रणश्यन्ति बीजाद्बीजं प्रवर्तते ॥
data.md: Only seeds were originally created. All this universe is the creation of seeds in succession. They that die, die for ever. Seeds come from seeds.

data.v: न प्रणाशोऽस्ति जीवानां दत्तस्य च कृतस्य च । याति देहान्तरं प्राणी शरीरं तु विशीर्यते ॥
data.md: Bhrigu said The living creature, or what is given, or our other acts, are never destroyed. The death of a creature is only a change of form. The body alone is dissolved.

data.v: न शरीराश्रितो जीवस्तस्मिन्नष्टे प्रणश्यति । यथा समित्सु दग्धासु न प्रणश्यति पावकः ॥
data.md: The living creature, though it depends upon the body, is not destroyed when the body is destroyed. It is not seen after the destroyed. It is not seen after the destruction of the physical body just as fire is not visible after the consumption of the fuel with which it was lighted.

data.v: अग्नेर्यथा तथा तस्य यदि नाशो न विद्यते । इन्धनस्योपयोगान्ते स चाग्निर्नोपलभ्यते ॥
data.md: Bharadwaja said If there is no destruction of the living creature like that of fire, I say, fire itself is not visible after consumption of the fuel (that ignited it).

data.v: नश्यतीत्येव जानामि शान्तमग्निमनिन्धनम् । गतिर्यस्य प्रमाणं वा संस्थानं वा न दृश्यते ॥
data.md: When the supply of a fuel is stopped, the fire is put out, and as far as I know, is destroyed. What has no longer any action should be considered as destroyed, for it proves its non-existence and which no longer occupics any space.

data.v: समिधामुपयोगान्ते सन्नेवाग्निर्न दृश्यते । आकाशानुगतत्वाद्धि दुर्ग्रहः स निराश्रयः ॥
data.md: Bhrigu said, It is true that after the consumption of fuel fire is no longer visible. It mixes with space because there is no longer any visible object wherein it can abide, and hence it cannot be perceived by us.

data.v: तथा शरीरसंत्यागे जीवो ह्याकाशवत्स्थितः । न गृह्यते सुसूक्ष्मत्वाद्यथा ज्योतिर्न संशयः ॥
data.md: Likewise, upon renouncing the body, the creature lives in space, and cannot be seen for its extreme subtility as is the case with fire.

data.v: प्राणान्धारयते ह्यग्निः स जीव उपधार्यताम् । वायुसंधारणो ह्यग्निर्नश्यत्युच्छ्वासनिग्रहात् ॥
data.md: It is fire or heat that kceps us the vital airs called Prana and the others. Know this heat is called life or the living agent. The heat which keeps up vital airs, is extinguished for the suppression of breath.

data.v: तस्मिन्नष्टे शरीराग्नौ शरीरं तदचेतनम् । पतितं याति भूमित्वमयनं तस्य हि क्षितिः ॥
data.md: With the extinction of heat, the body itself loses aniination. Falling down, it it is metamorphosed into earth, its ultimate destination.

data.v: जङ्गमानां हि सर्वेषां स्थावराणां तथैव च । आकाशं पवनोऽभ्येति ज्योतिस्तमनुगच्छति । तत्र त्रयाणामेकत्वं द्वयं भूमौ प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥
data.md: The breath that exists in all mobile and immobile objects mingles with space, and the heat which is in them follows that breath. These three (viz., space, air, and fair), mingle together. The other two (viz., water and earth), exist together in the shape of earth.

data.v: यत्र खं तत्र पवनस्तत्राग्निर्यत्र मारुतः । अमूर्तयस्ते विज्ञेया आपो मूर्तास्तथा क्षितिः ॥
data.md: There is wind where space is, and there is fire where is. They have in reality no forms, and become endued with form only in embodied creatures.

data.v: यद्यग्निमारुतौ भूमिः खमापश्च शरीरिषु । जीवः किंलक्षणस्तत्रेत्येतदाचक्ष्व मेऽनघ ॥
data.md: Bharadwaja said If in the bodies of all living creatures there are heat, wind, earth, space, and water, what then are the sins of the living agent? Tell me these, O sinless one.

data.v: पञ्चात्मके पञ्चरतौ पञ्चविज्ञानसंयुते । शरीरे प्राणिनां जीवं ज्ञातुमिच्छामि यादृशम् ॥
data.md: I wish to know the nature of the life that exists in the bodies of living beings,composed of the five principal elements, engaged in the five principal elements, engaged in the five acts, endued with the five senses and animation.

data.v: मांसशोणितसंघाते मेदःस्नाय्वस्थिसंचये । भिद्यमाने शरीरे तु जीवो नैवोपलभ्यते ॥
data.md: After the dissolution of the body which is a compound of flesh and blood, a mass of fat, sinews and bones, that which is the living agent is not seen.

data.v: यद्यजीवं शरीरं तु पञ्चभूतसमन्वितम् । शारीरे मानसे दुःखे कस्तां वेदयते रुजम् ॥
data.md: If this body, composed of the give elements, has no life, who or what then is that which feels misery on account of either physical or metal pain?

data.v: शृणोति कथितं जीवः कर्णाभ्यां न शृणोति तत् । महर्षे मनसि व्यग्रे तस्माज्जीवो निरर्थकः ॥
data.md: The living agent hears what is said, through the ears. It is, again, the fact, O great Rishi, that the same agent hears not when the mind is elsewhere engaged. It appears, therefore, that what is called the living agent serves no purpose.

data.v: सर्वं पश्यति यद्दृश्यं मनोयुक्तेन चक्षुषा । मनसि व्याकुले तद्धि पश्यन्नपि न पश्यति ॥
data.md: What the living agent sces with eyes acting in unison with the mind, the eye sees not, even when lying before it, if the mind elsewhere engaged.

data.v: न पश्यति न च ब्रूते न शृणोति न जिघ्रति । न च स्पर्शरसौ वेत्ति निद्रावशगतः पुनः ॥
data.md: Then again, when it is asleep, that agent neither sees nor smells, nor hears, nor speaks, nor feels the perceptions of touch and taste.

data.v: हृष्यति क्रुध्यति च कः शोचत्युद्विजते च कः । इच्छति ध्यायति द्वेष्टि वाचमीरयते च कः ॥
data.md: Who or what then is that which feels joy, becomes angry, or sorry and suffers tribulation? What is that which wishes, thinks, feels hatred and utters words.

data.v: न पञ्चसाधारणमत्र किंचि;च्छरीरमेको वहतेऽन्तरात्मा । स वेत्ति गन्धांश्च रसाञ्श्रुतिं च; स्पर्शं च रूपं च गुणाश्च येऽन्ये ॥
data.md: Bhrigu said The mind, like the body also, is made of the five elements. Therefore it is useless regarding the acts mentioned by you. Only the soul sustains the body. It is he that perceives smell, taste, sound, touch, forin and other properties.

data.v: पञ्चात्मके पञ्चगुणप्रदर्शी; स सर्वगात्रानुगतोऽन्तरात्मा । स वेत्ति दुःखानि सुखानि चात्र; तद्विप्रयोगात्तु न वेत्ति देहः ॥
data.md: Permeating all the limbs, that Soul witness the acts of the mind possessing five attributes and living within the body composed of the five elements. It is he who feels pleasure and pain, and when separated from him the body does not feel them.

data.v: यदा न रूपं न स्पर्शो नोष्मभावश्च पावके । तदा शान्ते शरीराग्नौ देहं त्यक्त्वा स नश्यति ॥
data.md: When one has no perception of form or of touch, when there is no heat in the fire of the body,—when the animal heat is gone,-the body, being renounced by the Soul, meets with destruction.

data.v: अम्मयं सर्वमेवेदमापो मूर्तिः शरीरिणाम् । तत्रात्मा मानसो ब्रह्मा सर्वभूतेषु लोककृत् ॥
data.md: The whole universe is made of water. Water is the form of all embodied creatures. In that water lives the Soul which is seen in the mind. That Soul is the Creator Brahman who exists in all things.

data.v: आत्मानं तं विजानीहि सर्वलोकहितात्मकम् । तस्मिन्यः संश्रितो देहे ह्यब्बिन्दुरिव पुष्करे ॥
data.md: Know that Soul. He is full of universal benevolence. He lives in the body like a drop of water in a lotus.

data.v: क्षेत्रज्ञं तं विजानीहि नित्यं लोकहितात्मकम् । तमो रजश्च सत्त्वं च विद्धि जीवगुणानिमान् ॥
data.md: Know well what is called Kshetrajna and which had universal benevolence. Goodness, darkness, and ignorance are the three attributes of the living agent.

data.v: सचेतनं जीवगुणं वदन्ति; स चेष्टते चेष्टयते च सर्वम् । ततः परं क्षेत्रविदं वदन्ति; प्रावर्तयद्यो भुवनानि सप्त ॥
data.md: The learned hold that the Soul had Consciousness and has the attributes of life. The Soul works and makes everything to work. Persons cognisant of the Soul say that the Soul is different from life. It is the Supreme Soul that has created the seven words and makes them works.

data.v: न जीवनाशोऽस्ति हि देहभेदे; मिथ्यैतदाहुर्मृत इत्यबुद्धाः । जीवस्तु देहान्तरितः प्रयाति; दशार्धतैवास्य शरीरभेदः ॥
data.md: There is no destruction of the living agent even when the body is dissolved. Men shorn of intelligence say that it dies. That is in fact false. All that the living agent does is that it goes from one body to another. What is called death is merely the dissolution of the body.

data.v: एवं सर्वेषु भूतेषु गूढश्चरति संवृतः । दृश्यते त्वग्र्यया बुद्ध्या सूक्ष्मया तत्त्वदर्शिभिः ॥
data.md: It is thus that the Soul, covered with various forms, goes form to form, unseen and unnoticed by others. Persons endued with true Knowledge witness the Soul by their keen and subtile intelligence.

data.v: तं पूर्वापररात्रेषु युञ्जानः सततं बुधः । लघ्वाहारो विशुद्धात्मा पश्यत्यात्मानमात्मनि ॥
data.md: Living on restricted diet, and with heart purged of all sins, devoting himself to meditation, a wise man succeeds every night, before sleep and after sleep, in sceing Soul by the help of his Soul.

data.v: चित्तस्य हि प्रसादेन हित्वा कर्म शुभाशुभम् । प्रसन्नात्मात्मनि स्थित्वा सुखमक्षयमश्नुते ॥
data.md: The king, effulgent, like fire living within the mind is called the living agent. It is from that Lord of everything that this creation has originated. This is the conclusion of the enquiry into the origin of creatures and the soul.

data.v: मानसोऽग्निः शरीरेषु जीव इत्यभिधीयते । सृष्टिः प्रजापतेरेषा भूताध्यात्मविनिश्चये ॥
data.md: The king, effulgent, like fire living within the mind is called the living agent. It is from that Lord of everything that this creation has originated. This is the conclusion of the enquiry into the origin of creatures and the soul.

data.v: असृजद्ब्राह्मणानेव पूर्वं ब्रह्मा प्रजापतिः । आत्मतेजोभिनिर्वृत्तान्भास्कराग्निसमप्रभान् ॥
data.md: Bhrigu said Brahman first created a few Brahmanas who passed by the name of Prajapatis (lord of creation). Effulgent like the fire or the Sun, they were created out of the energy of that First-born Being.

data.v: ततः सत्यं च धर्मं च तपो ब्रह्म च शाश्वतम् । आचारं चैव शौचं च स्वर्गाय विदधे प्रभुः ॥
data.md: The powerful Lord then created Truth, Duty, Penance, the eternal Vedas, all sorts of pious deeds, and Purity, for enabling creatures to acquire heaven (by practising them).

data.v: देवदानवगन्धर्वदैत्यासुरमहोरगाः । यक्षराक्षसनागाश्च पिशाचा मनुजास्तथा ॥
ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः शूद्राश्च द्विजसत्तम । ये चान्ये भूतसंघानां संघास्तांश्चापि निर्ममे ॥
data.md: After this, the gods and the Danavas, the Gandharvas, the Daityas, the Asuras, the great snakes, the Yakshas, the Rakshasas, the Serpents, the Pishachas, and mankind with their four divisions, viz., Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, Vaishyas, and Shudras, O foremost of twice-born ones, and all the other orders of creatures, were created.

data.v: ब्राह्मणानां सितो वर्णः क्षत्रियाणां तु लोहितः । वैश्यानां पीतको वर्णः शूद्राणामसितस्तथा ॥
data.md: The complexion of the Brahmanas was white; that of the Kshatriyas was red; that of the Vaishyas yellow; and that of the Shudras was black.

data.v: चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य वर्णेन यदि वर्णो विभज्यते । सर्वेषां खलु वर्णानां दृश्यते वर्णसंकरः ॥
data.md: Bharadwaja said If the distinction between the four castes be made by means only of colour, then it seems that all the four orders have been intermixed.

data.v: कामः क्रोधो भयं लोभः शोकश्चिन्ता क्षुधा श्रमः । सर्वेषां नः प्रभवति कस्माद्वर्णो विभज्यते ॥
data.md: Lust, anger, fear, cupidity, grief, anxiety, hunger, exhaustion, possess and prevail over all men. How can men be distinguished by the attributes?

data.v: स्वेदमूत्रपुरीषाणि श्लेष्मा पित्तं सशोणितम् । तनुः क्षरति सर्वेषां कस्माद्वर्णो विभज्यते ॥
data.md: The bodies of all men sweat and puss urine, faeces, phlegm, bile and blood. How then can men be divided into classes?

data.v: जङ्गमानामसंख्येयाः स्थावराणां च जातयः । तेषां विविधवर्णानां कुतो वर्णविनिश्चयः ॥
data.md: Mobile objects are endless in number; the immobile objects are also innumerable. How then can so many different objects be divided into classes?

data.v: न विशेषोऽस्ति वर्णानां सर्वं ब्राह्ममिदं जगत् । ब्रह्मणा पूर्वसृष्टं हि कर्मभिर्वर्णतां गतम् ॥
data.md: Bhrigu said There is in fact no distinction between the different castes. The whole world at first consisted of Brahmanas. Created equally by Brahman, men have, on account of their acts, been divided into various castes.

data.v: कामभोगप्रियास्तीक्ष्णाः क्रोधनाः प्रियसाहसाः । त्यक्तस्वधर्मा रक्ताङ्गास्ते द्विजाः क्षत्रतां गताः ॥
data.md: They who found excessive pleasure in enjoyment become possessed of the attributes of harshness and anger, endued with courage, and were unmindful of the works of piety and worship,-those Brahmanas possessing the quality of Darkness, became Kshatriyas.

data.v: गोषु वृत्तिं समाधाय पीताः कृष्युपजीविनः । स्वधर्मं नानुतिष्ठन्ति ते द्विजा वैश्यतां गताः ॥
data.md: Those Brahmanas again who, unmindful of the duties laid down for them, became endued with both the qualities of Goodness and Darkness, and follow the professions of cattletending and agriculture, became Vaishyas.

data.v: हिंसानृतप्रिया लुब्धाः सर्वकर्मोपजीविनः । कृष्णाः शौचपरिभ्रष्टास्ते द्विजाः शूद्रतां गताः ॥
data.md: Those Brahmanas again who were given to untruth and injuring other creatures possessed of cupidity, performed all sorts of works for their maintenance and had no purity of behaviour, and thus possessed of the quality of Darkness, became Shudras.

data.v: इत्येतैः कर्मभिर्व्यस्ता द्विजा वर्णान्तरं गताः । धर्मो यज्ञक्रिया चैषां नित्यं न प्रतिषिध्यते ॥
data.md: Divided by these occupations, Brahınanas, falling away from their own order became members of the other three castes. All the four castes, therefore, have always the right to perform all pious rites and sacrifices.

data.v: वर्णाश्चत्वार एते हि येषां ब्राह्मी सरस्वती । विहिता ब्रह्मणा पूर्वं लोभात्त्वज्ञानतां गताः ॥
data.md: Thus were the four castes at first created equally by Brahman who ordained for all of them the observances described (in the Vedas). Cupidity alone brought about the fall of many, who were possessed by ignorance.

data.v: ब्राह्मणा धर्मतन्त्रस्थास्तपस्तेषां न नश्यति । ब्रह्म धारयतां नित्यं व्रतानि नियमांस्तथा ॥
data.md: The Brahmanas are always devoted to the Brahma-scriptures and practising vows and restraints, are capable of understanding Brahima. Their penances, therefore, never prove fruitless.

data.v: ब्रह्म चैतत्पुरा सृष्टं ये न जानन्त्यतद्विदः । तेषां बहुविधास्त्वन्यास्तत्र तत्र हि जातयः ॥
data.md: They amongst them are not Brahmanas who cannot understand that every created thing is Supreme Brahma. These, falling away, became members of various (inferior) castes.

data.v: पिशाचा राक्षसाः प्रेता बहुधा म्लेच्छजातयः । प्रनष्टज्ञानविज्ञानाः स्वच्छन्दाचारचेष्टिताः ॥
data.md: Destitute of the light of knowledge, living a loose life of dissolution they are born as Pishas and Rakshasas and Ghosts, and as Mleccha tribes.

data.v: प्रजा ब्राह्मणसंस्काराः स्वधर्मकृतनिश्चयाः । ऋषिभिः स्वेन तपसा सृज्यन्ते चापरे परैः ॥
data.md: The great Rishis who at the beginning were created (by Brahman's Will) afterwards themselves created, through their penances, men devoted to the duties laid down for them and rites laid down in the Eternal Vedas.

data.v: आदिदेवसमुद्भूता ब्रह्ममूलाक्षयाव्यया । सा सृष्टिर्मानसी नाम धर्मतन्त्रपरायणा ॥
data.md: That other Creation, however, which is eternal and undecaying, which depends upon Brahma and has originated from the Primeval God, and which has Yoga for its support, is a mental one.

data.v: ब्राह्मणः केन भवति क्षत्रियो वा द्विजोत्तम । वैश्यः शूद्रश्च विप्रर्षे तद्ब्रूहि वदतां वर ॥
data.md: Bharadwaja said By what deeds, does one became a Brahmana? By what, a Kshatriya? O foremost of twice-born ones, by what deeds again does one become a Vaishya or a Shudra? Tell me this, O foremost of orators.

data.v: जातकर्मादिभिर्यस्तु संस्कारैः संस्कृतः शुचिः । वेदाध्ययनसंपन्नः षट्सु कर्मस्ववस्थितः ॥
शौचाचारस्थितः सम्यग्विघसाशी गुरुप्रियः । नित्यव्रती सत्यपरः स वै ब्राह्मण उच्यते ॥
सत्यं दानं दमोऽद्रोह आनृशंस्यं क्षमा घृणा । तपश्च दृश्यते यत्र स ब्राह्मण इति स्मृतः ॥
data.md: He, with whom truth, gifts, abstention from injury to others, mercy, shame, benevolence, and penance are associated, is called a Brahmana.

data.v: क्षत्रजं सेवते कर्म वेदाध्ययनसंमतः । दानादानरतिर्यश्च स वै क्षत्रिय उच्यते ॥
data.md: He, who follows the profession of war, who studies the Vedas, who makes gifts and takes wealth, is called a Kshatriya.

data.v: कृषिगोरक्ष्यवाणिज्यं यो विशत्यनिशं शुचिः । वेदाध्ययनसंपन्नः स वैश्य इति संज्ञितः ॥
data.md: He, who acquires fame by tending cattle, who is engaged in agriculture and the means of acquiring riches, who is pure in conduct and attends to the study of the Vedas, is called a Vaishya. J

data.v: सर्वभक्षरतिर्नित्यं सर्वकर्मकरोऽशुचिः । त्यक्तवेदस्त्वनाचारः स वै शूद्र इति स्मृतः ॥
data.md: He, who takes every sort of food, who is engaged in doing every sort of work, who is impure in behaviour, who does not study the Vedas, and whose conduct is unrighteous, is said to be a Shudra.

data.v: शूद्रे चैतद्भवेल्लक्ष्यं द्विजे चैतन्न विद्यते । न वै शूद्रो भवेच्छूद्रो ब्राह्मणो न च ब्राह्मणः ॥
data.md: If these marks are not seen in a Shudra, and if they are not seen in a Brahmana, then such a Shudra is no Shudra, and such a Brahmana is no Brahmana.

data.v: सर्वोपायैस्तु लोभस्य क्रोधस्य च विनिग्रहः । एतत्पवित्रं ज्ञातव्यं तथा चैवात्मसंयमः ॥
data.md: One should conquer cupidity and anger by every means. This, together with self-control, is the grandest results of Knowledge.

data.v: नित्यं क्रोधात्तपो रक्षेच्छ्रियं रक्षेत मत्सरात् । विद्यां मानावमानाभ्यामात्मानं तु प्रमादतः ॥
यस्य सर्वे समारम्भा निराशीर्बन्धनास्त्विह । त्यागे यस्य हुतं सर्वं स त्यागी स च बुद्धिमान् ॥
अहिंस्रः सर्वभूतानां मैत्रायणगतश्चरेत् । अविस्रम्भे न गन्तव्यं विस्रम्भे धारयेन्मनः ॥
परिग्रहान्परित्यज्य भवेद्बुद्ध्या जितेन्द्रियः । अशोकं स्थानमातिष्ठेदिह चामुत्र चाभयम् ॥
data.md: One should, without taking any gifts, by the help of his own intelligence completely control his passions. One should live in his sclf where there is no grief. One would then have no fear in this world and attain to fearless region in the next world.

data.v: तपोनित्येन दान्तेन मुनिना संयतात्मना । अजितं जेतुकामेन भाव्यं सङ्गेष्वसङ्गिना ॥
data.md: One who wishes to conquer that which is unconquerable should live giving himself up to penances, to self-control, to taciturnity, to a subjugation of the soul. Such a person should live in the midst of attachments without being attached thereto.

data.v: इन्द्रियैर्गृह्यते यद्यत्तत्तद्व्यक्तमिति स्थितिः । अव्यक्तमिति विज्ञेयं लिङ्गग्राह्यमतीन्द्रियम् ॥
data.md: All things that can be perceived by the sense are designated Manifest. One should seek to know all, however, that is Unmanifest, that is beyond the perception of the senses, that can be ascertained only by the subtile senses.

data.v: मनः प्राणे निगृह्णीयात्प्राणं ब्रह्मणि धारयेत् । निर्वाणादेव निर्वाणो न च किंचिद्विचिन्तयेत् । सुखं वै ब्राह्मणो ब्रह्म स वै तेनाधिगच्छति ॥
शौचेन सततं युक्तस्तथाचारसमन्वितः । सानुक्रोशश्च भूतेषु तद्द्विजातिषु लक्षणम् ॥
सत्यं ब्रह्म तपः सत्यं सत्यं सृजति च प्रजाः । सत्येन धार्यते लोकः स्वर्गं सत्येन गच्छति ॥
data.md: Bhrigu said Truth is Brahma; truth is Penance it is Truth which Creates all creatures. Truth sustains the entire universe and it is with the help of Truth that one goes to Heaven.

data.v: अनृतं तमसो रूपं तमसा नीयते ह्यधः । तमोग्रस्ता न पश्यन्ति प्रकाशं तमसावृतम् ॥
data.md: Untruth is only another shape of Darkness. It is Darkness that leads downwards. Those who are possessed by Darkness, cannot see the bright regions of Heaven.

data.v: स्वर्गः प्रकाश इत्याहुर्नरकं तम एव च । सत्यानृतात्तदुभयं प्राप्यते जगतीचरैः ॥
data.md: It has been said that Heaven is Light and that Hell is Darkness. The creatures living in this world may obtain both Heaven and Hell.

data.v: तत्र त्वेवंविधा वृत्तिर्लोके सत्यानृता भवेत् । धर्माधर्मौ प्रकाशश्च तमो दुःखं सुखं तथा ॥
data.md: In this world also, Truth and Untruth bring on contrary action and contrary indications, such as Righteousness and Unrighteousness, Light and Darkness, Pleasure and Pain.

data.v: तत्र यत्सत्यं स धर्मो यो धर्मः स प्रकाशो यः प्रकाशस्तत्सुखमिति । तत्र यदनृतं सोऽधर्मो योऽधर्मस्तत्तमो यत्तमस्तद्दुःखमिति ॥
data.md: Amongst these, Truth is Righteousness; Righteousness is Light; and Light is Happiness. Likewise Untruth is Unrighteousness; Unrighteousness is Darkness; and darkness is Sorrow or Misery.

data.v: अत्रोच्यते । शारीरैर्मानसैर्दुःखैः सुखैश्चाप्यसुखोदयैः । लोकसृष्टिं प्रपश्यन्तो न मुह्यन्ति विचक्षणाः ॥
data.md: Seeing that the world is stricken with physical and mental pain and with pleasures are that sure to end in misery, the wise never suffer themselves to be stupefied.

data.v: तत्र दुःखविमोक्षार्थं प्रयतेत विचक्षणः । सुखं ह्यनित्यं भूतानामिह लोके परत्र च ॥
data.md: A wiseman will try to rescue himself from sorrow. The happiness of living creatures is fragile both here and hereafter.

data.v: राहुग्रस्तस्य सोमस्य यथा ज्योत्स्ना न भासते । तथा तमोभिभूतानां भूतानां भ्रश्यते सुखम् ॥
data.md: The happiness of creatures that are possessed by Darkness disappears like the cffulgence of the Moon when possessed by Rahu.

data.v: तत्खलु द्विविधं सुखमुच्यते शारीरं मानसं च । इह खल्वमुष्मिंश्च लोके सर्वारम्भप्रवृत्तयः सुखार्था अभिधीयन्ते । न ह्यतस्त्रिवर्गफलं विशिष्टतरमस्ति । स एष काम्यो गुणविशेषो धर्मार्थयोरारम्भस्तद्धेतुरस्योत्पत्तिः सुखप्रयोजना ॥

यदेतद्भवताभिहितं सुखानां परमाः स्त्रिय इति तन्न गृह्णीमः । न ह्येषामृषीणां महति स्थितानामप्राप्य एष गुणविशेषो न चैनमभिलषन्ति । श्रूयते च भगवांस्त्रिलोककृद्ब्रह्मा प्रभुरेकाकी तिष्ठति । ब्रह्मचारी न कामसुखेष्वात्मानमवदधाति । अपि च भगवान्विश्वेश्वर उमापतिः काममभिवर्तमानमनङ्गत्वेन शममनयत् । तस्माद्ब्रूमो न महात्मभिरयं प्रतिगृहीतो न त्वेष तावद्विशिष्टो गुण इति नैतद्भगवतः प्रत्येमि । भगवता तूक्तं सुखानां परमाः स्त्रिय इति । लोकप्रवादोऽपि च भवति द्विविधः फलोदयः सुकृतात्सुखमवाप्यते दुष्कृताद्दुःखमिति । अत्रोच्यताम् ॥

अनृतात्खलु तमः प्रादुर्भूतं तमोग्रस्ता अधर्ममेवानुवर्तन्ते न धर्मम् । क्रोधलोभमोहमानानृतादिभिरवच्छन्ना न खल्वस्मिँल्लोके न चामुत्र सुखमाप्नुवन्ति । विविधव्याधिगणोपतापैरवकीर्यन्ते । वधबन्धरोगपरिक्लेशादिभिश्च क्षुत्पिपासाश्रमकृतैरुपतापैरुपतप्यन्ते । चण्डवातात्युष्णातिशीतकृतैश्च प्रतिभयैः शारीरैर्दुःखैरुपतप्यन्ते । बन्धुधनविनाशविप्रयोगकृतैश्च मानसैः शोकैरभिभूयन्ते जरामृत्युकृतैश्चान्यैरिति ॥
यस्त्वेतैः शारीरैर्मानसैर्दुःखैर्न स्पृश्यते स सुखं वेद । न चैते दोषाः स्वर्गे प्रादुर्भवन्ति । तत्र भवति खलु ॥
सुसुखः पवनः स्वर्गे गन्धश्च सुरभिस्तथा । क्षुत्पिपासाश्रमो नास्ति न जरा न च पापकम् ॥
data.md: These evils do not exist in heaven. There sweet breezes blow. In heaven there is also external fragrance. In heaven there exists no hunger, no thirst, no decrepitude, no sin.

data.v: नित्यमेव सुखं स्वर्गे सुखं दुःखमिहोभयम् । नरके दुःखमेवाहुः समं तु परमं पदम् ॥
data.md: In heaven there is perpetual happiness. Both happiness and misery exist in this world. In hell there is only misery. Happiness is, therefore, the greatest object of acquisition.

data.v: पृथिवी सर्वभूतानां जनित्री तद्विधाः स्त्रियः । पुमान्प्रजापतिस्तत्र शुक्रं तेजोमयं विदुः ॥
data.md: The Earth gives birth of all creatures. Females partake of her nature. The male animal is like Prajapati himself. The seminal fluid, it should be known, is the creative energy.

data.v: इत्येतल्लोकनिर्माणं ब्रह्मणा विहितं पुरा । प्रजा विपरिवर्तन्ते स्वैः स्वैः कर्मभिरावृताः ॥
data.md: In days of yore thus did Brahman ordain that the creation should go on. Each, by his own deeds, obtain happiness and misery.

data.v: दानस्य किं फलं प्राहुर्धर्मस्य चरितस्य च । तपसश्च सुतप्तस्य स्वाध्यायस्य हुतस्य च ॥
data.md: Bharadwaja said, What is the fruit of gift? What of Righteousness? What of conduct? What Penances duly performed? What of the study and recitation of the Vedas? And what of purring libations upon the fire.

data.v: हुतेन शाम्यते पापं स्वाध्याये शान्तिरुत्तमा । दानेन भोग इत्याहुस्तपसा सर्वमाप्नुयात् ॥
data.md: Sin is dissipated by pouring libations on the sacred fire. One comes by blessed place of mind, by study of the Vedas. One acquires pleasures and objects of enjoyment, by gift. One winesblissful heaven by Penances.

data.v: दानं तु द्विविधं प्राहुः परत्रार्थमिहैव च । सद्भ्यो यद्दीयते किंचित्तत्परत्रोपतिष्ठति ॥
data.md: Gift is said to be of two sorts : gifts for the other world, and those for this. Whatever is given to the good yields fruits to the giver in the other world.

data.v: असत्सु दीयते यत्तु तद्दानमिह भुज्यते । यादृशं दीयते दानं तादृशं फलमाप्यते ॥
data.md: Whatever is given to those that are not good yields fruits in this world. The fruits of gifts are proportionate of the gifts offered.

data.v: किं कस्य धर्मचरणं किं वा धर्मस्य लक्षणम् । धर्मः कतिविधो वापि तद्भवान्वक्तुमर्हति ॥
data.md: Bharadwaja said What duties should be performed by whom? What also are the characteristic marks। of duty? How many kinds of duty are there? You should tell me these.

data.v: स्वधर्मचरणे युक्ता ये भवन्ति मनीषिणः । तेषां धर्मफलावाप्तिर्योऽन्यथा स विमुह्यति ॥
data.md: Bhrigu said The wise men who are engaged in performing the duties laid down for them, acquires heaven as their reward. By doing otherwise people are sullied with the sin of folly.

data.v: यदेतच्चातुराश्रम्यं ब्रह्मर्षिविहितं पुरा । तेषां स्वे स्वे य आचारास्तान्मे वक्तुमिहार्हसि ॥
data.md: Bharadwaja said You should tell me about the four modes of life that were formerly laid down by Brahman, also the practices enjoined for each of them.

data.v: पूर्वमेव भगवता लोकहितमनुतिष्ठता धर्मसंरक्षणार्थमाश्रमाश्चत्वारोऽभिनिर्दिष्टाः । तत्र गुरुकुलवासमेव तावत्प्रथममाश्रममुदाहरन्ति । सम्यगत्र शौचसंस्कारविनयनियमप्रणीतो विनीतात्मा उभे संध्ये भास्कराग्निदैवतान्युपस्थाय विहाय तन्द्रालस्ये गुरोरभिवादनवेदाभ्यासश्रवणपवित्रीकृतान्तरात्मा त्रिषवणमुपस्पृश्य ब्रह्मचर्याग्निपरिचरणगुरुशुश्रूषानित्यो भैक्षादिसर्वनिवेदितान्तरात्मा गुरुवचननिर्देशानुष्ठानाप्रतिकूलो गुरुप्रसादलब्धस्वाध्यायतत्परः स्यात् ॥
data.md: Bhrigu said In days of yore, the divine Brahman, for the behoof of the world, and for the protection of righteousness, laid down for modes of life. Of them, to live in the house of the preceptor is the first (in order of time). In this mode of life one should have his soul cleansed by purity of conduct, by Vedic rites and by restraints and vows and humility. He should adore the morning and evening twilights the Sun, his own consecrated hearth, and the gods. He should shake off procrastination and idleness. He should purify his soul by saluting his preceptor, by studying the Vedas, and by attending to his preceptor's instructions. He should perform his ablutions thrice.

data.v: भवति चात्र श्लोकः । गुरुं यस्तु समाराध्य द्विजो वेदमवाप्नुयात् । तस्य स्वर्गफलावाप्तिः सिध्यते चास्य मानसम् ॥
data.md: He should lead a life of celibacy; attend to his consecrated hearth serve his preceptor dutifully; daily go out for alms and give ungrudgingly to his preceptor the whole of what is got in alms. Carrying out willingly the behests of his preceptor, he should be ready to receive such Vedic instruction as his preceptor may give him as a favour. There is a verse on this subject : That Brahmana who receives his Veda by attending reverentially upon his preceptor, attains to heaven and acquires the fruition of all his desires.

data.v: गार्हस्थ्यं खलु द्वितीयमाश्रमं वदन्ति । तस्य समुदाचारलक्षणं सर्वमनुव्याख्यास्यामः । समावृत्तानां सदाराणां सहधर्मचर्याफलार्थिनां गृहाश्रमो विधीयते । धर्मार्थकामावाप्तिर्ह्यत्र त्रिवर्गसाधनमवेक्ष्यागर्हितेन कर्मणा धनान्यादाय स्वाध्यायप्रकर्षोपलब्धेन ब्रह्मर्षिनिर्मितेन वा अद्रिसारगतेन वा हव्यनियमाभ्यासदैवतप्रसादोपलब्धेन वा धनेन गृहस्थो गार्हस्थ्यं प्रवर्तयेत् । तद्धि सर्वाश्रमाणां मूलमुदाहरन्ति । गुरुकुलवासिनः परिव्राजका ये चान्ये संकल्पितव्रतनियमधर्मानुष्ठायिनस्तेषामप्यत एव भिक्षाबलिसंविभागाः प्रवर्तन्ते ॥
data.md: Next comes the life of a householder. We shall explain to you all the pious acts and characteristic marks of that mode. This mode of life is ordained for those who, having lived the full term in the preceptor's house, return home, who are of pious conduct, who wish the fruits of a virtuous life with their wives. In it exist Virtue, Profit and pleasure. It is (thus) suited to the cultivation of the three-fold objects of life. Acquiring riches by irreproachable acts, or with wealth of great efficacy which is got from recitation of the Vedas, or living upon means followed by the regenerate Rishis, or with the produce of inountains and mincs, or with the wealth of offerings made in sacrifices and on the finish of vows and other observances, and those made to gods, the house-holder should lead this mode of life, That mode of life is considered as the root of all the others. Those who live in the houses of preceptors, those who lead lives of mendicancy, and others who observe vows and restraints, derive from this mode the means they live upon, the offerings they make to the departed manes and the gods, and, in short, their entire support.

data.v: वानप्रस्थानां द्रव्योपस्कार इति प्रायशः खल्वेते साधवः साधुपथ्यदर्शनाः स्वाध्यायप्रसङ्गिनस्तीर्थाभिगमनदेशदर्शनार्थं पृथिवीं पर्यटन्ति । तेषां प्रत्युत्थानाभिवादनानसूयावाक्प्रदानसौमुख्यशक्त्यासनशयनाभ्यवहारसत्क्रियाश्चेति ॥
data.md: The third mode of life is called the Vanaprastha or life in forest. Those that lead it, need not kcep in store wealth and articles. Living upon good food, and engaged in the study of the Vedas, generally those pious and god men walk over the Earth for visiting the sacred shrines and various other kingdoms. Standing up, advancing forward, sweet and sincere speeches, gifts according to the means of the giver, offer of seats and beds of the best sort, and presents of excellent viands, are some of the means for showing them regard.

data.v: भवति चात्र श्लोकः । अतिथिर्यस्य भग्नाशो गृहात्प्रतिनिवर्तते । स दत्त्वा दुष्कृतं तस्मै पुण्यमादाय गच्छति ॥
data.md: There is a verse on this subject. If a guest goes away from a house with expectations not fulfilled, he is supposed to take away the merits of the householder and transfer to the latter all his sins.

data.v: अपि चात्र यज्ञक्रियाभिर्देवताः प्रीयन्ते निवापेन पितरो वेदाभ्यासश्रवणधारणेन ऋषयः । अपत्योत्पादनेन प्रजापतिरिति ॥
data.md: Then again in the domestic mode of life the gods are propitiated by sacrifices and other religious rites : the departed manes by the performances of obsequial rites; the Rishis by the study of the Vedas, by listening to the instructions of preceptors, and by getting by heart the scriptures, and lastly the Creator by begetting children.

data.v: श्लोकौ चात्र भवतः । वत्सलाः सर्वभूतानां वाच्याः श्रोत्रसुखा गिरः । परिवादोपघातौ च पारुष्यं चात्र गर्हितम् ॥
data.md: There are two verses on this subject. One following this mode of life, should address all creatures with words of affection, and pleasant to the cars. To give pain, to inflict tortures, and use harsh words, are all censurable.

data.v: अवज्ञानमहंकारो दम्भश्चैव विगर्हितः । अहिंसा सत्यमक्रोधः सर्वाश्रमगतं तपः ॥
data.md: Insult, pride, and, deceit, also should be avoided. Abstention from injury, truth, and absence of anger, yield the merit of penances in all the modes of life.

data.v: अपि चात्र माल्याभरणवस्त्राभ्यङ्गगन्धोपभोगनृत्तगीतवादित्रश्रुतिसुखनयनाभिरामसंदर्शनानां प्राप्तिर्भक्ष्यभोज्यपेयलेह्यचोष्याणामभ्यवहार्याणां विविधानामुपभोगः स्वदारविहारसंतोषः कामसुखावाप्तिरिति ॥
data.md: These are allowed in a house-holders life, viz.., the use and enjoyment of garlands, ornaments, dresses, perfumed oils and scents, enjoyment of pleasures accruing froin dancing and music both vocal and instrumental, and all pleasant sights and scenes; the enjoyment of various kinds of foods and drinks belonging to best kinds of edibles, viz., those that are swallowed, those that are sucked; and the enjoyment of pleasures derivable from sports and all sorts of amusement and the gratification of desires.

data.v: त्रिवर्गगुणनिर्वृत्तिर्यस्य नित्यं गृहाश्रमे । स सुखान्यनुभूयेह शिष्टानां गतिमाप्नुयात् ॥
data.md: That men who following this mode of life seeks to acquire the three-fold objects of life (viz., Religion, Profit, and Pleasure, as well as Emancipation,-the great end of the three qualities of Goodness, Darkness and Ignorance, enjoys grcat happiness in this world and at last attains to the end reserved for virtuous and good persons.

data.v: उञ्छवृत्तिर्गृहस्थो यः स्वधर्मचरणे रतः । त्यक्तकामसुखारम्भस्तस्य स्वर्गो न दुर्लभः ॥
data.md: Even that householder who satisfies the duties of his life by following the practice of picking up fallen grains of corn from the lines of fields and who gives up sensual pleasure and attachment to action, does not find it difficult to acquire heaven.

data.v: वानप्रस्थाः खलु ऋषिधर्ममनुसरन्तः पुण्यानि तीर्थानि नदीप्रस्रवणानि सुविविक्तेष्वरण्येषु मृगमहिषवराहसृमरगजाकीर्णेषु तपस्यन्तोऽनुसंचरन्ति । त्यक्तग्राम्यवस्त्राहारोपभोगा वन्यौषधिमूलफलपर्णपरिमितविचित्रनियताहाराः स्थानासनिनो भूमिपाषाणसिकताशर्करावालुकाभस्मशायिनः काशकुशचर्मवल्कलसंवृताङ्गाः केशश्मश्रुनखरोमधारिणो नियतकालोपस्पर्शना अस्कन्नहोमबलिकालानुष्ठायिनः समित्कुशकुसुमोपहारहोमार्जनलब्धविश्रामाः शीतोष्णपवननिष्टप्तविभिन्नसर्वत्वचो विविधनियमयोगचर्याविहितधर्मानुष्ठानहृतमांसशोणितास्त्वगस्थिभूता धृतिपराः सत्त्वयोगाच्छरीराण्युद्वहन्ति ॥
यस्त्वेतां नियतश्चर्यां ब्रह्मर्षिविहितां चरेत् । स दहेदग्निवद्दोषाञ्जयेल्लोकांश्च दुर्जयान् ॥
data.md: That person who, with controlled soul, follows such duties originally laid down by regenerate Rishis, consumes all his sins like fire and acquires blissful regions for themselves which are so difficult of attaining.

data.v: परिव्राजकानां पुनराचारस्तद्यथा । विमुच्याग्निधनकलत्रपरिबर्हसङ्गानात्मनः स्नेहपाशानवधूय परिव्रजन्ति समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनास्त्रिवर्गप्रवृत्तेष्वारम्भेष्वसक्तबुद्धयोऽरिमित्रोदासीनेषु तुल्यवृत्तयः स्थावरजरायुजाण्डजस्वेदजोद्भिज्जानां भूतानां वाङ्मनःकर्मभिरनभिद्रोहिणोऽनिकेताः पर्वतपुलिनवृक्षमूलदेवतायतनान्यनुचरन्तो वासार्थमुपेयुर्नगरं ग्रामं वा नगरे पञ्चरात्रिका ग्रामैकरात्रिकाः । प्रविश्य च प्राणधारणमात्रार्थं द्विजातीनां भवनान्यसंकीर्णकर्मणामुपतिष्ठेयुः पात्रपतितायाचितभैक्षाः कामक्रोधदर्पमोहलोभकार्पण्यदम्भपरिवादाभिमानहिंसानिवृत्ता इति ॥
data.md: I shall now describe the conduct of the Parivrajakas, which is as follows : alienating themselves from attachment to the sacred fire, wealth, wife and children, and robes, seats, beds, and such other objects of enjoyment, and snapping the fetters of affection, they walk about, regarding with an equal eye a clump of earth or rock and gold. They never think of acquiring or enjoying the threefold objects of life. They regard impartially foes and friends and neutrals or strangers. They never injure, in thought, word, or deed, immobile objects, or creatures that are viviparous, or oviparous, or born of fifth, or called vegetables. They have no homes. They road over hills and mountains, upon shores of rivers or oceans, under shades of trees, and among temples of gods, They may go to towns or villages for living. In one town, however, they should not live for more than five nights, while in the same village they should not live for more than one night. Entering a town or a village, they should , for maintaining their life, go to the houses of liberal Brahmanas only. They should never ask for any alms but accept what is put into the bowls they carry. They should free themselves from lust, anger, pride, cupidity, delusion, miserliness, deceit, slander, vanity, and injury to creatures.

data.v: भवति चात्र श्लोकः । अभयं सर्वभूतेभ्यो दत्त्वा चरति यो मुनिः । न तस्य सर्वभूतेभ्यो भयमुत्पद्यते क्वचित् ॥
data.md: There are some verses on this subject-that person who, observing the vow of silence roams without giving any creature cause of fear, is never filled with any fear himself by any creature.

data.v: कृत्वाग्निहोत्रं स्वशरीरसंस्थं; शारीरमग्निं स्वमुखे जुहोति । यो भैक्षचर्योपगतैर्हविर्भि;श्चिताग्निनां स व्यतियाति लोकान् ॥
data.md: That learned person who performs the Agnihotra with the help of the fire that is in his own body, who pours libations into his own body,-acquires endless blissful regions on account of that fire having been fed with such libations acquired by a life of mendicancy.

data.v: मोक्षाश्रमं यः कुरुते यथोक्तं; शुचिः सुसंकल्पितबुद्धियुक्तः । अनिन्धनं ज्योतिरिव प्रशान्तं; स ब्रह्मलोकं श्रयते द्विजातिः ॥
data.md: That twice-born person who observes in the aforesaid way this mode of life having Liberation for its end, with a pure heart and understanding, attains to Brahma after the manner of tranquil ray of light that is not fed by any burning fuel.

data.v: अस्माल्लोकात्परो लोकः श्रूयते नोपलभ्यते । तमहं ज्ञातुमिच्छामि तद्भवान्वक्तुमर्हति ॥
data.md: Bharadwaja said Beyond this region there is a region of which we have heard but never seen. I wish to know all about it. You should describe it to me.

data.v: उत्तरे हिमवत्पार्श्वे पुण्ये सर्वगुणान्विते । पुण्यः क्षेम्यश्च काम्यश्च स वरो लोक उच्यते ॥
data.md: Bhrigu said Towards the north on the other a side of Himvat, which is sacred and full of merit, there is a sacred, blessed, and highly desirable region. That is called the other world.

data.v: तत्र ह्यपापकर्माणः शुचयोऽत्यन्तनिर्मलाः । लोभमोहपरित्यक्ता मानवा निरुपद्रवाः ॥
data.md: The men who dwell in that region are righteous in act, pious, of pure hearts, freed from cupidity and errors of judgement, and not subject to iniseries of any sort.

data.v: स स्वर्गसदृशो देशस्तत्र ह्युक्ताः शुभा गुणाः । काले मृत्युः प्रभवति स्पृशन्ति व्याधयो न च ॥
data.md: That region is, equal to heaven, possessed of excellent attributes. Death comes there at the proper time. Diseases never attack the inhabitants.

data.v: न लोभः परदारेषु स्वदारनिरतो जनः । न चान्योन्यवधस्तत्र द्रव्येषु न च विस्मयः । परोक्षधर्मो नैवास्ति संदेहो नापि जायते ॥
data.md: Nobody looks for the wives of other people. Every one is devoted to his own wife. These people do not assail or kill one another, or covet one another's things. There is no sin or doubt.

data.v: कृतस्य तु फलं तत्र प्रत्यक्षमुपलभ्यते । शय्यायानासनोपेताः प्रासादभवनाश्रयाः । सर्वकामैर्वृताः केचिद्धेमाभरणभूषिताः ॥
data.md: There the fruits of all sacred rites are visible. There some enjoy seats and best sorts of drinks and food, and live within palaces and mansions.

data.v: प्राणधारणमात्रं तु केषांचिदुपपद्यते । श्रमेण महता केचित्कुर्वन्ति प्राणधारणम् ॥
data.md: There some, bedecked with ornaments of gold, surround themselves every article of enjoyment. There are again, some that eat very sparingly for only keeping body and soul together.

data.v: इह धर्मपराः केचित्केचिन्नैकृतिका नराः । सुखिता दुःखिताः केचिन्निर्धना धनिनोऽपरे ॥
data.md: There some, with great exertion, try to suppress the vital airs. Here some men and devoted to righteousness, and some addicted to deceit. Some are happy and some wretched; some are poor and some, rich.

data.v: इह श्रमो भयं मोहः क्षुधा तीव्रा च जायते । लोभश्चार्थकृतो नॄणां येन मुह्यन्ति पण्डिताः ॥
data.md: Here are to be found exhaustion, and fear, and delusion and painful hunger. here cupidity for wealth is also seen, a passion that stupefies even the learned.

data.v: इह चिन्ता बहुविधा धर्माधर्मस्य कर्मणः । यस्तद्वेदोभयं प्राज्ञः पाप्मना न स लिप्यते ॥
data.md: Here various opinions are advanced by those who do virtuous or sinful deeds. That wise man who knows all those opinions which may be divided into two sorts, is never sullied by sin.

data.v: सोपधं निकृतिः स्तेयं परिवादोऽभ्यसूयता । परोपघातो हिंसा च पैशुन्यमनृतं तथा ॥
एतानासेवते यस्तु तपस्तस्य प्रहीयते । यस्त्वेतान्नाचरेद्विद्वांस्तपस्तस्याभिवर्धते ॥
data.md: Deceit with fraud, theft, slander malice, oppression, injury, treachery, and untruth, are vices which destroy the merit of one's penances. A learned man however, who avoids them, find the merit of his penances multiplied.

data.v: कर्मभूमिरियं लोक इह कृत्वा शुभाशुभम् । शुभैः शुभमवाप्नोति कृत्वाशुभमतोऽन्यथा ॥
data.md: Here there is much thought about fair and sinful acts. This region where we live is the field of action. One reaps the fruits of his actions, according to thelife he has led.

data.v: इह प्रजापतिः पूर्वं देवाः सर्षिगणास्तथा । इष्ट्वेष्टतपसः पूता ब्रह्मलोकमुपाश्रिताः ॥
data.md: Here, in days of yore, the very Creator and all the gods having performed proper penances, with the Rishis became cleansed and attained to Brahma.

data.v: उत्तरः पृथिवीभागः सर्वपुण्यतमः शुभः । इहत्यास्तत्र जायन्ते ये वै पुण्यकृतो जनाः ॥
data.md: The northern port of the Earth is highly auspicious and sacred. People of our region who perform fair deeds or show regard for Yoga, are born in that region. Others are born in the intermediate species. Some again, when their lease of life run out, become lost on Earth.

data.v: असत्कर्माणि कुर्वन्तस्तिर्यग्योनिषु चापरे । क्षीणायुषस्तथैवान्ये नश्यन्ति पृथिवीतले ॥
data.md: The northern port of the Earth is highly auspicious and sacred. People of our region who perform fair deeds or show regard for Yoga, are born in that region. Others are born in the intermediate species. Some again, when their lease of life run out, become lost on Earth.

data.v: अन्योन्यभक्षणे सक्ता लोभमोहसमन्विताः । इहैव परिवर्तन्ते न ते यान्त्युत्तरां दिशम् ॥
data.md: Engaged in feeding upon one another and sullied by cupidity and delusion, these men return to this very region without being able to go to that northern region.

data.v: ये गुरूनुपसेवन्ते नियता ब्रह्मचारिणः । पन्थानं सर्वलोकानां ते जानन्ति मनीषिणः ॥
data.md: Those wise men who with vows and observing Brahmacharya listen with reverence to the instructions of preceptors, can learn the ends reserved for all classes of men.

data.v: इत्युक्तोऽयं मया धर्मः संक्षेपाद्ब्रह्मनिर्मितः । धर्माधर्मौ हि लोकस्य यो वै वेत्ति स बुद्धिमान् ॥
data.md: I have now described to you briefly the duties laid down by Brahman. He, indeed, in an intelligent men who knows what is righteousness and its opposite in this world.

data.v: इत्युक्तो भृगुणा राजन्भरद्वाजः प्रतापवान् । भृगुं परमधर्मात्मा विस्मितः प्रत्यपूजयत् ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Thus, O king, did Bhrigu speak the highly energetic Bharadwaja. Of highly virtuous soul the latter became filled with wonder and adored the great sage with veneration.

data.v: एष ते प्रभवो राजञ्जगतः संप्रकीर्तितः । निखिलेन महाप्राज्ञ किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि ॥
data.md: Thus, O king, the origin of the universe has been described fully to you. What, O you of great wisdom, do you wish to hear after this.'

data.v: आचारस्य विधिं तात प्रोच्यमानं त्वयानघ । श्रोतुमिच्छामि धर्मज्ञ सर्वज्ञो ह्यसि मे मतः ॥
data.md: I think, O grandfather, that you know everything. O you, who are conversant with duties, I wish to hear you describe to me, O sinless one, the ordinances about conduct.

data.v: दुराचारा दुर्विचेष्टा दुष्प्रज्ञाः प्रियसाहसाः । असन्तो ह्यभिविख्याताः सन्तश्चाचारलक्षणाः ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Those are called wicked men who are of bad conduct, of bad acts, of wicked understanding, and great rashness, gusihed by purity of conduct and habit.

data.v: पुरीषं यदि वा मूत्रं ये न कुर्वन्ति मानवाः । राजमार्गे गवां मध्ये धान्यमध्ये च ते शुभाः ॥
data.md: They are good men who never answer calls of nature on the high roads, in cowpens, or in fields filled with paddy.

data.v: शौचमावश्यकं कृत्वा देवतानां च तर्पणम् । धर्ममाहुर्मनुष्याणामुपस्पृश्य नदीं तरेत् ॥
data.md: One should, having finished the necessary rites, perform; his ablutions in river-water and gratify the gods with oblations of water. This is the duty of all men.

data.v: सूर्यं सदोपतिष्ठेत न स्वप्याद्भास्करोदये । सायं प्रातर्जपन्संध्यां तिष्ठेत्पूर्वां तथापराम् ॥
data.md: The Sun-god should be always adored. One should not sleep after sunrise. Morning and evening the prayers, should be said, sitting with face turned towards the East and towards the West respectively.

data.v: पञ्चार्द्रो भोजनं कुर्यात्प्राङ्मुखो मौनमास्थितः । न निन्देदन्नभक्ष्यांश्च स्वाद्वस्वादु च भक्षयेत् ॥
data.md: One should, washing the five limbs, eal silently with face turned towards the East, One should never speak of the food which he is to eal. One should eat food which is good to the taste.

data.v: नार्द्रपाणिः समुत्तिष्ठेन्नार्द्रपादः स्वपेन्निशि । देवर्षिनारदप्रोक्तमेतदाचारलक्षणम् ॥
data.md: One should, washing the five limbs, cat silently with face turned towards the East. One should never speak of the food which he is to cal. One should eat food which is good to the taste.

data.v: शुचिकाममनड्वाहं देवगोष्ठं चतुष्पथम् । ब्राह्मणं धार्मिकं चैव नित्यं कुर्यात्प्रदक्षिणम् ॥
data.md: One should every day go round a sacred place, a bull, a sacred image, a cowpen, the crossing point of four roads, a pious Brahmana, and a sacred tree.

data.v: अतिथीनां च सर्वेषां प्रेष्याणां स्वजनस्य च । सामान्यं भोजनं भृत्यैः पुरुषस्य प्रशस्यते ॥
data.md: One should make no distinctions between his guests and servants and kinsmen in matters of food. To treat servants equally in this matter is highly spoken of.

data.v: सायं प्रातर्मनुष्याणामशनं देवनिर्मितम् । नान्तरा भोजनं दृष्टमुपवासी तथा भवेत् ॥
data.md: Eating morning and evening is an ordinance of the gods. It is not sanctioned that one should eat at any intermediate period. He who cats according to this rule gains the merit of a fast.

data.v: होमकाले तथा जुह्वन्नृतुकाले तथा व्रजन् । अनन्यस्त्रीजनः प्राज्ञो ब्रह्मचारी तथा भवेत् ॥
data.md: One should pour libations, at the hours fixed for Homa, on the sacred fire. Without wishing to know other people's wives, the wisc man who seeks his own wife in her season, acquires the merit of Brahmacharya.

data.v: अमृतं ब्राह्मणोच्छिष्टं जनन्या हृदयं कृतम् । उपासीत जनः सत्यं सत्यं सन्त उपासते ॥
data.md: The remnants of a Brahmana's food are like nectar. They are like the mother's milk. People highly value those remnants. The god, by cating them, attain to Brahma.

data.v: यजुषा संस्कृतं मांसं निवृत्तो मांसभक्षणात् । न भक्षयेद्वृथामांसं पृष्ठमांसं च वर्जयेत् ॥
data.md: One who has abstained from meat, should not take meat even if it be sanctified with Mantras from the Yajurveda. One should also avoid the flesh of the vertebral column and the flesh of animals not killed in sacrifices.

data.v: स्वदेशे परदेशे वा अतिथिं नोपवासयेत् । काम्यं कर्मफलं लब्ध्वा गुरूणामुपपादयेत् ॥
data.md: One should never make his guest to fast, whether at his own house or in a strange land. One should, having obtained alms, offer them of his elders.

data.v: गुरुभ्य आसनं देयं कर्तव्यं चाभिवादनम् । गुरूनभ्यर्च्य युज्यन्ते आयुषा यशसा श्रिया ॥
data.md: One should offer seats to his elders and respectfully bow to them. One obtains long life, fame, and prosperity, by a doing his elders.

data.v: नेक्षेतादित्यमुद्यन्तं न च नग्नां परस्त्रियम् । मैथुनं समये धर्म्यं गुह्यं चैव समाचरेत् ॥
data.md: One should never see the Sun at the moment of rising, nor should one gaze at a naked woman who is another man's wife. Living with one's wife (in her season) is not sinful, but it is an act that should always be done secretly.

data.v: तीर्थानां हृदयं तीर्थं शुचीनां हृदयं शुचिः । सर्वमार्यकृतं शौचं वालसंस्पर्शनानि च ॥
data.md: The heart of all sacred places and shrines is the Preceptor. The heart of all pure and cleansing things is Fire. All acts done by a good and pious person are good and praiseworthy, including even the touching of the hair of a cow's tail.

data.v: दर्शने दर्शने नित्यं सुखप्रश्नमुदाहरेत् । सायं प्रातश्च विप्राणां प्रदिष्टमभिवादनम् ॥
data.md: One should make polite enquiries every time he meets with another. One should salute Brahmanas every morning and evening.

data.v: देवगोष्ठे गवां मध्ये ब्राह्मणानां क्रियापथे । स्वाध्याये भोजने चैव दक्षिणं पाणिमुद्धरेत् ॥
data.md: In temple of gods, amid cows, in performing the rites of religion sanctioned for Brahmanas, in studying, the Vedas, and in Brahmanas, in studying, the Vedas, and in eating, the right hand should be raised.

data.v: पण्यानां शोभनं पण्यं कृषीणां बाद्यते कृषिः । बहुकारं च सस्यानां वाह्ये वाह्यं तथा गवाम् ॥
data.md: The adoration of Brahmanas, morning and evening, according to due rites, yields great merit. Through such worship the stock of the merchant, and the produce of the agriculturist, become profuse. The produce of all sorts of corn and the supply of all articles of enjoyment also become profuse.

data.v: संपन्नं भोजने नित्यं पानीये तर्पणं तथा । सुशृतं पायसे ब्रूयाद्यवाग्वां कृसरे तथा ॥
श्मश्रुकर्मणि संप्राप्ते क्षुते स्नानेऽथ भोजने । व्याधितानां च सर्वेषामायुष्यमभिनन्दनम् ॥
data.md: One should say, while giving food to another.-'Is it sufficient?' One should ask, when presenting drink,-Will it please?-One should ask, when giving sweetened milk and rice, or sugared gruel of barley, or milk with or pcas,-Has it fallen?-People should respectfully adore Brahmanas, after shaving, after spitting, after bathing, and after eating. Such adoration is sure to grant longlife to sickly men.

data.v: प्रत्यादित्यं न मेहेत न पश्येदात्मनः शकृत् । सुतस्त्रिया च शयनं सहभोज्यं च वर्जयेत् ॥
data.md: One should not pass urine with face turned towards the Sun, nor should one see his own excreta. One should not lie on the same bed with a woman, nor eat with her.

data.v: त्वंकारं नामधेयं च ज्येष्ठानां परिवर्जयेत् । अवराणां समानानामुभयेषां न दुष्यति ॥
data.md: One should never Thou-Thee their elders, while addressing them, nor take their names. Thou-,thee-,ing, or taking of names, is only allowable in addressing inferiors or one's compeers.

data.v: हृदयं पापवृत्तानां पापमाख्याति वैकृतम् । ज्ञानपूर्वं विनश्यन्ति गूहमाना महाजने ॥
data.md: sesame The hearts of sinful men betray the sins committed by them. Those sinful men who conceal their conscious sins from good men meet with destruction.

data.v: ज्ञानपूर्वं कृतं पापं छादयन्त्यबहुश्रुताः । नैनं मनुष्याः पश्यन्ति पश्यन्ति त्रिदिवौकसः ॥
data.md: Only ignorant fools try to conceal the sins which they commit knowingly. It is true that men do not see those sins, but the gods see them.

data.v: पापेन हि कृतं पापं पापमेवानुवर्तते । धार्मिकेण कृतो धर्मः कर्तारमनुवर्तते ॥
data.md: A sin concealed by another sin begets fresh sins. Again, an act of merit increases the merit, if concealed by an act of merit. The acts of a virtuous man always follow Virtue.

data.v: पापं कृतं न स्मरतीह मूढो; विवर्तमानस्य तदेति कर्तुः । राहुर्यथा चन्द्रमुपैति चापि; तथाबुधं पापमुपैति कर्म ॥
data.md: A man shorn of understanding never thinks of the sins committed by him. Those sins, however, overtake the doer who has disregarded the scriptures. As Rahu comes to Chandra, those sinful acts come to the foolish man.

data.v: आशया संचितं द्रव्यं यत्काले नेह भुज्यते । तद्बुधा न प्रशंसन्ति मरणं न प्रतीक्षते ॥
data.md: If the wealth is preserved with the hope of some desire, its end is painful. The wise are not in favour of that. The death does not wait for desire.

data.v: मानसं सर्वभूतानां धर्ममाहुर्मनीषिणः । तस्मात्सर्वेषु भूतेषु मनसा शिवमाचरेत् ॥
data.md: The objects that are the righteousness of all creatures is a quality of the mind. One should, therefore, in his hand, do good to all.

data.v: एक एव चरेद्धर्मं नास्ति धर्मे सहायता । केवलं विधिमासाद्य सहायः किं करिष्यति ॥
data.md: One should practise virtue alone. In the practice of virtue one need not seek the help of others. If one follows only the ordinances of the scriptures, what can companion do.

data.v: देवा योनिर्मनुष्याणां देवानाममृतं दिवि । प्रेत्यभावे सुखं धर्माच्छश्वत्तैरुपभुज्यते ॥
data.md: Righteousness is the origin of mankind. Righteousness is the nectar of the gods. After death, men enjoy, through Righteousness, eternal felicity.

data.v: अध्यात्मं नाम यदिदं पुरुषस्येह चिन्त्यते । यदध्यात्मं यतश्चैतत्तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह ॥
data.md: Yudhishthira said Tell me, O grandfather, what and of what nature is that which passes by the name of Adhyatma (spiritual) and which is laid down for ever person.

data.v: अध्यात्ममिति मां पार्थ यदेतदनुपृच्छसि । तद्व्याख्यास्यामि ते तात श्रेयस्करतरं सुखम् ॥
data.md: Bhishma said This Adhyatma, O son of Pritha, that you ask me about, I will presently describe. It is, O son, highly agreeable and productive of great happiness.

data.v: यज्ज्ञात्वा पुरुषो लोके प्रीतिं सौख्यं च विन्दति । फललाभश्च सद्यः स्यात्सर्वभूतहितं च तत् ॥
data.md: Great teachers have (before this) described the Creation and the Destruction of the universe). Knowing those truths, a person may acquire, even in this world, great satisfaction and happiness. Such knowledge also bring on the acquisition of great fruits, and it is highly beneficial to all creatures.

data.v: पृथिवी वायुराकाशमापो ज्योतिश्च पञ्चमम् । महाभूतानि भूतानां सर्वेषां प्रभवाप्ययौ ॥
data.md: Earth, Wind, Ether, Water, and Light forming the fifth, are the great elements. These are the origin and the destruction of all creatures.

data.v: ततः सृष्टानि तत्रैव तानि यान्ति पुनः पुनः । महाभूतानि भूतेषु सागरस्योर्मयो यथा ॥
data.md: To Him from whom these great primal elements spring, they return again and again severing themselves from all creatures like the wave of the ocean.

data.v: प्रसार्य च यथाङ्गानि कूर्मः संहरते पुनः । तद्वद्भूतानि भूतात्मा सृष्ट्वा संहरते पुनः ॥
data.md: As the tortoise extends its limbs and withdraws them again, so the Supreme Soul creates all objects and again withdraws them into Himself.

data.v: महाभूतानि पञ्चैव सर्वभूतेषु भूतकृत् । अकरोत्तेषु वैषम्यं तत्तु जीवोऽनु पश्यति ॥
data.md: The Creator places the five primary clements in all created objects in different proportions. The living creature, however, does not mark it.

data.v: शब्दः श्रोत्रं तथा खानि त्रयमाकाशयोनिजम् । वायोस्त्वक्स्पर्शचेष्टाश्च वागित्येतच्चतुष्टयम् ॥
data.md: Sound, the organ of hearing, and all holes,-these three, originate from Space Touch, action, and skin are the three-fold attributes of the Wind.

data.v: रूपं चक्षुस्तथा पक्तिस्त्रिविधं तेज उच्यते । रसः क्लेदश्च जिह्वा च त्रयो जलगुणाः स्मृताः ॥
data.md: Form, cye, and digestion are the three-fold attributes of Fire or Energy. Taste all liquid secretions, and the tongue are the three attributes of Water.

data.v: घ्रेयं घ्राणं शरीरं च ते तु भूमिगुणास्त्रयः । महाभूतानि पञ्चैव षष्ठं तु मन उच्यते ॥
data.md: Smell, the nose, and the body are the three properties, of Earth. The great elements are five. The mind is the sixth.

data.v: इन्द्रियाणि मनश्चैव विज्ञानान्यस्य भारत । सप्तमी बुद्धिरित्याहुः क्षेत्रज्ञः पुनरष्टमः ॥
data.md: The senses and the mind, O Bharata are the organs through which the cognition of a living creature is made. The seventh is the understanding; and the eight is the soul.

data.v: चक्षुरालोकनायैव संशयं कुरुते मनः । बुद्धिरध्यवसायाय क्षेत्रज्ञः साक्षिवत्स्थितः ॥
data.md: The senses are for perceiving; the mind creates uncertainty. The understanding brings all knowledge to certainty. The Soul exists as a witness.

data.v: ऊर्ध्वं पादतलाभ्यां यदर्वागूर्ध्वं च पश्यति । एतेन सर्वमेवेदं विद्ध्यभिव्याप्तमन्तरम् ॥
data.md: All that is above the two feet, all that is behind, and all that is above, are witnessed by the Soul. Know that the Soul permeates the entire being without left vacant.

data.v: पुरुषे चेन्द्रियाणीह वेदितव्यानि कृत्स्नशः । तमो रजश्च सत्त्वं च विद्धि भावांस्तदाश्रयान् ॥
data.md: All men should know fully the senses, the mind and the understanding. The three universal tendencies qualities called Goodness, Darkness and Ignorance, exist, dependent on the senses, the mind, and the understanding.

data.v: एतां बुद्ध्वा नरो बुद्ध्या भूतानामागतिं गतिम् । समवेक्ष्य शनैश्चैव लभते शममुत्तमम् ॥
data.md: Man, by understanding with the help of his intelligence, the manner in which creatures come and leave the world, is sure to attain by and by to steadfast peace.

data.v: गुणान्नेनीयते बुद्धिर्बुद्धिरेवेन्द्रियाण्यपि । मनःषष्ठानि सर्वाणि बुद्ध्यभावे कुतो गुणाः ॥
data.md: or The three qualities lead the understanding to worldly attachments. In this matter, the Understanding is identical with the Senses and the Mind. The Understanding, therefore, is identical with the six (the five senses and the mind), and also with the objects cognised by it. When, however, the Understanding is destroyed, the three qualities cannot produce action.

data.v: इति तन्मयमेवैतत्सर्वं स्थावरजङ्गमम् । प्रलीयते चोद्भवति तस्मान्निर्दिश्यते तथा ॥
data.md: This universe of mobile and iinmobile objects consists of that Intelligence. It is from that Intelligence that everything originales and it is into it that everything originates and it is into it that everything subsides. The scriptures point out, therefore, that everything is a manifestation of Intelligence.

data.v: येन पश्यति तच्चक्षुः शृणोति श्रोत्रमुच्यते । जिघ्रति घ्राणमित्याहू रसं जानाति जिह्वया ॥
data.md: That by which one sees, that is eye hears is the car. That by which one smells is called the organ of smell, and that by which one distinguishes the tastes is called the tongue.

data.v: त्वचा स्पृशति च स्पर्शान्बुद्धिर्विक्रियतेऽसकृत् । येन संकल्पयत्यर्थं किंचिद्भवति तन्मनः ॥
data.md: One acquires perception of touch by the skin that covers the body. That which is called the Intelligence undergoes changes. When the Intelligence desires anything it is called Mind.

data.v: अधिष्ठानानि बुद्धेर्हि पृथगर्थानि पञ्चधा । पञ्चेन्द्रियाणि यान्याहुस्तान्यदृश्योऽधितिष्ठति ॥
data.md: The foundations of the Intelligence are five in number, cach serving a different purpose. They are called the sense. The invisible principle. viz., Intelligence, Depends on them.

data.v: पुरुषाधिष्ठिता बुद्धिस्त्रिषु भावेषु वर्तते । कदाचिल्लभते प्रीतिं कदाचिदनुशोचति ॥
data.md: The Intelligence that exists in a living creature embraces the three qualities. Sometimes it obtains happiness and sometimes misery.

data.v: न सुखेन न दुःखेन कदाचिदपि वर्तते । एवं नराणां मनसि त्रिषु भावेष्ववस्थिता ॥
data.md: Sometimes it becomes shorn of both joy and misery. Thus Intelligence exists on the minds of all men.

data.v: सेयं भावात्मिका भावांस्त्रीनेतान्नातिवर्तते । सरितां सागरो भर्ता महावेलामिवोर्मिमान् ॥
data.md: The Understanding, however, whose chief function is to create elements, transcends those three states as the ocean, the king of rivers, stands against the powerful currents of the rivers that fall into it.

data.v: अतिभावगता बुद्धिर्भावे मनसि वर्तते । प्रवर्तमानं हि रजस्तद्भावमनुवर्तते ॥
data.md: That Intelligence which transcends the three qualities exists in the mind in a purc state, of (unmodified) existence alone. The quality of Darkness, however, that leads to action, soon pursues it.

data.v: इन्द्रियाणि हि सर्वाणि प्रदर्शयति सा सदा । प्रीतिः सत्त्वं रजः शोकस्तमो मोहश्च ते त्रयः ॥
data.md: At that time the Intelligence sets and the senses to action. The properties of the three are these : happiness dwell in Goodness; sorrow in Darkness; delusion in Ignorance.

data.v: ये ये च भावा लोकेऽस्मिन्सर्वेष्वेतेषु ते त्रिषु । इति बुद्धिगतिः सर्वा व्याख्याता तव भारत ॥
data.md: All the states of the mind are included in the three qualities. I have now, O Bharata, described to you the course of the understanding.

data.v: इन्द्रियाणि च सर्वाणि विजेतव्यानि धीमता । सत्त्वं रजस्तमश्चैव प्राणिनां संश्रिताः सदा ॥
data.md: An intelligent man should control all his senses. The three qualities of Goodness, Darkness and Ignorance are always attached to living creatures.

data.v: त्रिविधा वेदना चैव सर्वसत्त्वेषु दृश्यते । सात्त्विकी राजसी चैव तामसी चेति भारत ॥
data.md: Three kinds of intelligence also are seen in every creature, viz., that which depends upon Goodness, that upon darkness, and that upon Ignorance, O Bharata.

data.v: सुखस्पर्शः सत्त्वगुणो दुःखस्पर्शो रजोगुणः । तमोगुणेन संयुक्तौ भवतोऽव्यावहारिकौ ॥
data.md: The quality of goodness brings happiness; the quality of Darkness produces sorrow; and if these two combine with the quality of Ignorance then neither happiness nor sorrow is produced.

data.v: तत्र यत्प्रीतिसंयुक्तं काये मनसि वा भवेत् । वर्तते सात्त्विको भाव इत्यवेक्षेत तत्तदा ॥
data.md: Every state of happiness that appears in the body or the mind is due to the quality of Goodness.

data.v: अथ यद्दुःखसंयुक्तमतुष्टिकरमात्मनः । प्रवृत्तं रज इत्येव तन्नसंरभ्य चिन्तयेत् ॥
data.md: A disagreeable state of sorrow to oneself, is due to nothing but the quality of Darkness. One should never think of it in fear.

data.v: अथ यन्मोहसंयुक्तमव्यक्तमिव यद्भवेत् । अप्रतर्क्यमविज्ञेयं तमस्तदुपधारयेत् ॥
data.md: That state, which is full of delusion and error, and for which one knows not what to do, which is unascertainable and unknown, should be regarded as belonging to the quality of Ignorance.

data.v: प्रहर्षः प्रीतिरानन्दः सुखं संशान्तचित्तता । कथंचिदभिवर्तन्त इत्येते सात्त्विका गुणाः ॥
data.md: Joy, satisfaction, delight, happiness, tranquillity of heart, these are the properties of the state of Goodness. Man sometimes acquires a portion of them.

data.v: अतुष्टिः परितापश्च शोको लोभस्तथाक्षमा । लिङ्गानि रजसस्तानि दृश्यन्ते हेत्वहेतुभिः ॥
data.md: Discontent, heart-burning, grief, cupidity, vindictiveness, are all marks of darkness. They are seen with or without sufficient causes for producing them.

data.v: अभिमानस्तथा मोहः प्रमादः स्वप्नतन्द्रिता । कथंचिदभिवर्तन्ते विविधास्तामसा गुणाः ॥
data.md: Disgrace, delusion, error, slcep and stupefaction, that befall one through excess of ill-luck, are various properties of the state of Jgnorance.

data.v: दूरगं बहुधागामि प्रार्थनासंशयात्मकम् । मनः सुनियतं यस्य स सुखी प्रेत्य चेह च ॥
data.md: That person whose mind is far-reaching, capable of going on all directions, not confident about acquiring the objects it desires, and well-controlled, is happy both here and hereafter.

data.v: सत्त्वक्षेत्रज्ञयोरेतदन्तरं पश्य सूक्ष्मयोः । सृजते तु गुणानेक एको न सृजते गुणान् ॥
data.md: Mark the differences between those two subtile things, viz., Intelligence and the Soul. One of these viz., Intelligence (displays of qualities. The other viz., the Soul) does nothing of the kind.

data.v: मशकोदुम्बरौ चापि संप्रयुक्तौ यथा सदा । अन्योन्यमन्यौ च यथा संप्रयोगस्तथा तयोः ॥
data.md: A gnat and a fig may be seen to be united with each other. Though united, each, however, is separate from the other.

data.v: पृथग्भूतौ प्रकृत्या तौ संप्रयुक्तौ च सर्वदा । यथा मत्स्यो जलं चैव संप्रयुक्तौ तथैव तौ ॥
data.md: Likewise, Intelligence and Soul, though different from each other, by their by their respective natures, yet they may always be seen to exist in a state of union. A fish and water exist together. But cach, however, the case with Intelligence and Soul.

data.v: न गुणा विदुरात्मानं स गुणान्वेत्ति सर्वशः । परिद्रष्टा गुणानां च संस्रष्टा मन्यते सदा ॥
data.md: The qualities do not know the Soul, but the Soul knows them all. The Soul is the spectator of the qualities and consider them all as emanating from itself.

data.v: इन्द्रियैस्तु प्रदीपार्थं कुरुते बुद्धिसप्तमैः । निर्विचेष्टैरजानद्भिः परमात्मा प्रदीपवत् ॥
data.md: Acting through the senses, the mind, and the understanding which is the seventh, all of which are inactive and have no self-consciousness, the Soul discovers the objects like a lamp showing all objects around it by shedding its rays through an opening in the covering.

data.v: सृजते हि गुणान्सत्त्वं क्षेत्रज्ञः परिपश्यति । संप्रयोगस्तयोरेष सत्त्वक्षेत्रज्ञयोर्ध्रुवः ॥
data.md: The understanding or Intelligence creates all the qualities. The Soul only sees them. Such is certainly the connection between the Intelligence and the Soul.

data.v: आश्रयो नास्ति सत्त्वस्य क्षेत्रज्ञस्य च कश्चन । सत्त्वं मनः संसृजति न गुणान्वै कदाचन ॥
