(when seen through spectacles), as a mirror shows a person his own face, so the soul becomes an object of the Understanding's apprehension.

data.v: यदिन्द्रियैस्तूपकृतान्पुरस्ता;त्प्राप्तान्गुणान्संस्मरते चिराय । तेष्विन्द्रियेषूपहतेषु पश्चा;त्स बुद्धिरूपः परमः स्वभावः ॥
data.md: Manu said The mind united with the senses, remembers after a long time the impressions of objects received in the past. When the action of the senses is suspended, the Supreme Soul in the form in the Understanding, exists in its own true nature.

data.v: यथेन्द्रियार्थान्युगपत्समस्ता;न्नावेक्षते कृत्स्नमतुल्यकालम् । यथाबलं संचरते स विद्वां;स्तस्मात्स एकः परमः शरीरी ॥
data.md: When the Soul does not in the least regard all those objects for their simultaniety or otherwise in point of time but collecting them from all directions holds them before it together, it necessarily happens that he wanders among all incongruous things. He is, therefore, the Witness. Hence the Soul put in body is something having a distinct and independent existence.

data.v: रजस्तमः सत्त्वमथो तृतीयं; गच्छत्यसौ ज्ञानगुणान्विरूपान् । तथेन्द्रियाण्याविशते शरीरी; हुताशनं वायुरिवेन्धनस्थम् ॥
data.md: There is Rajas, there is Tamas, and there is Satva the third. There arc again three conditions of the understanding, viz., waking, dreaming, and sound sleep. The Soul perceives the pleasures and pains, which are all contradictory, of those states, and which partake of the nature of the three-fold qualities first mentioned. The Soul enters the senses like the wind entering the fire in piece of wood.

data.v: न चक्षुषा पश्यति रूपमात्मनो; न पश्यति स्पर्शनमिन्द्रियेन्द्रियम् । न श्रोत्रलिङ्गं श्रवणे निदर्शनं; तथागतं पश्यति तद्विनश्यति ॥
data.md: One cannot see the forın of the Soul by his eye, nor can the sense of touch, amongst the senses, apprehend it. The Soul, is not, again, perceived by the ear. It may, however, be seen by the help of the Shrutis and the instructions of the wise. As for senses, that particular senses which apprehends it, loses upon such apprehension its existence as a sense.

data.v: श्रोत्रादीनि न पश्यन्ति स्वं स्वमात्मानमात्मना । सर्वज्ञः सर्वदर्शी च क्षेत्रज्ञस्तानि पश्यति ॥
data.md: The senses cannot themselves apprehend their respective forms. The Soul is omniscient. It sees all things. Being omniscient, it is the Soul that sees the senses.

data.v: यथा हिमवतः पार्श्वं पृष्ठं चन्द्रमसो यथा । न दृष्टपूर्वं मनुजैर्न च तन्नास्ति तावता ॥
data.md: Nobody has seen the other side of the Himavat mountains, nor the reverse of the moon's disc. Yet it cannot be said that they do not exist.

data.v: तद्वद्भूतेषु भूतात्मा सूक्ष्मो ज्ञानात्मवानसौ । अदृष्टपूर्वश्चक्षुर्भ्यां न चासौ नास्ति तावता ॥
data.md: Likewise though never apprehended by the senses, yet nobody can say that the Soul, which dwells in all creatures, which is subtile, and which has knowledge for its essence, does not exist.

data.v: पश्यन्नपि यथा लक्ष्म जगत्सोमे न विन्दति । एवमस्ति न वेत्येतन्न च तन्न परायणम् ॥
data.md: People see the world reflected on the inoon's disc in the shape of spots. Though seeing, they do not know that it is the world that is so reflected there. Such is the knowledge of the Soul. That knowledge must come of itself. The Soul depends upon the Soul itself.

data.v: रूपवन्तमरूपत्वादुदयास्तमये बुधाः । धिया समनुपश्यन्ति तद्गताः सवितुर्गतिम् ॥
data.md: Reflecting on the formlessness of visible objects before birth and after destruction, wise men behold by the help of intelligence, the forinlessness of objects that have visible forins. Similarly although the Sun's motion cannot be seen, yet persons, by watching its rising and Setting, conclude that the sun has motion.

data.v: तथा बुद्धिप्रदीपेन दूरस्थं सुविपश्चितः । प्रत्यासन्नं निनीषन्ति ज्ञेयं ज्ञानाभिसंहितम् ॥
data.md: Likewise learned and wise men see the Soul by the help of the lamp of intelligence, though it is at a great distance from them, and seek to merge the fivefold elements, which are near, into Brahma.

data.v: न हि खल्वनुपायेन कश्चिदर्थोऽभिसिध्यति । सूत्रजालैर्यथा मत्स्यान्बध्नन्ति जलजीविनः ॥
data.md: Verily, an object cannot be performed without the application of means. Fishermen catch fish by means of nets made of strings.

data.v: मृगैर्मृगाणां ग्रहणं पक्षिणां पक्षिभिर्यथा । गजानां च गजैरेवं ज्ञेयं ज्ञानेन गृह्यते ॥
data.md: Animals are caught by employing animals as the agents. Birds are caught by employing birds as the agents. Elephants are taken by employing elephants. In this way the Soul may be apprehended by the principle of Knowledge.

data.v: अहिरेव ह्यहेः पादान्पश्यतीति निदर्शनम् । तद्वन्मूर्तिषु मूर्तिष्ठं ज्ञेयं ज्ञानेन पश्यति ॥
data.md: It is heard that only a snake can see a snake's legs. Likewise one sees, through Knowledge, the Soul encased in subtle form and living within the gross body.

data.v: नोत्सहन्ते यथा वेत्तुमिन्द्रियैरिन्द्रियाण्यपि । तथैवेह परा बुद्धिः परं बुद्ध्या न पश्यति ॥
data.md: People cannot, through their senses, know : the senses. Likewisc mere Intelligence at its highest cannot see the Soul which is supreme.

data.v: यथा चन्द्रो ह्यमावास्यामलिङ्गत्वान्न दृश्यते । न च नाशोऽस्य भवति तथा विद्धि शरीरिणम् ॥
data.md: The moon, on the fifteenth day of the dark fortnight, cannot be seen on account of its form being hidden. It cannot be said, however, that destruction overtakes it. Such is the case with the Soul living in the body.

data.v: क्षीणकोशो ह्यमावास्यां चन्द्रमा न प्रकाशते । तद्वन्मूर्तिवियुक्तः सञ्शरीरी नोपलभ्यते ॥
data.md: On the fifteenth day of the dark fortnight, the gross body of the moon is seen. Similarly the Soul, when freed from the body, cannot be apprehended.

data.v: यथा कोशान्तरं प्राप्य चन्द्रमा भ्राजते पुनः । तद्वल्लिङ्गान्तरं प्राप्य शरीरी भ्राजते पुनः ॥
data.md: As gaining another point in the sky, the moon begins to shine once more, similarly the soul, acquiring a new body, begins to manifest itself once more.

data.v: जन्मवृद्धिक्षयश्चास्य प्रत्यक्षेणोपलभ्यते । सा तु चन्द्रमसो व्यक्तिर्न तु तस्य शरीरिणः ॥
data.md: The birth, growth, and disappearance of the moon can all be directly perceived by the eye. These phenomena, however, belong to the gross form of that luminary. The like are not the attributes of the Soul,

data.v: उत्पत्तिवृद्धिव्ययतो यथा स इति गृह्यते । चन्द्र एव त्वमावास्यां तथा भवति मूर्तिमान् ॥
data.md: The moon, when it appears after its disappearance on the fifteenth day of the dark fortnight, is considered as the same luminary that had become invisible. Similarly despite the changes represented by birth, growth, and age, a person is considered as the same individual without any doubt of his identity.

data.v: नाभिसर्पद्विमुञ्चद्वा शशिनं दृश्यते तमः । विसृजंश्चोपसर्पंश्च तद्वत्पश्य शरीरिणम् ॥
data.md: It is not distinctly seen how Rabu approaches and leaves the moon. Likewise the Soul cannot be seen how it leaves one body and enters another.

data.v: यथा चन्द्रार्कसंयुक्तं तमस्तदुपलभ्यते । तद्वच्छरीरसंयुक्तः शरीरीत्युपलभ्यते ॥
data.md: Rahu becomes visible only when it exists with the sun or the moon. Likewise the Soul is apprehended only when it exists with the body.

data.v: यथा चन्द्रार्कनिर्मुक्तः स राहुर्नोपलभ्यते । तद्वच्छरीरनिर्मुक्तः शरीरी नोपलभ्यते ॥
data.md: Rahu becomes visible only when it exists with the sun or the moon. Likewise the Soul is apprehended only when it exists with the body.

data.v: यथा चन्द्रो ह्यमावास्यां नक्षत्रैर्युज्यते गतः । तद्वच्छरीरनिर्मुक्तः फलैर्युज्यति कर्मणः ॥
data.md: Then again, as the moon, even when it disappears on the fifteenth day of the dark fortnight, is not left by the constellations and the stars, the Soul also, even though separated from the body, is not deserted by the fruits of the acts it has won in that body.

data.v: यथा व्यक्तमिदं शेते स्वप्ने चरति चेतनम् । ज्ञानमिन्द्रियसंयुक्तं तद्वत्प्रेत्य भवाभवौ ॥
data.md: As in a dream this body (inactive) and the enlivening spirit in its subtile form, separating itself from the former, walks forth, so, in the state called deep sleep (or death), the subtile forin with all the senses becomes inactive, and the Understanding, separated from it, remains awake. The same is the case with Existence and Non-Existence.

data.v: यथाम्भसि प्रसन्ने तु रूपं पश्यति चक्षुषा । तद्वत्प्रसन्नेन्द्रियवाञ्ज्ञेयं ज्ञानेन पश्यति ॥
data.md: As when a sheet of water is clear, images reflected in it can be seen by the eye, similarly, if the senses be undisturbed, the Soul is capable of being seen by the understanding.

data.v: स एव लुलिते तस्मिन्यथा रूपं न पश्यति । तथेन्द्रियाकुलीभावे ज्ञेयं ज्ञाने न पश्यति ॥
data.md: If, however, the piece of water is agitated, the person standing by it can no longer sce those images. Likewise, if the senses become disturbed, the Soul can no longer be seen by the understanding.

data.v: अबुद्धिरज्ञानकृता अबुद्ध्या दुष्यते मनः । दुष्टस्य मनसः पञ्च संप्रदुष्यन्ति मानसाः ॥
data.md: Ignorance produces Delusion. Delusion possesses the mind. When the mind becomes impure, the five senses which have the mind for their refuge becomed corrupted also.

data.v: अज्ञानतृप्तो विषयेष्ववगाढो न दृश्यते । अदृष्ट्वैव तु पूतात्मा विषयेभ्यो निवर्तते ॥
data.md: Overfilled with Ignorance, and sunk in their mire of worldly objects, one cannot enjoy the sweets of contentment or tranquillity. The Soul with its good and evil acts, returns again and again to the objects of the world.

data.v: तर्षच्छेदो न भवति पुरुषस्येह कल्मषात् । निवर्तते तथा तर्षः पापमन्तं गतं यथा ॥
data.md: On account of sin one's thirst is never satisfied. One's thirst is then satisfied when one's sin is dissipated.

data.v: विषयेषु च संसर्गाच्छाश्वतस्य नसंश्रयात् । मनसा चान्यदाकाङ्क्षन्परं न प्रतिपद्यते ॥
data.md: On account of attachment to earthly objects, which has a tendency, to multiply itself, one wishes for things other than those for which one should wish, and accordingly fails to attain to the Supreme.

data.v: ज्ञानमुत्पद्यते पुंसां क्षयात्पापस्य कर्मणः । अथादर्शतलप्रख्ये पश्यत्यात्मानमात्मनि ॥
data.md: From the destruction of all sinful acts, knowledge originates in When Knowledge arises a person sees his Soul in his understanding even as one sees his own image in a polished mirror. men.

data.v: प्रसृतैरिन्द्रियैर्दुःखी तैरेव नियतैः सुखी । तस्मादिन्द्रियरूपेभ्यो यच्छेदात्मानमात्मना ॥
data.md: One reaps misery for his senses being not controlled. One acquires happiness on account of his senses being restrained. Therefore, a person should control his mind by self-exertion from objects apprehended by the senses.

data.v: इन्द्रियेभ्यो मनः पूर्वं बुद्धिः परतरा ततः । बुद्धेः परतरं ज्ञानं ज्ञानात्परतरं परम् ॥
data.md: Above the senses is the mind; above the mind is the understanding; above the understanding is the Soul; above the Soul is the Supreme.

data.v: अव्यक्तात्प्रसृतं ज्ञानं ततो बुद्धिस्ततो मनः । मनः श्रोत्रादिभिर्युक्तं शब्दादीन्साधु पश्यति ॥
data.md: From the Unmanifest originates the Soul; from the Soul has originated the understanding; from the understanding has' originated the mind. When the mind is united with the senses, than it apprehends sound and the other objects of the senses.

data.v: यस्तांस्त्यजति शब्दादीन्सर्वाश्च व्यक्तयस्तथा । विमुञ्चत्याकृतिग्रामांस्तान्मुक्त्वामृतमश्नुते ॥
data.md: He who renounces those objects as well as all those that are manifest, he who liberates himself from all things that arise from primordial matter, enjoys immortality.

data.v: उद्यन्हि सविता यद्वत्सृजते रश्मिमण्डलम् । स एवास्तमुपागच्छंस्तदेवात्मनि यच्छति ॥
data.md: The Sun rising spreads his rays. When he sets, he withdraws to himself those very rays that were spread by him.

data.v: अन्तरात्मा तथा देहमाविश्येन्द्रियरश्मिभिः । प्राप्येन्द्रियगुणान्पञ्च सोऽस्तमावृत्य गच्छति ॥
data.md: Similarly, the Soul, entering the body, obtains the fivefold objects of the senses by spreading over them his rays represented by the senses. When, however, he turns back, he is said to set by withdrawing those rays to himself.

data.v: प्रणीतं कर्मणा मार्गं नीयमानः पुनः पुनः । प्राप्नोत्ययं कर्मफलं प्रवृद्धं धर्ममात्मवान् ॥
data.md: Continually driven along the path that is created by acts, he reaps the fruit of his acts for his having followed the practice of acts.

data.v: विषया विनिवर्तन्ते निराहारस्य देहिनः । रसवर्जं रसोऽप्यस्य परं दृष्ट्वा निवर्तते ॥
data.md: Desire for the object of the senses does not affect a person who has no such desire. Desire, leaves him who has seen his soul, which, of course, is entirely free from desire.

data.v: बुद्धिः कर्मगुणैर्हीना यदा मनसि वर्तते । तदा संपद्यते ब्रह्म तत्रैव प्रलयं गतम् ॥
data.md: When the Understanding, shorn of the attachment to the objects of the senses, is concentrated in the mind, then does one succeed in attaining to Brahma, for it is there that the mind with with the understanding withdrawn into it can possibly be destroyed.

data.v: अस्पर्शनमशृण्वानमनास्वादमदर्शनम् । अघ्राणमवितर्कं च सत्त्वं प्रविशते परम् ॥
data.md: Brahma is not an object of touch or of hearing, or of taste, or of sight, or of smell, or of any other inference. Only the Understanding can get it.

data.v: मनस्याकृतयो मग्ना मनस्त्वतिगतं मतिम् । मतिस्त्वतिगता ज्ञानं ज्ञानं त्वभिगतं परम् ॥
data.md: All objects that the mind apprehends through the senses can be withdrawn into the mind; the mind can be withdrawn into the understanding; the Understanding can be withdrawn into the Soul, and the Soul into the Supreme.

data.v: इन्द्रियैर्मनसः सिद्धिर्न बुद्धिं बुध्यते मनः । न बुद्धिर्बुध्यतेऽव्यक्तं सूक्ष्मस्त्वेतानि पश्यति ॥
data.md: The senses cannot lead to the success of the mind. The mind cannot apprehend the Understanding. The Understanding cannot apprehend the manifested Soul. The Soul, however, which is subtile, sees these all.

data.v: ज्ञानं ज्ञेयाभिनिर्वृत्तं विद्धि ज्ञानगुणं मनः । प्रज्ञाकरणसंयुक्तं ततो बुद्धिः प्रवर्तते ॥
data.md: Pure Knowledge, exists in the various objects of knowledge. Know that mind is only an attribute of Knowledge. When the mind is united with the faculties of knowledge, then the understanding sets in.

data.v: यदा कर्मगुणोपेता बुद्धिर्मनसि वर्तते । तदा प्रज्ञायते ब्रह्म ध्यानयोगसमाधिना ॥
data.md: When freed from the attributes of action, the understanding is directed towards the mind; then does it succeed in knowing Brahma by meditation or Yoga ending in complete absorption (Samadhi).

data.v: सेयं गुणवती बुद्धिर्गुणेष्वेवाभिवर्तते । अवताराभिनिःस्रोतं गिरेः शृङ्गादिवोदकम् ॥
data.md: The Understanding, originating from Ignorance, and endued with the senses and attributes, runs towards external objects, like a river originating from a mountain summit and flowing towards other quarters.

data.v: यदा निर्गुणमाप्नोति ध्यानं मनसि पूर्वजम् । तदा प्रज्ञायते ब्रह्म निकष्यं निकषे यथा ॥
data.md: When the understanding, with-drawn into the mind, succeeds in absorbing itself into contemplation that is shorn of attributes, it acquires a knowledge of Brahma like the touch of gold on a touch-stone.

data.v: मनस्त्वपहृतं बुद्धिमिन्द्रियार्थनिदर्शनम् । न समक्षं गुणावेक्षि निर्गुणस्य निदर्शनम् ॥
data.md: The mind apprehends the objects of the senses. It must first be extinguished. Depend upon the attributes of objects that are before it, the mind can never show that which is without attributes.

data.v: सर्वाण्येतानि संवार्य द्वाराणि मनसि स्थितः । मनस्येकाग्रतां कृत्वा तत्परं प्रतिपद्यते ॥
data.md: Closing all the doors formed by the senses the Understanding should be with-drawn into the mind. In this condition when absorbed in contemplation, it acquires the knowledge of Brahma.

data.v: यथा महान्ति भूतानि निवर्तन्ते गुणक्षये । तथेन्द्रियाण्युपादाय बुद्धिर्मनसि वर्तते ॥
data.md: As upon the destruction of the attributes by which they are known, the fivefold great creatures are contracted into their subtile forms, so the Understanding may dwell in the mind alone, with the senses all withdrawn from their objects.

data.v: यदा मनसि सा बुद्धिर्वर्ततेऽन्तरचारिणी । व्यवसायगुणोपेता तदा संपद्यते मनः ॥
data.md: When the Understanding, though endued with the quality of certainty, lives in the mind, busied with the internal, even then it is nothing but the mind.

data.v: गुणवद्भिर्गुणोपेतं यदा ध्यानगुणं मनः । तदा सर्वगुणान्हित्वा निर्गुणं प्रतिपद्यते ॥
data.md: When the mind of consciousness, which attains to perfection through contemplation, succeeds in identifying qualities with their possessors, then can it cast off all attributes and attain to Brahma which is without qualities.

data.v: अव्यक्तस्येह विज्ञाने नास्ति तुल्यं निदर्शनम् । यत्र नास्ति पदन्यासः कस्तं विषयमाप्नुयात् ॥
data.md: There is no indication that which can give a knowledge of the Unseen. That which cannot be described in language, cannot be acquired by anyone.

data.v: तपसा चानुमानेन गुणैर्जात्या श्रुतेन च । निनीषेत्तत्परं ब्रह्म विशुद्धेनान्तरात्मना ॥
data.md: With purified soul, one should try to approach the Supreme Brahma, through the help afforded by penances, by inferences, by self-control, by the practices and observances sanctioned for one's own order, and by the Vedas.

data.v: गुणहीनो हि तं मार्गं बहिः समनुवर्तते । गुणाभावात्प्रकृत्या च निस्तर्क्यं ज्ञेयसंमितम् ॥
data.md: Persons of clear vision seek him in even external forms by freeing themselves from qualities. The Supreme, which is called by the name of what should be known, on account of the absence of all qualities, or of its own nature, can never be apprehended by argument.

data.v: नैर्गुण्याद्ब्रह्म चाप्नोति सगुणत्वान्निवर्तते । गुणप्रसारिणी बुद्धिर्हुताशन इवेन्धने ॥
data.md: When the Understanding becomes freed from qualities, then only can it attain to Brahma. When it is endued with qualities, it falls back from the Supreme. Indeed, such is the nature of the understanding that it rushes towards qualities and moves among them like fire among fuel.

data.v: यथा पञ्च विमुक्तानि इन्द्रियाणि स्वकर्मभिः । तथा तत्परमं ब्रह्म विमुक्तं प्रकृतेः परम् ॥
data.md: As in the state of deep and dreamless sleep the five senses exist freed from their respective works, similarly the Supreme Brahma exists high above Prakriti, freed from all its qualities.

data.v: एवं प्रकृतितः सर्वे प्रभवन्ति शरीरिणः । निवर्तन्ते निवृत्तौ च सर्गं नैवोपयान्ति च ॥
data.md: Embodied creatures perform various actions on account of attributes. When they abstain therefrom, they acquire liberation. Some again go to heaven.

data.v: पुरुषः प्रकृतिर्बुद्धिर्विशेषाश्चेन्द्रियाणि च । अहंकारोऽभिमानश्च संभूतो भूतसंज्ञकः ॥
data.md: The living creature, primordial nature, the understanding, the objects of the senses, the senses, consciousness, consciousness of Ego, are called creatures.

data.v: एकस्याद्या प्रवृत्तिस्तु प्रधानात्संप्रवर्तते । द्वितीया मिथुनव्यक्तिमविशेषान्नियच्छति ॥
data.md: The original creation of all these proceeded from the Supreme. Their second creation is due to the union of couples or pairs and is confined to all things except the principal five, and is governed by law for which the same species produce the same species.

data.v: धर्मादुत्कृष्यते श्रेयस्तथाश्रेयोऽप्यधर्मतः । रागवान्प्रकृतिं ह्येति विरक्तो ज्ञानवान्भवेत् ॥
data.md: From righteousness creatures obtain a great end, and from sinfulness they earn a low end. He who is not freed from attachments, goes through rebirth; while he who is freed therefrom, attains to Knowledge (or Brahma).

data.v: यदा ते पञ्चभिः पञ्च विमुक्ता मनसा सह । अथ तद्द्रक्ष्यसे ब्रह्म मणौ सूत्रमिवार्पितम् ॥
data.md: Manu said When the five attributes are united with the five senses and the mind, then is Brahma seen by the individual like a thread passing through a gem.

data.v: तदेव च यथा सूत्रं सुवर्णे वर्तते पुनः । मुक्तास्वथ प्रवालेषु मृन्मये राजते तथा ॥
data.md: As a thread may lie within gold or a pearl or a coral or any earthen object, so one's soul, for his own acts, may live within a cow, a horse, a man, an elephant or any other animal, or with a worm or an insect.

data.v: तद्वद्गोषु मनुष्येषु तद्वद्धस्तिमृगादिषु । तद्वत्कीटपतंगेषु प्रसक्तात्मा स्वकर्मभिः ॥
data.md: As a thread may lie within gold or a pearl or a coral or any earthen object, so one's soul, for his own acts, may live within a cow, a horse, a man, an elephant or any other animal, or with a worm or an insect.

data.v: येन येन शरीरेण यद्यत्कर्म करोत्ययम् । तेन तेन शरीरेण तत्तत्फलमुपाश्नुते ॥
data.md: The good deeds with a person performs in a particular body yield rewards that the individual enjoys in that particular body.

data.v: यथा ह्येकरसा भूमिरोषध्यात्मानुसारिणी । तथा कर्मानुगा बुद्धिरन्तरात्मानुदर्शिनी ॥
data.md: A soil, seemingly drenched with one particular kind of liquid, supplies to each different sort of Herb or plant that grows on it the sort of juice it requires for itself. Similarly, the Understanding, whose course is witnessed by the Soul, is obliged to follow the path marked out by pristine deeds.

data.v: ज्ञानपूर्वोद्भवा लिप्सा लिप्सापूर्वाभिसंधिता । अभिसंधिपूर्वकं कर्म कर्ममूलं ततः फलम् ॥
data.md: From knowledge originates desire. From desire originates resolution. From resolution proceeds action. From action proceed fruits.

data.v: फलं कर्मात्मकं विद्यात्कर्म ज्ञेयात्मकं तथा । ज्ञेयं ज्ञानात्मकं विद्याज्ज्ञानं सदसदात्मकम् ॥
data.md: Fruits, therefore, have actions as their cause. Actions have the understanding for their root. The understanding has knowledge for its ot, and knowledge has the Soul for its cause.

data.v: ज्ञानानां च फलानां च ज्ञेयानां कर्मणां तथा । क्षयान्ते तत्फलं दिव्यं ज्ञानं ज्ञेयप्रतिष्ठितम् ॥
data.md: That excellent outcome which is gained by the destruction of knowledge, of fruits, of the understanding, and of acts is called knowledge of Brahma.

data.v: महद्धि परमं भूतं युक्ताः पश्यन्ति योगिनः । अबुधास्तं न पश्यन्ति ह्यात्मस्था गुणबुद्धयः ॥
data.md: High indeed is that self-existent Essence which Yogins witness. They who are devoid of wisdom, and whose understandings are addicted to worldly objects never see that which exists in the soul itself.

data.v: पृथिवीरूपतो रूपमपामिह महत्तरम् । अद्भ्यो महत्तरं तेजस्तेजसः पवनो महान् ॥
data.md: Water is superior to the Earth; Light is superior to Water; Wind is superior to Light.

data.v: पवनाच्च महद्व्योम तस्मात्परतरं मनः । मनसो महती बुद्धिर्बुद्धेः कालो महान्स्मृतः ॥
data.md: Space is superior to Wind; Mind is superior 10 Space; Understanding is superior to Mind; Time is superior to Understanding.

data.v: कालात्स भगवान्विष्णुर्यस्य सर्वमिदं जगत् । नादिर्न मध्यं नैवान्तस्तस्य देवस्य विद्यते ॥
data.md: The Divine Vishnu, who is identical with this universe, is superior to Time. That god is without beginning, middle, and end.

data.v: अनादित्वादमध्यत्वादनन्तत्वाच्च सोऽव्ययः । अत्येति सर्वदुःखानि दुःखं ह्यन्तवदुच्यते ॥
data.md: For his being without beginning, iniddle, and cnd, he is Unchangeable. He is above all Sorrow, for Sorrow has limits.

data.v: तद्ब्रह्म परमं प्रोक्तं तद्धाम परमं स्मृतम् । तद्गत्वा कालविषयाद्विमुक्ता मोक्षमाश्रिताः ॥
data.md: That Vishnu is called the Supreme Brahma. He is the refuge or object of what is called the Highest. Knowing Him, they who are wise, freed from everything which is under the influence of Time, acquire liberation.

data.v: गुणैस्त्वेतैः प्रकाशन्ते निर्गुणत्वात्ततः परम् । निवृत्तिलक्षणो धर्मस्तथानन्त्याय कल्पते ॥
data.md: What we perceive is displayed in attributes. That which is called Brahma, being without attributes, is superior to these. Abstention from acts constitutes the greatest religion. That religion is sure to bring on deathlessness.

data.v: ऋचो यजूंषि सामानि शरीराणि व्यपाश्रिताः । जिह्वाग्रेषु प्रवर्तन्ते यत्नसाध्या विनाशिनः ॥
data.md: The Richs, the yajuses and the Samans depend on the body. They flow from the end of the tongue. They cannot be acquired without exertion and are subject to destruction.

data.v: न चैवमिष्यते ब्रह्म शरीराश्रयसंभवम् । न यत्नसाध्यं तद्ब्रह्म नादिमध्यं न चान्तवत् ॥
data.md: Brahma, however, cannot be acquired in this way, for it depends upon that (Soul) which has the body for its refuge. Without beginning, middle, or end, Brahma cannot be acquired by effort.

data.v: ऋचामादिस्तथा साम्नां यजुषामादिरुच्यते । अन्तश्चादिमतां दृष्टो न चादिर्ब्रह्मणः स्मृतः ॥
data.md: The Richs, the Samans, the Yajuses, have each a beginning. Those that have a beginning have also an end. But Brahma is said to be without beginning.

data.v: अनादित्वादनन्तत्वात्तदनन्तमथाव्ययम् । अव्ययत्वाच्च निर्द्वंद्वं द्वंद्वाभावात्ततः परम् ॥
data.md: And because Brahma has neither beginning nor end, it is said to be infinite and unchangeable. On account of unchangeableness, Brahma transcends all sorrow as also pairs of opposites.

data.v: अदृष्टतोऽनुपायाच्चाप्यभिसंधेश्च कर्मणः । न तेन मर्त्याः पश्यन्ति येन गच्छन्ति तत्परम् ॥
data.md: Through unfavourable destiny, through inability to find out the proper expedient, and through the obstacles put in by acts, men cannot see the path by which Brahına may be reached.

data.v: विषयेषु च संसर्गाच्छाश्वतस्य च दर्शनात् । मनसा चान्यदाकाङ्क्षन्परं न प्रतिपद्यते ॥
data.md: On account of attachment to earthly objects, which has a tendency, to multiply itself, one wishes for things other than those for which one should wish, and accordingly fails to attain to the Supreme.

data.v: गुणान्यदिह पश्यन्ति तदिच्छन्त्यपरे जनाः । परं नैवाभिकाङ्क्षन्ति निर्गुणत्वाद्गुणार्थिनः ॥
data.md: Others seeing worldly objects seek their possession. When they hanker after such objects, they do not see Brahma inasmuch as it is shorn of all attributes.

data.v: गुणैर्यस्त्ववरैर्युक्तः कथं विद्याद्गुणानिमान् । अनुमानाद्धि गन्तव्यं गुणैरवयवैः सह ॥
data.md: How can one who is endued with inferior qualities, acquire a knowledge of him who is possessed of superior qualities? It is by inference that one can arrive at a knowledge of Him who transcends all things in attributes and form.

data.v: सूक्ष्मेण मनसा विद्मो वाचा वक्तुं न शक्नुमः । मनो हि मनसा ग्राह्यं दर्शनेन च दर्शनम् ॥
data.md: We can know him only. By subtile intelligence, we cannot describe Him in words. The mind is caught by the mind, the eye by the eye.

data.v: ज्ञानेन निर्मलीकृत्य बुद्धिं बुद्ध्या तथा मनः । मनसा चेन्द्रियग्राममनन्तं प्रतिपद्यते ॥
data.md: By knowledge the understanding can be purged off of its impurities The understanding may be engaged for purifying the mind. The senses should be restrained by the mind. Performing all this, one may attain to the Unchangeable.

data.v: बुद्धिप्रहीणो मनसासमृद्ध;स्तथा निराशीर्गुणतामुपैति । परं त्यजन्तीह विलोभ्यमाना; हुताशनं वायुरिवेन्धनस्थम् ॥
data.md: One who has, by contemplation, become freed from attachments, and who has the wealth of a discerning mind, succeeds in attaining to Brahma which is without desire and above all attributes. As the wind does not touch the fire that lies within a piece of wood, so persons, who are moved (by desire for worldly objects stand aloof from that which is Supreme).

data.v: गुणादाने विप्रयोगे च तेषां; मनः सदा बुद्धिपरावराभ्याम् । अनेनैव विधिना संप्रवृत्तो; गुणादाने ब्रह्मशरीरमेति ॥
data.md: When all earthly objects are destroyed, the mind always attains to That which is higher than the Understanding; while upon their separation the mind always acquires that which is below the Understanding. Therefore, a person, who, according to the method already described, becomes engaged in destroying carthly objects, becomes immersed in Brahma.

data.v: अव्यक्तात्मा पुरुषोऽव्यक्तकर्मा; सोऽव्यक्तत्वं गच्छति ह्यन्तकाले । तैरेवायं चेन्द्रियैर्वर्धमानै;र्ग्लायद्भिर्वा वर्तते कर्मरूपः ॥
data.md: Though the Soul is unmanifest, yet when endued with qualities, its acts become manifest. When dissolution sets in it once more becomes unmanifest. The Soul is really inactive. Its exists, endued with the senses which create either happiness or misery.

data.v: सर्वैरयं चेन्द्रियैः संप्रयुक्तो; देहः प्राप्तः पञ्चभूताश्रयः स्यात् । नासामर्थ्याद्गच्छति कर्मणेह; हीनस्तेन परमेणाव्ययेन ॥
data.md: United with all the senses and body, it takes refuge in the five primal elements. It cannot, however, act through want of power, however, when it is deprived of force by the Supreme and Unchangeable.

data.v: पृथ्व्या नरः पश्यति नान्तमस्या; ह्यन्तश्चास्या भविता चेति विद्धि । परं नयन्तीह विलोभ्यमानं; यथा प्लवं वायुरिवार्णवस्थम् ॥
data.md: No man sees the end of this earth, but know this, viz., that the Earth's end will surely come. Man moved here (by attachments) is surely led to his last resort like the wind leading a vessel, tossed on the sea to a safe harbour at last.

data.v: दिवाकरो गुणमुपलभ्य निर्गुणो; यथा भवेद्व्यपगतरश्मिमण्डलः । तथा ह्यसौ मुनिरिह निर्विशेषवा;न्स निर्गुणं प्रविशति ब्रह्म चाव्ययम् ॥
data.md: Diffusing his rays the sun becomes the possessor of an attribute, withdrawing his rays he once more becomes an object shorn of attributes, Similarly a person casting off all distinctions and practising penances, at last enters the indestructible Brahma which is shorn of all attributes.

data.v: अनागतिं सुकृतिमतां परां गतिं; स्वयंभुवं प्रभवनिधानमव्ययम् । सनातनं यदमृतमव्ययं पदं; विचार्य तं शमममृतत्वमश्नुते ॥
data.md: By knowing Him who is without birth, who is the highest refuge of all pious men, who is self-create, from whom everything originates and whom everything returns, who is unchangeable, who is without beginning, middle, and end, and who is self and supreme, a person attains to immortality.'

data.v: पितामह महाप्राज्ञ पुण्डरीकाक्षमच्युतम् । कर्तारमकृतं विष्णुं भूतानां प्रभवाप्ययम् ॥
data.md: Yudhishthira said O grandfather, O you of great wisdom, I wish to hear fully, O chief of the Bharatas, of that lotus-eyed and indestructible one, who is the Crcator of all but who has been created by none, who is called Vishnu, who is the origin of all creatures and to whom all creatures return, who is known by the names of Narayana and Hrishikesha and Govinda and Keshava, and who is incapable of being defeated by any one.

data.v: नारायणं हृषीकेशं गोविन्दमपराजितम् । तत्त्वेन भरतश्रेष्ठ श्रोतुमिच्छामि केशवम् ॥
श्रुतोऽयमर्थो रामस्य जामदग्न्यस्य जल्पतः । नारदस्य च देवर्षेः कृष्णद्वैपायनस्य च ॥
data.md: Bhishma said I have heard of this subject from Jamadagni's son Rama while he described it from the celestial saint Narada and from Krishna-Dvaipayana. to

data.v: असितो देवलस्तात वाल्मीकिश्च महातपाः । मार्कण्डेयश्च गोविन्दे कथयत्यद्भुतं महत् ॥
data.md: Asita-Devala, O son, Valmiki of austere penances and Markandeya, describe Govinda as the most Wonderful and the Supreme.

data.v: केशवो भरतश्रेष्ठ भगवानीश्वरः प्रभुः । पुरुषः सर्वमित्येव श्रूयते बहुधा विभुः ॥
data.md: Keshava, O chief of Bharata's race, is the divine and powerful Lord of all. He is called Purusha, and is present in everything, having multiplied himself.

data.v: किं तु यानि विदुर्लोके ब्राह्मणाः शार्ङ्गधन्वनः । माहात्म्यानि महाबाहो शृणु तानि युधिष्ठिर ॥
data.md: Listen now, O Yudhisthira of powerful arms, those attributes which great Brahmanas say are to be seen in the great wielder of Sharnga.

data.v: यानि चाहुर्मनुष्येन्द्र ये पुराणविदो जनाः । अशेषेण हि गोविन्दे कीर्तयिष्यामि तान्यहम् ॥
data.md: I shall also, O king recite to you those acts which persons well-read in old histories attribute to Govinda.

data.v: महाभूतानि भूतात्मा महात्मा पुरुषोत्तमः । वायुर्ज्योतिस्तथा चापः खं गां चैवान्वकल्पयत् ॥
data.md: He is the soul of all creatures, the great one, and the foremost of all beings. He crealed (by his will) the five elements viz., Wind, Light, Water, Space and Earth.

data.v: स दृष्ट्वा पृथिवीं चैव सर्वभूतेश्वरः प्रभुः । अप्स्वेव शयनं चक्रे महात्मा पुरुषोत्तमः ॥
data.md: Having created the Earth that powerful Lord of all things, that great one, that foremost of all beings, lay on the surface of the waters.

data.v: सर्वतेजोमयस्तस्मिञ्शयानः शयने शुभे । सोऽग्रजं सर्वभूतानां संकर्षणमचिन्तयत् ॥
data.md: While thus floating upon the waters, that foremost of all beings, that resort of every sort of energy and splendour, created consciousness, the first-born of all beings in the universe.

data.v: आश्रयं सर्वभूतानां मनसेति विशुश्रुम । स धारयति भूतात्मा उभे भूतभविष्यती ॥
data.md: We have heard that He created consciousness with the mind,-Consciousness which is the resort of all created things. That Consciousness maintains all creatures and both the past and the future.

data.v: ततस्तस्मिन्महाबाहो प्रादुर्भूते महात्मनि । भास्करप्रतिमं दिव्यं नाभ्यां पद्ममजायत ॥
data.md: After that great Being. O mighty-armed one, viz., Consciousness originated a highly beautiful lotus effulgent like the Sun out of the navel of the Supreme Being.

data.v: स तत्र भगवान्देवः पुष्करे भासयन्दिशः । ब्रह्मा समभवत्तात सर्वभूतपितामहः ॥
data.md: Then, O son the illustrious and divine Brahman, the Grandfather of all creatures, came into being from that lotus, lighting all the points of the horizon with his effulgence.

data.v: तस्मिन्नपि महाबाहो प्रादुर्भूते महात्मनि । तमसः पूर्वजो जज्ञे मधुर्नाम महासुरः ॥
data.md: After the high-souled Grandfather had, O mighty-armed one, thus originated from the primeval lotus, a great Asura of the name of Madhu, having no beginning, came into being from the quality of ignorance, (Tamas).

data.v: तमुग्रमुग्रकर्माणमुग्रां बुद्धिं समास्थितम् । ब्रह्मणोपचितिं कुर्वञ्जघान पुरुषोत्तमः ॥
data.md: The foremost of all Beings for helping Brahman, killed that dreadful Asura of terrific deeds, engaged even then in the fearful act of killing the Grandfather.

data.v: तस्य तात वधात्सर्वे देवदानवमानवाः । मधुसूदनमित्याहुर्वृषभं सर्वसात्वताम् ॥
data.md: For slaying this demon, O son, all the gods and the Danavas and men called that foremost of all righteous person by the name of Madhusudana (slayer of Madhu).

data.v: ब्रह्मा तु ससृजे पुत्रान्मानसान्दक्षसप्तमान् । मरीचिमत्र्यङ्गिरसौ पुलस्त्यं पुलहं क्रतुम् ॥
data.md: After this, Brahman, created, by his will, seven sons with Daksha at their head. They were Marichi, Atri, Angiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu.

data.v: मरीचिः कश्यपं तात पुत्रं चासृजदग्रजम् । मानसं जनयामास तैजसं ब्रह्मसत्तमम् ॥
data.md: The eldest born, viz., Marichi, beget, by his will, a son named Kashyapa, highly energetic and the foremost of all person conversant with Brahma.

data.v: अङ्गुष्ठादसृजद्ब्रह्मा मरीचेरपि पूर्वजम् । सोऽभवद्भरतश्रेष्ठ दक्षो नाम प्रजापतिः ॥
data.md: From his toe, Brahmana had, even before the birth of Marichi, created a son. That son, O Bharata's chief, was Daksha, the progenitor of creatures.

data.v: तस्य पूर्वमजायन्त दश तिस्रश्च भारत । प्रजापतेर्दुहितरस्तासां ज्येष्ठाभवद्दितिः ॥
data.md: Daksha begot thirteen daughters, 0 Bharata, the eldest of whom was called Diti.

data.v: सर्वधर्मविशेषज्ञः पुण्यकीर्तिर्महायशाः । मारीचः कश्यपस्तात सर्वासामभवत्पतिः ॥
data.md: Marichi's son Kashyapa, O son, who was a master of duties and their distinctions, who was of righteous deeds and great fame, espoused them.

data.v: उत्पाद्य तु महाभागस्तासामवरजा दश । ददौ धर्माय धर्मज्ञो दक्ष एव प्रजापतिः ॥
data.md: The highly blessed Daksha next beget ten other daughters. That progenitor of creatures, viz., the righteous Daksha, conferred these upon Dharma.

data.v: धर्मस्य वसवः पुत्रा रुद्राश्चामिततेजसः । विश्वेदेवाश्च साध्याश्च मरुत्वन्तश्च भारत ॥
data.md: Dharma became father of the Vasus, the highly energetic Rudras the Vishvedevas, the Saddhyas, and the Maruts, O Bharata.

data.v: अपरास्तु यवीयस्यस्ताभ्योऽन्याः सप्तविंशतिः । सोमस्तासां महाभागः सर्वासामभवत्पतिः ॥
data.md: Daksha next beget twenty-seven other younger daughters. The highly blessed Soma espoused them all.

data.v: इतरास्तु व्यजायन्त गन्धर्वांस्तुरगान्द्विजान् । गाश्च किंपुरुषान्मत्स्यानौद्भिदांश्च वनस्पतीन् ॥
data.md: The other wives of Kashyapa gave births to Gandharvas, horses, birds, kine, Kimpurushas, fishes, and trees and plants.

data.v: आदित्यानदितिर्जज्ञे देवश्रेष्ठान्महाबलान् । तेषां विष्णुर्वामनोऽभूद्गोविन्दश्चाभवत्प्रभुः ॥
data.md: Aditi gave birth to the Adityas, the foremost ones among the gods, and highly powerful. Amongst them Vishnu was born in the form of a dwarf. Otherwise called Govinda, he became the foremost of them all.

data.v: तस्य विक्रमणादेव देवानां श्रीर्व्यवर्धत । दानवाश्च पराभूता दैतेयी चासुरी प्रजा ॥
data.md: By his power the prosperity of the gods increased. The Danavas were defeated. The children of Diti were the Asuras.

data.v: विप्रचित्तिप्रधानांश्च दानवानसृजद्दनुः । दितिस्तु सर्वानसुरान्महासत्त्वान्व्यजायत ॥
data.md: Danu gave birth to the Danavas having Viprachitti as their head. Diti gave birth to all the powerful Asuras.

data.v: अहोरात्रं च कालं च यथर्तु मधुसूदनः । पूर्वाह्णं चापराह्णं च सर्वमेवान्वकल्पयत् ॥
data.md: The destroyer of Madhu also created the Day and the Night, and the Seasons in their order, and the Morning and the Evening.

data.v: बुद्ध्यापः सोऽसृजन्मेघांस्तथा स्थावरजङ्गमान् । पृथिवीं सोऽसृजद्विश्वां सहितां भूरितेजसा ॥
data.md: After meditation he also created the clouds, and all the immobile and mobile objects. Highly energetic he also created the Vishvas and the Earth with all things upon her.

data.v: ततः कृष्णो महाबाहुः पुनरेव युधिष्ठिर । ब्राह्मणानां शतं श्रेष्ठं मुखादसृजत प्रभुः ॥
data.md: Then the highest used and powerful Krishna, O Yudhishthira, once again created from his mouth one hundred foremost Brahmans.

data.v: बाहुभ्यां क्षत्रियशतं वैश्यानामूरुतः शतम् । पद्भ्यां शूद्रशतं चैव केशवो भरतर्षभ ॥
data.md: From his two arms, he created one hundred Kshatriyas, and from his thighs one hundred. Vaishyas. Then, O foremost of Bharata's racc, Keshava created from his two feet one hundred Shudras.

data.v: स एवं चतुरो वर्णान्समुत्पाद्य महायशाः । अध्यक्षं सर्वभूतानां धातारमकरोत्प्रभुः ॥
data.md: Endued with great ascetic merit, the destroyer of Madhu, having thus created the four orders of men, made (Dhatri Brahman) the master and ruler of all created beings.

data.v: यावद्यावदभूच्छ्रद्धा देहं धारयितुं नृणाम् । तावत्तावदजीवंस्ते नासीद्यमकृतं भयम् ॥
data.md: In those times, men lived as long as they chose to live, and had no fear of Yama.

data.v: न चैषां मैथुनो धर्मो बभूव भरतर्षभ । संकल्पादेव चैतेषामपत्यमुदपद्यत ॥
data.md: Sexual intercourse, O chief of the Bharatas, was then not necessary for perpetuating the race. In those days, offspring were begotten by the will.

data.v: तत्र त्रेतायुगे काले संकल्पाज्जायते प्रजा । न ह्यभून्मैथुनो धर्मस्तेषामपि जनाधिप ॥
data.md: In the cycle that followed, viz., Treta, children were begotten by touch alone. The people of that cycle even, O king, had no necessity of sexual intercourse.

data.v: द्वापरे मैथुनो धर्मः प्रजानामभवन्नृप । तथा कलियुगे राजन्द्वंद्वमापेदिरे जनाः ॥
data.md: It was in the next cycle, viz., Dvapara, that the practice of sexual intercourse originated, O king, amongmen. In the Kali age, O monarch, men have come to marry and live in pairs.

data.v: एष भूतपतिस्तात स्वध्यक्षश्च प्रकीर्तितः । निरध्यक्षांस्तु कौन्तेय कीर्तयिष्यामि तानपि ॥
data.md: I have now told you of the supreme Lord of all creatures. He is also called the Ruler of all and everything. I shall now, O son of Kunti, describe to you the sinful creatures of the Earth. Listen to me.

data.v: दक्षिणापथजन्मानः सर्वे तलवरान्ध्रकाः । उत्साः पुलिन्दाः शबराश्चूचुपा मण्डपैः सह ॥
data.md: Those men, O king, are born in the southern region and are called Andhakas, Gushes, Palinodes, Shavers, Chuchukas, Madrakas.

data.v: उत्तरापथजन्मानः कीर्तयिष्यामि तानपि । यौनकाम्बोजगान्धाराः किराता बर्बरैः सह ॥
data.md: I shall also name those that are born in the northern region. They are Yaunas, Kambojas, Ghandharas, Kiratas, and Barbbaras.

data.v: एते पापकृतस्तात चरन्ति पृथिवीमिमाम् । श्वकाकबलगृध्राणां सधर्माणो नराधिप ॥
data.md: All of them, O son, are sinful, and live on this Earth, acting like Chandalas, ravens and vultures.

data.v: नैते कृतयुगे तात चरन्ति पृथिवीमिमाम् । त्रेताप्रभृति वर्तन्ते ते जना भरतर्षभ ॥
data.md: In the Krita cycle, O son, they did not live on Earth. It is from the Treta that they sprang and began to multiply, O chief of Bharata's race.

data.v: ततस्तस्मिन्महाघोरे संध्याकाले युगान्तिके । राजानः समसज्जन्त समासाद्येतरेतरम् ॥
data.md: When the terrible period of the junction of Treta and the Dvapara, set in the Kshatriyas, approaching one another, began to fight.

data.v: एवमेष कुरुश्रेष्ठ प्रादुर्भावो महात्मनः । देवदेवर्षिराचष्ट नारदः सर्वलोकदृक् ॥
नारदोऽप्यथ कृष्णस्य परं मेने नराधिप । शाश्वतत्वं महाबाहो यथावद्भरतर्षभ ॥
data.md: Even Narada, O king, acknowledge the supremacy and eternity of Krishna, O mightyarmed chief of Bharata's race.

data.v: एवमेष महाबाहुः केशवः सत्यविक्रमः । अचिन्त्यः पुण्डरीकाक्षो नैष केवलमानुषः ॥
data.md: Thus, O mighty-armed one, is Keshava of unvanquishable prowess. That lotus-eyed one is not a man. He is inconceivable!'

data.v: के पूर्वमासन्पतयः प्रजानां भरतर्षभ । के चर्षयो महाभागा दिक्षु प्रत्येकशः स्मृताः ॥
data.md: Yudhishthira said Who are the first Patriarch, O foremost of Bharata's race? What highly blessed Rishis are there, and on which quarters do each of them dwell?

data.v: श्रूयतां भरतश्रेष्ठ यन्मा त्वं परिपृच्छसि । प्रजानां पतयो ये स्म दिक्षु प्रत्येकशः स्मृताः ॥
data.md: 'Hear me, O chief of the Bharatas, about what you ask. I shall tell you who the Patriarchs were and what Rishis are mentioned as living on which points of the horizon.

data.v: एकः स्वयंभूर्भगवानाद्यो ब्रह्मा सनातनः । ब्रह्मणः सप्त पुत्रा वै महात्मानः स्वयंभुवः ॥
data.md: There was at first one Eternal, Divine, and Self-create Brahman. The self-create Brahman begat seven illustrious sons.

data.v: मरीचिरत्र्यङ्गिरसौ पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः । वसिष्ठश्च महाभागः सदृशा वै स्वयंभुवा ॥
data.md: They were Marichi, Atri, Angiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, and the highly blessed Vasistha who was equal to the Self-create himself.

data.v: सप्त ब्रह्माण इत्येष पुराणे निश्चयो गतः । अत ऊर्ध्वं प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वानेव प्रजापतीन् ॥
data.md: These seven sons have been described in the Puranas as seven Brahmanas. I shall now name the succeeding Patriarchs.

data.v: अत्रिवंशसमुत्पन्नो ब्रह्मयोनिः सनातनः । प्राचीनबर्हिर्भगवांस्तस्मात्प्राचेतसो दश ॥
data.md: In Atri's family was born the eternal and divine Varhi the ancient, born of penances. From Varhi the ancient were born the ten Prachetasas.

data.v: दशानां तनयस्त्वेको दक्षो नाम प्रजापतिः । तस्य द्वे नामनी लोके दक्षः क इति चोच्यते ॥
data.md: The ten Prachetasas had one son between them, viz., the Prajapati called by the name of Daksha. This last has two names in the world, viz., Daksha and Ka.

data.v: मरीचेः कश्यपः पुत्रस्तस्य द्वे नामनी श्रुते । अरिष्टनेमिरित्येकं कश्यपेत्यपरं विदुः ॥
data.md: Marichi had one son called Kashyapa. This last also has two names. Some call him Arishtanemi, and some Kashyapa.

data.v: अङ्गश्चैवौरसः श्रीमान्राजा भौमश्च वीर्यवान् । सहस्रं यश्च दिव्यानां युगानां पर्युपासिता ॥
data.md: Atri had another son born of his lions, viz., the handsome and princely Soma of great power. He practised penances for a thousand divine cycles.

data.v: अर्यमा चैव भगवान्ये चान्ये तनया विभो । एते प्रदेशाः कथिता भुवनानां प्रभावनाः ॥
data.md: The divine Aryaman and his sons, O king, have been described as those who issued injunctions, and as creators of all creatures.

data.v: शशबिन्दोश्च भार्याणां सहस्राणि दशाच्युत । एकैकस्यां सहस्रं तु तनयानामभूत्तदा ॥
data.md: Shashavindu had ten thousand wives. Upon each of them he begat a thousand sons, and thus they were ten thousand in number. Those sons refused to call any body else save themselves as Patriarch.

data.v: एवं शतसहस्राणां शतं तस्य महात्मनः । पुत्राणां न च ते कंचिदिच्छन्त्यन्यं प्रजापतिम् ॥
data.md: Shashavindu had ten thousand wives. Upon each of them he begat a thousand sons, and thus they were ten thousand in number. Those sons refused to call any body else save themselves as Patriarch.

data.v: प्रजामाचक्षते विप्राः पौराणीं शाशबिन्दवीम् । स वृष्णिवंशप्रभवो महान्वंशः प्रजापतेः ॥
data.md: The ancient Brahmanas bestowed a name on the creatures of the world, derived from Shashavindu. That extensive family of the Patriarch Shashavindu became in time the progenitor of the Vrishni race.

data.v: एते प्रजानां पतयः समुद्दिष्टा यशस्विनः । अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि देवांस्त्रिभुवनेश्वरान् ॥
data.md: These that I have named are noted as the illustrious Patriarchs. After this, I shall name the celestials who are the lords of the three worlds.

data.v: भगोंऽशश्चार्यमा चैव मित्रोऽथ वरुणस्तथा । सविता चैव धाता च विवस्वांश्च महाबलः ॥
data.md: Bhaga, Ansha, Aryaman, Mitra, Varuna, Savitri, Dhatri, Vivasvat of great might.

data.v: पूषा त्वष्टा तथैवेन्द्रो द्वादशो विष्णुरुच्यते । त एते द्वादशादित्याः कश्यपस्यात्मसंभवाः ॥
data.md: Tashtri, Pushan, Indra, and Vishnu know as the twelfth,-these are the twelve Adityas, all originated from Kashyapa.

data.v: नासत्यश्चैव दस्रश्च स्मृतौ द्वावश्विनावपि । मार्ताण्डस्यात्मजावेतावष्टमस्य प्रजापतेः ॥
data.md: Nasatya and Dashra are mentioned as the two Ashvins. These two are the sons of the illustrious Martanda, the eighth in the above.

data.v: त्वष्टुश्चैवात्मजः श्रीमान्विश्वरूपो महायशाः । अजैकपादहिर्बुध्न्यो विरूपाक्षोऽथ रैवतः ॥
हरश्च बहुरूपश्च त्र्यम्बकश्च सुरेश्वरः । सावित्रश्च जयन्तश्च पिनाकी चापराजितः । पूर्वमेव महाभागा वसवोऽष्टौ प्रकीर्तिताः ॥
एत एवंविधा देवा मनोरेव प्रजापतेः । ते च पूर्वे सुराश्चेति द्विविधाः पितरः स्मृताः ॥
data.md: These were considered as gods at the time of the Prajapati Manu. These were at first called the gods and the Pitris.

data.v: शीलरूपरतास्त्वन्ये तथान्ये सिद्धसाध्ययोः । ऋभवो मरुतश्चैव देवानां चोदिता गणाः ॥
data.md: The Siddhas and the Saddhyas were divided into two classes for their conduct and youth. The deities were formerly divided into two classes, viz., the Ribhus and the Maruts.

data.v: एवमेते समाम्नाता विश्वेदेवास्तथाश्विनौ । आदित्याः क्षत्रियास्तेषां विशस्तु मरुतस्तथा ॥
data.md: Thus have the Vishvas, the gods, and the Ashvins, been enumerated. Amongst them, the Adityas are Kshatriyas, and the Maruts are Vaishyas.

data.v: अश्विनौ तु मतौ शूद्रौ तपस्युग्रे समाहितौ । स्मृतास्त्वङ्गिरसो देवा ब्राह्मणा इति निश्चयः । इत्येतत्सर्वदेवानां चातुर्वर्ण्यं प्रकीर्तितम् ॥
data.md: The two Ashvins, practising severe penances, have been said to be Shudras. The deities sprung from Angirasa's family have been said to be Brahmanas. This is certain.

data.v: एतान्वै प्रातरुत्थाय देवान्यस्तु प्रकीर्तयेत् । स्वजादन्यकृताच्चैव सर्वपापात्प्रमुच्यते ॥
यवक्रीतोऽथ रैभ्यश्च अर्वावसुपरावसू । औशिजश्चैव कक्षीवान्नलश्चाङ्गिरसः सुताः ॥
ऋषेर्मेधातिथेः पुत्रः कण्वो बर्हिषदस्तथा । त्रैलोक्यभावनास्तात प्राच्यां सप्तर्षयस्तथा ॥
उन्मुचो विमुचश्चैव स्वस्त्यात्रेयश्च वीर्यवान् । प्रमुचश्चेध्मवाहश्च भगवांश्च दृढव्रतः ॥
मित्रावरुणयोः पुत्रस्तथागस्त्यः प्रतापवान् । एते ब्रह्मर्षयो नित्यमाश्रिता दक्षिणां दिशम् ॥
रुषद्गुः कवषो धौम्यः परिव्याधश्च वीर्यवान् । एकतश्च द्वितश्चैव त्रितश्चैव महर्षयः ॥
अत्रेः पुत्रश्च भगवांस्तथा सारस्वतः प्रभुः । एते नव महात्मानः पश्चिमामाश्रिता दिशम् ॥

data.v: न्यायतन्त्राण्यनेकानि तैस्तैरुक्तानि वादिभिः । हेत्वागमसदाचारैर्यदुक्तं तदुपास्यते ॥
data.md: are Various other Rishis whose names connected therewith, promulgated various other sciences such as Philosophy, Logic, etc. Let that Brahma which those Rishis have described by arguments drawn from reason, by means of the Vedas, and by inferences drawn from the direct evidence of the senses, be worshipped.

data.v: अनाद्यं यत्परं ब्रह्म न देवा नर्षयो विदुः । एकस्तद्वेद भगवान्धाता नारायणः प्रभुः ॥
data.md: Neither the gods nor the Rishis were able to grasp Brahma who is without beginning and who is the highest of the high. Only the divine creator of all things, viz., the powerful Narayana, had known of Brahma.

data.v: नारायणादृषिगणास्तथा मुख्याः सुरासुराः । राजर्षयः पुराणाश्च परमं दुःखभेषजम् ॥
data.md: From Narayana, the Rishis the foremost of the deities, the Asuras, and the royal sages of old, acquired the knowledge of that highest panacea for the cure of sorrow.

data.v: पुरुषाधिष्ठितं भावं प्रकृतिः सूयते सदा । हेतुयुक्तमतः सर्वं जगत्संपरिवर्तते ॥
data.md: When Prakriti creates through the action of Purusha, the universe with all its potencies begins to spring from it.

data.v: दीपादन्ये यथा दीपाः प्रवर्तन्ते सहस्रशः । प्रकृतिः सृजते तद्वदानन्त्यान्नापचीयते ॥
data.md: From one lighted lamp thousands of other lamps are capable of being lighted. Similarly, Prakriti produces thousands of existent things. On account of its infinity, primordial matter is never exhausted,

data.v: अव्यक्तकर्मजा बुद्धिरहंकारं प्रसूयते । आकाशं चाप्यहंकाराद्वायुराकाशसंभवः ॥
data.md: From the Unmanifest flows the Understanding determined by acts. The Understanding creates Consciousness. From Consciousness proceeds Space. From Space proceeds Wind.

data.v: वायोस्तेजस्ततश्चापस्त्वद्भ्यो हि वसुधोद्गता । मूलप्रकृतयोऽष्टौ ता जगदेतास्ववस्थितम् ॥
data.md: From the Wind proceeds Heat. From Heat proceeds Water, and from Water is produced the Earth. These Eight form primordial Prakriti. The universe rests on them.

data.v: ज्ञानेन्द्रियाण्यतः पञ्च पञ्च कर्मेन्द्रियाण्यपि । विषयाः पञ्च चैकं च विकारे षोडशं मनः ॥
data.md: From those Eight have originated the five organs of knowledge, the five organs of action, the five objects of the (first five) organs, and the one, viz., the Mind, forining the sixteenth, which is the outcome of their modification.

data.v: श्रोत्रं त्वक्चक्षुषी जिह्वा घ्राणं पञ्चेन्द्रियाण्यपि । पादौ पायुरुपस्थश्च हस्तौ वाक्कर्मणामपि ॥
data.md: The car, the skin, the two eyes, the tongue, and the nose are the five organs of knowledge. The two feet, the anus, the organ of generation, the two arms, and speech, are the five organs of action.

data.v: शब्दः स्पर्शोऽथ रूपं च रसो गन्धस्तथैव च । विज्ञेयं व्यापकं चित्तं तेषु सर्वगतं मनः ॥
data.md: Sound, touch, form, taste, and smell are the five objects of the senses, covering all things. The Mind lives upon all the senses and their objects.

data.v: रसज्ञाने तु जिह्वेयं व्याहृते वाक्तथैव च । इन्द्रियैर्विविधैर्युक्तं सर्वं व्यस्तं मनस्तथा ॥
data.md: In the perception of taste, the Mind becomes the tongue, and in speech Mind become words. Covered with the different senses, Mind becomes all the objects.

data.v: विद्यात्तु षोडशैतानि दैवतानि विभागशः । देहेषु ज्ञानकर्तारमुपासीनमुपासते ॥
data.md: These sixteen, existing in their respective forms, should be known as god. These adore Him who creates all knowledge and lives within the body.

data.v: तद्वत्सोमगुणा जिह्वा गन्धस्तु पृथिवीगुणः । श्रोत्रं शब्दगुणं चैव चक्षुरग्नेर्गुणस्तथा । स्पर्शं वायुगुणं विद्यात्सर्वभूतेषु सर्वदा ॥
data.md: Taste in the attribute of water; scent is the attribute of space; vision is the attribute of fire or light; and touch is the attribute of the wind. This is the case with all creatures at all times.

data.v: मनः सत्त्वगुणं प्राहुः सत्त्वमव्यक्तजं तथा । सर्वभूतात्मभूतस्थं तस्माद्बुध्येत बुद्धिमान् ॥
data.md: The Mind, is the attribute of existence. Existence springs from the Prakriti which exists in That which is the Soul of all existent beings.

data.v: एते भावा जगत्सर्वं वहन्ति सचराचरम् । श्रिता विरजसं देवं यमाहुः परमं पदम् ॥
data.md: These existence's, resting upon the supreme Divinity that is above Prakriti and that is inactive, uphold the entire universe of the mobile and immobile objects.

data.v: नवद्वारं पुरं पुण्यमेतैर्भावैः समन्वितम् । व्याप्य शेते महानात्मा तस्मात्पुरुष उच्यते ॥
data.md: This sacred building of nine doors (body) is endued with all these existences. That which is high above them, viz., the Soul, lives within it, pervading it all over. Therefore it is called Purusha.

data.v: अजरः सोऽमरश्चैव व्यक्ताव्यक्तोपदेशवान् । व्यापकः सगुणः सूक्ष्मः सर्वभूतगुणाश्रयः ॥
data.md: The Soul is not subject to decay and death. It has knowledge of what is manifest and what is unmanifest. It is again all-pervading, endued with qualities, subtile, and the refuge of all existence and qualities.

data.v: यथा दीपः प्रकाशात्मा ह्रस्वो वा यदि वा महान् । ज्ञानात्मानं तथा विद्यात्पुरुषं सर्वजन्तुषु ॥
data.md: As a lamp shows all objects great or small, similarly the Soul dwells in all creatures as the principle of knowledge.

data.v: सोऽत्र वेदयते वेद्यं स शृणोति स पश्यति । कारणं तस्य देहोऽयं स कर्ता सर्वकर्मणाम् ॥
data.md: Making the car to hear what it hears, it is the Soul that hears. Likewise, making the works, it is the Soul that sees. This body supplies the means by which the Soul derives knowledge. The bodily organs are not the doers, but it is the Soul that is doer, of all acts.

data.v: अग्निर्दारुगतो यद्वद्भिन्ने दारौ न दृश्यते । तथैवात्मा शरीरस्थो योगेनैवात्र दृश्यते ॥
data.md: There is fire in wood, but it is never seen by cutting upon a piece of wood. Similarly, the Soul lives within the body, but it can never be seen by cutting the body.

data.v: नदीष्वापो यथा युक्ता यथा सूर्ये मरीचयः । संतन्वाना यथा यान्ति तथा देहाः शरीरिणाम् ॥
data.md: Water must exits in rivers. Rays of light are always attached to the sun. Similarly, thc Soul has a body. This connection is not stopped because of the constant succession of bodies that Soul has to pass through.

data.v: स्वप्नयोगे यथैवात्मा पञ्चेन्द्रियसमागतः । देहमुत्सृज्य वै याति तथैवात्रोपलभ्यते ॥
data.md: In a dream, the Soul, endued with the five senses, leaves the body and moves over wide areas. Similarly, when death takes place, the Soul passes out of one body for entering another.

data.v: कर्मणा व्याप्यते पूर्वं कर्मणा चोपपद्यते । कर्मणा नीयतेऽन्यत्र स्वकृतेन बलीयसा ॥
data.md: The Soul is fettered by its pristine acts. Fettered by acts done by it in one state. Indeed, it is led from one into another body by its owni acts which are of very powerful consequences.

data.v: स तु देहाद्यथा देहं त्यक्त्वान्यं प्रतिपद्यते । तथा तं संप्रवक्ष्यामि भूतग्रामं स्वकर्मजम् ॥
data.md: I will not describe how the owner of a human body, casting off his body, enters another, and then again into another, and how, indeed, the whole range of beings is the result of their respective acts.

data.v: चतुर्विधानि भूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च । अव्यक्तप्रभवान्याहुरव्यक्तनिधनानि च । अव्यक्तनिधनं विद्यादव्यक्तात्मात्मकं मनः ॥
data.md: Bhishma said 'All immobile and mobile beings, divided into four classes, have been described to be of unmanifest birth and unmanifest death. Existing only in the unmanifest Soul, the Mind is said to possess the attributes of the unmanifest.

data.v: यथाश्वत्थकणीकायामन्तर्भूतो महाद्रुमः । निष्पन्नो दृश्यते व्यक्तमव्यक्तात्संभवस्तथा ॥
data.md: As a vast tree lies within a small unblown Ashvatha flower and is seen only when it comes out, so birth takes place from what is unmanifest.

data.v: अभिद्रवत्ययस्कान्तमयो निश्चेतनावुभौ । स्वभावहेतुजा भावा यद्वदन्यदपीदृशम् ॥
data.md: A piece of iron, which is inanimate runs towards a piece of loadstone. Likewise, inclinations and propensities due to natural instincts, and all else, run towards the Soul in a 11cw lifc.

data.v: तद्वदव्यक्तजा भावाः कर्तुः कारणलक्षणाः । अचेतनाश्चेतयितुः कारणादभिसंहिताः ॥
data.md: Indeed, as those propensities bom of Darkness and Ignorance, and inactive in their nature, are united with the Soul when re-born, similarly, those other inclinations and aspirations of the Soul that have their look directed towards Brahma become united with it, coming to it directly from Brahima itself.

data.v: न भूः खं द्यौर्न भूतानि नर्षयो न सुरासुराः । नान्यदासीदृते जीवमासेदुर्न तु संहितम् ॥
data.md: Neither earth, nor sky, nor heaven, nor things, nor the vital airs, nor virtue and vice, nor anything else, existed before, except the Intelligence-Soul. Nor have they any necessary connection with even the Intelligence-Soul corrupted by Darkness.

data.v: सर्वनीत्या सर्वगतं मनोहेतु सलक्षणम् । अज्ञानकर्म निर्दिष्टमेतत्कारणलक्षणम् ॥
data.md: The Soul is eternal. It is indestructible. It is in every creature. It is the cause of the Mind. It is without qualities. This universe before us is due to Darkness or Ignorance. The Soul's apprehensions of form, etc., are due to past desires.

data.v: तत्कारणैर्हि संयुक्तं कार्यसंग्रहकारकम् । येनैतद्वर्तते चक्रमनादिनिधनं महत् ॥
data.md: The Soul, when it becomes endued with desires, engages in acts. On account of that condition, this vast wheel of existence revolves with beginning and without end.

data.v: अव्यक्तनाभं व्यक्तारं विकारपरिमण्डलम् । क्षेत्रज्ञाधिष्ठितं चक्रं स्निग्धाक्षं वर्तते ध्रुवम् ॥
data.md: The Understanding, is the nave of that wheel. The body with the senses, forms its spokes. The perceptions and acts are its circumference. Urged by on the quality of Darkness, the Soul presides over it.

data.v: स्निग्धत्वात्तिलवत्सर्वं चक्रेऽस्मिन्पीड्यते जगत् । तिलपीडैरिवाक्रम्य भोगैरज्ञानसंभवैः ॥
data.md: Like oilmen pressing oilseeds pressing oilseeds in their machine, the consequences born of Darkness, assailing the universe which is moistened by Darkness, press or grind it in that wheel.

data.v: कर्म तत्कुरुते तर्षादहंकारपरिग्रहम् । कार्यकारणसंयोगे स हेतुरुपपादितः ॥
data.md: In that succession of births, the individual Soul, seized by the idea of Ego in consequence of desire, performs acts. In the union of cause and effect, those acts again become fresh causes.

data.v: नात्येति कारणं कार्यं न कार्यं कारणं तथा । कार्याणां तूपकरणे कालो भवति हेतुमान् ॥
data.md: Effects do not enter into causes. Nor do causes enter into effects. Time is the instrumental in the production of effects.

data.v: हेतुयुक्ताः प्रकृतयो विकाराश्च परस्परम् । अन्योन्यमभिवर्तन्ते पुरुषाधिष्ठिताः सदा ॥
data.md: The primordial essences, and their changes endued with causes, exist unitedly, on account of their being always presided over by the Soul.

data.v: सरजस्तामसैर्भावैश्च्युतो हेतुबलान्वितः । क्षेत्रज्ञमेवानुयाति पांसुर्वातेरितो यथा । न च तैः स्पृश्यते भावो न ते तेन महात्मना ॥
data.md: Like dust following the wind that moves it, the individual Soul, shorn of body, but endued still with inclinations born of Darkness and Ignorance with principles of causes formed by pristine deeds, moves on, following the direction of the Supreme Soul.

data.v: सरजस्कोऽरजस्कश्च स वै वायुर्यथा भवेत् । तथैतदन्तरं विद्यात्क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोर्बुधः । अभ्यासात्स तथा युक्तो न गच्छेत्प्रकृतिं पुनः ॥
data.md: As the wind is separate from the dust it carries away, so, the wise man should know, is the connection between life and the Soul. No one should think that the Soul, on account of its seeming union with the body and the senses and the other inclinations and beliefs and unbeliefs, is really endued therewith as its necessary and absolute qualities. On the other hand, the Soul should be considered as existing in its own nature.

data.v: संदेहमेतमुत्पन्नमच्छिनद्भगवानृषिः । तथा वार्तां समीक्षेत कृतलक्षणसंमिताम् ॥
data.md: Thus did the divine Rishi remove the doubt that had taken possession of his disciple's mind. Inspite of all this, people depend upon means consisting of acts and scriptural rites for removing misery and acquiring happiness.

data.v: बीजान्यग्न्युपदग्धानि न रोहन्ति यथा पुनः । ज्ञानदग्धैस्तथा क्लेशैर्नात्मा संबध्यते पुनः ॥
data.md: Seeds that are burnt by fire do not put forth sprouts. Likewise, if everything that produces misery be consumed by the fire of true knowledge, the Soul is freed from the obligation of re-birth in the world.

data.v: प्रवृत्तिलक्षणो धर्मो यथायमुपपद्यते । तेषां विज्ञाननिष्ठानामन्यत्तत्त्वं न रोचते ॥
data.md: Bhishma said more Persons who perform acts consider the performance of acts highly. Likewise, those who are devoted to Knowledge do not regard anything other than Knowledge.

data.v: दुर्लभा वेदविद्वांसो वेदोक्तेषु व्यवस्थिताः । प्रयोजनमतस्त्वत्र मार्गमिच्छन्ति संस्तुतम् ॥
data.md: Rare are persons fully conversant with the Vedas and depending upon the injunctions contained therein. The intelligent however consider the abstention from acts as the better of the two, viz., heaven and liberation.

data.v: सद्भिराचरितत्वात्तु वृत्तमेतदगर्हितम् । इयं सा बुद्धिरन्येयं यया याति परां गतिम् ॥
data.md: Abstention of acts is observed by highly wise That conduct, therefore, is praiseworthy. The intelligence which advocates abstention from acts, is that by which one attains to liberation. men.

data.v: शरीरवानुपादत्ते मोहात्सर्वपरिग्रहान् । कामक्रोधादिभिर्भावैर्युक्तो राजसतामसैः ॥
data.md: Endued with body, a person, through folly, and endued with anger and cupidity and all the propensities born of Darkness and Ignorance, cherishes attachment for all earthly objects.

data.v: नाशुद्धमाचरेत्तस्मादभीप्सन्देहयापनम् । कर्मणो विवरं कुर्वन्न लोकानाप्नुयाच्छुभान् ॥
data.md: One, therefore, who wishes to destroy his connection with the body, should never perforin any impure act. On the other hand, one should create by his acts a path for attaining to Liberation, without wishing for regions of happiness.

data.v: लोहयुक्तं यथा हेम विपक्वं न विराजते । तथापक्वकषायाख्यं विज्ञानं न प्रकाशते ॥
data.md: As gold, when united with iron, losses its purity and cannot shine, so Knowledge, when existing with attachment to earthly objects and such other shortcomings, fails to display its splendour.

data.v: यश्चाधर्मं चरेन्मोहात्कामलोभावनु प्लवन् । धर्म्यं पन्थानमाक्रम्य सानुबन्धो विनश्यति ॥
data.md: He who, influenced by cupidity, desire and anger, practises unrighteousness, transgressing the path of righteousness, is completely destroyed.

data.v: शब्दादीन्विषयांस्तस्मादसंरागादनुप्लवेत् । क्रोधहर्षौ विषादश्च जायन्ते हि परस्परम् ॥
data.md: One who is desirous of benefiting oneself should never seek, with too much attachment, earthly possessions representing by the objects of the senses. If one does it, anger and joy and sorrow arise from one another.

data.v: पञ्चभूतात्मके देहे सत्त्वराजसतामसे । कमभिष्टुवते चायं कं वा क्रोशति किं वदेत् ॥
data.md: When every one's body is made up of the five original elements as also of the three qualities of Goodness. Darkness, and Ignorance, whom shall one worship and whom shall one censure with what words?

data.v: स्पर्शरूपरसाद्येषु सङ्गं गच्छन्ति बालिशाः । नावगच्छन्त्यविज्ञानादात्मजं पार्थिवं गुणम् ॥
data.md: Only the fools become attached to the objects of the senses. On account of folly they do not know that their bodies are only modifications of earth.

data.v: मृन्मयं शरणं यद्वन्मृदैव परिलिप्यते । पार्थिवोऽयं तथा देहो मृद्विकारैर्विलिप्यते ॥
data.md: As a house made of earth is covered over with earth, so this body which is made of earth is saved from destruction by food which is only a change of earth.

data.v: मधु तैलं पयः सर्पिर्मांसानि लवणं गुडः । धान्यानि फलमूलानि मृद्विकाराः सहाम्भसा ॥
data.md: Honey, oil, milk, butter, meat, salt, treacle and grain of all kinds and fruit and roots are all modifications of earth and water.

data.v: यद्वत्कान्तारमातिष्ठन्नौत्सुक्यं समनुव्रजेत् । श्रमादाहारमादद्यादस्वाद्वपि हि यापनम् ॥
data.md: Giving up all desire (for rich food) herinits living in the forest take simple and unsavoury food, for only keeping up the body.

data.v: तद्वत्संसारकान्तारमातिष्ठञ्श्रमतत्परः । यात्रार्थमद्यादाहारं व्याधितो भेषजं यथा ॥
data.md: Likewise, a person who lives in the forest of the world, should be ready for labour and should take food for passing life, like a patient taking medicine.

data.v: सत्यशौचार्जवत्यागैर्यशसा विक्रमेण च । क्षान्त्या धृत्या च बुद्ध्या च मनसा तपसैव च ॥
भावान्सर्वान्यथावृत्तान्संवसेत यथाक्रमम् । शान्तिमिच्छन्नदीनात्मा संयच्छेदिन्द्रियाणि च ॥
सत्त्वेन रजसा चैव तमसा चैव मोहिताः । चक्रवत्परिवर्तन्ते ह्यज्ञानाज्जन्तवो भृशम् ॥
data.md: All creatures, stupefied by Ignorance by the qualities of Goodness, Darkness, and Ignorance and continually revolving like a wheel.

data.v: तस्मात्सम्यक्परीक्षेत दोषानज्ञानसंभवान् । अज्ञानप्रभवं नित्यमहंकारं परित्यजेत् ॥
data.md: All faults, begotten of Ignorance should be closely examined and the idea of Self, which originates from Ignorance, and creates misery, should be avoided.

data.v: महाभूतानीन्द्रियाणि गुणाः सत्त्वं रजस्तमः । त्रैलोक्यं सेश्वरं सर्वमहंकारे प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥
data.md: The five elements, the senses, the qualities of Goodness, Darkness and Ignorance, the three worlds with the Supreme Being himself, and acts, all rest on Self-consciousness.

data.v: यथेह नियतं कालो दर्शयत्यार्तवान्गुणान् । तद्वद्भूतेष्वहंकारं विद्याद्भूतप्रवर्तकम् ॥
data.md: As Time, under its own laws, always creates the seasons one after another, so one should know that Consciousness in all creatures is the mover of acts.

data.v: संमोहकं तमो विद्यात्कृष्णमज्ञानसंभवम् । प्रीतिदुःखनिबद्धांश्च समस्तांस्त्रीनथो गुणान् । सत्त्वस्य रजसश्चैव तमसश्च निबोध तान् ॥
data.md: Ignorance produces delusions. It is like Darkness and is born of Ignorance. All the joys and sorrows belong to the three qualities of Goodness, Darkness, and Ignorance.

data.v: प्रमोहो हर्षजः प्रीतिरसंदेहो धृतिः स्मृतिः । एतान्सत्त्वगुणान्विद्यादिमान्राजसतामसान् ॥
data.md: Listen now to those consequences that spring from the qualities of Goodness, Darkness and Ignorance. Contentment, the satisfaction that arises from joy, certainty, intelligence, and memory,-these are the results of the quality of Goodness. I shall now describe the consequences of Darkness and Ignorance.

data.v: कामक्रोधौ प्रमादश्च लोभमोहौ भयं क्लमः । विषादशोकावरतिर्मानदर्पावनार्यता ॥
data.md: Desire, anger, error, cupidity stupefaction, fear, and fatigue, belong to the quality of Darkness. Cheerlessness, grief discontent, vanity, pride, and wickedness, all belong to Ignorance.

data.v: दोषाणामेवमादीनां परीक्ष्य गुरुलाघवम् । विमृशेदात्मसंस्थानामेकैकमनुसंततम् ॥
data.md: Examining the weight or lightness of these and other evils that exist in the Soul, one should reflect upon each of them one after another.

data.v: के दोषा मनसा त्यक्ताः के बुद्ध्या शिथिलीकृताः । के पुनः पुनरायान्ति के मोहादफला इव ॥
data.md: Yudhishthira said, What eviis are shunned by persons sceking Liberation? What are those that are weakened by them? What are the evils that come again and again? What, again, are regarded as week, through stupefaction.

data.v: केषां बलाबलं बुद्ध्या हेतुभिर्विमृशेद्बुधः । एतत्सर्वं समाचक्ष्व यथा विद्यामहं प्रभो ॥
data.md: What, indeed, are those evils upon whose gravity and weakness a wise man should reflect with the help of intelligence and of reason? I have doubts upon these subjects. Describe these to me, O grandfather.

data.v: दोषैर्मूलादवच्छिन्नैर्विशुद्धात्मा विमुच्यते । विनाशयति संभूतमयस्मयमयो यथा । तथाकृतात्मा सहजैर्दोषैर्नश्यति राजसैः ॥
data.md: Bhishma said-'By rooting out all evils, a person of pure Soul succeeds in obtaining Liberation. As an axe made of steel cuts a steel chain, similarly, a person of cleansed Soul, destroying all the evils that originate from Darkness and that are born with the Soul, succeeds in cutting off his connection with the body.

data.v: राजसं तामसं चैव शुद्धात्माकर्मसंभवम् । तत्सर्वं देहिनां बीजं सर्वमात्मवतः समम् ॥
data.md: The qualities having their origin in Darkness, those that originate from Ignorance, and those stainless ones characterised by purity, form as it were the seed from which all embodied creatures have sprung. Amongst these, the quality of Goodness alone is the cause through which persons of pure souls succeed in attaining to Liberation.

data.v: तस्मादात्मवता वर्ज्यं रजश्च तम एव च । रजस्तमोभ्यां निर्मुक्तं सत्त्वं निर्मलतामियात् ॥
data.md: A person of pure soul, therefore, should cast off all the qualities begotten of Darkness and Ignorance. Then again when the quality of Goodness becomes frced from those of Darkness and Ignorance it shines the more.

data.v: अथ वा मन्त्रवद्ब्रूयुर्मांसादानां यजुष्कृतम् । हेतुः स एवानादाने शुद्धधर्मानुपालने ॥
data.md: Some say that sacrifices and other acts performed with the help of Mantras, and which bring about the purification of the Soul, are evil or cruel acts. On the other hand, those acts are the chief instruments for dissociating the Soul from all worldly attachments, and for the observance of the religion of peace.

data.v: रजसा धर्मयुक्तानि कार्याण्यपि समाप्नुयात् । अर्थयुक्तानि चात्यर्थं कामान्सर्वांश्च सेवते ॥
data.md: Through the influence of the qualities born of Darkness, all impious acts are perpetrated and all earthly acts as well as such acts as originate from desire are performed.

data.v: तमसा लोभयुक्तानि क्रोधजानि च सेवते । हिंसाविहाराभिरतस्तन्द्रीनिद्रासमन्वितः ॥
data.md: Through qualities born of Ignorance, one does all acts fraught with cupidity and springing from anger. In consequence of the attribute of Ignorance, one feels sleep and procrastination and becomes addicted to all acts of crucily and carnality.

data.v: सत्त्वस्थः सात्त्विकान्भावाञ्शुद्धान्पश्यति संश्रितः । स देही विमलः श्रीमाञ्शुद्धो विद्यासमन्वितः ॥
data.md: That person, however, who endued with faith and scriptural knowledge, follows the quality of Goodness, attends only to all good things and becomes endued with beauty and a soul free froin every corruption.

data.v: रजसा साध्यते मोहस्तमसा च नरर्षभ । क्रोधलोभौ भयं दर्प एतेषां साधनाच्छुचिः ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Delusion or loss of judgement arises from the quality of Darkness. Anger, cupidity, fear and pride originate from the quality of Ignorance, O foremost of Bharata's race. When all these are destroyed, one becomes pure.

data.v: परमं परमात्मानं देवमक्षयमव्ययम् । विष्णुमव्यक्तसंस्थानं विशन्ते देवसत्तमम् ॥
data.md: By obtaining purity, a person acquires the knowledge of the Supreme Soul which is effulgent, incapable of deterioration, without change, pervading all things, having the unmanifest for his refuge, and the foremost of all the gods.

data.v: तस्य मायाविदग्धाङ्गा ज्ञानभ्रष्टा निराशिषः । मानवा ज्ञानसंमोहात्ततः कामं प्रयान्ति वै ॥
data.md: By His illusory power men fall away from knowledge and become senseless, and their knowledge being darkened, yield to anger.

data.v: कामात्क्रोधमवाप्याथ लोभमोहौ च मानवाः । मानदर्पादहंकारमहंकारात्ततः क्रियाः ॥
data.md: From anger, they become subject to desire. From desire originate cupidity, delusion, vanity, pride and selfishness. From such selfishness proceed various sorts of acts.

data.v: क्रियाभिः स्नेहसंबन्धः स्नेहाच्छोकमनन्तरम् । सुखदुःखसमारम्भाज्जन्माजन्मकृतक्षणाः ॥
data.md: From acts originate various ties of affection and from those ties of affection springs sorrow or misery and from acts imbued with joy and sorrow proceeds the liability to birth and death.

data.v: जन्मतो गर्भवासं तु शुक्रशोणितसंभवम् । पुरीषमूत्रविक्लेदशोणितप्रभवाविलम् ॥
data.md: On account of the obligation of birth, one is compelled to live within the womb,—for the union of vital seed and blood. Living there is defiled with excreta urine and phlegm, and always fouled with blood that is created there.

data.v: तृष्णाभिभूतस्तैर्बद्धस्तानेवाभिपरिप्लवन् । संसारतन्त्रवाहिन्यस्तत्र बुध्येत योषितः ॥
data.md: Overwhelmed by thirst, the Intelligence Soul becomes fettered by anger and the rest that have been described above. It seeks, however, to escape those evils. In this respect, women must be considered as instruments which set the stream of Creation a going.

data.v: प्रकृत्या क्षेत्रभूतास्ता नराः क्षेत्रज्ञलक्षणाः । तस्मादेता विशेषेण नरोऽतीयुर्विपश्चितः ॥
data.md: By their nature, women are Kshetra, and men are Kshetrajna in respect of qualities. Therefore, wise persons should not pursue women especially.

data.v: कृत्या ह्येता घोररूपा मोहयन्त्यविचक्षणान् । रजस्यन्तर्हिता मूर्तिरिन्द्रियाणां सनातनी ॥
data.md: Indeed, women are like dreadful Mantra powers. They stupefy persons shorn of wisdom. They are sunk in the quality of Darkness. They are the eternal embodiment of the senses.

data.v: तस्मात्तर्षात्मकाद्रागाद्बीजाज्जायन्ति जन्तवः । स्वदेहजानस्वसंज्ञान्यद्वदङ्गात्कृमींस्त्यजेत् । स्वसंज्ञानस्वजांस्तद्वत्सुतसंज्ञान्कृमींस्त्यजेत् ॥
शुक्रतो रसतश्चैव स्नेहाज्जायन्ति जन्तवः । स्वभावात्कर्मयोगाद्वा तानुपेक्षेत बुद्धिमान् ॥
data.md: From the seminal fluid and sweat creatures spring from the body, influenced by pristino acts or in the course of nature. Therefore, a wise man should feel no regard for them.

data.v: रजस्तमसि पर्यस्तं सत्त्वं तमसि संस्थितम् । ज्ञानाधिष्ठानमज्ञानं बुद्ध्यहंकारलक्षणम् ॥
तद्बीजं देहिनामाहुस्तद्बीजं जीवसंज्ञितम् । कर्मणा कालयुक्तेन संसारपरिवर्तकम् ॥
data.md: The quality of Darkness rests on that of Ignorance. The quality of Goodness, again, rests on that of Darkness. Darkness which is unmanifest overspreads itself on Knowledge, and creates the phenomena of Intelligence and Consciousness has been described as the seed of individual Souls. That, again, which is the seed of such knowledge is called the Jiya (or Individual Soul). On account of acts and the virtue of time, the Soul goes through birth and repeated rounds of re-birth.

data.v: रमत्ययं यथा स्वप्ने मनसा देहवानिव । कर्मगर्भैर्गुणैर्देही गर्भे तदुपपद्यते ॥
data.md: As in a dream the Soul plays as if invested with a body which, of course, is due to the action of the mind, similarly, it gets in the mother's womb a body in consequence of qualities and propensities created by pristine deeds.

data.v: कर्मणा बीजभूतेन चोद्यते यद्यदिन्द्रियम् । जायते तदहंकाराद्रागयुक्तेन चेतसा ॥
data.md: Whatever senses, while it is there, are awakened by pristine deeds as the operating cause, become created in Consciousness in consequence of the mind co-existing with attachments.

data.v: शब्दरागाच्छ्रोत्रमस्य जायते भावितात्मनः । रूपरागात्तथा चक्षुर्घ्राणं गन्धचिकीर्षया ॥
data.md: On account of the past thoughts of sound that are awakened in it, the Soul, subjected to such influences, gets the organ of hearing. Similarly, from attachment to forms, its eye is produced, and from its desire after smell its organ of smelling.

data.v: स्पर्शनेभ्यस्तथा वायुः प्राणापानव्यपाश्रयः । व्यानोदानौ समानश्च पञ्चधा देहयापना ॥
data.md: From thoughts of touch it acquires the skin. Likewise, the five vital airs are acquired by it, viz., Prana, Apana, Vyana, Udana, and Samana, which make the body agoing.

data.v: संजातैर्जायते गात्रैः कर्मजैर्ब्रह्मणा वृतः । दुःखाद्यन्तैर्दुःखमध्यैर्नरः शारीरमानसैः ॥
data.md: Encased in body with all limbs fully developed on account of pristine deeds, the Soul takes birth, with both physical and mental sorrow, in the beginning, iniddle, and end.

data.v: दुःखं विद्यादुपादानादभिमानाच्च वर्धते । त्यागात्तेभ्यो निरोधः स्यान्निरोधज्ञो विमुच्यते ॥
data.md: It should be known that sorrow originates from the very formation of body in the womb). It increases with the idea of self. From renuciation of these, sorrow is destroyed. He who knows sorrow's end attains to Liberation.

data.v: इन्द्रियाणां रजस्येव प्रभवप्रलयावुभौ । परीक्ष्य संचरेद्विद्वान्यथावच्छास्त्रचक्षुषा ॥
data.md: Both the origin and the destruction of the senses depend on the quality of Darkness. A wise man should act with proper scrutiny with the help of the eye of the scriptures.

data.v: ज्ञानेन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थान्नोपसर्पन्त्यतर्षुलम् । ज्ञातैश्च कारणैर्देही न देहं पुनरर्हति ॥
data.md: The senses of knowledge, if they succeed in acquiring all their objects, can never stupefy the man who is without thirst. The embodied Soul, by making its senses weak, is saved from the obligation of re-birth.

data.v: अत्रोपायं प्रवक्ष्यामि यथावच्छास्त्रचक्षुषा । तद्विज्ञानाच्चरन्प्राज्ञः प्राप्नुयात्परमां गतिम् ॥
data.md: 'I shall now describe to you the means of conquering the senses as seen with the eye of the scriptures. A person, O king, will attain to the highest and by shaping his conduct accordingly.

data.v: सर्वेषामेव भूतानां पुरुषः श्रेष्ठ उच्यते । पुरुषेभ्यो द्विजानाहुर्द्विजेभ्यो मन्त्रवादिनः ॥
data.md: Amongst all living creatures man is said to be the foremost. Among men, the twice-born, persons well read in the Vedas are the foremost.

data.v: सर्वभूतविशिष्टास्ते सर्वज्ञाः सर्वदर्शिनः । ब्राह्मणा वेदतत्त्वज्ञास्तत्त्वार्थगतिनिश्चयाः ॥
data.md: These last are considered as the souls of all living creatures. Indeed, those Brahmanas who have mastered the Vedas are considered as allseeing and omniscient. They are persons who have become conversant with Brahma.

data.v: नेत्रहीनो यथा ह्येकः कृच्छ्राणि लभतेऽध्वनि । ज्ञानहीनस्तथा लोके तस्माज्ज्ञानविदोऽधिकाः ॥
data.md: As a blind man, without a guide, meets with many difficulties on a road, so has a person shorn of knowledge to meet with many impediments in the world. Therefore those who are endued with knowledge arc considered as superior to the rest.

data.v: तांस्तानुपासते धर्मान्धर्मकामा यथागमम् । न त्वेषामर्थसामान्यमन्तरेण गुणानिमान् ॥
data.md: Those who wish to acquire virtue practise various rites according to the scriptural injunctions. They do not, however, attain to Liberation. They only acquire those good qualities which I shall presently mention.

data.v: वाग्देहमनसां शौचं क्षमा सत्यं धृतिः स्मृतिः । सर्वधर्मेषु धर्मज्ञा ज्ञापयन्ति गुणानिमान् ॥
data.md: Purity of speech, of body, and of mind, forgiveness, truth, firmness and intelligence,-these good qualities are shown by pious persons who observe both kinds of religion.

data.v: यदिदं ब्रह्मणो रूपं ब्रह्मचर्यमिति स्मृतम् । परं तत्सर्वभूतेभ्यस्तेन यान्ति परां गतिम् ॥
data.md: What is called Brahmacharya is considered as the means of attaining to Brahma. That is the foremost of all religions. It is by the practice of that religion that one acquires the highest end.

data.v: लिङ्गसंयोगहीनं यच्छरीरस्पर्शवर्जितम् । श्रोत्रेण श्रवणं चैव चक्षुषा चैव दर्शनम् ॥
data.md: Brahmacharya has no connection with the five vital airs, mind, understanding, the five senses of perception, and the five senses of action. It is, therefore, free from all the perceptions that the senses give. It is heard only as a word, and its form, is not seen, but can only be conceived.

data.v: जिह्वया रसनं यच्च तदेव परिवर्जितम् । बुद्ध्या च व्यवसायेन ब्रह्मचर्यमकल्मषम् ॥
data.md: It is a state of existence only on the mind. It has no connection with the senses. That pure state should be attained to by the understanding alone.

data.v: सम्यग्वृत्तिर्ब्रह्मलोकं प्राप्नुयान्मध्यमः सुरान् । द्विजाग्र्यो जायते विद्वान्कन्यसीं वृत्तिमास्थितः ॥
data.md: He who practises it duly attains to Brahma; he who practises it half and half, attains to the status of the gods; while be who practises it indifferently, is born among Brahmanas and possessed of learning attains to eminence.

data.v: सुदुष्करं ब्रह्मचर्यमुपायं तत्र मे शृणु । संप्रवृत्तमुदीर्णं च निगृह्णीयाद्द्विजो मनः ॥
data.md: Brahmacharya is highly difficult to practise. Listen now to the means thereof. That twiceborn one who follows it should subdue the quality of Darkness as soon as it begins to show itself or as soon as it begins to be powerful.

data.v: योषितां न कथाः श्राव्या न निरीक्ष्या निरम्बराः । कदाचिद्दर्शनादासां दुर्बलानाविशेद्रजः ॥
data.md: One who has taken that yow should not speak with women. He should never look at a naked woman. The sight of women, under even indifferent circumstances, excites the passion of all weak-minded men.

data.md: If a person feels a desire for women rising in his heart, he should observe the vow called Krichcchra and also pass three days in water. If desire is formed even in a dream, one should, diving in water, mentally repeat for three times the three Riks by Aghamarshana.

data.md: That wise man who follows this VOW should, with a liberal and enlightened mind, consume the sins in his mind which are created by the quality of Darkness.

data.md: As the passage that carries away the refuge of the body is very closely connected with the body, so the embodied Soul is very closely connected with the body that confines it.

data.md: Know that there are ten principle canals. These help the functions of the five senses. From those ten issue out thousands of other passages that are minuter in form.

data.md: Like rivers filling the ocean at the proper time, all these channels, containing juices, nourish the body.

data.v: मध्ये च हृदयस्यैका सिरा त्वत्र मनोवहा । शुक्रं संकल्पजं नॄणां सर्वगात्रैर्विमुञ्चति ॥
data.md: There is a channel leading to the heart called Manovaha. It draws from every part of the human body the seminal fluid which is born of desire.

data.md: Numberless other channels issuing from that principal one extend into every part of the body and bearing the element of heat cause the sense of vision (and the rest).

data.md: As the butter that lies within milk is churned up by churing rods, so the desires that are created in the mind draw together the vital sced that lies within the body.

data.md: In the midst of even our dreams passion originating in imagination attacks the mind, with the result that the passage already named, viz., Manovaha, throws out the seminal fluid born of desire.

data.md: The great and divine Rishi Atri is a inaster of the subject of the generation of the vital secd.
