data.md: Shree said-Here, I give up a quarter of myself. Let it be placed on the Earth. Do you, next, make a proper distribution, O Shakra, for my second quarter.

data.v: ये वै सन्तो मनुष्येषु ब्रह्मण्याः सत्यवादिनः । ते ते पादं तितिक्षन्तामलं सन्तस्तितिक्षितुम् ॥
data.md: Shakra said 'The waters, among men, in their liquid form, do various services to men. Let the waters bear a fourth part of your person. They have the strength to bear a fourth part of you person. They have the strength to bear a portion of yours.'

data.v: एष मे निहितः पादो योऽयं सत्सु प्रतिष्ठितः । एवं विनिहितां शक्र भूतेषु परिधत्स्व माम् ॥
data.md: Shree said “Here, I give up my fourth quarter that is to be placed among the good. My portions thus given to different creatures, do you continue to protect me, O Shakra.'

data.v: भूतानामिह वै यस्त्वा मया विनिहितां सतीम् । उपहन्यात्स मे द्विष्यात्तथा शृण्वन्तु मे वचः ॥
ततस्त्यक्तः श्रिया राजा दैत्यानां बलिरब्रवीत् । यावत्पुरस्तात्प्रतपेत्तावद्वै दक्षिणां दिशम् ॥
पश्चिमां तावदेवापि तथोदीचीं दिवाकरः । तथा मध्यंदिने सूर्यो अस्तमेति यदा तदा । पुनर्देवासुरं युद्धं भावि जेतास्मि वस्तदा ॥
data.md: When, however, withdrawing himself from all quarters, the Sun will shine only upon the region of Brahman that is situate in the middle of Sumeru, then will again take place a great battle between the gods and the Asuras, and in that fight I shall certainly defeat all of you.

data.v: सर्वाँल्लोकान्यदादित्य एकस्थस्तापयिष्यति । तदा देवासुरे युद्धे जेताहं त्वां शतक्रतो ॥
data.md: When withdrawing himself from all quarters, the Sun will shine fixedly upon only the region of Brahman, then will again take place a great battle between the gods and the Asuras, and in the fight I shall certainly defeat all of you..

data.v: ब्रह्मणास्मि समादिष्टो न हन्तव्यो भवानिति । तेन तेऽहं बले वज्रं न विमुञ्चामि मूर्धनि ॥
data.md: Shakra said Brahman has commanded me, saying that I should never kill you. It is, therefore, O Vali, that I do not hurl my thunderbolt upon your head.

data.v: यथेष्टं गच्छ दैत्येन्द्र स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु महासुर । आदित्यो नावतपिता कदाचिन्मध्यतः स्थितः ॥
data.md: Go wherever you like, O king of the Daityas! O great Asuras, peace to you! No time will come when the sun will shine from only the meridian.

data.v: स्थापितो ह्यस्य समयः पूर्वमेव स्वयंभुवा । अजस्रं परियात्येष सत्येनावतपन्प्रजाः ॥
data.md: The self-create has before this ordinated the laws which regulate the Sun's motions. Giving light and heat to all creatures, he shines continually.

data.v: अयनं तस्य षण्मासा उत्तरं दक्षिणं तथा । येन संयाति लोकेषु शीतोष्णे विसृजन्रविः ॥
data.md: For six months he travels in a northward course and then for the other six in a southward course. The Sun travels by these courses, creating winter and summer for all creatures.'

data.v: एवमुक्तस्तु दैत्येन्द्रो बलिरिन्द्रेण भारत । जगाम दक्षिणामाशामुदीचीं तु पुरंदरः ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Thus addressed by Indra, O Bharata, Vali the king of the Daityas proceeded towards the south. Purandara proceeded towards the north.

data.v: इत्येतद्बलिना गीतमनहंकारसंज्ञितम् । वाक्यं श्रुत्वा सहस्राक्षः खमेवारुरुहे तदा ॥
data.md: After having listened to the wrong of Vali which were marked by no pride, the thousandeyed Indra then ascended the skies.

data.v: अत्रैवोदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् । शतक्रतोश्च संवादं नमुचेश्च युधिष्ठिर ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Regarding it, О Yudhisthira, is cited the old discourse between Prahlada and Indra.

data.v: श्रिया विहीनमासीनमक्षोभ्यमिव सागरम् । भवाभवज्ञं भूतानामित्युवाच पुरंदरः ॥
data.md: When the Asura Namuchi, who knew well the birth and the death of all creatures was sitting, shorn of prosperity but undisturbed at heart like the huge ocean in perfect stillness, Purandara addressed him these words-..

data.v: बद्धः पाशैश्च्युतः स्थानाद्द्विषतां वशमागतः । श्रिया विहीनो नमुचे शोचस्याहो न शोचसि ॥
data.md: You are now bound in fetters, fallen off from your former position, brought under the sway of your foes, and divested of prosperity. Your present circumstances are such as may well give room to grief. Yet how is it, O Prahlada, that you do not grieve.

data.v: अनवाप्यं च शोकेन शरीरं चोपतप्यते । अमित्राश्च प्रहृष्यन्ति नास्ति शोके सहायता ॥
data.md: 'By indulging in such sorrow as cannot be avoided one only wastes his body any cheering his enemies. Then, again, no one can lighten another's sorrow by putting any portion of it upon oneself. For these reasons, O Shakra, I do not grieve. All this that you see has one end.

data.v: तस्माच्छक्र न शोचामि सर्वं ह्येवेदमन्तवत् । संतापाद्भ्रश्यते रूपं धर्मश्चैव सुरेश्वर ॥
data.md: Indulgence in sorrow mars personal beauty, prosperity, life, and virtue itself, O king of the gods.

data.v: विनीय खलु तद्दुःखमागतं वैमनस्यजम् । ध्यातव्यं मनसा हृद्यं कल्याणं संविजानता ॥
data.md: Forsooth, suppressing that sorrow which comes upon oneself and which is begotten by a weak mind, one endued with true knowledge should reflect in his mind of that which yields the highest good not which lives in the heart itself.

data.v: यथा यथा हि पुरुषः कल्याणे कुरुते मनः । तदैवास्य प्रसीदन्ति सर्वार्था नात्र संशयः ॥
data.md: When one sets his mind upon what is for one's highest good, forsooth, the result that all his objects are accomplished.

data.v: एकः शास्ता न द्वितीयोऽस्ति शास्ता; गर्भे शयानं पुरुषं शास्ति शास्ता । तेनानुशिष्टः प्रवणादिवोदकं; यथा नियुक्तोऽस्मि तथा वहामि ॥
data.md: There is One Ordainer, and no second. His sway extends the embryo. Controlled by the great Ordainer I go on as He moves me on, like water running along a downward path.

data.v: भावाभावावभिजानन्गरीयो; जानामि श्रेयो न तु तत्करोमि । आशाः सुशर्म्याः सुहृदां सुकुर्व;न्यथा नियुक्तोऽस्मि तथा वहामि ॥
data.md: Knowing what is existence and what liberation, and understanding also that the latter is superior to the former, I do not, however, try to attain to it. Doing virtuous and sinful acts I go on as He moves me on.

data.v: यथा यथास्य प्राप्तव्यं प्राप्नोत्येव तथा तथा । भवितव्यं यथा यच्च भवत्येव तथा तथा ॥
data.md: One gets those things that are ordained to be got. That which is to happen actually takes place.

data.v: यत्र यत्रैव संयुङ्क्ते धाता गर्भं पुनः पुनः । तत्र तत्रैव वसति न यत्र स्वयमिच्छति ॥
data.md: Over even One has repeatedly to live in such wombs in which one is placed by the Ordainer. He has no choice in the matter.

data.v: भावो योऽयमनुप्राप्तो भवितव्यमिदं मम । इति यस्य सदा भावो न स मुह्येत्कदाचन ॥
data.md: That person never feels himself stupefied, who when placed in any particular condition, accepts it as that which he was ordained to be placed in.

data.v: पर्यायैर्हन्यमानानामभियोक्ता न विद्यते । दुःखमेतत्तु यद्द्वेष्टा कर्ताहमिति मन्यते ॥
data.md: Men are affected by pleasure and pain that come by turns in Time. There is no personal agency in this matter. In this lies sorrow.

data.v: ऋषींश्च देवांश्च महासुरांश्च; त्रैविद्यवृद्धांश्च वने मुनींश्च । कान्नापदो नोपनमन्ति लोके; परावरज्ञास्तु न संभ्रमन्ति ॥
data.md: Who is there amongst Rishis, gods, great Asuras, persons fully conversant with the three Vedas, and hermits living in the forest, whom calamities do not approach? Those, however, who know well, the Soul and not-Soul never fear calamities.

data.v: न पण्डितः क्रुध्यति नापि सज्जते; न चापि संसीदति न प्रहृष्यति । न चार्थकृच्छ्रव्यसनेषु शोचति; स्थितः प्रकृत्या हिमवानिवाचलः ॥
data.md: The wise person, naturally standing immovable like Himavat, never yields to anger; never allows himself to be addicted to the objects of the senses; never suffers pain in sorrow or rejoices in happiness. When overwhelmed with even great afflictions, such a person never grieves.

data.v: यमर्थसिद्धिः परमा न हर्षये;त्तथैव काले व्यसनं न मोहयेत् । सुखं च दुःखं च तथैव मध्यमं; निषेवते यः स धुरंधरो नरः ॥
data.md: That person is, indeed, a great man whom even great success cannot gladden and even great calamities cannot stupefy, and who bears pleasure and pain, and that which is between them both, with an unaffected mind.

data.v: यां यामवस्थां पुरुषोऽधिगच्छे;त्तस्यां रमेतापरितप्यमानः । एवं प्रवृद्धं प्रणुदेन्मनोजं; संतापमायासकरं शरीरात् ॥
data.md: A person should always be cheerful and not sorry into whatever condition he may fall, thus should a person remove his increasing sorrow which is born in his mind and that is (if not removed) sure to give pain.

data.v: तत्सदः स परिषत्सभासदः; प्राप्य यो न कुरुते सभाभयम् । धर्मतत्त्वमवगाह्य बुद्धिमा;न्योऽभ्युपैति स पुमान्धुरंधरः ॥
data.md: That concourse of learned men engaged in the discussion of the ethics of both the Shrutis and the Smritis is not a good assembly,-indeed, that does not deserve to be called so,-entering which a wicked man is not stricken with fear. That men is the foremost of his sex, who having made a proper enquiry after righteousness acts according to the conclusions to which he arrives.

data.v: प्राज्ञस्य कर्माणि दुरन्वयानि; न वै प्राज्ञो मुह्यति मोहकाले । स्थानाच्च्युतश्चेन्न मुमोह गौतम;स्तावत्कृच्छ्रामापदं प्राप्य वृद्धः ॥
data.md: The acts of a wise man are not easily understood. A wise man is never stupefied when afflictions overtake him. Even if he falls away from his position like Gautama in his old age, on account of the direst calamity, he does not allow himself to be stupefied.

data.v: न मन्त्रबलवीर्येण प्रज्ञया पौरुषेण वा । अलभ्यं लभते मर्त्यस्तत्र का परिदेवना ॥
data.md: Can a person by Mantras, strength, energy, wisdom, prowess, behaviour, conduct, or wealth, acquire that which has not been ordained to be acquired by him? What sorrow then is there if a person cannot acquire that which he seeks at heart.

data.v: यदेवमनुजातस्य धातारो विदधुः पुरा । तदेवानुभविष्यामि किं मे मृत्युः करिष्यति ॥
data.md: Before I was born, the ordainers had ordained that I am to do and suffer. I am fulfilling what was thus ordained for me. What then can death do to me.

data.v: लब्धव्यान्येव लभते गन्तव्यान्येव गच्छति । प्राप्तव्यान्येव प्राप्नोति दुःखानि च सुखानि च ॥
data.md: One gets only what has been ordained. One goes whence he was ordained to go. Those sorrows and joys only are obtained that are ordained so.

data.v: एतद्विदित्वा कार्त्स्न्येन यो न मुह्यति मानवः । कुशलः सुखदुःखेषु स वै सर्वधनेश्वरः ॥
data.md: That man who, knowing this well, does not allow himself to be stupefied, and who is contented with both happiness and misery, is considered as the foremost of his sex.

data.v: मग्नस्य व्यसने कृच्छ्रे किं श्रेयः पुरुषस्य हि । बन्धुनाशे महीपाल राज्यनाशेऽपि वा पुनः ॥
data.md: Yudhisthira said What, indeed, is good for a man who is sunk in dire distress, consequent on the loss of friends or kingdom, O king.

data.v: त्वं हि नः परमो वक्ता लोकेऽस्मिन्भरतर्षभ । एतद्भवन्तं पृच्छामि तन्मे वक्तुमिहार्हसि ॥
data.md: In this world, O foremost of Bharata's race, you are the greatest of our instructors! I ask you this. You should tell me what I ask."

data.v: पुत्रदारैः सुखैश्चैव वियुक्तस्य धनेन च । मग्नस्य व्यसने कृच्छ्रे धृतिः श्रेयस्करी नृप ॥
data.md: 'Fortitude is of the greatest good, O king, for one who has been deprived of sons and wives and pleasures of every sort and wealth, and who has been plunged into dire distress. The body is never emaciated of one who is always endued with fortitude.

data.v: धैर्येण युक्तस्य सतः शरीरं न विशीर्यते । आरोग्याच्च शरीरस्य स पुनर्विन्दते श्रियम् ॥
यस्य राज्ञो नरास्तात सात्त्विकीं वृत्तिमास्थिताः । तस्य स्थैर्यं च धैर्यं च व्यवसायश्च कर्मसु ॥
data.md: That wise man, O sire, who always follows righteous conduct succeeds in acquiring prosperity, patience, and perseverance in the accomplishment of all his objects.

data.v: अत्रैवोदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् । बलिवासवसंवादं पुनरेव युधिष्ठिर ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Regarding it, О Yudhisthira, is cited the old discourse between Prahlada and Indra.

data.v: वृत्ते देवासुरे युद्धे दैत्यदानवसंक्षये । विष्णुक्रान्तेषु लोकेषु देवराजे शतक्रतौ ॥
data.md: After the battle between the gods and the demons in which a large number of Daityas and Danavas fell, had come to a close, Vali became king. He was deceived by Vishnu who once more established his supremacy over all the worlds. The god of a hundred sacrifices was once more invested with the sovereignty of the celestials.

data.v: इज्यमानेषु देवेषु चातुर्वर्ण्ये व्यवस्थिते । समृध्यमाने त्रैलोक्ये प्रीतियुक्ते स्वयंभुवि ॥
data.md: After the celestial adininistration had thus been re-established, and the four orders of men had been re-established in performance of their respective duties, the three worlds once inore swelled with prosperty, and the Self-create . became glad of heart.

data.v: रुद्रैर्वसुभिरादित्यैरश्विभ्यामपि चर्षिभिः । गन्धर्वैर्भुजगेन्द्रैश्च सिद्धैश्चान्यैर्वृतः प्रभुः ॥
data.md: At that time, accompanied by the Rudras, the Vasus, the Adityas, the Ashvins, the celestial Rishis, the Gandharvas, the Siddhas, and other superior orders of beings, the powerful Shakra seated on his four-tusked prince of elephants, called Airavata, marched through all the worlds.

data.v: चतुर्दन्तं सुदान्तं च वारणेन्द्रं श्रिया वृतम् । आरुह्यैरावतं शक्रस्त्रैलोक्यमनुसंययौ ॥
data.md: At that time, accompanied by the Rudras, the Vasus, the Adityas, the Ashvins, the celestial Rishis, the Gandharvas, the Siddhas, and other superior orders of beings, the powerful Shakra seated on his four-tusked prince of elephants, called Airavata, marched through all the worlds.

data.v: स कदाचित्समुद्रान्ते कस्मिंश्चिद्गिरिगह्वरे । बलिं वैरोचनिं वज्री ददर्शोपससर्प च ॥
data.md: One day, while thus engaged, the holder of the thunderbolt was Virochana's son Vali within a certain mountain cave on the seashore. Seeing the king of Danavas, he came near him.

data.v: तमैरावतमूर्धस्थं प्रेक्ष्य देवगणैर्वृतम् । सुरेन्द्रमिन्द्रं दैत्येन्द्रो न शुशोच न विव्यथे ॥
data.md: Seeing the king of gods, viz., Indra, thus seated on the back of Airavata and surrounded by the several orders of the celestials, the king of the Daityas displayed no signs of sorrow or agitation.

data.v: दृष्ट्वा तमविकारस्थं तिष्ठन्तं निर्भयं बलिम् । अधिरूढो द्विपश्रेष्ठमित्युवाच शतक्रतुः ॥
data.md: Seeing Vali unmoved and fearless, Indra also addressed him from the back of his king of elephants, saying,-

data.v: दैत्य न व्यथसे शौर्यादथ वा वृद्धसेवया । तपसा भावितत्वाद्वा सर्वथैतत्सुदुष्करम् ॥
data.md: How is it, O Daitya, that you are so unmoved? Is it owning to your heroism or to your having waited reverentially upon elders? Is it owning to your mind having been purified by penances? To whatever cause it may be due, this mood of mind is surely very difficult to attain.

data.v: शत्रुभिर्वशमानीतो हीनः स्थानादनुत्तमात् । वैरोचने किमाश्रित्य शोचितव्ये न शोचसि ॥
data.md: Hurled from the highest position, you are now shorn of all your possessions and have been brought under the sway of your enemies. O Virochana's son what is that by adopting which you to do not grieve although it is time for grief.

data.v: श्रैष्ठ्यं प्राप्य स्वजातीनां भुक्त्वा भोगाननुत्तमान् । हृतस्वबलराज्यस्त्वं ब्रूहि कस्मान्न शोचसि ॥
data.md: Formerly, when you were the king of your own order, you enjoyed matchless pleasures. Now, however, you are shorn of your riches and jewels and sovereignty. Tell us why you arc so unmoved.

data.v: ईश्वरो हि पुरा भूत्वा पितृपैतामहे पदे । तत्त्वमद्य हृतं दृष्ट्वा सपत्नैः किं न शोचसि ॥
data.md: You were ere this a god, seated on the throne of your father and grandfathers. Finding yourself deprived to-day by your enemies, why do you not grieve?

data.v: बद्धश्च वारुणैः पाशैर्वज्रेण च समाहतः । हृतदारो हृतधनो ब्रूहि कस्मान्न शोचसि ॥
data.md: You are fettered with Varuna's noose and has been struck with my thunderbolt. Your wives and riches have been taken away. Tell us why you do not grieve.

data.v: भ्रष्टश्रीर्विभवभ्रष्टो यन्न शोचसि दुष्करम् । त्रैलोक्यराज्यनाशे हि कोऽन्यो जीवितुमुत्सहेत् ॥
data.md: Shorn of prosperity and fallen away from affluence, you do not gricve. This indeed, is something very remarkable. Who else, O Vali, then one like you, could dare lives thus after being shorn of the sovereignty of the three worlds?

data.v: एतच्चान्यच्च परुषं ब्रुवन्तं परिभूय तम् । श्रुत्वा सुखमसंभ्रान्तो बलिर्वैरोचनोऽब्रवीत् ॥
data.md: Hearing without any pain these and other cutting words that Indra said asserting the while his own superiority over him. Vali the son of Virochana fearlessly answered him thus.

data.v: निगृहीते मयि भृशं शक्र किं कत्थितेन ते । वज्रमुद्यम्य तिष्ठन्तं पश्यामि त्वां पुरंदर ॥
data.md: When calamities have assailed me, O Shakra, what do you gain by such brag now? To-day I see you, O Purandara stand before me with the thunder-bolt upraised in your hand.

data.v: अशक्तः पूर्वमासीस्त्वं कथंचिच्छक्ततां गतः । कस्त्वदन्य इमा वाचः सुक्रूरा वक्तुमर्हति ॥
data.md: Formerly, however, you could not behave so. Now you have somehow gained that power. Indeed, who else save you could give vent to such cruel words?

data.v: यस्तु शत्रोर्वशस्थस्य शक्तोऽपि कुरुते दयाम् । हस्तप्राप्तस्य वीरस्य तं चैव पुरुषं विदुः ॥
data.md: That person who, though able to punish, shows mercy towards a heroic enemies, defeated and brought under his control, is indeed a great man.

data.v: अनिश्चयो हि युद्धेषु द्वयोर्विवदमानयोः । एकः प्राप्नोति विजयमेकश्चैव पराभवम् ॥
data.md: When two persons fight, victory is indeed doubtful. One of the two surely becomes victorious, and the other is defeated.

data.v: मा च ते भूत्स्वभावोऽयं मया दैवतपुंगव । ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां विक्रमेण जितो बलात् ॥
data.md: O king of gods, let not your nature be so. Do not think that you have become the king of all creatures after having defeated all with your might and prowess.

data.v: नैतदस्मत्कृतं शक्र नैतच्छक्र त्वया कृतम् । यत्त्वमेवंगतो वज्रिन्यद्वाप्येवंगता वयम् ॥
data.md: That we have now become so is not owing to any act of ours, O Shakra. That you are now so is not owing, O holder of the thunderbolt, to any act of yours?

data.v: अहमासं यथाद्य त्वं भविता त्वं यथा वयम् । मावमंस्था मया कर्म दुष्कृतं कृतमित्युत ॥
data.md: What I am now you will be in time. Do not disregard me, thinking that you have performed a highly difficult feat.

data.v: सुखदुःखे हि पुरुषः पर्यायेणाधिगच्छति । पर्यायेणासि शक्रत्वं प्राप्तः शक्र न कर्मणा ॥
data.md: A person gets happiness and misery one after another in course of Time. You have, O Shakra, gained sovereignty of the universe in courses of Time but not by virtue of any particular merit in you.

data.v: कालः काले नयति मां त्वां च कालो नयत्ययम् । तेनाहं त्वं यथा नाद्य त्वं चापि न यथा वयम् ॥
data.md: It is Time that leads me on in his course. That same time leads you also onward. It is, therefore, that I am not what you are to-day, and you also are not what we are.

data.v: न मातृपितृशुश्रूषा न च दैवतपूजनम् । नान्यो गुणसमाचारः पुरुषस्य सुखावहः ॥
data.md: Dutiful services to parents, respectful adoration of deities, due practice of any good quality,-none of these can confer happiness on any one.

data.v: न विद्या न तपो दानं न मित्राणि न बान्धवाः । शक्नुवन्ति परित्रातुं नरं कालेन पीडितम् ॥
data.md: Neither knowledge nor penances, nor gifts, nor friends, nor kinsmen, can save one who is afflicted by Time.

data.v: नागामिनमनर्थं हि प्रतिघातशतैरपि । शक्नुवन्ति प्रतिव्योढुमृते बुद्धिबलान्नराः ॥
data.md: Even by a thousand means, men cannot avert an impending danger. Intelligence and strength are useless in such cases.

data.v: पर्यायैर्हन्यमानानां परित्राता न विद्यते । इदं तु दुःखं यच्छक्र कर्ताहमिति मन्यते ॥
data.md: Men are affected by pleasure and pain that come by turns in Time. There is no personal agency in this matter. In this lies sorrow.

data.v: यदि कर्ता भवेत्कर्ता न क्रियेत कदाचन । यस्मात्तु क्रियते कर्ता तस्मात्कर्ताप्यनीश्वरः ॥
data.md: If the seeming performner of an act is the real actor thereof, that doer then would not himself be the creation of some one else (viz., the God). Therefore, because the seeming doer is himself the creation of another, that another is the Supreme Being superior to whom there is nothing else.

data.v: कालेन त्वाहमजयं कालेनाहं जितस्त्वया । गन्ता गतिमतां कालः कालः कलयति प्रजाः ॥
data.md: Helped by Time I had defeated you. Helped by time you have defeated me. It is Time which moves all beings.

data.v: इन्द्र प्राकृतया बुद्ध्या प्रलपन्नावबुध्यसे । केचित्त्वां बहु मन्यन्ते श्रैष्ठ्यं प्राप्तं स्वकर्मणा ॥
data.md: O Indra, because your intelligence is very mean you do not see that destruction awaits all things! Some, indeed, respect you as one who has acquired by his own acts the sovereignty of the universe.

data.v: कथमस्मद्विधो नाम जानँल्लोकप्रवृत्तयः । कालेनाभ्याहतः शोचेन्मुह्येद्वाप्यर्थसंभ्रमे ॥
data.md: But, how can one like us who know the course of the world, grieve for having been afflicted by Time, or allow our understanding to be stupefied, or give way to the influence of error?

data.v: नित्यं कालपरीतस्य मम वा मद्विधस्य वा । बुद्धिर्व्यसनमासाद्य भिन्ना नौरिव सीदति ॥
data.md: Even when we are possessed by Time, coming in contact with a calamity, shall my understanding or that of one like me allow itself to be destroyed like a wrecked vessel at sea.

data.v: अहं च त्वं च ये चान्ये भविष्यन्ति सुराधिपाः । ते सर्वे शक्र यास्यन्ति मार्गमिन्द्रशतैर्गतम् ॥
data.md: Myself, yourself, and all those who will in future become the kings of the deities, shall have, O Shakra, to follow the way along which hundreds of Indras have gone before you.

data.v: त्वामप्येवं सुदुर्धर्षं ज्वलन्तं परया श्रिया । काले परिणते कालः कालयिष्यति मामिव ॥
data.md: When your hour will be full, Time will surely destroy you like me,-who are now so invincible and who now shine with matchless splendour.

data.v: बहूनीन्द्रसहस्राणि दैतेयानां युगे युगे । अभ्यतीतानि कालेन कालो हि दुरतिक्रमः ॥
data.md: In time's course many thousands of Indras and of gods have been swept off cycle after cycle. Time, Indeed, is irresistible.

data.v: इदं तु लब्ध्वा त्वं स्थानमात्मानं बहु मन्यसे । सर्वभूतभवं देवं ब्रह्माणमिव शाश्वतम् ॥
data.md: Having secured your present position, you think too much of yourself, even as the Creator of all beings, the divine and eternal Brahman.

data.v: न चेदमचलं स्थानमनन्तं वापि कस्यचित् । त्वं तु बालिशया बुद्ध्या ममेदमिति मन्यसे ॥
data.md: Having secured your present position of yours. With none did it last for ever. On account of a foolish understanding, you consider it immutable and eternal.

data.v: अविश्वास्ये विश्वसिषि मन्यसे चाध्रुवं ध्रुवम् । ममेयमिति मोहात्त्वं राजश्रियमभीप्ससि ॥
data.md: You trust in that which is not worthy of trust. You consider that to be eternal which is not eternal. O king of the gods, one who is possessed and stupefied by Time really considers himself thus.

data.v: नेयं तव न चास्माकं न चान्येषां स्थिरा मता । अतिक्रम्य बहूनन्यांस्त्वयि तावदियं स्थिता ॥
कंचित्कालमियं स्थित्वा त्वयि वासव चञ्चला । गौर्निपानमिवोत्सृज्य पुनरन्यं गमिष्यति ॥
data.md: It had belonged to numberless persons before you. Passing over them it has now become yours. It will say with you, O Vasava, for sometime and then prove its fickleness. Like a cow leaving one drinking ditch for another, it will surely leave you for somebody else.

data.v: राजलोका ह्यतिक्रान्ता यान्न संख्यातुमुत्सहे । त्वत्तो बहुतराश्चान्ये भविष्यन्ति पुरंदर ॥
data.md: So many kings have gone before you that I venture not to calculate them. In the future also, O Purandara, numberless sovereigns will rise after you.

data.v: सवृक्षौषधिरत्नेयं ससरित्पर्वताकरा । तानिदानीं न पश्यामि यैर्भुक्तेयं पुरा मही ॥
data.md: I do not see those kings now that had formerly enjoyed this Earth with her trees, plants, gems, living creatures, waters and mines.

data.v: पृथुरैलो मयो भौमो नरकः शम्बरस्तथा । अश्वग्रीवः पुलोमा च स्वर्भानुरमितध्वजः ॥
प्रह्रादो नमुचिर्दक्षो विप्रचित्तिर्विरोचनः । ह्रीनिषेधः सुहोत्रश्च भूरिहा पुष्पवान्वृषः ॥
सत्येषुरृषभो राहुः कपिलाश्वो विरूपकः । बाणः कार्तस्वरो वह्निर्विश्वदंष्ट्रोऽथ नैरृतः ॥
रित्थाहुत्थौ वीरताम्रौ वराहाश्वो रुचिः प्रभुः । विश्वजित्प्रतिशौरिश्च वृषाण्डो विष्करो मधुः ॥
हिरण्यकशिपुश्चैव कैटभश्चैव दानवः । दैत्याश्च कालखञ्जाश्च सर्वे ते नैरृतैः सह ॥
एते चान्ये च बहवः पूर्वे पूर्वतराश्च ये । दैत्येन्द्रा दानवेन्द्राश्च यांश्चान्याननुशुश्रुम ॥
बहवः पूर्वदैत्येन्द्राः संत्यज्य पृथिवीं गताः । कालेनाभ्याहताः सर्वे कालो हि बलवत्तरः ॥
सर्वैः क्रतुशतैरिष्टं न त्वमेकः शतक्रतुः । सर्वे धर्मपराश्चासन्सर्वे सततसत्रिणः ॥
data.md: All of them had adored the Creator in hundreds of sacrifices. You are not the only person that has done so. All of them were given to righteousness and all of them always celebrated great sacrifices.

data.v: अन्तरिक्षचराः सर्वे सर्वेऽभिमुखयोधिनः । सर्वे संहननोपेताः सर्वे परिघबाहवः ॥
data.md: All of them were capable of passing through the welkin and all were heroes that never retreated from the battle field. All of them had very strong bodies and all had arms resembling heavy bludgeons.

data.v: सर्वे मायाशतधराः सर्वे ते कामचारिणः । सर्वे समरमासाद्य न श्रूयन्ते पराजिताः ॥
data.md: All of them were adepts in hundreds of illusions, and all could assume any form they liked. We have never heard that having undertaken a battle any of them had ever met with defeat.

data.v: सर्वे सत्यव्रतपराः सर्वे कामविहारिणः । सर्वे वेदव्रतपराः सर्वे चासन्बहुश्रुताः ॥
data.md: All observed the vow of truth, and all of them sported as they wished. Devoted to the Vedas and Vedic rites, all of them were endued with great learning.

data.v: सर्वे संहतमैश्वर्यमीश्वराः प्रतिपेदिरे । न चैश्वर्यमदस्तेषां भूतपूर्वो महात्मनाम् ॥
data.md: Endued with great might, all of them had gained the highest prosperity and affluence. But none of those great kings lead the pride of sovereignty.

data.v: सर्वे यथार्थदातारः सर्वे विगतमत्सराः । सर्वे सर्वेषु भूतेषु यथावत्प्रतिपेदिरे ॥
data.md: All of them were liberal giving to each what each deserved. All of them behaved properly and duly by all creatures.

data.v: सर्वे दाक्षायणीपुत्राः प्राजापत्या महाबलाः । ज्वलन्तः प्रतपन्तश्च कालेन प्रतिसंहृताः ॥
data.md: All of them were the offspring of Daksha's daughters. Gifted with great strength, all were lords of the creation. Burning all things with their energy, all of them shone greatly. Yet all of them were carried away by Time.

data.v: त्वं चैवेमां यदा भुक्त्वा पृथिवीं त्यक्ष्यसे पुनः । न शक्ष्यसि तदा शक्र नियन्तुं शोकमात्मनः ॥
data.md: As regards you. ( Shakra, it is clear that when you shall have, after enjoying the Earth, to leave her you will not be able to control your grief.

data.v: मुञ्चेच्छां कामभोगेषु मुञ्चेमं श्रीभवं मदम् । एवं स्वराज्यनाशे त्वं शोकं संप्रसहिष्यसि ॥
data.md: Relinquish this desire for objects of affection and enjoyment. Relinquish this pride begotten by prosperity. If you act thus, you will then be able to bear the grief consequent on the loss of sovereignty.

data.v: शोककाले शुचो मा त्वं हर्षकाले च मा हृषः । अतीतानागते हित्वा प्रत्युत्पन्नेन वर्तय ॥
data.md: When the hour of sorrow comes, do not give way to it. Likewise, when the hour of joy comes, do not rejoice. Not thinking of both the past and the future, live contentedly with the present.

data.v: मां चेदभ्यागतः कालः सदायुक्तमतन्द्रितम् । क्षमस्व नचिरादिन्द्र त्वामप्युपगमिष्यति ॥
data.md: When Time that never sleeps came upon me that had always been mindful of my duties, bend you heart to the ways of peace, O Indra, for that same Time will very soon meet you.

data.v: त्रासयन्निव देवेन्द्र वाग्भिस्तक्षसि मामिह । संयते मयि नूनं त्वमात्मानं बहु मन्यसे ॥
data.md: You cut me to the quick with your words, and you seem deterinined to terrorise me. Indeed, finding me calm, you think very highly of you.

data.v: कालः प्रथममायान्मां पश्चात्त्वामनुधावति । तेन गर्जसि देवेन्द्र पूर्वं कालहते मयि ॥
data.md: Time had first attacked me. It is even now behind you. I was at first defeated by Time. It was therefore that you did afterwards succeed in defeating me for which you are bragging thus.

data.v: को हि स्थातुमलं लोके क्रुद्धस्य मम संयुगे । कालस्तु बलवान्प्राप्तस्तेन तिष्ठसि वासव ॥
data.md: Formerly, when I used to become angry, what person was there on Earth who could stand before me in battle? Time however, is stronger. He has overwhelmed me. It is therefore, O Vasava, that you are able to stand before me. Those thousand celestial years, over which your reign extends will surely come to an end.

data.v: यत्तद्वर्षसहस्रान्तं पूर्णं भवितुमर्हति । यथा मे सर्वगात्राणि नस्वस्थानि हतौजसः ॥
अहमैन्द्रच्च्युतः स्थानात्त्वमिन्द्रः प्रकृतो दिवि । सुचित्रे जीवलोकेऽस्मिन्नुपास्यः कालपर्ययात् ॥
data.md: You will then fall and your limbs will become as miserable as mine now even though I am endued with great energy. I have fallen away from the high place that is occupied by the king of the three worlds. You are not the real Indra in heaven.

data.v: किं हि कृत्वा त्वमिन्द्रोऽद्य किं हि कृत्वा च्युता वयम् । कालः कर्ता विकर्ता च सर्वमन्यदकारणम् ॥
नाशं विनाशमैश्वर्यं सुखदुःखे भवाभवौ । विद्वान्प्राप्यैवमत्यर्थं न प्रहृष्येन्न च व्यथेत् ॥
त्वमेव हीन्द्र वेत्थास्मान्वेदाहं त्वां च वासव । विकत्थसे मां किं बद्धं कालेन निरपत्रप ॥
त्वमेव हि पुरा वेत्थ यत्तदा पौरुषं मम । समरेषु च विक्रान्तं पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम् ॥
आदित्याश्चैव रुद्राश्च साध्याश्च वसुभिः सह । मया विनिर्जिताः सर्वे मरुतश्च शचीपते ॥
त्वमेव शक्र जानासि देवासुरसमागमे । समेता विबुधा भग्नास्तरसा समरे मया ॥
पर्वताश्चासकृत्क्षिप्ताः सवनाः सवनौकसः । सटङ्कशिखरा घोराः समरे मूर्ध्नि ते मया ॥
किं नु शक्यं मया कर्तुं यत्कालो दुरतिक्रमः । न हि त्वां नोत्सहे हन्तुं सवज्रमपि मुष्टिना ॥
न तु विक्रमकालोऽयं क्षमाकालोऽयमागतः । तेन त्वा मर्षये शक्र दुर्मर्षणतरस्त्वया ॥
त्वं मा परिणते काले परीतं कालवह्निना । नियतं कालपाशेन बद्धं शक्र विकत्थसे ॥
अयं स पुरुषः श्यामो लोकस्य दुरतिक्रमः । बद्ध्वा तिष्ठति मां रौद्रः पशुं रशनया यथा ॥
data.md: There stands that dark individual who cannot be resisted by the world. There he of fierce form; stands, having bound me like an inferior animal bound with ropes.

data.v: लाभालाभौ सुखं दुःखं कामक्रोधौ भवाभवौ । वधो बन्धः प्रमोक्षश्च सर्वं कालेन लभ्यते ॥
data.md: Gain and loss, happiness and misery, lust and anger, birth and death, captivity and release,-these all one meets in Time's course.

data.v: नाहं कर्ता न कर्ता त्वं कर्ता यस्तु सदा प्रभुः । सोऽयं पचति कालो मां वृक्षे फलमिवागतम् ॥
data.md: I am not the actor. You are not the actor, He is the actor who is omnipotent. Time ripens me like a fruit that is on a tree.

data.v: यान्येव पुरुषः कुर्वन्सुखैः कालेन युज्यते । पुनस्तान्येव कुर्वाणो दुःखैः कालेन युज्यते ॥
data.md: There are certain acts by doing which one person enjoys happiness in Time's course. By doing those very acts another reaps misery in the course of Time.

data.v: न च कालेन कालज्ञः स्पृष्टः शोचितुमर्हति । तेन शक्र न शोचामि नास्ति शोके सहायता ॥
data.md: Conversant as I am with the virtues of Time, I should not grieve when it is Time that has attacked me. It is therefore, O Shakra, that I do not grieve. Grief can do us no good. The grief of one that indulges in grief never dissipates his calamity. On the other hand, grief destroys his power. It is therefore that I do not grieve.

data.v: यदा हि शोचतां शोको व्यसनं नापकर्षति । सामर्थ्यं शोचतो नास्ति नाद्य शोचाम्यहं ततः ॥
एवमुक्तः सहस्राक्षो भगवान्पाकशासनः । प्रतिसंहृत्य संरम्भमित्युवाच शतक्रतुः ॥
data.md: Thus addressed by the kings of the Daityas, the god of a hundred sacrifices, viz., the powerful and thousand-eyed chastiser of Paka, checked his anger and said these words.'

data.v: सवज्रमुद्यतं बाहुं दृष्ट्वा पाशांश्च वारुणान् । कस्येह न व्यथेद्बुद्धिर्मृत्योरपि जिघांसतः ॥
data.md: Shakra said Seeing this upraised arm of mine, equipt with the thunderbolt, and those nooses of Varuna, who is there whose understanding is not moved, including the very Destroyer himself who brings about the death of all beings.

data.v: सा ते न व्यथते बुद्धिरचला तत्त्वदर्शिनी । ब्रुवन्न व्यथसे स त्वं वाक्यं सत्यपराक्रम ॥
data.md: Your understanding, however, so firm and so endued with visions of the truth has not been moved. 0 you of invincible prowess, verily you are unmoved to-day on account of your fortitude.

data.v: को हि विश्वासमर्थेषु शरीरे वा शरीरभृत् । कर्तुमुत्सहते लोके दृष्ट्वा संप्रस्थितं जगत् ॥
data.md: Seeing all things in this universe as transient, who is there in it, endued with body, that would venture to place confidence on either his body or all the objects of his desire?

data.v: अहमप्येवमेवैनं लोकं जानाम्यशाश्वतम् । कालाग्नावाहितं घोरे गुह्ये सततगेऽक्षरे ॥
data.md: Like yourself I also know that this universe is not eternal, and that it has been thrown into Time's fire that is dreadful though hidden from the view, that is perpetually burning, and that is indeed endless.

data.v: न चात्र परिहारोऽस्ति कालस्पृष्टस्य कस्यचित् । सूक्ष्माणां महतां चैव भूतानां परिपच्यताम् ॥
data.md: Every one is attacked here by Time. Nothing among subtile or gross beings can escape from Time's away. All things are being cooked in Time's pot.

data.v: अनीशस्याप्रमत्तस्य भूतानि पचतः सदा । अनिवृत्तस्य कालस्य क्षयं प्राप्तो न मुच्यते ॥
data.md: Time has no master. Time is ever vigilant. Time is always coO king every thing within itself. No one who has once entered the kingdom of Time which is perpetually going on, can escape therefrom.

data.v: अप्रमत्तः प्रमत्तेषु कालो जागर्ति देहिषु । प्रयत्नेनाप्यतिक्रान्तो दृष्टपूर्वो न केनचित् ॥
data.md: All embodied beings may be careless of Time, but Time is careful and is wide awake behind them. No one has ever been seen to have driven off Time from him.

data.v: पुराणः शाश्वतो धर्मः सर्वप्राणभृतां समः । कालो न परिहार्यश्च न चास्यास्ति व्यतिक्रमः ॥
data.md: Ancient eternal and the embodiment of Justice, Time is always equal about all living creatures. Time cannot be shunned and there is no retrogression in its course.

data.v: अहोरात्रांश्च मासांश्च क्षणान्काष्ठाः कला लवान् । संपिण्डयति नः कालो वृद्धिं वार्धुषिको यथा ॥
data.md: Like a usurer summing up his interest, Time sums up its subtile portions represented by Kalas, lavas, Kashthas, Kshanas, months, and days and nights.

data.v: इदमद्य करिष्यामि श्वः कर्तास्मीति वादिनम् । कालो हरति संप्राप्तो नदीवेग इवोडुपम् ॥
data.md: Like the current of river washing away a tree whose roots it can get at time, approaching him who says,-This I will do to-day but this I will do tomorrow-sweeps him always.'

data.v: इदानीं तावदेवासौ मया दृष्टः कथं मृतः । इति कालेन ह्रियतां प्रलापः श्रूयते नृणाम् ॥
data.md: Time carries away one and men say-I saw him a little while before How has he died?'

data.v: नश्यन्त्यर्थास्तथा भोगाः स्थानमैश्वर्यमेव च । अनित्यमध्रुवं सर्वं व्यवसायो हि दुष्करः । उच्छ्राया विनिपातान्ता भावोऽभावस्थ एव च ॥
सा ते न व्यथते बुद्धिरचला तत्त्वदर्शिनी । अहमासं पुरा चेति मनसापि न बुध्यसे ॥
data.md: Your understanding, firm and endued with true vision, is unmoved. You do not, even in your mind realise what you were sometime before.

data.v: कालेनाक्रम्य लोकेऽस्मिन्पच्यमाने बलीयसा । अज्येष्ठमकनिष्ठं च क्षिप्यमाणो न बुध्यसे ॥
data.md: Attacking the universe, powerful Time cooks it within itself and sweeps away every thing without caring for age or otherwise. Therefore, one who is being dragged by Time is unconscious of the noose put round one's neck.

data.v: ईर्ष्याभिमानलोभेषु कामक्रोधभयेषु च । स्पृहामोहाभिमानेषु लोकः सक्तो विमुह्यति ॥
data.md: to People, wedded jealousy, vanity, cupidity, lust, anger, fear, desire, carelessness, and pride, allow themselves to be stupefied.

data.v: भवांस्तु भावतत्त्वज्ञो विद्वाञ्ज्ञानतपोन्वितः । कालं पश्यति सुव्यक्तं पाणावामलकं यथा ॥
data.md: You, however, know the truth of existence. You are learned and endued with wisdom and penance. You sec Time as clearly like an embolic myrobalan on the palm of your hand.

data.v: कालचारित्रतत्त्वज्ञः सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः । वैरोचने कृतात्मासि स्पृहणीयो विजानताम् ॥
data.md: O son of Virochana, you know full well Time's conduct! You are well versed in all branches of knowledge. You are of purified Soul and a perfect master of your passions. You are a favourite of all wise persons.

data.v: सर्वलोको ह्ययं मन्ये बुद्ध्या परिगतस्त्वया । विहरन्सर्वतोमुक्तो न क्वचित्परिषज्जसे ॥
data.md: With your understanding you have full understood the entire universe. Though you have enjoyed every sort of happiness, you were never attached to anything, and hence you have not been sullied by anything.

data.v: रजश्च हि तमश्च त्वा स्पृशतो न जितेन्द्रियम् । निष्प्रीतिं नष्टसंतापं त्वमात्मानमुपाससे ॥
data.md: The qualities of Darkness and Ignorance do not soil you, for you have conquered your senses. You wait only upon your soul which is divested of both joy and sorrow.

data.v: सुहृदं सर्वभूतानां निर्वैरं शान्तमानसम् । दृष्ट्वा त्वां मम संजाता त्वय्यनुक्रोशिनी मतिः ॥
data.md: I feel mercy for you, because you are the friend of all creatures, without animosity, and your heart being full of tranquillity.

data.v: नाहमेतादृशं बुद्धं हन्तुमिच्छामि बन्धने । आनृशंस्यं परो धर्मो अनुक्रोशस्तथा त्वयि ॥
data.md: I do not wish to afflict an enlightened person like you by keeping him in chains. Abstention from injury is the greatest religion. I feel mercy for you.

data.v: मोक्ष्यन्ते वारुणाः पाशास्तवेमे कालपर्ययात् । प्रजानामपचारेण स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु महासुर ॥
data.md: Those nooses of Varuna, with which you have been fettered, will loosen in Time's course on account of the misconduct of inen. Blessed be you, O great Asura.

data.v: यदा श्वश्रूं स्नुषा वृद्धां परिचारेण योक्ष्यते । पुत्रश्च पितरं मोहात्प्रेषयिष्यति कर्मसु ॥
ब्राह्मणैः कारयिष्यन्ति वृषलाः पादधावनम् । शूद्राश्च ब्राह्मणीं भार्यामुपयास्यन्ति निर्भयाः ॥
वियोनिषु च बीजानि मोक्ष्यन्ते पुरुषा यदा । संकरं कांस्यभाण्डैश्च बलिं चापि कुपात्रकैः ॥
चातुर्वर्ण्यं यदा कृत्स्नमुन्मर्यादं भविष्यति । एकैकस्ते तदा पाशः क्रमशः प्रतिमोक्ष्यते ॥
अस्मत्तस्ते भयं नास्ति समयं प्रतिपालय । सुखी भव निराबाधः स्वस्थचेता निरामयः ॥
data.md: You have no fear from us. Wait quietly. Be happy, Be shorn of all sorrow. Let your heart be cheerful. May you not suffer from illness.

data.v: तमेवमुक्त्वा भगवाञ्शतक्रतुः; प्रतिप्रयातो गजराजवाहनः । विजित्य सर्वानसुरान्सुराधिपो; ननन्द हर्षेण बभूव चैकराट् ॥
data.md: Having said these words to him, the divine Indra, having the prince of elephants for his vehicle, left that place. Having defeated all the Asuras, the king of the gods rejoiced greatly and became the sole master of all the worlds.

data.v: महर्षयस्तुष्टुवुरञ्जसा च तं; वृषाकपिं सर्वचराचरेश्वरम् । हिमापहो हव्यमुदावहंस्त्वरं;स्तथामृतं चार्पितमीश्वराय ह ॥
data.md: The great Rishis lauded that lord of all mobile and immobile creatures. The Fire-God Once more began to carry the libations of clarified butter that were poured into his visible form, and the great god took charge of the nectar that was placed to his care.

data.v: द्विजोत्तमैः सर्वगतैरभिष्टुतो; विदीप्ततेजा गतमन्युरीश्वरः । प्रशान्तचेता मुदितः स्वमालयं; त्रिविष्टपं प्राप्य मुमोद वासवः ॥
data.md: Lauded by the foremost of Brahmanas engaged in sacrifices, the lord Indra, shining with effulgence, his anger quelled and his heart tranquillised, became glad, and returning to his own abode in heaven, began to pass his days in great happiness.

data.v: पूर्वरूपाणि मे राजन्पुरुषस्य भविष्यतः । पराभविष्यतश्चैव त्वं मे ब्रूहि पितामह ॥
data.md: Yudhisthira said Tell me, O grandfather, the marks of future greatness and future degeneration of a person.

data.v: मन एव मनुष्यस्य पूर्वरूपाणि शंसति । भविष्यतश्च भद्रं ते तथैव नभविष्यतः ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Blessings to you, the mind itself indicates the symptoms of one's future prosperity and future fall.

data.v: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् । श्रिया शक्रस्य संवादं तन्निबोध युधिष्ठिर ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Regarding it, О Yudhisthira, is cited the old discourse between Prahlada and Indra.

data.v: महतस्तपसो व्युष्ट्या पश्यँल्लोकौ परावरौ । सामान्यमृषिभिर्गत्वा ब्रह्मलोकनिवासिभिः ॥
data.md: The great and energetic ascetic Narada, whose effulgence is as immeasurable as Brahma itself, with sins all dissipated, capable of seeing through the power of his penances both this and the other world at once, and the equal of the celestial Rishis living in the region of the Creator, roamed at his pleasure through the three worlds.

data.v: ब्रह्मैवामितदीप्तौजाः शान्तपाप्मा महातपाः । विचचार यथाकामं त्रिषु लोकेषु नारदः ॥
data.md: The great and energetic ascetic Narada, whose effulgence is as immeasurable as Brahma itself, with sins all dissipated, capable of seeing through the power of his penances both this and the other world at once, and the equal of the celestial Rishis living in the region of the Creator, roamed at his pleasure through the three worlds.

data.v: कदाचित्प्रातरुत्थाय पिस्पृक्षुः सलिलं शुचि । ध्रुवद्वारभवां गङ्गां जगामावततार च ॥
data.md: One day, rising up early in the morning, he wished to perform his ablutions and for that purpose went to the river Ganga as the issued out of the pass called Dhruva, and plunged into the stream.

data.v: सहस्रनयनश्चापि वज्री शम्बरपाकहा । तस्या देवर्षिजुष्टायास्तीरमभ्याजगाम ह ॥
data.md: At that time the thousand-eyed Indra also, the holder of the thunder-bolt, and the destroyer of Shamvara and Paka, came to the very shore where Narada was.

data.v: तावाप्लुत्य यतात्मानौ कृतजप्यौ समासतुः । नद्याः पुलिनमासाद्य सूक्ष्मकाञ्चनवालुकम् ॥
data.md: The Rishi and the god, both of whom had perfectly controlled their minds, finished their ablutions, and having completed their silent recitations, sat together.

data.v: पुण्यकर्मभिराख्याता देवर्षिकथिताः कथाः । चक्रतुस्तौ कथाशीलौ शुचिसंहृष्टमानसौ । पूर्ववृत्तव्यपेतानि कथयन्तौ समाहितौ ॥
data.md: They spent the hour in reciting and listening to the excellent narratives told by the great celestial Rishis describing many good and high deeds. Indeed, with rapt attention the two were engaged in such lively discourse on ancient history.

data.v: अथ भास्करमुद्यन्तं रश्मिजालपुरस्कृतम् । पूर्णमण्डलमालोक्य तावुत्थायोपतस्थतुः ॥
data.md: While sitting there they saw the rising Sun casting his thousand rays right before him. Seeing the full orb, both of them stood up and lauded him.

data.v: अभितस्तूदयन्तं तमर्कमर्कमिवापरम् । आकाशे ददृशे ज्योतिरुद्यतार्चिःसमप्रभम् ॥
data.md: Just at that time they saw in the sky, in a direction opposite to that of the rising star of day, some luminous object, resplendent as burning fire which seemed to be a second star of day. And they saw, O Bharata, that that luminous object was gradually approaching them both.

data.v: तयोः समीपं संप्राप्तं प्रत्यदृश्यत भारत । तत्सुपर्णार्कचरितमास्थितं वैष्णवं पदम् । भाभिरप्रतिमं भाति त्रैलोक्यमवभासयत् ॥
data.md: Riding upon Vishnu's vehicle adorned with Garuda and Surya himself, that object shone forth with matchless splendour and seemed to the three worlds.

data.v: दिव्याभिरूपशोभाभिरप्सरोभिः पुरस्कृताम् । बृहतीमंशुमत्प्रख्यां बृहद्भानोरिवार्चिषम् ॥
data.md: The object they beheld was none other than Shree herself, attended by many Apsaras gifted with splendid beauty. Indeed, she looked like a large solar discherself, effulgent like fire.

data.v: नक्षत्रकल्पाभरणां ताराभक्तिसमस्रजम् । श्रियं ददृशतुः पद्मां साक्षात्पद्मतलस्थिताम् ॥
data.md: Decorated with ornaments that appeared like veritable stars, she wore a wreath resembling a garland of pearls. Indra saw that goddess called Padma living in the midst of lotuses. light up

data.v: सावरुह्य विमानाग्रादङ्गनानामनुत्तमा । अभ्यगच्छत्त्रिलोकेशं शक्रं चर्षिं च नारदम् ॥
data.md: Getting down from her foremost of cars, that peerless lady began to approach towards the lord of the three worlds and the celestial Rishi Narada.

data.v: नारदानुगतः साक्षान्मघवांस्तामुपागमत् । कृताञ्जलिपुटो देवीं निवेद्यात्मानमात्मना ॥
data.md: Followed by Narada, Indra also proceeded towards that lady. With joined hands, he offered himself up to her, and versed as he was with all things, he adored her with unsurpassed reverence and sincerity. The adorations over, the king of gods, O king, addressed Shree thus.

data.v: चक्रे चानुपमां पूजां तस्याश्चापि स सर्ववित् । देवराजः श्रियं राजन्वाक्यं चेदमुवाच ह ॥
data.md: Followed by Narada, Indra also proceeded towards that lady. With joined hands, he offered himself up to her, and versed as he was with all things, he adored her with unsurpassed reverence and sincerity. The adorations over, the king of gods, O king, addressed Shree thus.

data.v: का त्वं केन च कार्येण संप्राप्ता चारुहासिनि । कुतश्चागम्यते सुभ्रु गन्तव्यं क्व च ते शुभे ॥
data.md: Shakra said-'O you of sweet smiles, who, indeed, are you and for what have you come here? O you of fair brows, whence do you come and where will you go, O auspicious lady?'

data.v: पुण्येषु त्रिषु लोकेषु सर्वे स्थावरजङ्गमाः । ममात्मभावमिच्छन्तो यतन्ते परमात्मना ॥
data.md: 'In the three worlds full auspiciousness, all creatures, mobile and immobile, try with their whole hearts to gain a companionship with me.

data.v: साहं वै पङ्कजे जाता सूर्यरश्मिविबोधिते । भूत्यर्थं सर्वभूतानां पद्मा श्रीः पद्ममालिनी ॥
data.md: I am that Padma, that Shree adorned with lotuses, who originated from the lotus that blooms at the touch of the rays of the Sun-god, for the prosperity of all creatures.

data.v: अहं लक्ष्मीरहं भूतिः श्रीश्चाहं बलसूदन । अहं श्रद्धा च मेधा च सन्नतिर्विजितिः स्थितिः ॥
data.md: I am called Lakshmi, Bhuti, and Sree, O killer of Vala! I am Faith, I am Intelligence, I am Affluence, I am Victory, and I am Immutability.

data.v: अहं धृतिरहं सिद्धिरहं त्विड्भूतिरेव च । अहं स्वाहा स्वधा चैव संस्तुतिर्नियतिः कृतिः ॥
data.md: I am Patience. I am Success, and I am prosperity. I am Svaha, I am Svadha, I am Reverence, and I am Fate, and, I am Memory.

data.v: राज्ञां विजयमानानां सेनाग्रेषु ध्वजेषु च । निवासे धर्मशीलानां विषयेषु पुरेषु च ॥
data.md: I live at the van and on the standards of victorious and virtuous kings, as well as in their homes, cities, and kingdoms.

data.v: जितकाशिनि शूरे च संग्रामेष्वनिवर्तिनि । निवसामि मनुष्येन्द्रे सदैव बलसूदन ॥
data.md: I always live, O killer of Vala, with those foremost of men, the heroes longing for victory and unretrcating from battle.

data.v: धर्मनित्ये महाबुद्धौ ब्रह्मण्ये सत्यवादिनि । प्रश्रिते दानशीले च सदैव निवसाम्यहम् ॥
data.md: I also live for every with persons who are steadfastly attached to virtue, who are highly intelligent, who are devoted to Brahma, who are truthful in speech, who are possessed of humility, and who are liberal.

data.v: असुरेष्ववसं पूर्वं सत्यधर्मनिबन्धना । विपरीतांस्तु तान्बुद्ध्वा त्वयि वासमरोचयम् ॥
data.md: Formerly I lived with the Asuras on account of their being full of truth and merit. Seeing, however, that the Asuras have assumed adverse natures, I have left them and wish to live in you.

data.v: कथंवृत्तेषु दैत्येषु त्वमवात्सीर्वरानने । दृष्ट्वा च किमिहागास्त्वं हित्वा दैतेयदानवान् ॥
data.md: Shakra said 'O you of fair face, for what conduct of the Asuras did you live with them? What did you see there for which you have come here, having left the Daityas and the Danavas?

data.v: स्वधर्ममनुतिष्ठत्सु धैर्यादचलितेषु च । स्वर्गमार्गाभिरामेषु सत्त्वेषु निरता ह्यहम् ॥
data.md: Shree said I am devoted to those who follow the duties of their own order, to those who never fall away from patience, to those who take a pleasure in walking along the path leading to heaven.

data.v: दानाध्ययनयज्ञेज्या गुरुदैवतपूजनम् । विप्राणामतिथीनां च तेषां नित्यमवर्तत ॥
data.md: I always live with those who are famous for liberality, for study of the scriptures, for sacrifices, for other scriptural rites, and for adoration of Pitris, gods, preceptors, elders, and guests.

data.v: सुसंमृष्टगृहाश्चासञ्जितस्त्रीका हुताग्नयः । गुरुशुश्रूषवो दान्ता ब्रह्मण्याः सत्यवादिनः ॥
data.md: Formerly the Danavas used to keep their houses clean, to keep their women in control, to pour libations on the sacrificial fire, to wait dutifully on their preceptors, to control their passions, to be obedient to the Brahmanas, and to be truthful in speech.

data.v: श्रद्दधाना जितक्रोधा दानशीलानसूयकाः । भृतपुत्रा भृतामात्या भृतदारा ह्यनीर्षवः ॥
data.md: They were full of faith; they kept their anger under control; they practised the virtue of charity; they never envied others; they used to maintain their friends and advisers, and their wives they were never jealous.

data.v: अमर्षणा न चान्योन्यं स्पृहयन्ति कदाचन । न च जातूपतप्यन्ते धीराः परसमृद्धिभिः ॥
data.md: Formerly they never attacked one another, filled with anger. They were all contented and never felt pain on seeing other people's affluence and prosperity,

data.v: दातारः संगृहीतार आर्याः करुणवेदिनः । महाप्रसादा ऋजवो दृढभक्ता जितेन्द्रियाः ॥
data.md: They were all charitable and economical of respectable conduct; and endued with mercy. They were full of mercy, endued with simplicity of conduct, steadfast in faith, and had their passions under complete control. smear

data.v: संतुष्टभृत्यसचिवाः कृतज्ञाः प्रियवादिनः । यथार्थमानार्थकरा ह्रीनिषेधा यतव्रताः ॥
data.md: They used to keep their servants and counsellors contented, and were grateful and sweet-speeched. They used to serve every one according to his position and honour. They had shame. They were of rigid vows.

data.v: नित्यं पर्वसु सुस्नाताः स्वनुलिप्ताः स्वलंकृताः । उपवासतपःशीलाः प्रतीता ब्रह्मवादिनः ॥
data.md: They used to perform their ablutions on every sacred day. They used to themselves properly with perfumes and sacred unguents. They used to adorn their persons duly. They used to observe fasts and penances, were trustful, and utterers of Vedic hymns.

data.v: नैनानभ्युदियात्सूर्यो न चाप्यासन्प्रगेनिशाः । रात्रौ दधि च सक्तूंश्च नित्यमेव व्यवर्जयन् ॥
data.md: The Sun never rose while they lay asleep. They never slept when the Moon went away. They always abstained from curds and pounded barley.

data.v: काल्यं घृतं चान्ववेक्षन्प्रयता ब्रह्मचारिणः । मङ्गलानपि चापश्यन्ब्राह्मणांश्चाप्यपूजयन् ॥
data.md: They used every morning to look at clarified butter and other auspicious articles and with senses controlled they used to recite the Vedas and adore Brahmanas with gifts.

data.v: सदा हि ददतां धर्मः सदा चाप्रतिगृह्णताम् । अर्धं च रात्र्याः स्वपतां दिवा चास्वपतां तथा ॥
data.md: Their topic was always virtuous, and they never accepted gifts. They always went to sleep al midnight and never slept during the day.

data.v: कृपणानाथवृद्धानां दुर्बलातुरयोषिताम् । दायं च संविभागं च नित्यमेवानुमोदताम् ॥
data.md: They always used to take pleasure in showing mercy for the distressed, the helpless, the aged, the weak, the sick, and women, and enjoyed all their properties by sharing these with them.

data.v: विषण्णं त्रस्तमुद्विग्नं भयार्तं व्याधिपीडितम् । हृतस्वं व्यसनार्तं च नित्यमाश्वासयन्ति ते ॥
data.md: They always used to assure and cheer up the agitated, the cheerless, the anxious, the terrified, the diseased, the emaciated, the ; robbed, and the afflicted.

data.v: धर्ममेवान्ववर्तन्त न हिंसन्ति परस्परम् । अनुकूलाश्च कार्येषु गुरुवृद्धोपसेविनः ॥
data.md: They followed virtue and never injured one another. They were ready and well-disposed for every kind of action. They lised to serve and wait reverentially upon elders and aged individuals.

data.v: पितृदेवातिथींश्चैव यथावत्तेऽभ्यपूजयन् । अवशेषाणि चाश्नन्ति नित्यं सत्यतपोरताः ॥
data.md: They duly adored Pitris, gods and guests, and ate every day what was left after pleasing these. They were firmly devoted to truth and penances.

data.v: नैकेऽश्नन्ति सुसंपन्नं न गच्छन्ति परस्त्रियम् । सर्वभूतेष्ववर्तन्त यथात्मनि दयां प्रति ॥
data.md: None amongst them ate singly any food that was good, and none had known other people's wives. They treated all creatures as to their own selves.

data.v: नैवाकाशे न पशुषु नायोनौ न च पर्वसु । इन्द्रियस्य विसर्गं तेऽरोचयन्त कदाचन ॥
data.md: They never allowed the emission of the seminal fluid into empty space, into inferior animals, into forbidden wombs, or on sacred days.

data.v: नित्यं दानं तथा दाक्ष्यमार्जवं चैव नित्यदा । उत्साहश्चानहंकारः परमं सौहृदं क्षमा ॥
data.md: They were always famous for gifts, for cleverness, for simplicity, for hopeful exertion, for humility, for friendliness, for forgiveness.

data.v: सत्यं दानं तपः शौचं कारुण्यं वागनिष्ठुरा । मित्रेषु चानभिद्रोहः सर्वं तेष्वभवत्प्रभो ॥
data.md: And, O powerful one, truth, charity, penance, purity, inercy, sweet speeches, and absence of animosity towards friends, all these always lived in them.

data.v: निद्रा तन्द्रीरसंप्रीतिरसूया चानवेक्षिता । अरतिश्च विषादश्च न स्पृहा चाविशन्त तान् ॥
data.md: Sleep, idleness, fruitfulness, envy, want of foresight, discontent, melancholy, cupidity, never attacked them.

data.v: साहमेवंगुणेष्वेव दानवेष्ववसं पुरा । प्रजासर्गमुपादाय नैकं युगविपर्ययम् ॥
data.md: On account of the Danavas being famous for these good qualities, I lived with them from the beginning of the creation for many cycles.

data.v: ततः कालविपर्यासे तेषां गुणविपर्ययात् । अपश्यं विगतं धर्मं कामक्रोधवशात्मनाम् ॥
data.md: Times were changed, and that change brought about an alteration in the character of the Danavas. I saw that virtue and morality left them and that they began to give way to lust and anger.

data.v: सभासदां ते वृद्धानां सत्याः कथयतां कथाः । प्राहसन्नभ्यसूयंश्च सर्ववृद्धान्गुणावराः ॥
data.md: Persons of inferior attainments, began to cherish animosities towards elders possessed of superior qualifications, and while the latter, endued with virtue and merit, used to discourse on proper topics in the midst of assemblies, the former began to ridicule or laugh at them.

data.v: यूनः सहसमासीनान्वृद्धानभिगतान्सतः । नाभ्युत्थानाभिवादाभ्यां यथापूर्वमपूजयन् ॥
data.md: When reverend elders came, the younger individuals, scated at their ease, refused to worship the former by rising up and saluting them respectfully.

data.v: वर्तयन्त्येव पितरि पुत्राः प्रभवताऽऽत्मनः । अमित्रभृत्यतां प्राप्य ख्यापयन्तोऽनपत्रपाः ॥
data.md: In the presence of fathers, sons began to exercise power. Not receiving wages persons accepted service and shamelessly proclaimed the fact.

data.v: तथा धर्मादपेतेन कर्मणा गर्हितेन ये । महतः प्राप्नुवन्त्यर्थांस्तेष्वेषामभवत्स्पृहा ॥
data.md: Those amongst them who could amassing great wealth by doing unrighteous and censurable deeds came to be respected.

data.v: उच्चैश्चाप्यवदन्रात्रौ नीचैस्तत्राग्निरज्वलत् । पुत्राः पितॄनभ्यवदन्भार्याश्चाभ्यवदन्पतीन् ॥
data.md: During the night they began to cry aloud, Their homa fires ceased to send up bright flames. Sons began to govern their fathers and wives lorded over husbands.

data.v: मातरं पितरं वृद्धमाचार्यमतिथिं गुरुम् । गुरुवन्नाभ्यनन्दन्त कुमारान्नान्वपालयन् ॥
data.md: Mothers, fathers, aged seniors, preceptors, guests and guides ceased to get respect for their exalted position. People ceased to rear with love their own offspring but began to leave them.

data.v: भिक्षां बलिमदत्त्वा च स्वयमन्नानि भुञ्जते । अनिष्ट्वा संविभज्याथ पितृदेवातिथीन्गुरून् ॥
data.md: Without distributing the fixed portion in alms and reserving the fixed portion for offering it to the gods, every one ate what he had. Indeed, without offering their articles to the gods, in sacrifices and without sharing them with the Pitris, the gods, guests, and reverend elders they appropriated them to their own use shamelessly.

data.v: न शौचमनुरुध्यन्त तेषां सूदजनास्तथा । मनसा कर्मणा वाचा भक्तमासीदनावृतम् ॥
data.md: Their cooks no longer cherished any consideration for purity of mind, deed, and word. They ate what had been left uncovered.

data.v: विप्रकीर्णानि धान्यानि काकमूषकभोजनम् । अपावृतं पयोऽतिष्ठदुच्छिष्टाश्चास्पृशन्घृतम् ॥
data.md: Their corn lay scattered in yards, being deviated by crows and rats. Their milk remained in an open place and they began to touch clarified butter with hands unwashed after eating.

data.v: कुद्दालपाटीपिटकं प्रकीर्णं कांस्यभाजनम् । द्रव्योपकरणं सर्वं नान्ववैक्षत्कुटुम्बिनी ॥
data.md: Their spades, domestic knives, baskets and dishes and cups of white brass, and other utensils lay scattered in their houses.

data.v: प्राकारागारविध्वंसान्न स्म ते प्रतिकुर्वते । नाद्रियन्ते पशून्बद्ध्वा यवसेनोदकेन च ॥
data.md: Their housewife did not look after these. Tlicy no longer cared for the repairs of their houses and walls. Tethering their animals they did not give them food and drunk.

data.v: बालानां प्रेक्षमाणानां स्वयं भक्षानभक्षयन् । तथा भृत्यजनं सर्वं पर्यश्नन्ति च दानवाः ॥
data.md: Disregarding children that only looked, on, and without having fed their dependants, the Danavas ate what they had.

data.v: पायसं कृसरं मांसमपूपानथ शष्कुलीः । अपाचयन्नात्मनोऽर्थे वृथामांसान्यभक्षयन् ॥
data.md: They began to prepare payasa and kricara and dishes of meat and cakes and shashkuli for their own selves, and began to eat the flesh of animals not slain in sacrifices.

data.v: उत्सूर्यशायिनश्चासन्सर्वे चासन्प्रगेनिशाः । अवर्तन्कलहाश्चात्र दिवारात्रं गृहे गृहे ॥
data.md: They used to sleep even after sunrise. They slept in the mornings Day and night, disputes and quarrels raged in every house.

data.v: अनार्याश्चार्यमासीनं पर्युपासन्न तत्र ह । आश्रमस्थान्विकर्मस्थाः प्रद्विषन्ति परस्परम् । संकराश्चाप्यवर्तन्त न च शौचमवर्तत ॥
data.md: Those who were not respectable amongst them no longer showed any respect for them deserving of the same while the latter were seated in any place. Deviating from their fixed duties, they ceased to respect those who had returned into the forest for leading a life of peace and divine meditation. Intermixture of castes freely took place among them. They cared not for purity of body or mind.

data.v: ये च वेदविदो विप्रा विस्पष्टमनृचश्च ये । निरन्तरविशेषास्ते बहुमानावमानयोः ॥
data.md: Brahmanas, learned in the Vedas, did not receive any respect among them. Those again who were ignorant of the Richs were not condemned or punished. Both, namely, those who deserved respect and those who were unworthy of the same, were treated equally.

data.v: हावमाभरणं वेषं गतिं स्थितिमवेक्षितुम् । असेवन्त भुजिष्या वै दुर्जनाचरितं विधिम् ॥
data.md: Their servant girls became wicked, and began to wear golden necklaces and other ornaments and fine dresses, and used to remain in their houses or go away before their very eyes.

data.v: स्त्रियः पुरुषवेषेण पुंसः स्त्रीवेषधारिणः । क्रीडारतिविहारेषु परां मुदमवाप्नुवन् ॥
data.md: They began to derive great pleasure from sports and plays in which their women were dressed as men and their men as women.

data.v: प्रभवद्भिः पुरा दायानर्हेभ्यः प्रतिपादितान् । नाभ्यवर्तन्त नास्तिक्याद्वर्तन्तः संभवेष्वपि ॥
data.md: Those of their ancestors who were very rich had made gifts of wealth to worthy persons. The descendants of the donors, even when in affluence began to take back, for their unbelief, those gifts.

data.v: मित्रेणाभ्यर्थितं मित्रमर्थे संशयिते क्वचित् । वालकोट्यग्रमात्रेण स्वार्थेनाघ्नत तद्वसु ॥
data.md: When difficulties were anticipated for the fulfilment of any object and friend sought the advice of friend, that purpose was frustrated by the latter even if he had any slightest selfinterest to fulfil by frustrating it.

data.v: परस्वादानरुचयो विपण्यव्यवहारिणः । अदृश्यन्तार्यवर्णेषु शूद्राश्चापि तपोधनाः ॥
data.md: Even amongst their better classes have appeared traders and dealers in goods, beni upon misappropriating others. The Shudras began to practise penances.

data.v: अधीयन्तेऽव्रताः केचिद्वृथाव्रतमथापरे । अशुश्रूषुर्गुरोः शिष्यः कश्चिच्छिष्यसखो गुरुः ॥
data.md: Some have begun to study, without fixing any rules for regulating their hours and food. Other have begun to study, making useless rules. Disciples have refrained from rendering obedience and service to preceptors. Preceptors again have come to treat disciples as friends.

data.v: पिता चैव जनित्री च श्रान्तौ वृत्तोत्सवाविव । अप्रभुत्वे स्थितौ वृद्धावन्नं प्रार्थयतः सुतान् ॥
data.md: Fathers and mothers are tired with work, and do not enjoy festivities. Aged parents having no power over sons, have been compelled to beg their food of the latter.

data.v: तत्र वेदविदः प्राज्ञा गाम्भीर्ये सागरोपमाः । कृष्यादिष्वभवन्सक्ता मूर्खाः श्राद्धान्यभुञ्जत ॥
data.md: Amongst them, even wise persons wellread in the Vedas, and resembling the ocean itself in gravity, have begun to follow agriculture and similar callings Illiterate and ignorant persons have begun to be fed at Shraddhas.

data.v: प्रातः प्रातश्च सुप्रश्नं कल्पनं प्रेषणक्रियाः । शिष्यानुप्रहितास्तस्मिन्नकुर्वन्गुरवश्च ह ॥
data.md: Disciples instead of approaching preceptors, every morning for making dutiful enquiries, for determing what acts are to be performed, and for seeking commissions which they are to discharge, preceptors wait upon them to perform all those functions.

data.v: श्वश्रूश्वशुरयोरग्रे वधूः प्रेष्यानशासत । अन्वशासच्च भर्तारं समाहूयाभिजल्पती ॥
data.md: Daughter-in-law, in the presence of their husband's mothers and fathers, rebuke and chastise servants and maids, and calling their husbands lecture and rebuke them.

data.v: प्रयत्नेनापि चारक्षच्चित्तं पुत्रस्य वै पिता । व्यभजंश्चापि संरम्भाद्दुःखवासं तथावसन् ॥
data.md: Fathers, with great care, try to keep sons in good humour, or, through fear, distributing their wealth among children, live in misery and affliction.

data.v: अग्निदाहेन चोरैर्वा राजभिर्वा हृतं धनम् । दृष्ट्वा द्वेषात्प्राहसन्त सुहृत्संभाविता ह्यपि ॥
data.md: Even the friends of the victims, seeing the latter deprived of riches in fire or by robbers or by the king, have begun to jeer.

data.v: कृतघ्ना नास्तिकाः पापा गुरुदाराभिमर्शिनः । अभक्ष्यभक्षणरता निर्मर्यादा हतत्विषः ॥
data.md: They have become ungrateful and athestical and sinful and have begun to commit adultery with the wives of their preceptors. They have begun to take forbidden food. They hav. transgressed all bounds and restraints. They have become shorn of that splendour which had made them famous before.

data.v: तेष्वेवमादीनाचारानाचरत्सु विपर्यये । नाहं देवेन्द्र वत्स्यामि दानवेष्विति मे मतिः ॥
data.md: On account of these and other marks of wicked conduct and the change of their former nature, I shall not, O king of the gods, live among them any longer.

data.v: तां मां स्वयमनुप्राप्तामभिनन्द शचीपते । त्वयार्चितां मां देवेश पुरोधास्यन्ति देवताः ॥
data.md: I have, therefore, come to you of my own accord. Receive me with reverence, O lord of Sachi! Respected by you, O king of the gods, I shall receive honour from all other gods.

data.v: यत्राहं तत्र मत्कान्ता मद्विशिष्टा मदर्पणाः । सप्त देव्यो मयाष्टम्यो वासं चेष्यन्ति मेऽष्टधा ॥
data.md: There where I live the seven other goddesses with Jaya for the eighth, who love me, who are inseparably associated with me, and who depend upon me, wish to live.

data.v: आशा श्रद्धा धृतिः कान्तिर्विजितिः सन्नतिः क्षमा । अष्टमी वृत्तिरेतासां पुरोगा पाकशासन ॥
data.md: They Hope, Faith, Intelligence, Contentment, Victory, Advancement, Forgiveness. She who is the eighth, viz., Jaya, occupies the foremost place amongst them, O chastiser of Paka.

data.v: ताश्चाहं चासुरांस्त्यक्त्वा युष्मद्विषयमागता । त्रिदशेषु निवत्स्यामो धर्मनिष्ठान्तरात्मसु ॥
data.md: Having left the Asuras, all of them and myself have come to your kingdom. We shall henceforth live among the gods who are given to righteousness and faith.

data.v: इत्युक्तवचनां देवीमत्यर्थं तौ ननन्दतुः । नारदश्च त्रिलोकर्षिर्वृत्रहन्ता च वासवः ॥
data.md: After the goddess had said so, the celestial Rishi Narada, and Vasava the killer of Vritra, for pleasing her, offered her a joyful welcome.

data.v: ततोऽनलसखो वायुः प्रववौ देववेश्मसु । इष्टगन्धः सुखस्पर्शः सर्वेन्द्रियसुखावहः ॥
data.md: The Wind-God-that friend of Agni, then began to blow gently through the sky, carrying sweet odors, refreshing all creatures with whom he came into contact, and contributing to the pleasure of every one of the senses.

data.v: शुचौ चाभ्यर्चिते देशे त्रिदशाः प्रायशः स्थिताः । लक्ष्म्या सहितमासीनं मघवन्तं दिदृक्षवः ॥
data.md: All the gods, (hearing the news) gathered together in a pure and desirable spot and waited there for seeing Maghavat seated with Lakshmi beside him.

data.v: ततो दिवं प्राप्य सहस्रलोचनः; श्रियोपपन्नः सुहृदा सुरर्षिणा । रथेन हर्यश्वयुजा सुरर्षभः; सदः सुराणामभिसत्कृतो ययौ ॥
data.md: Then the thousand eyed king of the gods, accompanied by Shree and his friend the great Rishi, and riding upon a splendid car drawn by green horses, caine into that concourse of the celestials, receiving honour from all.

data.v: अथेङ्गितं वज्रधरस्य नारदः; श्रियाश्च देव्या मनसा विचारयन् । श्रियै शशंसामरदृष्टपौरुषः; शिवेन तत्रागमनं महर्द्धिमत् ॥
data.md: Observing a sign that the holder of the thunder-bolt made and which Shree herself approved of, then the great Rishi Narada, whose prowess all the gods knew, welcomed the approach of the goddess there and announced it as highly auspicious.

data.v: ततोऽमृतं द्यौः प्रववर्ष भास्वती; पितामहस्यायतने स्वयंभुवः । अनाहता दुन्दुभयश्च नेदिरे; तथा प्रसन्नाश्च दिशश्चकाशिरे ॥
data.md: Heaven's sky became clear and bright and began to shower ambrosia upon the region of the self-create Grand-father. The celestial keule-druns, though struck by none, began to beat, and all the cardinal points, becoming clear, seemed ablaze with splendour.

data.v: यथर्तु सस्येषु ववर्ष वासवो; न धर्ममार्गाद्विचचाल कश्चन । अनेकरत्नाकरभूषणा च भूः; सुघोषघोषा भुवनौकसां जये ॥
data.md: Indra began to pour rain upon crops that sprouted up at its proper season. No one then disgraced the path of righteousness. The Earth was bedecked with many mines filled with jewels and gems, and the chanting of Vedic recitations and other sweet sounds swelled up on the occasion of that success of the gods.

data.v: क्रियाभिरामा मनुजा यशस्विनो; बभुः शुभे पुण्यकृतां पथि स्थिताः । नरामराः किंनरयक्षराक्षसाः; समृद्धिमन्तः सुखिनो यशस्विनः ॥
data.md: Human beings, gifted with firm minds, and all following the sacred path trodden by the righteous, began to find pleasure in Vedic and other religious rites and acts. Men, Celestials, Kinnaras Yakshas and Rakshasas, all became endued with prosperity and cheerfulness.

data.v: न जात्वकाले कुसुमं कुतः फलं; पपात वृक्षात्पवनेरितादपि । रसप्रदाः कामदुघाश्च धेनवो; न दारुणा वाग्विचचार कस्यचित् ॥
data.md: Not a flower,. what to speak of fruits, dropped untimely from a tree even if the WindGod shook it with force. All the kine began to give sweet milk whenever milked by men and cruel and harsh words were not given vent to by any one.

data.v: इमां सपर्यां सह सर्वकामदैः; श्रियाश्च शक्रप्रमुखैश्च दैवतैः । पठन्ति ये विप्रसदः समागमे; समृद्धकामाः श्रियमाप्नुवन्ति ते ॥
data.md: They who, seeking advancement, appear before assemblies of Brahmanas, and read this description of the glorification of Shree by all the gods headed by Indra,-deities competent to grant every wish, succeed in acquiring great prosperity.

data.v: त्वया कुरूणां वर यत्प्रचोदितं; भवाभवस्येह परं निदर्शनम् । तदद्य सर्वं परिकीर्तितं मया; परीक्ष्य तत्त्वं परिगन्तुमर्हसि ॥
data.md: These then, O king of the Kurus are the foremost marks of prosperity and adversity. Requested by you, I have told you all. You should now act according to the instructions conveyed herein, understanding them after careful reflection,

data.v: किंशीलः किंसमाचारः किंविद्यः किंपरायणः । प्राप्नोति ब्रह्मणः स्थानं यत्परं प्रकृतेर्ध्रुवम् ॥
data.md: Yudhisthira said By what nature, what course of duties, what knowledge, and what energy, does one succeed in attaining to Brahma which is immutable and is beyond the reach of nature.

data.v: मोक्षधर्मेषु नियतो लघ्वाहारो जितेन्द्रियः । प्राप्नोति ब्रह्मणः स्थानं यत्परं प्रकृतेर्ध्रुवम् ॥
data.md: Bhishma said One who practises the religion of renunciation, who eats sparingly, and who has his senses under complete control, can attain to Brahma which is immutable and which is above nature.

data.v: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् । जैगीषव्यस्य संवादमसितस्य च भारत ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Regarding it, О Yudhisthira, is cited the old discourse between Prahlada and Indra.

data.v: जैगीषव्यं महाप्राज्ञं धर्माणामागतागमम् । अक्रुध्यन्तमहृष्यन्तमसितो देवलोऽब्रवीत् ॥
data.md: Once on a time Asita-Devala addressed Jaigishavya who was endued with great wisdom and fully acquainted with the truths of duty and morality.

data.v: न प्रीयसे वन्द्यमानो निन्द्यमानो न कुप्यसि । का ते प्रज्ञा कुतश्चैषा किं चैतस्याः परायणम् ॥
data.md: Devala said You are not pleased when lauded, you do not give way to anger when blamed or censured. What, indeed, is your wisdom? whence have you got it? And what, indeed, is the refuge of that wisdom?

data.v: इति तेनानुयुक्तः स तमुवाच महातपाः । महद्वाक्यमसंदिग्धं पुष्कलार्थपदं शुचि ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Thus accosted by Devala, the pure Jaigishavya of austere penances, said those words of great import, fraught with full faith, and deep significance.

data.v: या गतिर्या परा निष्ठा या शान्तिः पुण्यकर्मणाम् । तां तेऽहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि यन्मां पृच्छसि वै द्विज ॥
data.md: Jaigishavya said.. O foremost of Rishis, I shall tell you of what is the highest end, that which is the supreme goal, that which is tranquility, as regarded by all pious persons.

data.v: निन्दत्सु च समो नित्यं प्रशंसत्सु च देवल । निह्नुवन्ति च ये तेषां समयं सुकृतं च ये ॥
data.md: They, O Devala, who treat equally those who praise them and those who blame them, they who conceal their own vows and good acts, they who never indulge in vilifications, they who never say even what is good when it is calculated to injure (instead of producing any benefit), they who do not desire to retaliate injury are said to be wise men.

data.v: उक्ताश्च न विवक्षन्ति वक्तारमहिते रतम् । प्रतिहन्तुं न चेच्छन्ति हन्तारं वै मनीषिणः ॥
data.md: They, O Devala, who treat equally those who praise them and those who blame them, they who conceal their own vows and good acts, they who never indulge in vilifications, they who never say even what is good when it is calculated to injure (instead of producing any benefit), they who do not desire to retaliate injury are said to be wise men.

data.v: नाप्राप्तमनुशोचन्ति प्राप्तकालानि कुर्वते । न चातीतानि शोचन्ति न चैनान्प्रतिजानते ॥
data.md: They never grieve for what is yet to come. They are concerned with only what is present and act as they should. They never grieve for the past or even recollect it.

data.v: संप्राप्तानां च पूज्यानां कामादर्थेषु देवल । यथोपपत्तिं कुर्वन्ति शक्तिमन्तः कृतव्रताः ॥
data.md: Endued with power and controlled minds, they do at their pleasure, in the way in which it should be done, what they should do, O Devala, if solicited respectfully thereto.

data.v: पक्वविद्या महाप्राज्ञा जितक्रोधा जितेन्द्रियाः । मनसा कर्मणा वाचा नापराध्यन्ति कस्यचित् ॥
data.md: Of mature knowledge, of great wisdom, with anger under complete control, and with their passions subjugated, they never commit an injury to any one in thought, word, or deed.

data.v: अनीर्षवो न चान्योन्यं विहिंसन्ति कदाचन । न च जातूपतप्यन्ते धीराः परसमृद्धिभिः ॥
data.md: Formerly they never attacked one another, filled with anger. They were all contented and never felt pain on seeing other people's affluence and prosperity,

data.v: निन्दाप्रशंसे चात्यर्थं न वदन्ति परस्य ये । न च निन्दाप्रशंसाभ्यां विक्रियन्ते कदाचन ॥
data.md: Such men never indulge in exaggerated speeches, or laud others, or speak ill of them. They are again never influenced by praise and censure showered on them.

data.v: सर्वतश्च प्रशान्ता ये सर्वभूतहिते रताः । न क्रुध्यन्ति न हृष्यन्ति नापराध्यन्ति कस्यचित् । विमुच्य हृदयग्रन्थींश्चङ्क्रम्यन्ते यथासुखम् ॥
data.md: They are tranquil regarding all their desires, and are engaged in the well being of the creatures. They never give way to anger to indulge in joy, or injure any creature.

data.v: न येषां बान्धवाः सन्ति ये चान्येषां न बान्धवाः । अमित्राश्च न सन्त्येषां ये चामित्रा न कस्यचित् ॥
य एवं कुर्वते मर्त्याः सुखं जीवन्ति सर्वदा । धर्ममेवानुवर्तन्ते धर्मज्ञा द्विजसत्तम । ये ह्यतो विच्युता मार्गात्ते हृष्यन्त्युद्विजन्ति च ॥
data.md: O foremost of twice-born ones, they who acquire a knowledge of the rules of morality and righteousness, and who observe those rules in practice, acquire joy, while they who deviate from the path or righteousness are afflicted by anxieties and sorrow.

data.v: आस्थितस्तमहं मार्गमसूयिष्यामि कं कथम् । निन्द्यमानः प्रशस्तो वा हृष्येयं केन हेतुना ॥
data.md: I now follow the path of righteousness. Decried by others, why shall I be annoyed with them, or lauded by others, why shall I be pleased?

data.v: यद्यदिच्छन्ति तन्मार्गमभिगच्छन्ति मानवाः । न मे निन्दाप्रशंसाभ्यां ह्रासवृद्धी भविष्यतः ॥
data.md: Let men get whatsoever objects they please from whatsoever callings they pursue. Praise and censure cannot secure my advancement or the reverse.

data.v: अमृतस्येव संतृप्येदवमानस्य तत्त्ववित् । विषस्येवोद्विजेन्नित्यं संमानस्य विचक्षणः ॥
data.md: He who has understood the truths of things, becomes pleased with even disregard as if it were nectar. The wise man is indeed annoyed with regard as if it were poison.

data.v: अवज्ञातः सुखं शेते इह चामुत्र चोभयोः । विमुक्तः सर्वपापेभ्यो योऽवमन्ता स बध्यते ॥
data.md: He who is freed from all shortcomings sleeps fearlessly both here and hereafter even if insulted by others, On the other hand, he who insults him, meets with destruction.

data.v: परां गतिं च ये केचित्प्रार्थयन्ति मनीषिणः । एतद्व्रतं समाश्रित्य सुखमेधन्ति ते जनाः ॥
data.md: The wise men who seek to attain to the highest end, succeed in obtaining it following such a conduct.

data.v: सर्वतश्च समाहृत्य क्रतून्सर्वाञ्जितेन्द्रियः । प्राप्नोति ब्रह्मणः स्थानं यत्परं प्रकृतेर्ध्रुवम् ॥
data.md: Bhishma said One who practises the religion of renunciation, who eats sparingly, and who has his senses under complete control, can attain to Brahma which is immutable and which is above nature.

data.v: नास्य देवा न गन्धर्वा न पिशाचा न राक्षसाः । पदमन्ववरोहन्ति प्राप्तस्य परमां गतिम् ॥
data.md: The very gods, the Gandharvas, the Pishachas, and the Rakshasas, cannot attain to the end of one who has attained to the hightest end.

data.v: प्रियः सर्वस्य लोकस्य सर्वसत्त्वाभिनन्दिता । गुणैः सर्वैरुपेतश्च को न्वस्ति भुवि मानवः ॥
data.md: Yudhishthira said What man is there who is dear to all, who pleases all persons, and who is gifted with every merit and every accomplishment?

data.v: अत्र ते वर्तयिष्यामि पृच्छतो भरतर्षभ । उग्रसेनस्य संवादं नारदे केशवस्य च ॥
data.md: Bhishma said About it I shall recite to you the words that Keshava, asked by Ugrasena, said to him on a former occasion.

data.v: पश्य संकल्पते लोको नारदस्य प्रकीर्तने । मन्ये स गुणसंपन्नो ब्रूहि तन्मम पृच्छतः ॥
data.md: Ugrasena said All persons seem to be auxious to describe of the merits of Narada. I think that celestial Rishi must really be endued with every sort of merit. I ask you tell me this, O Keshava.

data.v: कुकुराधिप यान्मन्ये शृणु तान्मे विवक्षतः । नारदस्य गुणान्साधून्संक्षेपेण नराधिप ॥
data.md: Vasudeva said O chief of the Kukuras, listen to me as I describe shortly those good qualities of Narada which I know, I king! Narada is as well-read in the scriptures as he is good and pious in his conduct

data.v: न चारित्रनिमित्तोऽस्याहंकारो देहपातनः । अभिन्नश्रुतचारित्रस्तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥
data.md: And yet, he is not proud of his conduct, which makes one's blood so hot. It is for this that he is adored everywhere.

data.v: तपस्वी नारदो बाढं वाचि नास्य व्यतिक्रमः । कामाद्वा यदि वा लोभात्तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥
data.md: Narada deserves the respectful adorations of all. He never retracts his words through desire of cupidity. For this he is adored everywhere.

data.v: अध्यात्मविधितत्त्वज्ञः क्षान्तः शक्तो जितेन्द्रियः । ऋजुश्च सत्यवादी च तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥
data.md: He is fully conversant with the knowledge of the soul, bent on peace, endued with great energy, and a master of his senses. He is free from guile, and truthful in words. For this he is adored with respect everywhere.

data.v: तेजसा यशसा बुद्ध्या नयेन विनयेन च । जन्मना तपसा वृद्धस्तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥
data.md: He is distinguished by energy, fame, intelligence, knowledge, humility, birth, by penances, and years. For these he is everywhere adored with respect.

data.v: सुखशीलः सुसंभोगः सुभोज्यः स्वादरः शुचिः । सुवाक्यश्चाप्यनीर्ष्यश्च तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥
data.md: He is of good conduct. He dresses and houses himself well. He cats pure food. He loves all. He is pure in body and mind. He is sweet-speeched. He is free from envy and malice. For this he is adored everywhere with respect.

data.v: कल्याणं कुरुते बाढं पापमस्मिन्न विद्यते । न प्रीयते परानर्थैस्तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥
data.md: He is, forsooth, always employed in doing good to all people. No sin is in him. He never rejoices at other people's misfortunes. For this he is adored everywhere with respect.

data.v: वेदश्रुतिभिराख्यानैरर्थानभिजिगीषते । तितिक्षुरनवज्ञश्च तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥
data.md: He always tries to conquer all earthly desires by listening to Vedic recitations and attending to the Puranas. He is a great renouncer and he never disrespects any one. For this he is adored everywhere with respect.

data.v: समत्वाद्धि प्रियो नास्ति नाप्रियश्च कथंचन । मनोनुकूलवादी च तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥
data.md: He is endued with great learning in the scriptures. His conversation is varied and charming. His knowledge and wisdom are great. He is free from cupidity. He is free also from deception. He is large-hearted. He has conquered anger and cupidity. For this he is adored everywhere with respect.

data.v: बहुश्रुतश्चैत्रकथः पण्डितोऽनलसोऽशठः । अदीनोऽक्रोधनोऽलुब्धस्तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥
data.md: He is endued with great learning in the scriptures. His conversation is varied and charming. His knowledge and wisdom are great. He is free from cupidity. He is free also from deception. He is large-hearted. He has conquered anger and cupidity. For this he is adored everywhere with respect.

data.v: नार्थे न धर्मे कामे वा भूतपूर्वोऽस्य विग्रहः । दोषाश्चास्य समुच्छिन्नास्तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥
data.md: His devotion (to Brahma) is firm. His soul is blameless. He is well-versed in the Shrutis. He is free from cruelty. He is above the influence of delusion or faults. For this he is adored everywhere with respect.

data.v: दृढभक्तिरनिन्द्यात्मा श्रुतवाननृशंसवान् । वीतसंमोहदोषश्च तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥
असक्तः सर्वसङ्गेषु सक्तात्मेव च लक्ष्यते । अदीर्घसंशयो वाग्मी तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥
data.md: He is unattached to all objects of attachment (for others). For all that he seems to be attached to all things. He does not suffer long from the influence of any doubt. For this he is everywhere adored with respect.

data.v: समाधिर्नास्य मानार्थे नात्मानं स्तौति कर्हिचित् । अनीर्ष्युर्दृढसंभाषस्तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥
data.md: He has no longing for objects of profit and pleasure. He never speaks highly of his own self. He is shorn of malice. He is mild in speech. Therefore he is everywhere adored with respect.

data.v: लोकस्य विविधं वृत्तं प्रकृतेश्चाप्यकुत्सयन् । संसर्गविद्याकुशलस्तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥
data.md: He sees the hearts, different from one another, of all men, without blaming any of them. He is well-versed in all matters relating to the origin of things.

data.v: नासूयत्यागमं कंचित्स्वं तपो नोपजीवति । अवन्ध्यकालो वश्यात्मा तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥
data.md: He never disregards or hates any kind of sense. He lives according to his own standard of morality. He never passes time idly. He has controlled his soul. Therefore he is everywhere adored with respect.

data.v: कृतश्रमः कृतप्रज्ञो न च तृप्तः समाधितः । नियमस्थोऽप्रमत्तश्च तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥
data.md: He has worked hard in subjects worthy of hard application. He has acquired knowledge and wisdom. He is never satiate with yoga. He is always attentive and ready for work. He is ever careful. For this he is everywhere adored with respect.

data.v: सापत्रपश्च युक्तश्च सुनेयः श्रेयसे परैः । अभेत्ता परगुह्यानां तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥
data.md: He does not feel shame for any deficiency of his. He is very attentive. He is always engaged by others for doing what is for their behoof. He never divulges the secrets of others. For this he is everywhere adored with respect.

data.v: न हृष्यत्यर्थलाभेषु नालाभेषु व्यथत्यपि । स्थिरबुद्धिरसक्तात्मा तस्मात्सर्वत्र पूजितः ॥
data.md: He is never puffed up with joy at the time of making even valuable acquisitions. He is never pained at losses. His understanding is firm and fixed. His mind is unattached to all things. Therefore he is everywhere adored with respect.

data.v: तं सर्वगुणसंपन्नं दक्षं शुचिमकातरम् । कालज्ञं च नयज्ञं च कः प्रियं न करिष्यति ॥
data.md: Who, indeed, is there who will not love him who is thus endued with every merit and accomplishment, who is expert in all things, who is pure in body and mind, who is perfectly auspicious, who is well-versed with the course of time and the opportuneness it affords for particular acts, and who is well-acquainted with all agreeable things?

data.v: आद्यन्तं सर्वभूतानां श्रोतुमिच्छामि कौरव । ध्यानं कर्म च कालं च तथैवायुर्युगे युगे ॥
