data.md: As a goldsmith purifies the dross of his metal by repeatedly putting it into the fire with very great efforts of his own, similarly Individual Soul succeeds in purifying himself by his course through hundreds of births. Some one may be seen to purify himself in only one life by great efforts.

data.v: तद्वज्जातिशतैर्जीवः शुध्यतेऽल्पेन कर्मणा । यत्नेन महता चैवाप्येकजातौ विशुध्यते ॥
data.md: As a goldsmith purifies the dross of his metal by repeatedly putting it into the fire with very great efforts of his own, similarly Individual Soul succeeds in purifying himself by his course through hundreds of births. Some one may be seen to purify himself in only one life by great efforts.

data.v: लीलयाल्पं यथा गात्रात्प्रमृज्यादात्मनो रजः । बहु यत्नेन महता दोषनिर्हरणं तथा ॥
data.md: As one should with care remove stains from his body before they become thick, similarly one should with great efforts, wash off his sins.

data.v: यथा चाल्पेन माल्येन वासितं तिलसर्षपम् । न मुञ्चति स्वकं गन्धं तद्वत्सूक्ष्मस्य दर्शनम् ॥
data.md: By mixing only a few flowers with them, grains of sesame cannot be made to renounce their own smell. Similarly, one cannot, by purifying his heart only a little, succeed in seeing the Soul.

data.v: तदेव बहुभिर्माल्यैर्वास्यमानं पुनः पुनः । विमुञ्चति स्वकं गन्धं माल्यगन्धेऽवतिष्ठति ॥
data.md: When, however, those grains are perfumed repeatedly with the help of a large quantity of flowers, it is then that they cast off their own smell and assume that off the flowers with which they are mixed.

data.v: एवं जातिशतैर्युक्तो गुणैरेव प्रसङ्गिषु । बुद्ध्या निवर्तते दोषो यत्नेनाभ्यासजेन वै ॥
data.md: Similarly, faults, in the form of attachments to all our environments, are removed by the understanding in course of many lives, with the help of a large quantity of the quality of goodness, and by means of efforts born of practice.

data.v: कर्मणा स्वेन रक्तानि विरक्तानि च दानव । यथा कर्मविशेषांश्च प्राप्नुवन्ति तथा शृणु ॥
data.md: Listen, O Danava, by what means creatures attached to acts and those unattached to them get at the causes bringing on their respective states mind.

data.v: यथा च संप्रवर्तन्ते यस्मिंस्तिष्ठन्ति वा विभो । तत्तेऽनुपूर्व्या व्याख्यास्ये तदिहैकमनाः शृणु ॥
data.md: Listen to me with rapt attention. I shall in their due order, describe to you, O powerful Danava, as to how creatures follow action and how they give up action.

data.v: अनादिनिधनः श्रीमान्हरिर्नारायणः प्रभुः । स वै सृजति भूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च ॥
data.md: The Supreme Lord creates all creatures mobile and immobile. He is beginingless and endless. Unendued with attributes and endless. Unendued with attributes of any sort, he assumes attributes. He is the universal Destroyer, the Refuge of all things, the supreme Ordainer, and pure Intelligence.

data.v: एष सर्वेषु भूतेषु क्षरश्चाक्षर एव च । एकादशविकारात्मा जगत्पिबति रश्मिभिः ॥
data.md: In all creatures it is He who lives as the mutable and the immutable. It is He who, having eleven modifications for His essence, drinks this universe with His rays.

data.v: पादौ तस्य महीं विद्धि मूर्धानं दिवमेव च । बाहवस्तु दिशो दैत्य श्रोत्रमाकाशमेव च ॥
data.md: Know that the Earth is His feet. His head is formed by Heaven. His arms, O Daitya, are the several points of the horizon. The intermediate space is His ears.

data.v: तस्य तेजोमयः सूर्यो मनश्चन्द्रमसि स्थितम् । बुद्धिर्ज्ञानगता नित्यं रसस्त्वप्सु प्रवर्तते ॥
data.md: The light of His eye is the Sun, and His mind is in the Moon. His Understanding lives always in Knowledge, and His tongue is in Water.

data.v: भ्रुवोरनन्तरास्तस्य ग्रहा दानवसत्तम । नक्षत्रचक्रं नेत्राभ्यां पादयोर्भूश्च दानव ॥
data.md: O best of Danavas, the Planets are in the midst of His brows. The stars and constellations originate, from the light of His eyes. The Earth is in His feet, O Danava.

data.v: रजस्तमश्च सत्त्वं च विद्धि नारायणात्मकम् । सोऽऽश्रमाणां मुखं तात कर्मणस्तत्फलं विदुः ॥
data.md: Know also that the qualities of Rajas, Tamas, and Sattva are of Him. He is the fruit of all the modes of life, and He it is who should be known as the fruit of all religious acts.

data.v: अकर्मणः फलं चैव स एव परमव्ययः । छन्दांसि तस्य रोमाणि अक्षरं च सरस्वती ॥
data.md: The Highest and Immutable, He is also the fruit of abstention from all work. The Chcchandas are the hair on His body, and Pranava is His word.

data.v: बह्वाश्रयो बहुमुखो धर्मो हृदि समाश्रितः । स ब्रह्मपरमो धर्मस्तपश्च सदसच्च सः ॥
data.md: The various orders (of men) and the modes of life are His refuge. His mouths are many. duty is put in his heart. He is Brahma, He is the highest Righteousness; He is existent and He is non-existent.

data.v: श्रुतिशास्त्रग्रहोपेतः षोडशर्त्विक्क्रतुश्च सः । पितामहश्च विष्णुश्च सोऽश्विनौ स पुरंदरः ॥
data.md: He is Shruti. He is the scriptures. He is Sacrificial vessels. He is the sixteen sacrificial priests. He is all the Sacrifices. He is the Grandfather (Brahman), He is Vishnu. He is the two Ashvins, and he is Purandara.

data.v: मित्रश्च वरुणश्चैव यमोऽथ धनदस्तथा । ते पृथग्दर्शनास्तस्य संविदन्ति तथैकताम् । एकस्य विद्धि देवस्य सर्वं जगदिदं वशे ॥
data.md: He is Mitra, He is Varuna, He is Yama, He is Kuvera—the lord of riches. Although the Ritwijas seem to see Him as separate, He is, however, known to them as one and the same. Know that this entire universe is under the control of One divine Being.

data.v: नानाभूतस्य दैत्येन्द्र तस्यैकत्वं वदत्ययम् । जन्तुः पश्यति ज्ञानेन ततः सत्त्वं प्रकाशते ॥
data.md: The Veda that is in the soul, O king of Daityas, regards the unity of various creates. When a living creature realizes this unity on account of true knowledge, he is then said to attain to Brahma.

data.v: संहारविक्षेपसहस्रकोटी;स्तिष्ठन्ति जीवाः प्रचरन्ति चान्ये । प्रजाविसर्गस्य च पारिमाण्यं; वापीसहस्राणि बहूनि दैत्य ॥
data.md: The period of time during which one creation exists or owing which it ceases to exist is called a Kalpa. Living creatures exist for a thousand millions of such Kalpas, Immobile creatures also exists for an equal time. The period for which a particular creation exists is measured by many thousands of lakes, O Daitya!

data.v: वाप्यः पुनर्योजनविस्तृतास्ताः; क्रोशं च गम्भीरतयावगाढाः । आयामतः पञ्चशताश्च सर्वाः; प्रत्येकशो योजनतः प्रवृद्धाः ॥
data.md: Conceive a lake that is one Yojana in width, one Krosha is depth, and five hundred Yojanas in length. Imagine many thousands of such lakes.

data.v: वाप्या जलं क्षिप्यति वालकोट्या; त्वह्ना सकृच्चाप्यथ न द्वितीयम् । तासां क्षये विद्धि कृतं विसर्गं; संहारमेकं च तथा प्रजानाम् ॥
data.md: Try then to dry up those lakes by taking from them, only once a day, as much water as may be taken up with the end of a single hair. The number of days that would be necessary to drying them up perfectly by this process forins the period that is required by the life of one creation from its beginning to the time of its destruction.

data.v: षड्जीववर्णाः परमं प्रमाणं; कृष्णो धूम्रो नीलमथास्य मध्यम् । रक्तं पुनः सह्यतरं सुखं तु; हारिद्रवर्णं सुसुखं च शुक्लम् ॥
data.md: The highest Evidence says that creatures have six colours, viz., Dark, Tawny, Blue, Red, Yellow, and White. These colours produced by mixtures in various degrees of are three qualities of Rajas, Tamas, and Sattva. Where Tamas prevents Sattva falls below the mark, and Rajas remains the same, the result is the colour called Dark. When Tamas prevails as before, but the relations between Sattva sand Rajas, are changed the result is the color called Tawny. When Rajas prevents, Sattva goes down, and Tamas remains the same, the result is the colour called Blue. When Rajas prevents as before and the proportion change between Sativa and Tamas, the result is the intermediate colour called Red. That colour is more agreeable. When Sattva prevents Rajas falls down and Tamas keeps on the same, the result is the colour called Yellow. It yields happiness. When Sativa prevails and the proportion is changed between Rajas and Tamas, the result is the colour called White. It yields great happiness.

data.v: परं तु शुक्लं विमलं विशोकं; गतक्लमं सिध्यति दानवेन्द्र । गत्वा तु योनिप्रभवानि दैत्य; सहस्रशः सिद्धिमुपैति जीवः ॥
data.md: The White is the foremost colour, It is sinless on account of its being free from attachment and aversion. It is without grief, and free from the exertion necessary by desire for action. Hence, White, O king of Danavas, brings on Liberation. O Daitya, having undergone thousands of births derived through the womb, Individual Soul attains to success.

data.v: गतिं च यां दर्शनमाह देवो; गत्वा शुभं दर्शनमेव चाह । गतिः पुनर्वर्णकृता प्रजानां; वर्णस्तथा कालकृतोऽसुरेन्द्र ॥
data.md: That success is the same end which the divine Indra declared after having studied many sacred scriptural books and which has for its essence the apprehension of the Soul. The end again that creatures obtain depends on their colour, and colour, in its turn, depends upon the character of the Time that sets in, O Daitya.

data.v: शतं सहस्राणि चतुर्दशेह; परा गतिर्जीवगुणस्य दैत्य । आरोहणं तत्कृतमेव विद्धि; स्थानं तथा निःसरणं च तेषाम् ॥
data.md: The stages of existence, O Daitya, through which individual soul must pass are not unlimited. They are fourteen hundreds of thousands in number. In consequence of them individual soul, ascends, stays, and falls down as the case may be.

data.v: कृष्णस्य वर्णस्य गतिर्निकृष्टा; स मज्जते नरके पच्यमानः । स्थानं तथा दुर्गतिभिस्तु तस्य; प्रजाविसर्गान्सुबहून्वदन्ति ॥
data.md: The end that is acquired by an individual soul of dark colour is very low, for he becomes addicted to acts leading to hell and then has to rot in hell. The learned say that on account of his wickedness, the continuance of an individual is measured by many thousands of Kalpas.

data.v: शतं सहस्राणि ततश्चरित्वा; प्राप्नोति वर्णं हरितं तु पश्चात् । स चैव तस्मिन्निवसत्यनीशो; युगक्षये तमसा संवृतात्मा ॥
data.md: Having passed many hundred thousands of years in that stage, Individual Soul then attains to the colour called Tawny. In that condition he lives in perfect helplessness. At last when his sins are spent his mind, shaking off all attachments, cherishes Renunciation.

data.v: स वै यदा सत्त्वगुणेन युक्त;स्तमो व्यपोहन्घटते स्वबुद्ध्या । स लोहितं वर्णमुपैति नीलो; मनुष्यलोके परिवर्तते च ॥
data.md: When Individual Soul becomes endued with the quality of goodness, he then dispels everything connected with Darkness by the help of his intelligence, and exerts (for acquiring what is for his good). As the outcome of this, Individual Soul attains to the colour called Red. If the quality of goodness, however, be not acquired, Individual Soul then travels in a round of re-births in the world of men having attained to the colour called Blue.

data.v: स तत्र संहारविसर्गमेव; स्वकर्मजैर्बन्धनैः क्लिश्यमानः । ततः स हारिद्रमुपैति वर्णं; संहारविक्षेपशते व्यतीते ॥
data.md: Having attained to that end, and having been afflicted for the duration of one creation by the fetters of his own acts Individual Soul then attains to the colour called Yellow (or becomes a Deity). Existing in that condition for the period of a hundred creations, he then leaves it to return to it once more.

data.v: हारिद्रवर्णस्तु प्रजाविसर्गा;न्सहस्रशस्तिष्ठति संचरन्वै । अविप्रमुक्तो निरये च दैत्य; ततः सहस्राणि दशापराणि ॥
data.md: Having acquired the Yellow colour, Individual Soul exists for thousands of Kalpas, sporting as a Deity. Without, however, being emancipated, he has to live in hell, enjoying or enduring the fruits of his acts of past Kalpas and passing through nine and then thousand courses. Know that Individual Soul then becomes freed from the hell as represented heaven. Similarly Individual Soul escapes other births.

data.v: गतीः सहस्राणि च पञ्च तस्य; चत्वारि संवर्तकृतानि चैव । विमुक्तमेनं निरयाच्च विद्धि; सर्वेषु चान्येषु च संभवेषु ॥
स देवलोके विहरत्यभीक्ष्णं; ततश्च्युतो मानुषतामुपैति । संहारविक्षेपशतानि चाष्टौ; मर्त्येषु तिष्ठन्नमृतत्वमेति ॥
data.md: Individual Soul sports for many long Kalpas in the world of Devas. Falling thence, he once more becomes a man. He then lives in that condition for the period of a hundred and cight Kalpas. He then attains once more to the a status of a Deity. If while born as a man he falls through Kala, he then sinks into the Dark colour and thus occupies the very lowest of all stages of existence. I shall tell you, now, O foremost of Asuras, how Individual Soul succeeds in bringing about his Liberation.

data.v: सोऽस्मादथ भ्रश्यति कालयोगा;त्कृष्णे तले तिष्ठति सर्वकष्टे । यथा त्वयं सिध्यति जीवलोक;स्तत्तेऽभिधास्याम्यसुरप्रवीर ॥
दैवानि स व्यूहशतानि सप्त; रक्तो हरिद्रोऽथ तथैव शुक्लः । संश्रित्य संधावति शुक्लमेत;मष्टापरानर्च्यतमान्स लोकान् ॥
data.md: Desirous of Liberation, Individual Soul relying upon seven hundred kinds of acts every one of which is permeated-by predominance of the quality of goodness, gradually passes through Red and Yellow and at last attains to White. Arrived here, Individual Soul travels through several most adorable regions which have the Eight wellknown regions of felicity beneath them, and all the while follows that pure and effulgent form existence which is Liberation,

data.v: अष्टौ च षष्टिं च शतानि यानि; मनोविरुद्धानि महाद्युतीनाम् । शुक्लस्य वर्णस्य परा गतिर्या; त्रीण्येव रुद्धानि महानुभाव ॥
data.md: Know that the Eight which are identical with the Sixty hundreds, are to those who are highly effulgent, only creations of the mind. The highest, object of acquisition with one who is of White colour, is that condition which is above the three other states of consciousness, viz., Wakefulness and Dream and Dreamless sleep.

data.v: संहारविक्षेपमनिष्टमेकं; चत्वारि चान्यानि वसत्यनीशः । षष्ठस्य वर्णस्य परा गतिर्या; सिद्धा विशिष्टस्य गतक्लमस्य ॥
data.md: As regards that Yogin who cannot renounce the joy that Yoga-power begets, he has to live (in one and the same body) for one hundred Kalpas in auspiciousness and after that in four other regions. Even that is the highest end of one belonging to the sixth colour, and who is Unsuccessful though crowned with Success, and who has gone above all attachments and passions.

data.v: सप्तोत्तरं तेषु वसत्यनीशः; संहारविक्षेपशतं सशेषम् । तस्मादुपावृत्य मनुष्यलोके; ततो महान्मानुषतामुपैति ॥
data.md: That Yogin, again, who deviates from Yoga practices lives in the celestial region for a liundred Kalpas with the unspent residue of his pristine deeds and with the seven (viz., the five senses of knowledge and mind and understanding) purged of all stains on account of their predisposition towards the quality of goodness. After that period, such a person has 10 come to the world of men where he acquires great eminence.

data.v: तस्मादुपावृत्य ततः क्रमेण; सोऽग्रे स्म संतिष्ठति भूतसर्गम् । स सप्तकृत्वश्च परैति लोका;न्संहारविक्षेपकृतप्रवासः ॥
data.md: Returning from the world of men, he departs for attaining to new forms of life that run higher and higher in the upwards scale. While engaged in this, he passes through seven regions for seven times, his power being always multiplied on account of his mental concentration and the re-awakening from it.

data.v: सप्तैव संहारमुपप्लवानि; संभाव्य संतिष्ठति सिद्धलोके । ततोऽव्ययं स्थानमनन्तमेति; देवस्य विष्णोरथ ब्रह्मणश्च । शेषस्य चैवाथ नरस्य चैव; देवस्य विष्णोः परमस्य चैव ॥
data.md: The Yogin who wishes for final Liberation suppresses by Yoga-knowledge the seven, and continues to live in the world of life, shorn of attachments, and taking those seven for certain means of grief, he renounces them and attains after wards to that state which is Indestructible and Infinite. Some, say that that is the region of Mahadeva; some of Vishnu; some, of Brahiman; some, of Cesha; some, of Nara; some, of the effulgent Intelligence; and some, of the All-pervading.

data.v: संहारकाले परिदग्धकाया; ब्रह्माणमायान्ति सदा प्रजा हि । चेष्टात्मनो देवगणाश्च सर्वे; ये ब्रह्मलोकादमराः स्म तेऽपि ॥
data.md: When universal dissolution sets in, those persons who have succeeded in completely destroying by knowledge their gross and subtle and casual bodies, always enter into Brahma. All their Senses also which have action for their essence and which are not at one with Brahma, merge into the same.

data.v: प्रजाविसर्गं तु सशेषकालं; स्थानानि स्वान्येव सरन्ति जीवाः । निःशेषाणां तत्पदं यान्ति चान्ते; सर्वापदा ये सदृशा मनुष्याः ॥
data.md: When the time of universal dissolution sets in, those Individual Souls who have acquired the position of Devas and who have an unspent residue of the fruits of acts to enjoy or endure, return to those stages of life in the subsequent Kalpa which had been theirs in the pristine one. This is owing to the likeness of every successive Kalpa to every previous one.

data.v: ये तु च्युताः सिद्धलोकात्क्रमेण; तेषां गतिं यान्ति तथानुपूर्व्या । जीवाः परे तद्बलवेषरूपा; विधिं स्वकं यान्ति विपर्ययेण ॥
data.md: Those again whose acts, at the time of universal dissolution, have been exhausted by enjoyment or endurance of their fruits, descending from heaven, are born among men, in the subsequent Kalpa, for without Knowledge one cannot dissipate his acts in even a hundred Kalpas. All superior Being again, gifted with similar powers and similar forms, revert to their respective destinies at a new creation after a universal dissolution, ascending and descending precisely in the same way as during the creation that is dissolved.

data.v: स यावदेवास्ति सशेषभुक्ते; प्रजाश्च देव्यौ च तथैव शुक्ले । तावत्तदा तेषु विशुद्धभावः; संयम्य पञ्चेन्द्रियरूपमेतत् ॥
data.md: As regards, again, the person who knows Brahma, as long as he continues to enjoy and endure the unspent residue of his deeds of pristine Kalpas, it is said that all creatures and the two pure sciences live in his body. When his Intelligence becomes purified by Yoga, and when he prastises restraint, this perceptible universe appears to him as only his own fivefold senses.

data.v: शुद्धां गतिं तां परमां परैति; शुद्धेन नित्यं मनसा विचिन्वन् । ततोऽव्ययं स्थानमुपैति ब्रह्म; दुष्प्रापमभ्येति स शाश्वतं वै । इत्येतदाख्यातमहीनसत्त्व; नारायणस्येह बलं मया ते ॥
data.md: Enquiring with a purified mind, individual soul attains to a high and pure end. Thence he attains to a spot which knows no destruction, and thence attains to eternal Brahma which is so difficult of acquisition.

data.v: एवं गते मे न विषादोऽस्ति कश्चि;त्सम्यक्च पश्यामि वचस्तवैतत् । श्रुत्वा च ते वाचमदीनसत्त्व; विकल्मषोऽस्म्यद्य तथा विपाप्मा ॥
data.md: Vritra said I see, these your words are perfectly consonant with the truth. When this is so, I have no grief. Having heard your words, O you of great mental powers, I have become freed from sorrow and sin of every sort.

data.v: प्रवृत्तमेतद्भगवन्महर्षे; महाद्युतेश्चक्रमनन्तवीर्यम् । विष्णोरनन्तस्य सनातनं त;त्स्थानं सर्गा यत्र सर्वे प्रवृत्ताः । स वै महात्मा पुरुषोत्तमो वै; तस्मिञ्जगत्सर्वमिदं प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥
data.md: O illustrious Rishi, O holy one, I see this wheel of Time, endued with great energy, of the most effulgent and Infinite Vishnu, has been set in motion. Eternal is that station from which all sorts of creation originate. That Vishnu is the Supreme Soul. He is the foremost of Beings. In Him this entire universe lives.

data.v: एवमुक्त्वा स कौन्तेय वृत्रः प्राणानवासृजत् । योजयित्वा तथात्मानं परं स्थानमवाप्तवान् ॥
data.md: Bhishma continued Having said these words, O son of Kunti, Vritra renounced his life-breaths, uniting his soul (with the Supreme Soul), and attained to highest station.

data.v: अयं स भगवान्देवः पितामह जनार्दनः । सनत्कुमारो वृत्राय यत्तदाख्यातवान्पुरा ॥
data.md: Yudhishthira said Tell me, O grandfather, whether this Janardana (Krishna) is that illustrious and powerful Lord of whom Sanatkumara spoke to Vritra in days of yore.

data.v: मूलस्थायी स भगवान्स्वेनानन्तेन तेजसा । तत्स्थः सृजति तान्भावान्नानारूपान्महातपाः ॥
data.md: Bhishma said The Highest Deity, gifted with six attributes is at the Root. Staying there, the Supreme Soul, with his own energy, creates all these various existent things.

data.v: तुरीयार्धेन तस्येमं विद्धि केशवमच्युतम् । तुरीयार्धेन लोकांस्त्रीन्भावयत्येष बुद्धिमान् ॥
data.md: Know that this Keshava who knows no decay from His eighth part. Gifted with the greatest Intelligence, it is this Keshava who creates the three worlds with an eighth portion.

data.v: अर्वाक्स्थितस्तु यः स्थायी कल्पान्ते परिवर्तते । स शेते भगवानप्सु योऽसावतिबलः प्रभुः । तान्विधाता प्रसन्नात्मा लोकांश्चरति शाश्वतान् ॥
data.md: Coming immediately after Him who lies at the Bottom, this Keshava who is eternal, changes at the end of each Kalpa, He, however, who lies at the Root and who is gifted with great might and power lies in the waters when universal dissolution sets in Keshava is that Creator of pure Soul who passes through all the eternal words.

data.v: सर्वाण्यशून्यानि करोत्यनन्तः; सनत्कुमारः संचरते च लोकान् । स चानिरुद्धः सृजते महात्मा; तत्स्थं जगत्सर्वमिदं विचित्रम् ॥
data.md: Infinite and Eternal as He is, He fills all space and passes through the universe. Freed as He is from all limitations such as the possession of attributes would imply, he allows himself to be invested with ignorance and awakened to Consciousness, Keshava of Supremne Soul creates all things. In Him rests this wonderful universe fully.

data.v: वृत्रेण परमार्थज्ञ दृष्टा मन्येऽऽत्मनो गतिः । शुभा तस्मात्स सुखितो न शोचति पितामह ॥
data.md: Yudhisthira said-O who are conversant with the highest object of knowledge, I think that Vritra behold before hand the excellent end that awaited him. It is for this, O grandfather, that he was happy and did not sucumb to grief.

data.v: शुक्लः शुक्लाभिजातीयः साध्यो नावर्ततेऽनघ । तिर्यग्गतेश्च निर्मुक्तो निरयाच्च पितामह ॥
data.md: He who is of White colour, who has taken birth in a pure or stainless family, and who has attained to the rank of a Saddhya, does not, O a sinless one, return. Such person, O grandfather, is freed from both hell and all intermediate stations,

data.v: हारिद्रवर्णे रक्ते वा वर्तमानस्तु पार्थिव । तिर्यगेवानुपश्येत कर्मभिस्तामसैर्वृतः ॥
data.md: He, however, O king, who has acquired either the Yellow or the Red colour, is seen sometimes to be overwhelmed by darkness and fall among the order of Intermediate creatures.

data.v: वयं तु भृशमापन्ना रक्ताः कष्टमुखेऽसुखे । कां गतिं प्रतिपत्स्यामो नीलां कृष्णाधमामथ ॥
data.md: As regards ourselves, we are greatly afflicted and attached to objects which produce sorrow. Alas, what will be our end? Will it be the Blue or the Dark which is the lowest of all colours.

data.v: शुद्धाभिजनसंपन्नाः पाण्डवाः संशितव्रताः । विहृत्य देवलोकेषु पुनर्मानुष्यमेष्यथ ॥
data.md: Bhishma said You are Pandavas! you have been born in a stainless family. You are of rigid vows. Having sported happily in the celestial regions, you shall return to the world of men.

data.v: प्रजाविसर्गं च सुखेन काले; प्रत्येत्य देवेषु सुखानि भुक्त्वा । सुखेन संयास्यथ सिद्धसंख्यां; मा वो भयं भूद्विमलाः स्थ सर्वे ॥
data.md: Living happily as long as the creation lasts, all of you at the next new creation will be admitted among the gods, and enjoying all sorts of happiness you will at last be coloured among the Siddhyas! Let no fear be yours. Be you cheerful.

data.v: अहो धर्मिष्ठता तात वृत्रस्यामिततेजसः । यस्य विज्ञानमतुलं विष्णोर्भक्तिश्च तादृशी ॥
data.md: How great was the love of virtue possessed by Vritra of incomparable energy, whose knowledge was incomparable and whose devotion to Vishnu was so great.

data.v: दुर्विज्ञेयमिदं तात विष्णोरमिततेजसः । कथं वा राजशार्दूल पदं तज्ज्ञातवानसौ ॥
data.md: The position occupied by Vishnu of immeasurable energy is difficult, of being perceived. How, O foremost of kings, could Vritra comprehend it?

data.v: भवता कथितं ह्येतच्छ्रद्दधे चाहमच्युत । भूयस्तु मे समुत्पन्ना बुद्धिरव्यक्तदर्शनात् ॥
data.md: You have described Vritra's acts. I too have heard you in full faith. Because, on account of my seeing that one point is unintelligible that my curiosity has been roused for asking you again.

data.v: कथं विनिहतो वृत्रः शक्रेण भरतर्षभ । धर्मिष्ठो विष्णुभक्तश्च तत्त्वज्ञश्च पदान्वये ॥
data.md: How, indeed, was Vritra, who was virtuous, devoted to Vishnu, gifted with knowledge of truth derivable from a just comprehension of the Upanishads and Vedanta, defeated by Indra, O foremost of men.

data.v: एतन्मे संशयं ब्रूहि पृच्छतो भरतर्षभ । वृत्रस्तु राजशार्दूल यथा शक्रेण निर्जितः ॥
data.md: O king of the Bharatas, remove this my doubt! Indeed, tell me, O foremost of kings, how Vritra was defeated by Shakra.

data.v: यथा चैवाभवद्युद्धं तच्चाचक्ष्व पितामह । विस्तरेण महाबाहो परं कौतूहलं हि मे ॥
data.md: O grandfather, O you of mighty arms, tell me fully how the battle took place. Great is my curiosity to hear it.

data.v: रथेनेन्द्रः प्रयातो वै सार्धं सुरगणैः पुरा । ददर्शाथाग्रतो वृत्रं विष्ठितं पर्वतोपमम् ॥
data.md: Bhishma said-In days of yore, Indra, accompanied by the celestial army, proceeded on his car, and saw the Asura Vritra stationed before him like a mountain.

data.v: योजनानां शतान्यूर्ध्वं पञ्चोच्छ्रितमरिंदम । शतानि विस्तरेणाथ त्रीण्येवाभ्यधिकानि तु ॥
data.md: He was full five hundred Yojanas in height, 0 chastiser of enemies and three hundred Yojanas in circumference.

data.v: तत्प्रेक्ष्य तादृशं रूपं त्रैलोक्येनापि दुर्जयम् । वृत्रस्य देवाः संत्रस्ता न शान्तिमुपलेभिरे ॥
data.md: Seeing that form of Vritra, which was incapable of being defeated by the three worlds united together, the celestials became stricken with fear and full of anxiety.

data.v: शक्रस्य तु तदा राजन्नूरुस्तम्भो व्यजायत । भयाद्वृत्रस्य सहसा दृष्ट्वा तद्रूपमुत्तमम् ॥
data.md: Indeed, suddenly beholding that huge form of his enemy, O king, Indra was paralysed in the lower extremities.

data.v: ततो नादः समभवद्वादित्राणां च निस्वनः । देवासुराणां सर्वेषां तस्मिन्युद्ध उपस्थिते ॥
data.md: Then, on the eve of that great battle between the gods and the demons, there arose loud peals from both sides, and drums and other musical instruments were beaten and blown.

data.v: अथ वृत्रस्य कौरव्य दृष्ट्वा शक्रमुपस्थितम् । न संभ्रमो न भीः काचिदास्था वा समजायत ॥
data.md: Seeing Indra stationed before him, you of Kuru's race, Vritra felt neither awe nor fear, nor was he disposed to collect all his energies for the battle.

data.v: ततः समभवद्युद्धं त्रैलोक्यस्य भयंकरम् । शक्रस्य च सुरेन्द्रस्य वृत्रस्य च महात्मनः ॥
data.md: Then the battle took place filling the three worlds with fear, between Indra the king of the gods and Vritra of great energy.

data.v: असिभिः पट्टिशैः शूलैः शक्तितोमरमुद्गरैः । शिलाभिर्विविधाभिश्च कार्मुकैश्च महास्वनैः ॥
data.md: The entire sky was covered by the warriors of both sides with swords, axes, lances, darts, spears and heavy clubs and rocks of various sizes and bows of loud sound and various sorts of celestial weapons and fires and burning brands.

data.v: अस्त्रैश्च विविधैर्दिव्यैः पावकोल्काभिरेव च । देवासुरैस्ततः सैन्यैः सर्वमासीत्समाकुलम् ॥
data.md: The entire sky was covered by the warriors of both sides with swords, axes, lances, darts, spears and heavy clubs and rocks of various sizes and bows of loud sound and various sorts of celestial weapons and fires and burning brands.

data.v: पितामहपुरोगाश्च सर्वे देवगणास्तथा । ऋषयश्च महाभागास्तद्युद्धं द्रष्टुमागमन् ॥
data.md: All the deities led by the Grand-father, and all the highly-blessed Rishis, came to see the battle, on their best of cars; and the Siddhas, also, O foremost of Bharata's family, and the Gandharvas, with the Apsaras, on their own beautiful and foremost of cars, came there.

data.v: विमानाग्र्यैर्महाराज सिद्धाश्च भरतर्षभ । गन्धर्वाश्च विमानाग्र्यैरप्सरोभिः समागमन् ॥
ततोऽन्तरिक्षमावृत्य वृत्रो धर्मभृतां वरः । अश्मवर्षेण देवेन्द्रं पर्वतात्समवाकिरत् ॥
data.md: Then Vritra, that foremost of virtuous persons, speedily overwhelmed the sky and the king of gods with a thick shower of rocks.

data.v: ततो देवगणाः क्रुद्धाः सर्वतः शस्त्रवृष्टिभिः । अश्मवर्षमपोहन्त वृत्रप्रेरितमाहवे ॥
data.md: Thereat, filled with ire the celestials dispelled with their showers of arrows that thick down-pour of rocks showered by Vritra in battle.

data.v: वृत्रश्च कुरुशार्दूल महामायो महाबलः । मोहयामास देवेन्द्रं मायायुद्धेन सर्वतः ॥
data.md: Then Vritra, O foremost of Kurus, endued with mighty strength and large powers of illusion, stupefied the king of illusion. was

data.v: तस्य वृत्रार्दितस्याथ मोह आसीच्छतक्रतोः । रथंतरेण तं तत्र वसिष्ठः समबोधयत् ॥
data.md: When the god of hundred sacrifices, thus afflicted by Vritra, possessed by stupefaction, the sage Vashishtha restores him to his senses by chanting Samans.

data.v: देवश्रेष्ठोऽसि देवेन्द्र सुरारिविनिबर्हण । त्रैलोक्यबलसंयुक्तः कस्माच्छक्र विषीदसि ॥
data.md: Vashishtha said You are the foremost of the gods, O chief of the gods, O destroyer of Daityas and Asuras! The strength of the three worlds lies in you! Why, then, O Shakra, do you languish so!

data.v: एष ब्रह्मा च विष्णुश्च शिवश्चैव जगत्प्रभुः । सोमश्च भगवान्देवः सर्वे च परमर्षयः ॥
data.md: See, there are Brahma and Vishnu, and Shiva, that lord of the universe, the illustrious and divine Soma, and all the great Rishis.

data.v: मा कार्षीः कश्मलं शक्र कश्चिदेवेतरो यथा । आर्यां युद्धे मतिं कृत्वा जहि शत्रुं सुरेश्वर ॥
data.md: Do not, O Indra, yield to weakness, like an ordinary mortal! Firmly determined on battle, kill your enemies, O king of the gods.

data.v: एष लोकगुरुस्त्र्यक्षः सर्वलोकनमस्कृतः । निरीक्षते त्वां भगवांस्त्यज मोहं सुरेश्वर ॥
data.md: There, that lord of all the worlds, viz., the Three-eyed (Shiva), worshipped of all the worlds, is seeing you! Shake off this stupefaction, O king of the gods.

data.v: एते ब्रह्मर्षयश्चैव बृहस्पतिपुरोगमाः । स्तवेन शक्र दिव्येन स्तुवन्ति त्वां जयाय वै ॥
data.md: There, those twice-born Rishis, headed by Brihaspati, are lauding you for your victory, in celestial hymns.

data.v: एवं संबोध्यमानस्य वसिष्ठेन महात्मना । अतीव वासवस्यासीद्बलमुत्तमतेजसः ॥
data.md: Bhishma said-While the highly energetic Vasava was thus being restored to senses by the great Vashishtha, his strength became greatly increased.

data.v: ततो बुद्धिमुपागम्य भगवान्पाकशासनः । योगेन महता युक्तस्तां मायां व्यपकर्षत ॥
data.md: The illustrious punisher of Paka then, depending upon his intelligence, had recourse to high Yoga and with its help removed these illusions of Vritra.

data.v: ततोऽङ्गिरःसुतः श्रीमांस्ते चैव परमर्षयः । दृष्ट्वा वृत्रस्य विक्रान्तमुपगम्य महेश्वरम् । ऊचुर्वृत्रविनाशार्थं लोकानां हितकाम्यया ॥
data.md: Then Brihaspati, the son of Angiras, and those greatest of Rishis endued with great prosperity, seeing the prowess of Vritra, went to Mahadeva, and moved by the desire of benefiting the three worlds, urged him to kill the great Asura.

data.v: ततो भगवतस्तेजो ज्वरो भूत्वा जगत्पतेः । समाविशन्महारौद्रं वृत्रं दैत्यवरं तदा ॥
data.md: The energy of that illustrious lord of the universe thereupon assumed the nature of a fierce fever and entered the body of Vritra the lord of Asuras.

data.v: विष्णुश्च भगवान्देवः सर्वलोकाभिपूजितः । ऐन्द्रं समाविशद्वज्रं लोकसंरक्षणे रतः ॥
data.md: The illustrious and divine Vishnu, worshipped of all the worlds, bent upon protecting the universe, entered the thunderbolt of Indra.

data.v: ततो बृहस्पतिर्धीमानुपागम्य शतक्रतुम् । वसिष्ठश्च महातेजाः सर्वे च परमर्षयः ॥
data.md: Then the highly intelligent Brihaspati and Vashishtha of great energy and all the other foremost of Rishis, going to the God of hundred sacrifices, viz., the boon-giving Vasava, the worshipped of all the worlds, said to him kill forthwith Vritra, O powerful one.

data.v: ते समासाद्य वरदं वासवं लोकपूजितम् । ऊचुरेकाग्रमनसो जहि वृत्रमिति प्रभो ॥
data.md: Then the highly intelligent Brihaspati and Vashishtha of great energy and all the other foremost of Rishis, going to the God of hundred sacrifices, viz., the boon-giving Vasava, the worshipped of all the worlds, said to him kill forthwith Vritra, O powerful one.

data.v: एष वृत्रो महाञ्शक्र बलेन महता वृतः । विश्वात्मा सर्वगश्चैव बहुमायश्च विश्रुतः ॥
data.md: Maheshvara said There, O Shakra, stands the great Vritra, accompanied by a great army. He is the soul of the universe, capable of going everywhere, gifted with great powers of illusion, and highly illustrious.

data.v: तदेनमसुरश्रेष्ठं त्रैलोक्येनापि दुर्जयम् । जहि त्वं योगमास्थाय मावमंस्थाः सुरेश्वर ॥
data.md: This foremost of Asuras is, therefore incapable of being defeated by even the threeworlds in a body. Helped by Yoga, do you kill him, O king of the celestials. Do not neglect him.

data.v: अनेन हि तपस्तप्तं बलार्थममराधिप । षष्टिं वर्षसहस्राणि ब्रह्मा चास्मै वरं ददौ ॥
data.md: O king of the celestials, Vritra had practised, for full sixty thousand years, the severest penances for acquiring strength. Brahma gave him the boons he had prayed for, viz., the greatness that belongs to Yogins, large powers of illusion, enough of might, and superabundant energy.

data.v: महत्त्वं योगिनां चैव महामायत्वमेव च । महाबलत्वं च तथा तेजश्चाग्र्यं सुरेश्वर ॥
data.md: O king of the celestials, Vritra had practised, for full sixty thousand years, the severest penances for acquiring strength. Brahma gave him the boons he had prayed for, viz., the greatness that belongs to Yogins, large powers of illusion, enough of might, and superabundant energy.

data.v: एतद्वै मामकं तेजः समाविशति वासव । वृत्रमेनं त्वमप्येवं जहि वज्रेण दानवम् ॥
data.md: I give you my energy, O Vasava! The Danava has now lost his coolness. Do you, therefore, kill him now with your thunderbolt.

data.v: भगवंस्त्वत्प्रसादेन दितिजं सुदुरासदम् । वज्रेण निहनिष्यामि पश्यतस्ते सुरर्षभ ॥
data.md: Shakra said Before your eyes, O foremost of gods, I shall, through your favour kill with my thunderbolt this invincible son Diti.

data.v: आविश्यमाने दैत्ये तु ज्वरेणाथ महासुरे । देवतानामृषीणां च हर्षान्नादो महानभूत् ॥
data.md: Bhishma said. When the great Asura or Daitya was possessed by that fever, the gods and the Rishis, filled with joy, sent up loud cheers.

data.v: ततो दुन्दुभयश्चैव शङ्खाश्च सुमहास्वनाः । मुरजा डिण्डिमाश्चैव प्रावाद्यन्त सहस्रशः ॥
data.md: At the same time drums, and conchs of loud blare, and kettle-drums and tabors in thousands began to beat and blow.

data.v: असुराणां तु सर्वेषां स्मृतिलोपोऽभवन्महान् । प्रज्ञानाशश्च बलवान्क्षणेन समपद्यत ॥
data.md: Suddenly all the Asuras lost in a body their memory. At that moment their powers of illusion, also, disappeared.

data.v: तमाविष्टमथो ज्ञात्वा ऋषयो देवतास्तथा । स्तुवन्तः शक्रमीशानं तथा प्राचोदयन्नपि ॥
data.md: Knowing the enemy to be thus possessed, the Rishis and gods lauded both Shakra and Ishana, and began to urge the former.

data.v: रथस्थस्य हि शक्रस्य युद्धकाले महात्मनः । ऋषिभिः स्तूयमानस्य रूपमासीत्सुदुर्दृशम् ॥
data.md: The form that Indra assumed on the eve of the battle, while seated on his car and while his praises were being lauded by the Rishis, became such that none could look at it without dread.

data.v: वृत्रस्य तु महाराज ज्वराविष्टस्य सर्वशः । अभवन्यानि लिङ्गानि शरीरे तानि मे शृणु ॥
data.md: Bhishma said-Hear me, O king, I describe the symptoms that appeared on the body of Vritra when he was possessed by that fever.

data.v: ज्वलितास्योऽभवद्घोरो वैवर्ण्यं चागमत्परम् । गात्रकम्पश्च सुमहाञ्श्वासश्चाप्यभवन्महान् । रोमहर्षश्च तीव्रोऽभून्निःश्वासश्च महान्नृप ॥
data.md: The heroic Asura's mouth began to send out flames of fire. He became greatly pale. His body began to tremble all over. His breath became hard.

data.v: शिवा चाशिवसंकाशा तस्य वक्त्रात्सुदारुणा । निष्पपात महाघोरा स्मृतिः सा तस्य भारत । उल्काश्च ज्वलितास्तस्य दीप्ताः पार्श्वे प्रपेदिरे ॥
data.md: His hairs stood erect. His breath was very hard. His memory, O Bharata, went out of his mouth in the shape of a dreadful, and inauspicious jackal. Burning and blazing meteors dropped on his right and left.

data.v: गृध्रकङ्कवडाश्चैव वाचोऽमुञ्चन्सुदारुणाः । वृत्रस्योपरि संहृष्टाश्चक्रवत्परिबभ्रमुः ॥
data.md: Vultures, Kankas, and cranes yelled fierce cries, as they moved over Vritra's head.

data.v: ततस्तं रथमास्थाय देवाप्यायितमाहवे । वज्रोद्यतकरः शक्रस्तं दैत्यं प्रत्यवैक्षत ॥
data.md: Then, in that battle, Indra, worshipped of the gods, and armed with the thunderbolt, looked hard at the demon as the latter sat on his car.

data.v: अमानुषमथो नादं स मुमोच महासुरः । व्यजृम्भत च राजेन्द्र तीव्रज्वरसमन्वितः । अथास्य जृम्भतः शक्रस्ततो वज्रमवासृजत् ॥
data.md: Possessed by that dreadful fever, the powerful Asura, O king, yawned and uttered inhuman cries.

data.v: स वज्रः सुमहातेजाः कालाग्निसदृशोपमः । क्षिप्रमेव महाकायं वृत्रं दैत्यमपातयत् ॥
data.md: While the Asura was yawning, Indra discharged his thunderbolt at him. Endued with great enrgy and resembling the fire that destroys the creation at the end of the cycle, that thunderbolt overthrew in a moment Vritra of gigantic form.

data.v: ततो नादः समभवत्पुनरेव समन्ततः । वृत्रं विनिहतं दृष्ट्वा देवानां भरतर्षभ ॥
data.md: The gods on all sides cried aloud when they saw Vritra killed, O foremost of Bharata's race.

data.v: वृत्रं तु हत्वा भगवान्दानवारिर्महायशाः । वज्रेण विष्णुयुक्तेन दिवमेव समाविशत् ॥
data.md: Having killed Vritra, Mghavat, that enemy of the Danavas, of great entered heaven with that thunderbolt pervaded by Vishnu,

data.v: अथ वृत्रस्य कौरव्य शरीरादभिनिःसृता । ब्रह्महत्या महाघोरा रौद्रा लोकभयावहा ॥
data.md: Just then, O you of Kuru's family, the sin of Brahmanicide, fierce and dreadful and striking all the worlds with fear, came out of the person of the killed Vritra.

data.v: करालदशना भीमा विकृता कृष्णपिङ्गला । प्रकीर्णमूर्धजा चैव घोरनेत्रा च भारत ॥
कपालमालिनी चैव कृशा च भरतर्षभ । रुधिरार्द्रा च धर्मज्ञ चीरवस्त्रनिवासिनी ॥
साभिनिष्क्रम्य राजेन्द्र तादृग्रूपा भयावहा । वज्रिणं मृगयामास तदा भरतसत्तम ॥
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य वृत्रहा कुरुनन्दन । स्वर्गायाभिमुखः प्रायाल्लोकानां हितकाम्यया ॥
data.md: A little while after, O you of Kuru's race, the killer of Vritra, for the behoof of the three worlds, was proceeding towards heaven.

data.v: बिसान्निःसरमाणं तु दृष्ट्वा शक्रं महौजसम् । कण्ठे जग्राह देवेन्द्रं सुलग्ना चाभवत्तदा ॥
data.md: Seeing Indra of great energy thus proceeding on his mission, she caught the king of the gods and from that moment stuck to him.

data.v: स हि तस्मिन्समुत्पन्ने ब्रह्महत्याकृते भये । नलिन्यां बिसमध्यस्थो बभूवाब्दगणान्बहून् ॥
data.md: When the sin of Brahmanicide thus stuck to his body and filled him with terror, Indra entered the fibres of a lotus-stalk and lived there for many years.

data.v: अनुसृत्य तु यत्नात्स तया वै ब्रह्महत्यया । तदा गृहीतः कौरव्य निश्चेष्टः समपद्यत ॥
data.md: But the sin of Brahmanicide followed him closely. Indeed, O son of Kuru, seized by her, Indra became shorn of all his energies.

data.v: तस्या व्यपोहने शक्रः परं यत्नं चकार ह । न चाशकत्तां देवेन्द्रो ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहितुम् ॥
data.md: He tried much for driving her from him, but all those attempts proved useless,

data.v: गृहीत एव तु तया देवेन्द्रो भरतर्षभ । पितामहमुपागम्य शिरसा प्रत्यपूजयत् ॥
data.md: Seized by her, O foremost of Bharata's race, the king of the gods at last presented himself before the Grandfather and adored him by bending low his head.

data.v: ज्ञात्वा गृहीतं शक्रं तु द्विजप्रवरहत्यया । ब्रह्मा संचिन्तयामास तदा भरतसत्तम ॥
data.md: Knowing that Indra was possessed by the sin of Brahmanicide, Brahman began to think, 0 best of the Bharatas, (of the measures for freeing him).

data.v: तामुवाच महाबाहो ब्रह्महत्यां पितामहः । स्वरेण मधुरेणाथ सान्त्वयन्निव भारत ॥
मुच्यतां त्रिदशेन्द्रोऽयं मत्प्रियं कुरु भामिनि । ब्रूहि किं ते करोम्यद्य कामं कं त्वमिहेच्छसि ॥
data.md: The Grandfather at last, O you of great arms, addressed Brahmanicide in sweet words as if from the desire of pacifying her, and said.-0 amiable one, let the king of the gods, who is a favourite of mine, be freed from you. Tell me, what shall I do for you? What wish of yours shall I satisfy?

data.v: त्रिलोकपूजिते देवे प्रीते त्रैलोक्यकर्तरि । कृतमेवेह मन्येऽहं निवासं तु विधत्स्व मे ॥
data.md: Brahmanicide said When the Creator of the three worlds, when the illustrious god worshipped of the universe, has been pleased with me, I consider my wishes as already fulfilled. Let my residence be now fixed.

data.v: त्वया कृतेयं मर्यादा लोकसंरक्षणार्थिना । स्थापना वै सुमहती त्वया देव प्रवर्तिता ॥
data.md: Desirous of preserving the worlds, this rule has been laid down by you. It was you, O lord, who had introduced this important rule.

data.v: प्रीते तु त्वयि धर्मज्ञ सर्वलोकेश्वरे प्रभो । शक्रादपगमिष्यामि निवासं तु विधत्स्व मे ॥
data.md: As you have been pleased with me, O righteous Lord, O powerful Master of all the worlds, I shall surely leave Shakra! But grant me an abode to live in.

data.v: तथेति तां प्राह तदा ब्रह्महत्यां पितामहः । उपायतः स शक्रस्य ब्रह्महत्यां व्यपोहत ॥
data.md: Bhishma said. The Grandfather replied to Brahmanicide, saying,-So be it! Indeed, the Grandfather found out means for removing Brahmanicide from the body of Indra.

data.v: ततः स्वयंभुवा ध्यातस्तत्र वह्निर्महात्मना । ब्रह्माणमुपसंगम्य ततो वचनमब्रवीत् ॥
प्राप्तोऽस्मि भगवन्देव त्वत्सकाशमरिंदम । यत्कर्तव्यं मया देव तद्भवान्वक्तुमर्हति ॥
बहुधा विभजिष्यामि ब्रह्महत्यामिमामहम् । शक्रस्याद्य विमोक्षार्थं चतुर्भागं प्रतीच्छ मे ॥
data.md: Bhishma said I shall divide this sin of Brahmanicide into several parts. For freeing Shakra from her, do you take a fourth portion of that sin.

data.v: मम मोक्षस्य कोऽन्तो वै ब्रह्मन्ध्यायस्व वै प्रभो । एतदिच्छामि विज्ञातुं तत्त्वतो लोकपूजित ॥
data.md: How shall I be saved from her, O Brahman? O powerful Lord, do you appoint the way. I wish to know the means fully, O worshipped of all the worlds.

data.v: यस्त्वां ज्वलन्तमासाद्य स्वयं वै मानवः क्वचित् । बीजौषधिरसैर्वह्ने न यक्ष्यति तमोवृतः ॥
तमेषा यास्यति क्षिप्रं तत्रैव च निवत्स्यति । ब्रह्महत्या हव्यवाह व्येतु ते मानसो ज्वरः ॥
data.md: That portion of Brahmanicide which you will take upon yourself shall immediately enter into, and leaving you shall live in, that man who, overwhelmed by the quality of darkness, will abstain from offering your blazing form, seeds, herbs, and juices. O carrier of oblations, let the fever of your heart be dispelled.

data.v: इत्युक्तः प्रतिजग्राह तद्वचो हव्यकव्यभुक् । पितामहस्य भगवांस्तथा च तदभूत्प्रभो ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Thus addressed by the Grandfather, the eater of oblations and sacrificial offerings accepted his order. A fourth of that sin then entered his body, O king.

data.v: ततो वृक्षौषधितृणं समाहूय पितामहः । इममर्थं महाराज वक्तुं समुपचक्रमे ॥
data.md: The Grandfather then summoned the tree, the herbs, and all sorts of grass to him, and begged them to take upon themselves a fourth of that sin.

data.v: ततो वृक्षौषधितृणं तथैवोक्तं यथातथम् । व्यथितं वह्निवद्राजन्ब्रह्माणमिदमब्रवीत् ॥
data.md: Addressed by him, the trees and herbs and grasses became as much moved as Agni had been at the command and they replied to the Grandfather, saying, How shall we, O grandfather of all the worlds, be ourselves saved from this sin? You should not afflict us that have already been assailed by the fates.

data.v: अस्माकं ब्रह्महत्यातो कोऽन्तो लोकपितामह । स्वभावनिहतानस्मान्न पुनर्हन्तुमर्हसि ॥
वयमग्निं तथा शीतं वर्षं च पवनेरितम् । सहामः सततं देव तथा छेदनभेदनम् ॥
data.md: O god, we have always to bear heat and cold and the showers driven by the winds, besides the cutting and tearing.

data.v: ब्रह्महत्यामिमामद्य भवतः शासनाद्वयम् । ग्रहीष्यामस्त्रिलोकेश मोक्षं चिन्तयतां भवान् ॥
data.md: We are willing, O lord of the three worlds, to take at your order this sin of Brahmancide. May you point out the means of our rescue.

data.v: पर्वकाले तु संप्राप्ते यो वै छेदनभेदनम् । करिष्यति नरो मोहात्तमेषानुगमिष्यति ॥
data.md: This sin that you shall take, shall assail the man who through stupefaction of judgement will cut or tear any of you on a full-moon day.

data.v: ततो वृक्षौषधितृणमेवमुक्तं महात्मना । ब्रह्माणमभिसंपूज्य जगामाशु यथागतम् ॥
data.md: Thus addressed by the great Brahman, the trees, herbs and grasses worshipped the Creator and then went away without waiting there.

data.v: आहूयाप्सरसो देवस्ततो लोकपितामहः । वाचा मधुरया प्राह सान्त्वयन्निव भारत ॥
इयमिन्द्रादनुप्राप्ता ब्रह्महत्या वराङ्गनाः । चतुर्थमस्या भागं हि मयोक्ताः संप्रतीच्छत ॥
data.md: The Grandfather of all the worlds then sent for the Apsaras and pleasing them with sweet words, O Bharata, said,-This foremost of ladies, viz., Brahmanicide, has come out of Indra's body. Begged by me, do you take a fourth part of her into your own body.

data.v: ग्रहणे कृतबुद्धीनां देवेश तव शासनात् । मोक्षं समयतोऽस्माकं चिन्तयस्व पितामह ॥
data.md: The Apsaras said O Lord of all the gods, at your command We are fully willing to take a portion of this sin. But, O Grandfather our compact is that you do think of the means by which we ourselves may be rescued from this.

data.v: रजस्वलासु नारीषु यो वै मैथुनमाचरेत् । तमेषा यास्यति क्षिप्रं व्येतु वो मानसो ज्वरः ॥
data.md: Brahman said Let the fever of your hearts be removed. The portion of this sin that you will take upon yourselves shall leave you and immediately possess that men who will seek cohabitation with women in their menses.

data.v: तथेति हृष्टमनस उक्त्वाथाप्सरसां गणाः । स्वानि स्थानानि संप्राप्य रेमिरे भरतर्षभ ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Thus addressed by the Grandfather, O foremost of Bharata's race, the various clans of the Apsaras, with delighted hearts repaired to their respective places and began to sport in joy.

data.v: ततस्त्रिलोककृद्देवः पुनरेव महातपाः । अपः संचिन्तयामास ध्यातास्ताश्चाप्यथागमन् ॥
data.md: The illustrious Creator of the three worlds, gifted with great ascetic merit, then thought of the Waters which immediately came to him.

data.v: तास्तु सर्वाः समागम्य ब्रह्माणममितौजसम् । इदमूचुर्वचो राजन्प्रणिपत्य पितामहम् ॥
data.md: Arrived before Brahman of great energy, thc Waters bowed to him and said:-We have come before you, O chastiser of enemies, at your behest! O powerful Master of all the worlds, tell us what we are to do.

data.v: इमाः स्म देव संप्राप्तास्त्वत्सकाशमरिंदम । शासनात्तव देवेश समाज्ञापय नो विभो ॥
इयं वृत्रादनुप्राप्ता पुरुहूतं महाभया । ब्रह्महत्या चतुर्थांशमस्या यूयं प्रतीच्छत ॥
data.md: Brahman said-This dreadful sin has possessed Indra on account of his having killed Vritra. Take you a fourth part of Brahmanicide.

data.v: एवं भवतु लोकेश यथा वदसि नः प्रभो । मोक्षं समयतोऽस्माकं संचिन्तयितुमर्हसि ॥
data.md: The Waters said Let it be as you order, O master of all the worlds. You should, however, O powerful Lord of ours, concert the means by which we may be rescued from this.

data.v: त्वं हि देवेश सर्वस्य जगतः परमो गुरुः । कोऽन्यः प्रसादो हि भवेद्यः कृच्छ्रान्नः समुद्धरेत् ॥
data.md: You are the Lord of all the gods, and the supreme refuge of the universe. Who else is there whom we may worship so that he may save us from distress.

data.v: अल्पा इति मतिं कृत्वा यो नरो बुद्धिमोहितः । श्लेष्ममूत्रपुरीषाणि युष्मासु प्रतिमोक्ष्यति ॥
data.md: Brahman said This one shall forthwith go to, and thenceforth live in, that man who stupefied by his understanding and regarding you lightly will throw into you phlegm and urine and excreta. It is this, verily true do I say to you, that your rescue shall be brought about.

data.v: तमेषा यास्यति क्षिप्रं तत्रैव च निवत्स्यति । तथा वो भविता मोक्ष इति सत्यं ब्रवीमि वः ॥
ततो विमुच्य देवेन्द्रं ब्रह्महत्या युधिष्ठिर । यथानिसृष्टं तं देशमगच्छद्देवशासनात् ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Then, leaving the king of the deities, the sin of Brahmanicide, O Yudhishthira, proceeded to the abodes that were settled for her at the Grandfather's behest.

data.v: एवं शक्रेण संप्राप्ता ब्रह्महत्या जनाधिप । पितामहमनुज्ञाप्य सोऽश्वमेधमकल्पयत् ॥
data.md: It was thus, O king, that Indra had become attacked by that dreadful sin. With the Grandfather's permission Indra then resolved to celebrate a Horse-sacrifice.

data.v: श्रूयते हि महाराज संप्राप्ता वासवेन वै । ब्रह्महत्या ततः शुद्धिं हयमेधेन लब्धवान् ॥
data.md: O king! It is listen to that Indra have got relieved from the sin of Brahmanicide by celebrating a Horse-sacrifice.

data.v: समवाप्य श्रियं देवो हत्वारींश्च सहस्रशः । प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे वासवः पृथिवीपते ॥
data.md: Regaining his prosperity and killing thousands of enemies, that Vasava acquired great joy, O lord of Earth.

data.v: वृत्रस्य रुधिराच्चैव खुखुण्डाः पार्थ जज्ञिरे । द्विजातिभिरभक्ष्यास्ते दीक्षितैश्च तपोधनैः ॥
data.md: From the blood of Vritra, O son of Pritha, were born high-crested cocks. Therefore, those fowls are unclean (as food) for the twice-born ones, and those ascetics that have undergone the rite of initiation.

data.v: सर्वावस्थं त्वमप्येषां द्विजातीनां प्रियं कुरु । इमे हि भूतले देवाः प्रथिताः कुरुनन्दन ॥
data.md: Under all circumstances, O king, do you encompass what is agreeable to the twice-born, for these, O king, are known as gods on Earth.

data.v: एवं शक्रेण कौरव्य बुद्धिसौक्ष्म्यान्महासुरः । उपायपूर्वं निहतो वृत्रोऽथामिततेजसा ॥
data.md: It was thus, O Kuru chief, that the powerful Asura Vritra was killed by Shakra of great energy by the help of subtle intelligence and through the application of means. son

data.v: एवं त्वमपि कौरव्य पृथिव्यामपराजितः । भविष्यसि यथा देवः शतक्रतुरमित्रहा ॥
data.md: You will, also, O of Kunti, unvanquished on Earth, become another Indra and the killer of all your enemies.

data.v: ये तु शक्रकथां दिव्यामिमां पर्वसु पर्वसु । विप्रमध्ये पठिष्यन्ति न ते प्राप्स्यन्ति किल्बिषम् ॥
data.md: Those men who, on every Parva day, will recite this sacred narrative of Vritra in the midst of Brahmanas shall never be sullied by any sin.

data.v: इत्येतद्वृत्रमाश्रित्य शक्रस्यात्यद्भुतं महत् । कथितं कर्म ते तात किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि ॥
data.md: I have now recited to you one of the greatest and most wonderful feats of Indra about Vritra, What else do you wish to hear."

data.v: पितामह महाप्राज्ञ सर्वशास्त्रविशारद । अस्ति वृत्रवधादेव विवक्षा मम जायते ॥
data.md: Yudhishthira said O grandfather you are endued with great wisdom and thoroughly grounded in every branch of learning. From this very narrative of the destruction of Vritra the wish has arisen in my mind of asking you a question.

data.v: ज्वरेण मोहितो वृत्रः कथितस्ते जनाधिप । निहतो वासवेनेह वज्रेणेति ममानघ ॥
data.md: You have said, O king, that Vritra was Stupefied by Fever, and that then, O sinless one, he was killed by Vasava with the thunderboli.

data.v: कथमेष महाप्राज्ञ ज्वरः प्रादुरभूत्कुतः । ज्वरोत्पत्तिं निपुणतः श्रोतुमिच्छाम्यहं प्रभो ॥
data.md: How did this Fever, O you of great wisdom, originale, O lord, I wish to hear fully of the origin of Fever,

data.v: शृणु राजञ्ज्वरस्येह संभवं लोकविश्रुतम् । विस्तरं चास्य वक्ष्यामि यादृशं चैव भारत ॥
data.md: Listen, O king, to the origin, known all over the world, of Fever! I shall describe fully this topic, fully explaining how Fever first came into existence, O Bharata.

data.v: पुरा मेरोर्महाराज शृङ्गं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् । ज्योतिष्कं नाम सावित्रं सर्वरत्नविभूषितम् । अप्रमेयमनाधृष्यं सर्वलोकेषु भारत ॥
data.md: In days of yore, O king, there was a summit, named Savitri, of the mountains of Meru. Adored of all the worlds, it was endued with great effulgence and adorned with every sort of jewels and gems.

data.v: तत्र देवो गिरितटे हेमधातुविभूषिते । पर्यङ्क इव विभ्राजन्नुपविष्टो बभूव ह ॥
शैलराजसुता चास्य नित्यं पार्श्वे स्थिता बभौ । तथा देवा महात्मानो वसवश्च महौजसः ॥
तथैव च महात्मानावश्विनौ भिषजां वरौ । तथा वैश्रवणो राजा गुह्यकैरभिसंवृतः ॥
यक्षाणामधिपः श्रीमान्कैलासनिलयः प्रभुः । अङ्गिरःप्रमुखाश्चैव तथा देवर्षयोऽपरे ॥
विश्वावसुश्च गन्धर्वस्तथा नारदपर्वतौ । अप्सरोगणसंघाश्च समाजग्मुरनेकशः ॥
ववौ शिवः सुखो वायुर्नानागन्धवहः शुचिः । सर्वर्तुकुसुमोपेताः पुष्पवन्तो महाद्रुमाः ॥
data.md: A pure and auspicious air carrying various sorts of perfumes, blew there. The trees that stood there were adorned with the flowers of all seasons.

data.v: तथा विद्याधराश्चैव सिद्धाश्चैव तपोधनाः । महादेवं पशुपतिं पर्युपासन्त भारत ॥
data.md: A large number of Vidyadharas, Siddhas and ascetics, too, O Bharata, went there for waiting upon Mahadeva, that Lord of all creatures.

data.v: भूतानि च महाराज नानारूपधराण्यथ । राक्षसाश्च महारौद्राः पिशाचाश्च महाबलाः ॥
data.md: Many ghosts also, of various forms and aspects, and many fearful Rakshasas and powerful Pishachas, of various forms, mad with joy, and armed with various sorts of uplifted weapons forming the train of Mahadeva, were there, every one of whom looked like a blazing fire energy.

data.v: बहुरूपधरा हृष्टा नानाप्रहरणोद्यताः । देवस्यानुचरास्तत्र तस्थिरे चानलोपमाः ॥
data.md: Many ghosts also, of various forms and aspects, and many fearful Rakshasas and powerful Pishachas, of various forms, mad with joy, and armed with various sorts of uplifted weapons forming the train of Mahadeva, were there, every one of whom looked like a blazing fire energy.

data.v: नन्दी च भगवांस्तत्र देवस्यानुमते स्थितः । प्रगृह्य ज्वलितं शूलं दीप्यमानं स्वतेजसा ॥
data.md: The illustrious Nandi stood there obeying the great god, shining with his own energy and armed with a lance that resembled a flame of fire.

data.v: गङ्गा च सरितां श्रेष्ठा सर्वतीर्थजलोद्भवा । पर्युपासत तं देवं रूपिणी कुरुनन्दन ॥
data.md: Ganga, also, that foremost of all Rivers and originating from all sacred waters in the universe, waited there in her embodied form, O son of Kuru, upon that illustrious gods.

data.v: एवं स भगवांस्तत्र पूज्यमानः सुरर्षिभिः । देवैश्च सुमहाभागैर्महादेवो व्यतिष्ठत ॥
data.md: Thus worshipped by the celestial Rishis and the gods, the illustrious Mahadeva of great energy lived on that summit of Meru.

data.v: कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य दक्षो नाम प्रजापतिः । पूर्वोक्तेन विधानेन यक्ष्यमाणोऽन्वपद्यत ॥
data.md: After sometime had gone away, the Prajapati Daksha began to celebrate a sacrifice according to ancient rites.

data.v: ततस्तस्य मखं देवाः सर्वे शक्रपुरोगमाः । गमनाय समागम्य बुद्धिमापेदिरे तदा ॥
data.md: All the gods in a body headed by Sakra, resolved to repair to that sacrifice of Daksha.

data.v: ते विमानैर्महात्मानो ज्वलितैर्ज्वलनप्रभाः । देवस्यानुमतेऽगच्छन्गङ्गाद्वारमिति श्रुतिः ॥
data.md: We have heard that the great gods ordered by Mahadeva, mounted their celestial cars resembling the fire or the Sun in sheen, and proceeded to that spot whence the Ganges is said to issue.

data.v: प्रस्थिता देवता दृष्ट्वा शैलराजसुता तदा । उवाच वचनं साध्वी देवं पशुपतिं पतिम् ॥
data.md: Seeing the deities depart, the excellent daughter of the king of mountains, addressed her divine husband, viz., the Lord of all creatures, and said, O illustrious one, who are those gods headed by Shakra going? O you who know the truth, tell me truly, for a great doubt has possessed my mind.

data.v: भगवन्क्व नु यान्त्येते देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः । ब्रूहि तत्त्वेन तत्त्वज्ञ संशयो मे महानयम् ॥
data.md: Seeing the deities depart, the excellent daughter of the king of mountains, addressed her divine husband, viz., the Lord of all creatures, and said, O illustrious one, who are those gods headed by Shakra going? O you who know the truth, tell me truly, for a great doubt has possessed my mind.

data.v: दक्षो नाम महाभागे प्रजानां पतिरुत्तमः । हयमेधेन यजते तत्र यान्ति दिवौकसः ॥
data.md: Maheshvara said 0 highly blessed lady, the excellent Prajapati Daksha is worshipping the gods in a House Sacrifice! These Dwellers of heaven are going there.

data.v: यज्ञमेतं महाभाग किमर्थं नाभिगच्छसि । केन वा प्रतिषेधेन गमनं ते न विद्यते ॥
data.md: Uma said Why, O Mahadeva do you not go to that Sacrifice? What objection is there of your going to that place?

data.v: सुरैरेव महाभागे सर्वमेतदनुष्ठितम् । यज्ञेषु सर्वेषु मम न भाग उपकल्पितः ॥
data.md: O highly blessed lady, the gods in days of yore made a compact by virtue of which no share was allotted to me of offerings in all Sacrifices.

data.v: पूर्वोपायोपपन्नेन मार्गेण वरवर्णिनि । न मे सुराः प्रयच्छन्ति भागं यज्ञस्य धर्मतः ॥
data.md: According to that arrangement, O fair one, the gods do not give me, following the old custom, any share of the sacrificial offerings!

data.v: भगवन्सर्वभूतेषु प्रभवाभ्यधिको गुणैः । अजेयश्चाप्रधृष्यश्च तेजसा यशसा श्रिया ॥
data.md: Uma said-O illustrious one, among all gods, you are the foremost in prowess. In merit, in energy, in fame, and in prosperity you are second to none, and you are, indeed superior to all.

data.v: अनेन ते महाभाग प्रतिषेधेन भागतः । अतीव दुःखमुत्पन्नं वेपथुश्च ममानघ ॥
data.md: On account, however, of this disability regarding a share I am filled with great grief, O sinless one, and a treinour fills me from head to foot.

data.v: एवमुक्त्वा तु सा देवी देवं पशुपतिं पतिम् । तूष्णींभूताभवद्राजन्दह्यमानेन चेतसा ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Having said these words to her consort, the Lord of all creatures, O monarch, the goddess Parvati remained silent, her heart burning the while in grief.

data.v: अथ देव्या मतं ज्ञात्वा हृद्गतं यच्चिकीर्षितम् । स समाज्ञापयामास तिष्ठ त्वमिति नन्दिनम् ॥
data.md: Then, understanding what was in her heart and what her thoughts were (for wiping off that disgrace), Mahadeva addressed Nandi, saying,-Wait here.

data.v: ततो योगबलं कृत्वा सर्वयोगेश्वरेश्वरः । तं यज्ञं सुमहातेजा भीमैरनुचरैस्तदा । सहसा घातयामास देवदेवः पिनाकधृक् ॥
केचिन्नादानमुञ्चन्त केचिद्धासांश्च चक्रिरे । रुधिरेणापरे राजंस्तत्राग्निं समवाकिरन् ॥
केचिद्यूपान्समुत्पाट्य बभ्रमुर्विकृताननाः । आस्यैरन्ये चाग्रसन्त तथैव परिचारकान् ॥
ततः स यज्ञो नृपते वध्यमानः समन्ततः । आस्थाय मृगरूपं वै खमेवाभ्यपतत्तदा ॥
data.md: Then thus afflicted on every side, that Sacrifice, assumed the form of a deer and tried to fly away through the firmanent.

data.v: तं तु यज्ञं तथारूपं गच्छन्तमुपलभ्य सः । धनुरादाय बाणं च तदान्वसरत प्रभुः ॥
data.md: Learning that the Sacrifice was running away in that form, the powerful Mahadeva began to pursue him with bow and sorrow.

data.v: ततस्तस्य सुरेशस्य क्रोधादमिततेजसः । ललाटात्प्रसृतो घोरः स्वेदबिन्दुर्बभूव ह ॥
data.md: On account of the ire which then filled the heart of that foremost of all gods, possessed of matchless energy, a dreadful drop of sweat appeared on his forehead.

data.v: तस्मिन्पतितमात्रे तु स्वेदबिन्दौ तथा भुवि । प्रादुर्बभूव सुमहानग्निः कालानलोपमः ॥
data.md: When the drop of sweat fell down on the Earth, there immediately appeared a blazing fire resembling the conflagration that appears at the end of the cycle.

data.v: तत्र चाजायत तदा पुरुषः पुरुषर्षभ । ह्रस्वोऽतिमात्ररक्ताक्षो हरिश्मश्रुर्विभीषणः ॥
data.md: From that fire came out a dreadful being, O king of very short stature, having blood-red cyes and a green beard.

data.v: ऊर्ध्वकेशोऽतिलोमाङ्गः श्येनोलूकस्तथैव च । करालः कृष्णवर्णश्च रक्तवासास्तथैव च ॥
data.md: His body was covered all over with hair like a hawk's or an owl's and his hair stood erect. Of dreadful form, his complexion was dark and his dress blood-red. Like a fire burning a heap of dry grass or straw, that Being of high energy speedily consumed the embodied form of Sacrifice.

data.v: तं यज्ञं स महासत्त्वोऽदहत्कक्षमिवानलः । देवाश्चाप्यद्रवन्सर्वे ततो भीता दिशो दश ॥
तेन तस्मिन्विचरता पुरुषेण विशां पते । पृथिवी व्यचलद्राजन्नतीव भरतर्षभ ॥
हाहाभूते प्रवृत्ते तु नादे लोकभयंकरे । पितामहो महादेवं दर्शयन्प्रत्यभाषत ॥
data.md: Exclamation of 'Oh' and 'Alas' arose throughout the universe. Marking this, the before powerful Grandfather, appearing Mahadeva, addressed him thus.

data.v: भवतोऽपि सुराः सर्वे भागं दास्यन्ति वै प्रभो । क्रियतां प्रतिसंहारः सर्वदेवेश्वर त्वया ॥
data.md: O powerful one, the deities will henceforth give you a share of the sacrificial offerings! O Lord of all the gods, let this anger of yours be withdrawn by you.

data.v: इमा हि देवताः सर्वा ऋषयश्च परंतप । तव क्रोधान्महादेव न शान्तिमुपलेभिरे ॥
data.md: O scorcher of enemies, there, those gods, and the Rishis, on account of your anger, O Mahadeva, have become greatly agitated.

data.v: यश्चैष पुरुषो जातः स्वेदात्ते विबुधोत्तम । ज्वरो नामैष धर्मज्ञ लोकेषु प्रचरिष्यति ॥
data.md: This Being, also, that has originated from your sweat, O foremost of gods, shall walk among creatures, O righteous-souled one, under the name of Fever.

data.v: एकीभूतस्य न ह्यस्य धारणे तेजसः प्रभो । समर्था सकला पृथ्वी बहुधा सृज्यतामयम् ॥
data.md: O powerful one, if the energy of this Being remains intact, then the entire Earth herself will not be able to bear him. Let him, therefore, be divided into many parts.

data.v: इत्युक्तो ब्रह्मणा देवो भागे चापि प्रकल्पिते । भगवन्तं तथेत्याह ब्रह्माणममितौजसम् ॥
data.md: When Brahman had said these words, and when his proper share was appointed of the sacrificial offerings, Mahadeva replied to the Grandfather of great energy, saying,-So be it.

data.v: परां च प्रीतिमगमदुत्स्मयंश्च पिनाकधृक् । अवाप च तदा भागं यथोक्तं ब्रह्मणा भवः ॥
data.md: Indeed, the holder of Pinaka, viz., Bhava, smiled and became filled with joy. And he accepted the share that the Grandfather settled the offerings in sacrifices.

data.v: ज्वरं च सर्वधर्मज्ञो बहुधा व्यसृजत्तदा । शान्त्यर्थं सर्वभूतानां शृणु तच्चापि पुत्रक ॥
data.md: Knowing the constituents of everything, Mahadeva then divided. Fever into many parts, for the peace of all creatures. Listen, O son, as how he did this.

data.v: शीर्षाभितापो नागानां पर्वतानां शिलाजतुः । अपां तु नीलिकां विद्यान्निर्मोकं भुजगेषु च ॥
खोरकः सौरभेयाणामूषरं पृथिवीतले । पशूनामपि धर्मज्ञ दृष्टिप्रत्यवरोधनम् ॥
रन्ध्रागतमथाश्वानां शिखोद्भेदश्च बर्हिणाम् । नेत्ररोगः कोकिलानां ज्वरः प्रोक्तो महात्मना ॥
अब्जानां पित्तभेदश्च सर्वेषामिति नः श्रुतम् । शुकानामपि सर्वेषां हिक्किका प्रोच्यते ज्वरः ॥
data.md: This is what we have heard. The liverdisease also of sheep, and the hiccup of parrots are also known as forms of Fever. To this must be added the toil that tigers suffer, for that also, O righteous king, is known as a forms of Fever.

data.v: शार्दूलेष्वथ धर्मज्ञ श्रमो ज्वर इहोच्यते । मानुषेषु तु धर्मज्ञ ज्वरो नामैष विश्रुतः । मरणे जन्मनि तथा मध्ये चाविशते नरम् ॥
data.md: Besides these, O Bharata, amongst men, Fever, enters all bodies at the time of birth, of death, and on other occasions.

data.v: एतन्माहेश्वरं तेजो ज्वरो नाम सुदारुणः । नमस्यश्चैव मान्यश्च सर्वप्राणिभिरीश्वरः ॥
data.md: This Fever is known to be the dreadful power of Maheshvara. He has authority over all creatures and should, therefore, be respected and adored by all.

data.v: अनेन हि समाविष्टो वृत्रो धर्मभृतां वरः । व्यजृम्भत ततः शक्रस्तस्मै वज्रमवासृजत् ॥
data.md: It was by him that Vritra, that foremost of virtuous persons, was possessed when he yawned. It was then that Shakra discharged his thunderbolt at him.

data.v: प्रविश्य वज्रो वृत्रं तु दारयामास भारत । दारितश्च स वज्रेण महायोगी महासुरः । जगाम परमं स्थानं विष्णोरमिततेजसः ॥
data.md: The thunderbolt, entering the body of Vritra, O Bharata, divided him in two parts. Divided in two by the thunderbolt, the great Asura endued with great Yoga powers, went to the region of Vishnu of great energy.

data.v: विष्णुभक्त्या हि तेनेदं जगद्व्याप्तमभूत्पुरा । तस्माच्च निहतो युद्धे विष्णोः स्थानमवाप्तवान् ॥
data.md: It was on account of his devotion to Vishnu that he had succeeded in overwhelming the whole universe. And it was owing to his devotion to Vishnu that he ascended, when killed, to the region of Vishnu.

data.v: इत्येष वृत्रमाश्रित्य ज्वरस्य महतो मया । विस्तरः कथितः पुत्र किमन्यत्प्रब्रवीमि ते ॥
data.md: Thus, O son, while describing the story of Vritra have I recited to you fully the narrative of Fever! What else shall I describe to you?

data.v: इमां ज्वरोत्पत्तिमदीनमानसः; पठेत्सदा यः सुसमाहितो नरः । विमुक्तरोगः स सुखी मुदा युतो; लभेत कामान्स यथामनीषितान् ॥
data.md: That man who will read this account of the origin of Fever with rapt attention and cheerful heart shall become free from disease and shall always have happiness for his lot. Filled with joy he shall have all his wishes gratified.

data.v: शोकाद्दुःखाच्च मृत्योश्च त्रस्यन्ति प्राणिनः सदा । उभयं मे यथा न स्यात्तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह ॥
data.md: Yudhishthira said Living creatures always dread sorrow and death. Tell me, O grandfather, how the occurrence of these two may be warded off.

data.v: अत्रैवोदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् । नारदस्य च संवादं समङ्गस्य च भारत ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Regarding it, O Bharata, is cited the old discourse between Narada and Samanga.

data.v: उरसेव प्रणमसे बाहुभ्यां तरसीव च । संप्रहृष्टमना नित्यं विशोक इव लक्ष्यसे ॥
data.md: Narada said You salute your elders by prostrating yourself on the ground till your chest touches the ground. You appear to be engaged in crossing (the river of life) with your hands. You appear to be always free from sorrow and greatly cheerful.

data.v: उद्वेगं नेह ते किंचित्सुसूक्ष्ममपि लक्षये । नित्यतृप्त इव स्वस्थो बालवच्च विचेष्टसे ॥
data.md: I do not see that have the least anxiety. You are always content and happy, and you appear to play happily like a child.

data.v: भूतं भव्यं भविष्यच्च सर्वं सत्त्वेषु मानद । तेषां तत्त्वानि जानामि ततो न विमना ह्यहम् ॥
data.md: Samanga said O giver of honours, I know the truth about the Past, the Present, and the Future. Hence I never become dispirited.

data.v: उपक्रमानहं वेद पुनरेव फलोदयान् । लोके फलानि चित्राणि ततो न विमना ह्यहम् ॥
data.md: I know also what the commencement of acts is in this world, what, of their fruits and how different are those fruits. Hence I never give way to sorrow.

data.v: अगाधाश्चाप्रतिष्ठाश्च गतिमन्तश्च नारद । अन्धा जडाश्च जीवन्ति पश्यास्मानपि जीवतः ॥
data.md: You see, O Narada, the illiterate, the destitute, the prosperous, the blind, idiots and madmen, and ourselves also, all live.

data.v: विहितेनैव जीवन्ति अरोगाङ्गा दिवौकसः । बलवन्तोऽबलाश्चैव तद्वदस्मान्सभाजय ॥
data.md: These live by virtue of their pristine deeds. The very gods, who are freed from diseases, exist by virtue of their pristine deeds. The strong and the weak, all, live by virtue of their pristine deeds. It is proper, therefore, you should regard us with respect.

data.v: सहस्रिणश्च जीवन्ति जीवन्ति शतिनस्तथा । शाकेन चान्ये जीवन्ति पश्यास्मानपि जीवतः ॥
data.md: The masters of thousands live. The master of hundreds also live. They who overwhelmed with sorrow live. See, we too are living.

data.v: यदा न शोचेमहि किं नु न स्या;द्धर्मेण वा नारद कर्मणा वा । कृतान्तवश्यानि यदा सुखानि; दुःखानि वा यन्न विधर्षयन्ति ॥
data.md: When we, O Narada. do not yield to grief, what can the practice of the duties or the observance of acts do to us? And since all joys and sorrows do not terminate, they are, therefore, unable to agitate us at all. are

data.v: यस्मै प्रज्ञां कथयन्ते मनुष्याः; प्रज्ञामूलो हीन्द्रियाणां प्रसादः । मुह्यन्ति शोचन्ति यदेन्द्रियाणि; प्रज्ञालाभो नास्ति मूढेन्द्रियस्य ॥
data.md: Indeed, the very root of wisdom, is the freedom of the senses from mistake. It is the senses which produce error and grief. One whose senses are subject to mistake can never be said to have acquired wisdom.

data.v: मूढस्य दर्पः स पुनर्मोह एव; मूढस्य नायं न परोऽस्ति लोकः । न ह्येव दुःखानि सदा भवन्ति; सुखस्य वा नित्यशो लाभ एव ॥
data.md: That pride which a man, subject to error, entertains, is only a form of the error to which he is subject. As regards the man of error, neither this world nor the next is for him. It should be remembered that griefs do not last for ever and that happiness cannot be acquired always.

data.v: भावात्मकं संपरिवर्तमानं; न मादृशः संज्वरं जातु कुर्यात् । इष्टान्भोगान्नानुरुध्येत्सुखं वा; न चिन्तयेद्दुःखमभ्यागतं वा ॥
data.md: One like me would never adopt worldly life with all its changes and painful incidents. Such a one would not care for objects of enjoyments, and would not think at all of the happiness which they yield, or, indeed, of the griefs that come on.

data.v: समाहितो न स्पृहयेत्परेषां; नानागतं नाभिनन्देत लाभम् । न चापि हृष्येद्विपुलेऽर्थलाभे; तथार्थनाशे च न वै विषीदेत् ॥
data.md: One capable of depending on his own self, would never hanker after the possessions of others; would not think of unfair gains, would not feel overjoyed at the acquisition of even immense riches; and would not give way to sorrow at the loss of riches.

data.v: न बान्धवा न च वित्तं न कौली; न च श्रुतं न च मन्त्रा न वीर्यम् । दुःखात्त्रातुं सर्व एवोत्सहन्ते; परत्र शीले न तु यान्ति शान्तिम् ॥
data.md: Neither friends, nor riches, nor high birth, nor sacred learning, nor Mantras, nor energy, can succeed in saying one from sorrow in the next world. It is only by conduct that one can acquire happiness there.

data.v: नास्ति बुद्धिरयुक्तस्य नायोगाद्विद्यते सुखम् । धृतिश्च दुःखत्यागश्चाप्युभयं नः सुखोदयम् ॥
data.md: The understanding of the man who is not acquainted with Yoga can never be directed towards Liberation. One unacquainted with Yoga can never gain happiness. Patience and the determination to shake off sorrow, these two mark the setting in of happiness.

data.v: प्रियं हि हर्षजननं हर्ष उत्सेकवर्धनः । उत्सेको नरकायैव तस्मात्तं संत्यजाम्यहम् ॥
data.md: Anything agreeable brings on pleasure. Pleasure induced pride. Pride, again, produces sorrow. For these reasons, I avoid all these.

data.v: एताञ्शोकभयोत्सेकान्मोहनान्सुखदुःखयोः । पश्यामि साक्षिवल्लोके देहस्यास्य विचेष्टनात् ॥
data.md: Grief, Fear, Pride,—these that stupefy the heart, and also Pleasure and Pain, I see as witness since my body is endued with life and moves about.

data.v: अर्थकामौ परित्यज्य विशोको विगतज्वरः । तृष्णामोहौ तु संत्यज्य चरामि पृथिवीमिमाम् ॥
data.md: Knowing both riches and pleasure, and thirst and mistake, I wander over the Earth, freed from grief and every sort of anxiety of heart.

data.v: न मृत्युतो न चाधर्मान्न लोभान्न कुतश्चन । पीतामृतस्येवात्यन्तमिह चामुत्र वा भयम् ॥
data.md: Like one that has drunk nectar I have no fear, either in this world or in the next, of death, or sin, or cupidity, or anything of that sort.

data.v: एतद्ब्रह्मन्विजानामि महत्कृत्वा तपोऽव्ययम् । तेन नारद संप्राप्तो न मां शोकः प्रबाधते ॥
data.md: I have gained this knowledge, O Brahmana, as the outcome of my severe and indestructible penances. Therefore, O Narada, even when it comes to me, cannot affect me.

data.v: अतत्त्वज्ञस्य शास्त्राणां सततं संशयात्मनः । अकृतव्यवसायस्य श्रेयो ब्रूहि पितामह ॥
data.md: Yudhishthira said Tell me, O Grandfather, what is for the behoof of one who is not acquainted with the truths of the scriptures, who is always in doubt, and who abstains from self-control and the other practices the object where of the knowledge of the Soul.

data.v: गुरुपूजा च सततं वृद्धानां पर्युपासनम् । श्रवणं चैव विद्यानां कूटस्थं श्रेय उच्यते ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Adoring the preceptor, always reverentially attending the aged, and listening to the scriptures,-these are said to be of supreme benefit.

data.v: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् । गालवस्य च संवादं देवर्षेर्नारदस्य च ॥
data.md: Regarding it is cited the old discourse between Galava and the celestial Rishi Narada.

data.v: वीतमोहक्लमं विप्रं ज्ञानतृप्तं जितेन्द्रियम् । श्रेयस्कामं जितात्मानं नारदं गालवोऽब्रवीत् ॥
data.md: Once on a time Galava, desirous of securing what was for his behoof, addressed an Narada freed from error and fatigue, well-read in scriptures, pleased with knowledge a thorough master of his senses, and with soul devoted to Yoga, and said

data.v: यैः कैश्चित्संमतो लोके गुणैस्तु पुरुषो नृषु । भवत्यनपगान्सर्वांस्तान्गुणाँल्लक्षयाम्यहम् ॥
data.md: I see, O Ascetic, those virtues by the possession of which a person is respected in the world, live permanently in you.

data.v: भवानेवंविधोऽस्माकं संशयं छेत्तुमर्हति । अमूढश्चिरमूढानां लोकतत्त्वमजानताम् ॥
data.md: You are freed from error and, therefore, you should remove the doubts that fill the minds of men like ourselves who are subject to error and who are unacquainted with truths of the world.

data.v: ज्ञाने ह्येवं प्रवृत्तिः स्यात्कार्याकार्ये विजानतः । यत्कार्यं न व्यवस्यामस्तद्भवान्वक्तुमर्हति ॥
data.md: We do not know our duties, for the injunctions of the scriptures create inclination for Knowledge simultaneously with the inclination for acts. You should describe these subject to us.

data.v: भगवन्नाश्रमाः सर्वे पृथगाचारदर्शिनः । इदं श्रेय इदं श्रेय इति नानाप्रधाविताः ॥
data.md: O illustrious one, the different modes of life approve different courses of conduct,-'This is beneficial,'_'This is beneficial',-the scriptures exhort us often in this way.

data.v: तांस्तु विप्रस्थितान्दृष्ट्वा शास्त्रैः शास्त्राभिनन्दिनः । स्वशास्त्रैः परितुष्टांश्च श्रेयो नोपलभामहे ॥
data.md: Seeing the followers of the four modes of life, who are thus exhorted by the scriptures and who fully approve of what the scriptures have sanctioned for them, Thus travelling in various courses, and beholding that ourselves also are equall; content with our own scriptures, we cannot understand what is truly wholesome.

data.v: शास्त्रं यदि भवेदेकं व्यक्तं श्रेयो भवेत्तदा । शास्त्रैश्च बहुभिर्भूयः श्रेयो गुह्यं प्रवेशितम् ॥
data.md: If the scriptures were all of one opinion, then what is truly beneficial would have become clear. On account, however, of the scriptures being multifarious, that which is truly beneficial is filled with mystery.

data.v: एतस्मात्कारणाच्छ्रेयः कलिलं प्रतिभाति माम् । ब्रवीतु भगवांस्तन्मे उपसन्नोऽस्म्यधीहि भोः ॥
data.md: For these reasons, that which is truly beneficial, appears to as full of confusion. Do you, then, O illustrious one, describe to me the subject. I have come to you (for this). Instruct me.

data.v: आश्रमास्तात चत्वारो यथासंकल्पिताः पृथक् । तान्सर्वाननुपश्य त्वं समाश्रित्यैव गालव ॥
data.md: The modes of life four in number, O child! All of them serve the object for which they have been designed; and the duties they declare differ from one another. Learning them first from competent preceptor's, reflect upon them, OGalava.

data.v: तेषां तेषां तथा हि त्वमाश्रमाणां ततस्ततः । नानारूपगुणोद्देशं पश्य विप्रस्थितं पृथक् । नयन्ति चैव ते सम्यगभिप्रेतमसंशयम् ॥
data.md: See, the merits of those modes of life, as described, are varied in their form, divergent in their matter, and contradictory in their observances.

data.v: ऋजु पश्यंस्तथा सम्यगाश्रमाणां परां गतिम् । यत्तु निःश्रेयसं सम्यक्तच्चैवासंशयात्मकम् ॥
अनुग्रहं च मित्राणाममित्राणां च निग्रहम् । संग्रहं च त्रिवर्गस्य श्रेय आहुर्मनीषिणः ॥
निवृत्तिः कर्मणः पापात्सततं पुण्यशीलता । सद्भिश्च समुदाचारः श्रेय एतदसंशयम् ॥
मार्दवं सर्वभूतेषु व्यवहारेषु चार्जवम् । वाक्चैव मधुरा प्रोक्ता श्रेय एतदसंशयम् ॥
data.md: Mildness towards all creatures, sincerity of conduct, and sweet words,-these, forsooth, constitute excellence.

data.v: देवताभ्यः पितृभ्यश्च संविभागोऽतिथिष्वपि । असंत्यागश्च भृत्यानां श्रेय एतदसंशयम् ॥
data.md: A just distribution of one's riches among the gods, the Pitris, and guests, and adherence to servants,—these, forsooth, constitute excellence.

data.v: सत्यस्य वचनं श्रेयः सत्यज्ञानं तु दुष्करम् । यद्भूतहितमत्यन्तमेतत्सत्यं ब्रवीम्यहम् ॥
data.md: Truthfulness of speech is excellent. The knowledge of truth is, however, every difficult of acquisition. I hold that as truth which is highly beneficial to creatures.

data.v: अहंकारस्य च त्यागः प्रणयस्य च निग्रहः । संतोषश्चैकचर्या च कूटस्थं श्रेय उच्यते ॥
data.md: The absence of pride, the suppression of carelessness, contentment, living by one's own self,-these form the supreme excellence.

data.v: धर्मेण वेदाध्ययनं वेदाङ्गानां तथैव च । विद्यार्थानां च जिज्ञासा श्रेय एतदसंशयम् ॥
data.md: The study of the Vedas, and their branches, according to the well-known rules, and all enquiries and pursuits leading to the acquisition of knowledge,-are, forsooth excellent.

data.v: शब्दरूपरसस्पर्शान्सह गन्धेन केवलान् । नात्यर्थमुपसेवेत श्रेयसोऽर्थी परंतप ॥
data.md: One wishing to acquire what is excellent should never enjoy to excess sound and form and taste and touch and scent, and should not enjoy them for their sake alone.

data.v: नक्तंचर्या दिवास्वप्नमालस्यं पैशुनं मदम् । अतियोगमयोगं च श्रेयसोऽर्थी परित्यजेत् ॥
data.md: Walking in the night, sleep during the day, indulgence in idleness, villainy, pride, excessive indulgence and total abstention from enjoyment in objects of the senses, should be shunned by one desirous of acquiring what is excellent.

data.v: कर्मोत्कर्षं न मार्गेत परेषां परिनिन्दया । स्वगुणैरेव मार्गेत विप्रकर्षं पृथग्जनात् ॥
data.md: One should not seek self-elevation by putting down others. Indeed, one should by his merits only seek superiority over persons who are distinguished but never over those who are inferior.

data.v: निर्गुणास्त्वेव भूयिष्ठमात्मसंभाविनो नराः । दोषैरन्यान्गुणवतः क्षिपन्त्यात्मगुणक्षयात् ॥
data.md: Men having no real merit and filled with a sense of self-admiration depreciate men of real merit, by mentioning their own virtues and riches.

data.v: अनुच्यमानाश्च पुनस्ते मन्यन्ते महाजनात् । गुणवत्तरमात्मानं स्वेन मानेन दर्पिताः ॥
data.md: Puffed up with a sense of their own importance, these men, when none stops them, consider themselves to be superior to men of real distinction.

data.v: अब्रुवन्कस्यचिन्निन्दामात्मपूजामवर्णयन् । विपश्चिद्गुणसंपन्नः प्राप्नोत्येव महद्यशः ॥
data.md: One having true wisdom and real merits, wins great fame by abstaining from speaking ill of others and from indulging in self-praise.

data.v: अब्रुवन्वाति सुरभिर्गन्धः सुमनसां शुचिः । तथैवाव्याहरन्भाति विमलो भानुरम्बरे ॥
data.md: Flowers shed their pure and sweet odour without speaking of their own excellence. Likewise, the effulgent Sun scatters his shining rays in the sky in perfect silence.

data.v: एवमादीनि चान्यानि परित्यक्तानि मेधया । ज्वलन्ति यशसा लोके यानि न व्याहरन्ति च ॥
data.md: Similarly those men shine in the world with celebrity who by the help of their intelligence, renounce these and similar other faults and who do not blaze forth their own virtues.

data.v: न लोके दीप्यते मूर्खः केवलात्मप्रशंसया । अपि चापिहितः श्वभ्रे कृतविद्यः प्रकाशते ॥
data.md: The fool can never shine in the world by speaking out his own praise. The man, however, of real merit and learning acquires celebrity even if he be hidden in a pit.

data.v: असन्नुच्चैरपि प्रोक्तः शब्दः समुपशाम्यति । दीप्यते त्वेव लोकेषु शनैरपि सुभाषितम् ॥
data.md: Evil words, uttered with what strength of voice, die out. Good words, uttered, however softly, shine forth in the world.

data.v: मूढानामवलिप्तानामसारं भाषितं बहु । दर्शयत्यन्तरात्मानं दिवा रूपमिवांशुमान् ॥
data.md: As the Sun shows his fiery form so the multitude of words, of little sense, that fools filled with vanity give vent to show their hearts.

data.v: एतस्मात्कारणात्प्रज्ञां मृगयन्ते पृथग्विधाम् । प्रज्ञालाभो हि भूतानामुत्तमः प्रतिभाति माम् ॥
data.md: For these reasons men try to acquire wisdom of various sorts. It appears to me that of all acquisitions that of wisdom is the most precious.

data.v: नापृष्टः कस्यचिद्ब्रूयान्न चान्यायेन पृच्छतः । ज्ञानवानपि मेधावी जडवल्लोकमाचरेत् ॥
data.md: One should not speak until one is asked; nor should one speak when one is asked improperly. Even if endued with intelligence and knowledge, one should still sit in silence like an idiot.

data.v: ततो वासं परीक्षेत धर्मनित्येषु साधुषु । मनुष्येषु वदान्येषु स्वधर्मनिरतेषु च ॥
data.md: One should seek to live among honest men given to righteousness and liberality and the observance of the duties of their own order,

data.v: चतुर्णां यत्र वर्णानां धर्मव्यतिकरो भवेत् । न तत्र वासं कुर्वीत श्रेयोर्थी वै कथंचन ॥
data.md: One desirous of acquiring what is excellent should never live in a place where people make a confusion of their respective duties.

data.v: निरारम्भोऽप्ययमिह यथालब्धोपजीवनः । पुण्यं पुण्येषु विमलं पापं पापेषु चाप्नुयात् ॥
data.md: A person may be seen to live who abstains from all works and who is well-content with whatever little is gained without exertion. By living amid the righteous, one succeeds in acquiring pure virtue, Similarly one by living amid the sinful, becomes sullied with sin.

data.v: अपामग्नेस्तथेन्दोश्च स्पर्शं वेदयते यथा । तथा पश्यामहे स्पर्शमुभयोः पापपुण्ययोः ॥
data.md: As the touch of water or fire or the rays of the moon immediately carry the sensation of cold or heat, similarly the impressions of virtue and vice create happiness or misery.

data.v: अपश्यन्तोऽन्नविषयं भुञ्जते विघसाशिनः । भुञ्जानं चान्नविषयान्विषयं विद्धि कर्मणाम् ॥
data.md: Those who eat Vighasa eat without marking the flavours of the foods placed before them. They, however, who eat carefully marking the flavours of the duties prepared for them, should be known as persons still fettered by the bonds of action.

data.v: यत्रागमयमानानामसत्कारेण पृच्छताम् । प्रब्रूयाद्ब्रह्मणो धर्मं त्यजेत्तं देशमात्मवान् ॥
data.md: The pious men should leave that place where a Brahmana describes duties to disciples desirous of acquiring knowledge, as based on reasons, of the Soul, but who do not reverentially enquire after such knowledge.

data.v: शिष्योपाध्यायिका वृत्तिर्यत्र स्यात्सुसमाहिता । यथावच्छास्त्रसंपन्ना कस्तं देशं परित्यजेत् ॥
data.md: Who, however, will leave that place where exists fully that conduct between disciples and preceptors which is consistent with what has been sanctioned by the scriptures?
