data.md: Through Ignorance one goes to hell. Through Darkness one attains to the status of humanity. Through Goodness people ascend to the regions of the gods and partake of great happiness.

data.v: निष्कैवल्येन पापेन तिर्यग्योनिमवाप्नुयात् । पुण्यपापेन मानुष्यं पुण्येनैकेन देवताः ॥
data.md: By sticking to sin continuously one sinks into the intermediate order of beings. By acting both virtuously and sinfully one comes by the status of humanity. By acting only righteously, one attains to the status of the gods.

data.v: एवमव्यक्तविषयं क्षरमाहुर्मनीषिणः । पञ्चविंशतिमो योऽयं ज्ञानादेव प्रवर्तते ॥
data.md: In this way the twenty-fifth, viz., (the Indestructible), the wise say, by union with the unmanifest, becomes changed into (destructible). By means of knowledge, however, the Indestructible appears in His true nature.

data.v: एवमप्रतिबुद्धत्वादबुद्धमनुवर्तते । देहाद्देहसहस्राणि तथा समभिपद्यते ॥
data.md: Vasistha said Thus on account of his forgetfulness the Soul follows Ignorance and acquires thousands of bodies one after another.

data.v: तिर्यग्योनिसहस्रेषु कदाचिद्देवतास्वपि । उपपद्यति संयोगाद्गुणैः सह गुणक्षयात् ॥
data.md: He attains to thousands of births among the intermediate orders and sometimes among the very gods on account his union with qualities.

data.v: मानुषत्वाद्दिवं याति दिवो मानुष्यमेव च । मानुष्यान्निरयस्थानमानन्त्यं प्रतिपद्यते ॥
data.md: From the status of humanity he goes to heaven and from heaven he returns to humanity, and from humanity he sinks into hell for many long years.

data.v: कोशकारो यथात्मानं कीटः समनुरुन्धति । सूत्रतन्तुगुणैर्नित्यं तथायमगुणो गुणैः ॥
data.md: As the worm that make the cocoon does itself completely on all sides by means of the threads it weaves itself, so the Soul, though in reality above all qualities, invests himself on all sides with qualities.

data.v: द्वंद्वमेति च निर्द्वंद्वस्तासु तास्विह योनिषु । शीर्षरोगेऽक्षिरोगे च दन्तशूले गलग्रहे ॥
जलोदरेऽर्शसां रोगे ज्वरगण्डविषूचिके । श्वित्रे कुष्ठेऽग्निदाहे च सिध्मापस्मारयोरपि ॥
यानि चान्यानि द्वंद्वानि प्राकृतानि शरीरिषु । उत्पद्यन्ते विचित्राणि तान्येषोऽप्यभिमन्यते । अभिमन्यत्यभीमानात्तथैव सुकृतान्यपि ॥
एकवासाश्च दुर्वासाः शायी नित्यमधस्तथा । मण्डूकशायी च तथा वीरासनगतस्तथा ॥
चीरधारणमाकाशे शयनं स्थानमेव च । इष्टकाप्रस्तरे चैव कण्टकप्रस्तरे तथा ॥
भस्मप्रस्तरशायी च भूमिशय्यानुलेपनः । वीरस्थानाम्बुपङ्के च शयनं फलकेषु च ॥
विविधासु च शय्यासु फलगृद्ध्यान्वितोऽफलः । मुञ्जमेखलनग्नत्वं क्षौमकृष्णाजिनानि च ॥
शाणीवालपरीधानो व्याघ्रचर्मपरिच्छदः । सिंहचर्मपरीधानः पट्टवासास्तथैव च ॥
कीटकावसनश्चैव चीरवासास्तथैव च । वस्त्राणि चान्यानि बहून्यभिमन्यत्यबुद्धिमान् ॥
भोजनानि विचित्राणि रत्नानि विविधानि च । एकवस्त्रान्तराशित्वमेककालिकभोजनम् ॥
चतुर्थाष्टमकालश्च षष्ठकालिक एव च । षड्रात्रभोजनश्चैव तथैवाष्टाहभोजनः ॥
सप्तरात्रदशाहारो द्वादशाहार एव च । मासोपवासी मूलाशी फलाहारस्तथैव च ॥
वायुभक्षोऽम्बुपिण्याकगोमयादन एव च । गोमूत्रभोजनश्चैव शाकपुष्पाद एव च ॥
शैवालभोजनश्चैव तथाचामेन वर्तयन् । वर्तयञ्शीर्णपर्णैश्च प्रकीर्णफलभोजनः ॥
विविधानि च कृच्छ्राणि सेवते सुखकाङ्क्षया । चान्द्रायणानि विधिवल्लिङ्गानि विविधानि च ॥
चातुराश्रम्यपन्थानमाश्रयत्याश्रमानपि । उपासीनश्च पाषण्डान्गुहाः शैलांस्तथैव च ॥
विविक्ताश्च शिलाछायास्तथा प्रस्रवणानि च । विविधानि च जप्यानि विविधानि व्रतानि च ॥
नियमान्सुविचित्रांश्च विविधानि तपांसि च । यज्ञांश्च विविधाकारान्विधींश्च विविधांस्तथा ॥
वणिक्पथं द्विजक्षत्रं वैश्यशूद्रं तथैव च । दानं च विविधाकारं दीनान्धकृपणेष्वपि ॥
data.md: The Soul considers himself as following sometimes the ways of traders and merchants and the practices of Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, Vaishyas and Shudras, and gifts of various sorts to those who are poor or blind or helpless.

data.v: अभिमन्यत्यसंबोधात्तथैव त्रिविधान्गुणान् । सत्त्वं रजस्तमश्चैव धर्मार्थौ काम एव च । प्रकृत्यात्मानमेवात्मा एवं प्रविभजत्युत ॥
data.md: On account of his being invested with Ignorance, the Soul adopts the different qualities of Goodness, Darkness and Ignorance, and Righteousness and riches and pleasure.

data.v: स्वधाकारवषट्कारौ स्वाहाकारनमस्क्रियाः । याजनाध्यापनं दानं तथैवाहुः प्रतिग्रहम् । यजनाध्ययने चैव यच्चान्यदपि किंचन ॥
data.md: Under the influence of Nature, the Soul, undergoing changes himself, observes and follows and practises all these and considers himself as such. Indeed, the Soul considers himself as employed in the utterance of the sacred Mantras Svaha, Svadha and Vashat, and in saluting those he considers as his elders; in officiating in the sacrifices and studying the scriptures, and doing all other acts and rites of this sort.

data.v: जन्ममृत्युविवादे च तथा विशसनेऽपि च । शुभाशुभमयं सर्वमेतदाहुः क्रियापथम् ॥
data.md: The Soul considers himself as connected with birth and death and quarrels and destruction. All these, the learned say form the path of acts good and bad.

data.v: प्रकृतिः कुरुते देवी महाप्रलयमेव च । दिवसान्ते गुणानेतानभ्येत्यैकोऽवतिष्ठति ॥
रश्मिजालमिवादित्यस्तत्कालेन नियच्छति । एवमेषोऽसकृत्सर्वं क्रीडार्थमभिमन्यते ॥
आत्मरूपगुणानेतान्विविधान्हृदयप्रियान् । एवमेव विकुर्वाणः सर्गप्रलयकर्मणी ॥
क्रियाक्रियापथे रक्तस्त्रिगुणस्त्रिगुणातिगः । क्रियाक्रियापथोपेतस्तथा तदिति मन्यते ॥
एवं द्वंद्वान्यथैतानि वर्तन्ते मम नित्यशः । ममैवैतानि जायन्ते बाधन्ते तानि मामिति ॥
data.md: It is on account of the Soul being invested by Nature that these pairs of opposites, productive of happiness and woe, again and again come. It is on account of this Ignorance that individual Soul considers these sorrows to be his and imagines them as following him.

data.v: निस्तर्तव्यान्यथैतानि सर्वाणीति नराधिप । मन्यतेऽयं ह्यबुद्धित्वात्तथैव सुकृतान्यपि ॥
data.md: Indeed, O king, through that Ignorance it is that Individual Soul imagines he should anyhow cross those sorrows, and that he should, going into the regions of the gods, enjoy the happiness that await all his good deeds. it is through Ignorance that he thinks he should enjoy and suffer these delights and these miserics here in this world.

data.v: भोक्तव्यानि मयैतानि देवलोकगतेन वै । इहैव चैनं भोक्ष्यामि शुभाशुभफलोदयम् ॥
data.md: Indeed, O king, through that Ignorance it is that Individual Soul imagines he should anyhow cross those sorrows, and that he should, going into the regions of the gods, enjoy the happiness that await all his good deeds. it is through Ignorance that he thinks he should enjoy and suffer these delights and these miserics here in this world.

data.v: सुखमेव च कर्तव्यं सकृत्कृत्वा सुखं मम । यावदन्तं च मे सौख्यं जात्यां जात्यां भविष्यति ॥
data.md: Through Ignorance Individual Soul thinks,-I should secure my happiness. By continually doing good deeds, I may enjoy happiness in this life till its close and shall be happy in all future lives.

data.v: भविष्यति च मे दुःखं कृतेनेहाप्यनन्तकम् । महद्दुःखं हि मानुष्यं निरये चापि मज्जनम् ॥
data.md: Through, again the evil deeds I do in this life I may suffer unending misery. The status of humanity is full of great misery, for from it one sinks into hell.

data.v: निरयाच्चापि मानुष्यं कालेनैष्याम्यहं पुनः । मनुष्यत्वाच्च देवत्वं देवत्वात्पौरुषं पुनः । मनुष्यत्वाच्च निरयं पर्यायेणोपगच्छति ॥
य एवं वेत्ति वै नित्यं निरात्मात्मगुणैर्वृतः । तेन देवमनुष्येषु निरये चोपपद्यते ॥
ममत्वेनावृतो नित्यं तत्रैव परिवर्तते । सर्गकोटिसहस्राणि मरणान्तासु मूर्तिषु ॥
य एवं कुरुते कर्म शुभाशुभफलात्मकम् । स एव फलमश्नाति त्रिषु लोकेषु मूर्तिमान् ॥
प्रकृतिः कुरुते कर्म शुभाशुभफलात्मकम् । प्रकृतिश्च तदश्नाति त्रिषु लोकेषु कामगा ॥
तिर्यग्योनौ मनुष्यत्वे देवलोके तथैव च । त्रीणि स्थानानि चैतानि जानीयात्प्राकृतानि ह ॥
अलिङ्गां प्रकृतिं त्वाहुर्लिङ्गैरनुमिमीमहे । तथैव पौरुषं लिङ्गमनुमानाद्धि पश्यति ॥
स लिङ्गान्तरमासाद्य प्राकृतं लिङ्गमव्रणम् । व्रणद्वाराण्यधिष्ठाय कर्माण्यात्मनि मन्यते ॥
श्रोत्रादीनि तु सर्वाणि पञ्च कर्मेन्द्रियाणि च । वागादीनि प्रवर्तन्ते गुणेष्वेव गुणैः सह । अहमेतानि वै कुर्वन्ममैतानीन्द्रियाणि च ॥
निरिन्द्रियोऽभिमन्येत व्रणवानस्मि निर्व्रणः । अलिङ्गो लिङ्गमात्मानमकालः कालमात्मनः ॥
असत्त्वं सत्त्वमात्मानमतत्त्वं तत्त्वमात्मनः । अमृत्युर्मृत्युमात्मानमचरश्चरमात्मनः ॥
data.md: Though having no understanding, he still considers himself as endued with it, and though above the four and twenty topics, considers himself as one included among them. Though deathless, he still considers himself as subject to death, and though motionless regards himself as having motion.

data.v: अक्षेत्रः क्षेत्रमात्मानमसर्गः सर्गमात्मनः । अतपास्तप आत्मानमगतिर्गतिमात्मनः ॥
data.md: Though not possessed of a material body, he still considers himself as possessed of one; and though unborn, he still regards himself as having birth. Though above penances, he still considers as engaged in penances, and though he has no end he still considers himself as liable to attain to ends.

data.v: अभवो भवमात्मानमभयो भयमात्मनः । अक्षरः क्षरमात्मानमबुद्धिस्त्वभिमन्यते ॥
data.md: Though not gifted with motion and birth, he still considers himself as endued with both, and though above fear, still considers himself as subject to fear. Though Indestructible, he still considers himself Destructible. Invested with Ignorance, the Soul thus thinks of himself.

data.v: एवमप्रतिबुद्धत्वादबुद्धजनसेवनात् । सर्गकोटिसहस्राणि पतनान्तानि गच्छति ॥
data.md: Yudhishthira said It is thus, on account of his Ignorance and his association with others who are invested with Ignorance, that Individual Soul passes through millions and millions of births every one of which has dissolution in the end.

data.v: धाम्ना धामसहस्राणि मरणान्तानि गच्छति । तिर्यग्योनौ मनुष्यत्वे देवलोके तथैव च ॥
data.md: On account of his transformation into Intelligence invested with Ignorance, Individual Soul goes to millions of abodes, every one of which is liable to end in Jostruction, among intermediate beings and men and the gods.

data.v: चन्द्रमा इव कोशानां पुनस्तत्र सहस्रशः । लीयतेऽप्रतिबुद्धत्वादेवमेष ह्यबुद्धिमान् ॥
data.md: On account of Ignorance, Individual Soul like the Moon, has to wax and wane thousands and thousands of times. This is truly the nature of Individual Soul when invested with Ignorance. Know that the Moon has in reality full sixteen portions. Only fifteen of these are subject to increase and decrease. The sixteenth remains constant. after the manner of the Moon, Individual Soul too has full appear and disappear. The sixteenth is subject to no change.

data.v: कलाः पञ्चदशा योनिस्तद्धाम इति पठ्यते । नित्यमेतद्विजानीहि सोमः षोडशमी कला ॥
कलायां जायतेऽजस्रं पुनः पुनरबुद्धिमान् । धाम तस्योपयुञ्जन्ति भूय एव तु जायते ॥
data.md: Invested with Ignorance, Individual Soul repeatedly and continually takes birth in the fifteen portions, named above. With the etemai and immutable portion of Individual Soul the principal elements become united and this union takes place repeatedly.

data.v: षोडशी तु कला सूक्ष्मा स सोम उपधार्यताम् । न तूपयुज्यते देवैर्देवानुपयुनक्ति सा ॥
data.md: That sixteenth portion is subtile. It should be known as Soma. It is never upheld by the senses. On the other hand, the senses are upheld by it.

data.v: एवं तां क्षपयित्वा हि जायते नृपसत्तम । सा ह्यस्य प्रकृतिर्दृष्टा तत्क्षयान्मोक्ष उच्यते ॥
data.md: Since those sixteen portions are the cause of the birth of creatures, creatures can never, O king, take birth without their help. They are called Nature. The destruction of Jiva's liability to be united with nature is called Liberation.

data.v: तदेवं षोडशकलं देहमव्यक्तसंज्ञकम् । ममायमिति मन्वानस्तत्रैव परिवर्तते ॥
पञ्चविंशस्तथैवात्मा तस्यैवा प्रतिबोधनात् । विमलस्य विशुद्धस्य शुद्धानिलनिषेवणात् ॥
अशुद्ध एव शुद्धात्मा तादृग्भवति पार्थिव । अबुद्धसेवनाच्चापि बुद्धोऽप्यबुधतां व्रजेत् ॥
तथैवाप्रतिबुद्धोऽपि ज्ञेयो नृपतिसत्तम । प्रकृतेस्त्रिगुणायास्तु सेवनात्प्राकृतो भवेत् ॥
data.md: Though, O king, free from error of every sort, yet on account of its devotion to the three qualities of Nature, it becomes endued with those attributes.

data.v: अक्षरक्षरयोरेष द्वयोः संबन्ध इष्यते । स्त्रीपुंसोर्वापि भगवन्संबन्धस्तद्वदुच्यते ॥
data.md: Janaka said O holy one, it has been said that the relation between male and female is like that which exists between the Indestructible and the Destructible.

data.v: ऋते न पुरुषेणेह स्त्री गर्भं धारयत्युत । ऋते स्त्रियं न पुरुषो रूपं निर्वर्तयेत्तथा ॥
data.md: Without a male, a female can never conceive. Without a female, a male also can never create a form.

data.v: अन्योन्यस्याभिसंबन्धादन्योन्यगुणसंश्रयात् । रूपं निर्वर्तयत्येतदेवं सर्वासु योनिषु ॥
data.md: On account of their union with each other, and each depending upon the qualities of the other, forms are seen to spring up. This is the case with all orders of being.

data.v: रत्यर्थमभिसंरोधादन्योन्यगुणसंश्रयात् । ऋतौ निर्वर्तते रूपं तद्वक्ष्यामि निदर्शनम् ॥
data.md: Through each other's union for purposes of (sexual) intercourse, and through each depending upon the qualities of the other, forms (of living creatures) flow in seasons. I shall tell you the indications thereof.

data.v: ये गुणाः पुरुषस्येह ये च मातृगुणास्तथा । अस्थि स्नायु च मज्जा च जानीमः पितृतो द्विज ॥
data.md: Hear what the qualities are which belong to the father and what those are which belong to mother. Bones, sinews, and marrow, O twiceborn one, we know, originate from the father.

data.v: त्वङ्मांसं शोणितं चैव मातृजान्यपि शुश्रुम । एवमेतद्द्विजश्रेष्ठ वेदशास्त्रेषु पठ्यते ॥
data.md: Skin, flesh, and blood, we hear, originate from the mother. Even this, O foremost of twice-born ones, is what may be read of in the Veda and other scriptures.

data.v: प्रमाणं यच्च वेदोक्तं शास्त्रोक्तं यच्च पठ्यते । वेदशास्त्रप्रमाणं च प्रमाणं तत्सनातनम् ॥
data.md: Whatever is read as said in the Vedas and in other scriptures is considered as authority. The authority, again, of the Vedas and other scriptures, is eternal.

data.v: एवमेवाभिसंबद्धौ नित्यं प्रकृतिपूरुषौ । पश्यामि भगवंस्तस्मान्मोक्षधर्मो न विद्यते ॥
data.md: If Nature and Soul be always united together in this way by each opposing and cach depending on the other's qualities, I see, O holy one, that Liberation cannot exist. You, O holy one, are gifted with spiritual vision so that you see all things as if they are present before your eyes. If, therefore, there be any direct evidence of the existence of Liberation, do speak of it to me.

data.v: अथ वानन्तरकृतं किंचिदेव निदर्शनम् । तन्ममाचक्ष्व तत्त्वेन प्रत्यक्षो ह्यसि सर्वथा ॥
मोक्षकामा वयं चापि काङ्क्षामो यदनामयम् । अदेहमजरं दिव्यमतीन्द्रियमनीश्वरम् ॥
data.md: We are desirous of acquiring Liberation. Indeed, we wish to acquire That which is auspicious, bodiless, not subject to decrepitude, eternal, beyond the perception of the senses, and having nothing superior to it.

data.v: यदेतदुक्तं भवता वेदशास्त्रनिदर्शनम् । एवमेतद्यथा चैतन्न गृह्णाति तथा भवान् ॥
data.md: Vashishtha said What you say about the characteristics of the Vedas and the other scriptures is even so. You understand those marks in the way in which they should be understood.

data.v: धार्यते हि त्वया ग्रन्थ उभयोर्वेदशास्त्रयोः । न तु ग्रन्थस्य तत्त्वज्ञो यथावत्त्वं नरेश्वर ॥
data.md: O lord of kings, you only understand aright the texts of the Vedas and other scriptures without understanding the true senses or meaning of those texts, remembering them fruitlessly.

data.v: यो हि वेदे च शास्त्रे च ग्रन्थधारणतत्परः । न च ग्रन्थार्थतत्त्वज्ञस्तस्य तद्धारणं वृथा ॥
data.md: Indeed, one who remembers a work without understanding their meaning, is said to carry an useless load. He, however, who understands the true meaning of a treatise, is said to have studied that work to purpose.

data.v: भारं स वहते तस्य ग्रन्थस्यार्थं न वेत्ति यः । यस्तु ग्रन्थार्थतत्त्वज्ञो नास्य ग्रन्थागमो वृथा ॥
data.md: Indeed, one who remembers a work without understanding their meaning, is said to carry an useless load. He, however, who understands the true meaning of a treatise, is said to have studied that work to purpose.

data.v: ग्रन्थस्यार्थं च पृष्टः संस्तादृशो वक्तुमर्हति । यथा तत्त्वाभिगमनादर्थं तस्य स विन्दति ॥
data.md: Asked about the meaning of a text, one should communicate that meaning which he has understood by a careful study.

data.v: यस्तु संसत्सु कथयेद्ग्रन्थार्थं स्थूलबुद्धिमान् । स कथं मन्दविज्ञानो ग्रन्थं वक्ष्यति निर्णयात् ॥
data.md: That person of dull intelligence who refuses to explain the meanings of text in the midst of an assemblage of the learned, that person of foolish understanding, never succeeds in explaining the meaning aright.

data.v: निर्णयं चापि छिद्रात्मा न तं वक्ष्यति तत्त्वतः । सोपहासात्मतामेति यस्माच्चैवात्मवानपि ॥
data.md: An ignorant wight, going to explain the true meaning of treatises, incurs ridicule. Even those endued with a knowledge of the Soul have to incurs ridicule on such occasions.

data.v: तस्मात्त्वं शृणु राजेन्द्र यथैतदनुदृश्यते । याथातथ्येन सांख्येषु योगेषु च महात्मसु ॥
data.md: Listen now to me, O king, as to how the subject of Liberation has been explained among the great persons conversant with the Sankhya and the Yoga Systems of Philosophy.

data.v: यदेव योगाः पश्यन्ति सांख्यैस्तदनुगम्यते । एकं सांख्यं च योगं च यः पश्यति स बुद्धिमान् ॥
data.md: That which the Yogins behold is exactly what the Sankhyas strive after to attain. He who sees the Sankhya and the Yoga Systems to be one and the same is said to be gifted with intelligence.

data.v: त्वङ्मांसं रुधिरं मेदः पित्तं मज्जास्थि स्नायु च । एतदैन्द्रियकं तात यद्भवानिदमाह वै ॥
data.md: Skin, flesh, blood, fat, bile, marrow, and sinews, and these senses, which you were speaking to me, exist.

data.v: द्रव्याद्द्रव्यस्य निष्पत्तिरिन्द्रियादिन्द्रियं तथा । देहाद्देहमवाप्नोति बीजाद्बीजं तथैव च ॥
data.md: Objects originate from objects; the senses from the senses. From body one acquires a body, as a seed is obtained from seed.

data.v: निरिन्द्रियस्याबीजस्य निर्द्रव्यस्यास्य देहिनः । कथं गुणा भविष्यन्ति निर्गुणत्वान्महात्मनः ॥
data.md: When the Supreme Being is without senses, without seed, without matter, without body, He must be divested of all qualities; and on account of His being so, how, indeed, can He have qualities of any kind?

data.v: गुणा गुणेषु जायन्ते तत्रैव निविशन्ति च । एवं गुणाः प्रकृतितो जायन्ते च न सन्ति च ॥
data.md: Ether and other qualities originate from the qualities of Goodness, Darkness, and Ignorance, and disappear in the end in them. Thus the qualities arise from Nature and disappear in Nature.

data.v: त्वङ्मांसं रुधिरं मेदः पित्तं मज्जास्थि स्नायु च । अष्टौ तान्यथ शुक्रेण जानीहि प्राकृतानि वै ॥
data.md: Skin, flesh, blood, fat, bile, marrow, and sinews, and these senses, which you were speaking to me, exist.

data.v: पुमांश्चैवापुमांश्चैव त्रैलिङ्ग्यं प्राकृतं स्मृतम् । नैव पुमान्पुमांश्चैव स लिङ्गीत्यभिधीयते ॥
data.md: The Individual Soul and the universe are said to both partake of Nature characterised by the three qualities of Goodness, Darkness, and Ignorance. The Supreme Soul is different from both the Individual Soul and the universe.

data.v: अलिङ्गा प्रकृतिर्लिङ्गैरुपलभ्यति सात्मजैः । यथा पुष्पफलैर्नित्यमृतवो मूर्तयस्तथा ॥
data.md: As the seasons, though having no forms, are nevertheless inferred from the appearance of particular fruits and flowers, similarly, Nature, though formless, is inferred from the Principles of Greatness and the rest that originate from it.

data.v: एवमप्यनुमानेन ह्यलिङ्गमुपलभ्यते । पञ्चविंशतिमस्तात लिङ्गेष्वनियतात्मकः ॥
data.md: Thus, from the existence of Consciousness in body, the Supreme Soul, shorn of all qualities whatever and perfectly stainless, is inferred.

data.v: अनादिनिधनोऽनन्तः सर्वदर्शी निरामयः । केवलं त्वभिमानित्वाद्गुणेष्वगुण उच्यते ॥
data.md: Without beginning and destruction, without end, the seer of all things, and auspicious, that Soul, only on account of its Oneness with the body and other qualities, comes to be taken as invested with qualities.

data.v: गुणा गुणवतः सन्ति निर्गुणस्य कुतो गुणाः । तस्मादेवं विजानन्ति ये जना गुणदर्शिनः ॥
data.md: Those persons who are truly conversant with qualities know that only objects endued with qualities can have attributes but that That which is above all qualities can have none.

data.v: यदा त्वेष गुणान्सर्वान्प्राकृतानभिमन्यते । तदा स गुणवानेव परमेणानुपश्यति ॥
data.md: When the Individual Soul conquers all qualities born of Nature and which it assumes under mistake, only then does it see the Supreme Soul.

data.v: यत्तद्बुद्धेः परं प्राहुः सांख्या योगाश्च सर्वशः । बुध्यमानं महाप्राज्ञमबुद्धपरिवर्जनात् ॥
अप्रबुद्धमथाव्यक्तं सगुणं प्राहुरीश्वरम् । निर्गुणं चेश्वरं नित्यमधिष्ठातारमेव च ॥
प्रकृतेश्च गुणानां च पञ्चविंशतिकं बुधाः । सांख्ययोगे च कुशला बुध्यन्ते परमैषिणः ॥
यदा प्रबुद्धास्त्वव्यक्तमवस्थाजन्मभीरवः । बुध्यमानं प्रबुध्यन्ति गमयन्ति समं तदा ॥
data.md: When men of knowledge, who stand in fear of birth, of the several states of living consciousness, and of death, succeed in knowing the Unmanifest, they succeed in understanding the Supreme Soul at the same time.

data.v: एतन्निदर्शनं सम्यगसम्यगनुदर्शनम् । बुध्यमानाप्रबुद्धाभ्यां पृथक्पृथगरिंदम ॥
data.md: An intelligent man considers the unity of the Individual Soul with the Supreme Soul as consistent with the scriptures and as perfectly correct; while the man shorn of intelligence considers the two as different from each other. This forms the distinction between the man of intelligence and the man that is shorn of it.

data.v: परस्परेणैतदुक्तं क्षराक्षरनिदर्शनम् । एकत्वमक्षरं प्राहुर्नानात्वं क्षरमुच्यते ॥
data.md: The Characteristics of both the Destructible and Indestructible have now been said to you. The indestructible is Oneness or Unity, while multiplicity or variety is said to be the Destructible.

data.v: पञ्चविंशतिनिष्ठोऽयं यदासम्यक्प्रवर्तते । एकत्वं दर्शनं चास्य नानात्वं चाप्यदर्शनम् ॥
data.md: When one begins to study and understand property the twenty-five topics of enquiry, one then understands that the oneness of the Soul is consistent with the scriptures and its multiplicity is what is opposed to them.

data.v: तत्त्वनिस्तत्त्वयोरेतत्पृथगेव निदर्शनम् । पञ्चविंशतिसर्गं तु तत्त्वमाहुर्मनीषिणः ॥
data.md: These are the several characteristics of what is included in the list of topics is beyond that number and forms and twenty-sixth. The study or comprehension of created things according to their aggregates (of five) is the study and comprehension of topics. Above these is That which is eternal.

data.v: निस्तत्त्वं पञ्चविंशस्य परमाहुर्निदर्शनम् । वर्गस्य वर्गमाचारं तत्त्वं तत्त्वात्सनातनम् ॥
data.md: These are the several characteristics of what is included in the list of topics is beyond that number and forms and twenty-sixth. The study or comprehension of created things according to their aggregates (of five) is the study and comprehension of topics. Above these is That which is eternal.

data.v: नानात्वैकत्वमित्युक्तं त्वयैतदृषिसत्तम । पश्यामि चाभिसंदिग्धमेतयोर्वै निदर्शनम् ॥
data.md: Janaka said You have, O foremost of Rishis, said that Unity is the attribute of that which is Indestructible and variety or multiplicity is the attribute of what is known as Destructible. I have not, however, clearly understood the nature of these two. Doubts are still in my mind.

data.v: तथाप्रबुद्धबुद्धाभ्यां बुध्यमानस्य चानघ । स्थूलबुद्ध्या न पश्यामि तत्त्वमेतन्न संशयः ॥
data.md: Ignorant men consider the Soul as endued with multiplicity. They, however, who are endued with knowledge and wisdom consider the Soul to be one and the same. I, however, have a very dull understanding. I am, therefore, unable to understand how all this can take place.

data.v: अक्षरक्षरयोरुक्तं त्वया यदपि कारणम् । तदप्यस्थिरबुद्धित्वात्प्रनष्टमिव मेऽनघ ॥
data.md: I have almost forgotten the causes also that you have attributed to the unity and the multiplicity of the Indestructible and the Destructible on account of the restlessness of my understanding.

data.v: तदेतच्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि नानात्वैकत्वदर्शनम् । बुद्धमप्रतिबुद्धं च बुध्यमानं च तत्त्वतः ॥
data.md: I, therefore, wish to hear you once more discourse to me on those subjects of unity and multiplicity, on him who is gifted with knowledge, on what is shorn of knowledge, on Individual Soul, Knowledge, Ignorance, on Indestructible, Destructible, and the Sankhya and the Yoga systems, in detail and separately and agreeable to the truth.

data.v: विद्याविद्ये च भगवन्नक्षरं क्षरमेव च । सांख्यं योगं च कार्त्स्न्येन पृथक्चैवापृथक्च ह ॥
हन्त ते संप्रवक्ष्यामि यदेतदनुपृच्छसि । योगकृत्यं महाराज पृथगेव शृणुष्व मे ॥
data.md: Vashishtha said I shall tell you what you ask. Listen, however, to me, O king, as I explain to you the practices of Yoga separately.

data.v: योगकृत्यं तु योगानां ध्यानमेव परं बलम् । तच्चापि द्विविधं ध्यानमाहुर्वेदविदो जनाः ॥
data.md: Contemplation, which forms an obligatory practice with Yogins, is their highest power, Those conversant with Yoga say that that Contemplation is of two sorts.

data.v: एकाग्रता च मनसः प्राणायामस्तथैव च । प्राणायामस्तु सगुणो निर्गुणो मनसस्तथा ॥
data.md: One is the concentration of the mind, and the other is called Pranayama (suppression of vital airs). Pranayama is said to be real; while concentration of mind is unsubstantial to it.

data.v: मूत्रोत्सर्गे पुरीषे च भोजने च नराधिप । त्रिकालं नाभियुञ्जीत शेषं युञ्जीत तत्परः ॥
data.md: Excepting the three times when a man passes urine and stools and eats, one should devote his entire time to contemplation.

data.v: इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेभ्यो निवर्त्य मनसा मुनिः । दशद्वादशभिर्वापि चतुर्विंशात्परं ततः ॥
data.md: Withdrawing the senses from their objects by the help of the mind, one gifted with intelligence, having made oneself pure, should, according to the twenty-two modes of transmitting the Prana breath, unite the Individual Soul with That which is above the four and twentieth topic which is regarded by the wise as living in every part of the body and as above decay and destruction.

data.v: तं चोदनाभिर्मतिमानात्मानं चोदयेदथ । तिष्ठन्तमजरं तं तु यत्तदुक्तं मनीषिभिः ॥
data.md: Withdrawing the senses from their objects by the help of the mind, one gifted with intelligence, having made oneself pure, should, according to the twenty-two modes of transmitting the Prana breath, unite the Individual Soul with That which is above the four and twentieth topic which is regarded by the wise as living in every part of the body and as above decay and destruction.

data.v: तैश्चात्मा सततं ज्ञेय इत्येवमनुशुश्रुम । द्रव्यं ह्यहीनमनसो नान्यथेति विनिश्चयः ॥
data.md: It is by means of those twenty-two modes that the Soul may always be known. It is certain that this practice of Yoga is his whose mind is never possessed by evil passions. It is not any other person's.

data.v: विमुक्तः सर्वसङ्गेभ्यो लघ्वाहारो जितेन्द्रियः । पूर्वरात्रे परे चैव धारयेत मनोऽऽत्मनि ॥
स्थिरीकृत्येन्द्रियग्रामं मनसा मिथिलेश्वर । मनो बुद्ध्या स्थिरं कृत्वा पाषाण इव निश्चलः ॥
data.md: Freed from all attachments, abstemious in diet, and controlling all the senses, one should fix his mind on the Soul, during the first and the last part of the night, after having, O king of Mithila, stopped the functions of all the senses, quieted the mind by the understanding, and assumed a posture as motionless as that of stone.

data.v: स्थाणुवच्चाप्यकम्पः स्याद्गिरिवच्चापि निश्चलः । बुधा विधिविधानज्ञास्तदा युक्तं प्रचक्षते ॥
data.md: When men of knowledge, conversant with the rules of Yoga, become as fixed as a stake of wood, and as immovable as a mountain, then they are said to be in Yoga.

data.v: न शृणोति न चाघ्राति न रस्यति न पश्यति । न च स्पर्शं विजानाति न संकल्पयते मनः ॥
data.md: When one does not hear, and smell and taste, and see; when one does not feel any touch; when one's mind is perfectly free from every purpose; when one is not conscious of any thing, when one cherishes no thought, when one becomes like a piece of wood, then is he called by the wise to be in perfect Yoga.

data.v: न चाभिमन्यते किंचिन्न च बुध्यति काष्ठवत् । तदा प्रकृतिमापन्नं युक्तमाहुर्मनीषिणः ॥
data.md: When one does not hear, and smell and taste, and see; when one does not feel any touch; when one's mind is perfectly free from every purpose; when one is not conscious of any thing, when one cherishes no thought, when one becomes like a piece of wood, then is he called by the wise to be in perfect Yoga.

data.v: निवाते च यथा दीप्यन्दीपस्तद्वत्स दृश्यते । निरिङ्गश्चाचलश्चोर्ध्वं न तिर्यग्गतिमाप्नुयात् ॥
data.md: At such a time one shines like a limp that burns in a place where blows no wind; at such a time one becomes freed even from his subtile form, and perfectly at one with Brahma. When one acquires such progress, he has no longer to ascend or to fall among intermediate beings.

data.v: तदा तमनुपश्येत यस्मिन्दृष्टे तु कथ्यते । हृदयस्थोऽन्तरात्मेति ज्ञेयो ज्ञस्तात मद्विधैः ॥
data.md: When persons like ourselves say that there has been a complete identification of Knower, the Known, and Knowledge, then is the Yogin said to see the Supreme Self.

data.v: विधूम इव सप्तार्चिरादित्य इव रश्मिमान् । वैद्युतोऽग्निरिवाकाशे दृश्यतेऽऽत्मा तथात्मनि ॥
data.md: While in Yoga, the Supreme Soul shows itself in the Yogin's heart like a burning fire, or like the bright Sun or like the lightning's spark in the firmament.

data.v: यं पश्यन्ति महात्मानो धृतिमन्तो मनीषिणः । ब्राह्मणा ब्रह्मयोनिष्ठा ह्ययोनिममृतात्मकम् ॥
data.md: That Supreme Soul which is Unborn and which is the essence of nectar, which is seen by great Brahmanas gifted with intelligence and wisdom and conversant with the Vedas, is subtiler than what is subtile and greater than what is great. That Soul, though living in all creatures, is not seen by them.

data.v: तदेवाहुरणुभ्योऽणु तन्महद्भ्यो महत्तरम् । तदन्तः सर्वभूतेषु ध्रुवं तिष्ठन्न दृश्यते ॥
data.md: That Supreme Soul which is Unborn and which is the essence of nectar, which is seen by great Brahmanas gifted with intelligence and wisdom and conversant with the Vedas, is subtiler than what is subtile and greater than what is great. That Soul, though living in all creatures, is not seen by them.

data.v: बुद्धिद्रव्येण दृश्येत मनोदीपेन लोककृत् । महतस्तमसस्तात पारे तिष्ठन्नतामसः ॥
data.md: The Creator of the worlds, He is seen only by a person gifted with wealth of intelligence when helped by the lamp of the mind. He lives on the other shore of the Darkness and is above the Ishvara.

data.v: स तमोनुद इत्युक्तस्तत्त्वज्ञैर्वेदपारगैः । विमलो वितमस्कश्च निर्लिङ्गोऽलिङ्गसंज्ञितः ॥
data.md: Persons conversant with the Vedas and endued with omniscience call Him the remover of Darkness, stainless, above Darkness, and with and without attributes.

data.v: योगमेतद्धि योगानां मन्ये योगस्य लक्षणम् । एवं पश्यं प्रपश्यन्ति आत्मानमजरं परम् ॥
data.md: This is what is called the Yoga of Yogins. What else is the mark of Yoga? By such practices do Yogins succeed in seeing the Supreme Soul that is above destruction and decay.

data.v: योगदर्शनमेतावदुक्तं ते तत्त्वतो मया । सांख्यज्ञानं प्रवक्ष्यामि परिसंख्यानिदर्शनम् ॥
data.md: This much that I have told you in detail is about the Science of Yoga. I shall now describe to you that Sankhya philosophy by which the Supreme Soul is seen through the gradual destruction of mistakes.

data.v: अव्यक्तमाहुः प्रकृतिं परां प्रकृतिवादिनः । तस्मान्महत्समुत्पन्नं द्वितीयं राजसत्तम ॥
data.md: The Sankhyas, whose System is built on Nature, say that Nature, which is Unmanifest, is the foremost. From Nature they say, O king, the second principle called Greatness is produced.

data.v: अहंकारस्तु महतस्तृतीयमिति नः श्रुतम् । पञ्च भूतान्यहंकारादाहुः सांख्यानुदर्शिनः ॥
data.md: We have heard that from Greatness originates the third principle called Consciousness. The Sankhyas blessed with sight of the Soul say that from Consciousness originate the five subtile essences of sound, form, touch, taste, and scent.

data.v: एताः प्रकृतयस्त्वष्टौ विकाराश्चापि षोडश । पञ्च चैव विशेषा वै तथा पञ्चेन्द्रियाणि च ॥
data.md: All these eight they call by the name of Nature. The changes of these eight are sixteen in number. They are the five gross essences of ether, light, earth, water and wind, and the ten senses of action and of knowledge including the mind.

data.v: एतावदेव तत्त्वानां सांख्यमाहुर्मनीषिणः । सांख्ये विधिविधानज्ञा नित्यं सांख्यपथे रताः ॥
data.md: Wise men devoted to the Sankhya path and conversant with all its ordinances, and dispensations consider these twenty-four topics as including the whole range of Sankhya enquiry. One

data.v: यस्माद्यदभिजायेत तत्तत्रैव प्रलीयते । लीयन्ते प्रतिलोमानि सृज्यन्ते चान्तरात्मना ॥
data.md: What is produced becomes merged in the producing cause. Created by the Supreme Soul after another, these principles are destroyed in a reverse order.

data.v: अनुलोमेन जायन्ते लीयन्ते प्रतिलोमतः । गुणा गुणेषु सततं सागरस्योर्मयो यथा ॥
data.md: Al every new Creation, the qualities start into being in the lateral order, and (when Destruction comes) they merge in a reverse order, like the waves of the ocean disappearing in the ocean from which they originate.

data.v: सर्गप्रलय एतावान्प्रकृतेर्नृपसत्तम । एकत्वं प्रलये चास्य बहुत्वं च यदासृजत् । एवमेव च राजेन्द्र विज्ञेयं ज्ञेयचिन्तकैः ॥
data.md: O best of kings, this is the manner in which the Creation and the Destruction of Nature takes place. The Supreme Being is all that remains when Universal destruction takes place; and it is He who assumes various forms when Creation beings.

data.v: अधिष्ठातारमव्यक्तमस्याप्येतन्निदर्शनम् । एकत्वं च बहुत्वं च प्रकृतेरनु तत्त्ववान् । एकत्वं प्रलये चास्य बहुत्वं च प्रवर्तनात् ॥
data.md: One fully conversant with the nature of the topics of enquiry knows that Nature also assumes the same sort of diversity and unity, for when Destruction comes she reverts into unity and when Creation takes place she assumes diversity of form.

data.v: बहुधात्मा प्रकुर्वीत प्रकृतिं प्रसवात्मिकाम् । तच्च क्षेत्रं महानात्मा पञ्चविंशोऽधितिष्ठति ॥
data.md: The soul makes Nature, which contains the principles of production or growth, assume various forms. Nature is called Kshetra (or soil). Above the twenty-four topics or principles is the Sour which is Great. It presides over that Nature or Kshetra.

data.v: अधिष्ठातेति राजेन्द्र प्रोच्यते यतिसत्तमैः । अधिष्ठानादधिष्ठाता क्षेत्राणामिति नः श्रुतम् ॥
data.md: Hence, O great king, the foremost Yatis say that the Soul is the Presider. Indeed, we have heard that on account of the Soul's presiding over all Kshetras. He is called the Presider.

data.v: क्षेत्रं जानाति चाव्यक्तं क्षेत्रज्ञ इति चोच्यते । अव्यक्तिके पुरे शेते पुरुषश्चेति कथ्यते ॥
data.md: And because, He knows that Unmanifest Kshetra, He is, therefore, also called Kshetrajna. And because also Soul enters into Unmanifest Kshetra (viz., the body), therefore is He called Purusha.

data.v: अन्यदेव च क्षेत्रं स्यादन्यः क्षेत्रज्ञ उच्यते । क्षेत्रमव्यक्तमित्युक्तं ज्ञाता वै पञ्चविंशकः ॥
data.md: Kshetra is something quite different from Kshetrajna. Kshetra is Unmanifest. The Soul, which is above the twenty-four principles, is called the Knower.

data.v: अन्यदेव च ज्ञानं स्यादन्यज्ज्ञेयं तदुच्यते । ज्ञानमव्यक्तमित्युक्तं ज्ञेयो वै पञ्चविंशकः ॥
data.md: Kshetra is something quite different from Kshetrajna. Kshetra is Unmanifest. The Soul, which is above the twenty-four principles, is called the Knower.

data.v: अव्यक्तं क्षेत्रमित्युक्तं तथा सत्त्वं तथेश्वरम् । अनीश्वरमतत्त्वं च तत्त्वं तत्पञ्चविंशकम् ॥
data.md: The Unmanifest is called Kshetra, understanding, and also the supreme Lord; while Purusha, which is the twenty-fifth principle has nothing superior to it and is not a principle.

data.v: सांख्यदर्शनमेतावत्परिसंख्यानदर्शनम् । सांख्यं प्रकुरुते चैव प्रकृतिं च प्रचक्षते ॥
data.md: This much, O king, is an account of the Sankhya philosophy. The Sankhyas call Nature the cause of the universe, and merging all the are grosser principles into the Intelligence beyind the Supreme Soul.

data.v: तत्त्वानि च चतुर्विंशत्परिसंख्याय तत्त्वतः । सांख्याः सह प्रकृत्या तु निस्तत्त्वः पञ्चविंशकः ॥
data.md: Rightly studying the twenty-four topics along with Nature, and determining their true nature, the Sankhyas succeed in seeing. That which is the twenty-four topics or principles.

data.v: पञ्चविंशोऽप्रबुद्धात्मा बुध्यमान इति स्मृतः । यदा तु बुध्यतेऽऽत्मानं तदा भवति केवलः ॥
data.md: Individual Soul in reality is that very Soui which is above Nature and the four and twenty topics. When he succeeds in knowing that Supreme Soul by dissociating himself from Nature, he then becomes at one with the Supreme Soul.

data.v: सम्यग्दर्शनमेतावद्भाषितं तव तत्त्वतः । एवमेतद्विजानन्तः साम्यतां प्रतियान्त्युत ॥
data.md: I have now told you everything about the Sankhya System truly. Those who conversant with this philosophy acquire tranquillity.

data.v: सम्यङ्निदर्शनं नाम प्रत्यक्षं प्रकृतेस्तथा । गुणतत्त्वान्यथैतानि निर्गुणोऽन्यस्तथा भवेत् ॥
data.md: Indeed, as men whose understandings are subject to error directly perceive all objects of the senses, so men freed from error have directly known Brahma.

data.v: न त्वेवं वर्तमानानामावृत्तिर्विद्यते पुनः । विद्यतेऽक्षरभावत्वादपरस्परमव्ययम् ॥
data.md: They who acquire that state have never to return to this world after the dissolution of their bodies; while as regards those who are said to be liberated in this life, power, concentration, and immutability, become theirs, on account of their having attained to the nature of the Indestructible.

data.v: पश्येरन्नेकमतयो न सम्यक्तेषु दर्शनम् । तेऽव्यक्तं प्रतिपद्यन्ते पुनः पुनररिंदम ॥
data.md: They who see this universe as many are said to see incorrectly. These men are blind to Brahma. O chastiser of enemies, such persons have again and again to return to the world and assume bodies.

data.v: सर्वमेतद्विजानन्तो न सर्वस्य प्रबोधनात् । व्यक्तीभूता भविष्यन्ति व्यक्तस्य वशवर्तिनः ॥
data.md: They who are conversant with all that has been said above become endued with omniscient, and accordingly when they pass from this body no longer become subject to the subjection of any more physical frames.

data.v: सर्वमव्यक्तमित्युक्तमसर्वः पञ्चविंशकः । य एनमभिजानन्ति न भयं तेषु विद्यते ॥
data.md: All things, have been said to be the result of the Unmanifest. The Soul, which is the twentyfifth, is above all things. They who know the Soul have no fear of coming back to the world.

data.v: सांख्यदर्शनमेतावदुक्तं ते नृपसत्तम । विद्याविद्ये त्विदानीं मे त्वं निबोधानुपूर्वशः ॥
data.md: I have thus described you the Sankhya Philosophy. Listen now to me as I tell you what is Vidya (Knowledge) and what is Avidya (Nescience), one after the other.

data.v: अविद्यामाहुरव्यक्तं सर्गप्रलयधर्मि वै । सर्गप्रलयनिर्मुक्तं विद्यां वै पञ्चविंशकम् ॥
data.md: The learned say that that Nature which is subject to Creation and Destruction, is called Avidya; while Purusha (Soul), who is freed from the attributes of Creation and Destruction and who is above the twenty-four topics or principles, is called Vidya.

data.v: परस्परमविद्यां वै तन्निबोधानुपूर्वशः । यथोक्तमृषिभिस्तात सांख्यस्यास्य निदर्शनम् ॥
data.md: Listen to me first as I Tell you what is Vidya among success sets of other things, as explained in the Sankhya Philosophy. essences

data.v: कर्मेन्द्रियाणां सर्वेषां विद्या बुद्धीन्द्रियं स्मृतम् । बुद्धीन्द्रियाणां च तथा विशेषा इति नः श्रुतम् ॥
data.md: Among the senses of knowledge and those of action, the senses of knowledge are said to from what is known as Vidya. Of the senses of knowledge and their objects, the former form Vidya.

data.v: विशेषाणां मनस्तेषां विद्यामाहुर्मनीषिणः । मनसः पञ्चभूतानि विद्या इत्यभिचक्षते ॥
data.md: Of objects of the senses and the mind, the wise have said that the mind forms Vidya. Of mind and the five subtile essences, the five subtile essences form Vidya.

data.v: अहंकारस्तु भूतानां पञ्चानां नात्र संशयः । अहंकारस्य च तथा बुद्धिर्विद्या नरेश्वर ॥
data.md: Of the five subtile and Consciousness, Consciousness forms vidya. Of Consciousness and Greatness the latter O king, is Vidya.

data.v: बुद्धेः प्रकृतिरव्यक्तं तत्त्वानां परमेश्वरम् । विद्या ज्ञेया नरश्रेष्ठ विधिश्च परमः स्मृतः ॥
data.md: Of all the principles beginning with Greatness, and Nature, it is Nature, which is unmanifest and supreme, that is called Vidya. Of Nature, and that called Creator which is Supreme, the latter should be known as Vidya.

data.v: अव्यक्तस्य परं प्राहुर्विद्यां वै पञ्चविंशकम् । सर्वस्य सर्वमित्युक्तं ज्ञेयं ज्ञानस्य पार्थिव ॥
data.md: Above Nature is the twenty-fifth (Soul) who should be known as Vidya. Of all Knowledge, that which is the Object of Knowledge has been said to be the Unmanifest, O king.

data.v: ज्ञानमव्यक्तमित्युक्तं ज्ञेयं वै पञ्चविंशकम् । तथैव ज्ञानमव्यक्तं विज्ञाता पञ्चविंशकः ॥
data.md: Again, Knowledge has been said to be Unmanifest, and the Object of knowledge to be what is above the four and twenty. Once more, Knowledge has been said to be Unmanifest, and the Knower is what is above the four and twenty. I have now told you what is truly the meaning of Vidya and Avidya.

data.v: विद्याविद्यार्थतत्त्वेन मयोक्तं ते विशेषतः । अक्षरं च क्षरं चैव यदुक्तं तन्निबोध मे ॥
उभावेतौ क्षरावुक्तावुभावेतौ च नक्षरौ । कारणं तु प्रवक्ष्यामि यथा ख्यातौ तु तत्त्वतः ॥
अनादिनिधनावेतावुभावेवेश्वरौ मतौ । तत्त्वसंज्ञावुभावेतौ प्रोच्येते ज्ञानचिन्तकैः ॥
सर्गप्रलयधर्मित्वादव्यक्तं प्राहुरक्षरम् । तदेतद्गुणसर्गाय विकुर्वाणं पुनः पुनः ॥
data.md: Those who are endued with knowledge say that both are to be called principles. On account of its attributes of Creation and Destruction, the Unmanifest is called Indestructible. That Unmanifest becomes repeatedly modified for the purpose of creating the principles.

data.v: गुणानां महदादीनामुत्पद्यति परस्परम् । अधिष्ठानात्क्षेत्रमाहुरेतत्तत्पञ्चविंशकम् ॥
data.md: And because the principles beginning with Greatness are produced by Purusha (Soul) as well, and because also Purusha and the Unmanifest mutually depend upon each other, therefore is Purusha also, the twenty-fifth, called Kshetra.

data.v: यदा तु गुणजालं तदव्यक्तात्मनि संक्षिपेत् । तदा सह गुणैस्तैस्तु पञ्चविंशो विलीयते ॥
data.md: When the Yogin withdraws and merges all the principles into the Unmanifest Soul (or Brahma), then the twenty-fifth (viz., Soul or Purusha) also, with all those principles, disappears into it.

data.v: गुणा गुणेषु लीयन्ते तदैका प्रकृतिर्भवेत् । क्षेत्रज्ञोऽपि यदा तात तत्क्षेत्रे संप्रलीयते ॥
data.md: When the principles become merged each into its creator, then the one that remains is Nature. When Soul, too, O son, becomes merged into his own producing cause, then Nature with all the principles in it becomes subject to destruction and attains also to the condition of being without attributes on account of her dissociation from all principles.

data.v: तदाक्षरत्वं प्रकृतिर्गच्छते गुणसंज्ञिता । निर्गुणत्वं च वैदेह गुणेषु प्रतिवर्तनात् ॥
एवमेव च क्षेत्रज्ञः क्षेत्रज्ञानपरिक्षये । प्रकृत्या निर्गुणस्त्वेष इत्येवमनुशुश्रुम ॥
data.md: Thus it is that Soul, when his knowledge of Soil disappears, becomes, by his nature, shorn of qualities. We have heard it.

data.v: क्षरो भवत्येष यदा तदा गुणवतीमथ । प्रकृतिं त्वभिजानाति निर्गुणत्वं तथात्मनः ॥
data.md: We he becomes destructible he then assurnes attributes. When, however, he gains his own real nature, he then succeeds in understanding his own condition of being really shorn of qualities.

data.v: तदा विशुद्धो भवति प्रकृतेः परिवर्जनात् । अन्योऽहमन्येयमिति यदा बुध्यति बुद्धिमान् ॥
data.md: By shaking off Nature and beginning to realise that he is different from her, the intelligent Soul then comes to be regarded as pure and stainless.

data.v: तदैषोऽन्यत्वतामेति न च मिश्रत्वमाव्रजेत् । प्रकृत्या चैव राजेन्द्र नमिश्रोऽन्यश्च दृश्यते ॥
data.md: When Individual Soul ceases to exist in a state of union with Nature, then does he become at one with Brahima. When however, he exists united with Nature, he then, O king, seems to be different from Brahma.

data.v: यदा तु गुणजालं तत्प्राकृतं विजुगुप्सते । पश्यते चापरं पश्यं तदा पश्यन्न संज्वरेत् ॥
data.md: Indeed, when Individual Soul shows no affection for Nature and her principles, he then succeeds in seeing the Supreme and having once seen Him wishes not to lose that happiness.

data.v: किं मया कृतमेतावद्योऽहं कालमिमं जनम् । मत्स्यो जालं ह्यविज्ञानादनुवर्तितवांस्तथा ॥
data.md: When the Knowledge of truth comes to him, Individual Soul begins to lament thus:-Alas, how foolishly have I acted by falling through ignorance into this frame composed of nature like a fish entangled in a net.

data.v: अहमेव हि संमोहादन्यमन्यं जनाज्जनम् । मत्स्यो यथोदकज्ञानादनुवर्तितवानिह ॥
data.md: Alas, through Ignorance, I have inigrated from body to body like a fish from water to water thinking that water along is the element in which it can dwell.

data.v: मत्स्योऽन्यत्वं यथाज्ञानादुदकान्नाभिमन्यते । आत्मानं तद्वदज्ञानादन्यत्वं चैव वेद्म्यहम् ॥
data.md: Indeed, like a fish that does not know anything else than water to be its element, I also have never known anything else than children and wives to be my own!

data.v: ममास्तु धिगबुद्धस्य योऽहं मग्नमिमं पुनः । अनुवर्तितवान्मोहादन्यमन्यं जनाज्जनम् ॥
data.md: Fie on me that, through ignorance, am repeatedly passing from body to body in forgetfulness.

data.v: अयमत्र भवेद्बन्धुरनेन सह मोक्षणम् । साम्यमेकत्वमायातो यादृशस्तादृशस्त्वहम् ॥
data.md: The Supreme Soul alone is my friend. I can make friendship with Him. Whatever be my nature and whoever I may be, I am capable to be like Him and can become at one with Him.

data.v: तुल्यतामिह पश्यामि सदृशोऽहमनेन वै । अयं हि विमलो व्यक्तमहमीदृशकस्तथा ॥
data.md: I see my similarity with Him. I am, indeed, like Him. He is pure. It is clear that I am of the same nature.

data.v: योऽहमज्ञानसंमोहादज्ञया संप्रवृत्तवान् । ससङ्गयाहं निःसङ्गः स्थितः कालमिमं त्वहम् ॥
data.md: Through Ignorance and stupefaction, I have becoine associated with Inanimate Nature. Though really shorn of attachments, I have passed this long time in a state of attachment with Nature.

data.v: अनयाहं वशीभूतः कालमेतं न बुद्धवान् । उच्चमध्यमनीचानां तामहं कथमावसे ॥
data.md: Alas, by her was I so long controlled without having been able to know it. Various are the forms,-high, middling, and low,-that Nature assumes. Oh, how shall I like in those forms?

data.v: समानयानया चेह सहवासमहं कथम् । गच्छाम्यबुद्धभावत्वादेषेदानीं स्थिरो भवे ॥
data.md: How shall I live conjointly with her? On account of my ignorance I repair to her companionship. I shall now be fixed.

data.v: सहवासं न यास्यामि कालमेतद्धि वञ्चनात् । वञ्चितोऽस्म्यनया यद्धि निर्विकारो विकारया ॥
data.md: I shall no longer keep her company. For having passed so long a time with her, I should think that I was so long imposed on by her, for myself being really freed form change, how could I keep company with one who is subject to change.

data.v: न चायमपराधोऽस्या अपराधो ह्ययं मम । योऽहमत्राभवं सक्तः पराङ्मुखमुपस्थितः ॥
data.md: She cannot be held responsible for this. The responsibility is mine, since turning away from the Supreme Soul became of my own accord attached to her,

data.v: ततोऽस्मि बहुरूपासु स्थितो मूर्तिष्वमूर्तिमान् । अमूर्तश्चापि मूर्तात्मा ममत्वेन प्रधर्षितः ॥
data.md: On account of that attachment, myself, though without form in reality, had to live in various forms. Indeed, though without forın by nature I become endued with forms on account of my notion of Egoism, and thereby insulted and distressed.

data.v: प्रकृतेरनयत्वेन तासु तास्विह योनिषु । निर्ममस्य ममत्वेन किं कृतं तासु तासु च । योनीषु वर्तमानेन नष्टसंज्ञेन चेतसा ॥
न ममात्रानया कार्यमहंकारकृतात्मया । आत्मानं बहुधा कृत्वा येयं भूयो युनक्ति माम् । इदानीमेष बुद्धोऽस्मि निर्ममो निरहंकृतः ॥
ममत्वमनया नित्यमहंकारकृतात्मकम् । अपेत्याहमिमां हित्वा संश्रयिष्ये निरामयम् ॥
data.md: Renouncing Egoism which I always have regarding her and whose essence is made up of consciousness, and leaving Nature herself, I shall take refuge in Him, who is auspicious.

data.v: अनेन साम्यं यास्यामि नानयाहमचेतसा । क्षमं मम सहानेन नैकत्वमनया सह । एवं परमसंबोधात्पञ्चविंशोऽनुबुद्धवान् ॥
data.md: I shall be united with Him, and not will Nature which is inanimate. If I unite with Hiin, it will do me good. I have no similarity of nature with Nature.

data.v: अक्षरत्वं नियच्छेत त्यक्त्वा क्षरमनामयम् । अव्यक्तं व्यक्तधर्माणं सगुणं निर्गुणं तथा । निर्गुणं प्रथमं दृष्ट्वा तादृग्भवति मैथिल ॥
data.md: Shorn of qualities in his true nature and in reality Unmanifest, Individual Soul becomes invested with what is Manifest and assumes qualities. When he succeeds in seeing what is without qualities, and which is the origin of the Unmanifest, he becomes, O king of Mithila, at one with the same.

data.v: अक्षरक्षरयोरेतदुक्तं तव निदर्शनम् । मयेह ज्ञानसंपन्नं यथाश्रुतिनिदर्शनात् ॥
data.md: I have now told you according to what I have heard, as to how knowledge that is subtile, pure and certain, originates. Do you listen to me.

data.v: निःसंदिग्धं च सूक्ष्मं च विबुद्धं विमलं तथा । प्रवक्ष्यामि तु ते भूयस्तन्निबोध यथाश्रुतम् ॥
data.md: Now I again speak as I heard about that soul which is so tiny, awakened and pure.

data.v: सांख्ययोगौ मया प्रोक्तौ शास्त्रद्वयनिदर्शनात् । यदेव शास्त्रं सांख्योक्तं योगदर्शनमेव तत् ॥
data.md: I have already described to you, what the Sankhya and the Yoga Systems are as expounded in their respective scriptures. Verily, the science that has been explained in Sankhya treatises is at one with what has been laid down in the Yoga scriptures.

data.v: प्रबोधनकरं ज्ञानं सांख्यानामवनीपते । विस्पष्टं प्रोच्यते तत्र शिष्याणां हितकाम्यया ॥
data.md: The knowledge, 0 king, which the Sankhyas preach, is capable of awakening every one. In the Sankhya scriptures, that Knowledge has been explained very clearly for the behoof of disciples.

data.v: बृहच्चैव हि तच्छास्त्रमित्याहुः कुशला जनाः । अस्मिंश्च शास्त्रे योगानां पुनर्दधि पुनः शरः ॥
data.md: The learned say that this Sankhya System is very extensive. Yogins have respect for that System as also for the Vedas.

data.v: पञ्चविंशात्परं तत्त्वं न पश्यति नराधिप । सांख्यानां तु परं तत्र यथावदनुवर्णितम् ॥
data.md: In the Sankhya System no topic or principle above the twenty-fifth is admitted. That which the Sankhyas consider as their highest principle has been duly described (by me).

data.v: बुद्धमप्रतिबुद्धं च बुध्यमानं च तत्त्वतः । बुध्यमानं च बुद्धं च प्राहुर्योगनिदर्शनम् ॥
data.md: In the Yoga philosophy, it is said that Brahma, which is the essence of knowledge without the second, becomes the Individual Soul only when invested with Ignorance. In the Yoga Scriptures, therefore, both Brahma and Individual Soul are spoken of.

data.v: अप्रबुद्धमथाव्यक्तमिमं गुणविधिं शृणु । गुणान्धारयते ह्येषा सृजत्याक्षिपते तथा ॥
अजस्रं त्विह क्रीडार्थं विकुर्वन्ती नराधिप । आत्मानं बहुधा कृत्वा तान्येव च विचक्षते ॥
एतदेवं विकुर्वाणां बुध्यमानो न बुध्यते । अव्यक्तबोधनाच्चैव बुध्यमानं वदन्त्यपि ॥
data.md: Carelessly for his sport, O king, does Individual Soul undergo changes and because he is capable of understanding the called action of the Unmanifest, therefore he is the Comprehender.

data.v: न त्वेव बुध्यतेऽव्यक्तं सगुणं वाथ निर्गुणम् । कदाचित्त्वेव खल्वेतदाहुरप्रतिबुद्धकम् ॥
data.md: The Unmanifest or Nature can at no time comprehend Brahma which is really without qualities even when it shows itself with qualities. Hence is Nature called Unintelligent.

data.v: बुध्यते यदि वाव्यक्तमेतद्वै पञ्चविंशकम् । बुध्यमानो भवत्येष सङ्गात्मक इति श्रुतिः ॥
data.md: There is a declaration of the Shrutis that is ever Nature does succeed in knowing the twenty fifth, she then becomes at one with the Individual Soul who is united with her. On account of this Individual Soul or Purusha, who is not manifest and which in his real nature is not subject to changes, comes to be called as the Unawakened or Ignorant.

data.v: अनेनाप्रतिबुद्धेति वदन्त्यव्यक्तमच्युतम् । अव्यक्तबोधनाच्चैव बुध्यमानं वदन्त्युत ॥
data.md: There is a declaration of the Shrutis that is ever Nature does succeed in knowing the twenty fifth, she then becomes at one with the Individual Soul who is united with her. On account of this Individual Soul or Purusha, who is not manifest and which in his real nature is not subject to changes, comes to be called as the Unawakened or Ignorant.

data.v: पञ्चविंशं महात्मानं न चासावपि बुध्यते । षड्विंशं विमलं बुद्धमप्रमेयं सनातनम् ॥
data.md: Indeed, because the twenty-fifth can comprehend the Unmanifest, he is, therefore, called Comprehender. He cannot, however readily, comprehened the twenty-sixth, which is pure, which is Knowledge without duality, which is immeasurable, and which is eternal. The twenty-sixth, however, can know both the Individual Soul and Nature, numbering the twenty-fifth and the twenty-fourth respectively.

data.v: सततं पञ्चविंशं च चतुर्विंशं च बुध्यते । दृश्यादृश्ये ह्यनुगतमुभावेव महाद्युती ॥
अव्यक्तं न तु तद्ब्रह्म बुध्यते तात केवलम् । केवलं पञ्चविंशं च चतुर्विंशं न पश्यति ॥
बुध्यमानो यदात्मानमन्योऽहमिति मन्यते । तदा प्रकृतिमानेष भवत्यव्यक्तलोचनः ॥
बुध्यते च परां बुद्धिं विशुद्धाममलां यदा । षड्विंशो राजशार्दूल तदा बुद्धत्वमाव्रजेत् ॥
ततस्त्यजति सोऽव्यक्तं सर्गप्रलयधर्मिणम् । निर्गुणः प्रकृतिं वेद गुणयुक्तामचेतनाम् ॥
ततः केवलधर्मासौ भवत्यव्यक्तदर्शनात् । केवलेन समागम्य विमुक्तोऽऽत्मानमाप्नुयात् ॥
एतत्तत्तत्त्वमित्याहुर्निस्तत्त्वमजरामरम् । तत्त्वसंश्रयणादेतत्तत्त्ववन्न च मानद । पञ्चविंशतितत्त्वानि प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः ॥
data.md: O giver of honours, the Soul, though it has the body for its resting place, yet it cannot be said to have acquired the nature of those principles. The wise say that there are five and twenty principles in all.

data.v: न चैष तत्त्ववांस्तात निस्तत्त्वस्त्वेष बुद्धिमान् । एष मुञ्चति तत्त्वं हि क्षिप्रं बुद्धस्य लक्षणम् ॥
data.md: Indeed, O son, the Soul not to be considered as possessed of any of the principles. Endued with Intelligence, it is above the principles. It renounces quickly even that principle which is the mark of Knowledge.

data.v: षड्विंशोऽहमिति प्राज्ञो गृह्यमाणोऽजरामरः । केवलेन बलेनैव समतां यात्यसंशयम् ॥
data.md: When Individual Soul comes to regard himself as the twenty-sixth which is divested of decay and destruction, it is then that, forsooth, he succeeds by his own force in attaining to similarity with the twenty-sixth.

data.v: षड्विंशेन प्रबुद्धेन बुध्यमानोऽप्यबुद्धिमान् । एतन्नानात्वमित्युक्तं सांख्यश्रुतिनिदर्शनात् ॥
data.md: Though awakened by the twenty-sixth which is Pure Intelligence, Individual Soul still becomes subject to Ignorance. This is the cause of Jiva's multifariousness as explanied in the Shrutis and the Sankhya scriptures.

data.v: चेतनेन समेतस्य पञ्चविंशतिकस्य च । एकत्वं वै भवत्यस्य यदा बुद्ध्या न बुध्यते ॥
data.md: When Individual Soul, who is endued with consciousness, loses all Consciousness of a distinct or individual self, then does he, losing his multifariousness, resume his Oneness.

data.v: बुध्यमानोऽप्रबुद्धेन समतां याति मैथिल । सङ्गधर्मा भवत्येष निःसङ्गात्मा नराधिप ॥
data.md: O king, of Mithila, when Individual Soul, who is found to be in union with happiness and misery and who is seldom free from the consciousness of self, becomes identified with the Supreme Soul which transcends understanding, then does he becomes freed from virtue and vice.

data.v: निःसङ्गात्मानमासाद्य षड्विंशकमजं विदुः । विभुस्त्यजति चाव्यक्तं यदा त्वेतद्विबुध्यते । चतुर्विंशमगाधं च षड्विंशस्य प्रबोधनात् ॥
data.md: Indeed, when Individual soul attaining to the twenty-sixth which is Unborn and Powerful and which is shorn of all attachments, succeeds in comprehend it thoroughly, he himself becomes possessed of power and entirely renounces the Unmanifest or Nature.

data.v: एष ह्यप्रतिबुद्धश्च बुध्यमानश्च तेऽनघ । प्रोक्तो बुद्धश्च तत्त्वेन यथाश्रुतिनिदर्शनात् । नानात्वैकत्वमेतावद्द्रष्टव्यं शास्त्रदृष्टिभिः ॥
data.md: For understanding the twenty-sixth, the twenty-four principles seem to Individual soul to be unreal. I have thus told you, O sinless one, according to the indications of the Shrutis the nature of the Unintelligent, and of Individual Soul, as also of that which is Pure knowledge, agreeably to the truth. Guided by the scriptures, variety and oneness are thus to be understood.

data.v: मशकोदुम्बरे यद्वदन्यत्वं तद्वदेतयोः । मत्स्योऽम्भसि यथा तद्वदन्यत्वमुपलभ्यते ॥
data.md: The difference between the gnat and the Udumvara, or that between the fish and water, illustrates the difference between the Individual Soul and the Supreme Soul.

data.v: एवमेवावगन्तव्यं नानात्वैकत्वमेतयोः । एतद्विमोक्ष इत्युक्तमव्यक्तज्ञानसंहितम् ॥
data.md: The Multiplicity and Oneness of these two are to be understood thus. This is called Liberation, viz., this comprehension of oneself as something distinct from Unintelligent or Unmanifest Nature.

data.v: पञ्चविंशतिकस्यास्य योऽयं देहेषु वर्तते । एष मोक्षयितव्येति प्राहुरव्यक्तगोचरात् ॥
data.md: The twenty-fifth, which lives in the bodies of living creatures, should be liberated making him know the Unmanifest or the Supreme Soul which is above the understading.

data.v: सोऽयमेवं विमुच्येत नान्यथेति विनिश्चयः । परेण परधर्मा च भवत्येष समेत्य वै ॥
data.md: Indeed, that twenty-fifth is capable of acquiring Liberation in this way only and not through any other means. Though insooth different from the body in which he lives for the time being, he partakes of the nature of that body on account of his union with it.

data.v: विशुद्धधर्मा शुद्धेन बुद्धेन च स बुद्धिमान् । विमुक्तधर्मा मुक्तेन समेत्य पुरुषर्षभ ॥
data.md: Uniting with what is Pure, he becomes Pure. Uniting with the Intelligent, he becomes Intelligent. By uniting, O foremost of men, with one that is Liberate he becomes Liberated.

data.v: नियोगधर्मिणा चैव नियोगात्मा भवत्यपि । विमोक्षिणा विमोक्षश्च समेत्येह तथा भवेत् ॥
data.md: By uniting with one who is shorn of all attachments, he becomes freed from all attachments. By uniting with one striving after Liberation, he himself partaking of the nature of his companion, strives after Liberation.

data.v: शुचिकर्मा शुचिश्चैव भवत्यमितदीप्तिमान् । विमलात्मा च भवति समेत्य विमलात्मना ॥
data.md: By uniting with one of pure acts, he becomes pure and of pure acts and endued with blazing effulgence. By uniting with one of pure soul, he becomes of pure soul himself.

data.v: केवलात्मा तथा चैव केवलेन समेत्य वै । स्वतन्त्रश्च स्वतन्त्रेण स्वतन्त्रत्वमवाप्नुते ॥
data.md: By uniting with the One independent Soul, he becomes One and Independent. Uniting with One that is dependent on One's Own Self, he attains to the same nature and acquires Independence.

data.v: एतावदेतत्कथितं मया ते; तथ्यं महाराज यथार्थतत्त्वम् । अमत्सरत्वं प्रतिगृह्य चार्थं; सनातनं ब्रह्म विशुद्धमाद्यम् ॥
data.md: O monarch, I have duly told you all this that is perfectly true. Candidly have I described to you this subject, viz., the Eternal, Pure and Prime Brahma.

data.v: न वेदनिष्ठस्य जनस्य राज;न्प्रदेयमेतत्परमं त्वया भवेत् । विवित्समानाय विबोधकारकं; प्रबोधहेतोः प्रणतस्य शासनम् ॥
data.md: You may communicate this high knowledge, capable of awakening the soul, to that person, O king, who though not a master of the Vedas is, nevertheless, humble and has a keen desire for acquiring the knowledge of Brahma.

data.v: न देयमेतच्च तथानृतात्मने; शठाय क्लीबाय न जिह्मबुद्धये । न पण्डितज्ञानपरोपतापिने; देयं त्वयेदं विनिबोध यादृशे ॥
data.md: It should never be given to one who speaks falsehood, or one who is cunning or roguish, or one who has no strength of mind, or one who is of crooked understanding, or one who is jealous of men of knowledge, or one who pains others. Listen to me as I say who they are to whom this knowledge may safely be given.

data.v: श्रद्धान्वितायाथ गुणान्विताय; परापवादाद्विरताय नित्यम् । विशुद्धयोगाय बुधाय चैव; क्रियावतेऽथ क्षमिणे हिताय ॥
विविक्तशीलाय विधिप्रियाय; विवादहीनाय बहुश्रुताय । विजानते चैव न चाहितक्षमे; दमे च शक्ताय शमे च देहिनाम् ॥
एतैर्गुणैर्हीनतमे न देय;मेतत्परं ब्रह्म विशुद्धमाहुः । न श्रेयसा योक्ष्यति तादृशे कृतं; धर्मप्रवक्तारमपात्रदानात् ॥
data.md: This high knowledge of Brahma should never be given to one who has not such qualifications. It has been said that by giving this knowledge to one who is not considered a worthy recipient, no advantage or good fruit can arise.

data.v: पृथ्वीमिमां यद्यपि रत्नपूर्णां; दद्यान्नदेयं त्विदमव्रताय । जितेन्द्रियायैतदसंशयं ते; भवेत्प्रदेयं परमं नरेन्द्र ॥
data.md: This great knowledge should never be given, even if he gives in exchange the whole Earth full of gems and riches of every sort, to one that is not obscrvant of any vows and restraints. Forsooth, however, O king, this knowledge should be imparted to one who has conquered his senses.

data.v: कराल मा ते भयमस्तु किंचि;देतच्छ्रुतं ब्रह्म परं त्वयाद्य । यथावदुक्तं परमं पवित्रं; निःशोकमत्यन्तमनादिमध्यम् ॥
data.md: O Karala, do not entertain any fear since you have heard all this regarding high Brahma from the to-day! I have described to you duly the high and holy Brahma that is without beginning and middle, and that is capable of removing all kinds of sorrow.

data.v: अगाधजन्मामरणं च राज;न्निरामयं वीतभयं शिवं च । समीक्ष्य मोहं त्यज चाद्य सर्वं; ज्ञानस्य तत्त्वार्थमिदं विदित्वा ॥
data.md: Seeing Brahma whose sight is capable of doing away with both birth and death, O king, which is full of auspiciousness, which removes all fear, and which yields the highest benefit, and having acquired this essence of all knowledge, renounce all error and stupefaction to-day.

data.v: अवाप्तमेतद्धि पुरा सनातना;द्धिरण्यगर्भाद्गदतो नराधिप । प्रसाद्य यत्नेन तमुग्रतेजसं; सनातनं ब्रह्म यथाद्य वै त्वया ॥
पृष्टस्त्वया चास्मि यथा नरेन्द्र; तथा मयेदं त्वयि चोक्तमद्य । तथावाप्तं ब्रह्मणो मे नरेन्द्र; महज्ज्ञानं मोक्षविदां पुराणम् ॥
एतदुक्तं परं ब्रह्म यस्मान्नावर्तते पुनः । पञ्चविंशो महाराज परमर्षिनिदर्शनात् ॥
data.md: Bhishma said I have thus told you of high Brahma, just as the great Rishi had said, by attaining to which the Twenty-fifth (Individual Soul) has never to return.

data.v: पुनरावृत्तिमाप्नोति परं ज्ञानमवाप्य च । नावबुध्यति तत्त्वेन बुध्यमानोऽजरामरः ॥
data.md: On account of his knowing truly the Supreme Soul which is not subject to decay and death, Individual Soul is obliged to frequently return to the world. When, however, Individual Soul succeeds in acquiring that high knowledge, he has no longer to return.

data.v: एतन्निःश्रेयसकरं ज्ञानानां ते परं मया । कथितं तत्त्वतस्तात श्रुत्वा देवर्षितो नृप ॥
data.md: Having heard it, O king, from the celestial Rishi, I have, O son, given to you that great knowledge which yields the highest good.

data.v: हिरण्यगर्भादृषिणा वसिष्ठेन महात्मना । वसिष्ठादृषिशार्दूलान्नारदोऽवाप्तवानिदम् ॥
data.md: This knowledge acquired from Hiranyagarbha by the great Rishi Vashishtha. was From that foremost of Rishis, viz., Vashishtha, it was acquired by Narada.

data.v: नारदाद्विदितं मह्यमेतद्ब्रह्म सनातनम् । मा शुचः कौरवेन्द्र त्वं श्रुत्वैतत्परमं पदम् ॥
data.md: From Narada I have acquired that knowledge which is truly at one with the eternal Brahma. Having heard this discourse of great import, couched in excellent words, do not, O foremost of the Kurus, give way any longer to greaf.

data.v: येन क्षराक्षरे वित्ते न भयं तस्य विद्यते । विद्यते तु भयं तस्य यो नैतद्वेत्ति पार्थिव ॥
data.md: That man who knows the Destructible and the Indestructible, become freed from fear. He, indeed, O king, is compelled to entertain fear who is shorn of this knowledge.

data.v: अविज्ञानाच्च मूढात्मा पुनः पुनरुपद्रवन् । प्रेत्य जातिसहस्राणि मरणान्तान्युपाश्नुते ॥
data.md: On account of Ignorance, the man of foolish soul hath repeatedly to return to this world. Indeed, after death he has to be born in thousands and thousands of orders of Being, every one of which meets with Death in the end.

data.v: देवलोकं तथा तिर्यङ्मानुष्यमपि चाश्नुते । यदि शुध्यति कालेन तस्मादज्ञानसागरात् ॥
data.md: Now in the world of the gods, now among men, and now among intermediate orders of Being, he has to appear again and again. If in course of time he succeeds in crossing that Ocean of Ignorance in which he is sunk, he then succeeds in avoiding completely re-birth and attaining to oneness with the Supreme Soul.

data.v: अज्ञानसागरो घोरो ह्यव्यक्तोऽगाध उच्यते । अहन्यहनि मज्जन्ति यत्र भूतानि भारत ॥
data.md: The Ocean of Ignorance is dreadful. It is bottomless and called the Unmanifest. 0 Bharata, day after day, creatures are seen to fall and sink in that Ocean.

data.v: यस्मादगाधादव्यक्तादुत्तीर्णस्त्वं सनातनात् । तस्मात्त्वं विरजाश्चैव वितमस्कश्च पार्थिव ॥
data.md: Since you, O king, have been freed from that eternal and limitless Ocean of Ignorance, you have, therefore, become freed from Darkness and also Ignorance.

data.v: मृगयां विचरन्कश्चिद्विजने जनकात्मजः । वने ददर्श विप्रेन्द्रमृषिं वंशधरं भृगोः ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Once on a time a king of Janaka's family while roaming in the uninhabited forest in pursuit of deer, saw a superior Brahmana or Rishi of Bhrigu's race.

data.v: तमासीनमुपासीनः प्रणम्य शिरसा मुनिम् । पश्चादनुमतस्तेन पप्रच्छ वसुमानिदम् ॥
data.md: Bowing with his head to the Rishi who was seated at his ease, king Vasuman sat near him and with his permission put to him this question:भगवन् किमिदं श्रेयः प्रेत्य चापीह वा भवेत्।

data.v: भगवन्किमिदं श्रेयः प्रेत्य वापीह वा भवेत् । पुरुषस्याध्रुवे देहे कामस्य वशवर्तिनः ॥
सत्कृत्य परिपृष्टः सन्सुमहात्मा महातपाः । निजगाद ततस्तस्मै श्रेयस्करमिदं वचः ॥
data.md: Duly respected by king, and and thus questioned, that great Rishi endued with ascetic merit, then said these words to him which were highly beneficial.

data.v: मनसोऽप्रतिकूलानि प्रेत्य चेह च वाञ्छसि । भूतानां प्रतिकूलेभ्यो निवर्तस्व यतेन्द्रियः ॥
data.md: see If you seek both here and hereafter what is agreeable to your mind, do you then, with controlled senses, abstain from doing what is disagreeable to all creatures.

data.v: धर्मः सतां हितः पुंसां धर्मश्चैवाश्रयः सताम् । धर्माल्लोकास्त्रयस्तात प्रवृत्ताः सचराचराः ॥
data.md: Virtue is beneficial to them that are good. Virtue is the refuge of the good. From virtue have originated the three worlds with their mobile and immobile creatures.

data.v: स्वादुकामुक कामानां वैतृष्ण्यं किं न गच्छसि । मधु पश्यसि दुर्बुद्धे प्रपातं नानुपश्यसि ॥
data.md: O you, who are eagerly desirous of enjoying all agreeable objects, how is it that you are not yet satiated with objects or desire? You the honey, O you of little understanding, but are blind to the fall.

data.v: यथा ज्ञाने परिचयः कर्तव्यस्तत्फलार्थिना । तथा धर्मे परिचयः कर्तव्यस्तत्फलार्थिना ॥
data.md: As one desirous of acquiring the fruits of knowledge, should busy himself with the acquisition of knowledge, so one desirous of acquiring the fruits of Virtue should be busy with the acquisition of Virtue.

data.v: असता धर्मकामेन विशुद्धं कर्म दुष्करम् । सता तु धर्मकामेन सुकरं कर्म दुष्करम् ॥
data.md: If a wicked men, from desire of virtue, tries to do a pure and stainless act, the fulfilment of his desire becomes impossible. If, on the other hand, a good man, moved by the desire of acquiring virtue, tries to do an act that is even difficult, its accomplishment becomes easy for him.

data.v: वने ग्राम्यसुखाचारो यथा ग्राम्यस्तथैव सः । ग्रामे वनसुखाचारो यथा वनचरस्तथा ॥
data.md: If, while living in the forest, one acts in such a way as to enjoy all the pleasures of living amongst men in towns, one comes to be regarded not as a forest recluse but as an inhabitant of towns. Likewise, if one while living in towns, acts in such a way as to enjoy the happiness of a forest life, one is regarded not as a inhabitant of towns but as a forest recluse.

data.v: मनोवाक्कर्मके धर्मे कुरु श्रद्धां समाहितः । निवृत्तौ वा प्रवृत्तौ वा संप्रधार्य गुणागुणान् ॥
data.md: Ascertaining the merits of the religion of Karma and that of Abstention therefrom, do you, with concentrated senses, be devoted to the practices of virtue in thought, word, and deed.

data.v: नित्यं च बहु दातव्यं साधुभ्यश्चानसूयता । प्रार्थितं व्रतशौचाभ्यां सत्कृतं देशकालयोः ॥
data.md: Judging of the propriety of time and place, purified by the observance of vows and other purifying rites, and solicited, do you, without malice, make large gifts to the good.

data.v: शुभेन विधिना लब्धमर्हाय प्रतिपादयेत् । क्रोधमुत्सृज्य दत्त्वा च नानुतप्येन्न कीर्तयेत् ॥
data.md: Acquiring riches by fare means, one should give it away to worthy persons. One should make gifts, renouncing anger; and having made gifts one should never yield to sorrow nor proclaim those gifts with his own mouth.

data.v: अनृशंसः शुचिर्दान्तः सत्यवागार्जवे स्थितः । योनिकर्मविशुद्धश्च पात्रं स्याद्वेदविद्द्विजः ॥
data.md: The Brahmana who is full of mercy, who is pure, who has his senses under control, who is truthful in speech, who is full of candour, and whose birth is pure, has been considered as a person deserving of gifts.

data.v: सत्कृता चैकपत्नी च जात्या योनिरिहेष्यते । ऋग्यजुःसामगो विद्वान्षट्कर्मा पात्रमुच्यते ॥
data.md: A person is said to be pure in birth when he is born of a mother who has only one husband and who is of the same caste with him. Indeed, such a Brahmana, knowing the three Vedas, viz., Rich, Yajush, and Saman, endued with learning, only observant of the six duties, has been considered as deserving of gifts.

data.v: स एव धर्मः सोऽधर्मस्तं तं प्रतिनरं भवेत् । पात्रकर्मविशेषेण देशकालाववेक्ष्य च ॥
data.md: Virtue becomes sin and sin becomes virtue, according to the nature of the doer, of time, and of place.

data.v: लीलयाल्पं यथा गात्रात्प्रमृज्याद्रजसः पुमान् । बहुयत्नेन महता पापनिर्हरणं तथा ॥
data.md: Sin is renounced like the fifth on one's body,-a little with a little exertion, and a great quantity when the exertion is greater.

data.v: विरिक्तस्य यथा सम्यग्घृतं भवति भेषजम् । तथा निर्हृतदोषस्य प्रेत्यधर्मः सुखावहः ॥
data.md: A person, after clearing his bowels, should lake clarified butter, butter, which acts most beneficially on his system. Likewise, when one has freed himself of all faults and busies himself with the acquisition of virtue, that Virtue in the next world, brings on the highest happiness.

data.v: मानसं सर्वभूतेषु वर्तते वै शुभाशुभे । अशुभेभ्यः समाक्षिप्य शुभेष्वेवावतारयेत् ॥
data.md: Good and evil thoughts are in the minds of all creatures. Withdrawing the mind from cvil thoughts, it should always be bent towards good thoughts.

data.v: सर्वं सर्वेण सर्वत्र क्रियमाणं च पूजय । स्वधर्मे यत्र रागस्ते कामं धर्मो विधीयताम् ॥
data.md: One should always respect the practices of his own caste. Do you try, therefore, to act in such a way that you may have faith in the practices of your own caste.

data.v: अधृतात्मन्धृतौ तिष्ठ दुर्बुद्धे बुद्धिमान्भव । अप्रशान्त प्रशाम्य त्वमप्राज्ञ प्राज्ञवच्चर ॥
data.md: O you who are endued with an impatient soul, follow the practice of patience. O you of a foolish understanding try to be possessed of intelligence. Shorn of tranquillity, try to be tranquil, and shorn of wisdom as you are, try to act wisely.

data.v: तेजसा शक्यते प्राप्तुमुपायसहचारिणा । इह च प्रेत्य च श्रेयस्तस्य मूलं धृतिः परा ॥
data.md: He who is in the company of the righteous, succeeds, by his own energy, in acquiring the means of doing what is beneficial for him both here and hereafter. Verily, the root of that benefit is unflinching firmness.

data.v: राजर्षिरधृतिः स्वर्गात्पतितो हि महाभिषः । ययातिः क्षीणपुण्यश्च धृत्या लोकानवाप्तवान् ॥
data.md: The royal sage Mahabhisha, for want of this firinness, fell from heaven. Yayati, also, though his merits had become exhausted succeeded in regaining regions of happiness through his firmness.

data.v: तपस्विनां धर्मवतां विदुषां चोपसेवनात् । प्राप्स्यसे विपुलां बुद्धिं तथा श्रेयोऽभिपत्स्यसे ॥
data.md: You are sure to acquire great intelligence, as also what is for your highest good by seeing virtuous and learned persons endued with ascetic merit.

data.v: स तु स्वभावसंपन्नस्तच्छ्रुत्वा मुनिभाषितम् । विनिवर्त्य मनः कामाद्धर्मे बुद्धिं चकार ह ॥
data.md: Hearing these words of the sage, king Vasuman, having good disposition, withdrawing his mind from the pursuits of desire, set it upon the acquisition of virtue. a

data.v: धर्माधर्मविमुक्तं यद्विमुक्तं सर्वसंश्रयात् । जन्ममृत्युविमुक्तं च विमुक्तं पुण्यपापयोः ॥
data.md: You should, O grandfather, describe to me what is freed from duty and its reverse, what is freed from every doubt, what is above birth and death, as also virtue and sin, what is auspiciousness, what is eternal fearlessness, what is Eternal and Indestructible, and Immutable, what is always Pure, and what is ever free from exertion.

data.v: यच्छिवं नित्यमभयं नित्यं चाक्षरमव्ययम् । शुचि नित्यमनायासं तद्भवान्वक्तुमर्हति ॥
अत्र ते वर्तयिष्येऽहमितिहासं पुरातनम् । याज्ञवल्क्यस्य संवादं जनकस्य च भारत ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Regarding it I shall recite to you an old narrative, O Yudhishthira, of the discourse between the Sadhyas and a Swan.

data.v: याज्ञवल्क्यमृषिश्रेष्ठं दैवरातिर्महायशाः । पप्रच्छ जनको राजा प्रश्नं प्रश्नविदां वरः ॥
data.md: Bhishma said O Bharata, referring to this matter I shall recite to you the old discourse between Yajnavalkya and Janaka. Once on a time the famous king Daivarati of Janaka's race, truthfully understanding the meaning of all questions, put this question to Yajnavalkya, that foremost of Rishis.

data.v: कतीन्द्रियाणि विप्रर्षे कति प्रकृतयः स्मृताः । किमव्यक्तं परं ब्रह्म तस्माच्च परतस्तु किम् ॥
data.md: Janaka said ( regenerate Rishi, how many kinds of senses are there? How many kinds also are there of Nature? What is the Unmanifest and highest Brahma? What is higher than Brahmana? What is Birth and what Death? What are the limits of Age? You should, O foremost of Brahmanas, describe all these subjects to me who seek your favour.

data.v: प्रभवं चाप्ययं चैव कालसंख्यां तथैव च । वक्तुमर्हसि विप्रेन्द्र त्वदनुग्रहकाङ्क्षिणः ॥
data.md: Janaka said ( regenerate Rishi, how many kinds of senses are there? How many kinds also are there of Nature? What is the Unmanifest and highest Brahma? What is higher than Brahmana? What is Birth and what Death? What are the limits of Age? You should, O foremost of Brahmanas, describe all these subjects to me who seek your favour.

data.v: अज्ञानात्परिपृच्छामि त्वं हि ज्ञानमयो निधिः । तदहं श्रोतुमिच्छामि सर्वमेतदसंशयम् ॥
data.md: I am ignorant while you are an Ocean of knowledge. Hence, I ask you. Verily, I wish to hear you describe all these subject.

data.v: श्रूयतामवनीपाल यदेतदनुपृच्छसि । योगानां परमं ज्ञानं सांख्यानां च विशेषतः ॥
data.md: Hear, O king, what I say in answer to these questions of yours. I shall give you the high knowledge which Yogins prize, and especially that which is possessed by the Sankhyas.

data.v: न तवाविदितं किंचिन्मां तु जिज्ञासते भवान् । पृष्टेन चापि वक्तव्यमेष धर्मः सनातनः ॥
data.md: Nothing is unknown to you. Still you ask me. One, however, who is questioned, should answer. This is the eternal practice.

data.v: अष्टौ प्रकृतयः प्रोक्ता विकाराश्चापि षोडश । अथ सप्त तु व्यक्तानि प्राहुरध्यात्मचिन्तकाः ॥
data.md: Eight principles have been called by the name of Nature, while sixteen have been called changes. Of Manifest, there are seven. These are of views of those persons who are conversant with the spiritual science.

data.v: अव्यक्तं च महांश्चैव तथाहंकार एव च । पृथिवी वायुराकाशमापो ज्योतिश्च पञ्चमम् ॥
एताः प्रकृतयस्त्वष्टौ विकारानपि मे शृणु । श्रोत्रं त्वक्चैव चक्षुश्च जिह्वा घ्राणं च पञ्चमम् ॥
शब्दस्पर्शौ च रूपं च रसो गन्धस्तथैव च । वाक्च हस्तौ च पादौ च पायुर्मेढ्रं तथैव च ॥
एते विशेषा राजेन्द्र महाभूतेषु पञ्चसु । बुद्धीन्द्रियाण्यथैतानि सविशेषाणि मैथिल ॥
data.md: The ten commencing with sound, and originating from the five great principles, are called Vishesha. The five senses of knowledge are called Savishesha, O king of Mithila.

data.v: मनः षोडशकं प्राहुरध्यात्मगतिचिन्तकाः । त्वं चैवान्ये च विद्वांसस्तत्त्वबुद्धिविशारदाः ॥
data.md: Persons conversant with the spiritual science consider the Mind as the sixteenth. This is agreeable to your own views as also to those of other learned men well acquainted with the truths about principles.

data.v: अव्यक्ताच्च महानात्मा समुत्पद्यति पार्थिव । प्रथमं सर्गमित्येतदाहुः प्राधानिकं बुधाः ॥
data.md: From the Unmanifest, O king, originates the Greatness. The learned say this to be the first creation relating to Nature.

data.v: महतश्चाप्यहंकार उत्पद्यति नराधिप । द्वितीयं सर्गमित्याहुरेतद्बुद्ध्यात्मकं स्मृतम् ॥
data.md: From Greatness, O king of men, originates Consciousness. This has been designated the second creation having the Understanding for its essence.

data.v: अहंकाराच्च संभूतं मनो भूतगुणात्मकम् । तृतीयः सर्ग इत्येष आहंकारिक उच्यते ॥
data.md: From Consciousness has originated the Mind which is the essence of sound and the others that are the qualities of ether and the rest. This is the third creation, relating to Consciousness.

data.v: मनसस्तु समुद्भूता महाभूता नराधिप । चतुर्थं सर्गमित्येतन्मानसं परिचक्षते ॥
data.md: From Mind have originated the great elements, O king! This is the fourth creation called mental.

data.v: शब्दः स्पर्शश्च रूपं च रसो गन्धस्तथैव च । पञ्चमं सर्गमित्याहुर्भौतिकं भूतचिन्तकाः ॥
data.md: Persons conversant with the principal elements hold that Sound and Touch and Form and Taste and Scent are the fifth creation, relating to the Great elements.

data.v: श्रोत्रं त्वक्चैव चक्षुश्च जिह्वा घ्राणं च पञ्चमम् । सर्गं तु षष्ठमित्याहुर्बहुचिन्तात्मकं स्मृतम् ॥
data.md: The creation of the Ear, the Skin, the Eye, the Tongue, and the Scent, forms the sixth and is considered as having for its essence multiplicity of thought.

data.v: अधः श्रोत्रेन्द्रियग्राम उत्पद्यति नराधिप । सप्तमं सर्गमित्याहुरेतदैन्द्रियकं स्मृतम् ॥
data.md: The senses that come after the Ear and the others then originate, O king. This is called seventh creation and relates to the senses of knowledge.

data.v: ऊर्ध्वस्रोतस्तथा तिर्यगुत्पद्यति नराधिप । अष्टमं सर्गमित्याहुरेतदार्जवकं बुधाः ॥
data.md: Then, O king, come the vital air that rises upwards and those that go downwards. This is the eighth creation and called Arjjva (straight).

data.v: तिर्यक्स्रोतस्त्वधःस्रोत उत्पद्यति नराधिप । नवमं सर्गमित्याहुरेतदार्जवकं बुधाः ॥
data.md: Then come those vital airs which move transversely in the lower parts of the body and also that called Apana passing downwards. This, the ninth creation, is also called Arjjava, O king.

data.v: एतानि नव सर्गाणि तत्त्वानि च नराधिप । चतुर्विंशतिरुक्तानि यथाश्रुति निदर्शनात् ॥
data.md: These nine kinds of creation, and these principles, O king, which are twenty-four in number, are described to you according to what has been laid down in the scriptures.

data.v: अत ऊर्ध्वं महाराज गुणस्यैतस्य तत्त्वतः । महात्मभिरनुप्रोक्तां कालसंख्यां निबोध मे ॥
data.md: After this, O king, listen to me as I tell you the durations of time as said by the learned regarding these principles or attributes.

data.v: अव्यक्तस्य नरश्रेष्ठ कालसंख्यां निबोध मे । पञ्च कल्पसहस्राणि द्विगुणान्यहरुच्यते ॥
data.md: Yajnavalkya said Listen to me, O foremost of men, as I tell you what the duration of time is about the Supreme Purusha. Ten thousand Kalpas are said to form a single day of his.

data.v: रात्रिरेतावती चास्य प्रतिबुद्धो नराधिप । सृजत्योषधिमेवाग्रे जीवनं सर्वदेहिनाम् ॥
data.md: The duration of his night is equal. When his night passes, he awakes, O king, and first crcates herbs and plants which form the sustenance of all embodied creatures.

data.v: ततो ब्रह्माणमसृजद्धैरण्याण्डसमुद्भवम् । सा मूर्तिः सर्वभूतानामित्येवमनुशुश्रुम ॥
data.md: He then creates Brahman who originates from a golden egg. That Brahman is the form of all created things, as we have heard.

data.v: संवत्सरमुषित्वाण्डे निष्क्रम्य च महामुनिः । संदधेऽर्धं महीं कृत्स्नां दिवमर्धं प्रजापतिः ॥
data.md: Having lived for one whole year within that egg, the great ascetic Brahman, called also Prajapati came out of it and created the whole Earth, and the Heaven above.

data.v: द्यावापृथिव्योरित्येष राजन्वेदेषु पठ्यते । तयोः शकलयोर्मध्यमाकाशमकरोत्प्रभुः ॥
data.md: The lord then, it is seen in the Vedas, O king, placed the sky between Heaven and Earth.

data.v: एतस्यापि च संख्यानं वेदवेदाङ्गपारगैः । दश कल्पसहस्राणि पादोनान्यहरुच्यते । रात्रिमेतावतीं चास्य प्राहुरध्यात्मचिन्तकाः ॥
data.md: The wise men, conversant in the study of Vedas said that it is seven thousand and five hundred Kalpas that form the day of Brahman.

data.v: सृजत्यहंकारमृषिर्भूतं दिव्यात्मकं तथा । चतुरश्चापरान्पुत्रान्देहात्पूर्वं महानृषिः । ते वै पितृभ्यः पितरः श्रूयन्ते राजसत्तम ॥
data.md: Before creating any physical bodies out of the ingredients called the chief elements, Mahan or Brahma, endued with penances created four others called his sons. They are the fathers of the original fathers, O best of kings as we have heard.

data.v: देवाः पितॄणां च सुता देवैर्लोकाः समावृताः । चराचरा नरश्रेष्ठ इत्येवमनुशुश्रुम ॥
data.md: We have also heard, O king, that the senses (of knowledge) along with the four inner faculties, have originated from the Pitris, and that the entire universe of mobile and immobile Beings has been filled with those Great elements.
