data.md: O Brahmana, do you ask of me the boons you wish! I am pleased with you to-day and I appear to you now in my universal form as freed from decay and deterioration!

data.v: अद्य मे तपसो देव यमस्य नियमस्य च । सद्यः फलमवाप्तं वै दृष्टो यद्भगवान्मया ॥
data.md: Narada said Since, O holy one, I have to-day succeeded in seeing you, I think that I have acquired forthwith the fruits of my penances, O God, of my self-restraint, and of all the vows and observances that I have practised.

data.v: वर एष ममात्यन्तं दृष्टस्त्वं यत्सनातनः । भगवान्विश्वदृक्सिंहः सर्वमूर्तिर्महाप्रभुः ॥
data.md: This, indeed, is the highest boon you have granted me for you have appeared before me to-day, O Eternal Lord! You, O holy one, have the universe for your eye! You are the Lion. Your form is identifiable with everything! Possessed of power you, O Lord, are vast and infinite.

data.v: एवं संदर्शयित्वा तु नारदं परमेष्ठिजम् । उवाच वचनं भूयो गच्छ नारद माचिरम् ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Having thus appeared before Narada the son of Parameshthi, the great God addressed that ascetic and said,-Go hence, O Narada, and do not delay!

data.v: इमे ह्यनिन्द्रियाहारा मद्भक्ताश्चन्द्रवर्चसः । एकाग्राश्चिन्तयेयुर्मां नैषां विघ्नो भवेदिति ॥
data.md: These worshippers of mine, having moonlike complexions, are divested of all senses and do not live upon any kind of food. They are, again, all Liberated! With minds wholly concentrated upon me, people should think of me. Such worshippers will never meet with any obstacles.

data.v: सिद्धाश्चैते महाभागाः पुरा ह्येकान्तिनोऽभवन् । तमोरजोविनिर्मुक्ता मां प्रवेक्ष्यन्त्यसंशयम् ॥
data.md: These men have all acquired ascetic success and are highly blessed. In day of yore they became entirely devoted to me. They have becn freed from the qualities of Darkness and Ignorance. Forsooth, they are competent to enter me and become merged into my Self.

data.v: न दृश्यश्चक्षुषा योऽसौ न स्पृश्यः स्पर्शनेन च । न घ्रेयश्चैव गन्धेन रसेन च विवर्जितः ॥
सत्त्वं रजस्तमश्चैव न गुणास्तं भजन्ति वै । यश्च सर्वगतः साक्षी लोकस्यात्मेति कथ्यते ॥
भूतग्रामशरीरेषु नश्यत्सु न विनश्यति । अजो नित्यः शाश्वतश्च निर्गुणो निष्कलस्तथा ॥
द्विर्द्वादशेभ्यस्तत्त्वेभ्यः ख्यातो यः पञ्चविंशकः । पुरुषो निष्क्रियश्चैव ज्ञानदृश्यश्च कथ्यते ॥
यं प्रविश्य भवन्तीह मुक्ता वै द्विजसत्तम । स वासुदेवो विज्ञेयः परमात्मा सनातनः ॥
पश्य देवस्य माहात्म्यं महिमानं च नारद । शुभाशुभैः कर्मभिर्यो न लिप्यति कदाचन ॥
data.md: See, O Narada, the greatness and power of that God! He is never affected by good or bad deeds.

data.v: सत्त्वं रजस्तमश्चैव गुणानेतान्प्रचक्षते । एते सर्वशरीरेषु तिष्ठन्ति विचरन्ति च ॥
data.md: Satvata, Rajas, and Tamas, are said to be the three (original) qualities. These live and act in the bodies of all creatures.

data.v: एतान्गुणांस्तु क्षेत्रज्ञो भुङ्क्ते नैभिः स भुज्यते । निर्गुणो गुणभुक्चैव गुणस्रष्टा गुणाधिकः ॥
data.md: The Individual Soul, called Kshetrajna, enjoys and suffers the action of these three qualities. He, however, is above them and they cannot touch Him. Freed from these qualities, He is again their enjoyer and sufferer. Having created them Himself, He is above them all.

data.v: जगत्प्रतिष्ठा देवर्षे पृथिव्यप्सु प्रलीयते । ज्योतिष्यापः प्रलीयन्ते ज्योतिर्वायौ प्रलीयते ॥
data.md: O celestial Rishi, the Earth, which is the refuge of the universe, disappears into water. Water disappears into Fire and Fire into Wind. Wind disappears into Ether, and Ether into Mind. Mind is a great creature, and it disappears into Unmanifest Nature.

data.v: खे वायुः प्रलयं याति मनस्याकाशमेव च । मनो हि परमं भूतं तदव्यक्ते प्रलीयते ॥
अव्यक्तं पुरुषे ब्रह्मन्निष्क्रिये संप्रलीयते । नास्ति तस्मात्परतरं पुरुषाद्वै सनातनात् ॥
data.md: Unmanifest Nature, 0 Brahmana, disappears into Inactive Purusha (Soul). There is nothing higher than Purusha (Soul) which is Eternal.

data.v: नित्यं हि नास्ति जगति भूतं स्थावरजङ्गमम् । ऋते तमेकं पुरुषं वासुदेवं सनातनम् । सर्वभूतात्मभूतो हि वासुदेवो महाबलः ॥
data.md: There is nothing among mobile and immobile things in the universe which is immutable, except Vasudeva, the eternal Purusha.

data.v: पृथिवी वायुराकाशमापो ज्योतिश्च पञ्चमम् । ते समेता महात्मानः शरीरमिति संज्ञितम् ॥
data.md: Earth, Wind, Ether, Water, and Fire numbering the fifth—these are the five Great Creatures that have originated from Consciousness.

data.v: तदाविशति यो ब्रह्मन्नदृश्यो लघुविक्रमः । उत्पन्न एव भवति शरीरं चेष्टयन्प्रभुः ॥
न विना धातुसंघातं शरीरं भवति क्वचित् । न च जीवं विना ब्रह्मन्धातवश्चेष्टयन्त्युत ॥
स जीवः परिसंख्यातः शेषः संकर्षणः प्रभुः । तस्मात्सनत्कुमारत्वं यो लभेत स्वकर्मणा ॥
यस्मिंश्च सर्वभूतानि प्रलयं यान्ति संक्षये । स मनः सर्वभूतानां प्रद्युम्नः परिपठ्यते ॥
data.md: He who takes his his rise, from that Sankarshana, by his own acts, Sanatkumara, and in whom all creatures merge when the universal dissolution sets in, is the Mind of all creatures and is called by the name of Praddyumna.

data.v: तस्मात्प्रसूतो यः कर्ता कार्यं कारणमेव च । यस्मात्सर्वं प्रभवति जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम् । सोऽनिरुद्धः स ईशानो व्यक्तिः सा सर्वकर्मसु ॥
data.md: From Him originates. He who is the Creator, and who is both Cause and Effect. From this last, everything, viz., the mobile and immobile universe, originates. This one is called Aniruddha. He is otherwise called Ishana and He is manifest in all deeds.

data.v: यो वासुदेवो भगवान्क्षेत्रज्ञो निर्गुणात्मकः । ज्ञेयः स एव भगवाञ्जीवः संकर्षणः प्रभुः ॥
data.md: That illustrious one, viz., Vasudeva, who is called Kshetrajna, (Soul) and who is freed from qualities, should, O king of kings, be known as the powerful Sankarshana, when He takes birth as (Individual Soul).

data.v: संकर्षणाच्च प्रद्युम्नो मनोभूतः स उच्यते । प्रद्युम्नाद्योऽनिरुद्धस्तु सोऽहंकारो महेश्वरः ॥
data.md: From Sankarshana originates Praddyumna who is called “Mind-begotten." From Praddymuna is He who is Aniruddha. He is Consciousness, He is Ishvara (Supreme Lord).

data.v: मत्तः सर्वं संभवति जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम् । अक्षरं च क्षरं चैव सच्चासच्चैव नारद ॥
data.md: It is from me that the entire mobile and immobile universe originates. It is from me, O Narada, that the indestructible and the destructible, the existent and the non-existent, originates.

data.v: मां प्रविश्य भवन्तीह मुक्ता भक्तास्तु ये मम । अहं हि पुरुषो ज्ञेयो निष्क्रियः पञ्चविंशकः ॥
data.md: They who are devoted to me enter into me and become liberated. I am known as Purusha. Without acts, I am the Twenty-fifth.

data.v: निर्गुणो निष्कलश्चैव निर्द्वंद्वो निष्परिग्रहः । एतत्त्वया न विज्ञेयं रूपवानिति दृश्यते । इच्छन्मुहूर्तान्नश्येयमीशोऽहं जगतो गुरुः ॥
data.md: Getting over qualities, I am entire and indivisible. I am above all pairs of opposite and shorn of all attachments. This, O Narada, you will fail to understand. You see me as having a form. If I wish, I can dissolve this form in a moment. I am the Supreme Lord and the Preceptor of the universe.

data.v: माया ह्येषा मया सृष्टा यन्मां पश्यसि नारद । सर्वभूतगुणैर्युक्तं नैवं त्वं ज्ञातुमर्हसि । मयैतत्कथितं सम्यक्तव मूर्तिचतुष्टयम् ॥
data.md: What you see of me, ONarada, is merely an illusion of mine. I now appear to be possessed of the attributes of all created things. You are not competent to know me. I have shown to you duly my fourfold form. I am, O Narada, the doer, I am Cause, and I am Effect.

data.v: सिद्धा ह्येते महाभागा नरा ह्येकान्तिनोऽभवन् । तमोरजोभ्यां निर्मुक्ताः प्रवेक्ष्यन्ति च मां मुने ॥
data.md: These men have all acquired ascetic success and are highly blessed. In day of yore they became entirely devoted to me. They have becn freed from the qualities of Darkness and Ignorance. Forsooth, they are competent to enter me and become merged into my Self.

data.v: अहं कर्ता च कार्यं च कारणं चापि नारद । अहं हि जीवसंज्ञो वै मयि जीवः समाहितः । मैवं ते बुद्धिरत्राभूद्दृष्टो जीवो मयेति च ॥
data.md: I am the sum-total of all living creatures. All living creatures have their refuge in me, Do not think that you have seen the Individual Soul.

data.v: अहं सर्वत्रगो ब्रह्मन्भूतग्रामान्तरात्मकः । भूतग्रामशरीरेषु नश्यत्सु न नशाम्यहम् ॥
data.md: I pervade all things, O Brahmana, and am the inner Soul of all creatures. When the bodies of all creatures, however, are destroyed, I am not destroyed.

data.v: हिरण्यगर्भो लोकादिश्चतुर्वक्त्रो निरुक्तगः । ब्रह्मा सनातनो देवो मम बह्वर्थचिन्तकः ॥
data.md: He called Hiranyagarbha, who is the beginning of the world, who has four faces, who cannot be understood with the help of the Nirukta, who is otherwise called Brahman, who is an eternal god, is engaged in loO king after many of my works.

data.v: पश्यैकादश मे रुद्रान्दक्षिणं पार्श्वमास्थितान् । द्वादशैव तथादित्यान्वामं पार्श्वं समास्थितान् ॥
अग्रतश्चैव मे पश्य वसूनष्टौ सुरोत्तमान् । नासत्यं चैव दस्रं च भिषजौ पश्य पृष्ठतः ॥
data.md: The twelve Adityas are on the left side of my person. See the eight Vasus, those foremnost of gods, are in my front, and see, Nasatya and Dasra, those two celestial physicians, are in the rear. See also in my body all the Prajapatis and see the seven Rishis Also.

data.v: सर्वान्प्रजापतीन्पश्य पश्य सप्त ऋषीनपि । वेदान्यज्ञांश्च शतशः पश्यामृतमथौषधीः ॥
तपांसि नियमांश्चैव यमानपि पृथग्विधान् । तथाष्टगुणमैश्वर्यमेकस्थं पश्य मूर्तिमत् ॥
श्रियं लक्ष्मीं च कीर्तिं च पृथिवीं च ककुद्मिनीम् । वेदानां मातरं पश्य मत्स्थां देवीं सरस्वतीम् ॥
ध्रुवं च ज्योतिषां श्रेष्ठं पश्य नारद खेचरम् । अम्भोधरान्समुद्रांश्च सरांसि सरितस्तथा ॥
मूर्तिमन्तः पितृगणांश्चतुरः पश्य सत्तम । त्रींश्चैवेमान्गुणान्पश्य मत्स्थान्मूर्तिविवर्जितान् ॥
data.md: See also all the Oceans, those receptacles of water, and lakes, and rivers. See, also, O best of men, the four foremost ones amongst the Pitris in their embodied forms. See also, living in me, the three qualities (of Sattva, Rajas, and Tamas) which are formless.

data.v: देवकार्यादपि मुने पितृकार्यं विशिष्यते । देवानां च पितॄणां च पिता ह्येकोऽहमादितः ॥
data.md: The acts done in honour of the departed mane are superior to those done in honour of the gods. I am the Pitri of the both the gods and the Pitris, and am existing from the beginning.

data.v: अहं हयशिरो भूत्वा समुद्रे पश्चिमोत्तरे । पिबामि सुहुतं हव्यं कव्यं च श्रद्धयान्वितम् ॥
data.md: Becoming the Equine-head I pass through the Western and the Northern ocean and drink sacrificial libations duly poured with Mantras and solid sacrificial food offered with respect and devotion.

data.v: मया सृष्टः पुरा ब्रह्मा मद्यज्ञमयजत्स्वयम् । ततस्तस्मै वरान्प्रीतो ददावहमनुत्तमान् ॥
data.md: In ancient times I created Brahman who himself worshipped me in sacrifices. Pleased with him on that account I granted him many excellent boons.

data.v: मत्पुत्रत्वं च कल्पादौ लोकाध्यक्षत्वमेव च । अहंकारकृतं चैव नाम पर्यायवाचकम् ॥
data.md: I said to him that in the beginning of the cycle he would be born to me as my son, and the sovereignty of all the worlds would he enjoy, and various names will be given to diverse objects on account of the Ahankara, i. e., egoism, coming into existence.

data.v: त्वया कृतां च मर्यादां नातिक्राम्यति कश्चन । त्वं चैव वरदो ब्रह्मन्वरेप्सूनां भविष्यसि ॥
data.md: I also told him that none would ever violate the limits and boundaries he would lay down, and, further that he would be the giver of boons to persons who would solicit him for the same.

data.v: सुरासुरगणानां च ऋषीणां च तपोधन । पितॄणां च महाभाग सततं संशितव्रत । विविधानां च भूतानां त्वमुपास्यो भविष्यसि ॥
data.md: I further assured him that he would be an object of worship with all the gods and Asuras, all the Rishis and Pitris, and the various creatures forming the creation.

data.v: प्रादुर्भावगतश्चाहं सुरकार्येषु नित्यदा । अनुशास्यस्त्वया ब्रह्मन्नियोज्यश्च सुतो यथा ॥
data.md: I also gave him to understand that I would always appear for performing the business of the gods and for that I would allow myself to be commanded by him even as a son by his father.

data.v: एतांश्चान्यांश्च रुचिरान्ब्रह्मणेऽमिततेजसे । अहं दत्त्वा वरान्प्रीतो निवृत्तिपरमोऽभवम् ॥
data.md: Granting these and other highly agreeable boons to Brahman of great energy on account of my being propitiated with him I adopted the course dictated by Renunciation.

data.v: निर्वाणं सर्वधर्माणां निवृत्तिः परमा स्मृता । तस्मान्निवृत्तिमापन्नश्चरेत्सर्वाङ्गनिर्वृतः ॥
data.md: The highest Renunciation is the annihilation of all duties and acts. Hence, by adopting Renunciation one should act in complete happiness.

data.v: विद्यासहायवन्तं मामादित्यस्थं सनातनम् । कपिलं प्राहुराचार्याः सांख्यनिश्चितनिश्चयाः ॥
data.md: Learned preceptors, with settled conclusions deducted from the truths of the Sankhya philosophy, have spoken of me as Kapila endued with the power of knowledge, living within the effulgence of the Sun, and concentrated in Yoga.

data.v: हिरण्यगर्भो भगवानेष छन्दसि सुष्टुतः । सोऽहं योगगतिर्ब्रह्मन्योगशास्त्रेषु शब्दितः ॥
data.md: In the Vedas I have been repeatedly hymned as the illustrious Hiranyagarbha. In the Yoga-Shastras, O Brahmana, I have been spoken of as one who find pleasure in Yoga.

data.v: एषोऽहं व्यक्तिमागम्य तिष्ठामि दिवि शाश्वतः । ततो युगसहस्रान्ते संहरिष्ये जगत्पुनः । कृत्वात्मस्थानि भूतानि स्थावराणि चराणि च ॥
data.md: I am eternal. Assuming a form that is manifest, I live at present, in the sky. At the end of a thousand cycles, I shall once more withdraw the universe into myself.

data.v: एकाकी विद्यया सार्धं विहरिष्ये द्विजोत्तम । ततो भूयो जगत्सर्वं करिष्यामीह विद्यया ॥
अस्मन्मूर्तिश्चतुर्थी या सासृजच्छेषमव्ययम् । स हि संकर्षणः प्रोक्तः प्रद्युम्नं सोऽप्यजीजनत् ॥
प्रद्युम्नादनिरुद्धोऽहं सर्गो मम पुनः पुनः । अनिरुद्धात्तथा ब्रह्मा तत्रादिकमलोद्भवः ॥
ब्रह्मणः सर्वभूतानि चराणि स्थावराणि च । एतां सृष्टिं विजानीहि कल्पादिषु पुनः पुनः ॥
यथा सूर्यस्य गगनादुदयास्तमयाविह । नष्टौ पुनर्बलात्काल आनयत्यमितद्युतिः । तथा बलादहं पृथ्वीं सर्वभूतहिताय वै ॥
सत्त्वैराक्रान्तसर्वाङ्गां नष्टां सागरमेखलाम् । आनयिष्यामि स्वं स्थानं वाराहं रूपमास्थितः ॥
हिरण्याक्षं हनिष्यामि दैतेयं बलगर्वितम् । नारसिंहं वपुः कृत्वा हिरण्यकशिपुं पुनः । सुरकार्ये हनिष्यामि यज्ञघ्नं दितिनन्दनम् ॥
data.md: Assuming the form then of a Manlion, I shall, for doing good to the gods, kill Hiranyakasipu, the son of Diti, who will be a great destroyer of sacrifices.

data.v: विरोचनस्य बलवान्बलिः पुत्रो महासुरः । भविष्यति स शक्रं च स्वराज्याच्च्यावयिष्यति ॥
data.md: Virochana will have a powerful son named Vali. The entire universe consisting of gods, Asuras, and Rakshasas will not be able to kill that great Asura. He will hurl Shakra from the sovereignty of the universe.

data.v: त्रैलोक्येऽपहृते तेन विमुखे च शचीपतौ । अदित्यां द्वादशः पुत्रः संभविष्यामि कश्यपात् ॥
ततो राज्यं प्रदास्यामि शक्रायामिततेजसे । देवताः स्थापयिष्यामि स्वेषु स्थानेषु नारद । बलिं चैव करिष्यामि पातालतलवासिनम् ॥
data.md: I shall restore it to Indra of immeasurable splendour, and replace the gods, O Narada, in their respective stations,

data.v: त्रेतायुगे भविष्यामि रामो भृगुकुलोद्वहः । क्षत्रं चोत्सादयिष्यामि समृद्धबलवाहनम् ॥
data.md: In the Treta age I shall take birth as Rama in the race of Bhrigu, and root out the Kshatriyas who will become proud of their strength and riches.

data.v: संधौ तु समनुप्राप्ते त्रेतायां द्वापरस्य च । रामो दाशरथिर्भूत्वा भविष्यामि जगत्पतिः ॥
data.md: Towards the end of Treta and the beginning of Dvapara, I shall take birth as Rama the son of Dasharatha in Ikshvaku's race.

data.v: त्रितोपघाताद्वैरूप्यमेकतोऽथ द्वितस्तथा । प्राप्स्यतो वानरत्वं हि प्रजापतिसुतावृषी ॥
data.md: At that time, the two Rishis, viz., the two sons of Prajapati, called by the names of Ekata and Dvita, will on account of the injury done by them to their brother Trita, have to take birth as monkeys, losing the beauty of the human forin.

data.v: तयोर्ये त्वन्वये जाता भविष्यन्ति वनौकसः । ते सहाया भविष्यन्ति सुरकार्ये मम द्विज ॥
data.md: Those monkeys that shall take birth in the race of Ekata and Dvita, shall become endued with great power and mighty energy and will equal Shakra himself in power. All those monkeys, O twice-born one, will become my allies for performing the work of the gods.

data.v: ततो रक्षःपतिं घोरं पुलस्त्यकुलपांसनम् । हनिष्ये रावणं संख्ये सगणं लोककण्टकम् ॥
data.md: I shall then kill the dreadful king of the Rakshasas, that wretch of Pulastya's race, viz., the fierce Ravana, that thorn of all worlds, together with all his children and followers.

data.v: द्वापरस्य कलेश्चैव संधौ पर्यवसानिके । प्रादुर्भावः कंसहेतोर्मथुरायां भविष्यति ॥
data.md: At the junction the Dvapara and the Kali ages, I shall again appear in the world taking birth in city of Mathura for the purpose of killing Kansa.

data.v: तत्राहं दानवान्हत्वा सुबहून्देवकण्टकान् । कुशस्थलीं करिष्यामि निवासं द्वारकां पुरीम् ॥
data.md: There, after killing numberless Danavas that will be as thorns in the side of the gods, I shali take up my residence in Kushasthali at the city of Dwaraka.

data.v: वसानस्तत्र वै पुर्यामदितेर्विप्रियंकरम् । हनिष्ये नरकं भौमं मुरं पीठं च दानवम् ॥
data.md: While living in that city I shall kill the Asura Naraka the chief of the Earth,-him, that is, who will do an injury to Aditi, as also some other Danavas of the names of Muru and Pitha.

data.v: प्राग्ज्योतिषपुरं रम्यं नानाधनसमन्वितम् । कुशस्थलीं नयिष्यामि हत्वा वै दानवोत्तमान् ॥
data.md: Killing also another foremost of Danavas, viz., the kill of Pragjyotisha, I shall transplant that delightful city furnished with various kinds of wealth into Dwaraka.

data.v: शंकरं च महासेनं बाणप्रियहितैषिणम् । पराजेष्याम्यथोद्युक्तौ देवलोकनमस्कृतौ ॥
data.md: I shall then defeat the two gods adored of all the deities, viz., Maheshvara and Mahasena, who will become fond of the Danava Vana and do him various good offices and who will try their best for that worshipper of theirs.

data.v: ततः सुतं बलेर्जित्वा बाणं बाहुसहस्रिणम् । विनाशयिष्यामि ततः सर्वान्सौभनिवासिनः ॥
data.md: Defeating next the son of the Danava Vali, viz., Bana, who will be possessed a thousandarms, I shall next destroy all the inhabitants of the Danava city called Saubha.

data.v: यः कालयवनः ख्यातो गर्गतेजोभिसंवृतः । भविष्यति वधस्तस्य मत्त एव द्विजोत्तम ॥
data.md: I shall next, O foremost of Brahmanas, bring about the death of Kalayavana, a Danava who will be endued with great power on account of his being equipt with the energy of Gargya.

data.v: जरासंधश्च बलवान्सर्वराजविरोधकः । भविष्यत्यसुरः स्फीतो भूमिपालो गिरिव्रजे । मम बुद्धिपरिस्पन्दाद्वधस्तस्य भविष्यति ॥
data.md: A proud Asura will appear as a king at Girivraja, of the name of Jarasandha, who will fall out with all the other kings of the world. His death will be brought about by me through some one else guided by my intelligence.

data.v: समागतेषु बलिषु पृथिव्यां सर्वराजसु । वासविः सुसहायो वै मम ह्येको भविष्यति ॥
data.md: I shall next kill Shisupala in the sacrifice of king Yudhishthira the son of Dharma, into which sacrifice all the kings of the world will bring tribute. In some of these works, only Arjuna, the son of Vasava, will become my assistant.

data.v: एवं लोका वदिष्यन्ति नरनारायणावृषी । उद्युक्तौ दहतः क्षत्रं लोककार्यार्थमीश्वरौ ॥
कृत्वा भारावतरणं वसुधाया यथेप्सितम् । सर्वसात्वतमुख्यानां द्वारकायाश्च सत्तम । करिष्ये प्रलयं घोरमात्मज्ञातिविनाशनम् ॥
कर्माण्यपरिमेयानि चतुर्मूर्तिधरो ह्यहम् । कृत्वा लोकान्गमिष्यामि स्वानहं ब्रह्मसत्कृतान् ॥
data.md: Having four forms, I shall, in this way, perform many feats of great prowess, and attain at last to those regions of happiness created by me and honoured by all the Brahmanas.

data.v: हंसो हयशिराश्चैव प्रादुर्भावा द्विजोत्तम । यदा वेदश्रुतिर्नष्टा मया प्रत्याहृता तदा । सवेदाः सश्रुतीकाश्च कृताः पूर्वं कृते युगे ॥
data.md: When the Vedas disappeared from the world, I brought them back. The Vedas, were re-created by me in the Krita age.

data.v: अतिक्रान्ताः पुराणेषु श्रुतास्ते यदि वा क्वचित् । अतिक्रान्ताश्च बहवः प्रादुर्भावा ममोत्तमाः । लोककार्याणि कृत्वा च पुनः स्वां प्रकृतिं गताः ॥
data.md: They have once more disappeared or may only be partially heard here and there in the Puranas. Many of my best incarnations also in the world have become facts of the past.

data.v: न ह्येतद्ब्रह्मणा प्राप्तमीदृशं मम दर्शनम् । यत्त्वया प्राप्तमद्येह एकान्तगतबुद्धिना ॥
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं ब्रह्मन्भक्तिमतो मया । पुराणं च भविष्यं च सरहस्यं च सत्तम ॥
एवं स भगवान्देवो विश्वमूर्तिधरोऽव्ययः । एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ॥
data.md: Bhishma said 'The holy and illustrious god, of universal and immutable form, having said these words to Narada, disappeared there and then.

data.v: नारदोऽपि महातेजाः प्राप्यानुग्रहमीप्सितम् । नरनारायणौ द्रष्टुं प्राद्रवद्बदराश्रमम् ॥
data.md: Having won the high favour that he had solicited, Narada also, gifted with great energy, then proceeded in all haste to the retreat called Vadari, for seeing Nara and Narayana.

data.v: इदं महोपनिषदं चतुर्वेदसमन्वितम् । सांख्ययोगकृतं तेन पञ्चरात्रानुशब्दितम् ॥
data.md: This great Upanishad quite of a piece with the four Vedas, and the Sankhya-Yoga, and called by him by the name of the Pancharatra Scriptures and recited by Narayana himself with his own mouth, was repeated by Narada before a large audience in the residence of Brahman (his sire) in exactly the same way in which Narayana had recited it and in which he had heard it from his own lips."

data.v: नारायणमुखोद्गीतं नारदोऽश्रावयत्पुनः । ब्रह्मणः सदने तात यथा दृष्टं यथा श्रुतम् ॥
data.md: This great Upanishad quite of a piece with the four Vedas, and the Sankhya-Yoga, and called by him by the name of the Pancharatra Scriptures and recited by Narayana himself with his own mouth, was repeated by Narada before a large audience in the residence of Brahman (his sire) in exactly the same way in which Narayana had recited it and in which he had heard it from his own lips."

data.v: एतदाश्चर्यभूतं हि माहात्म्यं तस्य धीमतः । किं ब्रह्मा न विजानीते यतः शुश्राव नारदात् ॥
data.md: Yudhishthira said “Was not Brahman. the Creator of all things, acquainted with this wonderful discourse of the glory of Narayana gifted with intelligence that he heard it from the lips of Narada?

data.v: पितामहो हि भगवांस्तस्माद्देवादनन्तरः । कथं स न विजानीयात्प्रभावममितौजसः ॥
data.md: Is the illustrious Grandfather of all the worlds any way different from or inferior to the great Narayana? How then it is that he was unacquainted with the power of Narayana of great energy?"

data.v: महाकल्पसहस्राणि महाकल्पशतानि च । समतीतानि राजेन्द्र सर्गाश्च प्रलयाश्च ह ॥
data.md: Bhishma continued "Hundreds and thousands of great cycles, hundreds and thousands of Creations and Dissolutions, O king of kings, have been over and become events of the past.

data.v: सर्गस्यादौ स्मृतो ब्रह्मा प्रजासर्गकरः प्रभुः । जानाति देवप्रवरं भूयश्चातोऽधिकं नृप । परमात्मानमीशानमात्मनः प्रभवं तथा ॥
data.md: In the beginning of every Creation, Brahman, endued with great power and who creates all things, is remembered by Narayana). Brahman knows well, O king, that Narayana, that foremost of all gods is very much superior to him.

data.v: ये त्वन्ये ब्रह्मसदने सिद्धसंघाः समागताः । तेभ्यस्तच्छ्रावयामास पुराणं वेदसंमितम् ॥
तेषां सकाशात्सूर्यश्च श्रुत्वा वै भावितात्मनाम् । आत्मानुगामिनां ब्रह्म श्रावयामास भारत ॥
षट्षष्टिर्हि सहस्राणि ऋषीणां भावितात्मनाम् । सूर्यस्य तपतो लोकान्निर्मिता ये पुरःसराः । तेषामकथयत्सूर्यः सर्वेषां भावितात्मनाम् ॥
सूर्यानुगामिभिस्तात ऋषिभिस्तैर्महात्मभिः । मेरौ समागता देवाः श्राविताश्चेदमुत्तमम् ॥
data.md: The great Rishis who follow in the Sun's train, O son, repeated that excellent narrative to the deities assembled on the breast of Meru.

data.v: देवानां तु सकाशाद्वै ततः श्रुत्वासितो द्विजः । श्रावयामास राजेन्द्र पितॄणां मुनिसत्तमः ॥
data.md: The best of ascetics, viz., the regener: Asita, then, having heard the narrative from the gods, repeated it to the Pitris, O king of kings.

data.v: मम चापि पिता तात कथयामास शंतनुः । ततो मयैतच्छ्रुत्वा च कीर्तितं तव भारत ॥
data.md: I heard it from my father Shantanu, O son, who recited it to me formerly. Myself having heard it from my father, I have repeated it to you, O Bharata.

data.v: सुरैर्वा मुनिभिर्वापि पुराणं यैरिदं श्रुतम् । सर्वे ते परमात्मानं पूजयन्ति पुनः पुनः ॥
data.md: Gods and ascetics, they who have heard this excellent old narrative which is a Purana, all worship the Supreme Soul.

data.v: इदमाख्यानमार्षेयं पारंपर्यागतं नृप । नावासुदेवभक्ताय त्वया देयं कथंचन ॥
data.md: This discourse, belonging to the Rishis and thus handed down from one to another, should not, O king, be communicated by you to any one who is not a worshipper of Vasudeva.

data.v: मत्तोऽन्यानि च ते राजन्नुपाख्यानशतानि वै । यानि श्रुतानि धर्म्याणि तेषां सारोऽयमुद्धृतः ॥
data.md: This narrative, O king, is really the cream of the hundreds of other discourses that you have heard from me.

data.v: सुरासुरैर्यथा राजन्निर्मथ्यामृतमुद्धृतम् । एवमेतत्पुरा विप्रैः कथामृतमिहोद्धृतम् ॥
data.md: In days of yore, O king, the gods and the Asuras, in a body, churned the Ocean and raised the Ambrosia. Similarly the Brahmanas, in a body in days of yore, churned all the scriptures and raised this narrative, which resembles nectar.

data.v: यश्चेदं पठते नित्यं यश्चेदं शृणुयान्नरः । एकान्तभावोपगत एकान्ते सुसमाहितः ॥
प्राप्य श्वेतं महाद्वीपं भूत्वा चन्द्रप्रभो नरः । स सहस्रार्चिषं देवं प्रविशेन्नात्र संशयः ॥
data.md: He who frequently reads this narrative, and he who frequently listens to it with rapt attention, in a secluded spot, and filled with devotion, succeeds, being possessed of lunar complexion, in living in the spacious insular continent known by the name of White Island. Forsooth, such a man succeeds in entering into Narayana of a thousand rays.

data.v: मुच्येदार्तस्तथा रोगाच्छ्रुत्वेमामादितः कथाम् । जिज्ञासुर्लभते कामान्भक्तो भक्तगतिं व्रजेत् ॥
data.md: By listening to this narrative from the beginning, a sick person becomes freed from his disease. The man who simply desires to read or listen to this discourse, gets the fruition of all his wishes. By reading or listening to it. The devoted worshipper acquires the high end reserved for devoted worshippers.

data.v: त्वयापि सततं राजन्नभ्यर्च्यः पुरुषोत्तमः । स हि माता पिता चैव कृत्स्नस्य जगतो गुरुः ॥
data.md: You also, O king, should always adore and worship that foremost of all Beings. He is the father and the mother of all creatures, and He is an object of reverence to the entire universe.

data.v: ब्रह्मण्यदेवो भगवान्प्रीयतां ते सनातनः । युधिष्ठिर महाबाहो महाबाहुर्जनार्दनः ॥
data.md: Let the illustrious and Eternal God of the Brahmanas, Viz., Janarddana of great intelligence, be pleased with you, O Yudhisthira of mighty arms.

data.v: श्रुत्वैतदाख्यानवरं धर्मराड्जनमेजय । भ्रातरश्चास्य ते सर्वे नारायणपराभवन् ॥
data.md: Vaishampayana said Having listened to this best of discourses, O Janamejaya, king Yudhisthira the just, and all his brothers became devoted to Narayana.

data.v: जितं भगवता तेन पुरुषेणेति भारत । नित्यं जप्यपरा भूत्वा सरस्वतीमुदीरयन् ॥
data.md: And all of them, O Bharata, silently meditating upon Narayana (from that day), uttered these words for His glorification, viz., Victory to that holy and illustrious Being.

data.v: यो ह्यस्माकं गुरुः श्रेष्ठः कृष्णद्वैपायनो मुनिः । स जगौ परमं जप्यं नारायणमुदीरयन् ॥
data.md: He, again, who is our best of preceptors, viz., the Island-born Krishna, devoted to penances, sung, uttering the word Narayana, that great Mantra which is worthy of being silently.

data.v: गत्वान्तरिक्षात्सततं क्षीरोदममृताशयम् । पूजयित्वा च देवेशं पुनरायात्स्वमाश्रमम् ॥
data.md: Passing through the sky to the Ocean of milk, which is always the abode of nectar, and adoring the great God there, be returned to his own hermitage.

data.v: कथं स भगवान्देवो यज्ञेष्वग्रहरः प्रभुः । यज्ञधारी च सततं वेदवेदाङ्गवित्तथा ॥
data.md: Saunaka said is that illustrious god, viz., the powerful Narayana, who is a master of the Vedas and their branches, at once the doer and the enjoyer of sacrifices?

data.v: निवृत्तं चास्थितो धर्मं क्षेमी भागवतप्रियः । प्रवृत्तिधर्मान्विदधे स एव भगवान्प्रभुः ॥
data.md: Endued with forgiveness, he has adopted, again, the Religion of Renunciation. Indeed, it is that holy and powerful one who has himself laid down the duties of Renunciation.

data.v: कथं प्रवृत्तिधर्मेषु भागार्हा देवताः कृताः । कथं निवृत्तिधर्माश्च कृता व्यावृत्तबुद्धयः ॥
data.md: Why then has he made many of the gods the takers of shares in sacrifices which, of course, are all due to the Religion of Action. Why has he again created some with an opposite disposition, for they follow the ordinances of the Religion of Renunciation.

data.v: एतं नः संशयं विप्र छिन्धि गुह्यं सनातनम् । त्वया नारायणकथा श्रुता वै धर्मसंहिता ॥
data.md: Do you, O Suta, remove this doubt of ours. This doubt seems to be eternal and is filled with great mystery. You have heard all discourses on Narayana, which are consistent with the (other) scriptures.

data.v: इमे सब्रह्मका लोकाः ससुरासुरमानवाः । क्रियास्वभ्युदयोक्तासु सक्ता दृश्यन्ति सर्वशः । मोक्षश्चोक्तस्त्वया ब्रह्मन्निर्वाणं परमं सुखम् ॥
data.md: The whole world of Being, with Brahman, the gods, the Asuras, and human beings are seen to be deeply attached to acts which yield prosperity.

data.v: ये च मुक्ता भवन्तीह पुण्यपापविवर्जिताः । ते सहस्रार्चिषं देवं प्रविशन्तीति शुश्रुमः ॥
data.md: Liberation has, O twice-born one, been described by you to be the highest happiness and to consist of the cessation of existence. They who being shorn of both merit and demerit, become liberated, succeed, we hear, in entering the great God of a thousand rays.

data.v: अहो हि दुरनुष्ठेयो मोक्षधर्मः सनातनः । यं हित्वा देवताः सर्वा हव्यकव्यभुजोऽभवन् ॥
data.md: It seems to be, O Brahmana, that the eternal religion of Liberation is highly difficult of observance. Turning away from it, all the gods have become enjoyers of the libations of clarified butter poured with Mantras on sacrificial fires and other offerings presented to them by similar means.

data.v: किं नु ब्रह्मा च रुद्रश्च शक्रश्च बलभित्प्रभुः । सूर्यस्ताराधिपो वायुरग्निर्वरुण एव च । आकाशं जगती चैव ये च शेषा दिवौकसः ॥
data.md: Then, again, Brahman, and Rudra, the powerful Sakra the killer of Vala, the Sun, the Lord of the stars, the Wind-god, the god of fire, the god of the Waters, Infinite Space, the Universe too and the rest of the dwellers of heaven,-these, it seems do not know the way of securing an annihilation of conscious existence that is encompassed by one's own efforts.

data.v: प्रलयं न विजानन्ति आत्मनः परिनिर्मितम् । ततस्ते नास्थिता मार्गं ध्रुवमक्षयमव्ययम् ॥
स्मृत्वा कालपरीमाणं प्रवृत्तिं ये समास्थिताः । दोषः कालपरीमाणे महानेष क्रियावताम् ॥
data.md: Hence, perhaps, they have not followed the path which is certain, indestructible, and immutable. Hence, perhaps turning away from that path, they have adopted the Religion of Action which leads to conscious existence that is measured by time.

data.v: एतन्मे संशयं विप्र हृदि शल्यमिवार्पितम् । छिन्धीतिहासकथनात्परं कौतूहलं हि मे ॥
data.md: This, indeed, is one great defeat of those who are wedded to acts, for all their rewards are for the time being. This doubt, O twiceborn one, exists in my heart like a dagger! Tear it out by recounting to me some discourses of old on this subject. Great is my curiosity to listen to you.

data.v: कथं भागहराः प्रोक्ता देवताः क्रतुषु द्विज । किमर्थं चाध्वरे ब्रह्मन्निज्यन्ते त्रिदिवौकसः ॥
data.md: Why, O twice-born one, have the gods been said to be takers of their respective shares of sacrificial offerings presented to them with the help of Mantras in sacrifices of various kinds? Why, again, are the dwellers of heaven worshipped in sacrifices?

data.v: ये च भागं प्रगृह्णन्ति यज्ञेषु द्विजसत्तम । ते यजन्तो महायज्ञैः कस्य भागं ददन्ति वै ॥
data.md: And, O best of twice-born ones to whom do they, who partake of offerings in sacrifices performed to their honour, themselves make offerings when they perform great sacrifices?

data.v: अहो गूढतमः प्रश्नस्त्वया पृष्टो जनेश्वर । नातप्ततपसा ह्येष नावेदविदुषा तथा । नापुराणविदा चापि शक्यो व्याहर्तुमञ्जसा ॥
data.md: The question you have put to me, O king, relates to a deed mystery. No man can quickly answer it who has not practised penances, and who is not acquainted with the Puranas.

data.v: हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि यन्मे पृष्टः पुरा गुरुः । कृष्णद्वैपायनो व्यासो वेदव्यासो महानृषिः ॥
data.md: I shall, however, answer you by reciting to you what my preceptor the Island-born Krishna, otherwise called Vyasa, the great Rishi who has divided the Vedas, had said to us on a former occasion when questioned by us.

data.v: सुमन्तुर्जैमिनिश्चैव पैलश्च सुदृढव्रतः । अहं चतुर्थः शिष्यो वै पञ्चमश्च शुकः स्मृतः ॥
data.md: Sumanta, and Jaimini, and Paila of firm vows, and myself as the fourth, and Shuka. as the fifth, were disciples of the illustrious Vyasa.

data.v: एतान्समागतान्सर्वान्पञ्च शिष्यान्दमान्वितान् । शौचाचारसमायुक्ताञ्जितक्रोधाञ्जितेन्द्रियान् ॥
data.md: We, five in all, endued with self-control and purity of observances, had completely mastered anger and controlled our senses. Our preceptor used to teach us the Vedas having the Mahabharata for their fifth.

data.v: वेदानध्यापयामास महाभारतपञ्चमान् । मेरौ गिरिवरे रम्ये सिद्धचारणसेविते ॥
तेषामभ्यस्यतां वेदान्कदाचित्संशयोऽभवत् । एष वै यस्त्वया पृष्टस्तेन तेषां प्रकीर्तितः । ततः श्रुतो मया चापि तवाख्येयोऽद्य भारत ॥
data.md: Once on a time, on the breast of that foremost of mountains, viz., the delightful Meru, inhabited by Siddhas and Charanas while we were engaged in reading the Vedas, this very doubt sprang in our minds, that has been given vent to by you to-day. We, therefore, asked our preceptor about it. It heared the answer that our preceptor made. I shall now recount that answer to you, O Bharata.

data.v: शिष्याणां वचनं श्रुत्वा सर्वाज्ञानतमोनुदः । पराशरसुतः श्रीमान्व्यासो वाक्यमुवाच ह ॥
data.md: Hearing the words that were addressed to him by his disciples, that remover of all sorts of darkness represented by ignorance, viz., the blessed Vyasa the son of Parashara, said these words:मया हि सुमहत् तप्तं तपः परमदारुणम्।

data.v: मया हि सुमहत्तप्तं तपः परमदारुणम् । भूतं भव्यं भविष्यच्च जानीयामिति सत्तमाः ॥
data.md: I have practised the austerest of penances. You best of men, I am fully conversant with the Past, the Present, and the Future.

data.v: तस्य मे तप्ततपसो निगृहीतेन्द्रियस्य च । नारायणप्रसादेन क्षीरोदस्यानुकूलतः ॥
data.md: On account of those penances of mine and of the control under which I kept my senses, while I lived on the shores of the ocean of milk, Narayana became pleased with me. As the result of the great God's gratification, this omniscience about the Past, the Present, and Future that was desired by me, sprang in my inind.

data.v: त्रैकालिकमिदं ज्ञानं प्रादुर्भूतं यथेप्सितम् । तच्छृणुध्वं यथाज्ञानं वक्ष्ये संशयमुत्तमम् । यथा वृत्तं हि कल्पादौ दृष्टं मे ज्ञानचक्षुषा ॥
data.md: Listen now to me as I describe to you, in due order, this great doubt that has perplexed your minds. I have, with the eye of knowledge, seen, all that took place in the beginning of the aeon.

data.v: परमात्मेति यं प्राहुः सांख्ययोगविदो जनाः । महापुरुषसंज्ञां स लभते स्वेन कर्मणा ॥
data.md: He whom both the Sankhyas and the Yogins call by the name of the Supreme Soul, comes to be regarded as the foremost Purusha on account of his own deeds. From Him originate Prakriti that is called the unmanifest or Pradhana by the learned.

data.v: तस्मात्प्रसूतमव्यक्तं प्रधानं तद्विदुर्बुधाः । अव्यक्ताद्व्यक्तमुत्पन्नं लोकसृष्ट्यर्थमीश्वरात् ॥
अनिरुद्धो हि लोकेषु महानात्मेति कथ्यते । योऽसौ व्यक्तत्वमापन्नो निर्ममे च पितामहम् । सोऽहंकार इति प्रोक्तः सर्वतेजोमयो हि सः ॥
data.md: It is that Aniruddha who, becoming manifest, created the Grandfather Brahman. Aniruddha is known by another name, viz., consciousness, and is gifted with every sort of energy.

data.v: पृथिवी वायुराकाशमापो ज्योतिश्च पञ्चमम् । अहंकारप्रसूतानि महाभूतानि भारत ॥
data.md: Earth, Wind, Ether, Water, and Fire numbering the fifth—these are the five Great Creatures that have originated from Consciousness.

data.v: महाभूतानि सृष्ट्वाथ तद्गुणान्निर्ममे पुनः । भूतेभ्यश्चैव निष्पन्ना मूर्तिमन्तोऽष्ट ताञ्शृणु ॥
data.md: Having created the Great Creatures he then created their qualities. Combining the Great Creatures, he then created various embodied Beings. Hear me as I describe them to you.

data.v: मरीचिरङ्गिराश्चात्रिः पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः । वसिष्ठश्च महात्मा वै मनुः स्वायंभुवस्तथा । ज्ञेयाः प्रकृतयोऽष्टौ ता यासु लोकाः प्रतिष्ठिताः ॥
data.md: Marichi, Angiras, Atri, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, the great Vashistha, and the Self-created Manu,-these should be known as the eight elements. Upon these depend all the worlds.

data.v: वेदान्वेदाङ्गसंयुक्तान्यज्ञान्यज्ञाङ्गसंयुतान् । निर्ममे लोकसिद्ध्यर्थं ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । अष्टाभ्यः प्रकृतिभ्यश्च जातं विश्वमिदं जगत् ॥
data.md: Then the Grandfather of all the worlds, viz., Brahman, created, for the success of all creatures, the Vedas with all their branches as also the sacrifices with their limbs. From these eight elements have originated this vast universe.

data.v: रुद्रो रोषात्मको जातो दशान्यान्सोऽसृजत्स्वयम् । एकादशैते रुद्रास्तु विकाराः पुरुषाः स्मृताः ॥
data.md: Then originated Rudra from the principle of anger. Taking birth, he created ten others like him. These eleven Rudras are called by name of Vikara-Purushas.

data.v: ते रुद्राः प्रकृतिश्चैव सर्वे चैव सुरर्षयः । उत्पन्ना लोकसिद्ध्यर्थं ब्रह्माणं समुपस्थिताः ॥
data.md: The Rudras, the Prakritis, and the several celestial Rishis, having come into existence approached Brahman, with the object of upholding the universe and its work.

data.v: वयं हि सृष्टा भगवंस्त्वया वै प्रभविष्णुना । येन यस्मिन्नधीकारे वर्तितव्यं पितामह ॥
data.md: Addressing the Grandfather, they said,-We have been created, O holy one, by you, O you of great power. Tell us, O Grandfather, which of us should be vested with what jurisdiction.

data.v: योऽसौ त्वया विनिर्दिष्टो अधिकारोऽर्थचिन्तकः । परिपाल्यः कथं तेन सोऽधिकारोऽधिकारिणा ॥
data.md: What jurisdictions have been created by you for supervising what particular affairs? Which of us should, gifted with what sort of consciousness, shall take charge of which of these?

data.v: प्रदिशस्व बलं तस्य योऽधिकारार्थचिन्तकः । एवमुक्तो महादेवो देवांस्तानिदमब्रवीत् ॥
data.md: Do you ordain also to each of us the measure of strength that we are to have for satisfying the duties duties of our our respective jurisdictions.-Thus addressed by them, the great god replied to them in the following way.

data.v: साध्वहं ज्ञापितो देवा युष्माभिर्भद्रमस्तु वः । ममाप्येषा समुत्पन्ना चिन्ता या भवतां मता ॥
data.md: Brahman said You have done well, ye gods, in speaking to me of this matter. Blessed be you all! I was thinking of this very subject that has drawn your attention.

data.v: लोकतन्त्रस्य कृत्स्नस्य कथं कार्यः परिग्रहः । कथं बलक्षयो न स्याद्युष्माकं ह्यात्मनश्च मे ॥
data.md: How should the three words be maintained and kept agoing? How should your strength and mine be taken advantage of for the accomplishment of that object.

data.v: इतः सर्वेऽपि गच्छामः शरणं लोकसाक्षिणम् । महापुरुषमव्यक्तं स नो वक्ष्यति यद्धितम् ॥
data.md: Let all of us, leaving this place, go that unmanifest and foremost of Beings who is the witness of the world, for seeking his protection. He will tell us what is for our behoof.

data.v: ततस्ते ब्रह्मणा सार्धमृषयो विबुधास्तथा । क्षीरोदस्योत्तरं कूलं जग्मुर्लोकहितार्थिनः ॥
data.md: After this, those gods and Rishis, with Brahman, went to the northern shores of the ocean of milk, desirous of doing good to the three worlds.

data.v: ते तपः समुपातिष्ठन्ब्रह्मोक्तं वेदकल्पितम् । स महानियमो नाम तपश्चर्या सुदारुणा ॥
data.md: Arrived there, they began to practise those austere penances that are said by Brahman in the Vedas. Those austerest of penances are known by the name of Mahaniyama.

data.v: ऊर्ध्वं दृष्टिर्बाहवश्च एकाग्रं च मनोऽभवत् । एकपादस्थिताः सम्यक्काष्ठभूताः समाहिताः ॥
data.md: They stood there with mind fixed, immovable as stakes of wood, and with eyes upturned and arms raised upward.

data.v: दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं ते तपस्तप्त्वा तदुत्तमम् । शुश्रुवुर्मधुरां वाणीं वेदवेदाङ्गभूषिताम् ॥
data.md: For a thousand divine years they were engaged in those severe penances. At the conclusion of that time they heard these sweet words in harmony with the Vedas and their branches.

data.v: भो भोः सब्रह्मका देवा ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः । स्वागतेनार्च्य वः सर्वाञ्श्रावये वाक्यमुत्तमम् ॥
data.md: The Blessed and Holy One said You gods and Rishis having asceticism for wealth with Brahman in your company, honouring you all with welcome, I say to you these words.

data.v: विज्ञातं वो मया कार्यं तच्च लोकहितं महत् । प्रवृत्तियुक्तं कर्तव्यं युष्मत्प्राणोपबृंहणम् ॥
data.md: I know what is in your hearts! Verily, your thoughts are for the behoof of the three worlds. I shall multiply your energy and strength, investing the same with disposition for work.

data.v: सुतप्तं वस्तपो देवा ममाराधनकाम्यया । भोक्ष्यथास्य महासत्त्वास्तपसः फलमुत्तमम् ॥
data.md: You gods, well have you practised these penances from desire of worshipping me. You foremost of Beings, enjoy now the excellent fruits of those austerities which you have practised.

data.v: एष ब्रह्मा लोकगुरुः सर्वलोकपितामहः । यूयं च विबुधश्रेष्ठा मां यजध्वं समाहिताः ॥
data.md: This Brahman is the Lord of all the words. Gifted with power, he is the Grandfather of all creatures. You also are foremost of gods. Do you all, with concentrated minds, celebrate sacrifices for my glory.

data.v: सर्वे भागान्कल्पयध्वं यज्ञेषु मम नित्यशः । तथा श्रेयो विधास्यामि यथाधीकारमीश्वराः ॥
data.md: In those sacrifices which you will perform, do ye always give me a part of the sacrificial offerings. I shall then, ye lords of creation, assign to each of you your respective spheres and ordain what will be for your behoof.

data.v: श्रुत्वैतद्देवदेवस्य वाक्यं हृष्टतनूरुहाः । ततस्ते विबुधाः सर्वे ब्रह्मा ते च महर्षयः ॥
data.md: Vaishampayana said, Hearing these words of that God of gods, all those gods and great Rishis and Brahman became filled with such delight that the hair on their bodies stood erect.

data.v: वेददृष्टेन विधिना वैष्णवं क्रतुमाहरन् । तस्मिन्सत्रे तदा ब्रह्मा स्वयं भागमकल्पयत् । देवा देवर्षयश्चैव सर्वे भागानकल्पयन् ॥
data.md: They immediately made arrangements for a sacrifice in honour of Vishnu according to the Vedic ordinances. In that sacrifice, Brahman himself assigned a portion of the offerings to Vishnu.

data.v: ते कार्तयुगधर्माणो भागाः परमसत्कृताः । प्रापुरादित्यवर्णं तं पुरुषं तमसः परम् । बृहन्तं सर्वगं देवमीशानं वरदं प्रभुम् ॥
data.md: The gods and the Rishis and Brahman, in that sacrifice, worshipped the great God as one having the complexion of the Sun, as the foremost of Beings, situate beyond the reach of Ignorance, vast, pervading all things, the Supreme Lord of all, the giver of boons, and endued with power.

data.v: ततोऽथ वरदो देवस्तान्सर्वानमरान्स्थितान् । अशरीरो बभाषेदं वाक्यं खस्थो महेश्वरः ॥
data.md: Thus worshipped by them the boon-giving and great God, invisible and bodiless, addressed those assembled celestials from heaven and said to them

data.v: येन यः कल्पितो भागः स तथा समुपागतः । प्रीतोऽहं प्रदिशाम्यद्य फलमावृत्तिलक्षणम् ॥
data.md: I have received the offerings dedicated by you in this sacrifice. I am pleased with all of you. I shall confer rewards on you that will, however, be fraught with ends from where there will be return.

data.v: एतद्वो लक्षणं देवा मत्प्रसादसमुद्भवम् । यूयं यज्ञैरिज्यमानाः समाप्तवरदक्षिणैः । युगे युगे भविष्यध्वं प्रवृत्तिफलभोगिनः ॥
data.md: This shall be your distinctive characteristic, ye gods, from this day, on account of my favours and kindness for you. Celebrating sacrifices in every cycle, with large presents, you will become enjoyers of fruits born of Action.

data.v: यज्ञैर्ये चापि यक्ष्यन्ति सर्वलोकेषु वै सुराः । कल्पयिष्यन्ति वो भागांस्ते नरा वेदकल्पितान् ॥
data.md: You gods, those men also that will celebrate sacrifices, according to the Vedic ordinances, will give to all of you, shares of their sacrificial offerings.

data.v: यो मे यथा कल्पितवान्भागमस्मिन्महाक्रतौ । स तथा यज्ञभागार्हो वेदसूत्रे मया कृतः ॥
data.md: In the Veda-sutras I make him the receiver of a share like that which he has himself offered one in this sacrifice.

data.v: यूयं लोकान्धारयध्वं यज्ञभागफलोदिताः । सर्वार्थचिन्तका लोके यथाधीकारनिर्मिताः ॥
data.md: Created to superintend the affairs of your respective jurisdictions, do you uphold the worlds according to your strength as dependent on the shares you receive in those sacrifices.

data.v: याः क्रियाः प्रचरिष्यन्ति प्रवृत्तिफलसत्कृताः । ताभिराप्यायितबला लोकान्वै धारयिष्यथ ॥
data.md: Indeed, receiving strength from those rites and observances that will be in vogue in the several worlds, originating from the fruits of action, do ye continue to uphold the affairs of those worlds.

data.v: यूयं हि भाविता लोके सर्वयज्ञेषु मानवैः । मां ततो भावयिष्यध्वमेषा वो भावना मम ॥
data.md: Strengthened by the sacrifices that will be celebrated by men, ye will strengthen me. These are the thoughts that I cherish for you

data.v: इत्यर्थं निर्मिता वेदा यज्ञाश्चौषधिभिः सह । एभिः सम्यक्प्रयुक्तैर्हि प्रीयन्ते देवताः क्षितौ ॥
data.md: It is for this that I have created the Vedas and sacrifices and plants and herbs. Duly served with these by human beings on Earth, the gods will be pleased.

data.v: निर्माणमेतद्युष्माकं प्रवृत्तिगुणकल्पितम् । मया कृतं सुरश्रेष्ठा यावत्कल्पक्षयादिति । चिन्तयध्वं लोकहितं यथाधीकारमीश्वराः ॥
data.md: You foremost of gods, till the end of this aeon, I have ordained your creation, making your constitutions depend upon the result of the religion of Action. You foremost of Beings, do you then, about your respective jurisdictions, engage yourselves in seeking the welfare of the three worlds.

data.v: मरीचिरङ्गिराश्चात्रिः पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः । वसिष्ठ इति सप्तैते मानसा निर्मिता हि वै ॥
data.md: Marichi, Angiras, Atri, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, and Vasistha,-these seven Rishis have been created by the fiat of the will.

data.v: एते वेदविदो मुख्या वेदाचार्याश्च कल्पिताः । प्रवृत्तिधर्मिणश्चैव प्राजापत्येन कल्पिताः ॥
data.md: These will become the foremost of all persons versed in the Vedas. In fact, they will become the preceptors of the Vedas. They will follow the Religion of Action, for they have been intended to devote themselves to the act of procreating children.

data.v: अयं क्रियावतां पन्था व्यक्तीभूतः सनातनः । अनिरुद्ध इति प्रोक्तो लोकसर्गकरः प्रभुः ॥
data.md: This is the eternal path of creatures engaged in acts and observances. The powerful Lord who is charged with the creation of all the worlds is called Aniruddha.

data.v: सनः सनत्सुजातश्च सनकः ससनन्दनः । सनत्कुमारः कपिलः सप्तमश्च सनातनः ॥
सप्तैते मानसाः प्रोक्ता ऋषयो ब्रह्मणः सुताः । स्वयमागतविज्ञाना निवृत्तं धर्ममास्थिताः ॥
data.md: Sana, Sanatsujata, Sanaka, Sanandana, Sanatkumara, Kapila, and Sanatana,—these seven Rishis are known as the spiritual sons of Brahman. Their knowledge comes to them of itself. These seven follow the Religion of Renunciation.

data.v: एते योगविदो मुख्याः सांख्यधर्मविदस्तथा । आचार्या मोक्षशास्त्रे च मोक्षधर्मप्रवर्तकाः ॥
data.md: They are the foremost of all persons conversant with Yoga. They have a profound knowledge of the Sankhya philosophy. They are teachers of the scriptures on duty and it is they who introduce the duties of the Religion of Renunciation and cause them flow in the worlds.

data.v: यतोऽहं प्रसृतः पूर्वमव्यक्तात्त्रिगुणो महान् । तस्मात्परतरो योऽसौ क्षेत्रज्ञ इति कल्पितः । सोऽहं क्रियावतां पन्थाः पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभः ॥
data.md: From Nature has sprung Consciousness and the three great qualities. Transcending Nature is called Soul.

data.v: यो यथा निर्मितो जन्तुर्यस्मिन्यस्मिंश्च कर्मणि । प्रवृत्तौ वा निवृत्तौ वा तत्फलं सोऽश्नुतेऽवशः ॥
data.md: That Soul is myself. The path of those who follow acts is fraught with return. One cannot, by that path, reach the place whence there is no return. Different creatures have been created with different objects. Some are intended for the Path of Action and some for that of Renunciation. One enjoys the the reward, according to the path that he follows. This Brahman is the lord of all the worlds. Endued with power, it is he who creates the universe.

data.v: एष लोकगुरुर्ब्रह्मा जगदादिकरः प्रभुः । एष माता पिता चैव युष्माकं च पितामहः । मयानुशिष्टो भविता सर्वभूतवरप्रदः ॥
data.md: He is your mother and father, and he is your grandfather. At my behest, he will grant boons to all creatures.

data.v: अस्य चैवानुजो रुद्रो ललाटाद्यः समुत्थितः । ब्रह्मानुशिष्टो भविता सर्वत्रसवरप्रदः ॥
data.md: His son Rudra, who has originated from his brow at his behest, will, gifted with power, uphold all created beings.

data.v: गच्छध्वं स्वानधीकारांश्चिन्तयध्वं यथाविधि । प्रवर्तन्तां क्रियाः सर्वाः सर्वलोकेषु माचिरम् ॥
data.md: Go you to your respective jurisdictions, and seek, according to the ordinances, the welfare of the world! Let all the scriptural acts flow in all the worlds. Let there be no delay in this.

data.v: प्रदृश्यन्तां च कर्माणि प्राणिनां गतयस्तथा । परिनिर्मितकालानि आयूंषि च सुरोत्तमाः ॥
data.md: You foremost of gods, do ye ordain the acts of all creatures and the ends that they are come by. Do ye also set the limits of the lives of all creatures.

data.v: इदं कृतयुगं नाम कालः श्रेष्ठः प्रवर्तते । अहिंस्या यज्ञपशवो युगेऽस्मिन्नैतदन्यथा । चतुष्पात्सकलो धर्मो भविष्यत्यत्र वै सुराः ॥
data.md: This present cycle that is going on is the foremost of all epochs and should be known by the name of Krita. In this cycle living creatures should not be celebrated. It should be as I ordain and let it not be otherwise.

data.v: ततस्त्रेतायुगं नाम त्रयी यत्र भविष्यति । प्रोक्षिता यत्र पशवो वधं प्राप्स्यन्ति वै मखे । तत्र पादचतुर्थो वै धर्मस्य न भविष्यति ॥
data.md: In the sacrifices that will be celebrated in that age, animals, after dedication with the help of sacred Mantras, will be killed. As regards virtue, again, it will lose one quarter; only three quarters thereof will remain.

data.v: ततो वै द्वापरं नाम मिश्रः कालो भविष्यति । द्विपादहीनो धर्मश्च युगे तस्मिन्भविष्यति ॥
data.md: On the termination of the Treta, will come the mixed Yoga known by the name of Dvapara. In that cycle, virtue will lose two quarters and only two quarters thereof will remain.

data.v: ततस्तिष्येऽथ संप्राप्ते युगे कलिपुरस्कृते । एकपादस्थितो धर्मो यत्र तत्र भविष्यति ॥
data.md: Upon the termination of Dvapara, the cycle that will set in will be called Tish, and it will come with Kali walking in the van. Virtue will lose full three quarters. Only a quarter thereof will exist in all places.

data.v: एकपादस्थिते धर्मे यत्रक्वचनगामिनि । कथं कर्तव्यमस्माभिर्भगवंस्तद्वदस्व नः ॥
data.md: When the great God said these words, the gods and the celestial Rishis addressed him and said,-If only a fourth part of virtue is to exist in that age in every place, tell us, O Holy One, where shall we then go and what shall we do?

data.v: यत्र वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च तपः सत्यं दमस्तथा । अहिंसाधर्मसंयुक्ताः प्रचरेयुः सुरोत्तमाः । स वै देशः सेवितव्यो मा वोऽधर्मः पदा स्पृशेत् ॥
data.md: You foremost of gods, ye should, in that age, go to such places where the Vedas and Sacrifices and Penances and Truth and selfcontrol, accompanied by duties fraught with mercy for all creatures, will still continue. Sin will never be able to affect you at all.

data.v: तेऽनुशिष्टा भगवता देवाः सर्षिगणास्तथा । नमस्कृत्वा भगवते जग्मुर्देशान्यथेप्सितान् ॥
data.md: Vyasa said Thus commanded by the great God, the gods with all the Rishis bowed their heads to him and then proceeded to the places they desired.

data.v: गतेषु त्रिदिवौकःसु ब्रह्मैकः पर्यवस्थितः । दिदृक्षुर्भगवन्तं तमनिरुद्धतनौ स्थितम् ॥
data.md: After the celestiats had left that place, only Brahman remained there, desirous of seeing the great Deity then living in the form of Aniruddha.

data.v: तं देवो दर्शयामास कृत्वा हयशिरो महत् । साङ्गानावर्तयन्वेदान्कमण्डलुगणित्रधृक् ॥
data.md: The foremost of gods then appeared before Brahman having assumed a form that had a huge equine head. Carrying a pitcher and the triple stick, he appeared before Brahman, reciting the Vedas with all their branches.

data.v: ततोऽश्वशिरसं दृष्ट्वा तं देवममितौजसम् । लोककर्ता प्रभुर्ब्रह्मा लोकानां हितकाम्यया ॥
data.md: Seeing the great Deity of immeasurable energy in that form with an equine head, the powerful Brahman, the Creator of all the worlds, moved by the desire of doing good to his Creation, adored that boon-giving Lord with his head down and stood before him with hands joined in respect. The great Deity embraced Brahman and then told him these words.

data.v: मूर्ध्ना प्रणम्य वरदं तस्थौ प्राञ्जलिरग्रतः । स परिष्वज्य देवेन वचनं श्रावितस्तदा ॥
data.md: Seeing the great Deity of immeasurable energy in that form with an equine head, the powerful Brahman, the Creator of all the worlds, moved by the desire of doing good to his Creation, adored that boon-giving Lord with his head down and stood before him with hands joined in respect. The great Deity embraced Brahman and then told him these words.

data.v: लोककार्यगतीः सर्वास्त्वं चिन्तय यथाविधि । धाता त्वं सर्वभूतानां त्वं प्रभुर्जगतो गुरुः । त्वय्यावेशितभारोऽहं धृतिं प्राप्स्याम्यथाञ्जसा ॥
data.md: The Holy One said Do you, O Brahman, duly think of the courses of acts which creatures should follow. You are the great ordainer of all created Beings, You are the Master and the Lord of the universe. Placing this burthen on you I shall soon be free from anxiety.

data.v: यदा च सुरकार्यं ते अविषह्यं भविष्यति । प्रादुर्भावं गमिष्यामि तदात्मज्ञानदेशिकः ॥
data.md: At such time, however, when it will be difficult for you to accomplish the work of the gods, I shall then appear in incarnate forms perceiving the gravity of the emergencies.

data.v: एवमुक्त्वा हयशिरास्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत । तेनानुशिष्टो ब्रह्मापि स्वं लोकमचिराद्गतः ॥
data.md: With these words, that grand form with the equine head vanished then and there. Having received his behest, Brahman too proceeded speedily to his own region.

data.v: एवमेष महाभागः पद्मनाभः सनातनः । यज्ञेष्वग्रहरः प्रोक्तो यज्ञधारी च नित्यदा ॥
data.md: It is for this, O Blessed One, that the eternal lotus-navelled deity became the acceptor of the first share offered in sacrifices and hence it is that He is called the eternal upholder of all Sacrifices.

data.v: निवृत्तिं चास्थितो धर्मं गतिमक्षयधर्मिणाम् । प्रवृत्तिधर्मान्विदधे कृत्वा लोकस्य चित्रताम् ॥
data.md: Endued with forgiveness, he has adopted, again, the Religion of Renunciation. Indeed, it is that holy and powerful one who has himself laid down the duties of Renunciation.

data.v: स आदिः स मध्यः स चान्तः प्रजानां; स धाता स धेयः स कर्ता स कार्यम् । युगान्ते स सुप्तः सुसंक्षिप्य लोका;न्युगादौ प्रबुद्धो जगद्ध्युत्ससर्ज ॥
data.md: He is the beginning, He is the middle, and He is the end of all created Beings. He is their Creator and He is the actor and He is the act. Having withdrawn the universe into Himself at the end of the cycle, He enters into sleep, and awakening at the beginning of another cycle, He once more creates the universe.

data.v: तस्मै नमध्वं देवाय निर्गुणाय गुणात्मने । अजाय विश्वरूपाय धाम्ने सर्वदिवौकसाम् ॥
data.md: Do you all bow to that Illustrious One who is gifted with a high soul and who is above the : three qualities, who is Unborn, abode or refuge of all the dwellers of heaven.

data.v: महाभूताधिपतये रुद्राणां पतये तथा । आदित्यपतये चैव वसूनां पतये तथा ॥
data.md: Do you bow to Him who is the Supreme Lord of all creatures, who is the Lord of the Rudras, who is the Lord of the Adityas, and of the Vasus as well.

data.v: अश्विभ्यां पतये चैव मरुतां पतये तथा । वेदयज्ञाधिपतये वेदाङ्गपतयेऽपि च ॥
data.md: Do you bow to Him who is the Lord of the Ashvins, and the Lord of the Maruts, who is the Lord of all Sacrifices laid down in the Vedas, and the Lord of the Vedangas.

data.v: समुद्रवासिने नित्यं हरये मुञ्जकेशिने । शान्तये सर्वभूतानां मोक्षधर्मानुभाषिणे ॥
data.md: Bow Him who always lives in the Ocean, and who is called Hari, and whose hair is like the blades of the Munja grass. Bow to Him who is Peace and Tranquillity, and who gives the Religion of Liberation to all creatures.

data.v: तपसां तेजसां चैव पतये यशसोऽपि च । वाचश्च पतये नित्यं सरितां पतये तथा ॥
data.md: Bow to Him who is the Lord of Penances, of all kinds of energy, and of Fame, who is ever the Lord of Speech and the Lord of all the Rivers also.

data.v: कपर्दिने वराहाय एकशृङ्गाय धीमते । विवस्वतेऽश्वशिरसे चतुर्मूर्तिधृते सदा ॥
data.md: Bow to Him who is called Kaparddin, who is the Geat Boar, who is the Unicorn, and who is endued with great intelligence; who is the Sun, who assumed the well-known form with the equine head; and who is always shown in a fourfold form.

data.v: गुह्याय ज्ञानदृश्याय अक्षराय क्षराय च । एष देवः संचरति सर्वत्रगतिरव्ययः ॥
data.md: Bow to Him who is unravelled, who is capable of being apprehended by knowledge only, who is both indestructible and destructible. The supreme Deity, who is iminutable, permeates all things.

data.v: एवमेतत्पुरा दृष्टं मया वै ज्ञानचक्षुषा । कथितं तच्च वः सर्वं मया पृष्टेन तत्त्वतः ॥
data.md: He is the Supreme Lord who can be known with the help of the eye of Knowledge alone. It was thus that, helped by the eye of Knowledge, I saw, in days of yore, that foremost of gods.

data.v: क्रियतां मद्वचः शिष्याः सेव्यतां हरिरीश्वरः । गीयतां वेदशब्दैश्च पूज्यतां च यथाविधि ॥
data.md: Asked by you, I have told you everything in full, ye disciples, and do you act according to my words and dutifully serve the Supreme Lord called Hari. Do you sing His praises in Vedic words and adore and worship Him also according to due rites.

data.v: इत्युक्तास्तु वयं तेन वेदव्यासेन धीमता । सर्वे शिष्याः सुतश्चास्य शुकः परमधर्मवित् ॥
data.md: Vaishampayana said It was thus that the compiler of the Vedas, gifted with great intelligence, discoursed to us, accosted by us on that occasion. His son, the highly pious Shuka, and all his disciples listened to him while he delivered that discourse.

data.v: स चास्माकमुपाध्यायः सहास्माभिर्विशां पते । चतुर्वेदोद्गताभिश्च ऋग्भिस्तमभितुष्टुवे ॥
data.md: Our preceptor, with ourselves, O king, then worshipped the great Deity with Richs extracted from the four Vedas.

data.v: एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि । एवं मेऽकथयद्राजन्पुरा द्वैपायनो गुरुः ॥
data.md: I have thus told you everything about what you had asked me. It was thus, O king, that our Island-born preceptor discoursed to us.

data.v: यश्चेदं शृणुयान्नित्यं यश्चेदं परिकीर्तयेत् । नमो भगवते कृत्वा समाहितमना नरः ॥
भवत्यरोगो द्युतिमान्बलरूपसमन्वितः । आतुरो मुच्यते रोगाद्बद्धो मुच्येत बन्धनात् ॥
कामकामी लभेत्कामं दीर्घमायुरवाप्नुयात् । ब्राह्मणः सर्ववेदी स्यात्क्षत्रियो विजयी भवेत् । वैश्यो विपुललाभः स्याच्छूद्रः सुखमवाप्नुयात् ॥
data.md: A Brahmana, by doing this, becomes conversant with all the Vedas, and a Kshatriya becomes crowned with success. A Vaishya, by doing it, makes great profits, and a Shudra enjoys great happiness.

data.v: अपुत्रो लभते पुत्रं कन्या चैवेप्सितं पतिम् । लग्नगर्भा विमुच्येत गर्भिणी जनयेत्सुतम् । वन्ध्या प्रसवमाप्नोति पुत्रपौत्रसमृद्धिमत् ॥
data.md: A sonless man obtains a son. A maiden gets a desirable husband. A woman who has conceived, gives birth to a son.

data.v: क्षेमेण गच्छेदध्वानमिदं यः पठते पथि । यो यं कामं कामयते स तमाप्नोति च ध्रुवम् ॥
data.md: A barren woman conceives and gets many sons and grandsons. He who recites this discourse on the way succeeds in passing happily and without any obstacles along his way. In fact, one acquires whatever objects he cherishes, if one reads or recites this narrative.

data.v: इदं महर्षेर्वचनं विनिश्चितं; महात्मनः पुरुषवरस्य कीर्तनम् । समागमं चर्षिदिवौकसामिमं; निशम्य भक्ताः सुसुखं लभन्ते ॥
data.md: Hearing these words of the great Rishi, fraught with certainty of conclusion, and containing a recital of the attributes of that great one who is the foremost of all beings, hearing this narrative of the great assembly of Rishis and other dwellers of heaven,-men who are devoted to the Supreme Deity derive great happiness.

data.v: अस्तौषीद्यैरिमं व्यासः सशिष्यो मधुसूदनम् । नामभिर्विविधैरेषां निरुक्तं भगवन्मम ॥
वक्तुमर्हसि शुश्रूषोः प्रजापतिपतेर्हरेः । श्रुत्वा भवेयं यत्पूतः शरच्चन्द्र इवामलः ॥
data.md: O Holy One, you should tell me the meanings of those various names uttering which the great Rishi Vyasa with his disciples sang the praises of the illustrious killer of Madhu. I wish to hear those names of Hari, that Supreme Lord of all creatures. Indeed, by hearing of those names, I shall be sanctified and cleansed like the bright autumnal moon.

data.v: शृणु राजन्यथाचष्ट फल्गुनस्य हरिर्विभुः । प्रसन्नात्मात्मनो नाम्नां निरुक्तं गुणकर्मजम् ॥
data.md: Vaishampayana said, Listen, O king, to what the meanings are of the various names, due to attributes and acts, of Hari as the powerful Hari himself of cheerful soul explained them to Phalguna.

data.v: नामभिः कीर्तितैस्तस्य केशवस्य महात्मनः । पृष्टवान्केशवं राजन्फल्गुनः परवीरहा ॥
data.md: That killer of hostile heroes, viz., Phalguna, had at one time asked Keshava, enquiring after the meanings of the some of the names by which the great Keshava is worshipped.

data.v: भगवन्भूतभव्येश सर्वभूतसृगव्यय । लोकधाम जगन्नाथ लोकानामभयप्रद ॥
data.md: O Holy One, O supreme ordainer of the Past and the Future, O Creator of all Beings, O Immutable one, O Refuge of all the worlds, O Lord of the universe, O Remover of the fears of all persons.

data.v: यानि नामानि ते देव कीर्तितानि महर्षिभिः । वेदेषु सपुराणेषु यानि गुह्यानि कर्मभिः ॥
data.md: I wish to hear from you in detail, O Keshava, the meanings of all those names of yours, O God, which have been mentioned by the great Rishis in the Vedas and the Puranas on account of various acts of yours! None else than you, O Lord, is capable to explain the mcanings of those names.

data.v: तेषां निरुक्तं त्वत्तोऽहं श्रोतुमिच्छामि केशव । न ह्यन्यो वर्तयेन्नाम्नां निरुक्तं त्वामृते प्रभो ॥
data.md: I wish to hear from you in detail, O Keshava, the meanings of all those names of yours, O God, which have been mentioned by the great Rishis in the Vedas and the Puranas on account of various acts of yours! None else than you, O Lord, is capable to explain the mcanings of those names.

data.v: ऋग्वेदे सयजुर्वेदे तथैवाथर्वसामसु । पुराणे सोपनिषदे तथैव ज्योतिषेऽर्जुन ॥
सांख्ये च योगशास्त्रे च आयुर्वेदे तथैव च । बहूनि मम नामानि कीर्तितानि महर्षिभिः ॥
गौणानि तत्र नामानि कर्मजानि च कानिचित् । निरुक्तं कर्मजानां च शृणुष्व प्रयतोऽनघ । कथ्यमानं मया तात त्वं हि मेऽर्धं स्मृतः पुरा ॥
नमोऽतियशसे तस्मै देहिनां परमात्मने । नारायणाय विश्वाय निर्गुणाय गुणात्मने ॥
यस्य प्रसादजो ब्रह्मा रुद्रश्च क्रोधसंभवः । योऽसौ योनिर्हि सर्वस्य स्थावरस्य चरस्य च ॥
अष्टादशगुणं यत्तत्सत्त्वं सत्त्ववतां वर । प्रकृतिः सा परा मह्यं रोदसी योगधारिणी । ऋता सत्यामराजय्या लोकानामात्मसंज्ञिता ॥
data.md: He is the source whence have originated all mobile and immobile creatures. O foremost of all persons gifted with Sattva (Goodness), the attribute of Sattva consists of eighteen qualities. That attribute is Supreme Nature having for her soul the Sky and Earth and succeeding by her creative forces in keeping up the universe.

data.v: तस्मात्सर्वाः प्रवर्तन्ते सर्गप्रलयविक्रियाः । ततो यज्ञश्च यष्टा च पुराणः पुरुषो विराट् । अनिरुद्ध इति प्रोक्तो लोकानां प्रभवाप्ययः ॥
data.md: Divested of sex, She or He is the penances that people practise. He is both the sacrifice that is performed and the sacrificer who celebrates the sacrifice. He is the ancient and the infinite Purusha. He is otherwise called Aniruddha and is the source of the Creation and the Destruction of the universe.

data.v: ब्राह्मे रात्रिक्षये प्राप्ते तस्य ह्यमिततेजसः । प्रसादात्प्रादुरभवत्पद्मं पद्मनिभेक्षण । तत्र ब्रह्मा समभवत्स तस्यैव प्रसादजः ॥
data.md: When Brahmana's night was passed, through the grace of that Being of great energy, a lotus made its appearance first, you having eyes like lotus petals.

data.v: अह्नः क्षये ललाटाच्च सुतो देवस्य वै तथा । क्रोधाविष्टस्य संजज्ञे रुद्रः संहारकारकः ॥
data.md: Within that lotus was born Brahman, originating from Aniruddha's grace. Towards the evening of Brahman's day, Aniruddha became filled with anger, and as a consequence of this, there originated from his forehead a son called Rudra gifted with the power of destroying everything. These two, viz., Brahman and Rudra, are the foremost of all the gods, having originated respectively from the Cheerfulness and the Anger (of Aniruddha).

data.v: एतौ द्वौ विबुधश्रेष्ठौ प्रसादक्रोधजौ स्मृतौ । तदादेशितपन्थानौ सृष्टिसंहारकारकौ । निमित्तमात्रं तावत्र सर्वप्राणिवरप्रदौ ॥
data.md: Acting according to Aniruddha's directions, these two gods Create and Destroy. Although capable of granting boons to all creatures, they are, however, in their own work, (viz., Creation and Destruction), merely instruments in the hands of Aniruddha.

data.v: कपर्दी जटिलो मुण्डः श्मशानगृहसेवकः । उग्रव्रतधरो रुद्रो योगी त्रिपुरदारुणः ॥
data.md: Rudra is otherwise called Kaparddin. He has matted locks on his head, some times shows a bald head. He loves to live in the midst of crematoriums which form his home. He practises the austerest vows. He is a Yogin of mighty power and energy.

data.v: दक्षक्रतुहरश्चैव भगनेत्रहरस्तथा । नारायणात्मको ज्ञेयः पाण्डवेय युगे युगे ॥
data.md: He is the destroyer of Daksha's sacrifice and the tearer of Bhaga's eyes. O son of Pandu, Rudra should be known to have always Narayana for his Soul.

data.v: तस्मिन्हि पूज्यमाने वै देवदेवे महेश्वरे । संपूजितो भवेत्पार्थ देवो नारायणः प्रभुः ॥
data.md: If that god of gods, viz., Mahesvara, be adored, then, O Partha, is the powerful Narayana also adored.

data.v: अहमात्मा हि लोकानां विश्वानां पाण्डुनन्दन । तस्मादात्मानमेवाग्रे रुद्रं संपूजयाम्यहम् ॥
data.md: I am the Soul, O son of Pandu, of all the worlds, of all the universe. Rudra again, is my Soul. It is for this that I always worship him.

data.v: यद्यहं नार्चयेयं वै ईशानं वरदं शिवम् । आत्मानं नार्चयेत्कश्चिदिति मे भावितं मनः । मया प्रमाणं हि कृतं लोकः समनुवर्तते ॥
data.md: If I do not worship the auspicious and boon-giving Ishana, nobody would then worship my own self.

data.v: प्रमाणानि हि पूज्यानि ततस्तं पूजयाम्यहम् । यस्तं वेत्ति स मां वेत्ति योऽनु तं स हि मामनु ॥
रुद्रो नारायणश्चैव सत्त्वमेकं द्विधाकृतम् । लोके चरति कौन्तेय व्यक्तिस्थं सर्वकर्मसु ॥
न हि मे केनचिद्देयो वरः पाण्डवनन्दन । इति संचिन्त्य मनसा पुराणं विश्वमीश्वरम् । पुत्रार्थमाराधितवानात्मानमहमात्मना ॥
data.md: Having settled this in my mind, I worshipped in days of yore the ancient and powerful Rudra, for getting the boon of a son. In worshipping Rudra thus, I worshipped my own self.

data.v: न हि विष्णुः प्रणमति कस्मैचिद्विबुधाय तु । ऋत आत्मानमेवेति ततो रुद्रं भजाम्यहम् ॥
data.md: Vishnu never bows his head to any god except his own self. It is therefore that I worship Rudra.

data.v: सब्रह्मकाः सरुद्राश्च सेन्द्रा देवाः सहर्षिभिः । अर्चयन्ति सुरश्रेष्ठं देवं नारायणं हरिम् ॥
data.md: All the gods, including Brahman and Indra and the gods and the great Rishis, worship Narayana, that foremost of gods, otherwise called by the name of Hari.

data.v: भविष्यतां वर्ततां च भूतानां चैव भारत । सर्वेषामग्रणीर्विष्णुः सेव्यः पूज्यश्च नित्यशः ॥
data.md: Vishnu is the foremost of all Beings past, present, or future, and as such should always be worshipped with respect.

data.v: नमस्व हव्यदं विष्णुं तथा शरणदं नम । वरदं नमस्व कौन्तेय हव्यकव्यभुजं नम ॥
data.md: Do you bow your head to Vishnu. Do you bow your head to Him who gives protection to all. Do you bow,, O son of Kunti, to that great boon-giving god, that foremost of gods, who eats the offerings made to him in sacrifices.

data.v: चतुर्विधा मम जना भक्ता एवं हि ते श्रुतम् । तेषामेकान्तिनः श्रेष्ठास्ते चैवानन्यदेवताः । अहमेव गतिस्तेषां निराशीःकर्मकारिणाम् ॥
data.md: I have heard that there are four kinds of worshippers. Among them all, they that are devoted to me wholly and do not worship any other god, are the foremost. I am the end they seek, and though engaged in deeds, they never seek the fruits thereof.

data.v: ये च शिष्टास्त्रयो भक्ताः फलकामा हि ते मताः । सर्वे च्यवनधर्माणः प्रतिबुद्धस्तु श्रेष्ठभाक् ॥
data.md: The three remaining classes of my worshippers are those who seek the fruits of their acts. They acquire regions of great happiness, but then they have to drop down therefrom upon the exhaustion of their merits. Those amongst my worshippers, therefore, who are fully awakened obtain what is foremost.

data.v: ब्रह्माणं शितिकण्ठं च याश्चान्या देवताः स्मृताः । प्रबुद्धवर्याः सेवन्ते मामेवैष्यन्ति यत्परम् । भक्तं प्रति विशेषस्ते एष पार्थानुकीर्तितः ॥
data.md: Those who are awakened and whose conduct shows such enlightenment, may be engaged in worshipping Brahman or Mahadeva or the other gods who live in heaven, but they succeed at least in getting to myself.

data.v: त्वं चैवाहं च कौन्तेय नरनारायणौ स्मृतौ । भारावतरणार्थं हि प्रविष्टौ मानुषीं तनुम् ॥
data.md: I have thus told you, O Partha, what the destinations are between my worshippers. Yourself, O son of Kunti, and myself are known as Nara and Narayana. Both of us have taken human bodies only for the purpose of lightening the load of the Earth.

data.v: जानाम्यध्यात्मयोगांश्च योऽहं यस्माच्च भारत । निवृत्तिलक्षणो धर्मस्तथाभ्युदयिकोऽपि च ॥
data.md: I know the different sorts of Yoga that rest on the Soul. I know who I am and whence I am, O Bharata. I know the Religion of Renunciation, and all that contributes to the prosperity of creatures.

data.v: नराणामयनं ख्यातमहमेकः सनातनः । आपो नारा इति प्रोक्ता आपो वै नरसूनवः । अयनं मम तत्पूर्वमतो नारायणो ह्यहम् ॥
data.md: Eternal as I am, I am the one sole Refuge of all men. The waters have been called by the name of Nara, for they originated from Him called Nara. And since the waters, in former times, were my refuge, I am, therefore, called by the name of Narayana.

data.v: छादयामि जगद्विश्वं भूत्वा सूर्य इवांशुभिः । सर्वभूताधिवासश्च वासुदेवस्ततो ह्यहम् ॥
data.md: Taking the form of the Sun I cover the universe, with my rays. And because I am the home of all creatures, therefore, am I called by the name of Vasudeva.

data.v: गतिश्च सर्वभूतानां प्रजानां चापि भारत । व्याप्ता मे रोदसी पार्थ कान्तिश्चाभ्यधिका मम ॥
data.md: I am the end of all creatures and their father, O Bharata. I pervade the entire sky and the Earth. O Partha. and my splendour transcends every other splendour.

data.v: अधिभूतानि चान्तेऽहं तदिच्छंश्चास्मि भारत । क्रमणाच्चाप्यहं पार्थ विष्णुरित्यभिसंज्ञितः ॥
data.md: I am He, O Bharata, whom all creatures wish to attain to at the end. And because I overwhelm all the universe, I am called by the name of Vishnu.

data.v: दमात्सिद्धिं परीप्सन्तो मां जनाः कामयन्ति हि । दिवं चोर्वीं च मध्यं च तस्माद्दामोदरो ह्यहम् ॥
data.md: Desirous of acquiring success through control of their senses, people seek to obtain to me who am heaven and Earth and the sky between the two. For this am I called Damodara.

data.v: पृश्निरित्युच्यते चान्नं वेदा आपोऽमृतं तथा । ममैतानि सदा गर्भे पृश्निगर्भस्ततो ह्यहम् ॥
data.md: The word Prishni includes food, the Vedas, water, and nectar. These four are always in my stomach. Hence am I called Prishnigarbha.

data.v: ऋषयः प्राहुरेवं मां त्रितकूपाभिपातितम् । पृश्निगर्भ त्रितं पाहीत्येकतद्वितपातितम् ॥
data.md: The Rishis have said that once on a time when the Rishi Trita was thrown into a well by Ekata and Dvita, the distressed Trita invoked me, saying,-O Prishnigarbha, do you save the fallen Trita.

data.v: ततः स ब्रह्मणः पुत्र आद्यो ऋषिवरस्त्रितः । उत्ततारोदपानाद्वै पृश्निगर्भानुकीर्तनात् ॥
data.md: That foremost of Rishis, viz., Trita, the spiritual son of Brahma, having called on me thus, was saved from the pit.

data.v: सूर्यस्य तपतो लोकानग्नेः सोमस्य चाप्युत । अंशवो ये प्रकाशन्ते मम ते केशसंज्ञिताः । सर्वज्ञाः केशवं तस्मान्मामाहुर्द्विजसत्तमाः ॥
data.md: The rays that come out of the Sun who gives heat to the world, from the blazing fire, and from the Moon, form my hair. Hence do foremost of learned Brahmanas call me by the name of Keshava.

data.v: स्वपत्न्यामाहितो गर्भ उतथ्येन महात्मना । उतथ्येऽन्तर्हिते चैव कदाचिद्देवमायया । बृहस्पतिरथाविन्दत्तां पत्नीं तस्य भारत ॥
data.md: The great Utathya having impregnated his wife disappeared from her side through an illusion of the gods. The younger brother Brihaspati then appeared before that great one's wife.

data.v: ततो वै तमृषिश्रेष्ठं मैथुनोपगतं तथा । उवाच गर्भः कौन्तेय पञ्चभूतसमन्वितः ॥
पूर्वागतोऽहं वरद नार्हस्यम्बां प्रबाधितुम् । एतद्बृहस्पतिः श्रुत्वा चुक्रोध च शशाप च ॥
मैथुनोपगतो यस्मात्त्वयाहं विनिवारितः । तस्मादन्धो जास्यसि त्वं मच्छापान्नात्र संशयः ॥
स शापादृषिमुख्यस्य दीर्घं तम उपेयिवान् । स हि दीर्घतमा नाम नाम्ना ह्यासीदृषिः पुरा ॥
data.md: Through this curse of the foremost of Rishis, the child of Utathya was born blind and remained so for a long time. It was, therefore, that that Rishi, in days of yore, passed by the name of Dirghatamas.

data.v: वेदानवाप्य चतुरः साङ्गोपाङ्गान्सनातनान् । प्रयोजयामास तदा नाम गुह्यमिदं मम ॥
data.md: He, however, acquired the four Vedas with their eternal limbs and subsidiary parts. After that-he frequently invoked me by this secret name of mine. Indeed, according to the ordinance as laid down he repeatedly called me by the name of Keshava.

data.v: आनुपूर्व्येण विधिना केशवेति पुनः पुनः । स चक्षुष्मान्समभवद्गौतमश्चाभवत्पुनः ॥
data.md: Through the merit he acquired by uttering this name repeatedly, he became cured of his blindness and then passed by the name of Gotama.

data.v: एवं हि वरदं नाम केशवेति ममार्जुन । देवानामथ सर्वेषामृषीणां च महात्मनाम् ॥
data.md: This name of mine, therefore, O Arjuna, is productive of boons to them who utter it among all the gods and the great Rishis.

data.v: अग्निः सोमेन संयुक्त एकयोनि मुखं कृतम् । अग्नीषोमात्मकं तस्माज्जगत्कृत्स्नं चराचरम् ॥
data.md: The god of fire and Soma, blending together, become transfused into one and the same substance. It is, therefore, that the entire universe of mobile and immobile creatures is said to be pervaded by those two gods.

data.v: अपि हि पुराणे भवति । एकयोन्यात्मकावग्नीषोमौ । देवाश्चाग्निमुखा इति । एकयोनित्वाच्च परस्परं महयन्तो लोकान्धारयत इति ॥
data.md: In the Puranas, Agni and Soma are spoken of at possessing natures that had one and the same result. The gods also are said to have Agni for their mouth. It is on account of these two beings gifted with natures leading to the same result that they are said to be deserving of each other and upholders of the universe."

data.v: अग्नीषोमौ कथं पूर्वमेकयोनी प्रवर्तितौ । एष मे संशयो जातस्तं छिन्धि मधुसूदन ॥
data.md: How did Agni and Soma, in days of yore, attain to uniformity with regard to their original nature? Thus doubt has arisen in my mind. Do you remove it, O slayer of Madhu.

data.v: हन्त ते वर्तयिष्यामि पुराणं पाण्डुनन्दन । आत्मतेजोद्भवं पार्थ शृणुष्वैकमना मम ॥
data.md: I shall recite to you, O son of Pandu, an ancient story of events arising from my own energy. Do you listen to it with concentrated mind.

data.v: संप्रक्षालनकालेऽतिक्रान्ते चतुर्थे युगसहस्रान्ते । अव्यक्ते सर्वभूतप्रलये स्थावरजङ्गमे । ज्योतिर्धरणिवायुरहितेऽन्धे तमसि जलैकार्णवे लोके । तम इत्येवाभिभूतेऽसंज्ञकेऽद्वितीये प्रतिष्ठिते । नैव रात्र्यां न दिवसे न सति नासति न व्यक्ते नाव्यक्ते व्यवस्थिते । एतस्यामवस्थायां नारायणगुणाश्रयादक्षयादजरादनिन्द्रियादग्राह्यादसंभवात्सत्यादहिंस्राल्ललामाद्विविधप्रवृत्तिविशेषात् । अक्षयादजरामरादमूर्तितः सर्वव्यापिनः सर्वकर्तुः शाश्वतात्तमसः पुरुषः प्रादुर्भूतो हरिरव्ययः ॥
निदर्शनमपि ह्यत्र भवति । नासीदहो न रात्रिरासीत् । न सदासीन्नासदासीत् । तम एव पुरस्तादभवद्विश्वरूपम् । सा विश्वस्य जननीत्येवमस्यार्थोऽनुभाष्यते ॥
data.md: The Shruti declares,-Day was not. Night was not. Aught was not. Naught was not. In the beginning there was only Ignorance. She was of the form of the universe, and she is the night of Narayana of universal form. This is the meaning of the word of Tamas.

data.v: तस्येदानीं तमःसंभवस्य पुरुषस्य पद्मयोनेर्ब्रह्मणः प्रादुर्भावे स पुरुषः प्रजाः सिसृक्षमाणो नेत्राभ्यामग्नीषोमौ ससर्ज । ततो भूतसर्गे प्रवृत्ते प्रजाक्रमवशाद्ब्रह्मक्षत्रमुपातिष्ठत् । यः सोमस्तद्ब्रह्म यद्ब्रह्म ते ब्राह्मणाः । योऽग्निस्तत्क्षत्रं क्षत्राद्ब्रह्म बलवत्तरम् । कस्मादिति लोकप्रत्यक्षगुणमेतत्तद्यथा । ब्राह्मणेभ्यः परं भूतं नोत्पन्नपूर्वम् । दीप्यमानेऽग्नौ जुहोतीति कृत्वा ब्रवीमि । भूतसर्गः कृतो ब्रह्मणा भूतानि च प्रतिष्ठाप्य त्रैलोक्यं धार्यत इति ॥
data.md: From that Purusha thus born of Tamas and having Brahma for his parent, came into existence the Being called Brahman. Brahman, wishing to create creatures caused Agni and Soma to originate from his own own eyes. Afterwards when creatures were to be created, the ceated persons came out in their due order as Brahmanas and Kshatriyas. He who came into being as Soma was none else than Brahma; and they that were born as Brahmanas were all Soma in sooth. He who came into Being as Agni was none else than Kshatriya. The Brahmanas became gifted with greater energy than the Kshatriyas. If you enquire about the reason thereof, the answer is that this superiority of the Brahmanas to the Kshatriyas is an attribute which is manifest to the whole world. It occurred as follows. The Brahmanas represent the eldest creation amonst men. None were created before who were superior to the Brahmanas. He who offers food into the mouth of a Brahmana is considered as pouring libations into a burning fire. I say that having arranged things thus, the creation of creatures was accomplished by Brahman. Having established all created beings in their respective positions, he keeps us the three worlds. There is a similar declaration in the Mantras of the Shrutis.

data.v: मन्त्रवादोऽपि हि भवति । त्वमग्ने यज्ञानां होता विश्वेषाम् । हितो देवेभिर्मानुषे जने इति । निदर्शनं चात्र भवति । विश्वेषामग्ने यज्ञानां होतेति । हितो देवैर्मानुषैर्जगत इति । अग्निर्हि यज्ञानां होता कर्ता । स चाग्निर्ब्रह्म ॥

न ह्यृते मन्त्राद्धवनमस्ति । न विना पुरुषं तपः संभवति । हविर्मन्त्राणां संपूजा विद्यते देवमनुष्याणामनेन त्वं होतेति नियुक्तः । ये च मानुषा होत्राधिकारास्ते च । ब्राह्मणस्य हि याजनं विधीयते न क्षत्रवैश्ययोर्द्विजात्योः । तस्माद्ब्राह्मणा ह्यग्निभूता यज्ञानुद्वहन्ति । यज्ञा देवांस्तर्पयन्ति देवाः पृथिवीं भावयन्ति ॥

शतपथे हि ब्राह्मणं भवति । अग्नौ समिद्धे स जुहोति यो विद्वान्ब्राह्मणमुखे दानाहुतिं जुहोति । एवमप्यग्निभूता ब्राह्मणा विद्वांसोऽग्निं भावयन्ति । अग्निर्विष्णुः सर्वभूतान्यनुप्रविश्य प्राणान्धारयति । अपि चात्र सनत्कुमारगीताः श्लोका भवन्ति ॥
विश्वं ब्रह्मासृजत्पूर्वं सर्वादिर्निरवस्करम् । ब्रह्मघोषैर्दिवं तिष्ठन्त्यमरा ब्रह्मयोनयः ॥
ब्राह्मणानां मतिर्वाक्यं कर्म श्रद्धा तपांसि च । धारयन्ति महीं द्यां च शैत्याद्वार्यमृतं यथा ॥
नास्ति सत्यात्परो धर्मो नास्ति मातृसमो गुरुः । ब्राह्मणेभ्यः परं नास्ति प्रेत्य चेह च भूतये ॥
data.md: There is no duty higher than Truth. There is no one more worthy of respect than the mother. There is none more efficient than the Brahmana for conferring happiness both in this world and the next.

data.v: नैषामुक्षा वर्धते नोत वाहा; न गर्गरो मथ्यते संप्रदाने । अपध्वस्ता दस्युभूता भवन्ति; येषां राष्ट्रे ब्राह्मणा वृत्तिहीनाः ॥
data.md: The inhabitants of those kingdoms where Brahinanas have certain means of inaintenance become very wretched. There the no oxen do not carry the people or draw the plough, nor do cars of any kind bear them. There milk kept in jars is never churned for producing butter. On the other hand, the dwellers become shorn of every prosperity, and follow the ways of robbers.

data.v: वेदपुराणेतिहासप्रामाण्यान्नारायणमुखोद्गताः सर्वात्मानः सर्वकर्तारः सर्वभावनाश्च ब्राह्मणाः । वाक्समकालं हि तस्य देवस्य वरप्रदस्य ब्राह्मणाः प्रथमं प्रादुर्भूता ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च शेषा वर्णाः प्रादुर्भूताः । इत्थं च सुरासुरविशिष्टा ब्राह्मणा यदा मया ब्रह्मभूतेन पुरा स्वयमेवोत्पादिताः सुरासुरमहर्षयो भूतविशेषाः स्थापिता निगृहीताश्च ॥

अहल्याधर्षणनिमित्तं हि गौतमाद्धरिश्मश्रुतामिन्द्रः प्राप्तः । कौशिकनिमित्तं चेन्द्रो मुष्कवियोगं मेषवृषणत्वं चावाप । अश्विनोर्ग्रहप्रतिषेधोद्यतवज्रस्य पुरंदरस्य च्यवनेन स्तम्भितो बाहुः । क्रतुवधप्राप्तमन्युना च दक्षेण भूयस्तपसा चात्मानं संयोज्य नेत्राकृतिरन्या ललाटे रुद्रस्योत्पादिता ॥

त्रिपुरवधार्थं दीक्षामभ्युपगतस्य रुद्रस्योशनसा शिरसो जटा उत्कृत्य प्रयुक्ताः । ततः प्रादुर्भूता भुजगाः । तैरस्य भुजगैः पीड्यमानः कण्ठो नीलतामुपनीतः । पूर्वे च मन्वन्तरे स्वायंभुवे नारायणहस्तबन्धग्रहणान्नीलकण्ठत्वमेव वा ॥

अमृतोत्पादने पुरश्चरणतामुपगतस्याङ्गिरसो बृहस्पतेरुपस्पृशतो न प्रसादं गतवत्यः किलापः । अथ बृहस्पतिरपां चुक्रोध । यस्मान्ममोपस्पृशतः कलुषीभूता न प्रसादमुपगतास्तस्मादद्यप्रभृति झषमकरमत्स्यकच्छपजन्तुसंकीर्णाः कलुषीभवतेति । तदाप्रभृत्यापो यादोभिः संकीर्णाः संवृत्ताः ॥
विश्वरूपो वै त्वाष्ट्रः पुरोहितो देवानामासीत्स्वस्रीयोऽसुराणाम् । स प्रत्यक्षं देवेभ्यो भागमददत्परोक्षमसुरेभ्यः ॥
