data.md: I have been created by you. The Vedas are my eyes. Hence, I am above Time. Those Vedas, which form my eyes, have been taken away from me. I have, therefore, become blind. Do you awake from this Yoga-sleep. Give me back my eye. I am dear to you and you are dear to me.

data.v: एवं स्तुतः स भगवान्पुरुषः सर्वतोमुखः । जहौ निद्रामथ तदा वेदकार्यार्थमुद्यतः । ऐश्वरेण प्रयोगेण द्वितीयां तनुमास्थितः ॥
data.md: Thus landed by Brahman, the illustrious Purusha, with face turned towards every side, then renounced his sleep, resolved to recover the Vedas. Applying his Yoga-power, he put on a second form.

data.v: सुनासिकेन कायेन भूत्वा चन्द्रप्रभस्तदा । कृत्वा हयशिरः शुभ्रं वेदानामालयं प्रभुः ॥
data.md: His body, have an excellent nose, became as bright as the Moon. He assumed an equine head of great lustre, that head which was the abode of the Vedas.

data.v: तस्य मूर्धा समभवद्द्यौः सनक्षत्रतारका । केशाश्चास्याभवन्दीर्घा रवेरंशुसमप्रभाः ॥
data.md: The sky, with all its luminaries and constellations, became the crown of his head. His locks of hair were long and flowing, and had the sheen of the solar rays.

data.v: कर्णावाकाशपाताले ललाटं भूतधारिणी । गङ्गा सरस्वती पुण्या भ्रुवावास्तां महानदी ॥
data.md: The regions above and below became his two ears. The Earth became his forehead. The two rivers Ganga and Sarasvati became his two eye-brows,

data.v: चक्षुषी सोमसूर्यौ ते नासा संध्या पुनः स्मृता । ओंकारस्त्वथ संस्कारो विद्युज्जिह्वा च निर्मिता ॥
data.md: The Sun and the Moon became his two eyes. The twilight became his nose. The syllable OM became his memory and intelligence. The lightning became his tongue.

data.v: दन्ताश्च पितरो राजन्सोमपा इति विश्रुताः । गोलोको ब्रह्मलोकश्च ओष्ठावास्तां महात्मनः । ग्रीवा चास्याभवद्राजन्कालरात्रिर्गुणोत्तरा ॥
data.md: The Soma-drinking departed manes became, it is said, his teeth. The two regions of happiness viz., Goloka and Brahmaloka, became his upper and lower lips. The dreadful night after universal destruction, and that is above the three qualities, became his neck.

data.v: एतद्धयशिरः कृत्वा नानामूर्तिभिरावृतम् । अन्तर्दधे स विश्वेशो विवेश च रसां प्रभुः ॥
data.md: Having put on this form endued with the equine head and having various things for its various limbs, the Lord of the universe disappeared then and there, and went to the nether regions. was

data.v: रसां पुनः प्रविष्टश्च योगं परममास्थितः । शैक्षं स्वरं समास्थाय ओमिति प्रासृजत्स्वरम् ॥
data.md: Having reached those regions he began Yoga. Adopting a voice governed by the rules of the science called Shiksha, he began to chant Vedic Mantras,

data.v: स स्वरः सानुनादी च सर्वगः स्निग्ध एव च । बभूवान्तर्महीभूतः सर्वभूतगुणोदितः ॥
data.md: His pronunciation distinct and reverberated through the air, and was sweet the sound of his voice filled the nether region from end to end. Gifted with the properties of all elements it yielded great benefits.

data.v: ततस्तावसुरौ कृत्वा वेदान्समयबन्धनान् । रसातले विनिक्षिप्य यतः शब्दस्ततो द्रुतौ ॥
data.md: The two Asuras, making a compact with the Vedas about the time when they would return to take them up again, threw them down in the nether region, and ran towards the spot hence those sounds seemed to come.

data.v: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राजन्देवो हयशिरोधरः । जग्राह वेदानखिलान्रसातलगतान्हरिः । प्रादाच्च ब्रह्मणे भूयस्ततः स्वां प्रकृतिं गतः ॥
data.md: Meanwhile, O king, the Supreme Lord with the equine head, otherwise called Hari, who was himself in the nether region, took up all the Vedas.

data.v: स्थापयित्वा हयशिर उदक्पूर्वे महोदधौ । वेदानामालयश्चापि बभूवाश्वशिरास्ततः ॥
data.md: Returning to where Brahman was living, he gave the Vedas to him. Having restored the Vedas to Brahman, the Supreme Lord once more returned to his own nature. The Supreme Lord also established his form with the horsehead in the north-eastern region of the great ocean. Having established him who was the abode of the Vedas, he once more became the horse-headed from that he was.

data.v: अथ किंचिदपश्यन्तौ दानवौ मधुकैटभौ । पुनराजग्मतुस्तत्र वेगितौ पश्यतां च तौ । यत्र वेदा विनिक्षिप्तास्तत्स्थानं शून्यमेव च ॥
data.md: The two Danavas Madhu and Kaitabha, not finding the person from whom those sounds came, speedily returned there. They cast their eyes around but saw that the spot on which they had thrown the Vedas was vacant.

data.v: तत उत्तममास्थाय वेगं बलवतां वरौ । पुनरुत्तस्थतुः शीघ्रं रसानामालयात्तदा । ददृशाते च पुरुषं तमेवादिकरं प्रभुम् ॥
data.md: Proceeding quickly those two foremost of powerful Beings, rose from the nether region.

data.v: श्वेतं चन्द्रविशुद्धाभमनिरुद्धतनौ स्थितम् । भूयोऽप्यमितविक्रान्तं निद्रायोगमुपागतम् ॥
आत्मप्रमाणरचिते अपामुपरि कल्पिते । शयने नागभोगाढ्ये ज्वालामालासमावृते ॥
निष्कल्मषेण सत्त्वेन संपन्नं रुचिरप्रभम् । तं दृष्ट्वा दानवेन्द्रौ तौ महाहासममुञ्चताम् ॥
ऊचतुश्च समाविष्टौ रजसा तमसा च तौ । अयं स पुरुषः श्वेतः शेते निद्रामुपागतः ॥
data.md: Seeing the Lord thus lying, the two foremost of Danavas roared out a loud laugh. Having the qualities of Darkness and Ignorance, they said. This is that Being of white complexion. He is no lying asleep. Forsooth, this one has brought the Vedas away from the nether region.

data.v: अनेन नूनं वेदानां कृतमाहरणं रसात् । कस्यैष को नु खल्वेष किं च स्वपिति भोगवान् ॥
इत्युच्चारितवाक्यौ तौ बोधयामासतुर्हरिम् । युद्धार्थिनौ तु विज्ञाय विबुद्धः पुरुषोत्तमः ॥
निरीक्ष्य चासुरेन्द्रौ तौ ततो युद्धे मनो दधे । अथ युद्धं समभवत्तयोर्नारायणस्य च ॥
रजस्तमोविष्टतनू तावुभौ मधुकैटभौ । ब्रह्मणोपचितिं कुर्वञ्जघान मधुसूदनः ॥
data.md: Thereupon an encounter took place between those two and Narayana. The Asuras Madhu and Kaitabha were embodiments of the qualities of Darkness and Ignorance. Narayana killed them both for pleasing Brahman. He thence passed by the name of Madhusudana (slayer of Madhu).

data.v: ततस्तयोर्वधेनाशु वेदापहरणेन च । शोकापनयनं चक्रे ब्रह्मणः पुरुषोत्तमः ॥
data.md: Having brought about the destruction of the two Asuras and restored the Vedas to Brahman, the Supreme Being removed the sorrow of Brahman.

data.v: ततः परिवृतो ब्रह्मा हतारिर्वेदसत्कृतः । निर्ममे स तदा लोकान्कृत्स्नान्स्थावरजङ्गमान् ॥
data.md: Helped then by Hari and assisted by the Vedas, Brahman created all worlds with their mobile and immobile creatures.

data.v: दत्त्वा पितामहायाग्र्यां बुद्धिं लोकविसर्गिकीम् । तत्रैवान्तर्दधे देवो यत एवागतो हरिः ॥
data.md: After this, Hari, giving to the Grandfather intelligence of the foremost order regarding the Creation, disappeared there and then for going to the place he had come from.

data.v: तौ दानवौ हरिर्हत्वा कृत्वा हयशिरस्तनुम् । पुनः प्रवृत्तिधर्मार्थं तामेव विदधे तनुम् ॥
data.md: It was thus that Narayana, having assumed the form equipped with the horse-head, killed the two Danavas Madhu and Kaitabha. Once more, however, he assumed the same form for making the Religion of Action to prevent the universe.

data.v: एवमेष महाभागो बभूवाश्वशिरा हरिः । पौराणमेतदाख्यातं रूपं वरदमैश्वरम् ॥
data.md: Thus did the blessed Hari assume in days of yore that grand form having the horse-head. This, of all his forms, endued with power, is celebrated as the most ancient.

data.v: यो ह्येतद्ब्राह्मणो नित्यं शृणुयाद्धारयेत वा । न तस्याध्ययनं नाशमुपगच्छेत्कदाचन ॥
data.md: That person who frequently listens or mentally recites this history of the assumption by Narayana of the form with the horse-head, will never forget his Vedic or other learning.

data.v: आराध्य तपसोग्रेण देवं हयशिरोधरम् । पाञ्चालेन क्रमः प्राप्तो रामेण पथि देशिते ॥
data.md: Having worshipped with the austerest penances the illustrious god with the horsehead, the Rishi Panchala acquired the science of Karma by going along the path pointed out by the god (Rudra).

data.v: एतद्धयशिरो राजन्नाख्यानं तव कीर्तितम् । पुराणं वेदसमितं यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि ॥
data.md: I have thus recounted to you, O king, the old story of Hayashiras, agreeable to the Vedas, about which you had asked me.

data.v: यां यामिच्छेत्तनुं देवः कर्तुं कार्यविधौ क्वचित् । तां तां कुर्याद्विकुर्वाणः स्वयमात्मानमात्मना ॥
data.md: Whatever forms the Supreme Deity wishes to assume with a view to the governing of the affairs of the universe, he assumes immediately by his own inherent powers.

data.v: एष वेदनिधिः श्रीमानेष वै तपसो निधिः । एष योगश्च सांख्यं च ब्रह्म चाग्र्यं हरिर्विभुः ॥
data.md: The Supreme God, endued with every prosperity, is the receptacle of the Vedas. He is the receptacle of Penances also. The powerful Hari is Yoga. He is the embodiment of the Sankhya philosophy. He is that foremost Brahma of which we hear.

data.v: नारायणपरा वेदा यज्ञा नारायणात्मकाः । तपो नारायणपरं नारायणपरा गतिः ॥
data.md: The Vedas are the soul of Narayana, all sacrifices are the form of Narayana, Penances are Narayana and the highest end is also Narayana.

data.v: नारायणपरं सत्यमृतं नारायणात्मकम् । नारायणपरो धर्मः पुनरावृत्तिदुर्लभः ॥
data.md: Truth has Narayana for its refuge. Rita has Narayana for its soul. The Religion of Renunciation in which there is no return, had Narayana for its high region.

data.v: प्रवृत्तिलक्षणश्चैव धर्मो नारायणात्मकः । नारायणात्मको गन्धो भूमौ श्रेष्ठतमः स्मृतः ॥
data.md: The other Religion which has Action for its root, has equally Narayana for its Soul. The foremost of all the qualities that belong to the element of Earth is scent. Scent has Narayana for its soul.

data.v: अपां चैव गुणो राजन्रसो नारायणात्मकः । ज्योतिषां च गुणो रूपं स्मृतं नारायणात्मकम् ॥
data.md: The properties of Water, O king, are called the Tastes. These Tastes have Narayana for their soul. The foremost property of Fire is form. Form also has Narayana for its soul.

data.v: नारायणात्मकश्चापि स्पर्शो वायुगुणः स्मृतः । नारायणात्मकश्चापि शब्द आकाशसंभवः ॥
data.md: Touch, which is the property of Wind, is also said to have Narayana for its soul. Sound, which is a property of Air, has, like the others, Narayana for its soul.

data.v: मनश्चापि ततो भूतमव्यक्तगुणलक्षणम् । नारायणपरः कालो ज्योतिषामयनं च यत् ॥
data.md: Mind also, which is the property of Nature, has Narayana for its soul. Time which is measured by the motion to the celestial luminaries has similarly Narayana for its soul.

data.v: नारायणपरा कीर्तिः श्रीश्च लक्ष्मीश्च देवताः । नारायणपरं सांख्यं योगो नारायणात्मकः ॥
data.md: The presiding gods of Fame, of Beauty, and of Prosperity, have the same Supreme Deity for their soul. Both the Sankhya philosophy and Yoga have Narayana for their soul.

data.v: कारणं पुरुषो येषां प्रधानं चापि कारणम् । स्वभावश्चैव कर्माणि दैवं येषां च कारणम् ॥
data.md: The Supreme Being is the cause of all this, as Soul. He is, again, the cause of everything, as Nature.

data.v: पञ्चकारणसंख्यातो निष्ठा सर्वत्र वै हरिः । तत्त्वं जिज्ञासमानानां हेतुभिः सर्वतोमुखैः ॥
data.md: Those engaged in investigating the several subjects of enquiry with the help of such reasons as are of wide application, consider Hari to be at one with the five reasons referred to above and as the final refuge of all things.

data.v: तत्त्वमेको महायोगी हरिर्नारायणः प्रभुः । सब्रह्मकानां लोकानामृषीणां च महात्मनाम् ॥
data.md: Indeed, the powerful Narayana, endued with the highest Yoga-power, is the one subject of (enquiry). Keshava perfectly knows the thoughts of men including Brahman and the great Rishis, of those that are Sankhyas and Yogins, of those that are Yatis, and of those, generally, that are conversant with the Soul, but none of these can know what his thoughts are.

data.v: सांख्यानां योगिनां चापि यतीनामात्मवेदिनाम् । मनीषितं विजानाति केशवो न तु तस्य ते ॥
data.md: Indeed, the powerful Narayana, endued with the highest Yoga-power, is the one subject of (enquiry). Keshava perfectly knows the thoughts of men including Brahman and the great Rishis, of those that are Sankhyas and Yogins, of those that are Yatis, and of those, generally, that are conversant with the Soul, but none of these can know what his thoughts are.

data.v: ये केचित्सर्वलोकेषु दैवं पित्र्यं च कुर्वते । दानानि च प्रयच्छन्ति तप्यन्ति च तपो महत् ॥
data.md: Whatever acts are performed in honour of the gods or the departed manes, whatever gifts are made, whatever penances are performed, have Vishnu for their refuge,-Vishnu who is established upon his own supreme ordinances. He is named Vasudeva because of his being the adobe of all creatures.

data.v: सर्वेषामाश्रयो विष्णुरैश्वरं विधिमास्थितः । सर्वभूतकृतावासो वासुदेवेति चोच्यते ॥
data.md: Whatever acts are performed in honour of the gods or the departed manes, whatever gifts are made, whatever penances are performed, have Vishnu for their refuge,-Vishnu who is established upon his own supreme ordinances. He is named Vasudeva because of his being the adobe of all creatures.

data.v: अयं हि नित्यः परमो महर्षि;र्महाविभूतिर्गुणवान्निर्गुणाख्यः । गुणैश्च संयोगमुपैति शीघ्रं; कालो यथर्तावृतुसंप्रयुक्तः ॥
data.md: He is immutable. He is Supreme. He is the. foremost of Rishis. He is endued with the highest power. He is said to be above the three qualities. As Time assumes marks when it manifests itself in the form of successive seasons, so He, though really shorn of qualities, assumes qualities (for manifesting Himself).

data.v: नैवास्य विन्दन्ति गतिं महात्मनो; न चागतिं कश्चिदिहानुपश्यति । ज्ञानात्मकाः संयमिनो महर्षयः; पश्यन्ति नित्यं पुरुषं गुणाधिकम् ॥
data.md: Even the high-souled do not succeed in understanding his motions. Only those foremost of Rishis who have knowledge for their Souls, succeed in seeing in their hearts that Purusha who is above all qualities,

data.v: अहो ह्येकान्तिनः सर्वान्प्रीणाति भगवान्हरिः । विधिप्रयुक्तां पूजां च गृह्णाति भगवान्स्वयम् ॥
data.md: Janamejaya said The illustrious Hari becomes favourite to them who are whole-mindedly devoted to him. He accepts also all adoration that is offered to Him according to the ordinance.

data.v: ये तु दग्धेन्धना लोके पुण्यपापविवर्जिताः । तेषां त्वयाभिनिर्दिष्टा पारंपर्यागता गतिः ॥
data.md: Of those persons who have freed themselves from desire, and that are shorn of both merit and demerit, you have spoken of the Knowledge they attain, as handed down from preceptor to preceptor, as the end they acquire.

data.v: चतुर्थ्यां चैव ते गत्यां गच्छन्ति पुरुषोत्तमम् । एकान्तिनस्तु पुरुषा गच्छन्ति परमं पदम् ॥
data.md: Such persons always acquire that end which is the fourth, viz., the essence of the foremost of Purushas or Vasudeva,-through the three others. Those persons, however, who are devoted to Narayana with their whole minds at once acquire the highest end.

data.v: नूनमेकान्तधर्मोऽयं श्रेष्ठो नारायणप्रियः । अगत्वा गतयस्तिस्रो यद्गच्छन्त्यव्ययं हरिम् ॥
data.md: Forsooth, the Religion of Devotion is superior (to that of Knowledge) and is very dear to Narayana. These, without passing through the three successive stages at once attain to the immutable Hari.

data.v: सहोपनिषदान्वेदान्ये विप्राः सम्यगास्थिताः । पठन्ति विधिमास्थाय ये चापि यतिधर्मिणः ॥
data.md: The end that is attained by Brahmanas, who, practising due observances, study the Vedas with the Upanishads according to the rules laid down for such study, and by those who follow the Religion of Yatis, is inferior, I think, to that attained by persons devoted whole-mindedly to Hari, Who first promulgated this Religion of Devotion? Was it some god or some Rishi who declared it.

data.v: तेभ्यो विशिष्टां जानामि गतिमेकान्तिनां नृणाम् । केनैष धर्मः कथितो देवेन ऋषिणापि वा ॥
data.md: The end that is attained by Brahmanas, who, practising due observances, study the Vedas with the Upanishads according to the rules laid down for such study, and by those who follow the Religion of Yatis, is inferior, I think, to that attained by persons devoted whole-mindedly to Hari, Who first promulgated this Religion of Devotion? Was it some god or some Rishi who declared it.

data.v: एकान्तिनां च का चर्या कदा चोत्पादिता विभो । एतन्मे संशयं छिन्धि परं कौतूहलं हि मे ॥
data.md: What are the practices of those practices begin? I have doubts on those subjects. Do you dispell them. Great is my curiosity to her you explain the several points.

data.v: समुपोढेष्वनीकेषु कुरुपाण्डवयोर्मृधे । अर्जुने विमनस्के च गीता भगवता स्वयम् ॥
आगतिश्च गतिश्चैव पूर्वं ते कथिता मया । गहनो ह्येष धर्मो वै दुर्विज्ञेयोऽकृतात्मभिः ॥
data.md: Vaishampayana said, "When the diverse detachments of the Pandava and the Kuru armies were drawn up in battle array and when Arjuna became dispirited, the holy one himself explained the question of what is the end and what is not the end attained by persons of different characters. I have before this recited to you the words of the holy one. It is difficult to understand the religion preached by the holy one on that occasion. Men of impure souls cannot apprehend it at all.

data.v: संमितः सामवेदेन पुरैवादियुगे कृतः । धार्यते स्वयमीशेन राजन्नारायणेन ह ॥
data.md: Having created this religion in days of yore, viz., in the golden age, in perfect accordance with the Samans, it is borne, O king, by the Supreme Lord, viz., Narayana, himself.

data.v: एतमर्थं महाराज पृष्टः पार्थेन नारदः । ऋषिमध्ये महाभागः शृण्वतोः कृष्णभीष्मयोः ॥
data.md: This very subject was ushered by the highly blessed Partha to Narada in the midst of the Rishis and in the presence of Krishna and Bhishma.

data.v: गुरुणा च ममाप्येष कथितो नृपसत्तम । यथा तु कथितस्तत्र नारदेन तथा शृणु ॥
data.md: My preceptor, viz., the Island-born Krishna heard what Narada said. Receiving it from the celestial Rishis, O best of kings, my preceptor gave it to me in exactly the same way in which he had got it from the celestial Rishi. I shall now recount it to you, O king, in the same way as it has been received from Naradas. Listen, therefore, to me.

data.v: यदासीन्मानसं जन्म नारायणमुखोद्गतम् । ब्रह्मणः पृथिवीपाल तदा नारायणः स्वयम् । तेन धर्मेण कृतवान्दैवं पित्र्यं च भारत ॥
data.md: In that cycle when the Creator Brahman, O king, took his birth in the mind of Narayana and came out from the latter's mouth, Narayana himself, performed, O Bharata, his divine and ancestral rites in accordance with this religion. Those Rishis who live upon the froth of water then got it from Narayana.

data.v: फेनपा ऋषयश्चैव तं धर्मं प्रतिपेदिरे । वैखानसाः फेनपेभ्यो धर्ममेतं प्रपेदिरे । वैखानसेभ्यः सोमस्तु ततः सोऽन्तर्दधे पुनः ॥
data.md: From the froth-eating Rishis, this religion was gained by the Rishis, named Vaikhanasas. From the Vaikhanasas Soma got it. Afterwards, it disappeared from the universe.

data.v: यदासीच्चाक्षुषं जन्म द्वितीयं ब्रह्मणो नृप । तदा पितामहात्सोमादेतं धर्ममजानत । नारायणात्मकं राजन्रुद्राय प्रददौ च सः ॥
data.md: After the second birth of Brahman, viz., when he originated from the eyes of Narayana, O king, the Grandfather (that is, Brahman) then received this religion from Soma.

data.v: ततो योगस्थितो रुद्रः पुरा कृतयुगे नृप । वालखिल्यानृषीन्सर्वान्धर्ममेतमपाठयत् । अन्तर्दधे ततो भूयस्तस्य देवस्य मायया ॥
data.md: Having received it thus, Brahman gave this religion, which has Narayana for its soul, to Rudra. In the golden age of that ancient Kalpa, Rudra, devoted to Yoga, 0 king, communicated it to all those Rishis called Valkhilyas. Through the illusion of Narayana, it once more disappeared from the universe.

data.v: तृतीयं ब्रह्मणो जन्म यदासीद्वाचिकं महत् । तत्रैष धर्मः संभूतः स्वयं नारायणान्नृप ॥
data.md: In the third birth of Brahman which was from the speech of Narayana, this religion once more sprang up, O king, from Narayana himself.

data.v: सुपर्णो नाम तमृषिः प्राप्तवान्पुरुषोत्तमात् । तपसा वै सुतप्तेन दमेन नियमेन च ॥
data.md: Then a Rishi named Suparna acquired it from that foremost of Beings.

data.v: त्रिः परिक्रान्तवानेतत्सुपर्णो धर्ममुत्तमम् । यस्मात्तस्माद्व्रतं ह्येतत्त्रिसौपर्णमिहोच्यते ॥
data.md: The Rishi Suparna used to recite this excellent religion, three times during the day. Therefore it passed by the name of Trisauparna in the world.

data.v: ऋग्वेदपाठपठितं व्रतमेतद्धि दुश्चरम् । सुपर्णाच्चाप्यधिगतो धर्म एष सनातनः ॥
data.md: This religion has been referred to in the Rigveda. The duties it enjoins are extremely difficult of observance. From the Rishi Suparna, this eternal religion was acquired, O foremost of men, by the wind god, that sustainer of the lives of all creatures in the universe. The god of wind communicated it to such Rishis as live upon the remnants of sacrificial offerings after feeding guests and others.

data.v: वायुना द्विपदां श्रेष्ठ प्रथितो जगदायुषा । वायोः सकाशात्प्राप्तश्च ऋषिभिर्विघसाशिभिः ॥
data.md: This religion has been referred to in the Rigveda. The duties it enjoins are extremely difficult of observance. From the Rishi Suparna, this eternal religion was acquired, O foremost of men, by the wind god, that sustainer of the lives of all creatures in the universe. The god of wind communicated it to such Rishis as live upon the remnants of sacrificial offerings after feeding guests and others.

data.v: तेभ्यो महोदधिश्चैनं प्राप्तवान्धर्ममुत्तमम् । ततः सोऽन्तर्दधे भूयो नारायणसमाहितः ॥
data.md: From those Rishis this excellent religion was acquired by the great Ocean. It once more disappeared from the universe and became merged into Narayana.

data.v: यदा भूयः श्रवणजा सृष्टिरासीन्महात्मनः । ब्रह्मणः पुरुषव्याघ्र तत्र कीर्तयतः शृणु ॥
data.md: In the next birth of the great Brahman when he originated from the ear of Narayana, listen, O king, to what took place in that aeon.

data.v: जगत्स्रष्टुमना देवो हरिर्नारायणः स्वयम् । चिन्तयामास पुरुषं जगत्सर्गकरं प्रभुः ॥
data.md: The illustrious Narayana, otherwise called Hari, when he was bent upon Creation, thought of a Being who would be powerful enough to create the universe.

data.v: अथ चिन्तयतस्तस्य कर्णाभ्यां पुरुषः सृतः । प्रजासर्गकरो ब्रह्मा तमुवाच जगत्पतिः ॥
data.md: While thinking of this, a Being originated from his ears capable to create the universe. The Lord of all called him by the name of Brahman..

data.v: सृज प्रजाः पुत्र सर्वा मुखतः पादतस्तथा । श्रेयस्तव विधास्यामि बलं तेजश्च सुव्रत ॥
data.md: Addressing Brahman, the Supreme Narayana said,—Do you, O son, create all kinds of creatures from your mouth and feet. O you of excellent vows, I shall do what will be good for you, for I shall impart to you both energy and strength sufficient to make you competent for this work.

data.v: धर्मं च मत्तो गृह्णीष्व सात्वतं नाम नामतः । तेन सर्वं कृतयुगं स्थापयस्व यथाविधि ॥
data.md: Do you receive also from me this excellent religion known by the name of Satvata. Helped by that religion do you create the golden age and ordain it duly.

data.v: ततो ब्रह्मा नमश्चक्रे देवाय हरिमेधसे । धर्मं चाग्र्यं स जग्राह सरहस्यं ससंग्रहम् । आरण्यकेन सहितं नारायणमुखोद्गतम् ॥
उपदिश्य ततो धर्मं ब्रह्मणेऽमिततेजसे । तं कार्तयुगधर्माणं निराशीःकर्मसंज्ञितम् । जगाम तमसः पारं यत्राव्यक्तं व्यवस्थितम् ॥
ततोऽथ वरदो देवो ब्रह्मलोकपितामहः । असृजत्स तदा लोकान्कृत्स्नान्स्थावरजङ्गमान् ॥
data.md: Helped then by Hari and assisted by the Vedas, Brahman created all worlds with their mobile and immobile creatures.

data.v: ततः प्रावर्तत तदा आदौ कृतयुगं शुभम् । ततो हि सात्वतो धर्मो व्याप्य लोकानवस्थितः ॥
data.md: The age that first began was highly auspicious and came to be called by the name of Krita. In that age, the religion of Sattva existed, in the entire universe.

data.v: तेनैवाद्येन धर्मेण ब्रह्मा लोकविसर्गकृत् । पूजयामास देवेशं हरिं नारायणं प्रभुम् ॥
data.md: With the help of that primeval religion of virtue, Brahman, the Creator of all the worlds, adored the Lord of all the gods, viz., the powerful Narayana otherwise called Hari.

data.v: धर्मप्रतिष्ठाहेतोश्च मनुं स्वारोचिषं ततः । अध्यापयामास तदा लोकानां हितकाम्यया ॥
data.md: For the propagation then of that religion and desirous of benefiting the worlds, Brahman then instructed that Manu who is known by the name of Swarochish in that religion.

data.v: ततः स्वारोचिषः पुत्रं स्वयं शङ्खपदं नृप । अध्यापयत्पुराव्यग्रः सर्वलोकपतिर्विभुः ॥
data.md: Svarochish-Manu, that Lord of all the worlds, that foremost of all persons gifted with power, then cheerfully gave the knowledge of that religion to his own son, O king, who was known by the name of Shankhapada.

data.v: ततः शङ्खपदश्चापि पुत्रमात्मजमौरसम् । दिशापालं सुधर्माणमध्यापयत भारत । ततः सोऽन्तर्दधे भूयः प्राप्ते त्रेतायुगे पुनः ॥
data.md: The son of Manu, viz., Shankhapada, imparted the knowledge of that religion to his own son Suvarnabha who was the Regent of the cardinal and subsidiary points. When, upon the expiration of the Krita Yoga, the Treta came, that religion once more disappeared from the world.

data.v: नासिक्यजन्मनि पुरा ब्रह्मणः पार्थिवोत्तम । धर्ममेतं स्वयं देवो हरिर्नारायणः प्रभुः । उज्जगारारविन्दाक्षो ब्रह्मणः पश्यतस्तदा ॥
data.md: In a subsequent birth of Brahman, O best of kings, viz., that which was derived from the nose of Narayana, O Bharata, the illustrious and powerful Narayana or Hari having eyes like lotus petals, himself sang this religion in the presence of Brahman. Then the son of Brahman, created by his will, viz., Sanatkumara, studied this religion.

data.v: सनत्कुमारो भगवांस्ततः प्राधीतवान्नृप । सनत्कुमारादपि च वीरणो वै प्रजापतिः । कृतादौ कुरुशार्दूल धर्ममेतमधीतवान् ॥
data.md: From Santakumara, the Prajapati Virana, in the beginning of the Krita age, O foremost of Kurus, obtained this religion.

data.v: वीरणश्चाप्यधीत्यैनं रौच्याय मनवे ददौ । रौच्यः पुत्राय शुद्धाय सुव्रताय सुमेधसे ॥
कुक्षिनाम्नेऽथ प्रददौ दिशां पालाय धर्मिणे । ततः सोऽन्तर्दधे भूयो नारायणमुखोद्गतः ॥
अण्डजे जन्मनि पुनर्ब्रह्मणे हरियोनये । एष धर्मः समुद्भूतो नारायणमुखात्पुनः ॥
data.md: In the next birth of Brahman, viz., that which he derived from an egg which originated from Hari, this religion once more issued from the mouth of Narayana.

data.v: गृहीतो ब्रह्मणा राजन्प्रयुक्तश्च यथाविधि । अध्यापिताश्च मुनयो नाम्ना बर्हिषदो नृप ॥
data.md: It was received by Brahman, O king, and practised duly in all its details by him. Brahman then gave it, O king, to those Rishis who are known by the name of Varhishada.

data.v: बर्हिषद्भ्यश्च संक्रान्तः सामवेदान्तगं द्विजम् । ज्येष्ठं नाम्नाभिविख्यातं ज्येष्ठसामव्रतो हरिः ॥
data.md: From the Barhishadas it was acquired by a Brahmana well-versed in the Sama-Veda, and known by the name of Jeshthya. And because he was well-versed in the Samans, therefore was he known also by the name of Jeshthyasamavrata-Hari.

data.v: ज्येष्ठाच्चाप्यनुसंक्रान्तो राजानमविकम्पनम् । अन्तर्दधे ततो राजन्नेष धर्मः प्रभोर्हरेः ॥
data.md: From the Brahmana known by the name of Jeshthya, this religion was obtained by a king of the name of Avikampana. After this, that religion, derived from the powerful Hari, once more disappeared from the world.

data.v: यदिदं सप्तमं जन्म पद्मजं ब्रह्मणो नृप । तत्रैष धर्मः कथितः स्वयं नारायणेन हि ॥
data.md: During the seventh birth of Brahman from the lotus, O king, that sprang from the navel of Narayana, this religion was once more preached by Narayana himself, to the Grandsire of pure soul, the Creator of all the worlds, in the beginning of this Kalpa. The Grandfather gave it in days of yore to Daksha.

data.v: पितामहाय शुद्धाय युगादौ लोकधारिणे । पितामहश्च दक्षाय धर्ममेतं पुरा ददौ ॥
data.md: During the seventh birth of Brahman from the lotus, O king, that sprang from the navel of Narayana, this religion was once more preached by Narayana himself, to the Grandsire of pure soul, the Creator of all the worlds, in the beginning of this Kalpa. The Grandfather gave it in days of yore to Daksha.

data.v: ततो ज्येष्ठे तु दौहित्रे प्रादाद्दक्षो नृपोत्तम । आदित्ये सवितुर्ज्येष्ठे विवस्वाञ्जगृहे ततः ॥
data.md: Daksha, in his turn, gave it to the eldest of all the sons of his daughters, O monarch, viz., Aditya, who is senior in age to Savitri. From Aditya, Vivasvat got it.

data.v: त्रेतायुगादौ च पुनर्विवस्वान्मनवे ददौ । मनुश्च लोकभूत्यर्थं सुतायेक्ष्वाकवे ददौ ॥
data.md: In the beginning of the Treta Yuga, Vivasvat gave the knowledge of this religion to Manu. Manu, for the protection and support of all the worlds, then gave it to his son Ikshvaku.

data.v: इक्ष्वाकुणा च कथितो व्याप्य लोकानवस्थितः । गमिष्यति क्षयान्ते च पुनर्नारायणं नृप ॥
data.md: Promulgated by Ikshvaku, that religion overspreads the whole world. When the universal destruction sets in, it will once more return to Narayana and be merged in Him.

data.v: व्रतिनां चापि यो धर्मः स ते पूर्वं नृपोत्तम । कथितो हरिगीतासु समासविधिकल्पितः ॥
data.md: Even such are the particulars of this great religion. I have, before this, O foremost of kings, explained it to you in the Hari-Gita, with a brief reference to its ordinances.

data.v: नारदेन तु संप्राप्तः सरहस्यः ससंग्रहः । एष धर्मो जगन्नाथात्साक्षान्नारायणान्नृप ॥
data.md: This religion, with its mysteries and its abstract of details, was won by Narada, O king, from that Lord of the universe, viz., Narayana himself.

data.v: एवमेष महान्धर्म आद्यो राजन्सनातनः । दुर्विज्ञेयो दुष्करश्च सात्वतैर्धार्यते सदा ॥
data.md: Thus, O king, this foremost of religions is primeval and eternal. Incapable of being understood easily and highly difficult of being pervaded by the quality of godness.

data.v: धर्मज्ञानेन चैतेन सुप्रयुक्तेन कर्मणा । अहिंसाधर्मयुक्तेन प्रीयते हरिरीश्वरः ॥
data.md: It is by means of acts that are wellperformed and done with a perfect knowledge of duties,-acts, that is, in which there is nothing of injury to any creature,-that Hari the Supreme Lord became pleased.

data.v: एकव्यूहविभागो वा क्वचिद्द्विव्यूहसंज्ञितः । त्रिव्यूहश्चापि संख्यातश्चतुर्व्यूहश्च दृश्यते ॥
data.md: Some persons worship Narayana as endued with only one form, viz., that O Aniruddha. Some worship Him as endued with two forms, viz., that of Aniruddha and Pradyumna. Some adore Him as having three forms, viz., Aniruddha, Pradyumna and Sankarshana. A fourth section adore him as having four forms, viz., Aniruddha, Pradyumna, Shankarshana, and Vasudeva.

data.v: हरिरेव हि क्षेत्रज्ञो निर्ममो निष्कलस्तथा । जीवश्च सर्वभूतेषु पञ्चभूतगुणातिगः ॥
data.md: Hari is Himself the Kshetrajna (Soul). He is without parts. He is the Individual Soul in all creatures, getting over the five primal elements.

data.v: मनश्च प्रथितं राजन्पञ्चेन्द्रियसमीरणम् । एष लोकनिधिर्धीमानेष लोकविसर्गकृत् ॥
data.md: He is the Mind, O king, that directs and governs the five senses. Gifted with the highest intelligence, He is the Ordainer of the universe, and the Creator thereof.

data.v: अकर्ता चैव कर्ता च कार्यं कारणमेव च । यथेच्छति तथा राजन्क्रीडते पुरुषोऽव्ययः ॥
data.md: He is both active and inactive. He is both Cause and Effect. He is the one immutable Soul, who sports as He likes, O king.

data.v: एष एकान्तिधर्मस्ते कीर्तितो नृपसत्तम । मया गुरुप्रसादेन दुर्विज्ञेयोऽकृतात्मभिः । एकान्तिनो हि पुरुषा दुर्लभा बहवो नृप ॥
data.md: Thus have I recounted to you the Religion of Devotion, O best of kings, which cannot be comprehended by persons of impure souls but which I acquired through the favour of my preceptor.

data.v: यद्येकान्तिभिराकीर्णं जगत्स्यात्कुरुनन्दन । अहिंसकैरात्मविद्भिः सर्वभूतहिते रतैः । भवेत्कृतयुगप्राप्तिराशीःकर्मविवर्जितैः ॥
data.md: Persons are very rare, O king, who are devoted whole-mindedly to Narayana. If, O son of Kuru's race, the world has been full of such persons, who are full of universal mercy, who are possessed of the knowledge of the soul, and who are always busy with doing good to others, then the Krita age would have begun and all men would have undertaken works without desire of fruit.

data.v: एवं स भगवान्व्यासो गुरुर्मम विशां पते । कथयामास धर्मज्ञो धर्मराज्ञे द्विजोत्तमः ॥
data.md: It was even thus, O king, that foremost of twice-born ones, viz., the illustrious Vyasa, my preceptor, well-versed in all duties, described to king Yudhishthira the just this religion of Devotion, in the presence of many Rishis and in the hearing of Krishna and Bhishma. He had got it from the celestial Rishi Narada having penances for wealth.

data.v: ऋषीणां संनिधौ राजञ्शृण्वतोः कृष्णभीष्मयोः । तस्याप्यकथयत्पूर्वं नारदः सुमहातपाः ॥
data.md: It was even thus, O king, that foremost of twice-born ones, viz., the illustrious Vyasa, my preceptor, well-versed in all duties, described to king Yudhishthira the just this religion of Devotion, in the presence of many Rishis and in the hearing of Krishna and Bhishma. He had got it from the celestial Rishi Narada having penances for wealth.

data.v: देवं परमकं ब्रह्म श्वेतं चन्द्राभमच्युतम् । यत्र चैकान्तिनो यान्ति नारायणपरायणाः ॥
data.md: Those persons who are whole-mindedly devoted to Narayana in the end, that greatest of gods, identical with Brahma, pure in complexion, effulgent like the moon, and immutable.

data.v: एवं बहुविधं धर्मं प्रतिबुद्धैर्निषेवितम् । न कुर्वन्ति कथं विप्रा अन्ये नानाव्रते स्थिताः ॥
data.md: I see that those twice-born ones whose souls have been awakened, pactise various kinds of duties. Why it is that other Brahmanas do not practise those duties but observe other kinds of vows and rites?

data.v: तिस्रः प्रकृतयो राजन्देहबन्धेषु निर्मिताः । सात्त्विकी राजसी चैव तामसी चेति भारत ॥
data.md: Three kinds of disposition, O king, have been created about all embodied creatures, viz., that which appertains to the quality of goodness, that which appertains to the quality of Darkness, and lastly that which appertains to the quality of Ignorance, O Bharata.

data.v: देहबन्धेषु पुरुषः श्रेष्ठः कुरुकुलोद्वह । सात्त्विकः पुरुषव्याघ्र भवेन्मोक्षार्थनिश्चितः ॥
data.md: As regards embodied creatures, perpetuator of Kuru's race, that person is the foremost who follows the quality of Goodness, for, O foremost of men, it is certain that he will acquire Liberation.

data.v: अत्रापि स विजानाति पुरुषं ब्रह्मवर्तिनम् । नारायणपरो मोक्षस्ततो वै सात्त्विकः स्मृतः ॥
data.md: It is with the help of this very quality of Goodness that one endued therewith succeeds in understanding the person who is conversant with Brahma. As regards Liberation, it is entirely dependent upon Narayana. Hence it is that Liberation is considered as made up of the quality of Goodness.

data.v: मनीषितं च प्राप्नोति चिन्तयन्पुरुषोत्तमम् । एकान्तभक्तिः सततं नारायणपरायणः ॥
data.md: By thinking of the foremost of Beings, the man who is devoted whole-mindedly to Narayana, gains great wisdom.

data.v: मनीषिणो हि ये केचिद्यतयो मोक्षकाङ्क्षिणः । तेषां वै छिन्नतृष्णानां योगक्षेमवहो हरिः ॥
data.md: Those persons who are possessed of wisdom, who follow the practices of Yatis and the Religion of Liberation,-those persons whose thirst has been satisfied_always find that Hari favours them with the fruition of their desire.

data.v: जायमानं हि पुरुषं यं पश्येन्मधुसूदनः । सात्त्विकस्तु स विज्ञेयो भवेन्मोक्षे च निश्चितः ॥
data.md: That man subject to birth (and death) upon whom Hari casts a kind eye should be known as gifted with the quality of Goodness and devoted to the acquisition of Liberation.

data.v: सांख्ययोगेन तुल्यो हि धर्म एकान्तसेवितः । नारायणात्मके मोक्षे ततो यान्ति परां गतिम् ॥
data.md: The religion followed by a person who is devoted whole-mindely to to Narayana is considered as similar or equal in merit to the system of the Sankhyas.

data.v: नारायणेन दृष्टश्च प्रतिबुद्धो भवेत्पुमान् । एवमात्मेच्छया राजन्प्रतिबुद्धो न जायते ॥
data.md: By following that religion one acquires the highest end by attaining to Liberation which has Narayana for its soul. That person upon whom Narayana looks with mercy succeeds in becoming awakened.

data.v: राजसी तामसी चैव व्यामिश्रे प्रकृती स्मृते । तदात्मकं हि पुरुषं जायमानं विशां पते । प्रवृत्तिलक्षणैर्युक्तं नावेक्षति हरिः स्वयम् ॥
data.md: No one, O king, can become awakened through his own wishes. That nature which partakes of both Darkness and Ignorance is said to be mixed.

data.v: पश्यत्येनं जायमानं ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः । रजसा तमसा चैव मानुषं समभिप्लुतम् ॥
data.md: Only Brahman, the Grandfather of the worlds, cares for the person who is subject to me birth the death because of his mind being overwhelmed with the two inferior qualities of Darkness and Ignorance.

data.v: कामं देवाश्च ऋषयः सत्त्वस्था नृपसत्तम । हीनाः सत्त्वेन सूक्ष्मेण ततो वैकारिकाः स्मृताः ॥
data.md: Forsooth, the gods and the Rishis are endued with the qualities of Goodness, best of kings! But then they who are divested of that quality in its subtile form are always considered to be of mutable nature.

data.v: कथं वैकारिको गच्छेत्पुरुषः पुरुषोत्तमम् ॥
सुसूक्ष्मसत्त्वसंयुक्तं संयुक्तं त्रिभिरक्षरैः । पुरुषः पुरुषं गच्छेन्निष्क्रियः पञ्चविंशकम् ॥
data.md: Vaishampayana sajd— When it becomes able to abstain entirely from acts, the twenty-fifth, i.e., the Individual Soul, succeeds in attaining to the foremost of Beings which is highly subtile, which is invested with the quality of Goodness, and which is highly of Goodness, and which is fraught with the essence symbolised by the three letters of the alphabet (viz., A. U. and M.)

data.v: एवमेकं सांख्ययोगं वेदारण्यकमेव च । परस्पराङ्गान्येतानि पञ्चरात्रं च कथ्यते । एष एकान्तिनां धर्मो नारायणपरात्मकः ॥
data.md: The Sankhya system, the Aranyaka-Veda, and the Pancharatra scriptures, are all identical and form parts of one whole. This is the religion of those who are devoted whole. mindedly to Narayana—the religion that has Narayana for its Soul.

data.v: यथा समुद्रात्प्रसृता जलौघा;स्तमेव राजन्पुनराविशन्ति । इमे तथा ज्ञानमहाजलौघा; नारायणं वै पुनराविशन्ति ॥
data.md: As waves of the ocean, rising from the ocean, rush away from it only to return to it in the long run so various sorts of knowledge, originating from Narayana, return to Narayana in the end.

data.v: एष ते कथितो धर्मः सात्वतो यदुबान्धव । कुरुष्वैनं यथान्यायं यदि शक्नोषि भारत ॥
data.md: I have thus explained to you, O son of Kuru's race, what the religion of Goodness is. If you be qualified for it, O Bharata, do you practise that religion duly.

data.v: एवं हि सुमहाभागो नारदो गुरवे मम । श्वेतानां यतिनामाह एकान्तगतिमव्ययाम् ॥
data.md: Thus did the highly-blessed Narada explain to my preceptor.-the Island-born Krishna-the eternal and immutable course called Ekanta, followed by the Whites as also by Yatis.

data.v: व्यासश्चाकथयत्प्रीत्या धर्मपुत्राय धीमते । स एवायं मया तुभ्यमाख्यातः प्रसृतो गुरोः ॥
data.md: Pleased with Dharma's son Yudhisthira, Vyasa imparted this religion to king Yudhisthira the just who was endued with great intelligence. Derived from my preceptor I have also communicated it to you.

data.v: इत्थं हि दुश्चरो धर्म एष पार्थिवसत्तम । यथैव त्वं तथैवान्ये न भजन्ति विमोहिताः ॥
data.md: O best of kings, this religion is, for these reasons, highly difficult of practice. Others, hearing it, become as much stupefied as you have allowed yourself to be.

data.v: कृष्ण एव हि लोकानां भावनो मोहनस्तथा । संहारकारकश्चैव कारणं च विशां पते ॥
data.md: It is Krishna who is the protector of the universe and its beguiler. It is He who is the destroyer and the cause, O king.

data.v: सांख्यं योगं पञ्चरात्रं वेदारण्यकमेव च । ज्ञानान्येतानि ब्रह्मर्षे लोकेषु प्रचरन्ति ह ॥
data.md: The Sankhya System, the Pancharatra Scriptures, and the Aranyaka-Vedas—these different systems of knowledge or religion,-0 twice-born Rishi, are current in the world.

data.v: किमेतान्येकनिष्ठानि पृथङ्निष्ठानि वा मुने । प्रब्रूहि वै मया पृष्टः प्रवृत्तिं च यथाक्रमम् ॥
data.md: Do all these systems preach the same course of duties, or are the courses of duties preached by them, O ascetic, different from one another? Accosted by me, do you describe to me on Renunciation in due order!

data.v: जज्ञे बहुज्ञं परमत्युदारं; यं द्वीपमध्ये सुतमात्मवन्तम् । पराशराद्गन्धवती महर्षिं; तस्मै नमोऽज्ञानतमोनुदाय ॥
data.md: Vaishampayana said I bow to that great Rishi who is the remover of Darkness, and whom Satyavati bore to Parashara in the midst of an island, who is endued with great knowledge and great liberality of soul.

data.v: पितामहाद्यं प्रवदन्ति षष्ठं; महर्षिमार्षेयविभूतियुक्तम् । नारायणस्यांशजमेकपुत्रं; द्वैपायनं वेदमहानिधानम् ॥
data.md: The learned say that he is the origin of the Grandfather Brahman; that he is the sixth form of Narayana; that he is the foremost of Rishis; that he is endued with the power of Yoga; that as the only son of his parents he is an incarnate part of Narayana; and that, born under extraordinary circumstances on an Island, he is the undecaying receptacle of the Vedas.

data.v: तमादिकालेषु महाविभूति;र्नारायणो ब्रह्ममहानिधानम् । ससर्ज पुत्रार्थमुदारतेजा; व्यासं महात्मानमजः पुराणः ॥
data.md: In the Krita age, Narayana, of great power and might energy, created him as his son. Verily, the great Vyasa is unborn and ancient and is the undecaying receptacle of the Vedas.

data.v: त्वयैव कथितः पूर्वं संभवो द्विजसत्तम । वसिष्ठस्य सुतः शक्तिः शक्तेः पुत्रः पराशरः ॥
data.md: Janamejaya said, O best of twice-born ones, it was you who said before this that the Rishi Vashishtha had a son named Shakti and that Shakti had a son named Parashara, and that Parashara begot a son named the Island-born Krishna gifted with great ascetic merit.

data.v: पराशरस्य दायादः कृष्णद्वैपायनो मुनिः । भूयो नारायणसुतं त्वमेवैनं प्रभाषसे ॥
किमतः पूर्वजं जन्म व्यासस्यामिततेजसः । कथयस्वोत्तममते जन्म नारायणोद्भवम् ॥
data.md: You tell me again that Vyasa is the son of Narayana. I ask was it in some former birth that Vyasa of great energy had originated from Narayana? O you of great intelligence, do tell me of that birth of Vyasa from Narayana!

data.v: वेदार्थान्वेत्तुकामस्य धर्मिष्ठस्य तपोनिधेः । गुरोर्मे ज्ञाननिष्ठस्य हिमवत्पाद आसतः ॥
data.md: Desirous of understanding the meaning of the Shrutis, my preceptor, that sea of penances, who is greatly devoted to the observance of all scriptural duties and the acquisition of knowledge, lived for sometime in a particular region of the Himavat mountains.

data.v: कृत्वा भारतमाख्यानं तपःश्रान्तस्य धीमतः । शुश्रूषां तत्परा राजन्कृतवन्तो वयं तदा ॥
data.md: Gifted with great intelligence, he became fatigued with his penances on account of the great strain on his energies made by the composition of the Mahabharata. At that time, Sumanta and Jaimini and Paila of firm vows and myself as the fourth, and Shuka his own son, were his disciples. All of us, O king, seeing the fatigfue of our preceptor, waited dutifully upon him, engaged in doing all that was necessary for removing that fatigue of his.

data.v: सुमन्तुर्जैमिनिश्चैव पैलश्च सुदृढव्रतः । अहं चतुर्थः शिष्यो वै शुको व्यासात्मजस्तथा ॥
data.md: Gifted with great intelligence, he became fatigued with his penances on account of the great strain on his energies made by the composition of the Mahabharata. At that time, Sumanta and Jaimini and Paila of firm vows and myself as the fourth, and Shuka his own son, were his disciples. All of us, O king, seeing the fatigfue of our preceptor, waited dutifully upon him, engaged in doing all that was necessary for removing that fatigue of his.

data.v: एभिः परिवृतो व्यासः शिष्यैः पञ्चभिरुत्तमैः । शुशुभे हिमवत्पादे भूतैर्भूतपतिर्यथा ॥
data.md: Surrounded by these disciples of his, Vyasa shone on the breast of the Himavat mountains like the Lord of all the goblins, viz., Mahadeva, in the midst of those ghostly attendants of his.

data.v: वेदानावर्तयन्साङ्गान्भारतार्थांश्च सर्वशः । तमेकमनसं दान्तं युक्ता वयमुपास्महे ॥
data.md: Having recapitulated the Vedas with all their branches as also the meanings of all the Verses in the Mahabharata, one day, with rapt attention, all of us approached our preceptor who, having mastered his senses, was at time engaged in thought.

data.v: कथान्तरेऽथ कस्मिंश्चित्पृष्टोऽस्माभिर्द्विजोत्तमः । वेदार्थान्भारतार्थांश्च जन्म नारायणात्तथा ॥
data.md: Availing ourselves of an interval in the conversation, we asked that foremost of twiceborn ones to explain to us the meanings of the Vedas and of the Verses in the Mahabharata and describe to us the events as well of his own birth from Narayana.

data.v: स पूर्वमुक्त्वा वेदार्थान्भारतार्थांश्च तत्त्ववित् । नारायणादिदं जन्म व्याहर्तुमुपचक्रमे ॥
data.md: Conversant as he was with all subjects of enquiry, he at first described to us the interpretations of the Shrutis and the Mahabharata, and then began to narrate to us the following events regarding his birth from Narayana.

data.v: शृणुध्वमाख्यानवरमेतदार्षेयमुत्तमम् । आदिकालोद्भवं विप्रास्तपसाधिगतं मया ॥
data.md: Vyasa said Listen, ye disciples to this foremost of narratives, to this best of histories that concerns the birth of a Rishi. Belonging to the Krita age, this discourse has become known to me through my penances, ye twice-born ones.

data.v: प्राप्ते प्रजाविसर्गे वै सप्तमे पद्मसंभवे । नारायणो महायोगी शुभाशुभविवर्जितः ॥
data.md: On the occasion of the seventh creation, viz., that which was due to the primeval Lotus, Narayana, gifted, with the austerest penances, getting over both good and evil, and possessed of peerless splendour, at first created Brahman, from his navel. After Brahman had come into being, Narayana addressed him, saying,

data.v: ससृजे नाभितः पुत्रं ब्रह्माणममितप्रभम् । ततः स प्रादुरभवदथैनं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥
मम त्वं नाभितो जातः प्रजासर्गकरः प्रभुः । सृज प्रजास्त्वं विविधा ब्रह्मन्सजडपण्डिताः ॥
data.md: You have originated from my navel. Gifted with power of creation, do you begin to create diverse kinds of creatures, rational and irrational.

data.v: स एवमुक्तो विमुखश्चिन्ताव्याकुलमानसः । प्रणम्य वरदं देवमुवाच हरिमीश्वरम् ॥
data.md: Thus addressed by his Creator, Brahman, with mind stricken with anxiety, felt the difficulty of his task and became reluctant to do what he was ordered to do. Bowing his head to the boon-giving and illustrious Hari, the Lord of the universe, Brahman said these words to him,

data.v: का शक्तिर्मम देवेश प्रजाः स्रष्टुं नमोऽस्तु ते । अप्रज्ञावानहं देव विधत्स्व यदनन्तरम् ॥
data.md: I bow to you, O Lord of the gods, but I ask what power have I to create various creatures? I have no wisdom. Do you ordain what should be ordained in view of this.

data.v: स एवमुक्तो भगवान्भूत्वाथान्तर्हितस्ततः । चिन्तयामास देवेशो बुद्धिं बुद्धिमतां वरः ॥
data.md: Thus addressed by Brahman, the Lord of the universe, viz., Narayana, disappeared there and then from Brahman's view, the foremost of all being gifted with intelligence, viz., the Supreme Lord, then thought of Intelligence.

data.v: स्वरूपिणी ततो बुद्धिरुपतस्थे हरिं प्रभुम् । योगेन चैनां निर्योगः स्वयं नियुयुजे तदा ॥
data.md: Possessed of form that resembled immediately appeared before the powerful Hari. Himself above all Yoga, Narayana then, with Yoga, applied the goddess of Intelligence properly.

data.v: स तामैश्वर्ययोगस्थां बुद्धिं शक्तिमतीं सतीम् । उवाच वचनं देवो बुद्धिं वै प्रभुरव्ययः ॥
data.md: The illustrious and powerful and immutable Hari, addressed the goddess of Intelligence who was gifted with activity and goodness and all the power of Yoga, said to her these words-

data.v: ब्रह्माणं प्रविशस्वेति लोकसृष्ट्यर्थसिद्धये । ततस्तमीश्वरादिष्टा बुद्धिः क्षिप्रं विवेश सा ॥
data.md: For the accomplishment of the work of creating all the words do you enter into Brahman!-Ordered thus by the Supreme Lord, Intelligence immediately entered Brahman.

data.v: अथैनं बुद्धिसंयुक्तं पुनः स ददृशे हरिः । भूयश्चैनं वचः प्राह सृजेमा विविधाः प्रजाः ॥
data.md: When Hari saw that Brahman had become united with Intelligence, He once addressed him, saying,-Do you now create various creatures.

data.v: एवमुक्त्वा स भगवांस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत । प्राप चैव मुहूर्तेन स्वस्थानं देवसंज्ञितम् ॥
data.md: Replying to Narayana by uttering the word— Yes,-Brahman reverently accepted the order of his progenitor. Narayana then disappeared from Brahman's view, and in a more moment repaired to his own place known by the name of Light or Effulgence. Coming back to His own disposition, Hari resolved Himself into His one universal nature.

data.v: तां चैव प्रकृतिं प्राप्य एकीभावगतोऽभवत् । अथास्य बुद्धिरभवत्पुनरन्या तदा किल ॥
सृष्टा इमाः प्रजाः सर्वा ब्रह्मणा परमेष्ठिना । दैत्यदानवगन्धर्वरक्षोगणसमाकुलाः । जाता हीयं वसुमती भाराक्रान्ता तपस्विनी ॥
data.md: After the work of Creation, however, had been done by Brahman, another thought arose in the mind of Narayana. Indeed,. He thought thus,-Brahman, otherwise called Parameshthi, has created all these creatures, consisting of Daityas and Danavas and Gandharvas and Rakshasas. The helpless Earth has become loaded with the weight of creatures.

data.v: बहवो बलिनः पृथ्व्यां दैत्यदानवराक्षसाः । भविष्यन्ति तपोयुक्ता वरान्प्राप्स्यन्ति चोत्तमान् ॥
data.md: Many among the Daityas and Danavas and Rakshsas on Earth will become gifted with great strength. Possessed of penances, they will at various times succeed in acquiring many excellent boons.

data.v: अवश्यमेव तैः सर्वैर्वरदानेन दर्पितैः । बाधितव्याः सुरगणा ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः । तत्र न्याय्यमिदं कर्तुं भारावतरणं मया ॥
data.md: Elated with pride and power on account of those boons they will succeed in acquiring, they will oppress and afflict the gods and the Rishis endued with ascetic power.

data.v: अथ नानासमुद्भूतैर्वसुधायां यथाक्रमम् । निग्रहेण च पापानां साधूनां प्रग्रहेण च ॥
इमां तपस्विनीं सत्यां धारयिष्यामि मेदिनीम् । मया ह्येषा हि ध्रियते पातालस्थेन भोगिना ॥
मया धृता धारयति जगद्धि सचराचरम् । तस्मात्पृथ्व्याः परित्राणं करिष्ये संभवं गतः ॥
data.md: Assuming the form of a powerful snake I myself have to uphold the Earth in empty space. Supported by me thus, she will support the entire universe of creatures mobile and immobile. Incarnated on the Earth, therefore, in different forms, I shall have to save her at such time from danger.

data.v: एवं स चिन्तयित्वा तु भगवान्मधुसूदनः । रूपाण्यनेकान्यसृजत्प्रादुर्भावभवाय सः ॥
data.md: Having thought thus, the illustrious killer of Madhu created various forms in his mind in which to appear from time to time for performing the proposed task.

data.v: वाराहं नारसिंहं च वामनं मानुषं तथा । एभिर्मया निहन्तव्या दुर्विनीताः सुरारयः ॥
data.md: Assuming the form of a Boar, of a Manlion, of a Dwarf, and of human beings, I shall suppress or kill such enemies of the gods as will become wicked and ungovernable.

data.v: अथ भूयो जगत्स्रष्टा भोःशब्देनानुनादयन् । सरस्वतीमुच्चचार तत्र सारस्वतोऽभवत् ॥
data.md: After this, the Prime Creator of the universe once more uttered the syllable BHO, causing the atmosphere to resound with it. From this syllable of speech arose a Rishi named Sarasvat.

data.v: अपान्तरतमा नाम सुतो वाक्संभवो विभोः । भूतभव्यभविष्यज्ञः सत्यवादी दृढव्रतः ॥
data.md: The son, thus born of the Speech of Narayana, also passed by the name of Apantara-tamas. Endued with great power, he was fully conversant with the past, the present, and the future. Firm in the observance of vows, he was truthful in speech.

data.v: तमुवाच नतं मूर्ध्ना देवानामादिरव्ययः । वेदाख्याने श्रुतिः कार्या त्वया मतिमतां वर । तस्मात्कुरु यथाज्ञप्तं मयैतद्वचनं मुने ॥
data.md: To that Rishi who, after birth, had bowed his head to Narayana, the latter, who was the original Creator of all the gods and possessed of immutable nature, said those words-You should bestow your attention on the distribution of the Vedas, O foremost of all persons gifted with intelligence.

data.v: तेन भिन्नास्तदा वेदा मनोः स्वायंभुवेऽन्तरे । ततस्तुतोष भगवान्हरिस्तेनास्य कर्मणा । तपसा च सुतप्तेन यमेन नियमेन च ॥
data.md: For that act of the Rishi, the illustrious Hari became pleased with him, as also for his wellperformed penances, his and observances, and his control of the senses or passions.

data.v: मन्वन्तरेषु पुत्र त्वमेवं लोकप्रवर्तकः । भविष्यस्यचलो ब्रह्मन्नप्रधृष्यश्च नित्यशः ॥
data.md: Addressing him, Narayana said,-At each cycle of Manu, O son, you will act thus about the Vedas. You shall on account of this act of yours, be immutable, O twice-born one, and incapable of being excellent by any one.

data.v: पुनस्तिष्ये च संप्राप्ते कुरवो नाम भारताः । भविष्यन्ति महात्मानो राजानः प्रथिता भुवि ॥
data.md: When the Kali age will set in, certain princes of Bharata's line, named Kauravas, will take their birth from you. They will be celebrated over Earth as great princes ruling over powerful kingdoms.

data.v: तेषां त्वत्तः प्रसूतानां कुलभेदो भविष्यति । परस्परविनाशार्थं त्वामृते द्विजसत्तम ॥
data.md: Born of you, dissension's will break out among them for their destruction at one another's hands during your absence, O foremost of twice-born ones.

data.v: तत्राप्यनेकधा वेदान्भेत्स्यसे तपसान्वितः । कृष्णे युगे च संप्राप्ते कृष्णवर्णो भविष्यसि ॥
data.md: In that age also, gifted with austere penances, you will divide the Vedas into various classes. Indeed, in that dark age, your complexion will become dark.

data.v: धर्माणां विविधानां च कर्ता ज्ञानकरस्तथा । भविष्यसि तपोयुक्तो न च रागाद्विमोक्ष्यसे ॥
data.md: You will made various kinds of duties of flow and various kinds of knowledge also. Although gifted with austere penances, yet you shall never be able to free yourself from desire and attachment to the world.

data.v: वीतरागश्च पुत्रस्ते परमात्मा भविष्यति । महेश्वरप्रसादेन नैतद्वचनमन्यथा ॥
data.md: Your son, however, will be freed from every attachment like the Supreme Soul, through the favour of Mahadeva. It will not be otherwise.

data.v: यं मानसं वै प्रवदन्ति पुत्रं; पितामहस्योत्तमबुद्धियुक्तम् । वसिष्ठमग्र्यं तपसो निधानं; यश्चापि सूर्यं व्यतिरिच्य भाति ॥
तस्यान्वये चापि ततो महर्षिः; पराशरो नाम महाप्रभावः । पिता स ते वेदनिधिर्वरिष्ठो; महातपा वै तपसो निवासः । कानीनगर्भः पितृकन्यकायां; तस्मादृषेस्त्वं भविता च पुत्रः ॥
भूतभव्यभविष्याणां छिन्नसर्वार्थसंशयः । ये ह्यतिक्रान्तकाः पूर्वं सहस्रयुगपर्ययाः ॥
data.md: You will entertain no doubts about the meanings of things past, present, and future. Gifted with penances and instructed by me, you will see the incidents of a thousands and thousands of ages long past away. You will see through thousands and thousands of ages also in the future.

data.v: तांश्च सर्वान्मयोद्दिष्टान्द्रक्ष्यसे तपसान्वितः । पुनर्द्रक्ष्यसि चानेकसहस्रयुगपर्ययान् ॥
data.md: You will entertain no doubts about the meanings of things past, present, and future. Gifted with penances and instructed by me, you will see the incidents of a thousands and thousands of ages long past away. You will see through thousands and thousands of ages also in the future.

data.v: अनादिनिधनं लोके चक्रहस्तं च मां मुने । अनुध्यानान्मम मुने नैतद्वचनमन्यथा ॥
data.md: You shall in that birth, see me, O ascetic,—me who am without birth and death,-incarnated on Earth armed with the discus. All this will happen to you, O ascetic, through the merit that you will acquire for your continued devotion to me. These words of mine will never be otherwise.

data.v: शनैश्चरः सूर्यपुत्रो भविष्यति मनुर्महान् । तस्मिन्मन्वन्तरे चैव सप्तर्षिगणपूर्वकः । त्वमेव भविता वत्स मत्प्रसादान्न संशयः ॥
data.md: During that period, O son, you shall, as regards merits, be superior to even the Manus of the several periods. Forsooth, you will be so through my favour.

data.v: एवं सारस्वतमृषिमपान्तरतमं तदा । उक्त्वा वचनमीशानः साधयस्वेत्यथाब्रवीत् ॥
सोऽहं तस्य प्रसादेन देवस्य हरिमेधसः । अपान्तरतमा नाम ततो जातोऽऽज्ञया हरेः । पुनश्च जातो विख्यातो वसिष्ठकुलनन्दनः ॥
data.md: Having said these words to the Rishi Apantaratamas, otherwise called by the name of Sarasvat, the Supreme Lord sent him away, saying to him,-Go!-I am he that was born as Apantaratamas through the behest of Hari. Once more have I taken birth as the celebrated Krishna-Dvaipayana, a delighter of the race of Vashishtha.

data.v: तदेतत्कथितं जन्म मया पूर्वकमात्मनः । नारायणप्रसादेन तथा नारायणांशजम् ॥
data.md: I have thus told, you my dear disciples, the circumstances of my own pristine birth which was due to the favour of Narayana in so much that I was a very part of Narayana himself.

data.v: मया हि सुमहत्तप्तं तपः परमदारुणम् । पुरा मतिमतां श्रेष्ठाः परमेण समाधिना ॥
data.md: You foremost of intelligent persons, I practised, in days of yore, the austerest penances, with the help of the highest abstraction of the mind.

data.v: एतद्वः कथितं सर्वं यन्मां पृच्छथ पुत्रकाः । पूर्वजन्म भविष्यं च भक्तानां स्नेहतो मया ॥
data.md: You sons, actuated by my great love for yourselves who are devoted to me with reverence, I have told you everything about what you wished to know from me. viz., my first birth in days gone by and that other birth subsequent to it.

data.v: एष ते कथितः पूर्वं संभवोऽस्मद्गुरोर्नृप । व्यासस्याक्लिष्टमनसो यथा पृष्टः पुनः शृणु ॥
data.md: Vaishampayana said I have thus described to you, O king, the circumstances about the former birth of our revered preceptor, viz., Vyasa of unsullied mind, as asked by you! Listen to me once again!

data.v: सांख्यं योगं पञ्चरात्रं वेदाः पाशुपतं तथा । ज्ञानान्येतानि राजर्षे विद्धि नानामतानि वै ॥
data.md: There are various kinds of religion, O royal sage, who go by various names such as Sankhya, Yoga, the Panch-ratra, Vedas, and Pashupati.

data.v: सांख्यस्य वक्ता कपिलः परमर्षिः स उच्यते । हिरण्यगर्भो योगस्य वेत्ता नान्यः पुरातनः ॥
data.md: The promulgator of the Sankhya religion is said to be the great Rishi Kapila. The primeval Hiranyagarbha, and none else, is the promulgator of the Yoga system.

data.v: अपान्तरतमाश्चैव वेदाचार्यः स उच्यते । प्राचीनगर्भं तमृषिं प्रवदन्तीह केचन ॥
data.md: The Rishi Apantaratamas is said to be the preceptor of the Vedas, some call that Rishi by the name of Prachina-garbha.

data.v: उमापतिर्भूतपतिः श्रीकण्ठो ब्रह्मणः सुतः । उक्तवानिदमव्यग्रो ज्ञानं पाशुपतं शिवः ॥
data.md: The religion known by the name of Pashupata was promulgated by the Lord of Uma, that lord of all creatures, viz., the cheerful Shiva, otherwise known by the name of Shreekantha, the son of Brahman.

data.v: पञ्चरात्रस्य कृत्स्नस्य वेत्ता तु भगवान्स्वयम् । सर्वेषु च नृपश्रेष्ठ ज्ञानेष्वेतेषु दृश्यते ॥
data.md: The illustrious Narayana is himself the promulgator of the religion, contained in the Pancharatra Scriptures. In all these religions, O foremost of kings, it is seen that the powerful Narayana is the one sole object of exposition. According to the scriptures of these religions and the extent of knowledge they contain, Narayana is the one sole object of adoration they preach. Those persons whose vision, O king, blinded by darkness, cannot understand that Narayana is the Supreme Soul pervading the entire universe.

data.v: यथागमं यथाज्ञानं निष्ठा नारायणः प्रभुः । न चैनमेवं जानन्ति तमोभूता विशां पते ॥
तमेव शास्त्रकर्तारं प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः । निष्ठां नारायणमृषिं नान्योऽस्तीति च वादिनः ॥
data.md: Those wise persons who are the authors of the scriptures say that Narayana, who is a Rishi, is the one object of respectful adoration in the universe, I say that there is no other being like Him.

data.v: निःसंशयेषु सर्वेषु नित्यं वसति वै हरिः । ससंशयान्हेतुबलान्नाध्यावसति माधवः ॥
data.md: The Supreme God, called by the name of Hari, lives in the hearts of those who have are are succeeded in removing all doubts. Madhava never lives in the hearts of those who are under the sway of doubt and who would dispute away everything with the help of false logic.

data.v: पञ्चरात्रविदो ये तु यथाक्रमपरा नृप । एकान्तभावोपगतास्ते हरिं प्रविशन्ति वै ॥
data.md: They who conversant with the Pancharatra Scriptures, who are duly observant of the duties laid down therein, and who are whole-mindedly devoted to Narayana, succeed in entering into Narayana.

data.v: सांख्यं च योगं च सनातने द्वे; वेदाश्च सर्वे निखिलेन राजन् । सर्वैः समस्तैरृषिभिर्निरुक्तो; नारायणो विश्वमिदं पुराणम् ॥
data.md: The Sankhya and the Yoga Systems are eternal. All the Vedas, again, O king, are eternal. The Rishis, in all these systems or religion, have said that this universe existing from ancient times is Narayana's self.

data.v: शुभाशुभं कर्म समीरितं य;त्प्रवर्तते सर्वलोकेषु किंचित् । तस्मादृषेस्तद्भवतीति विद्या;द्दिव्यन्तरिक्षे भुवि चाप्सु चापि ॥
data.md: You should know that whatever acts, good or bad, laid down in the Vedas and occurring in heaven and Earth, the sky between, and the waters, are all made by that ancient Rishi Narayana.

data.v: बहवः पुरुषा ब्रह्मन्नुताहो एक एव तु । को ह्यत्र पुरुषः श्रेष्ठः को वा योनिरिहोच्यते ॥
data.md: Janamejaya said O twice-born one, are there many souls or is there only one? Who, in the universe, is the foremost of Souls? What, again, is said to be the source of all things?

data.v: बहवः पुरुषा लोके सांख्ययोगविचारिणाम् । नैतदिच्छन्ति पुरुषमेकं कुरुकुलोद्वह ॥
data.md: Vaishampayana said, In the Sankhya and the Yoga Systems many are the Souls spoken of. O preceptor of Kuru's race, those who follow these systems do not wish to assert that there is but one Purusha in the universe.

data.v: बहूनां पुरुषाणां च यथैका योनिरुच्यते । तथा तं पुरुषं विश्वं व्याख्यास्यामि गुणाधिकम् ॥
data.md: Similarly in scriptures in which the many Souls are said to have one origin in the Supreme Soul, it may be said that this entire universe is at one with that one Soul of superior attributes. I shall explain this now, after bowing to my preceptor Vyasa, that foremost of Rishis, who is conversant with the soul, endued with penances, self-controlled, and worthy of respectful adoration.

data.v: नमस्कृत्वा तु गुरवे व्यासायामिततेजसे । तपोयुक्ताय दान्ताय वन्द्याय परमर्षये ॥
इदं पुरुषसूक्तं हि सर्ववेदेषु पार्थिव । ऋतं सत्यं च विख्यातमृषिसिंहेन चिन्तितम् ॥
data.md: This speculation on Purusha, O king, occurs in all the Vedas. It is well-known to be at one with Rita and Truth. The foremost of Rishis, viz., Vyasa, has thought upon it.

data.v: उत्सर्गेणापवादेन ऋषिभिः कपिलादिभिः । अध्यात्मचिन्तामाश्रित्य शास्त्राण्युक्तानि भारत ॥
data.md: Having occupied themselves with reflection on what is called the spiritual science, various Rishis, O king, having Kapila for their first, have declared their opinions on this subject both generally and particularly.

data.v: समासतस्तु यद्व्यासः पुरुषैकत्वमुक्तवान् । तत्तेऽहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि प्रसादादमितौजसः ॥
data.md: Through the favour of Vyasa of great energy, I shall explain to you what Vyasa has said in brief on this question of the Oneness of Soul.

data.v: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् । ब्रह्मणा सह संवादं त्र्यम्बकस्य विशां पते ॥
data.md: Regarding it is cited the old discourse between Brahman, O king, and the Three-eyed Mahadeva.

data.v: क्षीरोदस्य समुद्रस्य मध्ये हाटकसप्रभः । वैजयन्त इति ख्यातः पर्वतप्रवरो नृप ॥
data.md: In the midst of the Ocean of milk, there is a very huge mountain of great effulgence like that of gold, known, O king, by the name of Vaijayanta.

data.v: तत्राध्यात्मगतिं देव एकाकी प्रविचिन्तयन् । वैराजसदने नित्यं वैजयन्तं निषेवते ॥
data.md: Going there all alone, from his own abode of great splendour and happiness, the illustrious god Brahman used very often to pass his time, engaged in thinking on the course of spiritual science.

data.v: अथ तत्रासतस्तस्य चतुर्वक्त्रस्य धीमतः । ललाटप्रभवः पुत्रः शिव आगाद्यदृच्छया । आकाशेनैव योगीशः पुरा त्रिनयनः प्रभुः ॥
data.md: While the four-headed Brahman of great intelligence, as seated there, his son Mahadeva, who had originated from his forehead, met him one day in course of his travel through the universe.

data.v: ततः खान्निपपाताशु धरणीधरमूर्धनि । अग्रतश्चाभवत्प्रीतो ववन्दे चापि पादयोः ॥
तं पादयोर्निपतितं दृष्ट्वा सव्येन पाणिना । उत्थापयामास तदा प्रभुरेकः प्रजापतिः ॥
उवाच चैनं भगवांश्चिरस्यागतमात्मजम् । स्वागतं ते महाबाहो दिष्ट्या प्राप्तोऽसि मेऽन्तिकम् ॥
कच्चित्ते कुशलं पुत्र स्वाध्यायतपसोः सदा । नित्यमुग्रतपास्त्वं हि ततः पृच्छामि ते पुनः ॥
data.md: The Grandfather said Welcome are you, O you of mighty arms! By good luck I see you after such a long time before me. I hope, O son, that everything is right with your penances, and your Vedic studies and recitations. You always observe the austerest penances. hence I ask you about the progress and well-being of those penances of yours.

data.v: त्वत्प्रसादेन भगवन्स्वाध्यायतपसोर्मम । कुशलं चाव्ययं चैव सर्वस्य जगतस्तथा ॥
data.md: Rudra said O Illustrious One, through your grace, all is well with my penances and Vedic studies. It is all right, again, with universe.

data.v: चिरदृष्टो हि भगवान्वैराजसदने मया । ततोऽहं पर्वतं प्राप्तस्त्विमं त्वत्पादसेवितम् ॥
data.md: I saw your illustrious self a long while ago in your own home of happiness and effulgence! I am coming thence to this mountain that is not the habitation of your feet.

data.v: कौतूहलं चापि हि मे एकान्तगमनेन ते । नैतत्कारणमल्पं हि भविष्यति पितामह ॥
data.md: My mind is filled up with great curiosity for your thus coming into such a secluded mind from your usual religion of happiness and splendour. There must be great reason, O Grandfather, for such an act.

data.v: किं नु तत्सदनं श्रेष्ठं क्षुत्पिपासाविवर्जितम् । सुरासुरैरध्युषितमृषिभिश्चामितप्रभैः ॥
data.md: Your own foremost of abodes is free from the pains of hunger and thirst and inhabited by both gods and Asuras, by Rishis of great splendour, as also by Gandharvas and Apsaras. Leaving such a spot of happiness, you live alone in this foremost of mountains. The cause of this cannot but be weighty.

data.v: गन्धर्वैरप्सरोभिश्च सततं संनिषेवितम् । उत्सृज्येमं गिरिवरमेकाकी प्राप्तवानसि ॥
data.md: Your own foremost of abodes is free from the pains of hunger and thirst and inhabited by both gods and Asuras, by Rishis of great splendour, as also by Gandharvas and Apsaras. Leaving such a spot of happiness, you live alone in this foremost of mountains. The cause of this cannot but be weighty.

data.v: वैजयन्तो गिरिवरः सततं सेव्यते मया । अत्रैकाग्रेण मनसा पुरुषश्चिन्त्यते विराट् ॥
data.md: This foremost of mountains, called Vaijayanta, is always my abode. Here, with concentrated mind, I meditate on the one universal Soul of infinite proportions.

data.v: बहवः पुरुषा ब्रह्मंस्त्वया सृष्टाः स्वयंभुवा । सृज्यन्ते चापरे ब्रह्मन्स चैकः पुरुषो विराट् ॥
data.md: Rudra said Self-create you are. Many are the Souls that haven been created by you. Others again, O Brahman, are being created by you. The Infinite Soul, however, of whom you speak, is one and single.

data.v: को ह्यसौ चिन्त्यते ब्रह्मंस्त्वया वै पुरुषोत्तमः । एतन्मे संशयं ब्रूहि महत्कौतूहलं हि मे ॥
data.md: Who is that foremost of Souls, O Brahman, that is being meditated by you? Great is my curiosity about it. Do you kindly remove the doubt that has possessed my mind!

data.v: बहवः पुरुषाः पुत्र ये त्वया समुदाहृताः । एवमेतदतिक्रान्तं द्रष्टव्यं नैवमित्यपि । आधारं तु प्रवक्ष्यामि एकस्य पुरुषस्य ते ॥
data.md: Brahman said O son, many are those Souls of whom you speak. The one Soul, however, of whom I am thinking, transcends all Souls and is invisible.

data.v: बहूनां पुरुषाणां स यथैका योनिरुच्यते । तथा तं पुरुषं विश्वं परमं सुमहत्तमम् । निर्गुणं निर्गुणा भूत्वा प्रविशन्ति सनातनम् ॥
data.md: The many Souls that exist in the universe constitute the basis upon which that one Soul slands; and since that one Soul is said to be the source whence all the innumerable Purushas have originated, hence all the latter, if they succeed in divesting themselves of attributes, become competent to enter into that one Soul who is at one with the universe, who is supreme, who is the foremost of the foremost, who is eternal, and who is himself divested of and is above all qualities. 77977 Ryt fagd TH

data.v: शृणु पुत्र यथा ह्येष पुरुषः शाश्वतोऽव्ययः । अक्षयश्चाप्रमेयश्च सर्वगश्च निरुच्यते ॥
data.md: Brahman said Listen, O son, as to how that Soul is indicated. He is eternal and immutable. He is undecaying and immeasurable. He pervades all things.

data.v: न स शक्यस्त्वया द्रष्टुं मयान्यैर्वापि सत्तम । सगुणो निर्गुणो विश्वो ज्ञानदृश्यो ह्यसौ स्मृतः ॥
data.md: O best of all creatures, that soul cannot be seen by you or me, others. Those who are endued with the understanding and the senses but shorn of self-control and tranquillity of soul cannot see him. The Supreme Soul is said to be one that can be seen with the help of knowledge alone.

data.v: अशरीरः शरीरेषु सर्वेषु निवसत्यसौ । वसन्नपि शरीरेषु न स लिप्यति कर्मभिः ॥
data.md: Though shorn of body, He lives in every body. Though living, again, in bodies He is never touched by the acts done by those bodies.

data.v: ममान्तरात्मा तव च ये चान्ये देहसंज्ञिताः । सर्वेषां साक्षिभूतोऽसौ न ग्राह्यः केनचित्क्वचित् ॥
data.md: He is my inner soul. He is your inner soul. He is the omniscient Witness living within all embodied creatures and engaged in marking their acts. No one can grasp or comprehend him at any time.

data.v: विश्वमूर्धा विश्वभुजो विश्वपादाक्षिनासिकः । एकश्चरति क्षेत्रेषु स्वैरचारी यथासुखम् ॥
data.md: The universe is the crown of his head. The universe is his arms. The universe is his feet. The universe is his eyes. The universe is his nose. Alone and singly, he passed through all bodies, unrestrained by any limitations on his will and as best as it likes him.

data.v: क्षेत्राणि हि शरीराणि बीजानि च शुभाशुभे । तानि वेत्ति स योगात्मा ततः क्षेत्रज्ञ उच्यते ॥
data.md: Kshetriya is another name for body. And because he knows all bodies as also all good and bad acts, therefore, he, who is the soul of Yoga, is called by the name of Kshetrajna.

data.v: नागतिर्न गतिस्तस्य ज्ञेया भूतेन केनचित् । सांख्येन विधिना चैव योगेन च यथाक्रमम् ॥
चिन्तयामि गतिं चास्य न गतिं वेद्मि चोत्तमाम् । यथाज्ञानं तु वक्ष्यामि पुरुषं तं सनातनम् ॥
तस्यैकत्वं महत्त्वं हि स चैकः पुरुषः स्मृतः । महापुरुषशब्दं स बिभर्त्येकः सनातनः ॥
एको हुताशो बहुधा समिध्यते; एकः सूर्यस्तपसां योनिरेका । एको वायुर्बहुधा वाति लोके; महोदधिश्चाम्भसां योनिरेकः । पुरुषश्चैको निर्गुणो विश्वरूप;स्तं निर्गुणं पुरुषं चाविशन्ति ॥
data.md: Fire is an element, but it may be seen to burn up in a thousand places under thousand different circumstances. The Sun is one and single, but his rays extend over the wide universe. Penances are of various kinds, but they have one common origin whence they have originated. The Wind is one, but it blows in various forms in the world. The great Ocean is the one parent of all the waters in the world seen under various circumstances. Shorn of qualities, that one Soul is the universe shown in infinitude. Originating from him, the infinite universe enters into that one Soul again who is above all qualities, when the time for its destruction comes.

data.v: हित्वा गुणमयं सर्वं कर्म हित्वा शुभाशुभम् । उभे सत्यानृते त्यक्त्वा एवं भवति निर्गुणः ॥
data.md: By renouncing the consciousness of body and the senses, by renouncing all acts good and bad, by renouncing both truth and falsehood, one succeeds in divesting oneself of qualities.

data.v: अचिन्त्यं चापि तं ज्ञात्वा भावसूक्ष्मं चतुष्टयम् । विचरेद्यो यतिर्यत्तः स गच्छेत्पुरुषं प्रभुम् ॥
data.md: The person who realises that inconceivable Soul and comprehends his subtile existence in the four-fold of Aniruddha, Pradyumna, Sankarshana, and Vasudeva, and who, on account of such comprehension, acquires perfect tranquillity of heart, succeeds in entering into, and identifying himself with, that one auspicious Soul.

data.v: एवं हि परमात्मानं केचिदिच्छन्ति पण्डिताः । एकात्मानं तथात्मानमपरेऽध्यात्मचिन्तकाः ॥
data.md: Some persons endued with learning speak of Him as the Supreme Soul. Others hold Him as the One Soul. A third class of learned men describe Him as the Soul.

data.v: तत्र यः परमात्मा हि स नित्यं निर्गुणः स्मृतः । स हि नारायणो ज्ञेयः सर्वात्मा पुरुषो हि सः । न लिप्यते फलैश्चापि पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा ॥
data.md: The truth is that He who is the Supreme Soul is always shorn of qualities. He is Narayana. He is the Universal Soul, and He is the One Purusha. He is never affected by the fruits of deeds as the leaf of the lotus is never drenched by the water one may throw upon it.

data.v: कर्मात्मा त्वपरो योऽसौ मोक्षबन्धैः स युज्यते । ससप्तदशकेनापि राशिना युज्यते हि सः । एवं बहुविधः प्रोक्तः पुरुषस्ते यथाक्रमम् ॥
data.md: The acting Soul is endued with the seventeen possessions. Thus is it said that there are innumerable kinds of Souls in due order.

data.v: यत्तत्कृत्स्नं लोकतन्त्रस्य धाम; वेद्यं परं बोधनीयं सबोद्धृ । मन्ता मन्तव्यं प्राशिता प्राशितव्यं; घ्राता घ्रेयं स्पर्शिता स्पर्शनीयम् ॥
data.md: In sooth, however, there is but one Soul. He is the abode of all the ordinances in the universe. He is the highest object of knowledge. He is at once the knower and the object to be known. He is at once the thinker and the object of thought. He is the eater and the food that is eaten. He is the smeller and the scent that is smelled. He is at once he that touches and the object that is touched.

data.v: द्रष्टा द्रष्टव्यं श्राविता श्रावणीयं; ज्ञाता ज्ञेयं सगुणं निर्गुणं च । यद्वै प्रोक्तं गुणसाम्यं प्रधानं; नित्यं चैतच्छाश्वतं चाव्ययं च ॥
data.md: He is the agent that sees and the object that is seen. He is the hearer and the object that is heard. He is the conceiver and the object conceived. He is possessed of qualities and is free from them. He is that, O son, which is named Pradhana (Nature), enduring, eternal, and immutable.

data.v: यद्वै सूते धातुराद्यं निधानं; तद्वै विप्राः प्रवदन्तेऽनिरुद्धम् । यद्वै लोके वैदिकं कर्म साधु; आशीर्युक्तं तद्धि तस्योपभोज्यम् ॥
data.md: He it is who creates the prime ordinance about Dhatri himself. Learned Brahmanas call Him by the name of Aniruddha. Whatever acts of excellent merits and blessings, originate in the world from the Vedas, have been caused by Him.

data.v: देवाः सर्वे मुनयः साधु दान्ता;स्तं प्राग्यज्ञैर्यज्ञभागं यजन्ते । अहं ब्रह्मा आद्य ईशः प्रजानां; तस्माज्जातस्त्वं च मत्तः प्रसूतः । मत्तो जगज्जङ्गमं स्थावरं च; सर्वे वेदाः सरहस्या हि पुत्र ॥
data.md: All the gods, and all the Rishis, gifted with tranquil souls, occupying their places on the altar, dedicate to Him the first share of their sacrificial offerings. I that am Brahman, the primeval master of all creatures, have come into being from Him, and you have sprung from me. From me has originated the universe with all its mobile and immobile creatures, and all the Vedas, O son, with their mysteries.

data.v: चतुर्विभक्तः पुरुषः स क्रीडति यथेच्छति । एवं स एव भगवाञ्ज्ञानेन प्रतिबोधितः ॥
data.md: Divided into four parts, (viz., Aniruddha, Pradyumna, Sankarshana, and Vasudeva), He sports as He pleases. That illustrious and divine Lord is such, awakened by His Own knowledge.

data.v: एतत्ते कथितं पुत्र यथावदनुपृच्छतः । सांख्यज्ञाने तथा योगे यथावदनुवर्णितम् ॥
data.md: I have thus answered you, O son, according to your questions, and according to the way in which the matter is explained in the Sankhya System and the Yoga Philosophy."

data.v: धर्माः पितामहेनोक्ता मोक्षधर्माश्रिताः शुभाः । धर्ममाश्रमिणां श्रेष्ठं वक्तुमर्हति मे भवान् ॥
data.md: Yudhishthira said You have, O grandfather, described to us the duties belonging to the Religion of Liberation. You should now tell us what the foremost duties are of persons belonging to the several modes of life.

data.v: सर्वत्र विहितो धर्मः स्वर्ग्यः सत्यफलोदयः । बहुद्वारस्य धर्मस्य नेहास्ति विफला क्रिया ॥
data.md: Bhishma said “The duties ordained with regard to every mode of life are capable, if well performed, of leading to heaven and the high fruit of Truth. Duties have many doors, and none of the practices enjoined by them fails to produce the desired effect.

data.v: यस्मिन्यस्मिंस्तु विषये यो यो याति विनिश्चयम् । स तमेवाभिजानाति नान्यं भरतसत्तम ॥
data.md: Whoever adopts a class of duties with steady and firm faith, praises the duties adopted by him to the exclusion of the rest, О chief of Bharata's race.

data.v: अपि च त्वं नरव्याघ्र श्रोतुमर्हसि मे कथाम् । पुरा शक्रस्य कथितां नारदेन सुरर्षिणा ॥
data.md: This particular subject, however, which you wish me to describe was in days of yore the subject of conversation between the celestial Rishi Narada and the king of the gods, viz., Indra.

data.v: सुरर्षिर्नारदो राजन्सिद्धस्त्रैलोक्यसंमतः । पर्येति क्रमशो लोकान्वायुरव्याहतो यथा ॥
data.md: The great Rishi Narada, O king, adored of all the world, has been crowned with success. He wanders through all the worlds unimpeded, like the all-pervading wind itself.

data.v: स कदाचिन्महेष्वास देवराजालयं गतः । सत्कृतश्च महेन्द्रेण प्रत्यासन्नगतोऽभवत् ॥
data.md: Once upon a time he went to the abode of Indra. Duly honoured by the king of the gods, he sat close to his host.

data.v: तं कृतक्षणमासीनं पर्यपृच्छच्छचीपतिः । ब्रह्मर्षे किंचिदाश्चर्यमस्ति दृष्टं त्वयानघ ॥
data.md: Seeing him seated at his ease and free from exhaustion, the husband of Shachi addressed him, saying,-O great Rishi, is there any thing wonderful that has been seen by you, O sinless one?

data.v: यथा त्वमपि विप्रर्षे त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् । जातकौतूहलो नित्यं सिद्धश्चरसि साक्षिवत् ॥
data.md: O twice-born Rishi, crowned with ascetic success, you walk about moved by curiosity, through the universe of mobile and immobile objects, seeing all things.

data.v: न ह्यस्त्यविदितं लोके देवर्षे तव किंचन । श्रुतं वाप्यनुभूतं वा दृष्टं वा कथयस्व मे ॥
data.md: O celestial Rishi, there is nothing in the universe which you do not know. Do you tell me, therefore, of any wonderful event which you may have seen, or heard of, or felt.

data.v: तस्मै राजन्सुरेन्द्राय नारदो वदतां वरः । आसीनायोपपन्नाय प्रोक्तवान्विपुलां कथाम् ॥
data.md: Thus questioned, Narada, that foremost of speakers, O king, then began to recite to the king of the gods the extensive history that follows.

data.v: यथा येन च कल्पेन स तस्मै द्विजसत्तमः । कथां कथितवान्पृष्टस्तथा त्वमपि मे शृणु ॥
data.md: Listen now to me as I recount that story which Narada told before Indra. I shall describe it in the same way in which the celestial Rishi had described it, and for the same purpose that he had in view.”

data.v: आसीत्किल कुरुश्रेष्ठ महापद्मे पुरोत्तमे । गङ्गाया दक्षिणे तीरे कश्चिद्विप्रः समाहितः ॥
data.md: Bhishma said "In a beautiful town called by the name of Mahapadma which was situate on the southern side of the river Ganga, there lived, O best of men, a Brahmana of concentrated Soul.

data.v: सौम्यः सोमान्वये वेदे गताध्वा छिन्नसंशयः । धर्मनित्यो जितक्रोधो नित्यतृप्तो जितेन्द्रियः ॥
data.md: Born in the family of Atri, he was amiable by nature. All his doubts had been removed and he was well conversant with the path he was to follow. Ever practising the duties of religion, he had a complete hold over his passion. Always contented, he was the perfect master of his senses.

data.v: अहिंसानिरतो नित्यं सत्यः सज्जनसंमतः । न्यायप्राप्तेन वित्तेन स्वेन शीलेन चान्वितः ॥
data.md: Given to penances and the study of the Vedas, he was respected by all good men. He acquired riches by fair means and his conduct in all things tallied with the mode of life he led and the order to which he belonged.

data.v: ज्ञातिसंबन्धिविपुले मित्रापाश्रयसंमते । कुले महति विख्याते विशिष्टां वृत्तिमास्थितः ॥
data.md: The family to which the belonging was large and famous. He had many kinsmen and relatives, and many children and wives. His conduct was always respectable and faultless.

data.v: स पुत्रान्बहुलान्दृष्ट्वा विपुले कर्मणि स्थितः । कुलधर्माश्रितो राजन्धर्मचर्यापरोऽभवत् ॥
data.md: Observing that he had many children, the Brahmana began to perform religious acts on a large scale. His religious observances, O king, were according to the customs of his own family.

data.v: ततः स धर्मं वेदोक्तं यथाशास्त्रोक्तमेव च । शिष्टाचीर्णं च धर्मं च त्रिविधं चिन्त्य चेतसा ॥
data.md: The Brahmana thought that there were three kinds of duties laid down for observances. There were, first, the duties ordained in the Vedas about the order in which he was born and the mode of life he was leading. There were, secondly, the duties sanctioned in the scriptures, viz., those especially called the Dharmashastras. And, thirdly, there were those duties that eminent and revered men of ancient times have followed, through not laid down either in the Vedas or the Scriptures.

data.v: किं नु मे स्याच्छुभं कृत्वा किं क्षमं किं परायणम् । इत्येवं खिद्यते नित्यं न च याति विनिश्चयम् ॥
data.md: Which of these duties should I follow? Which of thein, again, followed by me, are likely to produce my benefit? Which, indeed, should be my refuge? Thoughts like these always troubled him. He could not solve his doubts.

data.v: तस्यैवं खिद्यमानस्य धर्मं परममास्थितः । कदाचिदतिथिः प्राप्तो ब्राह्मणः सुसमाहितः ॥
data.md: While troubled with such thoughts, a Brahmana of concentrated soul and observant of every superior religion, came to his house as a guest.

data.v: स तस्मै सत्क्रियां चक्रे क्रियायुक्तेन हेतुना । विश्रान्तं चैनमासीनमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥
data.md: The house-holder duly respected his guest according to those ordinances of worship that are laid down in the scriptures. Seeing his guest refreshed and seated at ease, the host addressed him in the following words.

data.v: समुत्पन्नाभिधानोऽस्मि वाङ्माधुर्येण तेऽनघ । मित्रतामभिपन्नस्त्वां किंचिद्वक्ष्यामि तच्छृणु ॥
data.md: The Brahmana said Osinless One, I have become greatly attached to you on account of the sweetness of your conversation. You have become my friend. Listen to me, for I wish to say something to you.

data.v: गृहस्थधर्मं विप्रेन्द्र कृत्वा पुत्रगतं त्वहम् । धर्मं परमकं कुर्यां को हि मार्गो भवेद्द्विज ॥
