data.v: साङ्गांश्च चतुरो वेदान्योऽधीयीत द्विजर्षभः । षड्भ्यो निवृत्तः कर्मभ्यस्तं पात्रमृषयो विदुः ॥
data.md: The Rishis have declared that Brahmana to be a deserving object of gifts who studies the four Vedas with all their auxiliaries and is devoted to the six well known duties. One acquires great merit by making gifts to Brahmanas endued with such qualifications.

data.v: ये त्वेवंगुणजातीयास्तेभ्यो दत्तं महाफलम् । सहस्रगुणमाप्नोति गुणार्हाय प्रदायकः ॥
data.md: The man who makes gifts to a worthy Brahmana multiplies his merit a thousand fold. A single pious Brahmana gifted with wisdom and Vedic lore, observant of the duties laid down in the scriptures, and marked out by purity of conduct is capablu to rescue a whole family.

data.v: प्रज्ञाश्रुताभ्यां वृत्तेन शीलेन च समन्वितः । तारयेत कुलं कृत्स्नमेकोऽपीह द्विजर्षभः ॥
data.md: One should make gifts of kine and horses and riches and food and other kinds of articles to Brahmana who is gifted with such qualifications. By making such gifts to such persons one acquires great happiness in the next world.

data.v: गामश्वं वित्तमन्नं वा तद्विधे प्रतिपादयेत् । द्रव्याणि चान्यानि तथा प्रेत्यभावे न शोचति ॥
data.md: One should make gifts of kine and horses and riches and food and other kinds of articles to Brahmana who is gifted with such qualifications. By making such gifts to such persons one acquires great happiness in the next world.

data.v: तारयेत कुलं कृत्स्नमेकोऽपीह द्विजोत्तमः । किमङ्ग पुनरेकं वै तस्मात्पात्रं समाचरेत् ॥
data.md: As I have already told you, even one such Brahman can save the entire family to which the giver belongs. What need I say, therefore, O dear son of the merit of making gifts to many Brahmanas of such qualifications? In making gifts, thercfore, one should always select the object to whom the gift is to be made.

data.v: निशम्य च गुणोपेतं ब्राह्मणं साधुसंमतम् । दूरादानाययेत्कृत्ये सर्वतश्चाभिपूजयेत् ॥
data.md: Hearing of a Brahmana gifted with proper qualifications and respected by all good people, one should invite him even if he lives at a distance and welcoming him when he arrives one should adore him by all means in his power.

data.v: श्राद्धकाले च दैवे च धर्मे चापि पितामह । इच्छामीह त्वयाख्यातं विहितं यत्सुरर्षिभिः ॥
data.md: Yudhishthira said I wish you, O grandfather to tell me what the ordinances about the rites for the deities and the departed manes on occasions of Shraddhas.

data.v: दैवं पूर्वाह्णिके कुर्यादपराह्णे तु पैतृकम् । मङ्गलाचारसंपन्नः कृतशौचः प्रयत्नवान् ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Having purified oneself and then performed the well known auspicious rites, one should carefully perform all acts relating to the Pitris in the afternoon.

data.v: मनुष्याणां तु मध्याह्ने प्रदद्यादुपपत्तितः । कालहीनं तु यद्दानं तं भागं रक्षसां विदुः ॥
data.md: What is given to men should be given in the midday with love and regard. That gifts which is made untimely is taken by Rakshasas.

data.v: लङ्घितं चावलीढं च कलिपूर्वं च यत्कृतम् । रजस्वलाभिर्दृष्टं च तं भागं रक्षसां विदुः ॥
data.md: Gifts of articles that have been leapt over by any one, or been licked or sucked, or are not given peacefully, or have been seen by women who are impure for being in their season do not produce any merit. Such gifts are considered as the portions of Rakshasas.

data.v: अवघुष्टं च यद्भुक्तमव्रतेन च भारत । परामृष्टं शुना चैव तं भागं रक्षसां विदुः ॥
data.md: Gifts of articles that have been announced before many people or from which a part has been eaten by a Shudra or, that have been seen or licked by a dog, form portions of Rakshasas.

data.v: केशकीटावपतितं क्षुतं श्वभिरवेक्षितम् । रुदितं चावधूतं च तं भागं रक्षसां विदुः ॥
data.md: Food which is mixed with hair or in which there are worms, or which has been spoiled with spittle or saliva or which has been looked at by a dog or into which teardrops have fallen or which has been trodden upon, should be known as forming the part of Rakshasas.

data.v: निरोंकारेण यद्भुक्तं सशस्त्रेण च भारत । दुरात्मना च यद्भुक्तं तं भागं रक्षसां विदुः ॥
data.md: Food that has been eaten by a person incompetent to utter the syllable Om, or that has been eaten by a person bearing arms, O Bharata, or that has been caten by a wicked person, should be known as due to Rakshasas.

data.v: परोच्छिष्टं च यद्भुक्तं परिभुक्तं च यद्भवेत् । दैवे पित्र्ये च सततं तं भागं रक्षसां विदुः ॥
data.md: The food that is caten by a person from which a part has already been extent by another, or which is eaten without a part thereof having been offered to gods and guests and children, is appropriated by Rakshasas. Such impure food, if offered to the deities and Pitris is never accepted by them but is appropriated by Rakshasas.

data.v: गर्हितं निन्दितं चैव परिविष्टं समन्युना । दैवं वाप्यथ वा पैत्र्यं तं भागं रक्षसां विदुः ॥
मन्त्रहीनं क्रियाहीनं यच्छ्राद्धं परिविष्यते । त्रिभिर्वर्णैर्नरश्रेष्ठ तं भागं रक्षसां विदुः ॥
data.md: The food that is offered by the three twice born classes in Shraddhas in which Mantras are either not uttered or uttered incorrectly and in which the ordinances laid down in the scriptures are not duly performed, if given to guests and other people, is appropriated by Rakshasas.

data.v: आज्याहुतिं विना चैव यत्किंचित्परिविष्यते । दुराचारैश्च यद्भुक्तं तं भागं रक्षसां विदुः ॥
data.md: The food that is given to guests without having been previously dedicated to the deities or the Pitris with the help of libations on the sacred fire, or which has been sullied on account of a part thereof having been eaten by a person who is wicked or of irreligious conduct, should be known as being due to Rakshasas.

data.v: ये भागा रक्षसां प्रोक्तास्त उक्ता भरतर्षभ । अत ऊर्ध्वं विसर्गस्य परीक्षां ब्राह्मणे शृणु ॥
data.md: I have described to you the dues of the Rakshasas. Listen now to me as I put down the rules for determining the Brahmana who is worthy of gifts.

data.v: यावन्तः पतिता विप्रा जडोन्मत्तास्तथैव च । दैवे वाप्यथ वा पित्र्ये राजन्नार्हन्ति केतनम् ॥
data.md: All Brahmanas that have been outcasted, as also Brahmanas who are idiots and insane, do not deserve to be invited to Shraddhas in which offerings are made to either the deities or the departed manes.

data.v: श्वित्री कुष्ठी च क्लीबश्च तथा यक्ष्महतश्च यः । अपस्मारी च यश्चान्धो राजन्नार्हन्ति सत्कृतिम् ॥
data.md: That Brahmanas who is afflicted with leucoderina, or he who is shorn of generative power, or he who has got leprosy, or he who has got phthisis, or he who suffers from epilepsy, or he who is blind, should not O king, be invited.

data.v: चिकित्सका देवलका वृथानियमधारिणः । सोमविक्रयिणश्चैव श्राद्धे नार्हन्ति केतनम् ॥
data.md: Those Brahinana who practise as physicians, those who get regular pay for adoring the images of gods established by the rich or live upon the service of the gods, those who observe vows from pride or other false motives and those who sell Soma wine, do not deserve to be invited.

data.v: गायना नर्तकाश्चैव प्लवका वादकास्तथा । कथका योधकाश्चैव राजन्नार्हन्ति केतनम् ॥
data.md: Those Brahmanas who are by profession, vocalists, or dancers or players or instrumental musicians, or reciters of sacred books, or warriors and athletes, should not, O king be invited.

data.v: होतारो वृषलानां च वृषलाध्यापकास्तथा । तथा वृषलशिष्याश्च राजन्नार्हन्ति केतनम् ॥
data.md: Those Brahmanas who pour libations on the sacred fire for Shudras or who are preceptors of Shudras, or who are servant of Shudra masters, should not be invited.

data.v: अनुयोक्ता च यो विप्रो अनुयुक्तश्च भारत । नार्हतस्तावपि श्राद्धं ब्रह्मविक्रयिणौ हि तौ ॥
data.md: That Brahmana who is paid for his services as a preceptor or who attends as a pupil upon the lectures of some preceptor for an allowance paid to him, does not deserve to be invited, for both of thein are considered as sellers of Vedic learning.

data.v: अग्रणीर्यः कृतः पूर्वं वर्णावरपरिग्रहः । ब्राह्मणः सर्वविद्योऽपि राजन्नार्हति केतनम् ॥
data.md: That Brahmana who has been once induced to accept the gift of food in a Shraddha at the very beginning, as also he who has married a Shudra wife, even if gifted with every sort of knowledge, should not be invited.

data.v: अनग्नयश्च ये विप्रा मृतनिर्यातकाश्च ये । स्तेनाश्च पतिताश्चैव राजन्नार्हन्ति केतनम् ॥
data.md: Those Brahmanas who have no domestic fire, and they who attend upon corpses, they who are thieves, and they who have otherwise degraded themselves, do not o king, deserve to be invited.

data.v: अपरिज्ञातपूर्वाश्च गणपूर्वाश्च भारत । पुत्रिकापूर्वपुत्राश्च श्राद्धे नार्हन्ति केतनम् ॥
data.md: Those Brahmanas whose antecedents are not known or are vile, and they who are Putrika-putras, should not, O king, be invited on occasions of Shraddhas.

data.v: ऋणकर्ता च यो राजन्यश्च वार्धुषिको द्विजः । प्राणिविक्रयवृत्तिश्च राजन्नार्हन्ति केतनम् ॥
data.md: That Brahmana who gives loans of money, or he who lives upon the interest of the loans given by him, or he who lives by the sale of living creatures, should not, O king, be invited.

data.v: स्त्रीपूर्वाः काण्डपृष्ठाश्च यावन्तो भरतर्षभ । अजपा ब्राह्मणाश्चैव श्राद्धे नार्हन्ति केतनम् ॥
data.md: Persons who are henpecked or they who live by becoming the paramours of unchaste women, or they who do not perform their morning and evening prayers, should not, O king, be invited to Shraddhas.

data.v: श्राद्धे दैवे च निर्दिष्टा ब्राह्मणा भरतर्षभ । दातुः प्रतिग्रहीतुश्च शृणुष्वानुग्रहं पुनः ॥
data.md: Listen now to me as I say who the Brahmava is who has been ordained for acts done in honour of the gods and the departed manes. Indeed, I shall tell you what those merits are on account of which one may become a giver or a recipient of gifts in Shraddhas.

data.v: चीर्णव्रता गुणैर्युक्ता भवेयुर्येऽपि कर्षकाः । सावित्रीज्ञाः क्रियावन्तस्ते राजन्केतनक्षमाः ॥
data.md: Those Brahmanas who perform the rites and ceremonies laid down in the scriptures, or they who are possessed of merit, or they who know well the Gayatri, or they who perform the ordinary duties of Brahmanas, even if they happen to take lo agriculture for a living, are capable, O king, of being invited to Shraddhas.

data.v: क्षात्रधर्मिणमप्याजौ केतयेत्कुलजं द्विजम् । न त्वेव वणिजं तात श्राद्धेषु परिकल्पयेत् ॥
data.md: If a Brahmana happens to be well born, he should be invited to Shraddhas notwithstanding his taking up arms for fighting the battles of others. That Brahmana however O son, who happens lo drive a trade for a living should be discarded.

data.v: अग्निहोत्री च यो विप्रो ग्रामवासी च यो भवेत् । अस्तेनश्चातिथिज्ञश्च स राजन्केतनक्षमः ॥
data.md: That Brahmana who pours libations every day on the sacred fire, or who lives in a fixed habitation, who is not a thief and who performs the duties of hospitality to guests arrived at his house, should O king, be invited to Shraddhas.

data.v: सावित्रीं जपते यस्तु त्रिकालं भरतर्षभ । भिक्षावृत्तिः क्रियावांश्च स राजन्केतनक्षमः ॥
data.md: That Brahmana, O chief of Bharata's race, who recites the Savitri morning, noon and night or who lives upon charity begging as much as is necessary, who is observant of the rites and ceremonies laid down in the scriptures for persons of his order, should, O king, be invited to Shraddhas.

data.v: उदितास्तमितो यश्च तथैवास्तमितोदितः । अहिंस्रश्चाल्पदोषश्च स राजन्केतनक्षमः ॥
data.md: That Brahmana who having acquired riches in the morning becomes poor in the afternoon, or who poor in the morning becomes rich in the evening, or who is shorn of inalice or is stained by a minor faulty should, O king, be invited to Shraddhas.

data.v: अकल्कको ह्यतर्कश्च ब्राह्मणो भरतर्षभ । ससंज्ञो भैक्ष्यवृत्तिश्च स राजन्केतनक्षमः ॥
data.md: That Brahmana who is shorn of pride or sin, who is not given to dry disputation, or who lives upon alms got in his rounds of mendicancy from house to house; should, O king, be invited to sacrifices.

data.v: अव्रती कितवः स्तेनः प्राणिविक्रय्यथो वणिक् । पश्चाच्च पीतवान्सोमं स राजन्केतनक्षमः ॥
data.md: One who does not observe vows or who is given to untruth, who is a theif, or who lives by the sale of living creatures or by trade in general, should be invited to Shraddhas, ) king, if he happen to subsequently drink Soma in a sacrifice.

data.v: अर्जयित्वा धनं पूर्वं दारुणैः कृषिकर्मभिः । भवेत्सर्वातिथिः पश्चात्स राजन्केतनक्षमः ॥
data.md: That man who having acquired riches by foul or cruel means subsequently spends it in worshipping the gods and performing the duties of hospitality, becomes worthy, O king, of being invited to Shraddhas.

data.v: ब्रह्मविक्रयनिर्दिष्टं स्त्रिया यच्चार्जितं धनम् । अदेयं पितृदेवेभ्यो यच्च क्लैब्यादुपार्जितम् ॥
data.md: The riches that one has acquired by the sale of Vedic learning, or which has been acquired by a woman, or which has been gamed by meanness, should never be given to Brahmanas or spent in making offerings to the departed manes.

data.v: क्रियमाणेऽपवर्गे तु यो द्विजो भरतर्षभ । न व्याहरति यद्युक्तं तस्याधर्मो गवानृतम् ॥
data.md: That Brahmana, O chief of Bharata's race, who upon the completion of a Shraddha that is performed with his help, refuses to utter the words yukta, commits the sin of swearing falsely in a suit for land.

data.v: श्राद्धस्य ब्राह्मणः कालः प्राप्तं दधि घृतं तथा । सोमक्षयश्च मांसं च यदारण्यं युधिष्ठिर ॥
data.md: The time for celebrating the Shraddha, O Yudhishthira, is that when one gets a good Brahmana and curds and clarified butter and the sacred day of the new moon and the meat of wild animals such as deer and others.

data.v: श्राद्धापवर्गे विप्रस्य स्वधा वै स्वदिता भवेत् । क्षत्रियस्याप्यथो ब्रूयात्प्रीयन्तां पितरस्त्विति ॥
data.md: Upon the termination of a Shraddha performed by a Brahmana the word Svadha should be uttered. If performed by a Kshatriya the words that should be uttered are Let your departed manes be pleased.

data.v: अपवर्गे तु वैश्यस्य श्राद्धकर्मणि भारत । अक्षय्यमभिधातव्यं स्वस्ति शूद्रस्य भारत ॥
पुण्याहवाचनं दैवे ब्राह्मणस्य विधीयते । एतदेव निरोंकारं क्षत्रियस्य विधीयते । वैश्यस्य चैव वक्तव्यं प्रीयन्तां देवता इति ॥
कर्मणामानुपूर्वीं च विधिपूर्वकृतं शृणु । जातकर्मादिकान्सर्वांस्त्रिषु वर्णेषु भारत । ब्रह्मक्षत्रे हि मन्त्रोक्ता वैश्यस्य च युधिष्ठिर ॥
data.md: All the rites consequent upon birth, O Bharata, are necessary in the case of all the three castes. All these rites, O Yudhishthira, in the case of both Brahmanas and Kshatriyas as also in that of Vaishyas, are to be performed with the help of Mantras.

data.v: विप्रस्य रशना मौञ्जी मौर्वी राजन्यगामिनी । बाल्वजीत्येव वैश्यस्य धर्म एष युधिष्ठिर ॥
data.md: The girdle of Brahmana should be made of Munja grass. That of a Kshatriya should be a bowstring. The Vaishya's girdle should be made of the Valvaji grass. This has been laid down in the scriptures.

data.v: दातुः प्रतिग्रहीतुश्च धर्माधर्माविमौ शृणु । ब्राह्मणस्यानृतेऽधर्मः प्रोक्तः पातकसंज्ञितः । चतुर्गुणः क्षत्रियस्य वैश्यस्याष्टगुणः स्मृतः ॥
data.md: Listen now to me as I explain to you what forms the merits and demerits of both givers and recipients of gifts. A Brahmana violates his duty by uttering an untruth. Such an act on his part is sinful. A Kshatriya perpetrates four fold and a Vaishya eightfold the sin that a Brahmana incurs by uttering an untruth.

data.v: नान्यत्र ब्राह्मणोऽश्नीयात्पूर्वं विप्रेण केतितः । यवीयान्पशुहिंसायां तुल्यधर्मो भवेत्स हि ॥
data.md: A Brahmana should not eat elsewhere, having been previously invited by a Brahmana. By eating at the house of the person by whom he has been invited afterwards, he becomes inferior and even incurs the sin of the slaughter of an animal on occasions other than those of sacrifices.

data.v: अथ राजन्यवैश्याभ्यां यद्यश्नीयात्तु केतितः । यवीयान्पशुहिंसायां भागार्धं समवाप्नुयात् ॥
data.md: So also, if he eats elsewhere after having been invited by a Kshatriya or a Vaishya, he falls away from his position and incurs half the sin of the slaughter of an animal on occasion other than those of sacrifices.

data.v: दैवं वाप्यथ वा पित्र्यं योऽश्नीयाद्ब्राह्मणादिषु । अस्नातो ब्राह्मणो राजंस्तस्याधर्मो गवानृतम् ॥
data.md: That Brahmana, O king, who eats on occasions of such acts as are performed in honour of the gods or the departed manes by Brahmanas and Kshatriyas and Vaishyas, without having performed his ablutions, commits the sin of uttering an untruth for a COW.

data.v: आशौचो ब्राह्मणो राजन्योऽश्नीयाद्ब्राह्मणादिषु । ज्ञानपूर्वमथो लोभात्तस्याधर्मो गवानृतम् ॥
data.md: That Brahmana, O king, who eats on occasions of similar acts performed by persons belonging to three higher castes, at a time when he is impure on account of either a birth or a death among his cognates, and knowing that he is impure or through temptation, commits the same sin.

data.v: अन्नेनान्नं च यो लिप्सेत्कर्मार्थं चैव भारत । आमन्त्रयति राजेन्द्र तस्याधर्मोऽनृतं स्मृतम् ॥
data.md: He who lives upon riches acquired under false pretences like that of sojourns to sacred places or who begs the giver for riches pretending that he would spend it in religious acts, commits, O king, the sin of uttering an untruth,

data.v: अवेदव्रतचारित्रास्त्रिभिर्वर्णैर्युधिष्ठिर । मन्त्रवत्परिविष्यन्ते तेष्वधर्मो गवानृतम् ॥
data.md: That person, belonging to any of the three higher castes, O Yudhishthira, Yudhishthira, who at Shraddhas and on other occasions distributes food with the help of Mantras, to such Brahmanas as do not study the Vedas or who do not observe vows or who have not purified their conduct, forsooth, commits sin.

data.v: पित्र्यं वाप्यथ वा दैवं दीयते यत्पितामह । एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं दत्तं येषु महाफलम् ॥
data.md: Yudhishthira said I wish O grandfather, to know who those persons are by giving to whom the things dedicated to the gods and the departed manes, one may acquire sufficient rewards.

data.v: येषां दाराः प्रतीक्षन्ते सुवृष्टिमिव कर्षकाः । उच्छेषपरिशेषं हि तान्भोजय युधिष्ठिर ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Do you, O Yudhishthira, feed those Brahmanas whose wives respectfully wait for the residue of the dishes of their husbands like tillers of the soil waiting respectfully for timely showers of rain.

data.v: चारित्रनियता राजन्ये कृशाः कृशवृत्तयः । अर्थिनश्चोपगच्छन्ति तेषु दत्तं महाफलम् ॥
data.md: By making gifts to those Brahmanas who are always of pure conduct, О king, who are liberated by abstaining from all luxuries and even full meals who are given to the observance of such vows as lead to the emaciation of the body, and who approach givers with the object of getting gifts, one acquires great merit.

data.v: तद्भक्तास्तद्गृहा राजंस्तद्धनास्तदपाश्रयाः । अर्थिनश्च भवन्त्यर्थे तेषु दत्तं महाफलम् ॥
data.md: By making gifts to Brahmanas who considers conduct in the light of food, who considers conduct in the light of wives and children, who considers conduct in the light of strength, who considers conduct in the light of their refuge for crossing this world and acquiring happiness in the next, and who beg for riches only when wealth is absolutely needed, one acquires great merit.

data.v: तस्करेभ्यः परेभ्यो वा ये भयार्ता युधिष्ठिर । अर्थिनो भोक्तुमिच्छन्ति तेषु दत्तं महाफलम् ॥
data.md: By making gifts to those persons, O Yudhishthira, who having lost everything through thieves or oppressors, approach the giver one gains great merit.

data.v: अकल्ककस्य विप्रस्य भैक्षोत्करकृतात्मनः । बटवो यस्य भिक्षन्ति तेभ्यो दत्तं महाफलम् ॥
data.md: By making gifts to such Brahmanas as beg food from the hands of even a poor person of their caste who has just got something from others, one acquires great merit.

data.v: हृतस्वा हृतदाराश्च ये विप्रा देशसंप्लवे । अर्थार्थमभिगच्छन्ति तेभ्यो दत्तं महाफलम् ॥
data.md: By making gifts to such Brahmanas as have lost everything in times of universal distress and as have been deprived of their wives on such occasions, and as come to givers with solicitations for alms one acquires great merit.

data.v: व्रतिनो नियमस्थाश्च ये विप्राः श्रुतसंमताः । तत्समाप्त्यर्थमिच्छन्ति तेषु दत्तं महाफलम् ॥
data.md: By making gifts to such Brahmanas as observe vows and as place themselves voluntarily under painful rules and regulations, according to the Vedic injunctions, and as come to solicit riches for spending it upon the rites necessary to complete their vows and other observances one acquires great merit.

data.v: अव्युत्क्रान्ताश्च धर्मेषु पाषण्डसमयेषु च । कृशप्राणाः कृशधनास्तेषु दत्तं महाफलम् ॥
data.md: By making gifts to such Brahmanas as live at a great distance from the practices followed by the sinful and the wicked, as are shorn of strength for want of adequate support, and as are very poor in earthly possessions, one acquires great merit.

data.v: कृतसर्वस्वहरणा निर्दोषाः प्रभविष्णुभिः । स्पृहयन्ति च भुक्तान्नं तेषु दत्तं महाफलम् ॥
data.md: By making gifts to such Brahmanas as have been deprived of all their possessions by powerful men but as are perfectly innocent and as desire to fill their stomachs with any and every sort of food, one acquires great merit.

data.v: तपस्विनस्तपोनिष्ठास्तेषां भैक्षचराश्च ये । अर्थिनः किंचिदिच्छन्ति तेषु दत्तं महाफलम् ॥
data.md: By making gifts to such Brahmanas as beg on behalf of others performing penances and devoted to them, and as are satisfied with even small gifts one acquires great merit.

data.v: महाफलविधिर्दाने श्रुतस्ते भरतर्षभ । निरयं येन गच्छन्ति स्वर्गं चैव हि तच्छृणु ॥
data.md: You have now, O foremost of Bharata's race, heard what the scriptural declarations are about the acquisition of great merit by the making of gifts. Hear from me now, of those acts that lead to hell or heaven.

data.v: गुर्वर्थं वाभयार्थं वा वर्जयित्वा युधिष्ठिर । येऽनृतं कथयन्ति स्म ते वै निरयगामिनः ॥
data.md: They, O Yudhishthira, that speak an untruth on occasions other than those when such untruth is necessary for serving the purpose of the preceptor or for giving the assurance of safety to a person in fear of his life, sink in hell.

data.v: परदाराभिहर्तारः परदाराभिमर्शिनः । परदारप्रयोक्तारस्ते वै निरयगामिनः ॥
data.md: They who ravish other people's wives or have sexual intercourse with them, or assist at such sinful acts, sink in hell.

data.v: ये परस्वापहर्तारः परस्वानां च नाशकाः । सूचकाश्च परेषां ये ते वै निरयगामिनः ॥
data.md: They who rob others of their riches or destroy the riches and properties of other people, or trumpet the shortcomings of other people, sink in hell.

data.v: प्रपाणां च सभानां च संक्रमाणां च भारत । अगाराणां च भेत्तारो नरा निरयगामिनः ॥
data.md: They who spoil tanks used by cattle for satisfying thirst, who injure buildings used for public meetings, who break down bridges and causeways, and who pull down dwelling houses, have to sink in hell.

data.v: अनाथां प्रमदां बालां वृद्धां भीतां तपस्विनीम् । वञ्चयन्ति नरा ये च ते वै निरयगामिनः ॥
data.md: They who lead astray and cheat helpless women, or girls or aged dames, or such women as have been frightened, have to sink in hell.

data.v: वृत्तिच्छेदं गृहच्छेदं दारच्छेदं च भारत । मित्रच्छेदं तथाशायास्ते वै निरयगामिनः ॥
data.md: They who destroy the means of other people's subsistence, they who root out the habitations of other people, they who rob others of their wives, they who sow dissensions among friends, and they who destroy the hopes of other people, sink in hell.

data.v: सूचकाः संधिभेत्तारः परवृत्त्युपजीवकाः । अकृतज्ञाश्च मित्राणां ते वै निरयगामिनः ॥
data.md: They who trumpet forth the faults of others, they who break down bridges or causeways, they who live by following other people's calling and they who are ungrateful to friends for services received, have to sink in hell.

data.v: पाषण्डा दूषकाश्चैव समयानां च दूषकाः । ये प्रत्यवसिताश्चैव ते वै निरयगामिनः ॥
data.md: They who have no faith in the Vedas and show no respect for them, they who break the vows made by themselves or make others to break them, and they who fall away from their status through sin, sink in hell.

data.v: कृताशं कृतनिर्वेशं कृतभक्तं कृतश्रमम् । भेदैर्ये व्यपकर्षन्ति ते वै निरयगामिनः ॥
data.md: They who make the masters dismiss the servants that are hoping for rewards or are in the enjoyment of wages or salaries or waiting for returns in respect of valuable services already done, have to sink in hell.

data.v: पर्यश्नन्ति च ये दारानग्निभृत्यातिथींस्तथा । उत्सन्नपितृदेवेज्यास्ते वै निरयगामिनः ॥
data.md: They who themselves eat without offering portions thereof to their wives or their sacred fires or their servants or their guests, and they who do not perform the rites laid down in the scriptures for honouring the departed manes and deities, have to sink in hell.

data.v: वेदविक्रयिणश्चैव वेदानां चैव दूषकाः । वेदानां लेखकाश्चैव ते वै निरयगामिनः ॥
data.md: They who sell the Vedas, they who find fault with the Vedas, and they who reduce the Vedas into writing, have all to sink in hell.

data.v: चातुराश्रम्यबाह्याश्च श्रुतिबाह्याश्च ये नराः । विकर्मभिश्च जीवन्ति ते वै निरयगामिनः ॥
data.md: They who are out of the limit of the four wellknown modes of life, they who follow to practices interdicted by the Shrutis and the Scriptures, and they who perform wicked or sinful deeds or who do not belong to their order of birth have to sink in hell.

data.v: केशविक्रयिका राजन्विषविक्रयिकाश्च ये । क्षीरविक्रयिकाश्चैव ते वै निरयगामिनः ॥
data.md: They who live by selling hair, they who live by selling poisons, and they who live by selling milk have to sink in hell.

data.v: ब्राह्मणानां गवां चैव कन्यानां च युधिष्ठिर । येऽन्तरं यान्ति कार्येषु ते वै निरयगामिनः ॥
data.md: They, O Yudhishthira, that speak an untruth on occasions other than those when such untruth is necessary for serving the purpose of the preceptor or for giving the assurance of safety to a person in fear of his life, sink in hell.

data.v: शस्त्रविक्रयकाश्चैव कर्तारश्च युधिष्ठिर । शल्यानां धनुषां चैव ते वै निरयगामिनः ॥
data.md: They who sell weapons, they who forge weapons, they who make arrows, and they who make bows, have to sink in hell.

data.v: शल्यैर्वा शङ्कुभिर्वापि श्वभ्रैर्वा भरतर्षभ । ये मार्गमनुरुन्धन्ति ते वै निरयगामिनः ॥
data.md: They who obstruct paths and roads with stones and thorns and holes have to sink in hell.

data.v: उपाध्यायांश्च भृत्यांश्च भक्तांश्च भरतर्षभ । ये त्यजन्त्यसमर्थांस्तांस्ते वै निरयगामिनः ॥
data.md: They who renounce preceptors and servants and loyal followers without any offence, o foremost of Bharata's race, have to sink in hell.

data.v: अप्राप्तदमकाश्चैव नासानां वेधकास्तथा । बन्धकाश्च पशूनां ये ते वै निरयगामिनः ॥
data.md: They who set bullocks to work when the animals have not come of age, they who bore the noses of bullocks and other animals for controlling them the better while engaged in work, and they who keep animals always tethered, have to sink in hell.

data.v: अगोप्तारश्छलद्रव्या बलिषड्भागतत्पराः । समर्थाश्चाप्यदातारस्ते वै निरयगामिनः ॥
data.md: Those kings who do not protect their subjects while forcibly collect from them a sixth share of the produce of their fields, and they who though able and possessed of resources abstain from making gifts have to sink in hell.

data.v: क्षान्तान्दान्तांस्तथा प्राज्ञान्दीर्घकालं सहोषितान् । त्यजन्ति कृतकृत्या ये ते वै निरयगामिनः ॥
data.md: They who renounce persons gifted with forgiveness, selfcontrol and wisdom, or those with whom they have associated for many years when these are no longer of service to them have to sink in hell.

data.v: बालानामथ वृद्धानां दासानां चैव ये नराः । अदत्त्वा भक्षयन्त्यग्रे ते वै निरयगामिनः ॥
data.md: Those men who themselves eat without giving parts of the food to children, aged men and servants, have to sink in hell.

data.v: एते पूर्वर्षिभिर्दृष्टाः प्रोक्ता निरयगामिनः । भागिनः स्वर्गलोकस्य वक्ष्यामि भरतर्षभ ॥
data.md: All these men numbered above have to go to hell. Listen now to me, O foremost of Bharata's race, as I tell you who those men are who ascend to heaven.

data.v: सर्वेष्वेव तु कार्येषु दैवपूर्वेषु भारत । हन्ति पुत्रान्पशून्कृत्स्नान्ब्राह्मणातिक्रमः कृतः ॥
data.md: The man who transgresses against a Brahmana by obstructing the adoration of gods, suffer from the loss of all his children and animals.

data.v: दानेन तपसा चैव सत्येन च युधिष्ठिर । ये धर्ममनुवर्तन्ते ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः ॥
data.md: Those men, O Yudhishthira, who perform the duties laid down in the scriptures for them, practising the virtues of charity self control and truthfulness, go to the celestial region.

data.v: शुश्रूषाभिस्तपोभिश्च श्रुतमादाय भारत । ये प्रतिग्रहनिःस्नेहास्ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः ॥
data.md: Those men who having acquired knowledge by making obedient services to their preceptors and performing austere penances, are unwilling to accept gifts, succeed in ascending to heaven.

data.v: भयात्पापात्तथाबाधाद्दारिद्र्याद्व्याधिधर्षणात् । यत्कृते प्रतिमुच्यन्ते ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः ॥
data.md: Those men who save people from fear and sin and who remove the obstacles lying in the way of what they wish to accomplish and poverty and the sufferings of disease, succeed in ascending to heaven.

data.v: क्षमावन्तश्च धीराश्च धर्मकार्येषु चोत्थिताः । मङ्गलाचारयुक्ताश्च ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः ॥
data.md: Those men who are gifted with a forgiving disposition, who are endued with patience, who are ready to perform all righteous rites, and who are of pure conduct, succeed in ascending to heaven.

data.v: निवृत्ता मधुमांसेभ्यः परदारेभ्य एव च । निवृत्ताश्चैव मद्येभ्यस्ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः ॥
data.md: Those men who abstain from honey and meat, who abstain from sexual intercourse with the wives of other people, and who abstain from wines and spirituous liquors succeed in ascending to heaven.

data.v: आश्रमाणां च कर्तारः कुलानां चैव भारत । देशानां नगराणां च ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः ॥
data.md: Those men who help in the establishment of asylums for ascetics, who be come founders of families, O Bharata, who open up new countries for purposes of dwelling and implant towns and cities, succeed in ascending to heaven.

data.v: वस्त्राभरणदातारो भक्षपानान्नदास्तथा । कुटुम्बानां च दातारस्ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः ॥
data.md: Those men who distribute cloths and ornaments, as also food and drink, and who help in marrying others succeed in ascending to heaven.

data.v: सर्वहिंसानिवृत्ताश्च नराः सर्वसहाश्च ये । सर्वस्याश्रयभूताश्च ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः ॥
data.md: Those men who have abstained from all sorts of injury or harm to all creatures, who can endure everything, and who have made themselves the refuge of all creatures succeed in ascending to heaven.

data.v: मातरं पितरं चैव शुश्रूषन्ति जितेन्द्रियाः । भ्रातॄणां चैव सस्नेहास्ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः ॥
data.md: Those men who wait humbly upon their parents, who have controlled their senses, and who are affectionate towards their brothers, succeed in ascending to heaven.

data.v: आढ्याश्च बलवन्तश्च यौवनस्थाश्च भारत । ये वै जितेन्द्रिया धीरास्ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः ॥
data.md: Those men who master their senses though they are rich in worldly possessions, endued with robust constitution and gifted with youthful vigour, succeed in ascending to heaven.

data.v: अपराद्धेषु सस्नेहा मृदवो मित्रवत्सलाः । आराधनसुखाश्चापि ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः ॥
data.md: Those men who are kind even towards the offenders who are of mild disposition, who have an affection for all who are of mild behaviour, and who contribute to the happiness of others by rendering them every kind of service in humility, succeed in ascending to heaven.

data.v: सहस्रपरिवेष्टारस्तथैव च सहस्रदाः । त्रातारश्च सहस्राणां पुरुषाः स्वर्गगामिनः ॥
data.md: Those men who protect thousands of people, who make gifts to thousands of people, and who rescue thousands of people from distress, succeed in ascending to heaven.

data.v: सुवर्णस्य च दातारो गवां च भरतर्षभ । यानानां वाहनानां च ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः ॥
data.md: Those men who make gifts of gold and of kine, O foremost of Bharata's race, as also of conveyances and animals, succeed in ascending to heaven.

data.v: वैवाहिकानां कन्यानां प्रेष्याणां च युधिष्ठिर । दातारो वाससां चैव ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः ॥
data.md: Those men who give away such articles as are necessary in marriages, as also servants and maids, and cloths and robes succeed in ascending to heaven.

data.v: विहारावसथोद्यानकूपारामसभाप्रदाः । वप्राणां चैव कर्तारस्ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः ॥
data.md: Those men who make public pleasure houses, gardens, well, resting houses, and buildings for public meetings, and tanks for enabling cattle and men to satisfy their thirst and fields for cultivation, O Bharata succeed in ascending to heaven.

data.v: निवेशनानां क्षेत्राणां वसतीनां च भारत । दातारः प्रार्थितानां च ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः ॥
data.md: Those men who give houses and fields and populated villages to persons that want them, succeed in ascending to heaven.

data.v: रसानामथ बीजानां धान्यानां च युधिष्ठिर । स्वयमुत्पाद्य दातारः पुरुषाः स्वर्गगामिनः ॥
data.md: Those who having themselves manufactured drinks of sweet taste and seeds and paddy or rice, give them to others, succeed in ascending to heaven.

data.v: यस्मिन्कस्मिन्कुले जाता बहुपुत्राः शतायुषः । सानुक्रोशा जितक्रोधाः पुरुषाः स्वर्गगामिनः ॥
data.md: Those men who having been born in families high or low beget hundreds of children and live long lives, practising mercy and keeping anger under complete control, succeed in ascending to heaven.

data.v: एतदुक्तममुत्रार्थं दैवं पित्र्यं च भारत । धर्माधर्मौ च दानस्य यथा पूर्वर्षिभिः कृतौ ॥
data.md: I have thus explained to you, O Bharata, what the rites are in honour of the deities and the departed manes which are performed by people for the sake of the other world, what the ordinances are about making gifts, and what the views are of the Rishis of former times about both the articles of gift and the manner of giving them. inen

data.v: इदं मे तत्त्वतो राजन्वक्तुमर्हसि भारत । अहिंसयित्वा केनेह ब्रह्महत्या विधीयते ॥
data.md: Yudhishthira said O descendant of Bharata's race, you should answer this question of mine truly and in detail. What are those circumstances under which a person may become guilty of Brahmanicide without actually killing a Brahmana.

data.v: व्यासमामन्त्र्य राजेन्द्र पुरा यत्पृष्टवानहम् । तत्तेऽहं संप्रवक्ष्यामि तदिहैकमनाः शृणु ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Formerly, O king, I had one day requested Vyasa to explain to me this very subject. I shall now describe to you what Vyasa told me on that occasion. Do you listen to it with rapt attention.

data.v: चतुर्थस्त्वं वसिष्ठस्य तत्त्वमाख्याहि मे मुने । अहिंसयित्वा केनेह ब्रह्महत्या विधीयते ॥
data.md: Going to Vyasa, I addressed him saying You, O great ascetic, are the fourth in descent from Vaishishtha! Do you explain to me this. What are those circumstances under which one becomes guilty of Brahmanicide without actually killing a Brahmana?

data.v: इति पृष्टो महाराज पराशरशरीरजः । अब्रवीन्निपुणो धर्मे निःसंशयमनुत्तमम् ॥
data.md: Thus addressed by me, the own begotten son of Parashara, o king an adept in the science of morality gave me the following answer at once excellent and fraught with certainly.

data.v: ब्राह्मणं स्वयमाहूय भिक्षार्थे कृशवृत्तिनम् । ब्रूयान्नास्तीति यः पश्चात्तं विद्याद्ब्रह्मघातिनम् ॥
data.md: You should know that man as guilty of Brahmanicide who having of his own accord invited a Brahmana of pious conduct to his house for giving him alms then refuses too give anything on the pretence of there being nothing in the house.

data.v: मध्यस्थस्येह विप्रस्य योऽनूचानस्य भारत । वृत्तिं हरति दुर्बुद्धिस्तं विद्याद्ब्रह्मघातिनम् ॥
data.md: You should, O Bharata, know that man as guilty of Brahmanicide who destroys the means of living of a Brahmana well-read in the Vedas, and all their branches and who is shorn of attachments to worldly creatures and goods.

data.v: गोकुलस्य तृषार्तस्य जलार्थे वसुधाधिप । उत्पादयति यो विघ्नं तं विद्याद्ब्रह्मघातिनम् ॥
data.md: You should o king, know that man to be guilty of Brahmanicide who puts impediments in the way of thirsty kine while engaged in satisfying that thirst.

data.v: यः प्रवृत्तां श्रुतिं सम्यक्शास्त्रं वा मुनिभिः कृतम् । दूषयत्यनभिज्ञाय तं विद्याद्ब्रह्मघातिनम् ॥
data.md: You should take that man as guilty of Brahmanicide who, without studying them, finds fault with the Shrutis that have come down: from preceptor to pupil for ages and ages together, or with those scriptures that have been composed by the Rishis.

data.v: आत्मजां रूपसंपन्नां महतीं सदृशे वरे । न प्रयच्छति यः कन्यां तं विद्याद्ब्रह्मघातिनम् ॥
data.md: You should know that man as guilty of Brahmanicide who does not confer upon a suitable bridegroom his daughter endued with beauty and other excellent qualities.

data.v: अधर्मनिरतो मूढो मिथ्या यो वै द्विजातिषु । दद्यान्मर्मातिगं शोकं तं विद्याद्ब्रह्मघातिनम् ॥
data.md: You should know that foolish and sinful wightought to be guilty of Brahmanicide who pains the Brahmanas to the very core of their hearts.

data.v: चक्षुषा विप्रहीनस्य पङ्गुलस्य जडस्य वा । हरेत यो वै सर्वस्वं तं विद्याद्ब्रह्मघातिनम् ॥
data.md: You should know that man to be guilty of Brahmanicide who robs the blind, the lame, and idiots.

data.v: आश्रमे वा वने वा यो ग्रामे वा यदि वा पुरे । अग्निं समुत्सृजेन्मोहात्तं विद्याद्ब्रह्मघातिनम् ॥
data.md: You should know that man to be guilty of Brahmanicide who sets fire to the hermitage of ascetics or to forests or to a village or a town.

data.v: तीर्थानां दर्शनं श्रेयः स्नानं च भरतर्षभ । श्रवणं च महाप्राज्ञ श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः ॥
data.md: Yudhishthira said It has been said that sojourns to sacred waters is full of merit; that ablutions in such waters is meritorious; and that listening to the excellence of such waters is also meritorious. I wish to hear you expatiate on this subject, O grandfather.

data.v: पृथिव्यां यानि तीर्थानि पुण्यानि भरतर्षभ । वक्तुमर्हसि मे तानि श्रोतास्मि नियतः प्रभो ॥
data.md: You should, O chief of Bharata's race, mention to me the sacred waters existing on this Earth. I wish you of great power to hear you describe to me this subject.

data.v: इममङ्गिरसा प्रोक्तं तीर्थवंशं महाद्युते । श्रोतुमर्हसि भद्रं ते प्राप्स्यसे धर्ममुत्तमम् ॥
data.md: Bhishma said O you of great splendour, Angiras thus enumerated the sacred waters on the Earth. Blessed be you, you should listen to it, for you will then acquire great merit.

data.v: तपोवनगतं विप्रमभिगम्य महामुनिम् । पप्रच्छाङ्गिरसं वीर गौतमः संशितव्रतः ॥
अस्ति मे भगवन्कश्चित्तीर्थेभ्यो धर्मसंशयः । तत्सर्वं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तन्मे शंस महामुने ॥
data.md: Once on a time approaching the great and learned Rishi Angiras gifted with tranquillity of soul, while he was living in a forest, Gautama of rigid vows questioned him, saying O illustrious one, I have some doubts regarding the merits of sacred waters and shrines. I wish to hear you describe that subject. Do you therefore, O ascetic describe it to me.

data.v: उपस्पृश्य फलं किं स्यात्तेषु तीर्थेषु वै मुने । प्रेत्यभावे महाप्राज्ञ तद्यथास्ति तथा वद ॥
data.md: What merits are acquired by a person regarding the next world, by bathing in the sacred waters on the Earth, O you of great wisdom? Do you explain to me this truly and according to the ordinance.

data.v: सप्ताहं चन्द्रभागां वै वितस्तामूर्मिमालिनीम् । विगाह्य वै निराहारो निर्ममो मुनिवद्भवेत् ॥
data.md: Angiras said A person by bathing for seven days successively in the Chandrabhaga or the Vitasta whose waters are always seen to dance in waves, fasting all the while, is sure to become purged of all his sins and endued with the merit of an ascetic.

data.v: काश्मीरमण्डले नद्यो याः पतन्ति महानदम् । ता नदीः सिन्धुमासाद्य शीलवान्स्वर्गमाप्नुयात् ॥
data.md: There ere many rivers in the country called Kashmira. All these fall into the great river called Sindhu (Indus). By bathing in these rivers one is sure to become gifted with good character and to ascend to heaven after leaving this world.

data.v: पुष्करं च प्रभासं च नैमिषं सागरोदकम् । देविकामिन्द्रमार्गं च स्वर्णबिन्दुं विगाह्य च । विबोध्यते विमानस्थः सोऽप्सरोभिरभिष्टुतः ॥
data.md: By bathing in Pushkara, Prabhasa and Naimisha, and the ocean and Devika, and Indramarga and Svarnabindu, one is sure to ascend where, seated on a celestial car, one is sure be filled with joy on being worshipped by the Apsaras

data.v: हिरण्यबिन्दुं विक्षोभ्य प्रयतश्चाभिवाद्य तम् । कुशेशयं च देवत्वं पूयते तस्य किल्बिषम् ॥
data.md: By bathing in the waters of Hiranyabindu with a concentrated mind and respecting that sacred river, and bathing next at Kusheshaya and Devanta, one becomes purged of all one's sins.

data.v: इन्द्रतोयां समासाद्य गन्धमादनसंनिधौ । करतोयां कुरङ्गेषु त्रिरात्रोपोषितो नरः । अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति विगाह्य नियतः शुचिः ॥
data.md: Going to Indratoya near the Mountains of Gandhamadana and next to Karatoyas in the country called Kuranga, one should fast for three days and then bathe in those sacred waters with a concentrated heart and pure body. By doing this, one is sure to acquire the merit of a Horse-sacrifice.

data.v: गङ्गाद्वारे कुशावर्ते बिल्वके नेमिपर्वते । तथा कनखले स्नात्वा धूतपाप्मा दिवं व्रजेत् ॥
data.md: Bathing in Gangadvara and Kushavarta and Vilvaka in the Blue mountains, as also in Kanakhala, one is sure to become purged of all one's sins and then ascend to heaven.

data.v: अपां ह्रद उपस्पृश्य वाजपेयफलं लभेत् । ब्रह्मचारी जितक्रोधः सत्यसंधस्त्वहिंसकः ॥
data.md: If one becomes a Brahmacharin and control his anger, devotes oneself to truth and practises mercy towards all creatures, and then bathes in the Lake of Waters, one is sure to acquire the merit of a Horse-sacrifice.

data.v: यत्र भागीरथी गङ्गा भजते दिशमुत्तराम् । महेश्वरस्य निष्ठाने यो नरस्त्वभिषिच्यते । एकमासं निराहारः स्वयं पश्यति देवताः ॥
data.md: That part where Bhagirathi-Ganga flows northwards is known as the union of heaven, Earth, and the nether regions. Fasting for one month and bathing in that sacred Tirtha which is acceptable to Maheshvara, one can see the deities.

data.v: सप्तगङ्गे त्रिगङ्गे च इन्द्रमार्गे च तर्पयन् । सुधां वै लभते भोक्तुं यो नरो जायते पुनः ॥
data.md: One who gives oblations of water to his departed manes at Saptaganga and Triganga and Indramarga, obtains ambrosia for food if one has still to go through rebirth.

data.v: महाश्रम उपस्पृश्य योऽग्निहोत्रपरः शुचिः । एकमासं निराहारः सिद्धिं मासेन स व्रजेत् ॥
data.md: The man who in a pure state of body and mind performs his daily Agnihotra and fasts for one month and then bathes in Mahashrama, is sure to acquire success in one month.

data.v: महाह्रद उपस्पृश्य भृगुतुङ्गे त्वलोलुपः । त्रिरात्रोपोषितो भूत्वा मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया ॥
data.md: By bathing after a fast of three days and purifying the mind of all evil propensities, in the large lake situate in Bhrigutunga, one becomes purged of even the sin of Brahmanicide.

data.v: कन्याकूप उपस्पृश्य बलाकायां कृतोदकः । देवेषु कीर्तिं लभते यशसा च विराजते ॥
data.md: By bathing in Kanyakupa and performing one's ablutions in Valaka, one wins great fame among even the celestials and shines in glory.

data.v: देशकाल उपस्पृश्य तथा सुन्दरिकाह्रदे । अश्विभ्यां रूपवर्चस्यं प्रेत्य वै लभते नरः ॥
data.md: Bathing in Devika and the lake known by the name of Sundarika as also in the Tirtha called Aslivini, one acquires, in next life, great personal beauty.

data.v: महागङ्गामुपस्पृश्य कृत्तिकाङ्गारके तथा । पक्षमेकं निराहारः स्वर्गमाप्नोति निर्मलः ॥
data.md: By fasting for a fortnight and bathing in Mahaganga and Krittikangaraka, one becomes purged of all his sins and ascends to heaven.

data.v: वैमानिक उपस्पृश्य किङ्किणीकाश्रमे तथा । निवासेऽप्सरसां दिव्ये कामचारी महीयते ॥
data.md: Bathing in Vaimanika and Kinkinika, one acquires the power of going everywhere at will and becomes an object of great respect in the celestial region of the Apsaras.

data.v: कालिकाश्रममासाद्य विपाशायां कृतोदकः । ब्रह्मचारी जितक्रोधस्त्रिरात्रान्मुच्यते भवात् ॥
data.md: If a person, controlling his anger, and observing the vow of Brahmacharya for three days, bathes in the river Vipasa at the hermitage called Kalika, he is sure to get over rebirth.

data.v: आश्रमे कृत्तिकानां तु स्नात्वा यस्तर्पयेत्पितॄन् । तोषयित्वा महादेवं निर्मलः स्वर्गमाप्नुयात् ॥
data.md: Bathing in the asylum that is sacred to the Krittikas and offering oblations of water to the departed manes, and then pleasing Mahadeva, one becomes pure in body and mind and ascends to heaven.

data.v: महापुर उपस्पृश्य त्रिरात्रोपोषितो नरः । त्रसानां स्थावराणां च द्विपदानां भयं त्यजेत् ॥
data.md: If one, fasting for three days with a purified body and mind, bathes in Mahapura, one becomes freed from the fear of all mobile and immobile animals as also of all two feeted animals.

data.v: देवदारुवने स्नात्वा धूतपाप्मा कृतोदकः । देवलोकमवाप्नोति सप्तरात्रोषितः शुचिः ॥
data.md: By bathing in the Devadaru forest and offering oblations of water to the departed manes and living there for seven nights with a pure body and mind, one acquires the region of the celestials on departing from this world.

data.v: कौशन्ते च कुशस्तम्बे द्रोणशर्मपदे तथा । आपःप्रपतने स्नातः सेव्यते सोऽप्सरोगणैः ॥
data.md: Bathing in the waterfalls at Sharastamva and Kushustamva and Dronasharmapada, one is sure to acquire the region of the Apsaras where one is dutifully served by those superhuman beings.

data.v: चित्रकूटे जनस्थाने तथा मन्दाकिनीजले । विगाह्य वै निराहारो राजलक्ष्मीं निगच्छति ॥
data.md: If one, fasting bathes at Chitrakuta and Janasthana and the waters of Mandakini, one is sure to be gifted with real prosperity.

data.v: श्यामायास्त्वाश्रमं गत्वा उष्य चैवाभिषिच्य च । त्रींस्त्रिरात्रान्स संधाय गन्धर्वनगरे वसेत् ॥
data.md: By going to the retreat of Shyama and living there for a fortnight and bathing in the sacred water that lies there, one acquires the power of disappearing at will.

data.v: रमण्यां च उपस्पृश्य तथा वै गन्धतारिके । एकमासं निराहारस्त्वन्तर्धानफलं लभेत् ॥
कौशिकीद्वारमासाद्य वायुभक्षस्त्वलोलुपः । एकविंशतिरात्रेण स्वर्गमारोहते नरः ॥
data.md: Going to the tirtha Kaushiki and living there with a pure heart and abstaining from all food and drink for three days, one acquires the power of living in the happy region of the Gandharvas.

data.v: मतङ्गवाप्यां यः स्नायादेकरात्रेण सिध्यति । विगाहति ह्यनालम्बमन्धकं वै सनातनम् ॥
data.md: He who bathes in the lake Matanga is sure to acquire success in one night. He who bathes in Analamva or the eternal, Andhaka, or in Naimisha, or the tirtha called Svarga, and offers oblations of water to the departed manes, controlling his senses all the while, acquires the merit of a human sacrifice.

data.v: नैमिषे स्वर्गतीर्थे च उपस्पृश्य जितेन्द्रियः । फलं पुरुषमेधस्य लभेन्मासं कृतोदकः ॥
data.md: He who bathes in the lake Matanga is sure to acquire success in one night. He who bathes in Analamva or the eternal, Andhaka, or in Naimisha, or the tirtha called Svarga, and offers oblations of water to the departed manes, controlling his senses all the while, acquires the merit of a human sacrifice.

data.v: गङ्गाह्रद उपस्पृश्य तथा चैवोत्पलावने । अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति तत्र मासं कृतोदकः ॥
data.md: Bathing in Gangahrada and the tirtha Utplavana and daily offering oblations of water there for a full month to the departed manes, one acquires the merit of a Horse-sacrifice.

data.v: गङ्गायमुनयोस्तीर्थे तथा कालंजरे गिरौ । षष्टिह्रद उपस्पृश्य दानं नान्यद्विशिष्यते ॥
दश तीर्थसहस्राणि तिस्रः कोट्यस्तथापराः । समागच्छन्ति माघ्यां तु प्रयागे भरतर्षभ ॥
data.md: Bathing in the Shashthi lake one acquires merit much greater than what appertains to the gift of food. Ten thousand tirthas and thirty millions of other tirthas come to Prayaga, O chief of Bharata's race, in the month of Magha. He who bathes in Prayaga, with a controlled mind and observing rigid vows all the while the month of Magha, becomes purged of all his sins, O chief of Bharata's race, and attains to heaven.

data.v: माघमासं प्रयागे तु नियतः संशितव्रतः । स्नात्वा तु भरतश्रेष्ठ निर्मलः स्वर्गमाप्नुयात् ॥
मरुद्गण उपस्पृश्य पितॄणामाश्रमे शुचिः । वैवस्वतस्य तीर्थे च तीर्थभूतो भवेन्नरः ॥
data.md: Bathing in the tirtha that is sacred to the Maruts, as also in that which is situate in the retreat of the departed manes, in and also in that which is known by the name of Vaivasvata, one becomes purged of all one's sins and as pure and sanctified as tirtha.

data.v: तथा ब्रह्मशिरो गत्वा भागीरथ्यां कृतोदकः । एकमासं निराहारः सोमलोकमवाप्नुयात् ॥
data.md: Going to Brahmasaras as to the Bhagirathi and bathing there and offering oblations to the departed manes every day for a full month, abstaining from food all the while, one is sure to go to the region of Soma.

data.v: कपोतके नरः स्नात्वा अष्टावक्रे कृतोदकः । द्वादशाहं निराहारो नरमेधफलं लभेत् ॥
data.md: Bathing in Utpataka and then in Ashtavakra and offering oblations of water to the departed manes every day for twlve days successively, abstaining all the while from food, one acquires the merits of a Naramedha sacrifice.

data.v: मुञ्जपृष्ठं गयां चैव निरृतिं देवपर्वतम् । तृतीयां क्रौञ्चपादीं च ब्रह्महत्या विशुध्यति ॥
data.md: Bathing in Ashmaprishtha and Niravinda mountains and Kraunchapadi all three in Gayaone becomes purged of the sin of Brahmanicide. A bath in the first place purifies one of a single Brahmanicidele; bath in the second cleanness one of two similar offences; and a bath in the third cleanses one of three such offences.

data.v: कलश्यां वाप्युपस्पृश्य वेद्यां च बहुशोजलाम् । अग्नेः पुरे नरः स्नात्वा विशालायां कृतोदकः । देवह्रद उपस्पृश्य ब्रह्मभूतो विराजते ॥
data.md: Bathing in Vishala in Karavirapura and offering oblations of water to his departed and performing his ablutions in Devahrada too, one becomes at one with Brahma and shines in glory as such.

data.v: पुरापवर्तनं नन्दां महानन्दां च सेव्य वै । नन्दने सेव्यते दान्तस्त्वप्सरोभिरहिंसकः ॥
data.md: Bathing in Punaravarta Nanda, as also Mahananda, a man of controlled senses and universal mercy goes to the celestial garden of Nandana and served there by the various tribes of Apsaras.

data.v: उर्वशीकृत्तिकायोगे गत्वा यः सुसमाहितः । लौहित्ये विधिवत्स्नात्वा पुण्डरीकफलं लभेत् ॥
data.md: Bathing with concentrated soul in the tirtha of Urvashi which is situated in the river Lohitya, on the day of full moon of the month of Kartika, one acquires the merits of Pundarika sacrifice.

data.v: रामह्रद उपस्पृश्य विशालायां कृतोदकः । द्वादशाहं निराहारः कल्मषाद्विप्रमुच्यते ॥
data.md: Bathing in Ramahrada and offering oblations of water to the departed manes in the river Vipasha (Beas), and fasting for twelve days, one becomes purged of all sins.

data.v: महाह्रद उपस्पृश्य शुद्धेन मनसा नरः । एकमासं निराहारो जमदग्निगतिं लभेत् ॥
data.md: Bathing in the tirtha called Mahahrada with a purified heart and after fasting for one month, one is sure to acquire the status of the sage Jamadagni.

data.v: विन्ध्ये संताप्य चात्मानं सत्यसंधस्त्वहिंसकः । षण्मासं पदमास्थाय मासेनैकेन शुध्यति ॥
data.md: By exposing oneself to heat in the tirtha called Vindhya, a person given to truth and endued with compassion for all creatures should then practise austere penances, actuated by humility. By so doing, he is sure to acquire ascetic success in course of single month.

data.v: नर्मदायामुपस्पृश्य तथा सूर्पारकोदके । एकपक्षं निराहारो राजपुत्रो विधीयते ॥
data.md: Bathing in the Narmada as also the tirtha named Surparaka, fasting for a full fortnight, one is sure to become in one's next birth a prince of royal blood.

data.v: जम्बूमार्गे त्रिभिर्मासैः संयतः सुसमाहितः । अहोरात्रेण चैकेन सिद्धिं समधिगच्छति ॥
data.md: If one proceeds with controlled senses and a concentrated soul to the tirtha known as Jamvumarga, one is sure to acquire success in the course of a single day and night.

data.v: कोकामुखे विगाह्यापो गत्वा चण्डालिकाश्रमम् । शाकभक्षश्चीरवासाः कुमारीर्विन्दते दश ॥
data.md: By going to Chandalikashrama and bathing in the tirtha called Kokamukha, having lived for sometime on potherbs alone and worm rags for raiments one is sure to get ten beautiful maidens as his wives.

data.v: वैवस्वतस्य सदनं न स गच्छेत्कदाचन । यस्य कन्याह्रदे वासो देवलोकं स गच्छति ॥
data.md: One who lives by the side of the tirtha known by the name of Kanvahrada has never to visit the regions of Yama. Such a person is sure to ascend to the regions of happiness belonging to the celestials.

data.v: प्रभासे त्वेकरात्रेण अमावास्यां समाहितः । सिध्यतेऽत्र महाबाहो यो नरो जायते पुनः ॥
data.md: One who bathes with controlled senses on the day of the new moon in the tirtha known by the name of Prabhasa, is sure, you of mighty arins, of acquiring success and immortality simultaneously.

data.v: उज्जानक उपस्पृश्य आर्ष्टिषेणस्य चाश्रमे । पिङ्गायाश्चाश्रमे स्नात्वा सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ॥
data.md: Bathing in the tirtha known by the name of Ujjanaka which is situate in the retreat of Arshtisena's son, and next in the tirtha which is situate in the retreat of Pinga, one is sure to be purged of all his sins.

data.v: कुल्यायां समुपस्पृश्य जप्त्वा चैवाघमर्षणम् । अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति त्रिरात्रोपोषितः शुचिः ॥
data.md: Fasting for three days and bathing in the tirtha known as kulya and reciting the sacred Mantras of Aghamarshana, one acquires the merit of a Horse-sacrifice.

data.v: पिण्डारक उपस्पृश्य एकरात्रोषितो नरः । अग्निष्टोममवाप्नोति प्रभातां शर्वरीं शुचिः ॥
data.md: Fasting for one night and bathing in Pindaraka, one becomes purified on the next day and acquires the merit of an agnishtoma sacrifice.

data.v: तथा ब्रह्मसरो गत्वा धर्मारण्योपशोभितम् । पुण्डरीकमवाप्नोति प्रभातां शर्वरीं शुचिः ॥
data.md: One who goes to Brahmasara which is adorned by the woods called Dharmaranya one becomes purged of all one's sins in and acquires the merit of the Pundarika sacrifice.

data.v: मैनाके पर्वते स्नात्वा तथा संध्यामुपास्य च । कामं जित्वा च वै मासं सर्वमेधफलं लभेत् ॥
data.md: Bathing in the waters of the Mainaka mountain and reciting morning and evening prayers there and living at the spot for a month controlling desires, one acquires the merit of all the sacrifices.

data.v: विख्यातो हिमवान्पुण्यः शंकरश्वशुरो गिरिः । आकरः सर्वरत्नानां सिद्धचारणसेवितः ॥
data.md: The celebrated Himayat is sacred. That king of mountains is the father-in-law of Shankara, He is a mine of all jewels and gems and is the resort of the Siddhas and Charanas.

data.v: शरीरमुत्सृजेत्तत्र विधिपूर्वमनाशके । अध्रुवं जीवितं ज्ञात्वा यो वै वेदान्तगो द्विजः ॥
data.md: That twice born person who is as master of the vedas and who, considering this life to be exceedingly unstable, renounces his body on those mountains, abstaining from all food and drink according to the rites laid down in the scriptures, after having worshipped the gods and bent his head in worship of the ascetics is sure to acquire success and proceed to the eternal regions of Brahman.

data.v: अभ्यर्च्य देवतास्तत्र नमस्कृत्य मुनींस्तथा । ततः सिद्धो दिवं गच्छेद्ब्रह्मलोकं सनातनम् ॥
data.md: That twice born person who is as master of the vedas and who, considering this life to be exceedingly unstable, renounces his body on those mountains, abstaining from all food and drink according to the rites laid down in the scriptures, after having worshipped the gods and bent his head in worship of the ascetics is sure to acquire success and proceed to the eternal regions of Brahman.

data.v: कामं क्रोधं च लोभं च यो जित्वा तीर्थमावसेत् । न तेन किंचिन्न प्राप्तं तीर्थाभिगमनाद्भवेत् ॥
data.md: There is nothing which one cannot get who lives in a tirtha, restraining lust and controlling anger on account of such residence.

data.v: यान्यगम्यानि तीर्थानि दुर्गाणि विषमाणि च । मनसा तानि गम्यानि सर्वतीर्थसमासतः ॥
data.md: For the purpose of going to all the tirthas in the world, one should mentally think of those amongst them which are almost inaccessible or sojourns to which are attended with great difficulties.

data.v: इदं मेध्यमिदं धन्यमिदं स्वर्ग्यमिदं सुखम् । इदं रहस्यं देवानामाप्लाव्यानां च पावनम् ॥
data.md: Sojourns to tirthas yields the merits of Sacrifices. They are competent to purify everybody of sin. Fraught-with great good, they are capable of leading in heaven. The subject is truly a great mystery. The very gods should bathe in tirthas. To them also they are sin-purifying.

data.v: इदं दद्याद्द्विजातीनां साधूनामात्मजस्य वा । सुहृदां च जपेत्कर्णे शिष्यस्यानुगतस्य वा ॥
data.md: This discourse on tirthas should be delivered to Brahmanas, and to such honest or pious persons as are bent upon gaining what is for their own behoof. It should also be recited in the hearing of one's well-wishers and friends and of one's obedient and devoted disciples.

data.v: दत्तवान्गौतमस्येदमङ्गिरा वै महातपाः । गुरुभिः समनुज्ञातः काश्यपेन च धीमता ॥
data.md: Angiras endued with great ascetic merit, had delivered this discourse to Gautama. Angiras himself had got it from the highly intelligent Kashyapa.

data.v: महर्षीणामिदं जप्यं पावनानां तथोत्तमम् । जपंश्चाभ्युत्थितः शश्वन्निर्मलः स्वर्गमाप्नुयात् ॥
data.md: The great Rishis consider this discourse as deserving of constant repetition. It is the foremost of all purifying things. If one recites it regularly every day, he is sure to become purged of every sin and after this life 10 proceed to heaven.

data.v: इदं यश्चापि शृणुयाद्रहस्यं त्वङ्गिरोमतम् । उत्तमे च कुले जन्म लभेज्जातिं च संस्मरेत् ॥
data.md: One who listens to this discourse recited in his hearing this discourse, viz., of Angiras, which is regarded as a mystery is sure to attain in one's next life to birth in a good family and, what is more, one would have the memory of the pristine existence.

data.v: बृहस्पतिसमं बुद्ध्या क्षमया ब्रह्मणः समम् । पराक्रमे शक्रसममादित्यसमतेजसम् ॥
गाङ्गेयमर्जुनेनाजौ निहतं भूरिवर्चसम् । भ्रातृभिः सहितोऽन्यैश्च पर्युपास्ते युधिष्ठिरः ॥
शयानं वीरशयने कालाकाङ्क्षिणमच्युतम् । आजग्मुर्भरतश्रेष्ठं द्रष्टुकामा महर्षयः ॥
data.md: The old hero was lying on a bed coveted by heroes, in expectation of that sacred moment when he could take leave of his body. Many great Rishis had come there for seeing that foremost one of Bharata's race.

data.v: अत्रिर्वसिष्ठोऽथ भृगुः पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः । अङ्गिरा गौतमोऽगस्त्यः सुमतिः स्वायुरात्मवान् ॥
विश्वामित्रः स्थूलशिराः संवर्तः प्रमतिर्दमः । उशना बृहस्पतिर्व्यासश्च्यवनः काश्यपो ध्रुवः ॥
दुर्वासा जमदग्निश्च मार्कण्डेयोऽथ गालवः । भरद्वाजश्च रैभ्यश्च यवक्रीतस्त्रितस्तथा ॥
स्थूलाक्षः शकलाक्षश्च कण्वो मेधातिथिः कृशः । नारदः पर्वतश्चैव सुधन्वाथैकतो द्वितः ॥
data.md: There Sthulaksha, Shavalaksha, Kanwa, Medhatithi, Krishi, Narada, Parvata, Sudhanwan, Ekata and Dwita.

data.v: नितंभूर्भुवनो धौम्यः शतानन्दोऽकृतव्रणः । जामदग्न्यस्तथा रामः काम्यश्चेत्येवमादयः । समागता महात्मानो भीष्मं द्रष्टुं महर्षयः ॥
data.md: There also Nitambhu Bhuvana, Dhaumya, Shatananda, Akritavrana, Rama the son of Jamadagni and Kacha.

data.v: तेषां महात्मनां पूजामागतानां युधिष्ठिरः । भ्रातृभिः सहितश्चक्रे यथावदनुपूर्वशः ॥
data.md: All these great Rishis came there for seeing Bhishma lying on his bed of arrows. Yudhishthira with his brothers duly adored those great Rishis who had come there, one after another in proper order. Receiving that were were adoration, those foremost of Rishis sat themselves down and began to converse with one another.

data.v: ते पूजिताः सुखासीनाः कथाश्चक्रुर्महर्षयः । भीष्माश्रिताः सुमधुराः सर्वेन्द्रियमनोहराः ॥
भीष्मस्तेषां कथाः श्रुत्वा ऋषीणां भावितात्मनाम् । मेने दिविस्थमात्मानं तुष्ट्या परमया युतः ॥
ततस्ते भीष्ममामन्त्र्य पाण्डवांश्च महर्षयः । अन्तर्धानं गताः सर्वे सर्वेषामेव पश्यताम् ॥
तानृषीन्सुमहाभागानन्तर्धानगतानपि । पाण्डवास्तुष्टुवुः सर्वे प्रणेमुश्च मुहुर्मुहुः ॥
प्रसन्नमनसः सर्वे गाङ्गेयं कुरुसत्तमाः । उपतस्थुर्यथोद्यन्तमादित्यं मन्त्रकोविदाः ॥
प्रभावात्तपसस्तेषामृषीणां वीक्ष्य पाण्डवाः । प्रकाशन्तो दिशः सर्वा विस्मयं परमं ययुः ॥
महाभाग्यं परं तेषामृषीणामनुचिन्त्य ते । पाण्डवाः सह भीष्मेण कथाश्चक्रुस्तदाश्रयाः ॥
data.md: Thinking of the high blessedness and power of those Rishis, the Pandava princes began to discourse on the subject with their grandfather Bhishma.

data.v: कथान्ते शिरसा पादौ स्पृष्ट्वा भीष्मस्य पाण्डवः । धर्म्यं धर्मसुतः प्रश्नं पर्यपृच्छद्युधिष्ठिरः ॥
data.md: Vaishampayana said After that conversation was over, the pious Yudhishthira, the son of Pandu, touched Bhishma's feet with his head and then resumed his questions about morality and virtue.

data.v: के देशाः के जनपदा आश्रमाः के च पर्वताः । प्रकृष्टाः पुण्यतः काश्च ज्ञेया नद्यः पितामह ॥
data.md: Yudhishthira said Which countries, which provinces, which hermitages, which mountains, and which rivers, O grandfather, are the foremost in sancity.

data.v: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् । शिलोञ्छवृत्तेः संवादं सिद्धस्य च युधिष्ठिर ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Regarding it is cited the old conversation between a Brahmana in the observance of the Shila and the Unccha vows, O Yudhishthira, and a Rishi crowned with ascetic merits.

data.v: इमां कश्चित्परिक्रम्य पृथिवीं शैलभूषिताम् । असकृद्द्विपदां श्रेष्ठः श्रेष्ठस्य गृहमेधिनः ॥
data.md: Once on a time, a foremost person, having travelled over this entire Earth adorned with mountains, arrived at last in the house of a foremost person living like a householder in accordance with the shila vow. The latter welcomed his guest with due rites. Received with such hospitality, the happy Rishi passed the night happily in the house of his host.

data.v: शिलवृत्तेर्गृहं प्राप्तः स तेन विधिनार्चितः । कृतकृत्य उपातिष्ठत्सिद्धं तमतिथिं तदा ॥
data.md: The next morning the Brahmana in the observance of the Shila vow, having finished all his morning acts and rites and purified himself duly, gladly approached his guest crowned with ascetic success.

data.v: तौ समेत्य महात्मानौ सुखासीनौ कथाः शुभाः । चक्रतुर्वेदसंबद्धास्तच्छेषकृतलक्षणाः ॥
data.md: Meeting with each other and seated at their ease, the two began to take on agreeable subjects of the Vedas and the Upanishads.

data.v: शिलवृत्तिः कथान्ते तु सिद्धमामन्त्र्य यत्नतः । प्रश्नं पप्रच्छ मेधावी यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि ॥
data.md: Towards the conclusion of the discourse, the Brahmana in the observance of the Shila vow respectfully addressed the Rishi crowned with success. Gifted with intelligence, he put this very question which you, O Yudhishthira have put to me.

data.v: के देशाः के जनपदाः केऽऽश्रमाः के च पर्वताः । प्रकृष्टाः पुण्यतः काश्च ज्ञेया नद्यस्तदुच्यताम् ॥
data.md: Yudhishthira said Which countries, which provinces, which hermitages, which mountains, and which rivers, O grandfather, are the foremost in sancity.

data.v: ते देशास्ते जनपदास्तेऽऽश्रमास्ते च पर्वताः । येषां भागीरथी गङ्गा मध्येनैति सरिद्वरा ॥
data.md: The Rishi said Those countries, those provinces, those retreats, and those mountains, should be considered as the foremost in sanctity through which or by the side of which that foremost of all rivers viz., Bhagirathi, flows.

data.v: तपसा ब्रह्मचर्येण यज्ञैस्त्यागेन वा पुनः । गतिं तां न लभेज्जन्तुर्गङ्गां संसेव्य यां लभेत् ॥
data.md: The end which a creature can attain by penances by Brahmacharyya by sacrifices or by practising Renunciation, one is sure to attain by only living by the side of the Bhagirathi and bathing in its sacred waters.

data.v: स्पृष्टानि येषां गाङ्गेयैस्तोयैर्गात्राणि देहिनाम् । न्यस्तानि न पुनस्तेषां त्यागः स्वर्गाद्विधीयते ॥
data.md: Those creatures whose bodies have been sprinkled with the sacred waters of Bhagirathi or whose bones have been laid in that sacred stream, have not to fall away from heaven at any time.

data.v: सर्वाणि येषां गाङ्गेयैस्तोयैः कृत्यानि देहिनाम् । गां त्यक्त्वा मानवा विप्र दिवि तिष्ठन्ति तेऽचलाः ॥
data.md: Those men, O learned Brahmana, who use the waters of Bhagirathi in all their acts surely go to heaven after death.

data.v: पूर्वे वयसि कर्माणि कृत्वा पापानि ये नराः । पश्चाद्गङ्गां निषेवन्ते तेऽपि यान्त्युत्तमां गतिम् ॥
data.md: Even those men who, having committed various sinful deeds in the first part of their lives, live in after years by the side of Ganga, succeed in attaining to a very superior end.

data.v: स्नातानां शुचिभिस्तोयैर्गाङ्गेयैः प्रयतात्मनाम् । व्युष्टिर्भवति या पुंसां न सा क्रतुशतैरपि ॥
data.md: Hundreds of sacrifices cannot yield that merit which men of controlled souls are capable of acquiring by bathing in the sacred waters of Ganga.

data.v: यावदस्थि मनुष्यस्य गङ्गातोयेषु तिष्ठति । तावद्वर्षसहस्राणि स्वर्गं प्राप्य महीयते ॥
data.md: A person is respected and adored in the celestial region for as long a period as his bones lie in the channel of Ganga.

data.v: अपहत्य तमस्तीव्रं यथा भात्युदये रविः । तथापहत्य पाप्मानं भाति गङ्गाजलोक्षितः ॥
data.md: Even as the Sun, when he rises at the dawn of day, shines, having removed the darkness of night, likewise the person who has bathed in the waters of Ganga is seen to shine, purged of all his sins.

data.v: विसोमा इव शर्वर्यो विपुष्पास्तरवो यथा । तद्वद्देशा दिशश्चैव हीना गङ्गाजलैः शुभैः ॥
data.md: The countries and the points of the compass which are destitute of the sacred waters of Ganga are like nights without the moon or trees without flowers. Indeed a world without Ganga is like the different castes and modes of life when they are shorn of virtue or like sacrifices without Soma.

data.v: वर्णाश्रमा यथा सर्वे स्वधर्मज्ञानवर्जिताः । क्रतवश्च यथासोमास्तथा गङ्गां विना जगत् ॥
data.md: The countries and the points of the compass which are destitute of the sacred waters of Ganga are like nights without the moon or trees without flowers. Indeed a world without Ganga is like the different castes and modes of life when they are shorn of virtue or like sacrifices without Soma.

data.v: यथा हीनं नभोऽर्केण भूः शैलैः खं च वायुना । तथा देशा दिशश्चैव गङ्गाहीना न संशयः ॥
data.md: Forsooth countries and points of the compass which are without Ganga are like the sky without the sun or the Earth without mountains, or the etherial region without air.

data.v: त्रिषु लोकेषु ये केचित्प्राणिनः सर्व एव ते । तर्प्यमाणाः परां तृप्तिं यान्ति गङ्गाजलैः शुभैः ॥
data.md: All the creatures in the three worlds, if served with the sacred waters of Ganga, derive a pleasure the like of which they cannot derive from any other source.

data.v: यस्तु सूर्येण निष्टप्तं गाङ्गेयं पिबते जलम् । गवां निर्हारनिर्मुक्ताद्यावकात्तद्विशिष्यते ॥
data.md: He who drinks Ganga water which has been heated by the Sun's rays, derives merit much greater than that which belongs to the vow of living upon the wheat or grains or other corn picked up from cowdung.

data.v: इन्दुव्रतसहस्रं तु चरेद्यः कायशोधनम् । पिबेद्यश्चापि गङ्गाम्भः समौ स्यातां न वा समौ ॥
data.md: It cannot be said whether, he who performs a thousand Chandrayana rites for purifying his body and he who drinks the water of Ganga, are equal.

data.v: तिष्ठेद्युगसहस्रं तु पादेनैकेन यः पुमान् । मासमेकं तु गङ्गायां समौ स्यातां न वा समौ ॥
data.md: It cannot be said whether one who stands for a thousand years on one foot and one who lives for only a month by the side of Ganga are equal.

data.v: लम्बेतावाक्शिरा यस्तु युगानामयुतं पुमान् । तिष्ठेद्यथेष्टं यश्चापि गङ्गायां स विशिष्यते ॥
data.md: One who lives permanently by the side of Ganga is superior in merit to one who lives for ten thousand cycles with head hanging downwards.

data.v: अग्नौ प्राप्तं प्रधूयेत यथा तूलं द्विजोत्तम । तथा गङ्गावगाढस्य सर्वं पापं प्रधूयते ॥
data.md: As cotton, when it comes into contact with fire, is burnt off without a residue, so the sins of the person that has bathed in Ganga become perfectly consumed.

data.v: भूतानामिह सर्वेषां दुःखोपहतचेतसाम् । गतिमन्वेषमाणानां न गङ्गासदृशी गतिः ॥
data.md: There is no end superior to Ganga for those creatures who, with hearts afflicted by sorrow, seek to attain to ends which may remove that sorrow of theirs.

data.v: भवन्ति निर्विषाः सर्पा यथा तार्क्ष्यस्य दर्शनात् । गङ्गाया दर्शनात्तद्वत्सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ॥
data.md: As snakes become shorn of their poison as soon as they see Garuda, so one becomes purged of all his sins as soon as he sees the sacred river Ganga.

data.v: अप्रतिष्ठाश्च ये केचिदधर्मशरणाश्च ये । तेषां प्रतिष्ठा गङ्गेह शरणं शर्म वर्म च ॥
data.md: They who do not enjoy fame for virtue and they who are addicted to deeds of sinfulness, have Ganga for their fame, their protection, their means of safety their refuge or cover.

data.v: प्रकृष्टैरशुभैर्ग्रस्ताननेकैः पुरुषाधमान् । पततो नरके गङ्गा संश्रितान्प्रेत्य तारयेत् ॥
data.md: Many wretched men who commit various sins of a heinous nature, when they are about to sink into hell, are rescued by Ganga in the next world.

data.v: ते संविभक्ता मुनिभिर्नूनं देवैः सवासवैः । येऽभिगच्छन्ति सततं गङ्गामभिगतां सुरैः ॥
data.md: They, O foremost of intelligent men, who plunge every day in the sacred waters of Ganga, become the equals of great Munis and the very deities headed by Indra.

data.v: विनयाचारहीनाश्च अशिवाश्च नराधमाः । ते भवन्ति शिवा विप्र ये वै गङ्गां समाश्रिताः ॥
data.md: Those wretched men who are destitute of humility or modesty of behaviour and who are greatly sinful, become righteous and good, O Brahmana, by living by the side of Ganga.

data.v: यथा सुराणाममृतं पितॄणां च यथा स्वधा । सुधा यथा च नागानां तथा गङ्गाजलं नृणाम् ॥
data.md: As ambrosia is to the deities, as Svadha is to the Pitris, as Svadha is to the Nagas, so is Gangawater to human beings.

data.v: उपासते यथा बाला मातरं क्षुधयार्दिताः । श्रेयस्कामास्तथा गङ्गामुपासन्तीह देहिनः ॥
data.md: As children stricken with hunger, solicit their mothers for food, similarly do people desirous of their highest good seek Ganga.

data.v: स्वायंभुवं यथा स्थानं सर्वेषां श्रेष्ठमुच्यते । स्नातानां सरितां श्रेष्ठा गङ्गा तद्वदिहोच्यते ॥
data.md: As the region of the selfcreate Brahman is said to be the foremost of all places, so is Ganga said to be foremost of all rivers for those who desire to bathe.

data.v: यथोपजीविनां धेनुर्देवादीनां धरा स्मृता । तथोपजीविनां गङ्गा सर्वप्राणभृतामिह ॥
data.md: As the Earth and the cow are said to be the chief sustenance of the celestials, so is Ganga the chief sustenance of all living creatures.

data.v: देवाः सोमार्कसंस्थानि यथा सत्रादिभिर्मखैः । अमृतान्युपजीवन्ति तथा गङ्गाजलं नराः ॥
data.md: As the celestials support themselves upon the ambrosia that is in the Sun and the Moon and that is offered in various sacrifices, so do human beings support themselves upon Gangawater.

data.v: जाह्नवीपुलिनोत्थाभिः सिकताभिः समुक्षितः । मन्यते पुरुषोऽऽत्मानं दिविष्ठमिव शोभितम् ॥
data.md: One besmeared with the sand taken from the shores of Ganga considers oneself as an inhabitant of heaven, adorned with celestial unguents.

data.v: जाह्नवीतीरसंभूतां मृदं मूर्ध्ना बिभर्ति यः । बिभर्ति रूपं सोऽर्कस्य तमोनाशात्सुनिर्मलम् ॥
data.md: He who bears on his head the mud taken from the banks of Ganga looks effulgent like the sun himself bent on removing the surrounding darkness.

data.v: गङ्गोर्मिभिरथो दिग्धः पुरुषं पवनो यदा । स्पृशते सोऽपि पाप्मानं सद्य एवापमार्जति ॥
data.md: When the wind which is moistened with the particles of Gangawater touches one's body, it cleanses him immediately of every sin.

data.v: व्यसनैरभितप्तस्य नरस्य विनशिष्यतः । गङ्गादर्शनजा प्रीतिर्व्यसनान्यपकर्षति ॥
data.md: A person afflicted by calamities and about to sink under their pressures finds all his calamities removed by the joy which originates in his heart on seeing that sacred river.

data.v: हंसारावैः कोकरवै रवैरन्यैश्च पक्षिणाम् । पस्पर्ध गङ्गा गन्धर्वान्पुलिनैश्च शिलोच्चयान् ॥
data.md: By the sweet notes of the swans and Kokas and other aquatic fowl that play on her breast, Ganga, challenges the very Gandharvas and by her high banks the very mountains on the Earth.

data.v: हंसादिभिः सुबहुभिर्विविधैः पक्षिभिर्वृताम् । गङ्गां गोकुलसंबाधां दृष्ट्वा स्वर्गोऽपि विस्मृतः ॥
data.md: Seeing her surface teeming with swans and various other aquatic fowl, and having banks adorned with pasture lands with kine grazing on them, the celestial region herself loses her pride.

data.v: न सा प्रीतिर्दिविष्ठस्य सर्वकामानुपाश्नतः । अभवद्या परा प्रीतिर्गङ्गायाः पुलिने नृणाम् ॥
data.md: The high happiness which one enjoys by living on the banks of Ganga, can never be his who is living even in the celestial region.

data.v: वाङ्मनःकर्मजैर्ग्रस्तः पापैरपि पुमानिह । वीक्ष्य गङ्गां भवेत्पूतस्तत्र मे नास्ति संशयः ॥
data.md: I have no doubt in this that the person who is afflicted with sins perpetrated in words and thought and act, becomes cleansed on seeing Ganga.

data.v: सप्तावरान्सप्त परान्पितॄंस्तेभ्यश्च ये परे । पुमांस्तारयते गङ्गां वीक्ष्य स्पृष्ट्वावगाह्य च ॥
data.md: By seeing that sacred river, touching it, and bathing in its waters, one rescues his ancestors to the seventh degree, and his descendants to the seventh degeree, as also other ancestors and descendants.

data.v: श्रुताभिलषिता दृष्टा स्पृष्टा पीतावगाहिता । गङ्गा तारयते नॄणामुभौ वंशौ विशेषतः ॥
data.md: By hearing of Ganga, by wishing to go to that river, by drinking its waters, by touching those waters, and by bathing in them , a person rescues both his paternal and maternal families.

data.v: दर्शनात्स्पर्शनात्पानात्तथा गङ्गेति कीर्तनात् । पुनात्यपुण्यान्पुरुषाञ्शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ॥
data.md: By seeing touching and drinking the waters of Ganga, or by praising them, hundreds and thousands of sinful men become purged of all their sins.

data.v: य इच्छेत्सफलं जन्म जीवितं श्रुतमेव च । स पितॄंस्तर्पयेद्गङ्गामभिगम्य सुरांस्तथा ॥
data.md: They who wish to make their birth, life, and learning successful, should go to Ganga and please the departed manes and the celestials by offering them oblations of water.

data.v: न सुतैर्न च वित्तेन कर्मणा न च तत्फलम् । प्राप्नुयात्पुरुषोऽत्यन्तं गङ्गां प्राप्य यदाप्नुयात् ॥
data.md: The merit that one acquires by bathing in Ganga is such that the like of it is incapable of being acquired through the acquisition of sons or riches or the performance of meritorious acts.

data.v: जात्यन्धैरिह तुल्यास्ते मृतैः पङ्गुभिरेव च । समर्था ये न पश्यन्ति गङ्गां पुण्यजलां शिवाम् ॥
data.md: Those who, although physically able do not seek to see the sacred Ganga, are, forsooth, comparable persons suffering from congenital blindness or those who are dead or those who are benumbed through palsy or lameness.

data.v: भूतभव्यभविष्यज्ञैर्महर्षिभिरुपस्थिताम् । देवैः सेन्द्रैश्च को गङ्गां नोपसेवेत मानवः ॥
data.md: What is there who would not respect this sacred river that is adored by great Rishis knowing the Present the Past and the Future, as also by the very gods headed by Indra? to

data.v: वानप्रस्थैर्गृहस्थैश्च यतिभिर्ब्रह्मचारिभिः । विद्यावद्भिः श्रितां गङ्गां पुमान्को नाम नाश्रयेत् ॥
data.md: What man is there who wouldnot seek the protection of Ganga whose protection is sought by hermits and householders, by Yatis and Brahmacharins alike?

data.v: उत्क्रामद्भिश्च यः प्राणैः प्रयतः शिष्टसंमतः । चिन्तयेन्मनसा गङ्गां स गतिं परमां लभेत् ॥
data.md: The virtuous man with controlled mind, thinks of Ganga at the time when his vital airs are about to leave his body, succeeds in acquiring the highest end.

data.v: न भयेभ्यो भयं तस्य न पापेभ्यो न राजतः । आ देहपतनाद्गङ्गामुपास्ते यः पुमानिह ॥
data.md: That man who lives by the side of Ganga up to the time of his death, worshipping her reverentially, becomes freed from all fear of sin and of kings.

data.v: गगनाद्यां महापुण्यां पतन्तीं वै महेश्वरः । दधार शिरसा देवीं तामेव दिवि सेवते ॥
data.md: When that highly sacred river dropped from the sky, Maheshvara held it on his head. It is that very river which is worshipped in heaven.

data.v: अलंकृतास्त्रयो लोकाः पथिभिर्विमलैस्त्रिभिः । यस्तु तस्या जलं सेवेत्कृतकृत्यः पुमान्भवेत् ॥
data.md: The three regions are beautiful by the three courses of this sacred river. The man who uses the waters of that river, becomes certainly successful.

data.v: दिवि ज्योतिर्यथादित्यः पितॄणां चैव चन्द्रमाः । देवेशश्च यथा नॄणां गङ्गेह सरितां तथा ॥
data.md: As the solar ray is to the gods in the celestial region, as the moon is to the departed manes, as the king is to human beings, so is Ganga to all rivers.

data.v: मात्रा पित्रा सुतैर्दारैर्वियुक्तस्य धनेन वा । न भवेद्धि तथा दुःखं यथा गङ्गावियोगजम् ॥
data.md: One who becomes bereaved of mother or father or sons or wives or riches does not feel that grief which one feels when he becomes bereaved of Ganga.

data.v: नारण्यैर्नेष्टविषयैर्न सुतैर्न धनागमैः । तथा प्रसादो भवति गङ्गां वीक्ष्य यथा नृणाम् ॥
data.md: One does not get that joy through acts that lead to the region of Brahman, or through such sacrifices and rites that lead to heaven, or through children or riches, which one get from seeing Ganga.

data.v: पूर्णमिन्दुं यथा दृष्ट्वा नृणां दृष्टिः प्रसीदति । गङ्गां त्रिपथगां दृष्ट्वा तथा दृष्टिः प्रसीदति ॥
data.md: The pleasure that men derive from seeing Ganga is tantamount to what they derive from seeing the full moon.

data.v: तद्भावस्तद्गतमनास्तन्निष्ठस्तत्परायणः । गङ्गां योऽनुगतो भक्त्या स तस्याः प्रियतां व्रजेत् ॥
data.md: That man becomes dear to Ganga who worship her with deep devotion, with mind wholly fixed upon her, with a respect that refuses to take in any other object within its sphere, with a feeling that there is nothing else in the universe worthy of similar adoration, and with a steadiness that knows no decrease.

data.v: भूःस्थैः खस्थैर्दिविष्ठैश्च भूतैरुच्चावचैरपि । गङ्गा विगाह्या सततमेतत्कार्यतमं सताम् ॥
data.md: Creatures who live on Earth, in the sky or in the celestial region indeed, even beings who are very superior, should always bathe in Ganga. Indeed, this is the foremost of all duties of the righteous.

data.v: त्रिषु लोकेषु पुण्यत्वाद्गङ्गायाः प्रथितं यशः । यत्पुत्रान्सगरस्यैषा भस्माख्याननयद्दिवम् ॥
data.md: The fame of Ganga for sanctity has spread over the entire universe, since she carried all the sons of Sagara, who had been reduced to ashes, from here to the celestial region,

data.v: वाय्वीरिताभिः सुमहास्वनाभि;र्द्रुताभिरत्यर्थसमुच्छ्रिताभिः । गङ्गोर्मिभिर्भानुमतीभिरिद्धः; सहस्ररश्मिप्रतिमो विभाति ॥
data.md: Men who are washed by the bright, beautiful, high, and rapidly moving waves, raised by the wind, of Ganga, become purged of all their sins and resemble in splendour the Sun with his thousand rays.

data.v: पयस्विनीं घृतिनीमत्युदारां; समृद्धिनीं वेगिनीं दुर्विगाह्याम् । गङ्गां गत्वा यैः शरीरं विसृष्टं; गता धीरास्ते विबुधैः समत्वम् ॥
data.md: Those men of tranquil souls who have renounced their bodies in the waters of Ganga whose sanctity is as great as that of the butter and other liquids poured in sacrifices and which are capable of giving merits equal to those of the greatest of sacrifices, have certainly attained to a station equal to that of the very gods.

data.v: अन्धाञ्जडान्द्रव्यहीनांश्च गङ्गा; यशस्विनी बृहती विश्वरूपा । देवैः सेन्द्रैर्मुनिभिर्मानवैश्च; निषेविता सर्वकामैर्युनक्ति ॥
data.md: Indeed, Ganga, having faine and vast extent and at one with the entire universe and respected by the deities headed by Indra, the Munis, and human beings, is competent to grant the fruition of all their wishes io them who are blind, to them who are idiots, and to them who are destitute of all things.

data.v: ऊर्जावतीं मधुमतीं महापुण्यां त्रिवर्त्मगाम् । त्रिलोकगोप्त्रीं ये गङ्गां संश्रितास्ते दिवं गताः ॥
data.md: They who seek refuge with Ganga, that protectress of all the universe, that flows in three currents, that is filled with water at once highly sacred and sweet as honey and productive of every sort of good, have succeeded in acquiring the beatitude of Heaven.

data.v: यो वत्स्यति द्रक्ष्यति वापि मर्त्य;स्तस्मै प्रयच्छन्ति सुखानि देवाः । तद्भाविताः स्पर्शने दर्शने य;स्तस्मै देवा गतिमिष्टां दिशन्ति ॥
data.md: That mortal who live by the side of Ganga and sees her every day, becomes purified by her sight and touch. To him the gods give every sort of happiness here and a high end hereafter.

data.v: दक्षां पृथ्वीं बृहतीं विप्रकृष्टां; शिवामृतां सुरसां सुप्रसन्नाम् । विभावरीं सर्वभूतप्रतिष्ठां; गङ्गां गता ये त्रिदिवं गतास्ते ॥
data.md: Ganga is regarded as competent to rescue every creature from sin and lead him to the happiness of Heaven. She is held to be at one with Prishni the mother of Vishnu. She is identical with the Word or Speech. She is very remote and can not be easily attained. She is the embodiment of auspiciousness, and prosperity. She is capable granting the six wellknown attributes beginning with lordship or power. She is always bent upon showing her grace. She is the displayer of all things in the universe, and she is the great resort of all creatures. Those who seek her protection in this life have surely acquired heaven.

data.v: ख्यातिर्यस्याः खं दिवं गां च नित्यं; पुरा दिशो विदिशश्चावतस्थे । तस्या जलं सेव्य सरिद्वराया; मर्त्याः सर्वे कृतकृत्या भवन्ति ॥
data.md: The fame of Ganga has spread all over the sky, and Heaven, and Earth, and all the points, cardinal and subsidiary, of the compass. By using the waters of that foremost of rivers, mortal creatures always become crowned with high success.

data.v: इयं गङ्गेति नियतं प्रतिष्ठा; गुहस्य रुक्मस्य च गर्भयोषा । प्रातस्त्रिमार्गा घृतवहा विपाप्मा; गङ्गावतीर्णा वियतो विश्वतोया ॥
