data.md: That person who, himself seeing Ganga, points her out to others, finds that Ganga rescues him from rebirth and confers Liberation on him. Ganga held Guha, the commander-in-chief of the celestial army in her womb. She bears the most precious of all metals, viz., gold, also in that womb of hers. They who bathe in her waters every day in the morning, succeed in obtaining the three-fold objects, viz., Virtue and Wordly Profit and Pleasure. Those waters are, again, equal in point of sanctity to the butter that is poured with Mantras on the sacrificial fire. Capable of purging one from every sin, she has descended from the celestial region and her current is held in high regard by every one.

data.v: सुतावनीध्रस्य हरस्य भार्या; दिवो भुवश्चापि कक्ष्यानुरूपा । भव्या पृथिव्या भाविनी भाति राज;न्गङ्गा लोकानां पुण्यदा वै त्रयाणाम् ॥
data.md: Ganga is the daughter of Himavat, the wife of Hara, and the ornament of both Heaven and Earth. She is the bestower of everything auspicious, and is competent to give the six well known attributes beginning with lordship or power. Indeed, O king, Ganga is the one object of great sanctity in the three worlds and confers merit upon all.

data.v: मधुप्रवाहा घृतरागोद्धृताभि;र्महोर्मिभिः शोभिता ब्राह्मणैश्च । दिवश्च्युता शिरसात्ता भवेन; गङ्गावनीध्रास्त्रिदिवस्य माला ॥
data.md: Truly, O king, Ganga is Virtue in liquefied i form. She is energy in a liquid forin over the Earth. She is gifted with the splendour or power that belongs to the butter that is poured with Mantras on the sacrificial fire. She is always adorned with large waves as also with Brahmanas who may at all times be seen making their ablutions in her waters. Falling from Heaven, she was held by Shiva on his head. The very mother of the heavens, she has originated from the highest mountain for running over the plains and conferring the most valuable benefits on all creatures of the Earth.

data.v: योनिर्वरिष्ठा विरजा वितन्वी; शुष्मा इरा वारिवहा यशोदा । विश्वावती चाकृतिरिष्टिरिद्धा; गङ्गोक्षितानां भुवनस्य पन्थाः ॥
data.md: She is the highest cause of all things; she is perfectly pure. She is as subtile as Brahma. She is the best bed for the dying. She takes creatures speedily to the celestial region. She carries a large volume of water. She confers great fame on all. She is the protectress of the universe. She is at one with every forin. She is very much coveted by persons crowned with success. Indeed, Ganga is the path to that celestial region of those who have bathed in her water.

data.v: क्षान्त्या मह्या गोपने धारणे च; दीप्त्या कृशानोस्तपनस्य चैव । तुल्या गङ्गा संमता ब्राह्मणानां; गुहस्य ब्रह्मण्यतया च नित्यम् ॥
data.md: The Brahmanas consider Ganga as being equal to the Earth in forgiveness, and in the protection and upholding of those who live by her, further, as equalling Fire and the Sun in energy and splendour; and, lastly, as always equalling Guha himself in the matter of showing favours to the trueborn class.

data.v: ऋषिष्टुतां विष्णुपदीं पुराणीं; सुपुण्यतोयां मनसापि लोके । सर्वात्मना जाह्नवीं ये प्रपन्ना;स्ते ब्रह्मणः सदनं संप्रयाताः ॥
data.md: Those men who, in the life, even in their minds seek that sacred river which is lauded by the Rishis, which has come out of the feet of Vishnu, which is very ancient, and which is highly sacred succeed in going to the regions of Brahman.

data.v: लोकानिमान्नयति या जननीव पुत्रा;न्सर्वात्मना सर्वगुणोपपन्ना । स्वस्थानमिष्टमिह ब्राह्ममभीप्समानै;र्गङ्गा सदैवात्मवशैरुपास्या ॥
data.md: Fully convinced that children and other belongings, as also regions possessed of every kind of happiness, are transitory or frail, men of subdued souls, who are desirous of acquiring that everlasting station which is at one with Brahina, always pay their adorations to Ganga with that respect and love which are due from a son to a mother.

data.v: उस्रां जुष्टां मिषतीं विश्वतोया;मिरां वज्रीं रेवतीं भूधराणाम् । शिष्टाश्रयाममृतां ब्रह्मकान्तां; गङ्गां श्रयेदात्मवान्सिद्धिकामः ॥
data.md: The man of purified soul who is desirous of acquiring success should seek the protection of Ganga who is like a cow that gives ambrosia instead of ordinary milk, who is prosperity's self, who is endued with omniscience, who exists for all creatures, who is the source of all sorts of food, who is the mother of all mountains, who is the refuge of all pious persons, who is immeasurable in power and energy and who charms the heart of Brahman himself.

data.v: प्रसाद्य देवान्सविभून्समस्ता;न्भगीरथस्तपसोग्रेण गङ्गाम् । गामानयत्तामभिगम्य शश्व;न्पुमान्भयं नेह नामुत्र विद्यात् ॥
data.md: Having, with austere penances, pleased all the gods with the Supreme Lord (Vishnu), Bhagiratha brought Ganga down on the Earth. Going to her, men always succeed in freeing themselves from every sort of fear both here and hereafter.

data.v: उदाहृतः सर्वथा ते गुणानां; मयैकदेशः प्रसमीक्ष्य बुद्ध्या । शक्तिर्न मे काचिदिहास्ति वक्तुं; गुणान्सर्वान्परिमातुं तथैव ॥
data.md: Observing with the help of intelligence, I have mentioned to you only a small portion of the merits of Ganga. My power, however, is inadequate to speak of all the merits of the sacred river, or indeed, to measure her power and sanctity.

data.v: मेरोः समुद्रस्य च सर्वरत्नैः; संख्योपलानामुदकस्य वापि । वक्तुं शक्यं नेह गङ्गाजलानां; गुणाख्यानं परिमातुं तथैव ॥
data.md: One may, displaying his best powers, count the stones of the mountain Meru or measure the waters of the ocean. But one cannot count all the merits of the waters of Ganga.

data.v: तस्मादिमान्परया श्रद्धयोक्ता;न्गुणान्सर्वाञ्जाह्नवीजांस्तथैव । भजेद्वाचा मनसा कर्मणा च; भक्त्या युक्तः परया श्रद्दधानः ॥
data.md: Hence, having listened to these particular merits of Ganga which I have uttered with great devotion, one should in thought, word and deed, respect them with faith and devotion.

data.v: लोकानिमांस्त्रीन्यशसा वितत्य; सिद्धिं प्राप्य महतीं तां दुरापाम् । गङ्गाकृतानचिरेणैव लोका;न्यथेष्टमिष्टान्विचरिष्यसि त्वम् ॥
data.md: On account of your having listened to those merits which I have recounted, you are sure to fill all the three regions with fame and acquire a measure of success that is very large and that is difficult of being won by any other person. Indeed, you will soon after that, sport in joy in many a region of great happiness created by Ganga herself for those that respect her.

data.v: तव मम च गुणैर्महानुभावा; जुषतु मतिं सततं स्वधर्मयुक्तैः । अभिगतजनवत्सला हि गङ्गा; भजति युनक्ति सुखैश्च भक्तिमन्तम् ॥
data.md: Ganga always extends her favour to those who are devoted to her in huinbleness of heart. She unites those who are so devoted to her with every kind of happiness. I pray that the highly blessed Ganga may always inspire your heart and mine with the attributes of virtue.

data.v: इति परममतिर्गुणाननेका;ञ्शिलरतये त्रिपथानुयोगरूपान् । बहुविधमनुशास्य तथ्यरूपा;न्गगनतलं द्युतिमान्विवेश सिद्धः ॥
data.md: Bhishma said The learned ascetic gifted with high soul and great slendour and crowned with success having in this manner described to that poor Brahmana observing the Shila vow, on the subject of the infinite merits of Ganga, then ascended the sky.

data.v: शिलवृत्तिस्तु सिद्धस्य वाक्यैः संबोधितस्तदा । गङ्गामुपास्य विधिवत्सिद्धिं प्राप्तः सुदुर्लभाम् ॥
data.md: The poor Brahmana observing the Shila vow, awakened by the words of that ascetic crowned with success, duly sought refuge with Ganga and acquired great success.

data.v: तस्मात्त्वमपि कौन्तेय भक्त्या परमया युतः । गङ्गामभ्येहि सततं प्राप्स्यसे सिद्धिमुत्तमाम् ॥
data.md: Do you also, O son of Kunti, seek Ganga with great devotion for you will then, as the reward thereof, acquire great and excellent Success.

data.v: श्रुत्वेतिहासं भीष्मोक्तं गङ्गायाः स्तवसंयुतम् । युधिष्ठिरः परां प्रीतिमगच्छद्भ्रातृभिः सह ॥
data.md: Vaishampayana said Hearing this discourse from Bhishma of the praise of Ganga, Yudhishthira with his brothers became filled with great joy.

data.v: इतिहासमिमं पुण्यं शृणुयाद्यः पठेत वा । गङ्गायाः स्तवसंयुक्तं स मुच्येत्सर्वकिल्बिषैः ॥
data.md: That person who recites or hears recited this sacred topic of the praise of Ganga, becomes purged of every sin.

data.v: प्रज्ञाश्रुताभ्यां वृत्तेन शीलेन च यथा भवान् । गुणैः समुदितः सर्वैर्वयसा च समन्वितः । तस्माद्भवन्तं पृच्छामि धर्मं धर्मभृतां वर ॥
data.md: Yudhishthira said You, O grandfather, are endued with wisdom and knowledge of the scriptures, with conduct and behaviour, with various kinds of excellent attributes and also with years.

data.v: क्षत्रियो यदि वा वैश्यः शूद्रो वा राजसत्तम । ब्राह्मण्यं प्राप्नुयात्केन तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि ॥
data.md: There is not another man, O king, in all the worlds, who is worthier of being accosted on such topics. O best of kings, how may one, if he happens to be a Kshatriya or a Vaishya or a Shudra, succeed in acquiring the dignity of a Brahmana? You should tell nic the means. Is it by the most austere penances or by religious acts or by knowledge of the scriptures, that a person belonging to any of the three inferior castes succeeds in acquiring the dignity of Brahmana? Do tell me this, O grandfather.

data.v: तपसा वा सुमहता कर्मणा वा श्रुतेन वा । ब्राह्मण्यमथ चेदिच्छेत्तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह ॥
data.md: There is not another man, O king, in all the worlds, who is worthier of being accosted on such topics. O best of kings, how may one, if he happens to be a Kshatriya or a Vaishya or a Shudra, succeed in acquiring the dignity of a Brahmana? You should tell nic the means. Is it by the most austere penances or by religious acts or by knowledge of the scriptures, that a person belonging to any of the three inferior castes succeeds in acquiring the dignity of Brahmana? Do tell me this, O grandfather.

data.v: ब्राह्मण्यं तात दुष्प्रापं वर्णैः क्षत्रादिभिस्त्रिभिः । परं हि सर्वभूतानां स्थानमेतद्युधिष्ठिर ॥
data.md: Bhishma said The dignity of a Brahmana, O Yudhishthira, cannot be acquired by a person belonging to any of the three other castes. That dignity is the highest with respect to all creatures.

data.v: बह्वीस्तु संसरन्योनीर्जायमानः पुनः पुनः । पर्याये तात कस्मिंश्चिद्ब्राह्मणो नाम जायते ॥
data.md: Passing through numberless orders of existence by undergoing repeated births, one at last in some birth, becomes born as a Brahmana.

data.v: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् । मतङ्गस्य च संवादं गर्दभ्याश्च युधिष्ठिर ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Regarding it is cited the old discourse between Ashtavakra and the lady known by the name of Disha.

data.v: द्विजातेः कस्यचित्तात तुल्यवर्णः सुतः प्रभुः । मतङ्गो नाम नाम्नाभूत्सर्वैः समुदितो गुणैः ॥
data.md: Once on a time a Brahmana obtained a son who, though procerated by a person belonging 10 a different caste, had, however, the rites of infancy and youth performed according to the ordinances laid down for Brahmanas. The Child passed by the name of Matanga and was endued with every accomplishment.

data.v: स यज्ञकारः कौन्तेय पित्रा सृष्टः परंतप । प्रायाद्गर्दभयुक्तेन रथेनेहाशुगामिना ॥
data.md: His father wishing to celebrate a sacrifice, ordered him, O destroyer of enemies, to collect the articles required for the act. Having received the command of his father, he started for the purpose, riding on a quick coursing car, drawn by an ass.

data.v: स बालं गर्दभं राजन्वहन्तं मातुरन्तिके । निरविध्यत्प्रतोदेन नासिकायां पुनः पुनः ॥
data.md: It so happened that the ass yoked to that car was very young. Instead, therefore of being reined, the animal bore away the car near its dam. viz., the she-ass that had brought it forth. Malanga, dissatisfied with this, began to strike the animal with his goad on its nose.

data.v: तं तु तीव्रव्रणं दृष्ट्वा गर्दभी पुत्रगृद्धिनी । उवाच मा शुचः पुत्र चण्डालस्त्वाधितिष्ठति ॥
data.md: Seeing those marks of violence on her child's nose, the she-ass, full of affection for him, said, Do not grieve, O child, for this treatinent! A Chandala is driving you.

data.v: ब्राह्मणे दारुणं नास्ति मैत्रो ब्राह्मण उच्यते । आचार्यः सर्वभूतानां शास्ता किं प्रहरिष्यति ॥
data.md: There is no harshness in a Brahmana. The Brahmana is said to be the friend of all creatures. He is the teacher also of all creatures and their ruler. Can he punish any creature so cruelly.

data.v: अयं तु पापप्रकृतिर्बाले न कुरुते दयाम् । स्वयोनिं मानयत्येष भावो भावं निगच्छति ॥
data.md: This fellow, however, is of sinful deeds. He has no mercy to show to even such a young creature. He is simply proving the order of his birth by behaving thus. The nature which he has derived from his father forbids the growth of the sentiments of pity and kindness which are natural to the Brahmana.

data.v: एतच्छ्रुत्वा मतङ्गस्तु दारुणं रासभीवचः । अवतीर्य रथात्तूर्णं रासभीं प्रत्यभाषत ॥
data.md: Hearing these harsh words of the she-ass Matanga speedily came down from the car and addressing the she-ass said, Tell me, O blessed dame, by what fault is my mother stained?

data.v: ब्रूहि रासभि कल्याणि माता मे येन दूषिता । कथं मां वेत्सि चण्डालं क्षिप्रं रासभि शंस मे ॥
data.md: How do you know that I am a Chandala? Do you answer me forthwith,

data.v: केन जातोऽस्मि चण्डालो ब्राह्मण्यं येन मेऽनशत् । तत्त्वेनैतन्महाप्राज्ञे ब्रूहि सर्वमशेषतः ॥
data.md: How, indeed do you know that I am a Chandala? How have I lost the dignity of a Brahman? O you of great wisdom tell me all this fully, from beginning to end.

data.v: ब्राह्मण्यां वृषलेन त्वं मत्तायां नापितेन ह । जातस्त्वमसि चण्डालो ब्राह्मण्यं तेन तेऽनशत् ॥
data.md: The She-ass said You were begotten upon a Brahmana woman worked up with desire, by a Shudra following the calling of a barber. You are therefore, a Chandala by birth. You have not the dignity of a Brahmana.

data.v: एवमुक्तो मतङ्गस्तु प्रत्युपायाद्गृहं प्रति । तमागतमभिप्रेक्ष्य पिता वाक्यमथाब्रवीत् ॥
मया त्वं यज्ञसंसिद्धौ नियुक्तो गुरुकर्मणि । कस्मात्प्रतिनिवृत्तोऽसि कच्चिन्न कुशलं तव ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Thus addressed by the she ass Matanga returned home. Seeing him return. his father said I had engaged you in the difficult task of gathering the requisites of my intended sacrifice! Why have you returned without having accomplished your charge? Is it that you are not all right?

data.v: अयोनिरग्र्ययोनिर्वा यः स्यात्स कुशली भवेत् । कुशलं तु कुतस्तस्य यस्येयं जननी पितः ॥
data.md: Matanga said How can he who belongs to no definite order of birth, or to low caste be regarded as all right and happy? How O father, can that person be happy whose mother is impure.

data.v: ब्राह्मण्यां वृषलाज्जातं पितर्वेदयतीह माम् । अमानुषी गर्दभीयं तस्मात्तप्स्ये तपो महत् ॥
data.md: O father, this sheass, who seems to be more than a human being, tells me that I have been begotten upon a Brahman woman by a Shudra. I shall for this reason, practise the severest penances.

data.v: एवमुक्त्वा स पितरं प्रतस्थे कृतनिश्चयः । ततो गत्वा महारण्यमतप्यत महत्तपः ॥
data.md: Having said these words to his father, and firmly resolved upon what he had said, he went to the great forest and began to practise the austerest of penances.

data.v: ततः संतापयामास विबुधांस्तपसान्वितः । मतङ्गः सुसुखं प्रेप्सुः स्थानं सुचरितादपि ॥
data.md: Beginning those penances for the purpose of happily acquiring the dignity of a Brahmana Matanga began to scorch the very gods by the severity of his asceticism,

data.v: तं तथा तपसा युक्तमुवाच हरिवाहनः । मतङ्ग तप्यसे किं त्वं भोगानुत्सृज्य मानुषान् ॥
data.md: The king of the celestials, viz., Indra, appeared to him thus practising penances and said Why, O Matanga, do you pass your time in such grief, abstaining from all sorts of human enjoyments.

data.v: वरं ददानि ते हन्त वृणीष्व त्वं यदिच्छसि । यच्चाप्यवाप्यमन्यत्ते सर्वं प्रब्रूहि माचिरम् ॥
data.md: I shall give you boons. Do you name the boons. Do not delay, but tell me what is in your mind. Even if it be unattainable, I Shall yet bestow it on you.

data.v: ब्राह्मण्यं कामयानोऽहमिदमारब्धवांस्तपः । गच्छेयं तदवाप्येह वर एष वृतो मया ॥
data.md: Matanga said Desirous of acquiring the dignity of a Brahmana I have begun to practise these penances. After having obtained it, I shall go home. Even this is the boon I pray for.

data.v: एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचनं तमुवाच पुरंदरः । ब्राह्मण्यं प्रार्थयानस्त्वमप्राप्यमकृतात्मभिः ॥
श्रेष्ठं यत्सर्वभूतेषु तपो यन्नातिवर्तते । तदग्र्यं प्रार्थयानस्त्वमचिराद्विनशिष्यसि ॥
data.md: This object of your desire viz., the dignity of Brahmana, which is the foremost of everything, cannot be even acquired by penances. Therefore by coveting that foremost dignity, you will surely meet with destruction.

data.v: देवतासुरमर्त्येषु यत्पवित्रं परं स्मृतम् । चण्डालयोनौ जातेन न तत्प्राप्यं कथंचन ॥
data.md: One born as a Chandala can never acquire that dignity which is considered as the most sacred among the celestials and Asuras and human beings. once

data.v: एवमुक्तो मतङ्गस्तु संशितात्मा यतव्रतः । अतिष्ठदेकपादेन वर्षाणां शतमच्युत ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Thus addressed by Indra, Matanga of restrained vows and wellcontrolled soul, stood for a century of years on one foot, O you of unfading glory.

data.v: तमुवाच ततः शक्रः पुनरेव महायशाः । मतङ्ग परमं स्थानं प्रार्थयन्नतिदुर्लभम् ॥
मा कृथाः साहसं पुत्र नैष धर्मपथस्तव । अप्राप्यं प्रार्थयानो हि नचिराद्विनशिष्यसि ॥
data.md: O you of foolish understanding, it is impossible for you to obtain it in this world, Verily, by coveting that which is unattainable you are sure to meet with destruction forthwith.

data.v: मतङ्ग परमं स्थानं वार्यमाणो मया सकृत् । चिकीर्षस्येव तपसा सर्वथा न भविष्यसि ॥
data.md: I am repeatedly forbidding you. By trying, however, to attain that high dignity by the help of your penances, despite my repeated admonitions, you are sure to meet with destruction.

data.v: तिर्यग्योनिगतः सर्वो मानुष्यं यदि गच्छति । स जायते पुल्कसो वा चण्डालो वा कदाचन ॥
data.md: From a brute life one gains the status of humanity. If born as a human being, he is sure to be born as a Pukkasha or a Chandala.

data.v: पुंश्चलः पापयोनिर्वा यः कश्चिदिह लक्ष्यते । स तस्यामेव सुचिरं मतङ्ग परिवर्तते ॥
data.md: Verily, one having taken birth in that sinful caste, viz., Pulkasa, one, O Matanga, has to wander in it for a very long time.

data.v: ततो दशगुणे काले लभते शूद्रतामपि । शूद्रयोनावपि ततो बहुशः परिवर्तते ॥
data.md: Passing a period of one thousand years in that order one is next born as a Shudra. In the Shudra order, again, one has to wander for a long time.

data.v: ततस्त्रिंशद्गुणे काले लभते वैश्यतामपि । वैश्यतायां चिरं कालं तत्रैव परिवर्तते ॥
data.md: After thirty thousand years one is born as a Vaishya. There in that order, one has to pass a very long time.

data.v: ततः षष्टिगुणे काले राजन्यो नाम जायते । राजन्यत्वे चिरं कालं तत्रैव परिवर्तते ॥
data.md: After thirty thousand years one is born as a Vaishya. There in that order, one has to pass a very long time.

data.v: ततः षष्टिगुणे काले लभते ब्रह्मबन्धुताम् । ब्रह्मबन्धुश्चिरं कालं तत्रैव परिवर्तते ॥
data.md: After thirty thousand years one is born as a Vaishya. There in that order, one has to pass a very long time.

data.v: ततस्तु द्विशते काले लभते काण्डपृष्ठताम् । काण्डपृष्ठश्चिरं कालं तत्रैव परिवर्तते ॥
data.md: After thirty thousand years one is born as a Vaishya. There in that order, one has to pass a very long time.

data.v: ततस्तु त्रिशते काले लभते द्विजतामपि । तां च प्राप्य चिरं कालं तत्रैव परिवर्तते ॥
data.md: After thirty thousand years one is born as a Vaishya. There in that order, one has to pass a very long time.

data.v: ततश्चतुःशते काले श्रोत्रियो नाम जायते । श्रोत्रियत्वे चिरं कालं तत्रैव परिवर्तते ॥
data.md: After a time measured by multiplying the period last name by three hundred, one is born in the race of a Brahmana that is given to the recitation of the Gayatri and other sacred Mantras. There, in that order, one has to wander for a long period. After a time measured by multiplying the period last named by four hundred, one is born in the race of such a Bralımana who knows the entire Vedas and the scriptures. There, in that order, one has to wander for a very long period.

data.v: तदैव क्रोधहर्षौ च कामद्वेषौ च पुत्रक । अतिमानातिवादौ तमाविशन्ति द्विजाधमम् ॥
data.md: While wandering in that existence, joy and grief, desire and hatred vanity and evil speech, scck to enter into him and make a wretch of him.

data.v: तांश्चेज्जयति शत्रून्स तदा प्राप्नोति सद्गतिम् । अथ ते वै जयन्त्येनं तालाग्रादिव पात्यते ॥
data.md: If he succeeds in subjugating those foes, he then acquires a high end. If, on the other hand, those enemies succeed in subjugating him, he falls down from that high position like a person falling down on the ground from the high top of a palmyra tree.

data.v: मतङ्ग संप्रधार्यैतद्यदहं त्वामचूचुदम् । वृणीष्व काममन्यं त्वं ब्राह्मण्यं हि सुदुर्लभम् ॥
data.md: Knowing this for certain, O Matanga that I say to you do you name some other boon, for the status of a Brahmana is incapable of being acquired by you.

data.v: एवमुक्तो मतङ्गस्तु भृशं शोकपरायणः । अतिष्ठत गयां गत्वा सोऽङ्गुष्ठेन शतं समाः ॥
सुदुष्करं वहन्योगं कृशो धमनिसंततः । त्वगस्थिभूतो धर्मात्मा स पपातेति नः श्रुतम् ॥
data.md: On account of the observance of such Yoga which was extremely difficult to bear, he became very much emaciated and his arteries and veins became swollen and visible. He was reduced to only skin and bones. We have heard that righteous person, while practising those austerities at Gaya, dropped down on the ground from sheer exhaustion.

data.v: तं पतन्तमभिद्रुत्य परिजग्राह वासवः । वराणामीश्वरो दाता सर्वभूतहिते रतः ॥
data.md: Seeing him falling down the lord and giver of boons, engaged in the behoof of all creatures viz., Vasava, speedily came to that spot and held him fast.

data.v: मतङ्ग ब्राह्मणत्वं ते संवृतं परिपन्थिभिः । पूजयन्सुखमाप्नोति दुःखमाप्नोत्यपूजयन् ॥
ब्राह्मणे सर्वभूतानां योगक्षेमः समाहितः । ब्राह्मणेभ्योऽनुतृप्यन्ति पितरो देवतास्तथा ॥
ब्राह्मणः सर्वभूतानां मतङ्ग पर उच्यते । ब्राह्मणः कुरुते तद्धि यथा यद्यच्च वाञ्छति ॥
बह्वीस्तु संसरन्योनीर्जायमानः पुनः पुनः । पर्याये तात कस्मिंश्चिद्ब्राह्मण्यमिह विन्दति ॥
data.md: Passing through numberless orders of existence by undergoing repeated births, one at last in some birth, becomes born as a Brahmana.

data.v: किं मां तुदसि दुःखार्तं मृतं मारयसे च माम् । तं तु शोचामि यो लब्ध्वा ब्राह्मण्यं न बुभूषते ॥
ब्राह्मण्यं यदि दुष्प्रापं त्रिभिर्वर्णैः शतक्रतो । सुदुर्लभं तदावाप्य नानुतिष्ठन्ति मानवाः ॥
data.md: Those who having won the dignity of a Brahmana that, like wealth, is so difficult to acquire, do not seek to keep it up, must be considered as the most wretched in this world. Indeed, they are the most sinful of all creatures.

data.v: यः पापेभ्यः पापतमस्तेषामधम एव सः । ब्राह्मण्यं योऽवजानीते धनं लब्ध्वेव दुर्लभम् ॥
दुष्प्रापं खलु विप्रत्वं प्राप्तं दुरनुपालनम् । दुरवापमवाप्यैतन्नानुतिष्ठन्ति मानवाः ॥
एकारामो ह्यहं शक्र निर्द्वंद्वो निष्परिग्रहः । अहिंसादमदानस्थः कथं नार्हामि विप्रताम् ॥
यथाकामविहारी स्यां कामरूपी विहंगमः । ब्रह्मक्षत्राविरोधेन पूजां च प्राप्नुयामहम् । यथा ममाक्षया कीर्तिर्भवेच्चापि पुरंदर ॥
data.md: I bow to you by bending my head, O god! You should do that also by which my fame, O Purandara, may live eternally in the world!

data.v: छन्दोदेव इति ख्यातः स्त्रीणां पूज्यो भविष्यसि ॥
data.md: Shakra said You will be celebrated as the deity of a particular measure of verse and you will get the worship of all women. Your fame, O son, shall become peerless in the three worlds.

data.v: एवं तस्मै वरं दत्त्वा वासवोऽन्तरधीयत । प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा मतङ्गोऽपि प्राप तत्स्थानमुत्तमम् ॥
एवमेतत्परं स्थानं ब्राह्मण्यं नाम भारत । तच्च दुष्प्रापमिह वै महेन्द्रवचनं यथा ॥
data.md: You may thus see, O Bharata that the dignity of a Brahmana is very high. That dignity is incapable of being acquired here as said by the great Indra himself.

data.v: श्रुतं मे महदाख्यानमेतत्कुरुकुलोद्वह । सुदुष्प्रापं ब्रवीषि त्वं ब्राह्मण्यं वदतां वर ॥
data.md: Yudhishthira said I have heard this great description, 0, perpetuater of Kuru's race. You, O foremost of eloquent men, have said that the dignity of a Brahmana is greatly difficult of acquisition.

data.v: विश्वामित्रेण च पुरा ब्राह्मण्यं प्राप्तमित्युत । श्रूयते वदसे तच्च दुष्प्रापमिति सत्तम ॥
data.md: It is heard, however, that in former times the dignity of a Brahmana had been acquired by Vishvamitra. You, however, O best of men, tell us that dignity is incapable of being won.

data.v: वीतहव्यश्च राजर्षिः श्रुतो मे विप्रतां गतः । तदेव तावद्गाङ्गेय श्रोतुमिच्छाम्यहं विभो ॥
data.md: I have also heard that formerly king Vitahavya had succeeded in acquiring the dignity of a Brahmana. O powerful one, I wish to hear, O son of Ganga, the story of king Vitahavya's promotion.

data.v: स केन कर्मणा प्राप्तो ब्राह्मण्यं राजसत्तम । वरेण तपसा वापि तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हति ॥
data.md: By what acts did that best of kings succeed in acquiring the dignity of a Brahmana? Was it through some boon or was it through the virtue of penances? You should tell me everything.

data.v: शृणु राजन्यथा राजा वीतहव्यो महायशाः । क्षत्रियः सन्पुनः प्राप्तो ब्राह्मण्यं लोकसत्कृतम् ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Hear, O king, how the highly illustrious royal sage Vitahavya succeeded formerly in acquiring the dignity of a Brahmana that is so difficult to attain and that is held in such high esteem by all the world.

data.v: मनोर्महात्मनस्तात प्रजाधर्मेण शासतः । बभूव पुत्रो धर्मात्मा शर्यातिरिति विश्रुतः ॥
data.md: While the great Manu in days of yore was employed in ruling righteously his subjects, he obtained a son of righteous soul who become celebrated under the name of Sharyati.

data.v: तस्यान्ववाये द्वौ राजन्राजानौ संबभूवतुः । हेहयस्तालजङ्घश्च वत्सेषु जयतां वर ॥
data.md: In Sharyati's family, O monarch, two kings were born viz., Haihaya and Talajangha. Both of them were sons of Vatsa, O foremost of victorious kings.

data.v: हेहयस्य तु पुत्राणां दशसु स्त्रीषु भारत । शतं बभूव प्रख्यातं शूराणामनिवर्तिनाम् ॥
तुल्यरूपप्रभावाणां विदुषां युद्धशालिनाम् । धनुर्वेदे च वेदे च सर्वत्रैव कृतश्रमाः ॥
data.md: All of them resembled one another in features and prowess. All of them were gifted with great strength and all of them were possessed of great skill in battle. They all studied the Vedas and the science of weapons thoroughly.

data.v: काशिष्वपि नृपो राजन्दिवोदासपितामहः । हर्यश्व इति विख्यातो बभूव जयतां वरः ॥
data.md: In Kashi also, O monarch, there was a king who was the grandfather of Divodasa. The foremost of victorious men, he passed by the name of Haryashva.

data.v: स वीतहव्यदायादैरागत्य पुरुषर्षभ । गङ्गायमुनयोर्मध्ये संग्रामे विनिपातितः ॥
data.md: The sons of king Haihaya, O chief of men, invaded the kingdom of Kashi, and advancing to the country that lies between the rivers Ganga and Yamuna fought a battle with king Haryashva and killed him in it.

data.v: तं तु हत्वा नरवरं हेहयास्ते महारथाः । प्रतिजग्मुः पुरीं रम्यां वत्सानामकुतोभयाः ॥
data.md: Having killed king Haryashva thus, the sons of Haihaya, those great car warriors fearlessly returned to their own charming city in the country of the Vatsas.

data.v: हर्यश्वस्य तु दायादः काशिराजोऽभ्यषिच्यत । सुदेवो देवसंकाशः साक्षाद्धर्म इवापरः ॥
data.md: Meanwhile Haryashva's son Sudeva who looked like a celestial in splendour and who was a second god of virtue, was installed on the throne of Kashi as its king.

data.v: स पालयन्नेव महीं धर्मात्मा काशिनन्दनः । तैर्वीतहव्यैरागत्य युधि सर्वैर्विनिर्जितः ॥
data.md: The delighter of Kashi, the righteous-souled prince ruled his kingdom for some time when the hundred sons of Vitihavya once more attacked his territories and defeated him in battle.

data.v: तमप्याजौ विनिर्जित्य प्रतिजग्मुर्यथागतम् । सौदेविस्त्वथ काशीशो दिवोदासोऽभ्यषिच्यत ॥
data.md: Having defeated king Sudeva thus, the victors returned to their own city. After this, Divodasa, the son of Sudeva, became installed on the throne of Kashi as its king.

data.v: दिवोदासस्तु विज्ञाय वीर्यं तेषां महात्मनाम् । वाराणसीं महातेजा निर्ममे शक्रशासनात् ॥
data.md: Understanding the prowess of those great princess viz., the sons of Vitihavya, king Divodasa, gifted with great energy, rebuilt and fortified the city of Varanasi at the command of Indra.

data.v: विप्रक्षत्रियसंबाधां वैश्यशूद्रसमाकुलाम् । नैकद्रव्योच्चयवतीं समृद्धविपणापणाम् ॥
data.md: The territories of Divodasa were full of Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, Vaishyas and Shudras. and they teemed with all sorts of articles and provisions, and were adorned with prosperous shops and marts. Those territories O best of kings, extended northwards from the banks of Ganga to the southern Banks of Gomati, and resembled a second Amaravati (the city of Indra).

data.v: गङ्गाया उत्तरे कूले वप्रान्ते राजसत्तम । गोमत्या दक्षिणे चैव शक्रस्येवामरावतीम् ॥
data.md: The territories of Divodasa were full of Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, Vaishyas and Shudras. and they teemed with all sorts of articles and provisions, and were adorned with prosperous shops and marts. Those territories O best of kings, extended northwards from the banks of Ganga to the southern Banks of Gomati, and resembled a second Amaravati (the city of Indra).

data.v: तत्र तं राजशार्दूलं निवसन्तं महीपतिम् । आगत्य हेहया भूयः पर्यधावन्त भारत ॥
data.md: The Haihayas once again, O Bharata, attacked that foremost of kings as he ruled his kingdom.

data.v: स निष्पत्य ददौ युद्धं तेभ्यो राजा महाबलः । देवासुरसमं घोरं दिवोदासो महाद्युतिः ॥
data.md: The powerful king Divodasa gifted with great splendour, issuing out of his capital, gave them battle. The engagement between the two parties terrible like the encounter in days of old between the celestials and the Asuras.

data.v: स तु युद्धे महाराज दिनानां दशतीर्दश । हतवाहनभूयिष्ठस्ततो दैन्यमुपागमत् ॥
data.md: King Divodasa fought the enemy for a thousand days at the end of which, having lost a large number of followers and animals, he became greatly distressed.

data.v: हतयोधस्ततो राजन्क्षीणकोशश्च भूमिपः । दिवोदासः पुरीं हित्वा पलायनपरोऽभवत् ॥
data.md: King Divodasa, O king, having lost his army and seeing his treasury exhausted left his capital and fled away.

data.v: स त्वाश्रममुपागम्य भरद्वाजस्य धीमतः । जगाम शरणं राजा कृताञ्जलिररिंदम ॥
data.md: Going to the charming herinitage of the wise Bharadvaja, the king, O chastiser of foes, joining his hands in respect sought the Rishi's protection.

data.v: भगवन्वैतहव्यैर्मे युद्धे वंशः प्रणाशितः । अहमेकः परिद्यूनो भवन्तं शरणं गतः ॥
data.md: The king said O holy one, the sons of Vitahavya have killed all the children and men of my house. I only have escaped with life, totally discomfited by the enemy, I seek refuge with you.

data.v: शिष्यस्नेहेन भगवन्स मां रक्षितुमर्हसि । निःशेषो हि कृतो वंशो मम तैः पापकर्मभिः ॥
data.md: You should, O holy one, protect me with such affection as you have for a disciple! Those princes of sinful deeds have killed my whole family, leaving myself only alive.

data.v: तमुवाच महाभागो भरद्वाजः प्रतापवान् । न भेतव्यं न भेतव्यं सौदेव व्येतु ते भयम् ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Bharadvaja of great energy said to him who pleaded so piteously Do not fear! Do not fear! O son of Sudeva, let your fears be gone.

data.v: अहमिष्टिं करोम्यद्य पुत्रार्थं ते विशां पते । वैतहव्यसहस्राणि यथा त्वं प्रसहिष्यसि ॥
data.md: son on I shall perform a sacrifice, O monarch, in order that you may have a son through whom you will be able to smite thousand upon thousands of Vitahavya's party.

data.v: तत इष्टिं चकारर्षिस्तस्य वै पुत्रकामिकीम् । अथास्य तनयो जज्ञे प्रतर्दन इति श्रुतः ॥
data.md: After this, the Rishi performed a sacrifice with the object of bestowing a Divodasa. As the result thereof, to Divodasa was born a son named Pratarddana.

data.v: स जातमात्रो ववृधे समाः सद्यस्त्रयोदश । वेदं चाधिजगे कृत्स्नं धनुर्वेदं च भारत ॥
data.md: As soon as he was born, he grew into a child of full three and ten years, and quickly mastered the entire Vedas and the whole sciences of arms.

data.v: योगेन च समाविष्टो भरद्वाजेन धीमता । तेजो लौक्यं स संगृह्य तस्मिन्देशे समाविशत् ॥
data.md: Helped by his Yoga powers, the highly intelligent Bharadvaja had entered into the prince. Indeed, collecting all the energy of the objects of the universe, Bharadvaja caused it to enter the body of prince Pratarddana.

data.v: ततः स कवची धन्वी बाणी दीप्त इवानलः । प्रययौ स धनुर्धुन्वन्विवर्षुरिव तोयदः ॥
तं दृष्ट्वा परमं हर्षं सुदेवतनयो ययौ । मेने च मनसा दग्धान्वैतहव्यान्स पार्थिवः ॥
data.md: Seeing the prince, the son of Sudeva, viz., king Divodasa become filled with joy. Indeed, the old king thought the sons of his enemy Vitahavya as already killed.

data.v: ततस्तं यौवराज्येन स्थापयित्वा प्रतर्दनम् । कृतकृत्यं तदात्मानं स राजा अभ्यनन्दत ॥
data.md: Divodasa then installed his son Pratarddana as the heirapparent, and considering himself crowned with success became highly happy.

data.v: ततस्तु वैतहव्यानां वधाय स महीपतिः । पुत्रं प्रस्थापयामास प्रतर्दनमरिंदमम् ॥
data.md: After this, the old king commanded that chastiser of foes, viz., prince Pratarddana, to march against the sons of Vitahavya and kill them in battle.

data.v: सरथः स तु संतीर्य गङ्गामाशु पराक्रमी । प्रययौ वीतहव्यानां पुरीं परपुरंजयः ॥
data.md: Gifted with great prowess Pratarddana, that subjugator of hostile cities, speedily crossed Ganga on his car and proceeded against the city of the Vitahavyas.

data.v: वैतहव्यास्तु संश्रुत्य रथघोषं समुद्धतम् । निर्ययुर्नगराकारै रथैः पररथारुजैः ॥
data.md: Hearing the clatter of the wheels of his car, the sons of Vitahavya riding on their own cars that looked fortified citadels and that were capable of destroying hostile vehicles, issued out of their city.

data.v: निष्क्रम्य ते नरव्याघ्रा दंशिताश्चित्रयोधिनः । प्रतर्दनं समाजघ्नुः शरवर्षैरुदायुधाः ॥
data.md: Coming out of their capital. those foremost of men., viz., the sons of Vitahavya, who were all skilful warriors cased in mail rushed with uplifted weapons towards Pratarddana, covering him with showers of arrows.

data.v: अस्त्रैश्च विविधाकारै रथौघैश्च युधिष्ठिर । अभ्यवर्षन्त राजानं हिमवन्तमिवाम्बुदाः ॥
data.md: Surrounding him with numberless cars, O Yudhishthira, the Vitahavyas poured upon Pratarddana showers of weapons of various sorts like the clouds pouring torrents of rain on the breast of Himavat.

data.v: अस्त्रैरस्त्राणि संवार्य तेषां राजा प्रतर्दनः । जघान तान्महातेजा वज्रानलसमैः शरैः ॥
data.md: Baffling their weapons with his own, prince Pratarddana gifted with great energy killed them all with arrows that resembled the thunder bolt of Indra.

data.v: कृत्तोत्तमाङ्गास्ते राजन्भल्लैः शतसहस्रशः । अपतन्रुधिरार्द्राङ्गा निकृत्ता इव किंशुकाः ॥
data.md: Their heads cut off, O king, with hundreds and thousands of broad headed arrows, the warriors of Vitahavya dropped down with blood dyed bodies like Kinshuka trees felled on every side by woodmen with their axes.

data.v: हतेषु तेषु सर्वेषु वीतहव्यः सुतेष्वथ । प्राद्रवन्नगरं हित्वा भृगोराश्रममप्युत ॥
data.md: After all his warriors and sons had been killed in battle, king Vitahavya fled away from his capital to the hermitage of Bhrigu.

data.v: ययौ भृगुं च शरणं वीतहव्यो नराधिपः । अभयं च ददौ तस्मै राज्ञे राजन्भृगुस्तथा । ततो ददावासनं च तस्मै शिष्यो भृगोस्तदा ॥
data.md: Indeed, arrived there the royal fugitive sought refuge with Bhrigu. The Rishi Bhrigu, O monarch, assured the defeated king of his protection.

data.v: अथानुपदमेवाशु तत्रागच्छत्प्रतर्दनः । स प्राप्य चाश्रमपदं दिवोदासात्मजोऽब्रवीत् ॥
data.md: Pratarddana followed in the footsteps of Vitahavya. Arrived at the Rishi's hermitage, the son of Divodasa said in a loud voice Ho, listen ye disciples of the great Bhrigu that may happen to be present! I wish to see the sage, Go and inform him of this.

data.v: भो भोः केऽत्राश्रमे सन्ति भृगोः शिष्या महात्मनः । द्रष्टुमिच्छे मुनिमहं तस्याचक्षत मामिति ॥
data.md: Pratarddana followed in the footsteps of Vitahavya. Arrived at the Rishi's hermitage, the son of Divodasa said in a loud voice Ho, listen ye disciples of the great Bhrigu that may happen to be present! I wish to see the sage, Go and inform him of this.

data.v: स तं विदित्वा तु भृगुर्निश्चक्रामाश्रमात्तदा । पूजयामास च ततो विधिना परमेण ह ॥
data.md: Knowing that it was Pratarddana who had come, the Rishi Bhrigu himself came out of his hermitage and adored that best of kings according to due rites.

data.v: उवाच चैनं राजेन्द्र किं कार्यमिति पार्थिवम् । स चोवाच नृपस्तस्मै यदागमनकारणम् ॥
data.md: Addressing him then, the Rishi said: Tell me, o king, what is your business! The king, at this informed the Rishi of the reason of his arrival.

data.v: अयं ब्रह्मन्नितो राजा वीतहव्यो विसर्ज्यताम् । अस्य पुत्रैर्हि मे ब्रह्मन्कृत्स्नो वंशः प्रणाशितः । उत्सादितश्च विषयः काशीनां रत्नसंचयः ॥
data.md: The king said King Vitahavya has come here, O Brahmana! Do you surrender him. His sons, O Brahmana, had destroyed my family.

data.v: एतस्य वीर्यदृप्तस्य हतं पुत्रशतं मया । अस्येदानीं वधाद्ब्रह्मन्भविष्याम्यनृणः पितुः ॥
तमुवाच कृपाविष्टो भृगुर्धर्मभृतां वरः । नेहास्ति क्षत्रियः कश्चित्सर्वे हीमे द्विजातयः ॥
एवं तु वचनं श्रुत्वा भृगोस्तथ्यं प्रतर्दनः । पादावुपस्पृश्य शनैः प्रहसन्वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥
एवमप्यस्मि भगवन्कृतकृत्यो न संशयः । यदेष राजा वीर्येण स्वजातिं त्याजितो मया ॥
अनुजानीहि मां ब्रह्मन्ध्यायस्व च शिवेन माम् । त्याजितो हि मया जातिमेष राजा भृगूद्वह ॥
ततस्तेनाभ्यनुज्ञातो ययौ राजा प्रतर्दनः । यथागतं महाराज मुक्त्वा विषमिवोरगः ॥
data.md: cause. This king, O founder of the family that goes by your name becomes divested of the very order of his birth, on account of my might! Dismissed by the Rishi Bhrigu, king Pratarddana then left that hermitage, and went to the place he had come from, having, in the way I have described, voinited forth the poison of specch even as a snake vomits forth its real poison. Meanwhile, king Vitahavya, acquired the dignity of the twice born sage by virtue of the worth only of Bhrigu.

data.v: भृगोर्वचनमात्रेण स च ब्रह्मर्षितां गतः । वीतहव्यो महाराज ब्रह्मवादित्वमेव च ॥
तस्य गृत्समदः पुत्रो रूपेणेन्द्र इवापरः । शक्रस्त्वमिति यो दैत्यैर्निगृहीतः किलाभवत् ॥
ऋग्वेदे वर्तते चाग्र्या श्रुतिरत्र विशां पते । यत्र गृत्समदो ब्रह्मन्ब्राह्मणैः स महीयते ॥
स ब्रह्मचारी विप्रर्षिः श्रीमान्गृत्समदोऽभवत् । पुत्रो गृत्समदस्यापि सुचेता अभवद्द्विजः ॥
वर्चाः सुतेजसः पुत्रो विहव्यस्तस्य चात्मजः । विहव्यस्य तु पुत्रस्तु वितत्यस्तस्य चात्मजः ॥
वितत्यस्य सुतः सत्यः सन्तः सत्यस्य चात्मजः । श्रवास्तस्य सुतश्चर्षिः श्रवसश्चाभवत्तमः ॥
तमसश्च प्रकाशोऽभूत्तनयो द्विजसत्तमः । प्रकाशस्य च वागिन्द्रो बभूव जयतां वरः ॥
data.md: Santa had a son viz., the Rishi Shravas. Shravas begot a son named Tama. Tama begot a son named Prakasha who was a very great Brahmana.

data.v: तस्यात्मजश्च प्रमतिर्वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः । घृताच्यां तस्य पुत्रस्तु रुरुर्नामोदपद्यत ॥
data.md: Prakasha had a son named Vagindra who was the foremost of all silent reciters of sacred Mantras. Vagindra begot a son named Pramati who was a perfect master of all the Vedas and their auxiliaries. Pramati begot upon the Apsara Ghritachi a son who was named Ruru.

data.v: प्रमद्वरायां तु रुरोः पुत्रः समुदपद्यत । शुनको नाम विप्रर्षिर्यस्य पुत्रोऽथ शौनकः ॥
data.md: Ruru begot a son upon his wife Pramadvara. That son was the regenerate Rishi Shunaka. Shunaka begot a son who is named Shaunaka.

data.v: एवं विप्रत्वमगमद्वीतहव्यो नराधिपः । भृगोः प्रसादाद्राजेन्द्र क्षत्रियः क्षत्रियर्षभ ॥
data.md: It was thus, O foremost of monarchs that king Vitahavya, though a Kshatriya by the order of his birth, acquired the dignity of a Brahmana, O chief of Kshatriyas, through the grace of Bhrigu.

data.v: तथैव कथितो वंशो मया गार्त्समदस्तव । विस्तरेण महाराज किमन्यदनुपृच्छसि ॥
data.md: I have also told you the genealogy of the race that originated from his son Gritsamada. What else would you ask?

data.v: के पूज्याः के नमस्कार्या मानवैर्भरतर्षभ । विस्तरेण तदाचक्ष्व न हि तृप्यामि कथ्यताम् ॥
data.md: Yudhishthira said What men, O chief of Bharata's race are worthy of homage in the three worlds? Tell me this in detail, I am never satiated with hearing you describe these topics.

data.v: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् । नारदस्य च संवादं वासुदेवस्य चोभयोः ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Regarding it is cited the old conversation between a Brahmana in the observance of the Shila and the Unccha vows, O Yudhishthira, and a Rishi crowned with ascetic merits.

data.v: नारदं प्राञ्जलिं दृष्ट्वा पूजयानं द्विजर्षभान् । केशवः परिपप्रच्छ भगवन्कान्नमस्यसि ॥
data.md: Seeing Narada on one occasion adoring many foremost of Brahmanas with joined hands, Keshava addressed him, saying Whom do you worship? Whom amongst these Brahmanas, O holy one, do you worship with so great respect? If it is capable of being heard by me, I wish then to hear it. Do O foremost of righteous men, tell me this.

data.v: बहुमानः परः केषु भवतो यान्नमस्यसि । शक्यं चेच्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि ब्रूह्येतद्धर्मवित्तम ॥
शृणु गोविन्द यानेतान्पूजयाम्यरिमर्दन । त्वत्तोऽन्यः कः पुमाँल्लोके श्रोतुमेतदिहार्हति ॥
data.md: Narada said Hear, O Govinda, as to who those are whom I am adoring, Ogrinder of enemies What other person is there in the world who is worthier than you to hear this?

data.v: वरुणं वायुमादित्यं पर्जन्यं जातवेदसम् । स्थाणुं स्कन्दं तथा लक्ष्मीं विष्णुं ब्रह्माणमेव च ॥
data.md: I adore them o powerful one, who constantly worship Varuna and Vayu and Aditya, and Parjanya and the deity of Fire and Sthanu and Skanda and Lakshmi and Vishnu and the Brahmanas, and the lord of speech, and the Moon, and the Waters, and the Earth and the goddess Sarasvati,

data.v: वाचस्पतिं चन्द्रमसमपः पृथ्वीं सरस्वतीम् । सततं ये नमस्यन्ति तान्नमस्याम्यहं विभो ॥
data.md: O foremost of Vrishni's race, I always adore those Brahmanas who are are endued with penances, who are conversant with the Vedas who are always given to Vedic study, and who are possessed of great worth.

data.v: तपोधनान्वेदविदो नित्यं वेदपरायणान् । महार्हान्वृष्णिशार्दूल सदा संपूजयाम्यहम् ॥
data.md: O foremost of Vrishni's race, I always adore those Brahmanas who are are endued with penances, who are conversant with the Vedas who are always given to Vedic study, and who are possessed of great worth.

data.v: अभुक्त्वा देवकार्याणि कुर्वते येऽविकत्थनाः । संतुष्टाश्च क्षमायुक्तास्तान्नमस्याम्यहं विभो ॥
data.md: O powerful one, I bow down my head to those persons who are freed from boastfulness, who perform with an empty stomach, the rites in honour of the deities, who are always contended with what they have, and who are gifted with forgiveness.

data.v: सम्यग्ददति ये चेष्टान्क्षान्ता दान्ता जितेन्द्रियाः । सस्यं धनं क्षितिं गाश्च तान्नमस्यामि यादव ॥
data.md: I adore them, O Yadava, who are performers of sacrifices, who are forgiving in nature, and selfcontrolled, who are masters of their own senses, who worship truth and virtue, and who give away land and kine to good Brahmanas.

data.v: ये ते तपसि वर्तन्ते वने मूलफलाशनाः । असंचयाः क्रियावन्तस्तान्नमस्यामि यादव ॥
data.md: I bow to them, O Yadava, who are devoted to the observance of penances, who live in forests, who live upon fruits and roots who never store anything for the morrow, and who perform all the acts and rites laid down in the scriptures.

data.v: ये भृत्यभरणे सक्ताः सततं चातिथिप्रियाः । भुञ्जन्ते देवशेषाणि तान्नमस्यामि यादव ॥
data.md: I bow to them, O Yadava, who feed and cherish their servants who are always hospitable to guests and who eat only the residue of what is offered to the deities.

data.v: ये वेदं प्राप्य दुर्धर्षा वाग्मिनो ब्रह्मवादिनः । याजनाध्यापने युक्ता नित्यं तान्पूजयाम्यहम् ॥
data.md: I worship them who have become irresistible by studying the Vedas, who are eloquent in discoursing on the scriptures, who are observant of the vow of Brahmacharya, and who are always devoted to the duties of officiating at the sacrifices of others and of teaching disciples.

data.v: प्रसन्नहृदयाश्चैव सर्वसत्त्वेषु नित्यशः । आ पृष्ठतापात्स्वाध्याये युक्तास्तान्पूजयाम्यहम् ॥
data.md: I adore them that are endued with mercy towards all creatures and who study the Vedas till their back are heated by the Sun.

data.v: गुरुप्रसादे स्वाध्याये यतन्ते ये स्थिरव्रताः । शुश्रूषवोऽनसूयन्तस्तान्नमस्यामि यादव ॥
data.md: I bow to them, O Yadava, who try to acquire the grace of their preceptors, who labour in the acquisition of their Vedas, who are firm in the observance of vows, who wait with dutiful obedience, upon their preceptors and seniors, and who are free from malice and envy.

data.v: सुव्रता मुनयो ये च ब्रह्मण्याः सत्यसंगराः । वोढारो हव्यकव्यानां तान्नमस्यामि यादव ॥
data.md: I bow to them, O Yadava, who are observant of excellent vows, who practise silence, who have knowledge of Brahma, who are firm in truth, who are givers of libations of clarified butter and oblations of meat.

data.v: भैक्ष्यचर्यासु निरताः कृशा गुरुकुलाश्रयाः । निःसुखा निर्धना ये च तान्नमस्यामि यादव ॥
data.md: I bow to them, O, Yadava, who live upon elemosynary alms, who are emaciated for want of adequate food and drink, who have lived in the houses of their preceptors, who are averse to and destitute of all enjoyments and who are poor in Earthly possessions.

data.v: निर्ममा निष्प्रतिद्वंद्वा निर्ह्रीका निष्प्रयोजनाः । अहिंसानिरता ये च ये च सत्यव्रता नराः । दान्ताः शमपराश्चैव तान्नमस्यामि केशव ॥
data.md: I bow to them who are given to the practice of the duty of mercy towards all creatures who are firm in the observance of truth, who are self controlled, and who are peaceful in their conduct.

data.v: देवतातिथिपूजायां प्रसक्ता गृहमेधिनः । कपोतवृत्तयो नित्यं तान्नमस्यामि यादव ॥
data.md: I bow to them, O Yadava who are devoted to the worship of gods and guests, who are observant of the domestic mode of life and that follow the practice of pigeons about collecting their food.

data.v: येषां त्रिवर्गः कृत्येषु वर्तते नोपहीयते । शिष्टाचारप्रवृत्ताश्च तान्नमस्याम्यहं सदा ॥
data.md: I always bow to those persons, who while doing all their works have an eye on the threefold objects of life, and who are observant of truth and righteous behaviour.

data.v: ब्राह्मणास्त्रिषु लोकेषु ये त्रिवर्गमनुष्ठिताः । अलोलुपाः पुण्यशीलास्तान्नमस्यामि केशव ॥
data.md: I bow to them, O Keshava, who are conversant with Brahma, who are gifted with knowledge of the Vedas, who are attentive to the threefold objects of life, who are free from cupidity, and who are righteous in their behaviour.

data.v: अब्भक्षा वायुभक्षाश्च सुधाभक्षाश्च ये सदा । व्रतैश्च विविधैर्युक्तास्तान्नमस्यामि माधव ॥
data.md: I bow to them, O Madhava, who live upon water only, or upon air alone, or upon the residue of the food that is offered to deities and guests, and who practise all sorts of excellent VOWS.

data.v: अयोनीनग्नियोनींश्च ब्रह्मयोनींस्तथैव च । सर्वभूतात्मयोनींश्च तान्नमस्याम्यहं द्विजान् ॥
data.md: I always adore them who have no wives, who have wives and the domestic fire, who are the refuge of the Vedas, and who are the refuge of all creatures in the universe.

data.v: नित्यमेतान्नमस्यामि कृष्ण लोककरानृषीन् । लोकज्येष्ठाञ्ज्ञाननिष्ठांस्तमोघ्नाँल्लोकभास्करान् ॥
data.md: I always bow to those Rishis. O Krishna, who are the creators of the universe, who are the elders of the universe, who are the eldest members of the race or the family, who are dispellers of the darkness of ignorance, and who are the best of all persons in the universe.

data.v: तस्मात्त्वमपि वार्ष्णेय द्विजान्पूजय नित्यदा । पूजिताः पूजनार्हा हि सुखं दास्यन्ति तेऽनघ ॥
data.md: For these reasons, do you also O scion of Vrishni's race, adore every day those twiceborn persons of whom I speak. Worthy as they are of reverent worship, they will when adored confer happiness on you, O sinless one,

data.v: अस्मिँल्लोके सदा ह्येते परत्र च सुखप्रदाः । त एते मान्यमाना वै प्रदास्यन्ति सुखं तव ॥
data.md: Those persons of whom I speak are always givers of happiness in this world as well as in the next. Respected by all, they move about in this world, and, if adored by you are sure to grant you happiness.

data.v: ये सर्वातिथयो नित्यं गोषु च ब्राह्मणेषु च । नित्यं सत्ये च निरता दुर्गाण्यतितरन्ति ते ॥
data.md: They who are hospitable to all persons who come to them as guests, and who are always devoted to Brahmanas and kine as also to truth succeed in crossing all calamities and impediments.

data.v: नित्यं शमपरा ये च तथा ये चानसूयकाः । नित्यं स्वाध्यायिनो ये च दुर्गाण्यतितरन्ति ते ॥
data.md: They who are always devoted to peacefulness of conduct as also they who are shorn of malice and envy, and they who are always attentive to the study of the Vedas, succeed in crossing all calamities and impediments.

data.v: सर्वान्देवान्नमस्यन्ति ये चैकं देवमाश्रिताः । श्रद्दधानाश्च दान्ताश्च दुर्गाण्यतितरन्ति ते ॥
data.md: They who bow to all the deities, they who follow one Veda as their refuge, they who are possessed of faith and are self controlled, succeed in crossing all calamities and impediments.

data.v: तथैव विप्रप्रवरान्नमस्कृत्य यतव्रतान् । भवन्ति ये दानरता दुर्गाण्यतितरन्ति ते ॥
data.md: They who adore the foremost of Brahmanas with reverence and are firm in the observance of excellent vows and practise the virtue of charity succeed in crossing all calamities and impediments.

data.v: अग्नीनाधाय विधिवत्प्रयता धारयन्ति ये । प्राप्ताः सोमाहुतिं चैव दुर्गाण्यतितरन्ति ते ॥
data.md: They who, having lighted the domestic fire, duly keep it burning and adore it with reverence, and they who have duly poured libations in Somasacrifices, succeed in crossing all calamities and impediments.

data.v: मातापित्रोर्गुरुषु च सम्यग्वर्तन्ति ये सदा । यथा त्वं वृष्णिशार्दूलेत्युक्त्वैवं विरराम सः ॥
data.md: They who behave properly towards their mothers and fathers and preceptors and other elders even as you, O foremost of the Vrishnis, do behave, (succeed in crossing all calamities and impediments)! Having said these words the celestial Rishi ceased speaking.

data.v: तस्मात्त्वमपि कौन्तेय पितृदेवद्विजातिथीन् । सम्यक्पूजय येन त्वं गतिमिष्टामवाप्स्यसि ॥
data.md: Bhishma continued For these reasons, do you also, O son of Kunti, always adore with reverence the deities the departed manes the Brahmanas and guests arrived at your palace, and as the outcome of such conduct you are to acquire a desirable end! sure the departed manes the Brahmanas and guests arrived at your palace, and as the outcome of such conduct you are to acquire a desirable end! sure

data.v: किं राज्ञः सर्वकृत्यानां गरीयः स्यात्पितामह । किं कुर्वन्कर्म नृपतिरुभौ लोकौ समश्नुते ॥
data.md: Yudhishthira Said Which act, O grandfather is the foremost of all those that have been laid down for a king? What is that act by doing which a king succeeds in enjoying both this world and the next.

data.v: एतद्राज्ञः कृत्यतममभिषिक्तस्य भारत । ब्राह्मणानामनुष्ठानमत्यन्तं सुखमिच्छता । श्रोत्रियान्ब्राह्मणान्वृद्धान्नित्यमेवाभिपूजयेत् ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Even this, viz., the worship of the Brahmanas, is the foremost of all those deeds, O Bharata, which have been laid down for a king duly installed on the throne if, indeed, he is desirous of acquiring great happiness.

data.v: पौरजानपदांश्चापि ब्राह्मणांश्च बहुश्रुतान् । सान्त्वेन भोगदानेन नमस्कारैस्तथार्चयेत् ॥
data.md: The king should, with bows sweet speeches and gifts of all articles of enjoyment, adore all Brahmanas endued with great learning who may live in his city or provinces.

data.v: एतत्कृत्यतमं राज्ञो नित्यमेवेति लक्षयेत् । यथात्मानं यथा पुत्रांस्तथैतान्परिपालयेत् ॥
data.md: This is the foremost of all acts laid down for the king. Indeed, the king should always keep his eyes fixed on this. He should protect and cherish these, even as he protects his own self or his own children.

data.v: ये चाप्येषां पूज्यतमास्तान्दृढं प्रतिपूजयेत् । तेषु शान्तेषु तद्राष्ट्रं सर्वमेव विराजते ॥
data.md: The king should adore with greater reverence those amongst the Brahmanas who may be worthy of it. When such men are freed from all anxiety, the whole kingdom shines in beauty.

data.v: ते पूज्यास्ते नमस्कार्यास्ते रक्ष्याः पितरो यथा । तेष्वेव यात्रा लोकस्य भूतानामिव वासवे ॥
data.md: Such individuals are worthy of adoration. The king should bow his head to such individuals. Indeed, they should be honoured, even as one honours his father and grandfather. The course of conduct followed by men, depends upon them as the existence of all creatures depends upon Vasava.

data.v: अभिचारैरुपायैश्च दहेयुरपि तेजसा । निःशेषं कुपिताः कुर्युरुग्राः सत्यपराक्रमाः ॥
data.md: Having prowess incapable of being baffled and gifted with great energy, such men if enraged are capable of reducing the entire kingdom to ashes by only their will or by acts of incantation, or by other means.

data.v: नान्तमेषां प्रपश्यामि न दिशश्चाप्यपावृताः । कुपिताः समुदीक्षन्ते दावेष्वग्निशिखा इव ॥
data.md: I do not see anything that can destroy them. Their power seems to be uncontrolled, being capable of reaching to the last end of the universe. When angry, their looks fall upon men and things like a burning flame of fire upon a forest. are

data.v: विद्यन्तेषां साहसिका गुणास्तेषामतीव हि । कूपा इव तृणच्छन्ना विशुद्धा द्यौरिवापरे ॥
data.md: The most courageous men are struck with fear at their name. Their virtues and powers are extraordinary and immeasurable. Some amongst them are like wells and pits with mouths covered by grass and creepers, while others resemble the sky shorn of clouds and darkness.

data.v: प्रसह्यकारिणः केचित्कार्पासमृदवोऽपरे । सन्ति चैषामतिशठास्तथान्येऽतितपस्विनः ॥
data.md: Some amongst them of dreadful dispositions. Some are as mild and soft in disposition as cotton. Some amongst them are very cunning. Some amongst them are given to the practice of penances.

data.v: कृषिगोरक्ष्यमप्यन्ये भैक्षमन्येऽप्यनुष्ठिताः । चोराश्चान्येऽनृताश्चान्ये तथान्ये नटनर्तकाः ॥
data.md: Some amongst them are employed in agricultural pursuits. Some amongst them are engaged in the keep of kine. Some amongst them live upon eleemosynary alms. Some amongst them are even thieves. Some amongst them are found of creating quarrels and disputes. Some again, amongst them are actors and dancers.

data.v: सर्वकर्मसु दृश्यन्ते प्रशान्तेष्वितरेषु च । विविधाचारयुक्ताश्च ब्राह्मणा भरतर्षभ ॥
data.md: Some amongst them are competent to perform all feats ordinary and extraordinary. The Brahmanas, O chief of Bharata's race, are of various aspects and conduct.

data.v: नानाकर्मसु युक्तानां बहुकर्मोपजीविनाम् । धर्मज्ञानां सतां तेषां नित्यमेवानुकीर्तयेत् ॥
data.md: One should always sing the praises of the Brahmanas who are conversant with all duties, who are righteous of conduct, who are given to various kinds of acts, and who are seen to derive their sustenance from various callings.

data.v: पितॄणां देवतानां च मनुष्योरगरक्षसाम् । पुरोहिता महाभागा ब्राह्मणा वै नराधिप ॥
data.md: The Brahmanas, O king, who are highly blessed are older in respect of their origin than the departed manes, the deities human beings, the Snakes, and the Rakshasas.

data.v: नैते देवैर्न पितृभिर्न गन्धर्वैर्न राक्षसैः । नासुरैर्न पिशाचैश्च शक्या जेतुं द्विजातयः ॥
data.md: These twice born persons are incapable of being defeated by the deities or the departed manes, or the Gandharvas or the Rakshasas, or the Asuras or the Pishachas.

data.v: अदैवं दैवतं कुर्युर्दैवतं चाप्यदैवतम् । यमिच्छेयुः स राजा स्याद्यं द्विष्युः स पराभवेत् ॥
data.md: The Brahmanas are competent to make him a god, that is not a god. They can, again, divest one who is a deity of his status as such. He becomes a king, whom they wish to make a king. He on the other hand, is crushed whom they do not love or like.

data.v: परिवादं च ये कुर्युर्ब्राह्मणानामचेतसः । निन्दाप्रशंसाकुशलाः कीर्त्यकीर्तिपरावराः । परिकुप्यन्ति ते राजन्सततं द्विषतां द्विजाः ॥
data.md: Expert in praise and dispraise, and themselves the origin or cause of other people's fame and ignominy, the Brahmanas, O king, always become angry with those who seek to injure others.

data.v: ब्राह्मणा यं प्रशंसन्ति पुरुषः स प्रवर्धते । ब्राह्मणैर्यः पराक्रुष्टः पराभूयात्क्षणाद्धि सः ॥
data.md: That man whom the Brahmanas praise succeeds in becoming prosperous. That man who is censured and renounced by the Brahmanas soon meets with discomfiture.

data.v: शका यवनकाम्बोजास्तास्ताः क्षत्रियजातयः । वृषलत्वं परिगता ब्राह्मणानामदर्शनात् ॥
data.md: It is on account of the absence of Brahmanas from among them that the Shakas, the Yavanas, the Kamvojas and other Kshatriya tribes have become fallen and degraded into Shudras.

data.v: द्रमिळाश्च कलिङ्गाश्च पुलिन्दाश्चाप्युशीनराः । कौलाः सर्पा माहिषकास्तास्ताः क्षत्रियजातयः ॥
data.md: The Dravidas, the Kalingas, the Pulindas the Ushinaras, the Kolisarpas, the Mahishakas, and other Kshatriyas, have, on account of the absence of Brahmanas from among their midst, become degraded into Shudras. Defeat from them is preferable to victory, O foremost of victorious persons.

data.v: वृषलत्वं परिगता ब्राह्मणानामदर्शनात् । श्रेयान्पराजयस्तेभ्यो न जयो जयतां वर ॥
data.md: The Dravidas, the Kalingas, the Pulindas the Ushinaras, the Kolisarpas, the Mahishakas, and other Kshatriyas, have, on account of the absence of Brahmanas from among their midst, become degraded into Shudras. Defeat from them is preferable to victory, O foremost of victorious persons.

data.v: यस्तु सर्वमिदं हन्याद्ब्राह्मणं च न तत्समम् । ब्रह्मवध्या महान्दोष इत्याहुः परमर्षयः ॥
data.md: One killing all other living creatures in this world does not commit a sin so heinous as that of killing a single Brahmana. The great Rishis have said that Brahmanicide is a heinous sin.

data.v: परिवादो द्विजातीनां न श्रोतव्यः कथंचन । आसीताधोमुखस्तूष्णीं समुत्थाय व्रजेत वा ॥
data.md: One should never utter the dispraise or calumny of the Brahmanas. Where the dispraise of Brahmanas is uttered, one should sit with face hanging down or leave that place.

data.v: न स जातो जनिष्यो वा पृथिव्यामिह कश्चन । यो ब्राह्मणविरोधेन सुखं जीवितुमुत्सहेत् ॥
data.md: That man has not as yet been born in this world or will not take birth here who has been or will be able to pass his life happily after quarrelling with the Brahmanas.

data.v: दुर्ग्रहो मुष्टिना वायुर्दुःस्पर्शः पाणिना शशी । दुर्धरा पृथिवी मूर्ध्ना दुर्जया ब्राह्मणा भुवि ॥
data.md: One cannot seize the wind with his hands. One cannot touch the moon with his hand. One cannot support the earth on his arms. Similarly, O king, one is not able to defeat the Brahmanas in this world,

data.v: ब्राह्मणानेव सततं भृशं संप्रतिपूजयेत् । एते हि सोमराजान ईश्वराः सुखदुःखयोः ॥
data.md: Bhishma said One should always offer the most respectful adoration to the Brahmanas. They have Soma for their king, and they it is who confer happiness and misery upon others.

data.v: एते भोगैरलंकारैरन्यैश्चैव किमिच्छकैः । सदा पूज्या नमस्कार्या रक्ष्याश्च पितृवन्नृपैः । अतो राष्ट्रस्य शान्तिर्हि भूतानामिव वासवात् ॥
data.md: They, O king, should always be cherished and protected as one cherishes and protect his own father and grandfather, and should be adored with bows and gifts of food and ornaments and other articles of enjoyment as also with such things as they may wish for. The peace and happiness of the kingdom originate from such respect shown to the Brahmanas even as the peace and happiness of all living creatures come from Vasava the king of the gods.

data.v: जायतां ब्रह्मवर्चस्वी राष्ट्रे वै ब्राह्मणः शुचिः । महारथश्च राजन्य एष्टव्यः शत्रुतापनः ॥
data.md: Let Brahmanas of pure conduct and Brahmaeffulgence be born in a kingdom. Kshatriya also who are splendid carwarriors and that are capable of defeating all enemies, should be desired.

data.v: ब्राह्मणं जातिसंपन्नं धर्मज्ञं संशितव्रतम् । वासयेत गृहे राजन्न तस्मात्परमस्ति वै ॥
data.md: This was said to me by Narada. There is nothing higher, O king, than this viz., the act of making a Brahmana of good birth, having a knowledge of morality and righteousness, and steadfast in the observance of excellent vows, live in his mansion. Such an act yields every sort of blessing.

data.v: ब्राह्मणेभ्यो हविर्दत्तं प्रतिगृह्णन्ति देवताः । पितरः सर्वभूतानां नैतेभ्यो विद्यते परम् ॥
data.md: The sacrificial offerings given Brahmanas reach the very gods who accept them. Brahmanas are the fathers of all creatures. There is nothing higher than a Brahmana.

data.v: आदित्यश्चन्द्रमा वायुर्भूमिरापोऽम्बरं दिशः । सर्वे ब्राह्मणमाविश्य सदान्नमुपभुञ्जते ॥
data.md: The Sun, the Moon, the Wind, the Water, the Earth, the Sky and the points of the compass, all enter the body of the Brahmana and take what the Brahmana eats. In that house where Brahmanas do not eat, the departed manes refuse to eat.

data.v: न तस्याश्नन्ति पितरो यस्य विप्रा न भुञ्जते । देवाश्चाप्यस्य नाश्नन्ति पापस्य ब्राह्मणद्विषः ॥
ब्राह्मणेषु तु तुष्टेषु प्रीयन्ते पितरः सदा । तथैव देवता राजन्नात्र कार्या विचारणा ॥
तथैव तेऽपि प्रीयन्ते येषां भवति तद्धविः । न च प्रेत्य विनश्यन्ति गच्छन्ति परमां गतिम् ॥
येन येनैव हविषा ब्राह्मणांस्तर्पयेन्नरः । तेन तेनैव प्रीयन्ते पितरो देवतास्तथा ॥
data.md: Such men never meet with destruction. Indeed, they succeed in acquiring great ends. Those particular offerings in sacrifices with which one pleases the Brahmanas, go to please both the departed manes and the deities. The Brahmana is the cause of that sacrifice whence all created things have originated.

data.v: ब्राह्मणादेव तद्भूतं प्रभवन्ति यतः प्रजाः । यतश्चायं प्रभवति प्रेत्य यत्र च गच्छति ॥
वेदैष मार्गं स्वर्गस्य तथैव नरकस्य च । आगतानागते चोभे ब्राह्मणो द्विपदां वरः । ब्राह्मणो भरतश्रेष्ठ स्वधर्मं वेद मेधया ॥
data.md: The Brahmana is conversant with that which has taken place and that which will take place. The Brahmana is the foremost of all twolegged beings. The Brahmana, O chief of the Bharatas, is fully conversant with those duties which have been laid down for his order.

data.v: ये चैनमनुवर्तन्ते ते न यान्ति पराभवम् । न ते प्रेत्य विनश्यन्ति गच्छन्ति न पराभवम् ॥
data.md: Those persons who follow the Brahmanas are never defeated. They never meet with destruction even after death. Indeed, victory is always theirs.

data.v: ये ब्राह्मणमुखात्प्राप्तं प्रतिगृह्णन्ति वै वचः । कृतात्मानो महात्मानस्ते न यान्ति पराभवम् ॥
data.md: Those great persons indeed, those persons who have subdued their souls, who accept the words that fall from the lips of the Brahmanas, are never defeated. Victory always becomes theirs.

data.v: क्षत्रियाणां प्रतपतां तेजसा च बलेन च । ब्राह्मणेष्वेव शाम्यन्ति तेजांसि च बलानि च ॥
data.md: The energy of those Kshatriyas who scorch everything with their energy and might, when they encounter the Brahmanas, become neutralised.

data.v: भृगवोऽजयंस्तालजङ्घान्नीपानङ्गिरसोऽजयन् । भरद्वाजो वैतहव्यानैलांश्च भरतर्षभ ॥
data.md: The Bhrigus conquered the Talajanghas. The sons of Angiras conquered the Nipas. Bharadvaja conquered the Vitahavyas as also the Alias, O chief of Bharata's race. and power

data.v: चित्रायुधांश्चाप्यजयन्नेते कृष्णाजिनध्वजाः । प्रक्षिप्याथ च कुम्भान्वै पारगामिनमारभेत् ॥
data.md: Although all these Kshatriyas were capable of using various arms, yet the Brahmanas named, owning only black deer-skins for their emblems, succeeded in conquering them effectually. Bestowing the Earth upon the Brahmanas and illuminating both the worlds by the brilliance of such an act, one should accomplish acts through which one may succeed in acquiring the end of all things.

data.v: यत्किंचित्कथ्यते लोके श्रूयते पश्यतेऽपि वा । सर्वं तद्ब्राह्मणेष्वेव गूढोऽग्निरिव दारुषु ॥
data.md: Like. fire concealed within wood, everything that is said or heard or read in this world, lies in the Brahmana.

data.v: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् । संवादं वासुदेवस्य पृथ्व्याश्च भरतर्षभ ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Regarding it is cited the old conversation between a Brahmana in the observance of the Shila and the Unccha vows, O Yudhishthira, and a Rishi crowned with ascetic merits.

data.v: मातरं सर्वभूतानां पृच्छे त्वा संशयं शुभे । केन स्वित्कर्मणा पापं व्यपोहति नरो गृही ॥
data.md: Vasudeva said O mother, of all creatures, O auspicious goddess, I wish to ask you for a solution of this doubt of mine! By what act does a man living like a householder succeed in cleansing all his sins.?

data.v: ब्राह्मणानेव सेवेत पवित्रं ह्येतदुत्तमम् । ब्राह्मणान्सेवमानस्य रजः सर्वं प्रणश्यति ॥
data.md: The Earth said One should serve the Brahmanas. This conduct is purifying and excellent. All the impurities are destroyed of that man who serves the Brahmanas with respect.

data.v: अतो भूतिरतः कीर्तिरतो बुद्धिः प्रजायते । अपरेषां परेषां च परेभ्यश्चैव ये परे ॥
ब्राह्मणा यं प्रशंसन्ति पुरुषः स प्रवर्धते । अथ यो ब्राह्मणाक्रुष्टः पराभवति सोऽचिरात् ॥
data.md: That man whom the Brahmanas praise succeeds in becoming prosperous. That man who is censured and renounced by the Brahmanas soon meets with discomfiture.

data.v: यथा महार्णवे क्षिप्त आमलोष्टो विनश्यति । तथा दुश्चरितं कर्म पराभावाय कल्पते ॥
data.md: That man who speaks ill of the Brahmanas soon meets with discomfiture, even as a clod of unbaked earth, meets with destruction when thrown into the sea.

data.v: पश्य चन्द्रे कृतं लक्ष्म समुद्रे लवणोदकम् । तथा भगसहस्रेण महेन्द्रं परिचिह्नितम् ॥
data.md: Similarly, all acts that are hurtful to the Brahmanas, to bring about discomfiture and ruin. Look at the dark spots on the Moon and the salt waters of the ocean.

data.v: तेषामेव प्रभावेन सहस्रनयनो ह्यसौ । शतक्रतुः समभवत्पश्य माधव यादृशम् ॥
data.md: The great Indra had at one time been marked all over with a thousand sexmarks. It was through the power of the Brahmanas that those marks were metamorphosed into as many eyes.

data.v: इच्छन्भूतिं च कीर्तिं च लोकांश्च मधुसूदन । ब्राह्मणानुमते तिष्ठेत्पुरुषः शुचिरात्मवान् ॥
data.md: See, O Madhava, how all these things took place. Desiring fame and prosperity and are sure various regions of beatitude in the next world, a person of pure conduct and soul should, O destroyer of Madhu, live in obedience to the dictates of the Brahmanas.

data.v: इत्येतद्वचनं श्रुत्वा मेदिन्या मधुसूदनः । साधु साध्वित्यथेत्युक्त्वा मेदिनीं प्रत्यपूजयत् ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Hearing those words of the goddess Earth, the destroyer of Madhu, O you of Kuru's race, said, Excellent, Excellent! and honoured the goddess in due form.

data.v: एतां श्रुत्वोपमां पार्थ प्रयतो ब्राह्मणर्षभान् । सततं पूजयेथास्त्वं ततः श्रेयोऽभिपत्स्यसे ॥
data.md: Having heard this discourse between the goddess Earth and Madhava, do you, O son of Pritha, always, with rapt soul, adore all superior Brahmanas. Doing this, you will surely obtain what is highly beneficial for you.

data.v: जन्मनैव महाभागो ब्राह्मणो नाम जायते । नमस्यः सर्वभूतानामतिथिः प्रसृताग्रभुक् ॥
data.md: Bhishma said O blessed king, a Brahmana, by birth alone becomes an object of worship with all creatures and entitled, as guests, to eat the first portion of all cooked food.

data.v: सर्वान्नः सुहृदस्तात ब्राह्मणाः सुमनोमुखाः । गीर्भिर्मङ्गलयुक्ताभिरनुध्यायन्ति पूजिताः ॥
data.md: From them come all the great objects of life. They are the friends of all creatures in the universe. They are again the mouths of all the gods (for food poured into their mouths is eaten by the deities). Adored with respect, they wish its prosperity by uttering words fraught with auspiciousness.

data.v: सर्वान्नो द्विषतस्तात ब्राह्मणा जातमन्यवः । गीर्भिर्दारुणयुक्ताभिरभिहन्युरपूजिताः ॥
data.md: From them come all the great objects of life. They are the friends of all creatures in the universe. They are again the mouths of all the gods (for food poured into their mouths is eaten by the deities). Adored with respect, they wish its prosperity by uttering words fraught with auspiciousness.

data.v: अत्र गाथा ब्रह्मगीताः कीर्तयन्ति पुराविदः । सृष्ट्वा द्विजातीन्धाता हि यथापूर्वं समादधत् ॥
data.md: About it, persons conversant with ancient history repeat the following verses sung of old respecting how in ancient times the Creator, after having created the Brahmanas, laid down their duties.

data.v: न वोऽन्यदिह कर्तव्यं किंचिदूर्ध्वं यथाविधि । गुप्ता गोपायत ब्रह्म श्रेयो वस्तेन शोभनम् ॥
data.md: A Brahmana should never do anything else than what has been laid down for him. Protected they should protect others. By acting thus, they are sure to acquire what is for their behoof.

data.v: स्वमेव कुर्वतां कर्म श्रीर्वो ब्राह्मी भविष्यति । प्रमाणं सर्वभूतानां प्रग्रहं च गमिष्यथ ॥
data.md: By doing those acts that are laid down for them, they are sure to acquire Brahma prosperity You shall become the exemplas of all creatures, and reins for controlling them.

data.v: न शौद्रं कर्म कर्तव्यं ब्राह्मणेन विपश्चिता । शौद्रं हि कुर्वतः कर्म धर्मः समुपरुध्यते ॥
data.md: A Brahmana endued with learning should never do that which is laid down for the Shudras. By doing such acts, a Brahmana loses his merit.

data.v: श्रीश्च बुद्धिश्च तेजश्च विभूतिश्च प्रतापिनी । स्वाध्यायेनैव माहात्म्यं विमलं प्रतिपत्स्यथ ॥
data.md: By Vedic study he is sure to acquire prosperity, intelligence, energy and power competent to scorch all things, as also glory of the most superior kind.

data.v: हुत्वा चाहवनीयस्थं महाभाग्ये प्रतिष्ठिताः । अग्रभोज्याः प्रसूतीनां श्रिया ब्राह्म्यानुकल्पिताः ॥
data.md: By offering oblations of clarified butter to the deities, the Brahmanas acquire high blessedness, become worthy of taking the precedence of even children in the matter of all kinds of cooked food, and gifted with Brahma prosperity.

data.v: श्रद्धया परया युक्ता ह्यनभिद्रोहलब्धया । दमस्वाध्यायनिरताः सर्वान्कामानवाप्स्यथ ॥
data.md: Endued with faith that is fraught with mercy towards all creatures, and devoted to self-control and the study of the Vedas, you shall acquire the fruition of all your desires.

data.v: यच्चैव मानुषे लोके यच्च देवेषु किंचन । सर्वं तत्तपसा साध्यं ज्ञानेन विनयेन च ॥
data.md: Whatever things exist in the world of men, whatever things exist in the region of the celestials, can all be achieved and acquired with the help of penances and knowledge and the observance of vows and restraints.

data.v: इत्येता ब्रह्मगीतास्ते समाख्याता मयानघ । विप्रानुकम्पार्थमिदं तेन प्रोक्तं हि धीमता ॥
data.md: I have thus recited to you, O sinless one, the verses that were sung by Brahmana himself. Gifted with supreme intelligence and wisdom, the Creator himself ordained this through mercy for the Brahmanas.

data.v: भूयस्तेषां बलं मन्ये यथा राज्ञस्तपस्विनः । दुरासदाश्च चण्डाश्च रभसाः क्षिप्रकारिणः ॥
data.md: The power of those amongst them who are devoted to penances is equal to the power of kings. They are, indeed, irresistible, fierce, fleet like lightning and exceedingly quick in what they do.

data.v: सन्त्येषां सिंहसत्त्वाश्च व्याघ्रसत्त्वास्तथापरे । वराहमृगसत्त्वाश्च गजसत्त्वास्तथापरे ॥
data.md: There are amongst them those who are possessed of might of lions and those who are possessed of the might of tigers. Some of them are gifted with the might of boars, some of the deer and some of crocodiles.

data.v: कर्पासमृदवः केचित्तथान्ये मकरस्पृशः । विभाष्यघातिनः केचित्तथा चक्षुर्हणोऽपरे ॥
data.md: Some there are amongst them whose touch resembles that of snakes of dreadful poison, and some whose bite resembles that of sharks. Some amongst them are capable of bringing about by words only the destruction of those that are opposed to them; and some are competent to destroy by a look only of their eyes.

data.v: सन्ति चाशीविषनिभाः सन्ति मन्दास्तथापरे । विविधानीह वृत्तानि ब्राह्मणानां युधिष्ठिर ॥
data.md: Some among them, as already said, are like snakes of dreadful poison, and some that are gifted with very mild dispositions. The dispositions, O Yudhishthira, of the Brahmanas, are of various kinds.

data.v: मेकला द्रमिडाः काशाः पौण्ड्राः कोल्लगिरास्तथा । शौण्डिका दरदा दर्वाश्चौराः शबरबर्बराः ॥
data.md: The Mekalas, the Dravidas, the Lathas, the Paundras, the Knowashiras, the Shaundikas, the Daradas, the Darvas, Darvas, the Chauras, Shavaras, the Varvaras, the Kiratas, the Yavanas and numerous other tribes of Kshatriyas, have degenerated into the status of Shudras through the anger of the Brahmanas.

data.v: किराता यवनाश्चैव तास्ताः क्षत्रियजातयः । वृषलत्वमनुप्राप्ता ब्राह्मणानामदर्शनात् ॥
data.md: It is on account of the absence of Brahmanas from among them that the Shakas, the Yavanas, the Kamvojas and other Kshatriya tribes have become fallen and degraded into Shudras.

data.v: ब्राह्मणानां परिभवादसुराः सलिलेशयाः । ब्राह्मणानां प्रसादाच्च देवाः स्वर्गनिवासिनः ॥
data.md: On account of their having disregarded the Brahmanas, the Asuras have been obliged to take refuge in the depths of the ocean. Through the favour of the Brahmanas, the celestials have become denizens of the happy regions of Heaven.

data.v: अशक्यं स्प्रष्टुमाकाशमचाल्यो हिमवान्गिरिः । अवार्या सेतुना गङ्गा दुर्जया ब्राह्मणा भुवि ॥
data.md: The element of other is incapable of being touched. The Himavat mountains, incapable of being moved from their root. The current of Ganga is incapable of being resisted by a dam. The Brahmanas are incapable of being governed.

data.v: न ब्राह्मणविरोधेन शक्या शास्तुं वसुंधरा । ब्राह्मणा हि महात्मानो देवानामपि देवताः ॥
data.md: Kshatriyas are incapable of ruling the Earth without securing the good will of Brahmanas. are The Brahmana are great. They are the deities of the very deities.

data.v: तान्पूजयस्व सततं दानेन परिचर्यया । यदीच्छसि महीं भोक्तुमिमां सागरमेखलाम् ॥
data.md: Do you always adore them with gifts and obedient services, if, indeed, you desire to enjoy the sovereignty of the whole Earth encircled by seas.

data.v: प्रतिग्रहेण तेजो हि विप्राणां शाम्यतेऽनघ । प्रतिग्रहं ये नेच्छेयुस्तेऽपि रक्ष्यास्त्वयानघ ॥
data.md: The energy and power of Brahmanas, o sinless one, become abated by the acceptance of gifts. You should protect your family, O king, from those Brahmanas who do not desire to accept gifts.

data.v: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् । शक्रशम्बरसंवादं तन्निबोध युधिष्ठिर ॥
data.md: Bhishma said Regarding it is cited the old conversation between a Brahmana in the observance of the Shila and the Unccha vows, O Yudhishthira, and a Rishi crowned with ascetic merits.

data.v: शक्रो ह्यज्ञातरूपेण जटी भूत्वा रजोरुणः । विरूपं रूपमास्थाय प्रश्नं पप्रच्छ शम्बरम् ॥
data.md: Once upon a time Shakra, assuming the guise of an ascetic with matted locks on his head and body covered with ashes all over, rode on an ugly car and went to the Asura Shambara.

data.v: केन शम्बर वृत्तेन स्वजात्यानधितिष्ठसि । श्रेष्ठं त्वां केन मन्यन्ते तन्मे प्रब्रूहि पृच्छतः ॥
data.md: Shakra said Through what conduct, O Shambara, you have been able to become the head of your family? Why do all people consider you as superior? Do you tell me this truly and fully.

data.v: नासूयामि सदा विप्रान्ब्रह्माणं च पितामहम् । शास्त्राणि वदतो विप्रान्संमन्यामि यथासुखम् ॥
data.md: Shambara said I never entertain any ill feelings towards the Brahmanas. Whatever instructions they give, I accept with unqualified reverence. When the Brahmanas are engaged in explaining the scriptures, I listen to them with great happiness.

data.v: श्रुत्वा च नावजानामि नापराध्यामि कर्हिचित् । अभ्यर्च्याननुपृच्छामि पादौ गृह्णामि धीमताम् ॥
data.md: Having heard their interpretations I never disregard them. Nor do I ever offend against the Brahmanas in any way. I always adore intelligent Brahmanas. I always seek information from them. I always adore their feet.

data.v: ते विश्रब्धाः प्रभाषन्ते संयच्छन्ति च मां सदा । प्रमत्तेष्वप्रमत्तोऽस्मि सदा सुप्तेषु जागृमि ॥
data.md: Approaching me with confidence, they always address me with affection and enquire after my wellbeing. If they ever happen to be careless, I am always careful. If they happen to sleep, I always remain awake.

data.v: ते मा शास्त्रपथे युक्तं ब्रह्मण्यमनसूयकम् । समासिञ्चन्ति शास्तारः क्षौद्रं मध्विव मक्षिकाः ॥
data.md: Like bees drenching the cells of the comb with honey, the Brahmanas, who are my zstructors and rulers, always drench me with the nectar of knowledge who am always devoted to the path pointed out by the scriptures, wlw am devoted to the Brahmanas and who am perfectly shorn of malice or evil passion.

data.v: यच्च भाषन्ति ते तुष्टास्तत्तद्गृह्णामि मेधया । समाधिमात्मनो नित्यमनुलोममचिन्तयन् ॥
data.md: I always accept with cheerful hearts whatever they say. Helped by memory and understanding. I am always careful of my own faith in them and I always think of my own inferiority to them.
